text.en:
Yes, it's a disaster. The forests are now filled with insane Treants, unusually overgrown plants, crystals, and Ambrosia streams that can harm travelers.

I suspect it's caused by the imprisonment of the Goddess of Nature in our world. Trapped by darkness, she spawns these... nightmares that break into the real world.

Nobody knows what to do with the shadow woods. They keep growing, absorbing more and more new territories.

Айденус и Яскер – два лидера государств в сложной ситуации. Они уже давно не контролируют происходящее в Сарнауте, и всё, что они могут сделать – это реагировать на новую угрозу. События на Джигране в очередной раз перевернули всё с ног на голову. И если для Айденуса возвращение Скракана - безусловное подспорье, то для Яскера – возвращение Незеба это опасный вызов и потенциальный кризис! Кто знает, не развернётся ли в Империи междуусобная борьба?

Впрочем, пока оба лидера контролируют происходящее. Все-таки они теперь не обязаны подчиняться Иркалле, которой пришлось убрать своих тёмных миньонов из столиц, да и общая угроза Тэпа пока работает на сплочение. Однако, кто знает, как дальше всё повернётся?

While the Elves do not have the same problems as the Gibberlings and Orcs, they also have reasons to be unhappy with the League. The war, and especially the war as it was on Dane, is very far from the ideals of Beauty and Pleasure. Irretrievable losses, when the dead did not even have a chance to be reborn, horrified the Elves. "The league was created for safety, but what did we get besides endless battles?" This is what the few supporters of isolation have been saying so far.

That is why the new ruler of the Elves Antoinette de Delice negotiated with Yasker about developing stronger peaceful relations. Yasker agreed with her initiatives and announced the beginning of a "policy of detente" accompanied by "new thinking" - meaning the understanding that the conflict between the League and the Empire can be resolved peacefully. A cultural exchange has been organized - the youth of the League can visit the allods of the Empire, and vice versa!
I see sand and blood! I see flames and lightning! I see gold and lies! Before moon rises three times, the liar will tell his stories! Trust him, and you will lose your head!
Anything you wish, champion!
Make your choice!
Are you sure you are ready to fight demons ?
Great! Let's fight the demon scum!
Make your choice!
Done!
You are welcome!

Hm, it means that I'm dead, all the same. I must admit it' not very pleasant. Last time I did not feel anything, now I feel... weakened.
I fancy if this state is caused by the artifacts we have found in the sealed crypt at ZIT... It is worth thinking about. It seems I died there, at ZIT...
Is this a check?.. I report: access level prohibits the security guards to be aware of any experiments held at the secure facility!
I’ll distribute the beewax, and you will give them hooch - I’ve been clean and sober for a while, you see, I wouldn’t want to fly off the handle.
Aren’t they beautiful? Let me make an amulet out of them...
Code Green, rose-two-six. Another skunk tried to steal a card!

name.en: Learn about the events in the Holy Land and their consequences

text.en:
Though no one expected it, the demonic threat is back. The renegade imperial mage Gorluxor, who has joined the neutral faction of the Historians, has made an attempt to claim the Gift of Tensess. Demon cultists and the demons themselves came to the Holy Land with him. It was a miracle we managed to stop them. Gorluxor was killed in the Tensess Temple, seemingly for the last time, with no chance of resurrection.

"The Great Astral Campaign is not over! The demonic threat has not been eradicated. You started celebrating too soon! The enemy is hiding and preparing to strike again," said Tensess's Soul to the heads of the state.

After seeing the evidence of the return of the demons, the League and the Empire realized that their old enemy was by no means defeated. On the contrary, he had been planning another attack for years. And while many allods were saved this time, the world still remained in mortal danger. The demons and their cultists needed to be defeated before they destroyed Sarnaut.

Realizing that the League and the Empire alone cannot hope to defeat their common enemy, the Veterans of the Great Astral Campaign united in secret, creating the "United Army", an alliance of the Empire and the League.

There was also the City of Demons. The League and the Empire kept trying to get there, but it wasn't easy. Something unexpected was waiting for the heroes in battle against Gorluxor. He wasn't alone - the room he was standing in was filled with capsules. And each capsule had Gorluxor in it. He himself had also changed considerably - from under the hem of his mantle, tentacles were visible instead of human legs. Behind him stood a strange apparatus - a device that allowed the cultists to come to life without the Gift of Tensess.

But after that device was destroyed, something amazing happened - Gorluxor's Tower shook and moved. It's like it disappeared into the ground. Alarmed, the heroes stepped closer to the pit.

As they descended into the Abyss, the heroes met a strange old man who looked more comical than threatening. And when the heroes defeated him, something incredible happened - the old man split into two parts - one was unthinkably beautiful, and the other was disgustingly terrible. A beautiful angel and a disgusting spider, so big that it filled the entire Abyss with its body. It was a hard-won victory, but it was still unclear who was behind Gorluxor.

Tep, an Arisen from the Zem people, found a way to live forever by killing his own compatriots with a deadly plague and absorbing the power of their Sparks. The mightiest sorcerers joined their forces to repel the aggression of the Summoner and contaminated Tep with his own plague. Confined in his own Pyramid and sustained by his Sparks, the Summoner was doomed to thousands of years of dying and resurrecting again... His own genius condemned him to madness.

But several millennia later Tep Cultists found a way to release their master...

The forebodings turned out to be true. Soon Umoir was struck by a mysterious Leper that turned all living beings into corrupted creatures, and once thriving groves and meadows into gloomy wastelands. Later was discovered the demonic nature of the Leper, created by Queen Catherina, whose will had been enslaved by Sarn.

The spread of the Leper was barely stopped with the help of Klavdia, who appeared out of nowhere. Catherina hastily fit out a huge ship called Eclipse and rushed to the depths of the Astral to find and destroy one of the Seals keeping Sarn confined. The greatest heroes pursued her and battled Sarn with the power of incarnated Nezeb and Skrakan - the Great Mages of the past. Catherina was released from the deleterious power of the God of Light. Then the Sarn's Avatar, which was hiding in the Ancient Mound, was destroyed, and the history of Leper on Umoir was finally put to an end.

Still the enormous power that Klavdia had stolen from Tep bothered the Great Mages of the League and the Empire. It was clear that it was nearly as great as that of the Gods. But what could Klavdia do with it? And where had Tep found a source of divine power? If it is not located, the next strike can be lethal for Sarnaut...

Events that year began with a distress signal received from the Imperial research ship, the Infinity. It was sent by Cosmos to study the deep layers of the astral plane. After summoning the Hero of Sarnaut, Cosmos asked him to find out what happened.

As it turned out, the Infinity discovered one of the Seals of Nihaz and was exposed to darkness that killed the entire crew. It turned out that Nihaz managed to create a new subspecies of demons - demons of Darkness who can influence the very Spark of creatures.

These demons were about to become a serious threat to Sarnaut, but then Zayan proposed a plan: to create an army of undead that would not possess the Sparks and therefore would be immune to such influences. At Catherina's suggestion, Foul Dale on Umoir was chosen as the gathering place for this army. And Klavdia Kalugina proposed to strike with this army at Nihaz and whatever he hides behind this Seal.

To create the army of the undead, a talented warlock was needed - it was Dakkar de Desirae. In addition, one of Urd's scrolls was discovered in Dale. Urd was an ancient Xadaganian summoner who possessed knowledge that greatly aided the creation of such an army. In addition, they managed to conclude an alliance with vampires, exiles from the House de Doucer, and subdue the ghosts of Gipat.

On Gipat, Dakkar and the Hero of Sarnaut found a very important testimony about the past of Nihaz and Klavdia Kalugina: "One day a very eloquent Traveler visited the court of the Mother and Father. The traveler confused many people, and Klavdia's sister was one of them. Those events started the Great War."

So far, it was difficult to interpret this data. After putting heroes of the past (Danas, Naira, Fergard, Reniesta, and Gorislav Averchenko) at the head of the army of undead generals, Dakkar and Nyan were able to restore Annette de Tristesse's mind - a vampire who also joined their army, becoming the commander of all vampires.

They also needed to get the Key to the Seal. It was obtained with Klavdia's help: she took the Hero of Sarnaut to the island Heart of Fire where the dragons kept the Key of Chaos. They got the key, but it turned out that Agrus and the other dragons were building an army of Draconids. They intended to attack the League and Empire in the near future.

After the army of the undead was ready, they were loaded aboard the Eclipse which headed for the Seal. The resistance of the demons and Nihaz's servants was enormous, but none of them stood a chance against the undead who simply swept away all the barriers. The only problem for Sarnaut's heroes was Hedus-Avior-Mirach, the Void Dragon, torn apart by Nihaz and distorted by darkness. While the commanders were planning another attack, it gave everyone a brief respite.

Heroes were once again summoned by Klavdia Kalugina who revealed her plan: her target was Nihaz's Citadel hidden behind the Seal. While the heroes and the undead attacked the bastions head-on, Klavdia was able to sneak into the lower levels where she found the coordinates of another world, the world of Klavdia's mother, a powerful deity capable of defeating Nihaz.

To reach her, Klavdia decided to build her own Star Gates – the Gates-3 project was started on Suslanger.

However, a new player intervened: a mysterious saboteur caused the "Incident" which led to the release of large amounts of a new resource - the Ambrosia. This saboteur also stole a key part of the Gates-3 project and disappeared.

Klavdia asked the heroes to resolve the situation - and they managed to learn something. They met a mysterious girl named Alice on Suslanger. Apparently she was behind the "Incident". However, Alice managed to fool everyone for a long time, and no one was able to figure out her true motives.

name.en: Ask about the events on Ammer

text.en:
The Expeditions of the League and the Empire discovered a new race of Aoidoi which appeared from the Well of Souls after the deaths of Sarn and the Architect. Well of Souls was the concentration of the power of the two dead deities. A terrible explosion gave rise to a separate allod - Ammer. Time there went much faster at first, and a powerful astral storm protected it from outside threats. But when the storm abated, demons started appearing on the allod.

Their victim was Domina Aellona, one of the rulers of the Aoidoi, a member of the Council of Domini. Another Dominus - Kyros who fell in love with Aellona -was immortal. Learning about the possibility of resurrection thanks to the Gift of Tensess, Kyros wanted to resurrect Aellona - but all in vain. Then Kyros decided that universal immortality is a poison that destroys this world, and that it was necessary to destroy Purgatory and the Servant of Tensess.

He managed to get the support of another race from Ammer, the centaurs. Once upon a time, Kyros defeated their leader Citovras in a duel, and now the centaurs respected the warrior of the Aoidoi immensely. The mysterious Wanderer also took his side, revealing the Secret Paths to Kyros. These paths were guarded by a strange creature called Simargl who loved riddles.

Kyros was stopped at the last possible moment, when he was already fighting the Servant. Altered by darkness, the immortal Aoidos vanished.

After these events, the other Dominus handed over power over the Well of Souls to Klavdia, Zayan, and Catherina. They created their own Orders of Followers.

Soon a new Dominus appeared from the Well of Souls - Cosmos. He decided to hold Dionic Games. During the games, Cosmos showed everyone that Nihaz was ready to retaliate. Apparently, Nihaz was behind the Wanderer who helped Kyros.

Cosmos used the Observatory, a unique creation that had its own mind, to send the hero of Sarnaut first to the past, where he saved Skulnar the Fierce, and then to the future, where the hero managed to bring the Sculptor to the present right before the world was destroyed by Nihaz. Later the Sculptor became the chief Architect for all architects in Sarnaut.

Cosmos announced that Nihaz was ready to destroy Sarnaut - and the only chance for the League and Empire to unite, ending all wars. If the leaders of states refused to do this, then Cosmos threatened to erase them from history with the help of the Observatory. That was when the League and Empire signed a peace treaty.
Good luck!
Good luck!

Artifacts are a true marvel!

You can find them in the most dangerous corners of Sarnaut. In Deep Astral and Distortions, on battlefields and group adventures you will certainly loot some. If you are a gifted craftsman, you can even craft them yourself!

If an artifact doesn't look good enough for you, you can transform it on the Anvil of Artifacts. I will help you with that. But remember: you can only transform artifacts that you created yourself! The ones that you looted in adventures can be easily disassembled with tools, unless they are cursed, of course.

name.en: Ask for a starter's equipment set

text.en: Here, take it. This is all equipment you need, adjusted to your size and level.

Glad to see you.

I'm a Relic Master. There are only two of us in Sarnaut.

As soon as the first Relic of the ancient heroes was discovered, it became clear that such artifacts can be transformed, and the demand for my crafting skills was increased. Everyone needs a craftsman who has a knack for all these swords and armor. I used to be a blacksmith, you know... But under the guidance of the Great Yasker I was reforged, so to say...

Well, what would you like to know about my job?

The Empire is well known for valuing its citizens. That's why only in the Empire can you meet the all of your important officials.
Absolutely anyone can visit Yasker's Tower and personally meet with the leader of the City Council, the Imperial Sentinels, the Orcs, or the Arisen. You can even meet Yasker himself! No official is above meeting with the citizens they serve!

name.en: Ask about the Demon Hunters' quartermasters

text.en: It's not easy to find the Demon Hunters! They never stay long in one place. But we know from intelligence reports that a small expedition stopped on a recently discovered archipelago called the Dragon Ring. And if you want to earn the trust of the Hunters and get their equipment, find Rustle the Forester, Sofia Lozhkina, and Vasily Gurov in their camp.

name.en: Ask about the Master's Army quartermaster

text.en: The Keeper of Peace, who serves the Master in the Citadel on the Isle of Revelation, is ready to provide those who join the ranks of his army with items of their allies - the Wormfaces and Draconids. And the Equilibrium Keeper can be found on the Twilight Isle at the outpost of the Master's forces.

In addition to fighting the League and other enemies in the open world, the brave defenders of the Empire can take part in battles at special training grounds. Here, death means nothing, because everyone is resurrected by the Great Mages. And those who win can receive special rewards. You can learn more from the quartermasters of the respective skirmishes. You can find them on the second floor of Yasker’s Tower. Ernest Sechin will tell you about the Guild Dominion, Slap the Furious - about rating combats, and Yaskul Sekhet - about random skirmishes. In addition, you can also find merchants selling rare goods there, like trophies from the battlefields.

Sarang Gahidzha is the holder of a dubious record - he disassembled his own tomb into individual stones in one hour and seventeen minutes. He's located on the top floor of Yasker's Tower and is available to train all new disassemblers.

The Freeborn are a coalition of various minor races that have gathered in Pridonsk in the Dead Sea. The Empire turns a blind eye to their activities since they see no harm in it. However, evil tongues say that they are in cahoots with the drug mafia. And others say they are at feud with them. If you figure out what's actually going on, you can get rewards from Purk the Hasty and Grum the Thrifty.

Semer Khendjer is the Imperial Guild Master. He oversees the creation of guilds. Guilds are official organizations formed by citizens for the purpose of pursuing a common goal.
Membership in a guild is highly encouraged by the Empire - I'm sure you'll find the benefits are invaluable. You should visit him on the top floor of Yasker's Tower.

Runes are special items that are linked to the power of the Great Martyrs. They can increase your power when placed in your weapons and armor. Every citizen should meet with Master Semer Nemar for an in-depth tutorial about the use of runes. He can be found on the top floor of Yasker's Tower.

name.en: Ask about the Servants of the Light

text.en:
The Order of Compassion was founded under Yasker's orders in the year 972. The goal of the Order is to spread of the teachings of the Trinity Church and help Imperial citizens wherever they are found.
Its members are called the Servants of the Light, and they consist of both courageous Xadaganian girls and the wise women of the Arisen. They sell drops of mirra which will aid you greatly in your travels.

Our world is full of various mounts - both living and mechanical. Progress does not stand still! There is always something new coming out. Vladimir Kostin, an experienced horse breeder, can tell you all about them. He is well versed in technology - he can tell you about assault shells, for example. You can find him in Victory Park.

So you've reached a high level of development? It's time to get a new kind of equipment - regular quartermasters can't help you anymore. You can get it from Naia Windina who can be found in the Astral Academy next to the forge. It's not the best possible equipment, but it should do for a start. Naia will give you a full set of items, and you can change their stats using special insignias.

Do you think you might make a decent agitator? Your skills will not go to waste, because the Free Traders, with Yasker's permission, have launched a special program to get new heroes to participate in adventures in our world.  And you can help them. You can find out the details from Angelika Berezkina, a representative of the Tycoons. She can be found near the bank in Yasker's Tower.

The oracle Sarbaz Segret can be found outside of Yasker's Tower. If you don't know what you should do in life, or if you're afraid you'll miss something important in the future, then I would suggest you talk to him. His visions are invaluable.

After the events on Ammer, there are three Orders in our world - the Order of Progress, the Order of Creation, and the Order of Balance. By joining them, and gaining Order Prestige, you will be able to acquire special prizes that Caeda, the Order Quartermaster, can bestow on you. You can find her in the Astral Academy.

The postal service was created to ease communications between citizens of the Empire. Employees of the service, called postal workers, can be found anywhere. They are always ready to tell you everything you need to know about letters and packages, and to quickly deliver your correspondences.

As I said before, the Empire puts a lot of effort into uncovering the secrets of the world. Recently a Xadaganian named Mark Staritsyn was appointed the Keeper of Secrets.
It's his job to systematically research and solve these mysteries. All citizens that have information regarding any riddles, mysteries, secrets, or even gossip are instructed to report to him.
Every Imperial citizen can now build their own Astral ship after proving their loyalty to the Empire. To learn more about this you should visit the Astral Academy at the Nezebgrad Port to the north.

To the north of Nezebgrad there is a port where ships regularly travel through the Astral to other parts of the Empire. Recently, most of the Empire's efforts are focused on transporting Imperial soldiers to the Holy Land where a war is raging.

name.en: Ask about the Commander of the Imperial Sentinels

text.en: These days Crazystorm the Merciless holds the position of Commander of the Imperial Sentinels. He completely re-examined the goals of the Sentinels and redirected all of their activities. Their main goal is no longer to fight the Astral demons, but to combat the insidious actions of the League.

Portals are a quick and reliable way to move between different territories. Now, thanks to increased prosperity and recent developments in science and magic, portals have been set up across all parts of the Empire. To learn more speak with the Portal Keeper Roman Mishin who is located in the Bort Quarter.
And what makes you think I'll give you that? As if I were just going to sign some papers all of a sudden. Hmph... I thought the citizens of the Empire had a higher opinion of us.

name.en: Embark on a flight to your allod

text.en:
And who's going to sign the safety course completion form?
You already have? Then go!

name.en: Find out about the allod creation

text.en:
Based on the technologies our agents got from the Master, we have developed a technology which allows us to make matter out of the Astral. Without going into details, I will say that a great future awaits us! We are now making the first steps to restoring the world as we knew it, the way it was the Cataclysm.
Unfortunately, we still can't create large allods, but being able to build even a small one is an achievement that speaks for itself. The Great Yasker has ordered that these allods be bestowed to the Empire's Great Heroes. So you have a pretty good chance of becoming the legal owner of your very own allod. All you have to do is get some meteorite iron, which is required to protect the allod from being absorbed by the Astral.

name.en:
Get a Ruby for the Art of Creation World Mystery (level 60).

Requires 50 shards.

text.en: Go now, and may your new skills serve the Empire well!
Go now, and may your new skills serve the Empire well!

name.en:
Get a Ruby for the Sarnaut's Gods World Mystery (level 70).

Requires 60 shards.

text.en: Go now, and may your new skills serve the Empire well!

name.en:
Get a Ruby for the Demon Cultists World Mystery (level 45).

Requires 20 shards.

text.en: Go now, and may your new abilities serve the Empire well!
Go now, and may your new abilities serve the Empire well!
Go now, and may your new skills serve the Empire well!
I see. I wish all our citizens were as diligent as you!
A paper confirming you are not a League spy? Hold on a second, I'll sign it for you.
No, I've ordered another cape! Be more attentive.
Great! Now you bring me the next headpiece on the list.

Ah, so you're here about the rune!
Yes, I do have one for you. Here, take this. Thanks for the delivery!

Greetings!

We Mercenaries are not just after easy money, we are disciplined and experienced warriors, that surpass the soldiers of the imperial army by a long shot. Why? It's simple - those who prefer to earn a living with the sword and not with the plow, but do not want to feel like a square peg in a round hole, join the Mercenaries. From the point of view of the law, we are private military subcontractors that follow a special regime. We serve the Empire, but that doesn't mean that we can't make a profit. So if you need reliable, trained warriors at a reasonable price - you won't find better than us!

You can hire one Mercenary, or five if you want. So, shall we start discussing the contract?
Demon damn it, exactly what I've been hiding from!

name.en: Trade 5 Gifts of Infatuation for a Gift of True Love

text.en: Love is the most beautiful feeling!

We can only win if humans and demons join forces! So we'll have to wait for the right moment to advance from both sides at the same time! Would you like to know when that's going to happen? Check your calendar - all the details have been added to it.

Would you like to join my squad? When the time comes, just find me and fight beside me.
The thoughts you catch erupt into a gamut of emotions, the majority being fury, hatred and bloodlust.
Goodbye! I'm sure we'll meet another day...
Good luck!
Good luck!
Good luck!
Good luck!
Good luck!
Good luck!
Good luck!
Good luck!
Good luck!
Let's begin. I would pray for a miracle, but I would not know who to ask. We can only rely on ourselves, I guess.
Teleporting...
Teleporting...
Teleporting...
Teleporting...
Teleporting...
Teleporting...
Teleporting...
Teleporting...
Teleporting...
Teleporting...

Astral is the basis for everything. This is the source of any entity, primal substance in its pure form, creating and destroying things.
Astral is composed of differing layers, so far you are only familiarized with the first one. But there is also life in the faraway Astral corners.
Don't be like a blind man assured that the world is limited by the length of his stick. Throw away your stick and you will see the light.
Remember, you have a unique opportunity - you can discover all secrets of the Astral, step into its depths. But no one knows what awaits you there. One thing I'm sure of - the things that do not kill you make you stronger.

You have already found four Astral Crystals.
Imperial Jade is a gem of travelers. It will protect you on your way.
Citrine is a symbol of cunning. It will save you from enemy intrigues and cheating during your journeys.
Amethyst will calm your mind.
Agate will warn you of oncoming danger.
But it's not enough to go further. You need two more gems.
No traveler will survive without a bit of luck, that's why you need Turquoise gem.
Besides, you can't continue your journey without Malachite. This gem binds the entire universe to our world.
When you gather all keys, Astral Gateway will open.
In the deeper layers you will meet much more powerful enemies. Perhaps you will find there new keys allowing you to dive into deeper layers. Take your chance and fight against the strongest opponents.
This is a challenge, a great trial. Pass the test, and you will be glorified. Fail, and no one will remember you. Choose your destiny!

Oh you’ve made a nice tangle, haven’t you? Haven’t I warned you to choose sides carefully? So what are you going to do now?

Do you think defeating an evil god and obtaining the godly power is what it takes? Of course... NOT! All the force that you’ve got will never outpower the real thing!

No, the real thing to fear is not Sarn. He’s safely shackled, don’t thank me. What threatens your world, is dark, huge and deadly. Even I wouldn’t mess with it! But now I’ll just step back and enjoy the view! I love tragedy!
I’ve said enough. Bye for now, mortal! See you soon!

Freedom is my dream! I can see the day that my shackles will fall off, and I will rize! The world will lay in dust, and then it will be reborn! I will be avenged, and my enemies will pay for everything!

Noone can stop me! Decide now, what you want - eternal life or oblivion?
It’s your own choice, mortal. I will meet you again, and at the last instant of your life you will observe my power!
Gather up forces! Call in for everybody, whether they are good or evil, for what is coming, is a hundred times more dangerous!

name.en: Ask Alk to touch the crystal

text.en: Lovely stone! I'll give you a dozen of cobra fangs for it! You would not exchange it, would you? Then why did you show it? To tease me?
Me watch and learn!
Son of the Wind have tricky things. I believe you outlander, I'll touch this stone.
Hidden
Cheers!

Well, better than in that dreadful castle anyway. Sometimes all those Houses’ policies just get too old... But then I remember that I could have been still trapped in that coffin in the chapel, and then preparing for the Ball doesn’t feel so awful after all.

Dakkar has to try really hard to maintain his authority, and I am doing my best to help him with that. His reputation has suffered enough since he chose a non-elf as a life partner.

Oh, I'm not sure... I can't say... We fought for three days and captured the Watchtower. You should have seen the assault - it was legendary! And not a scratch on me... I was that lucky! But later that night, in the camp... Ignatius Chernov... He offered to take a walk...
There are other things besides war, you know! Just one kiss, oh... I swear it! A single kiss... And that was it... When dawn broke I couldn't get up. A veil of darkness hung before my eyes. What's wrong with me? Help me! Help... Oh...
Poof! Take care!

The adventures of Ath-Zak began here in Gipat. An ancient record called the "Cursed Lands" tells about his adventures in Gipat, Ignos, and Suslanger. I recommend that you read it. It's quite fascinating.
The story ends happily. Ath-Zak recovers his memory, finds his sweetheart, and together with Tka-Rik, the June Great Mage, he defeats the ancient Curse. You will find more detail in the book.

The Catacombs consist of three circles.
The outer circle is relatively safe. The central circle represents a moderate threat to adventurers, and the third circle is the most dangerous.
Remember, the Catacombs are ever-changing. You can't use the same route twice. Doors you opened once may suddenly lock. Walls are moving, portals swap their exits. Everything is so unstable...

What's that? An amulet that protects me from fear? Thank you, but I'm afraid it won't work for me. I don't believe in such things. Once I drank a bravery potion that an alchemist brewed for me and I fainted right away from fear of terrible side effects...
Make sure you don't lose it again!
I guess we're stuck here.
What're we going to do?
Life is all about eating!
How can I help you?
Keep in mind that damage and healing effects of your abilities will be reduced!

Gee, you have found my Teddy! Thank you, thank you, I'm so glad!
I thought he'd left me forever, but he just lost the way, and now you've found him!
Your nose is cold, and you are cold, let me warm you a little bit!
Done!
You again. Alive and whole. A pity.
As you wish! Get ready!
Apologies accepted. Come on, I fully understand your concerns. League's welfare comes first!
Hurry up! I cannot hold it forever.
Good luck!
Jungles? Hmm, why not? Not bad. Looks good, nice and green. So, shall we stick with the jungles, or take a look at some other options?

The whiteness of pure snow, the impregnability of gray stony precipices, blinding sun that makes your eyes water, and frost that nibbles at your ears. Each to their own! Shall we stick with the snow, or change to something else?

Phew! That was the most interesting job in my life! Can you believe it - we've created a whole allod with our own hands! Thank you for this possibility. If you need some assistance in the future, do not hesitate to call on us!

Hello! And who are you?

You’re looking for Ademar? Yes, he’s been here for a while. I look after him - feed him and everything, but nothing works.

His heart and soul are shrouded in sorrow ever since his daughter Annette went missing. I don’t know what to do, I’ve tried everything. There’s only one option left, but it’s not something I can do myself.

Are you a great hero? Will you help, then? Go to White Lake, speak with the Bird Oracle Gamayun. Do what it says, and you might be able to help Ademar.

You a like a child. Always pick up dirt. It’s good you’re not trying to put it in your mouth.

Everything in this land has become corrupted. Every little thing, humans, animals, trees and flowers, all turn into dread. We call this disease "Leper". Only gods know how to cure it. We’ve tried both fire and wizardry, all in vain. Even Catherina herself, the Queen of Umoir, is only able as much as to restrain it, not to turn it the other way round.

This is not a good time to visit this place...
Thank you! What would I have done without you? My mother and father will be so happy!
Get ready. Let’s start with someone simple, like Midnight Dweller, for example.
That didn’t even make you sweat! Alright, let’s try something more complicated.
Take your pick!
Take your pick!

I've never seen the wood of such a remarkable quality! I wish the trees like these grew all around.
Wait a minute... He-e-eh! As it usually is... A heap of remnants and five decent bows. Give them to our allies, I fear they will need them very soon.

name.en: Purchase items to upgrade the tool

text.en: Purchase items to upgrade the tool

name.en: Purchase items to upgrade the tool

text.en: Purchase items to upgrade the tool
Anything you wish, champion!
Excellent! Bring it on! Everybody's dancing, you and me!
Yes, you've become favored among women! That means I have something for you... I hope you enjoy it!

Can you feel the spring coming? Forces of nature are awakening, blood pounding in your veins! Do you feel the urge to perform something outstanding? Heroic?
By order of Aidenus, everyone must be given an opportunity to perform heroic deeds - and to celebrate the victory, of course. Buy Victorious Banner of the League from Silantiy Vinegarov, equip it and go out the the battlefield. Fight the Imperial players and receive the proof of your deed for every defeated player. Defeat more enemies all over Sarnaut, and receive valuable reward!
And don't miss your chance to take part in barbecue contest! A hungry warrior cannot fight! If you eat well, you will defeat more enemies and receive more rewards! Don't you think so?
 Aidenus himself will take part in the celebrations. He will give a speech near his tower every hour. Come and listen! All the guests will receive greeting cards. And if you bring your Guest of Honor papers, they will be stamped to certify that you've witnessed the ceremony.

Can you feel the spring coming? Forces of nature are awakening, blood pounding in your veins! Do you feel the urge to perform something outstanding? Heroic?
By order of Yasker, everyone must be given an opportunity to perform heroic deeds - and to celebrate the victory, of course. Buy Victorious Banner of the Empire from Timur Kefirin, equip it and go out the the battlefield. Fight the League players and receive the proof of your deed for every defeated player. Defeat more enemies all over Sarnaut, and receive valuable reward!
And don't miss your chance to take part in barbecue contest! A hungry warrior cannot fight! If you eat well, you will defeat more enemies and receive more rewards! Don't you think so?
 Yasker himself will take part in the celebrations. He will give a speech near his tower every hour. Come and listen! All the guests will receive greeting cards. And if you bring your Guest of Honor papers, they will be stamped to certify that you've witnessed the ceremony.
Make your choice!
Make your choice!
Make your choice!
Make your choice!

Greetings!

Now when the fire was ceased on the frontline, the League and the Empire have finally made a step towards understanding. In order to establish friendly relations, it was decided to arrange a joint resort at the Tropical Atoll.

Oh, it's the best place in the world! Sunlit beaches, sand and palms! Smoothies, contests, prizes and fireworks... You should travel there, you won't regret!

There is no better place in Sarnaut than this hospitable island. A friendly tribe of the Great Turtle welcomes both Imperial citizens and League subjects. There is no place for long-standing fights at the resort - there is only sun, water, sand and entertainment. Crab racing, pub marathon, race and swim along the seashore, slot machines - there's entertainment for every fancy! To go there, you just need to buy a ticket from me given you have reached level 20.
Bon voyage!

name.en: Ask if Vsemil Snowdrop may help

text.en: No, thank you. No help needed at the moment. Perhaps, tonight we’ll need some, though.
Thank you! Here are your cards!

name.en: Exchange Silver Dust costume for two New Year cards

text.en: Thank you! Here are your cards!

name.en: Exchange Polar Star costume for two New Year cards

text.en: Thank you! Here are your cards!
Thank you! Here are your cards!

Happy blissful New Year!
If you like the New Year's celebration, I'll gladly help you decorate the town with fir trees and garlands, make a snowman or play snowballs! And if you have holiday postcards, I'll exchange them for presents and souvenirs.

name.en: Exchange your souvenirs for New Year cards

text.en: Make your choice!

I had a dream, and in that dream there was some place forgotten by everyone...

And strange words came to mind... Here, listen.

I see it so clearly:

The tree is dying,

The ancient enemy has been awakened,

There is no rest for the dead!

Deadly Frost will come,

And countless enemies

Whose skin is white.

I see it through time.

Blood ties get stronger:

Pilgrim's children

Will take ragged weaving

And tie it into a whole.

What does it mean? I don’t know... But apparently there's a long road ahead of you... And there really is no rest for the dead! Anyway, the new ruler is a troubling one...

Give me your hand...
Look, can you see this line? There is a castle looming over a bleak and joyless village. The mysteries that are hidden deep within Darkwater you will discover.
These lines cross - Izbor Yavorsky, the head of the League Defenders, will give you a task himself. A druid and a priest are in dire need of aid.
A mournful wail of an unfortunate soul that is trapped by a force that is powerful and ugly. I fear that this force is going to be looking for you!

name.en: Ask for a prediction for level 26

text.en:
I didn't expect to see you so soon, but it's good that you've come. I saw you in my dream last night...
You went to go see our ambassador Klavdius Trojanov, he had a very important task for you. He sent you into a dark place and there were terrible enemies around every corner! Then I woke up in a cold sweat.
Do not go to the dark place alone!

name.en: Ask for a prediction for level 27

text.en:
How about you join me for a cup of tea? When you've finished, please give me your cup. Time for reading tea leaves.
Oh, look! Clearly, the leaves show the long and winding road - you will soon take a trip to Eljune to take care of many important matters!
A coin... Careful with Klavdius Trojanov's quest!
There's a shield and a mace... you will be helping Mikhail Selyaninov!
Drink some more. Now there's a tree - the gentle forestfolk will puzzle you with their dilemmas and you will uncover a great secret.
A storm cloud now! A terrible darkness is corrupting the Site of Power.
Drink. The Church of Light is in need of help. You must help them!
The last leaf remains... A monk robe means Zosim Nikulin will need you.
Hurry, dear... to Eljune!

name.en: Ask for a prediction for level 31

text.en:
We'll use the cards today. Do you see this? Two of Diamonds - for great struggle. I believe that Coba Plateau is in need of a hero! A grand problem awaits those, who...
Demon Hunters and Historians are in need for aid! In return they will help you.

name.en: Ask for a prediction for level 37

text.en:
Look me in the eye, dear, and try not to blink.
Judging by the expression of your eyes, you already know what lies in store for you. And yes, you are right.
I have seen a dragon! There will be a Great Dragon. Go see Izbor Yavorsky again before you leave. Although, perhaps he wouldn't know about the dragon himself...

I don't need the cards this time to tell you what you should do. Go see Aidenus immediately.
I've recently had some very bad premonitions... evil is hovering all around us. I'm sure that Aidenus is aware of it and has a new task to give to you.
The Great Mage will send you to a place unknown, but do trust him. Trust in those who have already fought the evil, the veterans of the Great Astral Campaign!

Perfect timing! Yesterday I had a prophetic dream!
I saw owls, thousands of owls - it's an omen! An omen of something massive! They were heading to Novograd and each of them had a letter in their beak. Inside the letters were weird stones.
Check your mailbox right away. Important news will lead you to the new lands, new adventures, and new secrets.

name.en: Ask for a prediction for level 45

text.en:
This is so sad! This mysterious Director who encourages everyone to find the Revelation is drawing more and more attention! People are talking about the secrets of the past, and no one cares about the future anymore! I tried glancing into the future.
Do you know what it holds? Darkness! Impenetrable darkness! I saw nothing!
Director serves his tricks, that's for sure. Maybe I should find this Revelation myself to dispel the darkness!

After the God of Darkness ran away, I recovered my ability to see through the veil of time!
Your future is tough and tricky. I see a coffin! This is a bad omen.Your eyes are empty and your heart is frozen. I see the endless sky reflected in the endless ocean. The sky and the sea are divided with lies and surrounded with deceit spoken by a madman trying to conquer the whole world...
There's a long road, to the stone house and many battles that would change the world forever. That's your destiny!

Show me your palm, darling.

You have a long road ahead of you, through the thicket of the forest, through ice and heat... I can see an awful disease in those far lands, the disease that you will have to fight. A mighty ship in the swirling Astral, two girls, ginger-haired and raven-haired, one laughing, one sobbing. Both are full of pride, but the pride won't do them good. I can see you walking hand in hand with one, fighting the other one, but they both will help you defeat the disaster, however unwilling they will seem to be...

I can see you talking to the ancient Gods, born before the Light, willing to save the world and your own soul from the disaster that is to come! I can also see that their time has gone, and young Gods will arrive, with burning hearts and glowing eyes... These Gods will shape the future and the fate of the world.

This is all I know, and there's nothing else. Go. May your road be straight.

Ah, I don't even need to hold your hand or read tea leaves! I can see everything only by looking at your face.

Soon a madman will ask you for help, and you won't be able to refuse. A new road, long and winding, is waiting for you.

I can see you walking across the land that once used to be thriving. But now there where once was forest, only black stumps are left. I can see plumes of smoke above white-stone fortresses. Fire and death, as far as the eye can see - the wings of war are unfolded above that allod. And you are at the forefront, as always. But don't you lose courage - an army of allies is right behind you!

And your enemy... No. No! It can't be! Again that horror, that blue oblivion with no life or soul! Ah, I can sense a power that's above gods and stronger than the Light... The time itself abides it. And I can't see what lies at the end of the road.

Please, be careful in your ventures. A single wrong move can ruin the whole world!

name.en: Ask for a prediction for level 6

text.en:
I'm looking in my divination sphere, and I'm seeing you exploring all of our beautiful Novograd. You will meet an important Elf and a cheerful Gibberling. They will offer very significant jobs...
Now you're clashing with the rebels in northern Lightwood. You will learn many new things. But above all else, I see you embarking on a perilous mission into a fortress captured by the enemy.
Be careful!

Greetings, my friend.

My prediction is really simple this time. Skulnar the Fierce will contact you. I can't tell you the reason.

But there's one thing I do know. You and I will meet again.

I'm leaving Novograd now. I'm going to the Holy Land. I had a bad dream, and my cards have been silent. So I'm thinking about getting a new deck from the Free Traders.

You should find Skulnar the Fierce. As far as I know, he's on Coldberg now.

name.en: Ask if Vsemil Snowdrop may help

text.en: Negative! Everybody’s having fun!
You are doing important work for Sarnaut! Best suppliers send their wares here to aid your cause.
Only guild members with the Officer title or higher can do this!
Only guild members with the Officer title or higher can do this!

A self-propelled combat device which delivers defensive fire. Only suits for ranged combat.

Falconet is the best option for those who seek great fire power for their group.

Pimen does not attack enemies but devotes himself to healing and supporting his allies. The powers of nature, to which he appeals, help him pull them even from the grip of death.

Pimen will effectively increase the survivability of your group, though don't forget that he needs constant protection.
Ah, alright, let's go!
Fly, little bird! Come back quickly!

Weeell, everything is raaather simple. The hunt starts at 7 pm and 3 am and lasts for four hours. Those who are late, will always be late... We don't wait for anyone. I will give you an Astral Splitter, a Spectral Energy Absorber, a High-Frequency Generator and a Ghost Trap.
You neeeed to find a ghost and beat it up, but don't kill it! As soon as you drain the ghost of its powers, use these devices to weaken it and catch it with our traaaap.
Now pay attention. To catch Shipwright's Ghost, you need to split its en... energy... Split its energy contour first. Draaain it with the Absorber, then use the Traaap and catch it! Use the High-something Generator to catch Cannoneer's Ghost.
To catch Steersmen, you will need Splitter and Generator.
And don't forget the Trap! Remember, this equipment is fraaagile and exp... experim... It hasn't been tested! Sometimes it malfunctions and emits speeectral energyyy. If it haaappens, don't worry and be coool. It is unpleasant, but not deadly.

Stay right there! Thief, I'll kill you!
Wait, you are not one of them! Weeell... I'm sorry. My mistake...
My name is Iron Hoof, the Ghost Hunter. I hunt ghosts, spirits and other evil beings. How may I help?

Mortals can't keep a treasure that falls into their hands. Yes, I found the fragment you've lost. Take it back if you want.
But if you bother me again, I'll bite your head off!
Astralophone flashes, and a Fragment appears with a note saying: "Be more careful"!

A demon! What do you want? Leave me alone!
You scum! I'll find you even in the world beyond and wring your neck! Oh, sorry, I wasn't talking to you. Ignatius Chernov is a real bastard! There was a fight in the ruins and he hit me. He said, "Sorry, I swung at the skeleton and you got in the way." That blind freak! It's a flesh wound, too. Nothing to look at! So why does it burn so bad? I feel like my insides are crawling out. Ignatius, you bastard... I'll get you even in the world beyond!
You should talk to Gorislav Gipitsky first.

Who knows?

Although I have a suspicion...

I went to Windswept Foothills once... And suddenly I was stuck, couldn't move a limb. So I think we might find an answer in that place.

The elder is to blame, I tell you! He was the one who got us into this! He was up to something, I just know it. That governor is a filthy traitor, too! Ath-Zak made sure he went to hell. Have we ended up in hell, too? Do we have to put up with this hell forever?
I knew I should have left Gipatia. It would have been better to live in the mountains than sit here and do nothing but send the Chosen Ones to fetch my tools over and over. Look how many of them are here! Most of those Chosen Ones are good for nothing. If I had a copper for every one that I saw, I could have bought a palace by now! Oh well...
What did I live for? Everything's been in vain!

Orcs, I see... Even before you told me, I remembered something - fire everywhere, smoke obscured my vision, and huge shadows danced around as screams filled the air... I thought I caught a glimpse of a nightmare but then I realized that it had been real. It had all been real...
If the dragons keep on pursuing their own goals and don't make adjustments, it seems that we'll have to remain as ghosts until the end of time. It's alright... I suppose we'll get used to it...

name.en: Call Spirit of Order for guidance

text.en: Spirit of Order heeds your call...

name.en: Give them a glass of porter

text.en:
What a brilliant idea!
My throat is quite dry. So many people have listened to my sermons, but many have yet to hear them so I must keep talking!
A drink is just what I need.

What? I don't want to talk to anyone... Leave me alone, leave me alone! No, wait... Tell me if the elder or anyone else said anything about me. Do they want to throw me out of the village? No?
Oh, I'd be better off dead! I can't remember anything! Can you hear me? Nothing! I can't recall that fight with Ath-Zak either! Don't you dare forget that! Oh, oh, oh...

So that's how things went... Orcs destroyed the entire village, didn't they? Yes, it was as soon as Ath-Zak left. It's all because I, the militia's commander, was already dead. The barbarians must have grown bolder. They wouldn't have dared to attack the village if I were alive.

Orcs? Those bastards? How could they have caught us unaware? It probably happened after we bid farewell to Ath-Zak, so that he could continue his journey. I drank too much that evening and I can't remember what's happened since then. That's when I must've been killed. How unfair! I can't even remember my last fight...
While Ath-Zak and I were wandering across Gipat we talked a lot, you know. He said something about repressed memories! He had lost his memory then too. Maybe I'll remember everything over time just like he did.

name.en: Give them a pair of sandals

text.en: Ah, the Chosen One, the Chosen One!

name.en: Give them a pair of sandals

text.en: Ah, the Chosen One, the Chosen One!
Good luck!

name.en: Ask what the portal guardian needs

text.en: Here, I'll cast a spell on you that'll allow you to understand the needs of the portal guardian.
Are you sure you want to bind to this location?

name.en: Ask for the Signet Ring of the House de Doucer

text.en: Yes, I found it right after you left. Take it and don't lose it anymore. It's not good to throw away such important things!
Oh, if you insist! If you freeze to death, let it be so! Let's get started!
My brothers allow me to take rule for an hour! And should I say, I do not mind!
Summer always comes after winter and spring. There is no way that I deal with you before my elder brothers, January and March.

The first thing we've seen here were palm trees in deep snow. Then we spotted June ruins, and boy, were we happy about it! Junes mean treasure!
So we tried and landed here. Ran upon rocks and got stuck. We should have set and gone on the spot, but greed is blind - we landed and dispatched scouts. That's where those scarecrows got on us. I barely escaped, but Nicholas, my companion, was captured and imprisoned.
Can't get him out, can't leave without, so I'm just sitting here freezing off my... back.
Will you be so kind as to find and save him? And look for the treasures, too! I'll pay you back well!
This is the Icy Heart of Ayateotle! Glory to the heroes! We're free!

name.en: There was a whole bucket of fake blood - they used it to paint on the fence.

text.en: Can you imagine that? How did they even come up with that idea...

Oh, I knew we should've kept an eye on them. But this! If it weren't for you, , we would've had a tragedy on our hands!

Did you stop Obrad? What happened to that vampire?
Alright, guys! Hold the elf while I show this fool...

Svetlana...?

You must be joking... hiccup? Don't you know Svetlana has been dead for a while?

It happened a long time ago. The old king was still alive, and he had a beautiful daughter. The Valir dynasty ruled from their castle. One day a prince visited us, a noble elf!

We marveled at him, and most of all, Svetlana herself. She fell in love, and it looked like he returned her feelings. They got married here, in the church. But then the prince left for the Ball where all elven families gathered. He was skilled in dark sorcery, and he wanted to prove himself.

He did. But he didn't know a tragedy was about to strike. When he returned to the Castle, his fiancée was lying dead in a coffin. We cried all our eyes out. The prince's face darkened, he locked the doors and started using his forbidden magic. He wanted to bring Svetlana back.

But it didn't work. As soon as the sun was down, a wind rose and blew out all candles in the castle. Screams followed - the dead started breaking out of their graves, eating the servants alive! Everyone fled in terror, trying to get away as far as they could. So did I... though I wish I'd died there.

I'm here now, living out the rest of my life...

name.en: Maybe you know why the locals suddenly hate Gala and her elves?

text.en:
Who knows? People are like sheep - they do what they are told. Perhaps one of the nobles said something about Gala and the vamps, and they got spooked.

And who suffers the most? Me! Look what they did to my cart!
I'm a harness maker, and I can do a lot of useful things. Repair armor and equipment, for example.

We fixed a camp not far away from here.
Chubby Family, the astral admirals, are in charge there. How fortunate that they managed to ingrain hope into our hearts and solidate our souls!..
Admirals ordered me to search for the survived and take them to the camp. I'm glad you're alive! It looks like you went through the shipwreck without a scratch, you were born under a lucky star!
Thank you!
Thank you! You saved my life!
Thank you!

Tep's cultists did it! Oh, what in the world blew me to the Frozen Peak!... First the astral pirates riddled my ship, so it finally broke to pieces above that wicked place... We thought it a miracle that we were nearly landing and everybody was safe...
Then those cultists appeared out of nowhere! They pinioned us and dragged us somewhere... My clothes were all torn! I finally found myself in a large crate... That's all that I remember...
Damn it! If only I could gain my strength to break away from here, I'll kill those bastards!
Am I dead? I could not remember... I don't remember anything at all! Oww, it hurts so bad... How could a Spark feel so much pain?
What to do next? Fire back! And should anyone break in, shred them to pieces right away - if they reach the reactor, even Zems won't put our bodies back together!

Victory? Don't you see that Octhulhu ahead of us?!

Our shields are drained; we can't face an Octulhu. We've got to hide in the Anomaly and pray it won't follow us there. Hold on tight!

What? You, snot-noses, want to fight me? Ha, ha, ha! You have lost your minds!
Do you really think that you can even scratch me?
Ungrateful mortals... Perhaps it's time to teach you some sense, and to give the next lesson myself!
I will keep it safe until you find all fragments.
I will keep it safe until you find all fragments.
Demonic Spark is a rare and mysterious substance. It's different from Sparks of all living beings created by Sarn. Servant of Nihaz in the Tka-Rik's Cave will trade these sparks for valuable rewards.

name.en: I'm ready to learn the first part of the Revelation!

text.en:
"In the battle of gods that took place in another world, one god was defeated by another. The first one was Sarn, the God of Light. Nihaz, God of Darkness, had to find the way to imprison his enemy, as gods are immortal. He decided to create a new world for the vanquished God of Light..."
These words open Tka-Rik's Revelation. Our world is a prison. Now you have to pass the first trial prepared by Nihaz. Repeat his deed and put Sarn back in chains. To do so, you must use the powers of the Magic Chain five times. Crystal Barrier granted by my armor will help you to resist the God of Light.
Shall we start the first trial? When you're ready, touch these three spheres to obtain special abilities for the forthcoming battle!
Go ahead!

name.en: I'm ready to learn the second part of the Revelation!

text.en:
Here is the next part of the Tka-Rik's Revelation:
"As long as this world exists, Sarn cannot break loose. Nihaz summoned dragons, the magical beings, to protect Sarnaut. Twelve Dragon Keepers controlled twelve parts of the world. They were the most powerful creatures, their very existence ensured that the prisoner would remain confined.
The planet created by the God of Darkness was barely habitable - only dragons capable of withstanding the extreme cold and heat could live there. They were devoted to their task for millions years, until a huge meteorite collided with Sarnaut. It destroyed a large part of the world, killing three Guardians. Shackles holding Sarn became looser..."
Wait! I feel a hostile presence... There's someone else in here... It can't be a demon, they don't get that far... A cultist?
Will you help me to kill him? Touch the sphere to obtain a special ability to destroy the Crystal Barrier! Hurry up!

I'm sorry, the plan has changed...
My people found a way to return me to life. You are going to playing your part in it, by the way, and so are the Dragons. It's hard to believe - sworn enemies have united to challenge the god!
I will no longer obey the orders of this betrayer who turned my people into the miserable underground beasts! Damn you Nihaz!
I'm going to disappear in a moment. Prepare yourself, as the protective spell that holds the demons will fall. It's an ultimate test for you! Do your best to survive.
Farewell. If it works, we'll never meet again. And remember - don't trust anyone! Neither Sarn, nor Nihaz. Everybody lies, especially gods...
Good luck!
Sorry, but you don't have enough money.
Pay 10 gold to receive the Altruism effect allowing to collect Orbs of Greed safely

name.en: I'm ready to pass the trial

text.en: Stand still, I'm going to cast a spell that will grant you three attempts...

Old family trees from the times of Kania before the Cataclysm?.. I'm afraid they're not so easy to read now - the noblemen of old were so fond of constructed Elven languages... and there was over a hundred of those, I think. Only a true expert would be able to deal with this! Though I think I know one, which is fortunate: Alexander Chatsky, the man well versed in these matters of wisdom...
Here, take this. You won't survive without it.
Let's begin. I would pray for a miracle, but I would not know who to ask. We can only rely on ourselves, I guess.
Select the weapon you like!
Select the weapon you like!
Select the weapon you like!
Select the weapon you like!
Select the weapon you like!
Select the weapon you like!
Select the weapon you like!
Select the weapon you like!

name.en: Tell about your visions of the future

text.en:
Truly amazing things you saw! Sarn and Nihaz... No, I never heard these names before. You say, they are the gods who created our world? Never heard of them, I tell thee.

Don’t be upset. Visions are nothing more than just visions. There were no such gods here. No Sarn, no Nihaz, no Tensess, only emptiness, deep black Nothingness looked me in the eye.

The only thing is quite clear: either to start or to stop the Leper can only a god, and nobody else. To tell you the truth, I thought it was Catherina at first, but no, she’s unable to.

Why would gods get angry with us? Why punish? What are our sins?..

Listen on. Catherina turned to believe in the Light. Any belief is not bad, but she found no better thing to do as to suppress old pagan shamans. She put them to prison, executed, punished in all possible and impossible manners. And then the Leper came. Common people grumbled and raged, and suffered a big deal. On the one hand, there was Catherina with her sanctions. On the other hand, there were wicked creatures from the corrupted forest. People chose for the Leper and fled to the woods.

These amulets keep the old gods’ power. Nevermind they are ancient and weak, and unable to fight the Light. Their might is safely stored in the amulets, and if you manage to find them all, I will tell you another story...
We haven’t seen a living soul here for ages!
Thank you! I am so grateful!
Are you out of your mind? You don’t go around losing things like that! Here, make sure not to let it go again.
Take it!

I thank you with all my heart! Have you come to the old man? I’d rather not go and see him, he’s really short-tempered. Think for yourselves, though. I have to hurry back to the village, see you there. If you stay alive, that is.
What is it you want?

name.en: Ask about the Grain of Protopower

text.en:
What is this? Do you have any idea of what this is? Careful! If you drop it, as much as a hole in the ground will remain instead of the tower!

Elementals? What elementals? Ah, the ones on the roof! They’re easy, just direct the Grain’s power on them, and they’re done.

For the sake of the Astral, go and get the Sphere! And don’t you touch anything else, hear me?
You haven't completed all tasks yet. Talk to me again when you are ready for new adventures.
Well, do you feel better now? Yes, this burden is heavy...

name.en: Use the Ashes of Time and tell about the future

text.en:
Wait, I'll drink some water. My throat is parched because of your insane stories...
Well... Should I believe you or not? Oh, I feel dizzy... Was it just water I drank?

name.en: Ask for the League Expeditionary Corps' Standard

text.en:
Hmm... Of course, I have another one. But should I give it to you if you lost the previous one? Do you know what the Standard is? This is an emblem of your troops, do you understand? You have lost the ... this is ... this is unbelievable!
Allright, I'll do you a favor, only thanks to your previous services. Here is your new standard. Make sure not to lose it.
What is it? Are you here to taunt the prisoners?

Be careful with your mail! Don't miss important letters.
Here, take it. I have plenty of these.
Here you are! May you find the Revelation!... If it actually exists at all, that is.

The auction house is a place where you can sell your items to other citizens, as well as buy items from other citizens.
The process is very simple. If you want to sell something, simply put the item up for sale and fill out the auction period and the minimum bid. You can also set a buyout price if you choose. Afterwards, simply confirm your request and I'll start selling your item straight away.
However, my services aren't free. You're charged a small fee for advertising the item, as well as a percent of the winning bid.
I can also help you find items that other citizens are selling. You can search for the things you want by type, quality, level, price, or name.
If you decide to buy something, you can purchase it immediately at the buyout price or you can make a bid that's higher than the last one. Remember that any other citizen can outbid you while the auction is still going.
All of the money that you make from selling items, all of your unsold items, and all of the items from auctions that you win will be mailed directly to you. You can retrieve them at any mailbox or postal worker.

Auction lives off deposits and commission. Nobody wants to work for free, you know! For each item you put up for auction you pay some gold. For a 24 hour auction, deposit is 33% of the vendor's price. Deposit for a 12 hour auction is 15% of the item price, and a 60 hour auction costs 60% of the price. As other players may pay for your items twice the vendor's price, or even more, you'll benefit anyway! If the item is sold, you will receive your deposit back, but we will withhold our commission. And if nobody buys your item, well, don't take it amiss, but we will keep the deposit. Commission rate is 5% of the actual selling price of your auction.

It's all very simple! You rent a safe deposit box where you can store whatever you want. The cell is not bottomless, you can't fit a lot in there. For a fee you can buy additional deposit boxes to meet your storage needs.

You have so many trophies that your safe deposit box is bursting at the seams? Not a problem! Goblin Banker is ready to provide special deposit boxes with increased capacity in exchange for Expansion Tokens. You can get Expansion Tokens in exchange for all kinds of bags.

Yes, yes, you heard right - a good roomy bag is now a rarity: you can get it as a reward for thoroughly exploring Tep's Pyramid on Irdrich, saving Catherina on the Eclipse, defeating Bedlam at the Winter Palace, surviving the Battle of Gods, and defeating Kyros on the Secret Paths.

An experienced warrior can earn a modest bag on the Battlegrounds, and brave explorers can try their luck in combat with the strongest opponents on the islands in the Astral and at the Observatory on high difficulty.
Nice doing business with you.

name.en: Buy a Page from the Book of Secrets for 100,000 Gold

text.en: Sold!

Great Mage Zayan compared all evidence, obtained on Irdrich and Umoir, and found a trace that led to the key to Tep's secret. He organized an expedition to the distant allod of Ferris, where the source of the Summoner's great power was supposedly located.

Behind the snowy mountains the expedition found something absolutely unexpected - an old Imperial scientific complex from the times of Nezeb. The intrusion awoke the security systems of the laboratories... and not only them. The expedition drew the attention of a mysterious entity, which apparently was the subject of the research. Soon the surveyors found out that the operation of the complex was sabotaged by Tep's cultists.

Deep down the mines of Ferris the expedition came across unknown creatures that called themselves the Architects. Their power was almost divine, and their only aim was to eliminate chaos, which they saw in every living being of Sarnaut. One of them, the Sculptor, granted Tep a grain of his power. Soon afterwards Tep abandoned the complex and recklessly left the Sculptor alive...

Without knowing that, the expedition released the Sculptor from his prison and thus almost let the rest of the Architects break into Sarnaut. Having joined their forces, the heroes valiantly repelled the otherworldly invasion.

But now when our world has caught the attention of the godlike creatures, the League and the Empire are preparing for the worst...

name.en: Ask about the Revelation and the Game of the Gods

text.en:
Much of what happened started to make sense when the heroes encountered the mysterious Director. This mysterious manipulator organized a "Play" on the Gipat Shard where he forced everyone to participate in unusual tests. With the help of the Wormfaces, who turned out to be mutated Junes, he was able to show that the June Gates were fake and the Great Astral Campaign was pointless.

Then this Director, who turned out to be the familiar innkeeper from the Holy Land, Gorislav Gipitsky, sent the heroes into the past where they helped save the allod Kirah from destruction during the first attack of the demons.

The true revelation was waiting for the heroes on the next fragment of Gipat - the Isle of Revelation. Here, in the Tka-Rik's cave, the heroes learned that the mysterious Master of the cultists was the former god of Light, Sarn, and the Director Gorislav Gipitsky was the God of Darkness Nihaz.

Nihaz once imprisoned Sarn in Sarnaut. Over time, the God of Light lost his mind and started creating races of destroyers in an attempt to destroy this world and free himself. All existing races are his children, and the last of them are demons.

When his plan failed, Sarn tried to get to the Star Gates, a device that allows travel between worlds, hoping to use it to leave Sarnaut. But he was not alone - the Wormfaces and the Draconids had the same idea. They betrayed Nihaz and tried to get out of the dying world.

Nihaz led his enemies into a trap, and the heroes of Sarnaut helped him with that. But after realizing that the God of Darkness was likely to target them next, the heroes challenged him and seemingly expelled him from Sarnaut.

Skulnar the Fierce, the founder of the school of Orc Psionicists, was disturbed by the visions that visited his students and asked the Heroes of Sarnaut for help. He wanted to find out what awaited them all in the future. The hero turned to all the Psionicists of the world for interpretations, and each of them saw omens of the imminent death of the world.

Elizaveta Rysina received an important prediction. It was revealed to her that the Orcs would revolt and that Skulnar the Fierce would lead them. Rysina tried to attack the Orc Psionicist, but the Hero of Sarnaut did not let her kill him. The Head of the Council promised to watch the Orc carefully after that.

Another prediction was made by Cassandra - one of the Aoidoi' Domini, also a prophetess. She saw the future of the Hero of Sarnaut where he was doomed to die. No matter what the Hero of Sarnaut does, he won't be able to escape it.

These were not the only events that occurred that troubling year: a little later, the hero of Sarnaut and Nihaz made a bet to save the Sparks of the June heroes: Ath-Zak, Lu-a-Jala, and Tka-Rik. And while the Hero of Sarnaut managed to beat the God of Darkness, Klavdia Kalugina took the Sparks.

name.en: Ask about the events on Suslanger

text.en:
Heroes were once again summoned by Klavdia Kalugina who revealed her plan: her target was Nihaz's Citadel hidden behind the Seal. While the heroes and the undead attacked the bastions head-on, Klavdia was able to sneak into the lower levels where she found the coordinates of another world, the world of Klavdia's mother, a powerful deity capable of defeating Nihaz.

To reach her, Klavdia decided to build her own Star Gates – the Gates-3 project was started on Suslanger.

However, a new player intervened: a mysterious saboteur caused the "Incident" which led to the release of large amounts of a new resource - the Ambrosia. This saboteur also stole a key part of the Gates-3 project and disappeared.

Klavdia asked the heroes to resolve the situation - and they managed to learn something. They met a mysterious girl named Alice on Suslanger. Apparently she was behind the "Incident". However, Alice managed to fool everyone for a long time, and no one was able to figure out her true motives.

name.en: Ask about the events in Eden

text.en:
The result of Alice's activities on Suslanger was the appearance of the Ambrosia which became the new primary energy source coveted both by the League - represented by Catherina - and the Empire. They believed that it came from the world of that same goddess, Klavdia's mother.

Catherina decided to act on her own. The Expedition she assembled went to this world, Eden, where she began harvesting the Ambrosia. But the consequences were different - the race that inhabited this world, the Children, responded to such activities with hostility.

The Hero of Sarnaut arrived in Eden when the conflict was already in full swing. And although they tried to reconcile these warring parties, they did not succeed.

The All-Mother gave the hero several lessons which made it clear that she greatly disapproved of the Gift of Tensess, which was actually the Gift of Nihaz, and of Great Mages' immortality.

In Eden, the Hero of Sarnaut met Klavdia's sister, Hirkalla, who took a different approach, wishing to grant "eternal life" to everyone. She revived the Children from a tribe whose life span had come to an end and set them against the followers of the All-Mother.

The Hero dealt with the followers of Hirkalla, but she herself managed to escape - saying in the end that the Hero needed to decide how to protect Sarnaut.

In the meantime, the conflict between the Children and the Expedition reached boiling point - the Hero had to choose whom to support: the Children protecting their world or the Expedition which acted in the interests of Sarnaut. The war began.

One of the leaders of the Expedition, the Great Mage Felix, wanted to end the war on his own terms with the help of a unique weapon - an Ambrosia mana bomb with incredible destructive power.

While Felix and Catherina were busy building mana bombs, the Children gathered all possible allies. After the decisive battle the All-Mother, wanting to avoid more losses, agreed to go to Sarnaut.

And fell into Nihaz's trap.

Everything that happened was part of his cunning plan. He needed a new prisoner to replace the deceased Sarn, so for years he has been manipulating people from the shadows. Now Nihaz is waiting for the All-Mother to share the power of Creation with him.

To ensure that she remains his prisoner, Nihaz left his daughter, Hirkalla, in his place, entrusting her with the rule of Sarnaut. Hirkalla intends to transform this world according to her vision, vanquishing death completely and definitively.

However, there are those who are willing to challenge her - among them her sister Klavdia who has become Alice, a time traveler trying to change the past for a better future.

name.en: Ask about the events on Isa

text.en:
Some time after Hirkalla's accession, it became clear that the Great Trees of Sarnaut began to wither. It was caused by the imprisonment of the All-Mother - the divine energies that had emanated from her were cut off. The Gibberlings, led by the seer Unn, tried to contact the goddess through the Trees, and these attempts led them to the half-destroyed allod Howlem, the Pridens' homeland.

They were able to awaken one of the First Ones - the squirrel Ratatoskr. The squirrel told them that their lost homeland Isa still existed, supported by the first of the Great Trees - the Prophetic Ash. And that it can be used to contact the All-Mother.

The heroes of Sarnaut, together with Unn, Murk, Waterlily, and two more Gibberlings - the brothers Wickham and Trondur Sharp - were able to transport themselves to their lost homeland with Ratatoskr's help. There they met the Gibberlings who had survived the cataclysm, but before the heroes could find their forgotten relatives, they ran into the white Urun - the Pridens who had rejected the call of the Voices. These heroes also accidentally destroyed the prison which held the spirit of Kharyskhan, the leader of these Uruns.

The first aborigine they met was a little Gibberling named Gerda who did not have a family. Gerda had an unusual amulet that she inherited from her ancestors. It soon became clear that this amulet was made of meteorite iron - but there were no deposits in this part of Isa. It was a mystery that had no answer yet, but Gerda was determined to learn the truth about her ancestors.

The heroes had to defeat Kharyskhan and unravel the mystery surrounding Gerda and her amulet. The answer was found on a long journey: in the icy mountains they discovered the Freya, one of the ships that had set out in search of Isa. Her captain was Gerda's ancestor. She had the amulet thanks to him. And the Sharps recognized the captain as their distant great-grandfather who had disappeared during the expedition. Thus, it turned out that Sharps and Gerda were very distant relatives.

This captain Koll was able to find Isa thanks to the orc shaman Brus. He promised the shaman he would free the spirit of Skulnar in return - the same Skulnar who once led the Horde in the battle against Kania.

It turned out to be Kharyskhan who had the ability to resurrect in a new body time and again. His goal was to regain his former strength, revive the Horde, and take over the new world. After all, once upon a time he was so powerful that the Orcs' faith in him practically deified his Spark. After the Gray Prince treacherously killed him by order of Nezeb and Tensess, Skulnar's body and his Spark were buried on Isa. After the Cataclysm, the prison was destroyed, and Skulnar's Spark was freed, but it could not leave Isa. Those who imprisoned him tied his Thread of Fate to these lands.

After the Horde fell, Skulnar was gradually being forgotten, and the power of its Spark decreased with each century. Then he decided to create a new cult of himself. Once every few centuries, he accumulated enough power to take over the body of the strongest Priden. He would then spread and strengthen the legend of Kharyskhan among the Urun and Gibberlings. His cruelty helped him remain in the memory of generations and preserve their faith, and therefore his power. And all this time Skulnar kept looking for a way to untie himself from Isa. During his last rebirth, he met the captain of the Freya and learned how it could be done, but his body died before he could accomplish it.

Kharyskhan attacked the Gibberling settlement and managed to capture and kill the Sharps and Gerda. The heroes had no choice but to follow him to the Halls of Fate.

The heroes managed to save Gerda and Sharps by tying their broken Threads of Fate together. Thanks to this ritual, the Thread of Isa itself was now connected to the Threads of the rest of the world. This meant the lost homeland of the Gibberlings was once again open to the world. But in the process, the spell binding Skulnar to Isa was broken. His spark escaped.

The heroes also had to find the Thread of the All-Mother in the Halls and learn how to free her from prison. At the All-Mother's request, a signal was sent to the world of Enod. They hoped it would reach her children, the lords of Light and Order, and they would come and help free her.

Thus hope was born. The Gibberlings found their homeland and were reunited after a thousand years of separation.

name.en: Learn about the events on Jigran
Ask about the events on Ammer

text.en:
The Expeditions of the League and the Empire discovered a new race of Aoidoi which appeared from the Well of Souls after the deaths of Sarn and the Architect. Well of Souls was the concentration of the power of the two dead deities. A terrible explosion gave rise to a separate allod - Ammer. Time there went much faster at first, and a powerful astral storm protected it from outside threats. But when the storm abated, demons started appearing on the allod.

Their victim was Domina Aellona, one of the rulers of the Aoidoi, a member of the Council of Domini. Another Dominus - Kyros who fell in love with Aellona -was immortal. Learning about the possibility of resurrection thanks to the Gift of Tensess, Kyros wanted to resurrect Aellona - but all in vain. Then Kyros decided that universal immortality is a poison that destroys this world, and that it was necessary to destroy Purgatory and the Servant of Tensess.

He managed to get the support of another race from Ammer, the centaurs. Once upon a time, Kyros defeated their leader Citovras in a duel, and now the centaurs respected the warrior of the Aoidoi immensely. The mysterious Wanderer also took his side, revealing the Secret Paths to Kyros. These paths were guarded by a strange creature called Simargl who loved riddles.
