With the ancient dark magic she managed to rejuvenate her body... and lost her human soul!
For killing hundreds of girls she was outlawed and sentenced to death, but she managed to escape!
A whisper goes round that Blood Countess has hid on one of the astral islands. There she has a manor with many well-trained and loyal servants and continues her horrible and indecent actions. Beware of Blood Countess, if you do not want to be one of her slaves and end up in a bloodless body on the floor of her laboratory.

I know about that resort. Though it's not so much a resort... more like an epic fail. As you know, scientists like to boast about their technology and play the role of nature tamers. That is why they wanted to build the resort on eternal ice. So they found an appropriate freezing islet, erected a dome and built a whole town underneath. Imagine... Icy wind is howling, but inside the dome birds are singing, green grass grows... Idyllic, so to speak.
However, our brainiacs did not account for a tribe of wild orcs that lived in the islet's caves. Those orcs mostly fed on mountain goats and mushrooms that grew there. And when Imperial engineers were building their dome, they cemented the underground stream. Due to lack of pure water, goats died, mushrooms withered and orcs had nothing to feast upon. Naturally, they started warring with the resort guards. But those guards were ferocious in their own right! All veterans. Perhaps they thought that some bigwigs were going skiing or something. Made the resort secretive. One step beyond the perimeter, they fire without a warning. They don't care whether you are Kanian, Xadaganian or the Holy Tenses himself. They'll kill you on the spot! Once I wanted to unload some goods from my ship, but those idiots opened fire. Can you imagine? They were firing at an Imperial ship, no questions asked! Almost killed me! I spat at those fools, turned the ship around and flew away far from that island. Devil knows what mysteries they are protecting, if Xadaganians are firing at Xadaganians without hesitation.

name.en: Ask about the Twelve Brothers' Grove

text.en:
Seasons... It has been so long since we last saw them change, even before Sarnaut broke... There's an old tale that tells about a little girl that was kicked out of the house into a deep forest in the middle of winter by an evil step-mother. She was about to freeze to death, when she came across twelve brothers on a clearing in the woods. These were the twelve months, who used to gather together once a year to see each other and chat. She warmed up by their fire and saw quite a few miracles.
That's merely a tale, of course, but one of my friends once told me he saw a wonderful isle in the Astral. It looked like a glass sphere, with a wood in the snow, and a clearing, and a fire, and twelve young men inside. As he flew by, the snow melted, flowers bloomed, then the green faded and withered, leaves began to fall, and then it was winter and snow again. He tried to approach the isle, but it disappeared all of a sudden, and he could never see it again. Do you think the tale told the truth? Is there such a place? Are there still seasons and the months? Who knows...

This is an ancient stronghold, it traces its history back into the past. It started with the cordon lines built here by the Kanians to protect against orcish raids long time ago. It has seen many sieges, was burnt to the ground, but rebuilt every time... When the World broke into pieces, the shard of the stronghold disappeared in the Astral, but a bit of it remained.
Demon Hunters discovered and restored it, so it has become one of the strongest keeps. Demons don't even dare to approach!

You know about Quiet Hills, don't you? What a nice place that was! Looking at this bucolic village, I always thought that, in the future, we could forget about squabbles with Kanians and live happily together. But fate had other plans... A curse awoke and ruined the village in Quiet Hills, turning all peasants into ethereal apparitions. And recently, while exploring a deep layer of this Astral, I stumbled upon a Quiet Hills reflection. It is hundred times more horrible!
The reflection did not have any curse. But the peasants suffered even worse... A necromancer appeared on that island and easily subdued it! Sarang Fravashi was the necromancer's name. He decided to experiment with Kanian peasants... And ended up killing everyone! He turned the whole population of Quiet Hills into decaying zombies and bare-boned skeletons! Scary stuff... I still shiver when I think about it! They were Quiet Hills, but now they are Dead Hills...

New adventurers know that where there are June ruins, there are treasures. Wise adventurers know that treasures usually mean trouble. However, the wisest have been to all these ruins and took care of both.
Is there anything left in Altan Tepek? We came across the isle but couldn't land there. We just flew around it and took a good look at it: It looks like a tropical forest, but it's frozen and covered in snow, and the wind rages through the place. Something seemed to move there, but I'm not sure what it was. Are you curious? Well, if you manage to land there, let me know what that was and why it's frozen!

Normally you can come across nobody but Demons in the Astral, but some time ago huge swarms of termites came from nowhere, invulnerable to the Astral or anything else. At first they attacked ships, and once they even made it to Nezebgrad!
One of the Free Traders entrapped a few, dissected their bodies and found meteorite dust inside. The smell of money made many sign on to find their nest. Alas, they found nothing but death. And can you imagine the size of their nest? Whatever riches they have in their stomachs, there is no way I’m coming near it.

You ought to know what happened in Irdrich. A powerful Zem necromancer, Tep, announced himself a god, and was about to put his foot on Sarnaut's neck with his army of mechanoids. The League and the Empire united their forces to crush him, and so they did. The remnants of Tep's army are still there in Sarnaut.
The rusty mechanoids either aren't aware of Tep's fall or turned away from him. So don't be surprised if you ever come across them in the depths of the Astral.

Thank Yasker, there are so many Imperial resorts in the world! All kinds of them! Libraries, cinemas, museums! Choose whatever you like. But no! Some prefer hot and forbidden pleasures!
So, there's this goblin, who set up a fight Arena on one of the isles. Very much like Demon Arena, only without demons. There's gambling, and drinking, and party girls, and smugglers, and assassins, and slave dealers... Shame. If you ever come across this isle, just turn your back on it. It's no good anyway.

I've been to this allod. It really is a cemetery, and it is peaceful, indeed. It's old Kanial burial grounds that look gloomy and sad, with dark trees hanging over swampy hollows, and mossy gravestones, and mysterious shadows and lights in the depths. I chose not to land there, just in case. You shouldn't trouble the dead, or they will trouble you!

Old Loam? Why do you ask? Look me in the eye! Don't lie!

Huh, I guess I can discuss state secrets with you. Of course I know that allod. There is nothing special about it, just a poor cold village surrounded by pine-woods. Probably, that's the reason why the Council has chosen it as a test site for their experiments. Spying on Kanian households! Surveillance operations! Intelligence! Oh, just like in the good old days...

Some strange things are happening to animals near Old Loam, and some of the villagers have gone missing - this all I've heard from the sailors. I suggest you avoid that isle and stay away from Council's business. Just one mistake, and they will have to kill you. That would be sad.

You don't doubt they are working for the benefit of the Empire, do you?

That's one interesting place. I haven't been there for a while... And I don't miss it.

Just several years ago Triplefield was a lively trading town. They sold all kinds of goods there - elven gems, peasant straw shoes, Kanian armor...

But then there was an outbreak of the undead - they exterminated the whole place, and very few managed to survive. They collapsed the single bridge that led to the town and settled in a small village, far away from the damned ruins.

Happily, the nearby elven enclave wasn't affected by the outbreak, and they helped the survivors put their life back on track. But still the former glory of Triplefield was gone for good.

I heard that the League Church had sent a squad of Inquisitors there, and now I am wondering what do those servants of the Light have to do with that Light-forsaken place?

Workshop? Yes, I've heard about it... That's one wicked place, mark my words.

They say, all kinds of sorcerers used to gather there to practice in peace and quiet. But their practices have gone too far: they started experimenting on Sparks, trapping them and transferring them to different bodies. It's like a filial agency of Tep's Pyramid! Surely, both the League and the Empire were outraged by these experiments. But the sorcerers did not really care and just threw all the objectors to the Astral.

Some devilry has been going on on that isle ever since. Those who flied by say that the sorcerers had started cutting down trees and building wooden soldiers and golems. Just think of it! What if that army comes alive and attacks our allods? Messing with Sparks has done no one any good.

Have you ever heard legends about enchanting Sirens' songs and shipwrecks caused by them? Well, those legends are real.

One of the distant allods is occupied by an Elven tribe - I can find no other way to call those savages. Astralonauts report that music and singing can be heard coming from the Sirens' Rock, and it makes ship crews rush to their own destruction. It is difficult to resist that magic, but it is possible if there is a gifted specialist on board. Or a deaf thug.

The amount of ship wrecks speaks for itself. It's hard to imagine how many fair sailors have fallen prey to those bloodthirsty creatures! What has happened to them? Were they eaten alive? By the way, the undead were also seen on that Rock...

I strongly recommend you to avoid that isle. We should have sent there a squad of Mentalists long ago and destroyed that trash from a safe distance.

Oh, Firefrost and its temple... It's an allod where severe frosts and burning flames co-exist in peace and harmony. A beautiful place! And what looks beautiful from the Astral, is most certainly deadly. Remember: do not approach Firefrost! Once only goblins and trolls used to live there, but now it's Elementals as well. They say there's also a mysterious spirit, born by the two elements, reigning over the allod. I wish I could see it!

If you're not afraid of Elementals and don't want to live forever, you can find yourself a good team and give them a fight. After all, it's an ancient temple, filled with untold treasures. They have to do someone good!

A real pearl of the Astral! It would make a nice place for an Imperial resort. But alas, this is not going to happen. The allod is occupied by hostile aborigines.

Initially the Lagoon was only populated by an Aviak tribe. We used to have stable trade relations with them. Honest barter trade - their skins and jewels for our weapons. An incredible generosity on our part! Everybody knows there are no better weapons in the whole world.

But then some pirates, whose names are unknown to us, assaulted the Lagoon, hoping to easily steal all our goods. But the Aviaks repelled their attack and robbed their ship instead. Apparently, they found some eggs on the ship and took them. Unluckily, those were lizard eggs. When the lizards hatched, they fled to the other side of the allod. Soon there was another aborigine tribe in the Lagoon.

Since then the Aviaks of the Tusky Lagoon became hostile to the "wingless". If you fly by, don't expect them to be friendly.

Hm... I heard of a small allod, lost deep in the Astral. I've never been there actually. They say sinister things about it. Ships get lost... One friend of mine told me that when a ship approaches that island, its devices start to hiccup and the reactor boils!

And there's more. Once I met a drunken orc who claimed that once he was a cook on an Imperial trading ship, which crashed at that very allod. He spoke of the undead, of savages that eat humans, and of an ugly idol... Honestly, I didn't pay much attention to his drunken gibberish, but if you ever moor your ship to that allod, don't let go of your weapon!

Don't you know about it? "East Overshoe - that's where we're going," traders used to say before sailing out to that trading city. Its citizens used to always talk in proverbs!

Once it was a rich and peaceful city. But you know, words have power. Every time they saw an arriving trader, they said: "Speak of the devil!" Naturally, one day a real devil's imp appeared. Now they are facing the music, so to say.

I flew by East Overshoe the other day - it's silent and empty. But who knows what's really going on there? Still waters run deep, they say!

Plaque City? Alright, I will tell you its sad story. They say, once it was a beautiful town, and the citizens lived in peace and prosperity. The trade was thriving, and the craftsmen were making good money, and everybody praised the Light and led a godly life.

Blissful places like that one are rare, and they are like thorns in the flesh of the evil. And so the trouble came. The city was stricken by a magical pestilence. A mighty necromancer killed the city rulers and released all sorts of terrible diseases. The sky went black, and the earth swelled with impurity! Some citizens tried to burn the pest; others seized the moment and descended to pillage.

Eventually, the curse got so strong that the city split away from the allod and dissolved in the Astral, and its name was erased from the memory of people. But sometimes it appears here and there to relive the terrible Day of Pestilence. Be careful, or the city will swallow you as well.

Forgotten Temple? What, may I ask, is it you are looking for in that cursed place? Believe me, anyone who comes there craves to forget it has ever happened to them.

It used to be just plain June ruins in the middle of an island which was of no interest even to Demons, but then Wormfaces laid their hands on the temple and kindled a fire which had been dormant for centuries inside of it. The island burned like a torch until it collapsed with an ice shard of another allod. Now half of the island is burning with scorching fire, and the other one is ice-cold. Also, it is swarming with aggressive Elementals, golem sentries and Wormfaces, who detest strangers.

However, there are some madmen among the Historians who wish to risk their lives for the sake of science. I heard an expedition, lead by Martine de Blizare, recently set out to the Forgotten Temple... No one has heard anything from them ever since!

Ravine of Shadows? Yes, I've heard of it, although I haven't been there myself. One Priden traveler told me that many years ago a shard of Howlem split off and drifted away, with a temple which stood upon it.

Then some Astral pirates told me about a huge piece of rock in the Astral with ancient ruins on the top of it. They thought they could stuff their treasuries in that place, but they ended up fighting their own shadows! Few of them escaped, and the curse is still haunting anyone who dares to come to the Ravine...

I heard this story about the place: a long time ago, on a far away island, there lived a powerful mage who loved to conduct various experiments. One day he created a crystal - an artifact of unprecedented power which allowed him to control attractive force and alter matter. But as it turned out, the crystal had a mind of its own.

People in the city next to the tower started falling ill and dying, and the sorcerer himself became more cruel and reclusive. He stayed in his tower and barely interacted with the residents. At some point he noticed that the crystal never left his hands, and that he reacted badly when someone got curious about it. The mage realized that the artifact was changing him.

He decided to destroy the crystal, but it did not work, because he continued to hear the call of the artifact. The mage then decided to hide the fragments at a great distance from each other in hopes of weakening the artifact so he could control it. He created three shrines where he buried the pieces of the crystal. After taking the largest fragment of the artifact, the mage locked himself in the tower. He thought he could find a way to destroy the crystal completely.

Exhausted and embittered residents blamed the mage. They decided to destroy him along with his tower but could not finish the job. Over time, the island became deserted. The city was reduced to swampy ruins, and the shrines holding the artifact fragments developed cracks and partially collapsed. They changed the minds of the forest dwellers, making them more aggressive. Wights, zombies and skeletons appeared in the cemetery. And it got suspiciously quiet in the city square, among the destroyed statues and buildings...

They say a trio of treasure seekers recently went there - a family of Gibberlings: Indy, Nathan, and Lara... Perhaps you'll meet them?

At the dawn of astral navigation, before the invention of visors, when the first ships had to literally feel their way through, lighthouses were built on all the discovered islands. The light coming from a lighthouse could be seen from great distances and signaled, "Sail here, it's safe."

But, as astral navigation developed, lighthouses lost a good deal of their importance. So these days lighthouses remain mostly as a tribute to the old ways, a place to rest, spend the night and shoot the breeze.

But recently I received dire news: an astral pirate gang seized one of the old lighthouses and turned it into a trap. As soon as a ship following its light docks, the gang boards the vessel, plunders and demolishes it, while its crew are forced to walk the plank into the astral!

What brutes! Barbarians! So many innocent people got hurt because of them. They must be stopped at any cost! And if you find any treasures, I'm sure the dead owners won't mind if you keep them...

name.en: Ask about the recently discovered islands

text.en: Thanks to heroes who are not afraid to go boldly forth and, with a steady hand, guide their astral ships to the deepest layers, it has been possible to learn a lot about the properties of the astral. For example, in the deepest layers there are islands about which nobody had heard before! If you want, I will tell you about them.

Do you want to know more? That's good. Curiosity is not a vice, but an optimal way to get to know the world. If it weren't for my curiosity, how would I ever come to know so many interesting tidbits about the astral? I wouldn't know even a tenth of the wonders an adventurer could encounter on their journey!

This allod is rather small and unimportant. Seven old Knights used to dwell there, together with a poverty struck Elven House, who escaped from Anna’s harassment. Years passed by, but then the ill fate got them: first the Leper corrupted the island, then the leader of the House brought a present to his wife, who, by the way, originally went from Kania. The present was an antique June mirror, a plate of black obsidian in a golden frame, a true beauty. However, it’s typical for the June treasure to bear dark surprises. To cut a long story short, the allod used to be quite unnoticeable before, and now it’s also scary as hell. But who knows, may be some hot shots find themselves brave enough to obtain the rare treasure!

Nawlad Jeer is a living legend. Although “living” doesn’t quite describe him. He’s one of the world’s greatest necromancers. He’s been dwelling in an isolated mansion for many years now, talking only to the undead. His villagers, on the other hand, are quite the opposite: cheerful, merry, always willing to talk. Very open for vendors and foreign goods! One of my friends, a merchant, has recently been there, and just as he started unloading his goods, he saw a crowd of people staring into one spot, not paying attention to anything else. And there was this fog, ghostly fog spreading around. He made it to flee, scared to death. If you are ever around, may be, you will have a chance to find out what that was.

This allod belongs to Nomarkh Iblis, a rich inventor. He’s famous, but not too much respected - he prefers working out fraudulent plots to developing new weapons. The last time he played his trick on Yasker himself, but the latter couldn’t swallow that, of course, and sent a whole squad of Imperial soldiers to Iblis’ allod. I have no idea how it all will end. The allod is well guarded and armed. You can go and watch the show.

The last time he played his trick on Yasker himself, but the latter couldn’t swallow that, of course, and sent a whole squad of Imperial soldiers to Iblis’ allod. I have no idea how it all will end, but my guess is that the Imperials don’t have much of a chance. The allod is well guarded and armed. We can go and watch the show. Want to bet that the Imperials will lose?

Don’t even ask. This allod is top secret. Neither you nor me should be even aware that it exists. Oh, all right, I love gossiping, I’ll tell you what I know. The Dead City revealed some technologies, that were gathered and moved for testing to this very allod. They wanted to open some Gates, don’t ask me what that is, I don’t want to know. You’re asking why? Because all staff was urgently evacuated from the allod recently, the whole sector closed and isolated, entrance prohibited! Oh, this is so exciting! But too risky, I wouldn’t go there myself. Sure, you can, why not. Tell me what you’ll have seen there, alright? Promise?

Another Imperial lab failed. They learn no lessons... The Dead City revealed some technologies, that were gathered and moved for testing to this very allod. They wanted to open some Gates, don’t ask me what that is, I don’t want to know. You’re asking why? Because all staff was urgently evacuated from the allod recently, the whole sector closed and isolated, entrance prohibited! Do you still want to sniff out the Imperial secret? Sure, you can, why not. Tell me what you’ll have seen there, alright?

This prosperous mine used to belong to Umoir traders. In fact, it’s Mistress who rules the allod, within and without. It’s her good will to share the riches. Evidently, people got her angry with their greed or disrespect. In any case, there are wild beasts now, where the settlement used to be. I’m too scared of the Mistress, so I wouldn’t go there myself!

This allod had always been nothing but a naked stone, no life, no plants. But recently it magically transformed into a blooming land with rivers, trees and homes. I docked, and discovered amazing creatures I had never seen before. They look much like Gibberlings, but not at all Gibberlings. They’re fluffy and have big ears, very cheerful, but a bit twitchy. They say there’s another tribe beyond the mountain, and the war is about to break out. I appealed to the Light, and they only looked weird and hurried to say goodbye to me. That’s really an enigma!

This allod had always been nothing but a piece of rock, no life, no plants. But recently it magically transformed into a flourishing land with rivers, trees, and even a handful of houses! I docked and discovered amazing creatures I had never seen before. They look a little bit like Gibberlings, but fluffy and big-eared. They are quite friendly, if a bit twitchy. They say there’s another tribe beyond the mountain, and they are afraid of it. I wished that the Light would keep them safe, but they gave me a strange look and sent me on my way. That place is an enigma!

This is the most widely known pirates’ nest in the world! It attracts all kinds of scum from all over the universe! Feint the Greedy himself moved there before he died. People say, that’s where he buried his treasures. But it’s the old story. The news are more troubling, however. One of my acquaintances, a decent gentleman, was about to stop by and push off his, so to say, goods, and all he saw was a wrecked fort, plumes of smoke and purple tentacles over it. So there is nothing good about the place, I tell you.

One of my acquaintances, a decent gentleman, was about to stop by and push off his, so to say, goods, and all he saw was a wrecked fort, plumes of smoke and purple tentacles over it. So there is nothing good about the place, I tell you.

I’ve been there. It’s a nice place: green forests, fresh springs. A settlement in the middle with a tall wall around it, a temple in its center and nice citizens. Good place to visit and trade, you know. The locals suffer from the thieves, but they’re rich enough to hire someone to deal with them, right?

Good place to visit and trade, you know. The locals suffer from the thieves, but they’re rich enough to hire someone to deal with them, right?

That is one curious inquiry. Have you any idea, that you could be easily put to prison just for asking such a question?

See, even after the Cataclysm some of the Xadaganians refused to recognize Nezeb's authority. When the industrial revolution began, a few isolated allods, where Xadaganians resided, declined to accept the new doctrine, and went on living up to the old rules. Dersaadet is just the place. So to say, a shard of the ancient Empire, lost in time.

They don't trust in the Light, don't worship the Trinity Church's saints. Instead, they pray to their Almighty in mosques. Mustafa al Muhad, the sultan of Dersaadet, possesses unlimited power. Anyone, who confronts him, faces his loyal janissary and wise Vizir's magic. However, if you come to Dersaadet with peace, you will be welcomed, wined and dined!

text.en: Feel free to ask, I will tell you everything I know. If it's now about military secrets or any other classified information, of course.

name.en: Ask about heroic adventures in the Mysterious Astral

text.en:
What would like to know?

These islands are for heroes who are ready for the most difficult adventures with a Hero's Compass.

Astral reflections occur only in the deepest layers of the Astral. On the outside, they look like real and familiar locations, but their content differs greatly from what you would expect. For example, a castle where some knight used to live will be occupied by undead or werewolves in its reflection. Where a river used to run, lava or corrosive acid may flow. Enemies may not appear as what they seem...
As I understand, astral reflections are images of the future, past or present that reveal a possible outcome of an event. Exploring these reflections is very dangerous, since you can never know what you will deal with, but the reward upon a victory may be significant!
There’s something wrong about this allod...
There’s something wrong about this allod...
We did it! Unbelievable!

name.en: Offer help in disabling the Pyramid

text.en: Get ready then! Nobody knows what happens next...

Oh... Astral be praised!
Can you help me to disable the Pyramid? I don't need treasures anymore! I just want to get out of here...

Your visit to our land comes at a dire time...
We've renounced Armando, our creator, and fled to this island lost deep in the astral. The natives were decent folk, and we've been living peacefully side by side, exchanging their blood for our goods and knowledge. And curse be upon those shapeshifters for trying to destroy our alliance!
If you're willing to help us, you'll have to defeat the shapeshifters' chieftain named Luth the Meager, and he's as cruel and ruthless a bastard as I've met in all of my days.
But first you'll need to protect both villages from the shapeshifters! In the center of each village there's a security seal that can create a barrier that those shifters can't breach. All you need to do is activate the seal and hold out for a while.
I will help you by temporarily bestowing my dark gift upon you. Don't be afraid, you're not going to become a vampire. We have given a vow not to beget the likes of us any longer. However, the power of blood will help you in battle. As long as you're satiated and the blood runs hotly through your veins, you alone will be worth a good dozen in combat! But there's a catch, and that's the eternal thirst, a faint semblance of which you're about to experience.
If you feel hungry or exhausted, drink some fresh blood. Any human on this island will gladly let you have a sip. After all, you're our only hope! If there are no humans around, you can settle for the blood of an animal. It doesn't taste quite as good, but the thirst will be quenched... for a while!
Now go! All of us, both humans and vampires, are pinning our hopes on you.

Glob will blow this blockage into pieces, believe it!
All he has to do is light a match. Just wait until we get there - you'll witness a boom the likes of which you've never seen, as the whole tunnel turns to dust!
So, let's roll?
Let's set it all to pieces, Step!
So, steeplejack, shall we blow this place to pieces? Where once was a blockage there'll be a gaping hole, ya dig!
Fire it up, Dub!

Hey, get out of here! This is Capa's island! Capa is first! It's all mine, mine, mine!
Crafty clansmen steal a march on Capa, yes, yes. Ugh, scoundrels! Not to worry, Capa will kill them all, and the treasure will be mine, mine, mine!
Outsider, do you also want treasure? There is a lot of booty there. An entire expedition dug. The scientists were eager, but they were still fools! They opened the locked door, they let the ancient evil out, and - boom - there are nothing but restless spirits roaming the island. Nobody hinders Capa now, except clansmen.... and outsiders!
 But Capa is not greedy, no, no. Capa wants to have a.... what's it called... a bet with you! If you kill all the scoundrels and monsters faster than Capa, the treasure is yours. Capa is not a fool, Capa does not want to fight with strong outsiders. If Capa kills everyone quicker, then the treasure will be Capa's. And Capa will kill the outsiders, because the outsiders are weak!
So, outsider, will you make a bet with Capa?
Only, don't run ahead, mind! Fight fair! If outsiders run ahead, Capa gets angry!
Outsiders are cowardly, they are afraid to argue with Capa! Then off you go to meet your death, strangers. When you are killed, Capa will go on and will kill everyone himself and take the treasure!

I can't believe my eyes! People! Real people!
No matter who you are, just help me, please! Someone else should have survived!
Thank you! I am no warrior, so I'll step aside.

Normally you can come across nobody but Demons in the Astral, but some time ago huge swarms of termites came from nowhere, invulnerable to the Astral or anything else. At first they attacked ships, and once they even made it to Nezebgrad! One of the Free Traders entrapped a few, dissected their bodies and found meteorite dust inside.
The smell of money made us sign on to find their nest. Off we went, and were unlucky enough to find it - as soon as we approached, a whole lot of them attacked us. The last thing I remember was a heavy blow on the head.
When I came round, there was no one around. All my crew were carried away by the termites. Even my little sister... oh, she wanted to see the Astral so, she begged to take her with me...
They say insects don't devour their prey right away. May be there still is a chance to save them... Please, help!
The hare looks dangerous.

name.en: A cute and innocent-looking hare looks at you from the ground, surrounded by a pile of dead bodies. Something is not right.

text.en: A cute fluffy animal. There are dead bodies and blood everywhere. It was probably not involved.

name.en: The frozen throne spreads terrible chill...

text.en:
You can see a Xadaganian helmet right on the frozen throne and you can hear its voice...
‘It is time,’ says the helmet.
For a second, it sounds like the voice comes from the ice.

text.en:
A weird-looking thing with vaguely humanoid features clutches a level 14 rune in its hands, peering at you suspiciously.

- Mine! It’s mine! I spent so much! I lost so much! But it’s mine now! I endured everything! I went though HELL! Bites from Armando’s vampires everywhere... Scars from Areisia’s claws! Why did she have to throw me up in the air?!

And that?! Bruises from Euriala’s bubbles! I swear to the Light, they were harmless at first, and then they started GRINDING THEIR VICTIMS TO A BLOODY PULP.

And you know what this is?! Marks from cursed scouts’ arrows! How could I know a Crippling Shot would cripple my soul?!

Burning arrows... Why, Tensess? Why were trolls, wolves, and hamsters using burning arrows?!

Wolves... Wolves around me, there are screams, blood everywhere, everything is on fire, I’m dying, something’s gnawing at me, and the lion... Why did wolves serve a lion?! That’s not logical!

I remember... Remember a prayer... Everyone is whispering: Lumix Isle... It’s our hope. May we stay on course and reach Lumix Isle... But no. The compass’s cursed arrow turns and... Land of the Thousand Wings. Death, death... Cross, skull, coffin.

My friends... they said it’s going to be fine, everything will work out, but... they... they were engineers. Death! The whole arena is covered in blood! They believed it would be alright... It wasn’t!

But this is all in the past... I have the rune now, and I’m not giving it to you! My... precious.

This is an excellent opportunity to earn glory, honors, and respect, and to acquire unique equipment and other valuable items. There are two teams fighting in a Skirmish. The idea is to find out who's the best, who's the strongest. There are no friends or allies. An Imperial team may face another Imperial team, League may fight League.

There are several arenas, each giving you the Signs of Victory. Use these signs to obtain Battleground Emblems and trade them for various prizes!
Do you want to confront other heroes in a fair combat? Welcome to the Battleground!

There are two unequal teams in this battleground. The bastion is occupied by six strong defenders. Twenty four weaker players attack the bastion. Their goal is to break into the bastion and kill all the defenders or capture their flag to win. They have nine tries of 3 minutes each, and if they fail to stay within the time limits, the onslaught stops, the dead revive, the attackers return to the ship and prepare for the next onslaught. If they fail for 9 times, the bastion defenders win. Find out what tips the scale, the skill or the number!

There are two teams of twelve people in this Battleground. They fight for the flag on the hill. The flag cannot be captured, but you will receive victory points for every team member near it. However, there’s no use flocking around the flag: there are two cannons on either side of the hill, capable of turning any player into thin spread. Whoever is the first to hit the victory score, wins the battleground.

There are two teams of twelve people in this Battleground. The main goal is to capture and hold control points: the mill, the lumber mill and Zem ruins. To capture, tap on a flag near a location and prevent enemies from tapping it. While you are holding a flag, your team will be scoring victory points. Hold more flags to collect points faster. Whoever is the first to hit the victory score, wins the battleground.

Helping your friends is good! Any creature may attack them, and who's going to be there to protect them, but you? You may give a hand not only to your best friends, but to anybody you choose to, provided that you are going to Astral allods. Meet me in the hangar, if you're interested.
Here. Careful, don’t spill the honey!
Do you have a real friend? Not just a friend, but someone who you can trust your life with? Listen, I will tell you about a rite that will bind you.

What is it, to be best friends with someone? I, for instance, have two best friends: a Xadaganian girl and an Arisen. We've been to every other corner of the Astral, crawled through each and every Isle! We're not blood relatives, but they're closer to me than my whole clan! You can't choose a sibling to your taste, but your best friends are your own choice and there's noone to blame. Clear?

You better take this kind of friendship seriously, just as a marriage, though these are not connected. A husband and wife, or a teacher and pupil, or a master and student may become best friends. Any two close friends of at least level 15 can! You may have two best friends at the most, they are to precious to throw around.

name.en: What does it take to become Best Friends?

text.en: This rite is ancient, but simple. First, you will have to buy a ritual honey Bowl of Friendship from me. The stronger you are, the stronger honey you need, the more expensive it is. Offer it to someone, who you want to be best friends with. If they accept, drip a few drops of your bloods in the bowl, take a gulp, and that's it: you're Best Friends!

name.en: How to stop being Best Friends?

text.en: The ties are strong, but still they can be torn. You won't need any special ritual, just say the words: "You're not my Best Friend any more!" If your best friend betrays you and goes over to the League, you won't need any words at all: your friendship is over, you're enemies. Ew, I hate the sound of it!

There are a lot! Firstly, best friends can go down to Dungeons together, even if they significantly differ in levels. Secondly, they can give each other a hand in Astral quests. Thirdly, one may teleport to their best friend from farthermost edges of Sarnaut. And finally, best friends can lend each other most precious things: their mounts and astral ships. See, how deeply you should trust each other?

Normally two heroes with a significant difference in levels cannot go down to the same dungeon or Astral Isle. This rule does not affect best friends. However, the stronger best friend is not able to just smash the enemy. Instead, they cover their best friend's back and support them. The little one thus obtains five new abilities: one increases damage, another protects from enemies' spells, the third one heals, the fourth one casts fear on the enemy, and the last one teleports the party to the dungeon entrance, just like Mage's Sanctuary. Best friends can invite other heroes to their party, but the stronger best friend's abilities do not apply to them.

If you want to help your best friend, just tell me, I will cast a Helping Hand on you. While it lasts, you may visit Astral Isles together with your best friend, and not spend any keys. You won't get any loot, either. Tell me as soon as you're done.
Once a half an hour you may teleport to each other, provided that you both are not in combat. When you're done, you may teleport back to your initial location.

Who may you safely lend your Astral ship? Why, your best friend, of course! Enter the hangar together, summon your ship and lend it to your best friend. The things they can do to the ship are the same as you can do: summon, undock from hangars, travel to Astral isles, enter battles, take damage and repair it. One thing they are unable to perform, is changing your ship's devices.
You cannot summon your ship while your best friend is holding it. To get it back, you have to enter the hangar together once again and ask for it. The ship will automatically return to you once your friendship is over.
Bear in mind, that all cargo on the ship will disappear as soon as your best friend gets hold of your ship!

A best friend is so near and dear that you could easily trust them with your life or light-heartedly lend them your mount. It is as easy as one, two, three! Enter your stable, choose a mount you would like to lend and share it! If your best friend has an empty slot, the mount you have chosen will gallop right into it, and all their Incarnations will be able to ride it as well! It's just as easy to return it, you only need to open the stable.
There are, however, two restrictions. First, a mount whose rank is 5 or higher is faithful to you, so make sure to share only mounts of ranks 1 to 4. Second, color patterns belong to you and cannot be shared.
Well done! Now you can fly around as much as you want. You won't spend any keys. You won't get any loot at the Isle, either. But you don't charge for helping a friend, eh!
Hey. Are you going out into the Astral? I like that. Kill a monster or two for me, will you? You know that you can help your friends out there, but without getting loot?
Good decision. Enough is enough! Ah well, one cannot sponge off their friends forever. Now you will be spending your keys and receive loot again.

name.en: I think I'm the one you are looking for.

text.en:
What? You?!

No, it has nothing to do with you. We are looking for a descendant of the Legendary Orc who could wield one of the types of higher magic - elemental, necromancy, and so forth...
Oh please, you are no psionicist. You're just a weird shaman.
That's right, put these strange ideas out of your head and focus on finding the real descendant of the Legendary Orc.

We're working on more than ten major projects at the ZIT. And what does the City Council do? Take away my best employees for their horrible experiments! How can they expect us to finish our work on time?
I hope you didn't think I would just hand the piece of paper over to you.

We're working on more than ten major projects at the ZIT. And what does the City Council do? Take away my best employees for their horrible experiments! How can they expect us to finish our work on time?
Here, take this one and don't lose it!

name.en: The thing is... I'm an orc psionicist!

text.en: Ha ha, very funny. Everyone knows there are no orc psionicists. You're just a weird shaman, my friend!

name.en: But I can read other people's thoughts!

text.en: Listen, I have no time for this tomfoolery, my hands are full as it is. Go play your tricks in the Old Square.
Are you trying to tell me something, child?
Don't even think about it. These are special prisoners. I was ordered by the City Council to guard them personally.
Well? Why are you staring at me?

name.en: I think I'm the one you need!

text.en: What? No, you are destined to find the descendant of the Legendary Orc, and that's it.

name.en: I think I'm the one you need!

text.en: What? No, you are destined to find the descendant of the Legendary Orc, and that's it.
Ahaha! What are you babbling... There are no orc psionicists! Or rather, we have yet to find them. But you're definitely not one of them. You're just a weird shaman!

I'm only a guardsman. Who might want to save someone like me? No one is going to save us. It's all a big joke.
When I was a child, I dreamt of becoming a general, but they told me only children of generals would be allowed to reach that rank. So I ended up becoming a cannoneer. Boom! Hah! I even have a marksmanship badge. Do you want to see it? Hm, where is it? It's gone! Did you steal it?
They'll come after you eventually! Who? They... They'll be here soon. The Empire will be finished, and I'll be a general. That's how it's going to be!

This is humiliating! A delicate woman like me in the arms of Imperial dogs! I remember how I used to dream of being captured. They would chain me up, undress me... It seemed so exciting! But this isn't like that at all. It's cold and the food is awful.
But I know that the League Army won't leave me here. My family will make them do something! ...At least that priest was kind to me. Oh Ignat, you are so wonderful!

Don't torture us. We'll tell you everything we know! We'll even tell you things that we don't know! We were promised freedom soon, but we don't believe a word of it. So please, just stop hurting us.
Who promised that? Why, Ignat of course. He kept talking about freedom and peace, but his plans seemed pretty farfetched. Who's going to launch a big operation just to save the likes of us?

text.en: It is not that easy! You cannot walk or ride there. I will teach you a spell, which will teleport you directly to the Kingdom of Nature at any moment you like.
Believe what? If you're having... some kind of issue, you should go to the medical unit, it's to the south of here.

name.en: The thing is, I'm... an orc psionicist!

text.en:
Uh... Hang on... wait here. I'm going to call the doctor.

Just stay calm. They can fix you!

All right. Just don't get anxious. It happens!

It's stress and hot weather - it's cooking your brain, hah.

name.en: Why does no one believe me?

text.en:
You gotta understand - there are no orc psionicists... And you... you're just a weird shaman.

Just keep your mouth shut, or you'll get hauled off to a mental hospital one of these days.

I am here to educate citizens about various important matters. How may I be of assistance?

When the great Nezeb disappeared, Yasker became his successor. Day and night he sits in the Tower and thinks about how to best serve the citizens of the Empire. The Great Yasker is always happy to talk to ordinary citizens, but appointments must be booked in advance. The current wait time is approximately two years.
You can learn new skills from combat and magic trainers in Yasker's Tower. They work twenty four - seven and will gladly share their knowledge.

Economic system, in general, and commercial relations, in particular, are well-developed in the Empire. You may find traders and vendors on every corner of the city. There are also a lot of them in Yasker's Tower. Satisfaction guaranteed!

The Empire is famous for its craftsmen and wonderful things they create. You have a chance to become one of them, if you like. All you have to do is undergo a course with one of them. Trainers await in Yasker's Tower twenty four - seven and will gladly share their knowledge.

Government, authorities and embassies are located in the capital of the Empire. Any citizen is free to visit the Yasker's Tower and see with their own eyes where the City Counsil, Imperial Sentinels and Trinity Church are, take a look at orcish and Zem embassies. We are open to all the Imperial people!

Auction House is inside Yasker's Tower. You may sell or purchase rare and valuable items there.
Postal Service is used to send and receive messages, items and currencies. You can find a lot of postmen around the city.
There's an Astral port in the Northern part of Nezebrgad. It is widely used in military and transport purposes. You may use it to go on vacation or join a mighty quest.
I will help you bind your Adventurer's Stone to this location.

name.en: Ask about the Kingdom of Nature

text.en: The Kingdom of Nature is a secret allod that only the wardens can reach - the druids, animists, huntmasters and shamans. That is where we gather magic reagents that are used to brew special potions. I can teach you the secret of how to get there.
Hi there!

The ogres are very dangerous. It won't be easy to lure them into a trap. For bait you should use the meat of wild boars. They live all over this allod so they should be easy to find.
After you gather a lot of meat you should throw it into a cage. The ogres should eventually be unable to resist the food and enter the trap.
What? What happened?
I feel really sleepy.
What happened? Where am I?
Ugh, I don't feel so good.
Who are you?
I'm very weak. I need to lie down.
Oooh!
Very bad...
Nnnnrrghh...
I feel so dizzy.

Good day!
Please, don't make rapid movements during our conversation. My treatment after the flight crash is not complete.

Reporting!
Within the scope of the "Outside" program I've accomplished the first flight beyond the atmosphere and astralosphere. Manned spacecraft "North" has reached the target altitude and successfully landed.
I'm sorry, but I can't give away what I've seen up there. It's a top secret! You know, I'm not asking you about the mysterious device that the League Crusader was trying to steal! Although I am very interested.

Oh, hello.
Is there anything you need to fix? Sew on a button or repair an Astral battleship? I can help with anything.

No, it's not a feat... I just can't stay away from work. I grow tired when I'm loitering!
This is our family trait. My elder brother was born with a pick in his hands. Well, figuratively. If he doesn't shovel a couple tons of ore per day, he suffers from headache.
So when they sent us here to "recover", we were out of our minds!
My brother is lucky, he's already discharged from here. They promise to send me back to the capital soon. I can't wait!
Are you bored? Please have a seat, let's talk.

What are you talking about? "Mother hero", ha! Why, I gave birth to fourteen children, so what? This runs in our family. Life in the steppes is no fun. We wouldn't have survived otherwise. Only one of five orcs reaches adulthood. Now life is safer, we have enough food and medicines, but our nature remains the same.
Everyone around says I'm a hero, but I'm not. When there is a whole platoon of my sons... then call me a hero!
Where bad luck ends, cemetery begins.
What lives in apples and is an avid reader? A bookworm!
There is no harm if they laugh at you... Much worse when they mourn you...
Healthy sleep prolongs life and shortens the workday.
Can I help you?
-The patient has turned the corner, but he didn't get too far.
Medical case repeats twice. First time as a tragedy, and second time as a paragraph in medical textbook!
Better live on bread and water than die from obesity.
Many people complain of back pain, but no one details it down to muscular syndromes of vertebral, arthritic, visceral or myofascial genesis.
Clear conscience is a sign of a bad memory.

Motoric and verbal excitation... delusional thoughts...
That won't be easy... Schizophrenia, I suppose.
The dragon snarls and beats its wings with impatience.
Are you ready?
The dragon is ready to fly!
Let's fly!
I'll soon be ready to call the spirit of the captain.
Alright then, let's begin...

This body is pretty weak and skeleton-like. Couldn't you do any better than this?! Oh well. I'm going to get drunk and pick up a few female Chosen Ones. Hopefully one day I'll learn to look at my reflection without disgust.

name.en: Tell him about the cultist's proposal

text.en:
Hah! What do you expect me to do? I don't care if they chose a cherry tree as their leader! Let them worship a tea cup or dragon droppings! I don't give a damn!
Sorry but I can't turn into a ghost again. The mere thought of it makes my stomach turn. Surely there must be another way to find out this name.

name.en: Ask about the bodie's poor health

text.en:
What do you expect will come of this? It's not a big deal to spend half the day in the bushes. We're quite used to that. You just have to find a place with a lot of leaves.
As for my liver, I'll just jump off the allod. Death can cure illnesses, you know. The higher you jump, the quicker suffering ends!

name.en: Ask to question the cultist's soul

text.en:
That'll be easy! What a brilliant idea! We can't do anything to him until we combine our souls, and then I'll be able to drag all the names out of him. I'll be able to find out the names of all his cousins if I want!
Now, why are you looking at me like that? Are you up to something? You're not planning to lure me out so he can possess my body, do you? Not bloody likely, good sir. I'm not a simpleton!

What? The cultist was castrated? Turn around, let me check... Oh, bloody hell! What a terrible joke that was! Although, he is a pretty worthless loser. It probably wouldn't make much of a difference. If I were him, I'd probably join a cult as well... A cult of girls!
I'm not going to be a part of this! Damn everything! Change everything back the way it was! I'd rather be a ghost of a hero than a live as the village clown...

May the great Tensess be with you!

This ritual will teach you to be a bearer of true power - that of love, mercy, and faith. May you be a mirror of all that is good in this world! May the word of Tensess be with you! May the Light embrace you! And now... you may go!

Everybody has sinned. Even Tensess says in his Testament, that "there is no single creature in the world who never violated any virtues. May this not become an obstacle on the way to the enlightenment! Everyone can abandon the old sins and let the Light into their souls by saying: Nay to Evil, I Praise the Light!"
Here you are, you have come and said the words to receive the blessing of the Light. May those who was harmed by you, forgive you, as the Light has long done!
Go in peace now.
May the Light bless you!
In the name of the Light, I am now marking you with sacred oil... As this oil is pouring the mercy of the Light is covering you forever and ever!
Hello there! How can I help you?
How is the delivery of that letter going?
Lost, huh... Fine, I got a couple spares. Here. Don't lose them!

Did you know our birthday is coming up soon?
Oh... an early birthday gift! How touching! Hurray! Hurray! Time for a celebration!

We want to make a scene... we know, we need some Orcs! They're pretty violent!
Flowers? For us? We asked for an Orc! Well, we guess flowers are nice too... thanks!
No one loves us... Nobody pays us any attention...
Flowers! They've noticed us! Someone is interested in us! Hurray, what a happy day!
Life is a wonderful thing! There's always something interesting going on.
See, our words are true! We've been given some flowers! We were right - life is good!
Give them some flowers
Giving presents is a way more pleasant than receiving them!

text.en: This is our world and that's all you need to know.
This strange sphere is obviously attracting the Architects' attention. Soon enough we will have to repel another attack.

The sphere is buzzing and radiating dim blue light. It certainly has something in common with the Architects.

Maybe, we should give it a good kick to attract the attention of our uninvited guests?
Yes, Commander?
Yes, sir!

The Architects are aware of our presence, yet they keep on raining fire over the place instead of facing us. Cowardly wretches!

I will cover you with a magical barrier which is supposed to protect you from the fire. Don't look at me like that! When you deal with the Architects' magic, you can be sure of nothing.

Are you ready?
May the Light protect us!
These ancient June ruins are overflowing with magic...
Done!

Hello, hello!
Want a refreshing cocktail? Or do you need some exhilarating drink to make your blood run faster? Anything you like!
Or maybe you'd like to take part in our Tipsy Marathon and win "The Drunkest Runner" title!
Aha! I can see interest in your eyes! I knew that the marathon would intrigue you!
Hey, pal! Wanna take part in the "Tipsy Marathon"? You'll enjoy it even if you don't win a prize!

Tipsy Marathon? You're a sportsman, that much is obvious!

The bartenders are still making cocktails for the next marathon, so go take a walk and come back later.

Clear your head before the competition!

Oh, that's our favorite sports! We are good at running, but the most fun is trying to run when your legs stumble and everything doubles in your eyes. So much more challenging!
Point is, we have seven bars here at the Atoll, and you have to drink a cocktail in each.
The more drunk you are when you come to the bar, the more points you get! So drink bottoms up and run fast to the next bar, while the alcohol is still in your brain. If you manage to drink cocktails at all seven bars, you will receive the prize of a drunk marathoner!
Where do you get cocktails? There are two options. You can either buy them from bartenders, or pick up fruits and mix drinks yourself. You can learn cocktail recipes from me.
Oh, and there is a rule on our island: alcohol is prohibited unless you are participating in the Tipsy Marathon. Stay sober if you don't want to return early!

name.en: Take part in the Tipsy Marathon

text.en:
Drink it in one gulp and run to the next bar!
One.
Two...
Three!
Feeling dry? We'll fix it in no time! What would you like?

Hello! Do you want to enjoy the most spectacular and reckless gambling game of our island? Welcome to Crab Racing!

Choose a track to bet. Come on, there are no losers in crab racing!
