Of course, things are uneasy there... Many are dissatisfied, because it is impossible to resurrect everyone at the same time. I have a feeling that a rebellion is brewing... And we will have to be at the forefront. Again.

I have always loved balls and festivals. Of course, House de Tristesse is not a Great House, but we still have pride in ourselves.

Since I represent House de Doucer now, I'm their equal.

, we're grateful to Catherina for giving us a chance to travel on her ship. It's very nice!

Louis made the right decision when he sent the Galleon Castle to Umoir... Normally we have few opportunities to see the world outside our allods, so these few months have been rather educational.

And this celebration conveniently gathered all the important people here... We can hold talks that will begin the new era of peace in Sarnaut!

And of course, we all remember about you. This day is yours, so let's celebrate.

Hello, !

Oh, has it really been a year since our last conversation? Time flies... And I've been terribly busy... It's so difficult to rule the Elves!

One Great Game is over - now another has begun. The alliances have changed, and those who were our allies may become our enemies tomorrow.

Fortunately, I no longer need to prove anything to anyone. We, the House de Delice, always keep our word - the future of Sarnaut is diplomacy. I promised we'd make peace with the Empire, right? You got it.

I'd like to take part in this expedition of yours, but it seems that Catherina doesn't want us there. Oh, I'm afraid it will end badly for her - after all, our House, the House of born diplomats, could be very helpful in negotiations with the inhabitants of another world...

But no, the new toys are all they care about. The Ambrosia is such a strange thing. No, I do believe it's irreplaceable, but this resource should not be their priority.

Look at the guests. Did you notice how many moneybags are here? They all arrived to speak with Catherina and divide uncertain future profits. In exchange, they offer funding on an unprecedented scale. And some have already made investments. Several factories on Umoir and New Igsh have already started manufacturing combat Mechanoids. Combat Mechanoids!

I hope you'd be able to convey my concerns to Catherina.

Ah, the lost soul... , I believe? I heard you are ready to open the Gates leading to the outer darkness. And it made me wonder - do those who dwell in that darkness know about the Light?

If they don't, then our mission is to enlighten them. Grant them the miracle of Resurrection, healing, and protection.

But if our Gift is rejected, then let the punishment fall on them. Give them revenge for the neglect and disrespect.

Woe to those who call evil good and good evil, worship darkness as light and light as darkness, regard bitter as sweet and sweet as bitter!

What in the world!

You got me out of my Gipat, dragged me here for some reason... Why? What did you want?

There are fewer and fewer ghosts on Gipat, they scattered in all directions...

Should I move away from my native village too? A good master is always in demand, even if they are a ghost...

I don't know what Gort is upset about. He should have stayed on Jigran or Gipat, it's not like anyone forced him to go! And my trade is going well: we have a stone house now, so we'll reach a new level soon! In short, I'm not going anywhere, I'm fine where I am! I came here to rest, but when I return, I will continue my trade!
What do we have here - a party? Who's paying, I wonder? And what are we celebrating? Your heroics...? Oh, really...
How interesting... It's been a while since I've seen anything but the Grove of the First, and the world has changed... Our power is growing...
We have been watching the little Pridens... But we, the First, are responsible for the whole world... We must keep an eye on everything... And we'll start with Isa.

Well? How is it going? Long time no see, heh...

As you can see, we have a Club meeting. We decide what to do next. Now is our time, the time of the Free Traders! Why do you think?

Yes, it's as plain as a pike staff! Since they clashed in the Holy Land, the League and the Empire have been losing, and we have been gaining. Still, this is a matter of common interest. Which is what? We need our business to be good.

I provide transportation and make sure goods are delivered intact. And apparently we can ship goods to other worlds now. There's room for growth, heh.
Hey, what's up, rookie? Having fun, I hope? Come on, don't be sad!

, I'm glad Catherina doesn't seem to be holding a grudge! Because it was the House de Grandeur that didn't support her back on Scarge...

Although back then we didn't think she'd succeed. She was too young and flighty... And Smaragd's lessons served to made her arrogant rather than truly powerful.

I never considered these toys to be anything worthy of note. Did they help the Junes? Of course not! But Tka-Rik's magical powers were strong enough to overcome the Curse.

Well, what happened is history, and you, like many other heroes, are a part of it. So congratulations on that.

I'm glad to see you!

We are all together now: the heroes of Umoir, Rud Glaen, and even Skrakan himself! We should remember the old times, especially since we're about to go on a campaign again!

I'm glad to see you!

We are all together now: the heroes of Umoir, Rud Glaen, and even Skrakan himself! We should remember the old times, especially since we're about to go on a campaign again!

After all, evil is not only on Jigran, it has also made a nest on my Forox. Aidenus had a student named Bogsha who became the Great Mage when Aidenus moved to the Kanian Archipelago...

Bogsha took on apprentices, and there was a black sheep among them. Tritogor deceived his teacher and lured him into the Misty Valley where Bogsha got lost. Tritogor then turned to the dark arts and began to perform terrible rituals. The residents fled, but most of them took refuge under the protection of Ivan the Ascetic, the governor of the allod and the head of the Church! Now he seeks help from heroes to deal with Tritogor's betrayal, rescue Bogsha and drive out all evil from Forox!

Lots of food. Chief is happy!

 Fought Booka-Booka! Booka-Booka almost died. Recovered for a long time, hmm!

Four years! Only drank fire water – to travel to your camp.

But Booka-Booka is not angry at ! Booka-Booka is friends with ! Will share fire water and tasty milk! If  comes back, of course.

Ahem. , I should probably apologize for the situation with Elleken!

He was blackmailing me, you understand! He threatened to tell Claude's story... I couldn't let that happen! These ancient Great Mages are terrifying creatures...

Where is he now? He didn't deign to inform me. I believe he's trying to form an alliance with dragons. They are supposed to be mortal enemies, Great Mages and dragons... But Elleken has always admired them. I'm sure they can come to an understanding... After all, they have a shared goal now!

I hope you're not holding this against me on a day like this.

Greetings, Stormbringer!

I was happy to get an invitation. To see you all. There are so many of you. And you are all so different!

We centaurs are still trying to find our way in this world. We settled in the Frontier steppes. And some have left to explore other allods. I hope my brethren can find their place and destiny among you.

And if you need our help - you need only ask.
I do not enjoy balls!

I do not enjoy balls!

However, I must thank you -

since I have regained my destiny,

I have accepted a government position.

Having stopped senseless disputes,

I have been using my skills for the benefit of others

 - in that great mixture of peoples, eras and countries,

 which was created by a certain event,

I look for the original genealogies of the Awakened,

so I can learn about their origins...

And there is no end to this work!

We've reconciled with Sofia. In the evenings we read books.

And I listen to my father-in-law, keeping silent.

I don't argue with him, because he's an old man,

and he won't change his ways no matter what!

Hello! I'm an orc announcer, and this is Nina. We are at the celebration of the Anniversary.

Actually, I'm not sure why I was invited, but I didn't refuse! Who can say no to a party?! And there are other outcasts here, just like you and me. It's a shame they kicked you out for something you didn't do... But maybe things will be better in the future!
I'm an orc announcer! Reporting live from this amazing event called the Allods Anniversary!

Oh, great. You're here, too.

Having fun? Seems that way. And can you believe that? No one is holding anyone by the throat or kicking their skulls in. If they all met ten years ago - you can imagine the scuffle, I'm sure.

What I mean is, the world has changed. And it happened thanks to you. Yes, yes, no need for modesty.

Rysina and Yasker are side-eyeing me, but I'm sure they've come to accept the fact that Orc Psionicists exist. My school is flourishing. We are gathering talents from all over Sarnaut. We even visit savages that probably skewered some unlucky travelers just yesterday - and we find gems there. And that is thanks to you, too.

! You're here, too!

We came here right after Irene. There's something we need to discuss...

With the Empire, too! No, I had nothing to do with any rebellions. That's Shamans' doing, I had no idea what they were planning...

Ugh, soon I'll have to start training... on Nea. It's too bad I'll have to leave my school... Though they promised to keep an eye on it. Who? Unn, that furball. She has some kind of authority with the Gibberlings, so everything should be all right on Coldberg.

I hope I'm not in trouble... Because Rysina and Yasker have been giving me dirty looks. Anyway, congratulations on your Anniversary!

Ha ha, ! The old friends are together once again.

I was miraculously released from this Suslanger! It was nothing but trouble. I was starting to forget my titles and regalia... Who am I? A trainer of Orc Psionicists? Zayan’s apprentice? The chief of the Horde? A navigator of other worlds?

Ugh, the thought makes me shudder. There's one good thing about it - Fury is helping me. She is a sensible one, even if hot tempered. If she sees a problem, she goes at it with an axe! Heh.

Anyway, we decided to take a break from all that... Let Kurgan lead them for now. We're going to travel around the world for a month or so, while there's still time...

Time until what? Didn't Eladia tell you? Hmm, maybe I shouldn't say anything, but they are mounting an Expedition. And they can't do it without me, since I'm... the navigator. But it takes time to prepare everything... And they still can't find that damn Chronophone. It would take even longer to build another one. So we still have time to kill.

Well, if they haven't called you yet, they will soon. Rest for now! Well, see you around.

Heh, it's nice to be back in Sarnaut! It's not fun in Eden: every tree thinks aloud, making your head hurt.

Well, if this is a party, let's celebrate. I've heard the news - who knew it would turn out like this? It means Klavdia miscalculated...

I'll be going to Suslanger with Fury: I need to see what the Landfill Warriors are up to, hehe... And then, perhaps, I'll return to Zayan - I still need to complete this training.

name.en: It was nice to fight side by side with you.

text.en:
Yes, I knew you would do the same! But of course you would. Klavdia and I agreed to inform her mother - it had to be done.

And as for Felix and his iron blockheads - as defenders of Sarnaut they are worthless. Just fools who messed up when they put us at war with the Children.

name.en: It's too bad we fought on different sides

text.en:
Yes, it was unpleasant. But I couldn't do otherwise, and neither could Eurial. Klavdia and I agreed to inform her mother - it had to be done.

But I don't hold grudges, so if you're ready to forget about the past, then I'll forget it, too.

Didn't expect to see me here? But like everyone else, I resurrected as soon as I was released from Nihaz's box.

We should all be grateful to our mistress Hirkalla for helping us cast off the shackles of death. I will lead her unstoppable Swarm against her enemies!

As for you, maybe you know what happened to my brother? Where is my brother, Roman Swordson...?
Do you believe in the power of insects, traveler? Even now I hear the voice of the Swarm, calling to me from the depths of the Astral...

Greetings, .

I've heard what happened at the Great Ball. Well, now you probably understand why I'm not fond of politics. My father is too obsessed with his intrigues and machinations to pay attention to the people around him.

I'm afraid his scheming will backfire in the end. Of course, Zayan will help Skulnar, but what happened at the Ball will hardly strengthen the alliance we need to oppose Nihaz.

But maybe they'll forget about their quarrels just for one night?

Greetings, .

I've heard about your deeds. Alas, I myself have nothing new to boast about: the endless siege of Nihaz's Citadel is starting to become tiresome. Every day we send the dead to storm the next entrance, giving you the opportunity to get in from the other side.

Fortunately, the cemeteries of Sarnaut are almost bottomless - there's no shortage of the undead. Capable Summoners, too.

The vampires of the House de Doucer, those who joined Annette, also provide invaluable assistance. Wigo has few supporters these days.

Hopefully, sooner or later the siege will be over. My presence is demanded by business on the Kanian Archipelago where Svetlana seems to be having some problems.

Well, we all made mistakes. We have to admit it. We thought we were fighting Nihaz, but this god led us straight to his Citadel by sending us these coordinates.

Now our army serves Hirkalla... For what purpose? Who knows... She speaks of the gods of Light and Order, tyrants from other worlds who do not tolerate dissent and apostasy. What if they are a greater threat to Sarnaut than she is?

Greetings! Yes, we happened to meet in battle. Even though I lost, the same force brought me back to life, and it will be like this every time.

We left Jigran because we could no longer control the undead. But Skrakan needs us to serve the Great Mages. There are many dangers in the world. Swords are needed everywhere. Have you ever heard about the witches' coven? And they are just as dangerous as Tep. Morrana wanted the Scroll of Tensess for herself, and the Dale witches tried to get their hands on Urd's Folio. Who knows what else they are up to? Witch hunters told me a story how witches from the coven commit atrocities on distant allods...

Greetings! You and I fought against the nihilists and the Paladins... But every battle comes to an end.

We left Jigran because we could no longer control the undead. But Skrakan needs us to serve the Great Mages. There are many dangers in the world. Swords are needed everywhere. Have you ever heard about the witches' coven? And they are just as dangerous as Tep. Morrana wanted the Scroll of Tensess for herself, and the Dale witches tried to get their hands on Urd's Folio. Who knows what else they are up to? Witch hunters told me a story how witches from the coven commit atrocities on distant allods...
Ah, I'm itching for a fight... I remember how we walked through the glorious lands of Umoir, performing feats and fighting against the servants of the demon. It wasn't that long ago...

Oh, hello!

This is fun. Good ideas! And interesting contests!

We didn't think we'd get invited. After the whole mess with Zakhar Krestov on Sogot... everyone is side-eyeing us. They think we're some kind of fanatics.

But in truth... Our chief Negus Baruti was furious when he heard about it. He says our reputation is ruined, and the whole Sarnaut knows it.

So we'll lie low for a while. We have our own entertainment here, if you're interested: fist fights. It's simple – it's you or them. And you can bet your coin on fighters.

There are also demons... anyway, there's a coin in each cage. If you're brave enough, you can try and get them! Watch out for your fingers, though! Haha.

Ah, there are so many different guests here, right?

I was also invited, of course. Like all the times before. But back then I had other things to do! Fortunately, this year I'm completely free.

Still, look at this sophisticated gathering. Although I'm surprised to see certain people here.

Anyway, it was nice talking to you, . I still need to speak with Catherina about financing her Expedition.

What, you're not a hero anymore?

Everyone turned their back on you? And George knew. He foresaw it... But that’s fine, you can be a hero without all the accolades, right?

Golly! It's fun here! We had no idea you gathered like this every year, otherwise we would've found our way here ages ago, ha ha! I'm joking!

Yes, we have visited many places - Siveria, the Frozen Frontier, and Lightwood. We didn’t like what we saw: our kin are mistreated. Other nations have more land, and what we have is of poor quality. But we'll talk about this later.

I'll go fight these orcs!

Buddy! What brings you here?

I wanted to see what all the fuss was about, and since the jinn came here, I followed him.

Things are quiet on Suslanger. The Orcs calmed down a bit, and the adventurers chased away those who kept them from finding the treasures.

I have also discovered something interesting... Perhaps I will tell you later.

Listen, you’re talking to all these Great Mages, and I’m a nobody, even if I were a village elder at some point. Can you put in a word for me? I need one little thing - a dragon's heart.

Did you think Empress Hirkalla was out of the picture? No, the Empress ordered me to closely watch anyone who would speak against her!

And has not revoked her decrees, she expects them to be upheld! Fortunately, she has not just monsters, but also the loyal guard on her side.

However, if you find yourself in the southern regions of Jigran, see if the Elder is as powerful as they say and if he needs new servants with experience - in managing a village, searching for precious metals, infiltrating secret organizations, espionage and disinformation...

Ah, it's you...

Well, are you happy? Did you get what you wanted? Saved Skulnar from Elleken?

My father has plans that go far into the future. I tried to warn Zayan, but he refuses to listen to me...

You know, I acted in his interests for so many years, but as soon as I stumbled, he was quick to forget about me. It made me rethink what I believed about everything happening in our world, and my mother's actions started making sense.

I want to protect Sarnaut from Nihaz. These gods do not belong here.

If we have to use Skulnar, so be it.

I'm not going to put up with the Darkness in Sarnaut, whatever the motives of this Hirkalla. I'm sure we can handle it ourselves, because you and the others have managed to challenge and defeat even more powerful creatures so far!

Since you were able to thwart her plans in Eden, maybe you can do it here, too?

I need to talk to Zayan - together we can work something out.

name.en: It was nice to fight side by side with you.

text.en:
Yes, it couldn't be otherwise! I knew you would not buy into the promises of Catherina and this psychopath Felix. The Children are in the right. As for the All-Mother - yes, you can and should disagree with her, but opposing her? Indirectly helping Nihaz and Hirkalla? That would plunge all worlds into darkness!

Hirkalla has violated all the laws - both divine and human, and who knows what this will lead to? The dead have awakened, our allods are plunging into nightmares, and something is happening to the Great Trees...

name.en: It's too bad we fought on different sides

text.en:
I'm sorry this happened! But I hope you can see now that the All-Mother was partly right.

Hirkalla has violated all the laws - both divine and human, and who knows what this will lead to? The dead have awakened, our allods are plunging into nightmares, and something is happening to the Great Trees...

We must stop her at all costs, find allies who will agree to challenge her!

Hah, you've come up with a lot of plans! Everyone will have their own idea of how to deal with Tep... But I have something, too. And I understand dark magic, trust me! My father is probably not the only mage in this poor world, right?

Zayan won't tell you this, but believe me - the elves witnessed Hickut's death, but not the fate of the Junes who had fallen victim to Sarn's curse back in the day.

The Conclave, when they were convinced the Plague was gone, could not leave all these artifacts and grimoires lying freely accessible in the dead cities. The expedition they assembled took everything that was even remotely dangerous. Where do you think it ended up? And how did Armando's father, Gramont, came up with that spell?

Yes, these powerful items are somewhere on Nocturne... Maybe I should visit it? They say the House de Douceur has some problems there...

I suppose you have questions… That haven't been answered yet. So... who am I to you? This version of me, I mean. Well, I remember how we went to Ferris, how Tungars captured me... I remember our meeting at the Death Plant. I'm the same Elena as my... original copy. But there's something else in my head... the Architects' information... the Sculptor's memories... I'm something different...

There you are... We just came from Jigran, and we're about to leave again... I suppose you have questions... That haven't been answered yet. So... who am I to you? This version of me, I mean. Well, I remember how we went to Ferris, how Tungars captured me... I remember our meeting at the Death Plant. I'm the same Elena as my... original copy. But there's something else in my head... the Architects' information... the Sculptor's memories... I'm something different...
You know, I'm not sure I'll come back to life if I die. I don't know what will happen to my Spark which is essentially a copy of another Spark... I need to speak with the others here.

Yes, we decided to leave Jigran for now. You know, I'm not sure I'll come back to life if I die. I don't know what will happen to my Spark which is essentially a copy of another Spark...

This allod is becoming too dangerous! The threat to all living things comes from the south where Hirkalla's power over the army of the dead is fading away with each passing day... An old villain has risen in Sadrok, and it became the stage for his revenge on his adversaries.

I need to speak with Skrakan, Danas and the others.
Oh, we brought little ones here, and they ran off again! This ship is so huge, I'm worried I'll never find them!

At ease, soldier!

They must have confused you, eh? Your face says it all. You must be tired of all those divine designs and intrigues. Well, I'll have a task for you...

At ease, soldier!

They must have confused you, eh? Your face says it all. You must be tired of all those divine designs and intrigues. Well, I'll have a task for you...

The Orcs are rebelling on the Izune Allod! Just think! While we are fighting for all of them here, they are robbing, pillaging, and killing common folk, and no one can bring them to justice?

Yes, Yasker wants to resolve the whole matter peacefully, but you and I both know that the only way to resolve it is to go there and show them what's what! The sure-fire way!

The Great Mages have always speculated about things lying beyond Sarnaut. During the Cataclysm, many works were written about this, even though such research was prohibited by the Conclave. Skrakan himself was extremely interested in this...

And now we know what's there.

Many other worlds where great forces wage their war. And we became part of this war.

We weren't given much choice, however. It looks like no one in these worlds has it.

What do we do? How do we proceed? Alas, I can't give you any advice... It's up to you.

Hello! It's good to see you again after all that dark business on Jigran! Nihilists who fought on your side... What an amazing force they had gathered! I'm afraid the Order of Stars might be behind this. They once fought the Great Mages...

Though maybe it's not them but the spirit of rebellion in Sarnaut. The Elves and Gibberlings are drifting away from Kania, the Arisen Zem are angry with Xadagan which failed to protect them, the Orcs are actually rebelling! But the most dangerous are those who seem meek and quiet...

Goblins! Who knows what they'll get up to? Goblins are decent mages and technicians... It's a threat no one has foreseen. It might be deadly!

Hello! It's good to see you again after all that dark business on Jigran! Nihilists who fought on your side... What an amazing force they had gathered! I'm afraid the Order of Stars might be behind this. They once fought the Great Mages...

Though maybe it's not them but the spirit of rebellion in Sarnaut. The Elves and Gibberlings are drifting away from Kania, the Arisen Zem are angry with Xadagan which failed to protect them, the Orcs are actually rebelling! But the most dangerous are those who seem meek and quiet...

Goblins! Who knows what they'll get up to? Goblins are decent mages and technicians... It's a threat no one has foreseen. It might be deadly!
They say magic is a sword without a hilt. You can't hold it without it affecting you. But even without a hilt, a sword is still a sword. And you can use it to defend yourself.
What a surprise! I knew I'd see you again... Fish bones told me something about you... Hmm, I forgot what exactly... But I remember that you need to be wary of scissors...

Oh, my! There are creatures I've never seen in our forest! The Pridens are inviting me to Howlem - to see their forests... I think I'll go...

Well, once we drink all the beer here!

It's peaceful...

You know, it makes me want to sing!

Something like "happy birthday", yes. But I'll need something to play the tune. I saw a guy with a harmonica around here. I wonder how people would react to a crocodile with a harmonica?
I have given up gambling, and I intend to use my engineering and mathematical knowledge to develop a real game theory and to understand how chance manifests itself in real life!

Ah, thank you for your help... As soon as I got my destiny back, the madness left me...

I have given up gambling, and I intend to use my engineering and mathematical knowledge to develop a real game theory and to understand how chance manifests itself in real life!

Well, of course, I apologized to Lisa and married her. Together we will use the inheritance from the old countess to improve the lives of the people around us...
Come here, you...
Ahh! Not fair!
Shoo!! Shoo!
I found the best hiding spot!
And I'm hungry.

Uh. Ahem.

, I believe? I'm very pleased to meet you.

It's amazing to see someone who does so much for our world. Alas, I rarely manage to participate in adventures, unless someone summons me in battle.

However, we are here for a reason, and it's directly related to your actions. You already know about "Gates-3", but the Expedition to another world is being kept secret.

We are going to fund this undertaking because it promises huge profits. This newfangled Ambrosia power engineering is becoming increasingly important, and there are clearly not enough sources of this rare substance. Apparently, they can be found in another world...

Which is how we ended up making the investment. Fortunately, our funds are full at this time, so we were able to allocate the necessary resources.

Hehe, young manlady, it must be hard to hear those unfair words from Aidenus and Yasker? I'll tell you how it is - if anyone is to blame for what happened, it's our, ahem... leaders. And their attempts to push all the blame onto you is them trying to cop out of their responsibility.

I have a business offer. The Tycoon Club has been aiding you for a while, and we recognize that this cooperation has room for further development. Perhaps it's time to leave the service of the inert League or the dogmatic Empire and start working with us? Think about it.

How could we miss such a celebration? Though I see the list of guests is a bit shorter now... Well, I'm sure we'll find something to talk about even with the Gibberlings...

These people are born sailors, and while they spent centuries isolated on Isa, I'm sure they'll get into the swing of it quickly...

We're hiring more crews now - all because of those cursed pirates... Neither the League nor the Empire care about them, and those bastards built ports in the deep Astral and started making forays into our territories. They attack my ships! The gall!

Ahem.

Young people, idling about? While we're so busy here.

Who do you think rules our world? The Conclave of the Great Mages? Or the governors of the allods? Generals of the Empire? Ancient sorcerers? Almighty gods?

Or is it the Tycoons, huh?

It's close, but it's not the correct answer. Our world is ruled by money. Crystals or gold - it doesn't matter. But try and imagine one gold coin. And now imagine a billion of them - it's our company's weekly turnover. That's the real power that rules our world.

Why the long face, young manlady? Are you upset about what these two fools, Aidenus and Yasker, said to you? Never mind all that. What do they know? I wouldn't trust them to sweep the floor.

The Tycoon Club is quite impressed with what you have achieved in Eden. It's not about the Ambrosia, no. Information is what's important - it's worth something on its own.

We see huge potential for growth. Our world is too cramped for the Free Traders already, and the Star Trail seems to be the perfect solution.

We've heard of your exploits on Isa, young manlady! Well, a newly discovered allod is wonderful news. I'm sure the Gibberlings will appreciate the advantages of doing business with the Free Traders. After all, we have much to offer.

Despite the political perturbations, our field of activity is growing both outward and inward, since Sarnaut still has places that remain unexplored...

Uh, here we meet again, buddy... Yes, I'm sick of that Citadel. Everyday it's demons, vampires, or dragons, and you have to deal with them all...

And I'm just a simple man, even if a ghost. But it looks like our service is over. Now we are going to Jigran. Where will fate take us next? Who knows, who knows...

Ah, once again I find myself without guidance! I'm not good at thinking for myself, I need orders to follow... I suppose I'll have to serve the Mistress of Umoir, get hired as a guard somewhere... I was a voivode in the Settlement... I have some experience! Or maybe Zakh will find me some work for old sake's sake?

I'm a simple man - I became a governor not because I was good at thinking, but because I knew when a punch could solve a problem. And all these speculations only make my head hurt. It's true what they say - if it's too complicated, it can't be good.

Oh, I knew we'd see each other again...

 I just didn’t think it would happen so soon. However, I don't think I have a choice. The League and the Empire have failed - let's face it. Now SHE is in charge of everything - and Aidenus and Yasker will dance to her tune.

It doesn't quite suit me, but we have to work with what we have, not what we wish for.

Most likely, if everything goes according to HER plan, there will be no trace of the current states.

Why?

It's simple - if everyone who has ever died is resurrected, most of them have never been subjects of either the League or the Empire in its modern form.

The simplest estimates say that most of the resurrected will be former citizens of the Kanian Empire, the version that existed before the Cataclysm.

Again, why?

It's simple - at that moment the population of our world was the largest, and the old Kania was the most populated state. After the split, most died, and the number of people living since then is nowhere near those values. But that state, just like Xadagan, was much more developed than the primitive kingdoms of the Allods era which rolled back to chivalry and feudalism at first. But... we'll see.

I also understand that you are interested in our contract. It's still valid. You see, SHE released the Sparks from Nihaz's Box. But Nezeb was not in the Box. He is still somewhere out there, in the astral plane. And you will need to find him.
You remember your debt, right? You owe me! Ah, I wish could steal a ship and set sail in search of Nezeb's Spark...
Chronicles lie, just like everything else. History is written in a way that it has its own heroes and villains, but there are no heroes or villains in real life.

I'm glad to see you. Yes, I managed to recover my destiny, and the eternal melancholy that enveloped me has retreated! However, I understand now that I have caused a lot of grief to other living beings… And I feel that I must somehow atone for my actions! Perhaps by doing something for the benefit of others I can earn their forgiveness? In any case, Jigran still needs protection, and I will continue to guard the borders of our settlements...

Greetings, !

She's a beautiful vessel, isn't she? Although, she can't compare to the Galleon Castle.

It's lacks luster, I'd say. Too utilitarian. I've been thinking of building something like this, but I'm leaning towards commissioning it from Renard...

But this celebration is top notch. I know what I'm talking about, you see. Happy Anniversary!

My cards foretold that I'd see you here. They also foretold excellent entertainment and crowds of people, and they were correct.

Perhaps you heard predictions about our future? Vampires, demons, all that nasty vermin. But don't you worry!

I saw good things, too. Like you having snowball fights and sledging this winter. You'll overcome everything, I'm sure of that.

My cards foretold that I'd see you here again, . They also foretold excellent entertainment and crowds of people, and they were correct.

Perhaps you heard predictions about our future? No? And there's something troubling happening on Suslanger... Don't worry, I believe everything will be fine.

I saw good things, too. Like you having snowball fights and sledging this winter.

So don't worry, everything will be fine. Just celebrate the Anniversary!

There was a girl in the pioneer camp...

When heroes came to see her, she played with them!

Clap your hands,

one, two, three.

Then hands at your sides,

like a giant tree!

There was a girl in the pioneer camp...

When heroes came to see her, she played with them!

Clap your hands,

one, two, three.

Then hands at your sides,

like a giant tree!

Oh, the wind of my sails, the clouds of my sky! The old jinn is glad to see you on this strange ship that flies through the void.

They had been asking me to come here for weeks, but I was afraid to leave Suslanger. Fortunately, your actions have given me enough peace of mind to do it. The evil Ifrits are tamed, and the Orcs, greedy for Nezeb's treasures, are hiding in their junkyard.

That is why I have conjured up the most convincing illusion possible. It will replace me until I return to my sands.

I see amazing things here. There are many people I once knew but have not seen for many centuries...
Carr! One who is black as a raven hides their black thoughts under their blackness!

Ah, I'm glad to see you at this celebration, my friend. It may seem that only a couple of years have passed since the Great Ball, but look how much has happened. Changes are brewing in the politics of the Great Houses as old alliances are broken and new ones emerge.

Houses de Delice, Pluie, and Desirae have decided that the future of the Elves lies with the Free Traders. We need a new alliance consisting of free allods that everyone can freely enter. Dane may become the center of it, but the Elves will play a significant role in it.
Dear friend, it's nice to see you at this celebration! The entertainment aboard Catherina's ship may not be the best, but I'm glad to see some of the guests here.
I'm still busy with my experiments, working to improve zombies for the Necro-Incubator...

Fate? A very strange matter... But I don't think what happened affected me in any way. I'm still busy with my experiments, working to improve zombies for the Necro-Incubator... What changed?

Now we need to focus on research and experiments! Jigran is a unique place where many different forces collided - both divine and primal, one might even say primordial!

! We meet again.

I'm here to warn you all. For I believe you are heading straight into the trap of the Dark God. He is cunning, as an owl is cunning in the night. He lies in wait for you on many paths, and very few of those are straight paths.

Everything you have done, everything you have devised - he knew about it in advance, for his capabilities are not the capabilities of mortals, but the powers of God. He persuaded you to do what he wanted with false promises, he put tools in your hands so you could forge your own chain...

Listen to me carefully: I had a vision of what is coming. Sarnaut will become the dominion of Darkness, and Death will rule among the ruins. And you will serve this Death... But in the land that is forgotten, amid ice and fire, there is still hope...

If you think I'm just another mindless tyrant and oppressor, then you are stupid. My mission is to stir up your drowsy swamp, and to give you a chance to play with other gods on an equal footing. You have a huge potential, and I will try to unleash it. Of course, sacrifices are inevitable, as are some... difficulties. But the end justifies the means, and all the losses will not be in vain in the end.

name.en: Why did Klavdia run away from the battle?

text.en:
My sister can hardly be called brave. However, in this case, she was not afraid. She acted out of calculation, although many would call it cowardice.

But she decided to toy with time. As you understand, Alice is Klavdia, the Klavdia who disappeared from the battlefield and used the Gates to visit the past.

 It all happened in an instant for you, but this sudden opening of the Gates resulted in the release of the All-Mother's power into the past, creating the Ambrosia on Suslanger that you encountered a year earlier.

And now we have a classic case where the future and the past begin to influence each other.
You yourself had a similar experience when you used Gates-2 and stole the Grain of Protopower from Zayan. The snake has bitten its tail, and time forms a closed loop.

Little sister wants to change the future, but it's impossible.

However, I suppose we will see her again when she gets tired of running like a squirrel in a wheel.

name.en: Why is the All-Mother weaker than Nihaz?

text.en:
What kind of question is that? Nihaz is the god of darkness who has absorbed the power of destruction, death, and other forces, and she is... a simple deity of Life and Creation.

Really, what did you expect from her, what kind of help? It's not even Sarn with his scorching Light which he wielded before his imprisonment and subsequent madness. In the City of Demons, you only saw a faint glimpse of his powers.

The All-Mother, of course, is also capable of punishing her enemies, which she demonstrated to you at the "Trial" arranged for the entertainment of her minions. Surrounded by her adherents and believers, she is much more powerful over there. Of course, if she had been given time, she could have spawned the deities of Light and Order here - defenders who are in fact tyrants...

But we did not give her this chance. Klavdia naively assumed that Nihaz was powerless, but he was ready for the arrival of the All-Mother in Sarnaut. The empty prison became a trap for a god.

name.en: How does the resurrection of all the dead work?

text.en:
Well, as you can see, I don't waste words. But don't expect everything to be ready in an instant I will indeed resurrect all these poor mortals, but it will take some time - after all, they need bodies that they do not have, and it's not easy to create new ones from nothing. You need a lot of energy... I guess you already know the general principle since you took part in the creation of this Cradle required to open a portal to the Dead City...

It's enough for now that they have been liberated. Little by little, they will be brought back to life - one by one, from the most useful to the ones I don't need at all.

Of course, this does not apply to those who left Sarnaut. Their Sparks can hardly be found now... Although, if we win, resurrection will be granted to all worlds.
I was once called "Death Incarnate", I walked through other worlds, asserting my father's authority! Begone before I get angry and send your soul to purgatory!

It's a little sad... Why? Well, our world was simple, there were us and our enemies, the Urun. Isa was big for us, but now...

Now she has become small, and our enemies are not the same now. The world is so big! There's so much in it! And there are more worlds beyond its borders! There are more of them than grains of sand on the shore. Who are we then in this infinity?

Ugh, I need to wash this thought down... Pour me another!
There is something I don't understand... So our natural cousins, Spiritwoods and Kikimoras, are like pets to you? Like some kind of squirrels? How come?

If the Great Void - or the Astral, as you call it - is a large ocean, then it must have its own Lyngbakr... Oh, we've heard all about the Octulhu. You might not believe it, but we've already hunted one with Froddy and the crew of the Sparrow. They were saying something about some Battle Campaign and that they urgently needed to kill ten Octulhus... As I understand it, these campaigns of yours are something like our Winter Watch...

But there must be fish bigger than this Octhulhu!
And then we thought of something: we want to borrow a ship from this sorceress and visit a certain place... Just don’t tell her!
Do you think this Eclipse is hard to control? I don't think so - you don't need to hoist sails, just turn the wheel...

Quiet, you fools. Or everyone's going to find out...

Ah, it's you! Hello, hello! Listen, do you know anyone who has a head for ship reactors?

Hic...! Wow, that's some... s-strong stuff! Really f-feeling it now... I met someone... Tekyan, I think. They are s-sort of our distant kin, yeah? W-we should invite them here... Offer our m-mead... Hic!

Existing as a ghost is another interesting kind of being. I should have "thanked" you for it, but... Perhaps it's my own fault... Our business is trade, and somehow I got too carried away with my plans. Catherina later explained my mistake to me.

So I don't hold grudges. It's just business, nothing personal.

I'm even willing to help you out if you need a new weapon.
I'm not a dealer in death, as many say. There's no need for pomposity. I'm just a arms dealer, and how they are used is not my concern.
There's plenty of wise vipers on Is-sa... I'll have s-someone to talk to... S-soon we, the Firs-st, will open a portal from Howlem to other lands-s.

Yes, I'm alive too. Life gives you countless opportunities, doesn't it? A new time is dawning in Sarnaut, the time of the Free Traders, not the old states! In this era, people like me can rise to heights that have not been achievable until now, don't you think? In any case, my island is reopened, and soon the Arena will once again cheer for its champions!
Perhaps the young hero was thinking about participating in hot fights in the Arena? I'm ready to provide such an opportunity!
According to all these mages, absorbing the power of the Thunderstorm made me some kind of unique creature that can take the form of the Thunderstorm spirit at will...

Greetings! Even though I recovered my destiny, I nevertheless retained my magical power. I continued to serve Empress Hirkalla. According to all these mages, absorbing the power of the Thunderstorm made me some kind of unique creature that can take the form of the Thunderstorm spirit at will... Such power must serve ordinary people... Moreover, together with my husband and former lover I organized a trading enterprise that supplies food and artisan goods to all corners of our allod!

Now, when a new threat has come from the south, I will protect Kelinovka from any danger!

Oh, I see! The dead are resurrected! Yes, but it's all nonsense - that's what I'll tell you. I know this - I myself have been a ghost for a year now. I'll be honest with you, having no body is not fun. And where do we put a horde of ghosts? There is a place, they say...

Zakh gathered us here, seeing as the people of Umoir are also here. Why not go sailing... We sailed with this Klavdia once... I have a feeling we'll hit the road again soon!

And as for Tep, we've seen worse! If we have to, we will go again, or rather, crawl on our bellies like in those days!

I think I'll go have a beer. I still can't get used to the fact that we are almost alive now...
Eh, I remember how Zak and I crawled all over Gipat on our bellies.

A great occasion for celebration.

But remember – our enemy is close. I'm afraid there'll be no joyous days in our future.

I'll send a message to you soon. Be prepared.

, I've noticed your leaders have become somewhat... overconfident? Do they think Nihaz is finished?

That's not the case, I'm afraid. You have only dealt with his minions. The Citadel itself is still under his control.

Aidenus, Catherina, and Yasker - what are they planning? You don't know? Neither do I. That troubles me. In their quest for power, they forget that we all serve one purpose. There shouldn't be any quarrels between us. I should remind them of the consequences of disobedience...

Alright, don't let me keep you from the festivities. Let's celebrate the Anniversary.

Ahaha! How are you, ? You are here, too!

It's a miracle I've made it here at all. I had to gave up some of my associates to persuade Zarida to take me along!

There are still a lot of us left on Umoir. Victoria keeps trying to catch some of those animals. But I have all my caches marked on the map - all the landing spots for our smuggled goods.

So I'm quite an important person now - they might even make me a Customs officer.

They told me all the booze is in your honor? Wow! They weren't lying, then? Congratulations.

Hello, hello, ! How are you?

I'm great. I gathered my team again, and now we work for Zarida, transporting all sort of goods through the Astral – from Umoir to Suslanger, from Suslanger to Yakhch, from Yakhch to Umoir.

While the profits are not impressive, we are doing alright, yeah. Stability is more important. And now with this Ambrosia, the money is really good. Except this stupid storm is making things difficult, so right now we're at a standstill.

But there's another thing. We're going to be transporting Mechanoids. Thousands of them have been assembled, all shiny and polished - we just need to load them up and go!

We helped the All-Mother! Should I go back to Eden and help my people in their fight against the Expedition? I'm told Rhubarb continues to fight... Or should I look for more allies? Like those Star Knights?

May the power of Life bless you! I have a message from my home world, just for you! Like a wave from a rock falling into the water, the news of a new God of Death is spreading across the worlds! This new threat, which exceeds the threat of Nihaz and the architects, has forced the gods to unite. The Divine Children of the All-Mother have realized how much is at stake. But each of them is an army of their own... Who knows, perhaps they will storm the Gates of Ganzir or even come here, to Sarnaut?

Such is the message of the Children of Light, and I have already informed the Conclave...

Who awakened me?

Who was it? I slept and dreamed... What kind of dreams did I have...? I remember the tree that lost its leaves, as though fall had come. I remember the rains in the city of the dead on dark rivers, I remember the majestic pyramids that stand in the middle of the desert valleys...
The shadows have awakened, and they are calling to us.

Catherina knows how to impress people, . I have no doubt her creation is worth a lot, though everyone present will try to diminish its importance.

But if we let go of our habit of negating other people's projects, this ship is an outstanding creation of the human race...

Our approaches are quite different. When you visited the Galleon Castle, you had the opportunity to see that. But the Eclipse serves its purpose well. I'm curious what this project on Suslanger will amount to. After all, it's trying to combine different traditions.

Congratulations, .

It's nice to meet you again, !

Oh, this year has been delightful. Thirty years have passed since the Ball where we won, and every day of those years has been a real torment, I swear. Ruling your own House is not easy, and running the Elven Houses, this ball of snakes... You can imagine how hard it can be...

Nevertheless, I continue to closely monitor what is happening in our world. While my son is on an extremely important mission, things are taking their course. As I expected, the appearance of the Great Mage among the Orcs caused unrest in the Empire. Realizing this, Yasker tried to mitigate the possible consequences by forming an alliance with the League, thereby gaining a respite and time for re-equipping his forces.

For the first time since the foundation of the League, we have a situation where the balance of power can radically change.

May the Light bless you!

I'm happy to see you here. Let me wish you a happy anniversary on behalf of all elves – and please accept this invitation to our next Great Ball.

You know, there's something beautiful about these festivities. It's a good occasion for a chat. I already talked to... Elizaveta Rysina. We discussed matters of Faith. And belief in Faith, of course. The thing is, in light of the recent Revelations, we'll have to make amendments to our doctrines.

I also spoke with the Pridens, Aviaks, and Tekyan. Everyone who believes in the Light. I hope soon we'll have a unified Holy Church in Sarnaut!

I'm glad to see you again, - this time on board the Eclipse. The Great Ball is over, and now it's time for the consequences...

I would like to believe Antoinette's politics will lead us into a new era of peace! Perhaps it will be so. For now, we still need to deal with Darkness, so this is no time for disputes.

And, of course, we are faced with eternal questions that our faith in the Light asks us... I think everything is ready for us to overcome our contradictions and try to find the truth. Where do we look for it? I believe you'll find the answer... Who knows where your path takes you? Perhaps Sarnaut is becoming too small for you, !

Think about it after the Anniversary. Relax and have fun for now.

Ah, , I'm glad to see you…

Another year has passed and here we are again on this ship. I wonder what will happen next year?

During this time, we have taken many steps towards our unity. We need to rethink everything we know. Discussions at our cathedral are in full swing, because everyone sees it differently.

So the Church of Eternal Light – which unites the Church of Light, the Trinity Church, and the enlightened Pridens – needs some help.

We believe the answers to our questions are hidden in those other worlds. I believe the Expedition won't be able to proceed without you, so I'd like to ask a favor of you. We need to understand where the Light as a force came from. Does it have a source... besides our faith?

Light gives me strength! We stood firm in the confrontation with the dark goddess and defended the great Cathedral with Hiero and his followers. Now we are facing a much more powerful enemy, Tep. Another face of Darkness, like demons or architects... I know they call themselves differently, but the Light reveals the truth to me - these are all faces of darkness, countless and invincible!

And that Aisa who took people's destinies - isn't she another dark entity?

Face the truth: there is one true path, the path of the primordial light, everything else is false...

Light gives me strength! Do you really think your defection will be forgotten? You swore allegiance to the Dark Goddess, and it doesn't matter that she was deceived by another enemy, another face of Darkness, like demons or architects...

I know they call themselves differently, but the Light reveals the truth to me - these are all faces of darkness, countless and invincible!

And that Aisa who took people's destinies - isn't she another dark entity?

Face the truth: there is one true path, the path of the primordial light, everything else is false...

It's an interesting place, !

But there's something missing. It's probably the fireworks... I believe I can improve the formula! It's all about brisance. They could stand to be more... striking.

I should discuss this with Catherina. Although it's time for me to return to Gelida. Things are not going well without me... I need to keep an eye on everything, you see.

Alright, let's just try to enjoy ourselves for the time being! Work can wait. That goes for you, too.

In the depth of the Astral, I heard her call. The Queen of Death came to Sarnaut, and I could not help answering the call. Now I must wait for the hour when allods will again be enveloped by the plague. Existence must be reborn...

I was born on the streets of the dead cities of Hickut, from the screams of the dying, and from the black winds that sow death. I was the terror, the scourge of the full-blooded cities of Kania, the deadly fear that drove the caravans of Ugra away from the infested oases. I saw bonfires in the steppes and abandoned villages among the ice of Isa...

I was born on the streets of the dead cities of Hickut, from the screams of the dying, and from the black winds that sow death. I was the terror, the scourge of the full-blooded cities of Kania, the deadly fear that drove the caravans of Ugra away from the infested oases. I saw bonfires in the steppes and abandoned villages among the ice of Isa...

Aho!

We haven't seen each other since Irene, right? I heard about your adventures on Suslanger. It made me regret I wasn't there, even though I’m not a fan of heat and sand. But does anyone have your back out there?

I have my own business on Ferris, but I'm ready to be done with it soon. Maybe then we'll go back to the good old days...

In short, if you ever need a strong arm and a brave heart, I will always answer your call.

What a meeting, eysh! I did not expect to see you here, but I'm glad you came.

I see the guest list has changed... And while I'm glad to see old friends, new guests cause concern. Some of those we met on Ferris reeked of secrets, didn't they?

The Darkness turned out to be more insidious than we thought. But that doesn't mean all is lost, does it? I'm sure we'll come up with something eventually.

name.en: I know that you helped the Children...

text.en:
A little trick from the old scout, eysh! I didn’t leave the Catherina's camp - I wanted to see what these soldiers were up to… Like Skulnar, I understood that our task was different - not to assist in the extraction of the Ambrosia, but to negotiate an agreement with the All Mother.

And despite what happened later, I don't regret my actions. Disarming that bomb was the right thing to do. It's good that both Herbert and Elena managed to leave and travel to other worlds.

name.en: But you were on the Children's side...

text.en:
Sorry about the deception, kylys. I still remembered our initial task that Klavdia gave us - to find her mother and negotiate with her, and Felix's actions were the opposite of that! So while I stayed in the Expedition camp, I nevertheless told Skulnar everything that was happening there...

I hope you're not holding a grudge, eysh. You saw how it all turned out! But I still have no regrets. Disarming that bomb was the right thing to do. It's good that both Herbert and Elena managed to leave and travel to other worlds.
Eysh! I just came back from Isa. We still can't pacify the Urun! Of course, Kharyskhan is gone, but they are a stubborn bunch... It's going to take some time!

Aho, frriend! The news we bring is not good.

Not all is calm on Isa and Howlem - although we pacified the Uruns after Kharyskhan's disappearance, great frosts are descending from the mountains, and now even the stupid Tya-ah are forced to retreat to the lowlands. The astral currents are also unstable. Only the power of the First Ones keeps us safe, eysh!

The wise Doolga say it's because of the power that was granted not only to the First Ones, but also to other old gods - and Helad is the most insidious of them!

So it's not just about Tep. The Arisen told me there are worshippers of Helad, Scorched Guardian, and others among them!
If you follow the path pointed out by a liar, you will find only lies at the bottom of the misty city! Carr!

Awakened from eternal sleep? Placed in the service of the forces of darkness? What happened should have upset me, but what's the point of being upset? All my life I have looked at my surroundings, aiming my bow, but I have also had to think about many things. What do we want, after all? A prosperous Sarnaut? The same for my native Kania that I served.

Our road will not be straight. We are still only pawns in the hands of these gods, and our goal is to reach the edge of the board. Sooner or later, the surviving pawn will become the queen, and we will be able to dictate the rules of this game ourselves.

Yes, we couldn't take the Cathedral, you and the Paladins were stronger. But that's in the past now - we no longer serve Hirkalla.

It's not the first time we are here, but it's the first time we're free of someone else's influence.

We are on our own, but our service is not over yet - we serve Sarnaut itself.

But it would be nice to return to Umoir. Resurrected by Hirkalla, many who once lived are looking for a new place for themselves - and the most talented of them are now awaited in Glimor, in the technomagic academy where they are introduced to the latest technology developed by Catherina's students.

We both fought for the dark mistress, but then fate steered us in different directions. We left Hirkalla's service.

It's not the first time we are here, but it's the first time we're free of someone else's influence.

We are on our own, but our service is not over yet - we serve Sarnaut itself.

But it would be nice to return to Umoir. Resurrected by Hirkalla, many who once lived are looking for a new place for themselves - and the most talented of them are now awaited in Glimor, in the technomagic academy where they are introduced to the latest technology developed by Catherina's students.
In my time, everything seemed simple - true friends were behind me, enemies were ahead, and my arrow would cover this distance.

We should arrange a celebration in Darkblood Citadel... But Eclipse will do, I suppose.

But what can I tell you? You already know everything. Yes, it's your celebration, .

I'm already writing about your deeds in my Chronicles. Yes, there are many pages about you. In that regard, you are on a par with people like Danas, Iglez, Ath-Zak. , the hero of Sarnaut. How does that sound?

But remember: history is often a comedy, and even more often, a tragedy. Your story is not finished yet, and how it ends depends on you.

Like the last time, Catherina acts as a hospitable hostess, ...

But I'm glad we have this opportunity to meet again and discuss everything. The last year presented quite a few challenges.

Unity is a fragile thing, and soon our alliances will be tested. It's not even about the League and Empire, though I'm pleased that Aidenus and Yasker are trying to find a common ground.

A difficult time awaits the League and Empire, because both are torn apart by internal conflicts.

And Cosmos whose actions give cause for concern. No, I don't believe he is Nihaz's puppet, but he's been making a lot of enemies by his uncompromising choices.

Let's discuss this after the Anniversary... For now, let's celebrate!

Ah, ...

What should I tell you this time... First of all, you should have talked to me before opening the Gates to some other world. I'm afraid Catherina and Klavdia acted too rashly...

I'm not sure we need to rush things in the current situation. I spoke with some of the guests, and they agree that the risks are great. And some are only concerned about future profits...

But since the decision has already been made, I will help you. First of all, we need Skulnar. Perhaps we'll find out what Elleken really meant.

When will you stop falling into every trap set for you? Really, bringing a goddess to a world that served as a prison for a god? Releasing an ancient orc, freeing his soul when everyone was being resurrected? Spilling everything you'd been through to a monk who was totally not suspicious?

But alright, everyone makes mistakes, and the Great Mages who destroyed the world have no business lecturing you...

I will continue to follow your adventures... It seems that your connection to this mysterious Luck is what makes them so interesting.

Greetings.

They call us, the Arisen, unemotional. But right now I feel joy.

These ten years were a real breakthrough. We've learned so much. We found Tep and managed to stop him. Understood our role in the game of mad Gods. Put an end to this foolish war.

Something big is ahead. I believe that now.

Greetings, .

I must admit last year I had no idea we were witnessing the birth of a new tradition: meeting on this ship every year...

But let's leave the congratulatory speeches to those who have a responsibility to make them. You must be wondering: what's happening in the world?

Nihaz is locked up in his Citadel. The Great Ball of the Elves is over, and their politics have changed. The Orcs are dismayed by the news of their Great Mage. But you took part in all these events.

There is something, however, that happens without your knowledge. The secret project on Suslanger in particular, though it is too early to talk about that one. You will probably hear about it at some point. On Xadagan, we also started one very important project for my people - it's meant to secure our future. I can't tell you any details yet, but we've learned a lot from Tep and his cultists. It will all serve the Zem people well.

Greetings, .

Indeed, a new tradition was born. To meet on this ship once a year. The participants change, of course, but you are still here - and this is good news.

What do you want to know? The news?

I'll tell you briefly what I know and what I'm allowed to say: your actions on Suslanger were successful. And while we haven't recovered the Chronophone yet, all other threats to our project have been eliminated. "Gates-3" is ready for launch, and we have started to form the Expedition which will travel to these other worlds Klavdia was talking about.

The Orcs seem to have calmed down. Skulnar became the leader of the Horde, albeit mostly nominally. My Xadaganian colleagues won't talk about it, but personally I'm glad it happened - perhaps we have a chance to get out of this conflict without loss.

We have time for a breather now - so take advantage of it.

Ah, is that what it is? Universal reanimation? Immortal life? It's what the people of Sarnaut have always dreamed of! Mad Tep saw only a glimpse of existence. His followers, led by the traitor Nefer Ur, proclaimed him the incarnation of Nih. But the true Nih has always been among us...

And now his daughter is fulfilling her destiny! Death and Life are two sides of the same coin, and the path of Poison is its edge! Let us proclaim the coming of a new age and drink the blessed poison to achieve unity!
They say the difference between poison and medicine is in the dose! It may kill some, heal others, drive a few crazy, and reveal the truth to one.

In these difficult times, I have the opportunity to reach out to all the residents of Sarnaut!

Brothers and sisters! It's time to cast aside old feuds! None of us will survive unless we unite our forces into an iron fist under sole command and cease disputes!

In these difficult times, I have the opportunity to reach out to all the residents of Sarnaut!

Brothers and sisters! It's time to cast aside old feuds! We are facing a real danger - after all, it's not just my Xadaganian Empire that is threatened by the mad necromancer. Tep will stop at nothing to destroy us all - the Kanians, the Orcs, the Gibberlings, the Pridens, the Elves, and the Arisen, the Aoidoi... None of us will survive unless we unite our forces into an iron fist under sole command and cease disputes!

We have already united our Churches, let us unite our states into a single Empire! I will accept this great responsibility and lead you all to victory!

The City Council has always been naive. They were looking for a conspiracy in the ranks of Zem... But what if the Zem people themselves are the conspiracy? What if loyalists and traitors are only part of the overall plan? Such a thoughtful game, such a grand plan that everyone who participates in it, willingly or unwillingly, are working to bring about his victory? There are no absolutists, no mystics, and no progressors - only those who have patience and those who do not. Tep and Ur, we're tired of waiting!
If the body is weak and the spirit is strong, can the body be changed to match the spirit? Many of us have gone much further than others have dared.
Who says I have to run around like a clockwork toy? You must think things through before doing anything, so why waste energy?

So I've found my destiny. Who says I have to run around like a clockwork toy? You must think things through before doing anything, so why waste energy? I'm glad I've overcome... what's that elven word? Procrastination, right! So I can continue to improve my village Oblomovka. There is so much to do there, since all peasants started resurrecting... I have already bought rare seeds, and cattle, and all sorts of mechanical tools straight from Xadagan... Soon we'll be the most advanced village in Sarnaut.

Greetings on behalf of all Tycoons.

My colleagues are very busy, alas, but they asked me to give you their regards. And of course, allow me to thank you again for saving Dane.

I must admit, I'm not here simply to enjoy myself. When these cultists of Order occupied my Winter Palace, they stole an extremely rare collection of elven trinkets. I'm currently trying to find out where they might have ended up. It appears that Hoof managed to sell them already. Does the name Gray Prince mean anything to you? No? Pity.

, how could I miss this celebration? I'm sorry I wasn't able to attend the Great Ball!

Though I admit it allowed me to avoid certain uncomfortable questions. The thing is, many of the treasures in my Winter Palace came from Irene!

I still don't have the most precious one! They say Hoof sold everything in the Black Market - someone known as Gray Prince bought it. A mysterious person that left a notable mark in the history of the world! I'm not sure if it's a title or something else, but he's extremely dangerous and cunning!

But let's not talk about it now... So, are you having fun? It's a celebration in your honor, after all!

!

I'm glad to see you at this celebration. You probably understand that, in addition to the celebration of the beginning of your journey, we have also gathered here for a very important purpose – to discuss the details of the future undertaking. And Catherina plays a big part in it.

Ambrosia. This resource that has appeared out of nowhere and turned out to be very valuable. With its help, we will be able to change the appearance of Sarnaut. It gave a new impulse to mana power engineering and made it possible to create things that we'd only dreamed of.

That is why we must find its source - the place where it's abundant. The Expedition we are mounting includes representatives from both the League and the Empire. The Free Traders will also be there - we provide the funding in exchange for a portion of the profits.

The expedition will be a risky undertaking, but we are ready for anything.

Ahem! To be honest, our enterprise in Eden turned out to be much more difficult than I imagined. And all this talk about ethics... Well, let's just say it's not very ethical! But who raises these questions? The Orcs who stirred up a rebellion? The Gibberlings who have already lost their homeland? The Pridens who force their children to survive? Don't talk to me about ethics.

We Free Traders must think about profit! Not worry about offending someone's sensibilities. We need the Ambrosia, it's the only thing that can open the way to rapid progress!

Ollum is hovering in the air.

The demon is trying to send a series of images to you.

You see a field of roses, and there's a Tower beyond it. Is that Sogot?

The visions change too quickly, you cannot make out anything. The images form a strange picture of a Dragon in your mind. But it is not a Dragon at all. A creature of nightmares that seems to be made of darkness pierced by crests of flame. Its power, its magic, its rage.

Ollum cuts off the stream of images. Is he dreaming it? Do astral demons have nightmares?

Ollum sends you another stream of images. Joy, peace, happiness. Then you see yourself from the outside. The demon seems happy here and now.

Ollum is hovering in the air.

The demon is trying to send a series of images to you.

You see endless sands and mountains shaped by time.

The visions change too quickly, you cannot make out anything. You see the outline of the Gates that lead somewhere beyond Sarnaut. You sense the demon's desire. He wants to go there... a Star Trail leading to another world? For a moment, you realize that Ollum is showing you the memories of your Creator, Sarn. The only moment of clarity - the place where it all began - is all you can grasp.

Ollum cuts off the stream of images. It seems to be all he wanted you to see.

And now the demon wants to wish you a happy Anniversary.

Ollum is hovering in the air.

The demon is trying to send a series of images to you.

Again you see the familiar sands of Suslanger, the mountains, and the Gates behind them.

You feel the impatience of the demons who can't wait to travel to outer space. But the demons need to wait – they are discouraged from urgent and hasty actions. You sense a conflict between the packs. Some of them are more impatient than others. The rage of these packs is growing.

Ollum cuts off the stream of images. It seems to be all he wanted you to see.

Hello, Cap.

How are you? Have you seen Skulnar? He's a big shot now.

And I help out here and there when I can. Big things are happening now, and I can't believe it has come to this.

Wow, if only you knew what has been brewing here. The forces that have gathered, the plans that are being outlined...

It is a pity they want to keep you out of the loop. They say you've caused enough trouble already.

Hello, boss! Are you on vacation?

They gave me a leave, too. They say they can handle it themselves. Well, I built a bomb for them. Them failing to detonate it is their problem, not mine. Maybe I'll return to Sogot where the Demonologists also need help. Or maybe somewhere else. Skulnar said he needed a capable mechanic at his Landfill on Suslanger!

name.en: Did you make the bomb that almost killed everyone?

text.en:
Careful with the accusations. They gave me a task - I made a bomb. And what they do with it is not my concern. You can blow up rocks with it, you can fell trees, or you can put it in a museum to show it off.

They did not immediately figure out what to do. Everyone thinks that this great power heals everyone, that it doesn't do harm. How do you kill with it? But you know the thing about its power? It just needs to be channeled in the right direction. So I advised them against blowing up the Ambrosia. Instead, they should use a bomb infused with it, which would make the explosion more powerful... But there's a problem - it has to be charged first. That's why those pieces of timber were able to take it apart...

name.en: Why didn't your bomb go off in the end?

text.en:
I did what I could. They should have guarded it better, it's not some simple explosive.

They did not immediately figure out what to do. Everyone thinks that this great power heals everyone, that it doesn't do harm. How do you kill with it? But you know the thing about its power? It just needs to be channeled in the right direction. So I advised them against blowing up the Ambrosia. Instead, they should use a bomb infused with it, which would make the explosion more powerful... But there's a problem - it has to be charged first. That's why those pieces of timber were able to take it apart...

This All-Mother is also stupid. If she had the power, it could be used against darkness. And it doesn’t matter whether you grow flowers or thorns - everything can be utilized if you are smart enough.

Hi, chief! I'm here with Skulnar, we're helping the orcs transport weapons to Izune, but shhh, don't tell anyone. It's a secret! It was great to see Eurial and Murk... So our team is back together again!

Anyway, I sense a big mess coming, because you've managed to revive all sorts of people who like to cause chaos! There will be no peace until they all kill each other... As for that dead guy, Tep, I have a tip from an Arisen from my old job that he's going to die soon! Do you know what they're building there, those dead ones? Ooh, they could build a hundred ships with all that metal. I bet they'll finish off the bastard themselves!

Do you know that when this world was shattered, all the ancient primordial forces began to gradually fade away? The broken world could not give us any more energy, and there were much fewer believers... Gradually, one by one, we fell asleep...

Those whom you call deities have many names. Some of them are known as the First, for they were indeed the first to come at the dawn of existence. Some came later, partly created by faith and the power that remained after the creation was completed.

But now everything is different - the Gates to other worlds have opened a door, letting in a stream of power that awakens those who went into hibernation. The Darkness that resurrects the dead also contributes to this. The gods will return soon...

Snakes have always lived on the border of water and earth, belonging to two elements. But beware of Frost who is eager to turn the waters into solid ice. He is the enemy of all living things and the enemy of snakes.

Ah, if only I had some brains…

Buddy! Don't be afraid! I'm not going to take your brains!

But perhaps you can hear it? Dark voices are calling... These are all the maidens of darkness, crows, spiders and snakes... Those who lived far from human settlements... They are now trying to get into this world...

They have lived in the space between worlds since ancient times, moving through cracks...
Now they are approaching Sarnaut... Slowly but surely... They will be here soon...

I would not be just a nothin' my head all full of stuffin'

My heart all full of pain.

I would dance and be merry, life would be a ding-a-derry,

If I only had a brain!

Braaaains!
People won't change, and no one can make them, it's not worth the effort!

Yes, friends... I continue to atone for my sins... And by the gracious permission of Porfiry, I can leave Jigran and visit such places where I listen to wise people and, as someone who encountered Aisa, offer some advice...

Zvik, zvik! Do you always sail on these big boxes made of wood and iron? Hilarious!

And I bring good news: more and more First Ones are waking up from sleep! Even the spirits of Howlem, but they are still too weak to make the journey... The Great Ash is recovering; the Trees on the Kanian Archipelago, Frozen Frontier, Igsh, and Yakhch have sprouted new shoots!

Shadow woods are still there... But they stopped spreading! Zvik, zvik!

Of course, I knew everyone would compare the Galleon Castle and the Eclipse, ...

But how can you compare the incomparable? A workhorse and a doe?

You know, I'm starting to wonder if our architects overlooked something. Even Gorluxor equipped his version of the Castle with death rays. Weapons are a necessity in our world. The Eclipse has them, but it's getting more and more difficult to live aboard it... If we create something for the next Great Ball, it should be something truly destructive that can't be defended against.

But for now, let's just celebrate the Anniversary. There's still time!

Huh, I had a feeling in this damned Citadel that something was going wrong! I just sensed a trap, but Klavdia was so sure... Many people think she somehow deceived you, but speaking as a true traitor - she was simply deluded. Should the gods be any different from humans in this regard?

As for Hirkalla, we'll see. She wants us to serve her, just like we served Dakkar, but I want to understand what she really wants. And in order to find out, I need to get closer to her...

Greetings! What, you're here again? Looking for a new outfit or gossip?

Okay, I know you want to hear what's going on... Before this news spread around the world, I'll tell you: the power of our sovereign has noticeably weakened... No, the machine is still working, the Awakened are still being resurrected, but we no longer have control over the undead army.

There are still a few camps in the north, but in the south, near the Sadrok Palace, some scoundrel with a group of bandits managed to snatch them away! All sorts of dangerous creatures serve him... I also heard he has business in Dar Ulgorn and that he's looking for someone!
"Undress Reniesta." What kind of stupid advice is that?!  If the Gibberlings are right and I was destined to betray my friends, then the fight must be fair.

Greetings!

The Eclipse is a unique ship, indeed. You know what I think?

The League chose our path in the end. The path of the Empire! Hasn't Catherina taken the path of technical progress? Hasn't she asserted her undivided authority? That's exactly what we, Imperial citizens, do!

As for the ships, be assured that we're building something even better right now. And we're planning a unique mission for a ship with a beautiful name Infinity. She will travel to the deepest layers of the Astral.

You're back on the Eclipse. , right?

The last time I told you that the Empire had bigger projects than this ship. The Infinity... Alas, Cosmos's recklessness had tragic consequences! Do you think we can trust him? After the events on Umoir, I highly doubt that. Don't worry, even the Great Mage of the Aoidoi stumbles.

As for the Orcs, we'll handle them, too. There are plenty of our forces on Izune - they'll keep the Shamans in check. We won't let them ruin the Empire.

But don't think about it now. Just enjoy yourself while there's still time.

Oh, it's you again!

I've received a report on your actions on Jigran... If they hadn't been sanctioned by Yasker, we would've had a serious talk!

However, I believe this Hirkalla would have resurrected Nezeb anyway, with or without your help. This has caused a lot of problems for the Empire. We have yet to sort out the Orc rebellion, and now we've lost contact with Nefer Ur. What is he planning there, in Xadagan? No one has a clue, even though we've sent plenty of agents to the Zem allod.

Very interesting...

Children of Chaos attach a lot of importance to certain dates of the cycle. I noticed you need special rituals to remember your past.

Even now, when your sun is hidden from you, so you cannot measure time the way you could before.

What drives you? It's unclear.

Child of Chaos...
