The time when you will have to make a choice is near.

I detect a temporal effect spreading throughout the world. Someone is trying to change the course of events. To warp the river of time into meanders. No, Cosmos has no part in it.

Soon you will understand everything. For now, celebrate.

Oh, buddy! I'm glad to see you here! Yes, I've heard what happened in Eden, Ivan and Froddy told us everything. Oh, well. It doesn't negate everything you'd done earlier, right?

The Tycoon Club is ready to support you! You are too valuable to be discarded!

And we have a lot of things to do - the activity of pirates is growing, the dead are returning from the underworld, the Wormfaces and demons are still restless... But most importantly, something is happening to all the Great Trees of this world! This is terrible, because New Isa depends on the sapling of the Tree that is planted on Nordheim...

The Free Traders specialize in different fields. Mine is meteorite mining, Ivan's are trading ports, Ivlis trades in weapons, Hugh is in entertainment, Profka is in astral transportation, Victoria is in prohibited goods, Goblin Banker - in banking services.

Ah, silly Sparklet is surprised to see me here?

I was invited here. I was so bored there on the Secret Paths. Nobody solves my riddles.

And it's just running back and forth, back and forth, trying to fix something. It is not enough to cross the Bridge of Time, because there is also a Spinning Wheel, and a Wheel. And everything turns round.

If you break the Thread, sooner or later you will have to pay. Isn't that right, my little friend?

I am both the key and the lock, and what has not come true cannot come true. A piece of glass is spinning on a white hill, but the gaze of a blind man sees only a shadow. The one who has lost his home would like to build a new one, but without a home he is a wanderer. If you enter a river, you cannot enter the same river again.

If the pattern of the Spinning Wheel is outlined, it is too late to flip a coin. And the Wheel is deceptive, it goes up and down.

All Sparklets run to the Source, but not all are destined to reach it. Run, Sparklet, run along the path between the Stars. Can you make it in time?

Nezeb seeks a victory by trying to unite the peoples of Sarnaut. I admit, this makes sense, even though the ambitious trickster dreams of even greater power... However, I want to propose a grander plan.

Nezeb seeks a victory by trying to unite the peoples of Sarnaut. I admit, this makes sense, even though the ambitious trickster dreams of even greater power... However, I want to propose a grander plan. Since ancient times, I have studied the outer worlds, and I have achieved a lot on these paths. Even though I haven't been to the Star Path, I know someone there can oppose Tep. And the Light is only one of the forces. Even in Death, Tep is not the absolute master!

We should form our own alliances with these forces, since many residents of Sarnaut have already set off on journeys to other worlds.

I was thinking about the world of Enod, Sarn's original world where the first elves were tempered in the fight against such threats. I think we should take a trip to Enod and enlist their help.

Welcome to the celebration!

Well, I hope everyone can see I'm a generous ruler?

Letting you all board my Eclipse! I still can't believe I agreed to this... It will take months to clean it afterwards. I'll make undiligent students swab the decks as punishment.

But oh well. Have fun! Celebrate! We arranged all this for you. I'm serious.

Welcome to the celebration, !

Everyone loved it the last time, so we decided to do it again. Well, I hope everyone can see I'm a generous ruler?

Letting you all board my Eclipse! I still can't believe I agreed to this... It will take months to clean it afterwards. I'll make undiligent students swab the decks as punishment.

But oh well. Have fun! Celebrate! We arranged all this for you. I'm serious.

Welcome to the celebration, !

I'm sure you have a lot of questions about our project "Gates-3". Well, let me answer them: firstly, we are almost ready to activate it. We still need to take care of some things, and one of them is this cursed Chronophone. It's time to finish this story, but from what I gathered listening to Eladia's confused explanations, she wants Nihaz to take the first step. Personally, I believe someone is just playing for time.

Secondly, I will not invite you to join our Expedition. Why? There are way too many predictions relating to you personally. And I don't want some mysterious nonsense to interfere with my plans. I'm not taking demons with me for the same reason. No arks will sail outside Sarnaut. The best way to combat a prophecy is not to follow it.

You again, on my ship!

Well, I'm not going to throw you out, and I'm not in charge, anyway. Hirkalla is in command right now, and I have to obey her for the time being.

But I'm not going to sit still! I’m sure we can find a way to oppose her. If she thinks she can just come into our world and impose her rules, she's wrong!

Of course, I'm not going to fight her directly - that would be stupid. But rest assured, I'll find a way to put her in her place!

Well, I was wrong about Hirkalla... She is rather wise and unprejudiced unlike those retrogrades, Aidenus and Yasker...

Of course, she loves power... And I understand that. If she wants to be called the Darkest Mistress - so be it. Mistress of Umoir and Queen of Sarnaut will find common ground.

She has ambitious plans... Resurrecting everyone who has ever died? Why not? Restoring Sarnaut? I'm all for it. Hirkalla gave my Expedition access to other worlds. My students are traveling them right now, acquiring new knowledge and technology... The world... will soon change irrevocably.

At least this time I'm free from the gaze of the almighty goddesses! Well, hello!

I'm glad to see you aboard the Eclipse again. Relax, have fun, because now is that short time in the year when the last disaster has faded, and the next one is still looming somewhere on the horizon...

We have gathered here for the fifth time, and there have been fifteen anniversaries in your honor in total, if I remember correctly.

Not long before the current festivities, the Conclave of Great Mages was held here. They discussed the current affairs - Hirkalla, Tep, and everything else. The goddess sisters went to gather their strength after that, while we decided to think about something else.

The future created by Nihaz... how realistic is it? Is there some threat that could lead to the destruction of the world in the future? Nihaz did not invent this possible future - the probability of its creation was artificially increased... We know for sure that in this future Tep was defeated, so... Perhaps it's where we could find the means to fight him. Perhaps Cosmos could help us get there again and find what we need. Think about it!

Hmm. Interesting! People have been eyeing me strangely, especially those two goblins! Let me guess - they aren't fond of trolls here, are they? Hmm...

The Trolls used to be more intelligent...

Hello, hello!

The Threads of Fate have led you to me again.

I guess you would like to learn about your future. About Horizon and everything else I showed you.

Know that the future can be changed. It is like roads –– they fork and merge. Have you seen the Frozen Frontier? The way it looked before the end? Then, perhaps, you've seen Horizon as well. These are all versions of the future. If I make a step to the side, the road will change.

But is there a path where Sarnaut is saved? I touched all the Threads one by one, but alas, the path I showed you is the most likely one. And yet there's still hope. I believe everything is in your hands.

Greetings, !

The Threads of Fate have led you to me again.

I guess you would like to learn about your future. About Horizon and everything else I showed you.

Know that the future can be changed. It is like roads –– they fork and merge. Have you seen the Frozen Frontier? The way it looked before the end? Then, perhaps, you've seen Horizon as well. These are all versions of the future. If I make a step to the side, the road will change.

But is there a path where Sarnaut is saved? I touched all the Threads one by one, but alas, the path I showed you is the most likely one. And yet there's still hope. I believe everything is in your hands.

Greetings, !

I wonder what the Threads are saying? It's an interesting matter, because the predictions are starting to get confusing...

I thought our future was set in stone, and the Darkness would swallow Sarnaut, but since then, the visions have been showing me something different. And it looks like someone is trying to change the pattern, tangling the Threads. It's unprecedented, but I can't say it's completely unbelievable.

In our family, only some of the legends about the past are preserved, because we only had a few weaver's looms on our island. The True Holders of the Thread could read the Fabric of the World more accurately, but they all remained on Isa, our ancestral home, and it no longer exists.

Oh child, who knew it would turn out like this! The Darkness outwitted everyone, and we... couldn't do anything! They say Nihaz created a false future in order to deceive us all... It was very, very cunning, but no one has been able to escape fate yet. When he diverted the course of the river of time, the god of darkness might have sealed his fate.

The future will show us the truth. Right now I'm here to tell you that I'm going to New Isa, to the Great Tree. Disturbing news came from Froddy. Something troubling is going on. I need to see everything myself, and then I will tell you what it is.

You and I found Isa, child... Who knew Fortune would favor us so... But something bothers me... The Weaver abilities you gained... Last time that happened, it was a response to the arrival of the Scissors embodied by the Architect... Who is it this time? Skulnar the Northwind? I don't know...

It's nice to get some fresh air. Shh, I'm incognito here.

So many important people. I'm surprised they didn't invite the whole Conclave. But you know, people would rather go to a party than a war. How many of them will join our ranks when the time comes? Exactly.

Daddy will make his move soon. He enjoys toying with us for now, but when push comes to shove, he is ruthless.

But alright, I won't spoil your fun. Enjoy yourself! Set off fireworks, set fire to Catherina's skirt, drink with the crocodile! Have fun.

Oh, we can't do it without you, ! We've been waiting for you!

Alright, enough joking. You see, not everyone danced at the Balls and drank Irene wine this year. Some of us were actually busy!

It worked well with the army of dead. They did your job for you. Your assault on the Citadel could have gone a little better. Rewards are all you care about!

You didn't make it to the last level? I bet "Father" would be so pleased!

But this is not about him. Destroying another avatar? It's about time, but it won't solve all our problems. I have a solution. What kind? Ah, you're so quick with words. I wish you were as efficient with your actions. I'll tell you everything later... When the time comes.

For now, have fun - go fly a glider and win that lion if you haven't already.

So not a single event happens without you, ? Perhaps it's true.

Look at them. They will drown you in words, predictions, promises, maybe even veiled threats...

Do not trust anyone. Now is the moment you can determine your own future.

You need to understand that the choice is yours. And you will have to make it no matter what.

Ah, it's you! The one who disrupted my plans on Umoir! I wanted to organize fights with these mighty beasts! But don't worry, I've found a way - why use Blighted mutants when I have the Ambrosia? Creatures pumped full of Ambrosia - what can be cooler than that! So fights are definitely going to happen.

Of course, I had to sweet-talk the Gray Prince, and now I owe him. But I always pay my debts. Someday my father's killers will pay for everything, just like my traitor brother. Soon Yasker will fall and the Korleone family will regain their power.
Was it easy for a little girl who lost her father to take over as boss of the mafia? What do you think?

How are you, Hero?

Don't you forget - new battles await us. Doesn't have to be between the League and Empire! We have enough enemies. One of them is the Darkness. Darkness of despair. Darkness of impotence. And we are the only ones standing in its way.

I hope you remember that. Or rather, will remember it tomorrow.

Today, just enjoy yourself!

We're on this ship again, !

It's a nice change from Irene... From one holiday to the next... I'm going to go deaf from all the fireworks.

I won't tell you to go have fun. We all remember how that turned out at the Ball. In fact, you should prepare for new feats! Which ones? It's hard to say at this time, but we need to do something about Nihaz, you understand. We defeated him once, but now he's back...

We need to finish this once and for all. How? You'll learn that soon...

! It's good to see you, friend.

Another year has passed, right? It wasn't too difficult, but not completely without challenges. Which you overcame. If everything in the reports I received is true, then it got really hot there on Suslanger. Both literally and figuratively.

You uncovered Nezeb's old secrets, so you must understand why Kania and Xadagan were at each other's throats. We have always been a free state where everyone had a voice in the council.

In the Empire, the word of your superior is law. And it's most noticeable on Suslanger.

Of course, there are times when we work together well. The Great Astral Campaign: yes, from a military point it was pointless, but we learned so much when we fought together.

And now, the pioneers. The idea of sending in more young guys and girls... It's brilliant. I hope they will find common ground. You see, I'm still skeptical about this world. But I'm an old man, a man of the sword, so I still hope the young League members will be able to insert a bit of free-thinking into the minds of their peers from the Empire.

And the Empire will change over time. It will become freer, closer to us.

It is time:

The maiden Seida's

Words must be remembered.

The moment is near.

Behold the sinister city

Full of shadows and spiders!

You will walk the path

Of visions and dreams.

Be wary of strangers

You may encounter.

Broken threads

Cannot be tied together reliably.

Oh, hello! There you are, the hero of this celebration! We've heard about you so much over the year...

Well, the Winter Watch is over... Now we want to travel...

We are composing another story! About the grandma - Mauni the Dancer! Have you heard that story? Well, perhaps you'll hear it soon...

Oh, hello, hello! We knew we'd meet you here! All we've done this whole year is travel! We've been to Lightwood, Izune, Forox, and even Lugna! It's a shame you weren't with us, but never mind that! We're thinking about putting together a new expedition... Here's our company: Murk, Waterlily, and our new acquaintances - Skulnar, Eurial, Nogrom. Together we are a force to reckon with! But maybe we should take someone else with us! You, for example?

Those hunters invited us to join them! They say they have the best training on Kirah: there are wild demons everywhere, and you need to fight to survive! It's almost like the Winter Watch! We could fly there and compare experiences...

False light showed itself! It could do nothing against the darkness that took hold of our world! Because the truth is in the old gods, the gods that our people used to worship! Even demons are more powerful than false light! Don't you see it? Throw away the foolish belief in a dead mage and accept the true gods!
Accept the true gods! The gods that were with the tribes of Aro in the days of their youth! Gods that lived in forests and swamps!

Hey, wait! What was it... ! Or I'll shoot you. Wait! Don't be afraid! I'm kidding, heh.

I don’t really get why they called me. After all, it's my dad who's a decorated general, so they drag him to all sorts of feasts.

Anyway, I figured I have you to thank for that. Well... I mean, thanks. I can at least get a decent meal out of it. Something that's not cacti or hyenas for a change.

And I wanted to say something. Oh, right! In short, we've dealt with Shrinka - he's gonna have a hard time finding allies from now on.

We'll kick anyone's ass for Skulnar. But he told us to keep a lid on it for now. We have to wait! So it's quiet on Suslanger, and I had nothing to do with the ruckus on Izune - those are not my guys.

Well, call me if you need any help?

Hey, how's it going?  Are they still fighting on Eden? We’ve been sitting too long in the Landfill, chasing worms and beating up the Unyielding. Any minute now, the guys are gonna stir up trouble again. They don't listen to me or Kurgan on the other allods, and on Izune partisans already make regular attacks on the Xadaganians.

It's good that Skulnar has returned at least, maybe things will be quiet for now.

Sometimes it's good to take a break from work...

So who do we have to thank for this celebration? You, ! You are the Hero of Sarnaut. You started this chain of events 10 years ago.

Let us remember how much we've lost over the years. Those who gave their lives to bring this day closer. Does anyone remember the allods Arav, Ark, Jalin, Imbul, or Karakir?

If we don't preserve what we have left – our descendants will not forgive us!

I'm glad to see you here, ! Let no one say the Empire cares about nothing but wars. If there's a potential for peace, we do our best to realize it.

We have enough problems without having to fight the League. Together, we can accomplish so much more. That is why we initiated a cultural exchange program - this is our chance to show everyone a more progressive life. When they see the beauty of Xadaganian cities, they will understand that our path is the right one. That's the Great Nezeb's will.

Allow me to congratulate you on behalf of the Conclave of the Empire, even though my colleagues, Great Mages, are absent from this event.

So, on behalf of the Great Mage Simon from Suslanger, Great Mage Felix from Yakhch, Great Mage Leonid from New Igsh, Great Mage Abram from Vechnoslavsk, Great Mage Rustam from Istinsk, Great Mage Mansur from Manodar, Great Mage Negus Nevzr from Izune, and from all other Great Mages of small allods of the Empire - happy anniversary, !

I often wonder how the world has changed since your journey began, . Yes, a lot of things have already been discovered, and mana power engineering has been rapidly developing. Perhaps, thanks to you, we gained a variety of new goods.

The City Council is still counting the trophies we got after defeating Gorluxor; the technologies created by Tep for the world of illusions are still being studied at ZIT Headquarters.

And now we are ready to go to another world. Again, with the help of technologies we obtained thanks to you. The world is changing, and these changes are inevitable. Even the drowsy League is forced to move forward now. Its representatives such as Catherina are often more imperial in spirit than many of the conservative bureaucrats from Yasker’s Tower.

What will you find outside Sarnaut? I'm confident that, whatever it is, it will change our world once again.

Ah, it's you...

Are you expecting words of encouragement or something? There'll be none. We are all prisoners of Hirkalla who now rules Sarnaut from her throne in Jigran. She is called the Darkest Mistress, so go ask her for parting wishes...

Greetings, hero!

Well, I'm not disappointed this time... Yes, some things could have been avoided, and you should have been more careful and not trusted strangers with important state secrets... But what got we wanted: Hirkalla was weakened. As for Tep... He was beaten the first time, so he'll be beaten a second time. That's what I think.

This time by the forces of the Great Mages. They didn't gather here for nothing - the hunt for Tep is underway, and we're ready to strike. After all, over the past years we've learned a lot, discovered things that you have no idea about, so we might surprise the old necromancer yet!

Greetings! I'm glad to see you and the other heroes! You've helped many people, me included, and we're not going to forget this. I believe we'll meet again some day - in the restored house of the Junes.

Greetings! I'm glad to see you and the other heroes! It's been fifteen years since your first exploits. You've helped many people, me included, and we're not going to forget this. I believe we'll meet again some day - in the restored house of the Junes.

Yes, we'll reclaim our homeland and revive our people, and neither Sarn nor Nihaz will stop us.

Perhaps we'll make our own contribution to the future of Sarnaut. Remember - you will always be welcome in our new homeland.

You again, !

What did you do to our ship? Yes, yes, after going to Nihaz's Citadel! Demons wrecked the place, it took us months to fix everything. How can you trust heroes after that...

How did the assault on Nihaz's Citadel go? Did you succeed? I knew it.

Well, since we're celebrating your anniversary, I won't be too nitpicky. You can live for now.

Oh Tensess, you're here again. And you brought some strange guests with you. Who are they?

Who is that winged damsel? Is that a six-legged cat? A giant pigeon? And the crocodile... Am I hallucinating...?

Anyway, these are some weird creatures, while the orcs and goblins... Goblins should be scrubbing down the hold! Instead of strutting around in tailcoats... They will make a mess - it's all they ever do.

Last time we had elves, a cultured bunch...

May the Light bless you!

I'm happy to see you here. Let me wish you a happy anniversary on behalf of all the Elves!

But what can I tell you? You already know everything. Yes, it's your celebration, .

I'm already writing about your deeds in my Chronicles. Yes, there are many pages written about you.

But remember: history is often a comedy, and even more often, a tragedy. Your story is not finished yet, and how it ends depends on you.
Greetings on behalf of all Tycoons.

Ollum is hovering in the air.

The demon is trying to send a series of images to you.

The visions change too quickly, you cannot make out anything.
Welcome to the Eclipse, dear guests! Come here, I'll give you directions!
Welcome to the Eclipse, dear guests! Come here, I'll give you directions!

name.en: Ask about the list of events

text.en:
Many interesting events take place on the Eclipse!

You can go on a tour of the Holy Land. Another ship will take you there!

Guests can also participate in fist fights and a battle of sailplanes!

You can also converse with other guests, set off fireworks, or join a lottery where you can win an Anniversary Lion!
Two Great Mages are on the ship right now – Yasker and Aidenus! They entrusted their allods to their students so they could attend this celebration!
Demon Hunters are also here! They would like you to fight them in the ring.
Have a good journey!

name.en: Ask about tours of the Holy Land

text.en: Be on the boarding device at the scheduled time – a ship will take you to the Holy Land and back.
The boarding device is on the main deck.
Have a good journey!
The boarding device is on the main deck.
Have a good journey!
You can find the head of the Empire in his camp.
Have a good journey!
There are sailplanes on the lower deck – everyone can test-drive them.

name.en: How do I get to the lower deck?

text.en: The entrance is right behind me.
Have a good journey!
The entrance is right behind me.
You can find the head of the League in his camp.
Have a good journey!
If you need to get rid of anniversary coins quickly, visit the Coin Master!
Have a good journey!

Hello, hello!

The Threads of Fate have led you to me again.

Welcome to the celebration!

Well, I hope everyone can see I'm a generous ruler?

Letting you all board my Eclipse! I still can't believe I agreed to this... It will take months to clean it afterwards. I'll make undiligent students swab the decks as punishment.

But oh well. Have fun! Celebrate! We arranged all this for you. I'm serious.
If you're wondering what to do, speak with Anton Turischev. He'll tell you about activities on the deck.

It's nice to get some fresh air. Shh, I'm incognito here.

So many important people. I'm surprised they didn't invite the whole Conclave.

But you go on, enjoy yourself! Set off fireworks, set fire to Catherina's skirt, drink with the crocodile! Have fun.

Sometimes it's good to take a break from work...

So who do we have to thank for this celebration? You, ! You are the Hero of Sarnaut. You started this chain of events.

Constant rumpus, weird odors, lazy and arrogant citizens. That's what the capital is like!

I can see you're not one of them. Pleased to meet you. We are Demon Hunters, and we came here to take a break from our routine slaughter in the Astral. Everybody needs rest!

Huh, look who's here! That's one famous warrior here in our ring!

Come here, I'll show you a couple of moves!

We're fighting till five bruises. Bet a copper on your victory – you might just get lucky!

Don't you think you're a little too skinny, fella? Couldn't they send someone a bit tougher? I'm gonna knock you cold in no time, huh!

Come on, show me what you got.

To defeat me, you need to land at least ten blows. Here, bet a silver coin on your victory. You might get lucky!

Aho.

It's not easy to defeat me – land at least fifteen hits.

Bet a gold coin on your victory. You might get lucky.
Now you will get some!
Huh! I warned you.
Hah! You have no coins, then? Bring me a silver coin, then we'll talk.
Hm...
Hm... It looks like you don't have any gold.
No way, find a copper first.

You have my respect! I thought you're just another weakling, but I can see I was wrong!

Wait, don't go back to the ring right now. Take a break - you need it!
Rejoice in victory, akyly. Take some rest now.

You're good! The spectators love you.

I could keep on fighting you, but you're already barely standing on your feet. Go get some rest.

name.en: What will I get for fighting in the ring?

text.en:
Fame and respect, of course! And a dozen of bruises, too.

For winning over Glum, you will be rewarded with a Copper Anniversary Coin; for winning over Lanky, with a Silver one; for winning over Fang, with a Gold one!
Can't you see, there's already someone in the ring!
...The Priden silently shakes his head and nods at the fighters in the ring.
Wait a bit, the ring is occupied.

These ones? Oh, they are here for a reason!

You see, we want to show the people that demons are not as scary as they imagine. Of course, they can cause a lot of trouble if you unleash them... But believe me, killing them is pretty easy.

See those coins in each cage? If you're brave enough, you can try and get them! Watch out for your fingers, though, haha! They say, no matter how hard you practice, it always takes at least ten attempts before you can get a coin.

Good luck!

Look at you! You're all blue with bruises.

Come again later, I'll show you some more moves, huh!
Huh! Come again later, when you are well-rested.

Huh, no way! I won't fight you now.

You're way too exhausted. Go get some rest!

I looked around at those next to me. Apprentices, future "mechanics", and a number of mechanical knights who are imperfect and clumsy. The transfer of Sparks has proved to be very promising. However, not every Spark will take root in a new body. I need to find a way to contact those Arisen and find out how they get around the issue of "rejection". But Nezeb jealously guards his "scientists". So far, only my first knight remains an ideal model without any flaw.

Sooner or later...

SCARGE WILL BE THE FORCE OF PROGRESS IN KANIA

...and perhaps in the entire Sarnaut.

What do you think... Darkness is coming, all that jazz! I can’t wait till it swallows you all!

Well, I’m helping this Darkness. Someone has to do it, yeah?

I’m selling stuff here for the infected folk like you!

Nihaz is a smart guy. He knows you won’t lift a finger unless there’s a reward tied to it! Damn collectors...

Ugh... You reek of pure spirit!

Get out of here before I drop dead!
Right, finally one of ours! Where have you been?
Everything for my people!

I’m helping those capable of opposing the Darkness.

Good intentions and good deeds should be amply rewarded, correct?

I’m helping those capable of opposing the Darkness...

Unfortunately, you are not one of them.

Ugh... Aren’t you confusing me with someone?

Don’t you have a better use for Mirra? This is not a Purgatory. Or do you want me to send you there?

Cut it out and go. Considering what we’re up against, you’ll get there soon enough.
Dark times are upon us, my friend. What do you do to oppose the Curse?
It’s a shame. Such a pure soul - and the Darkness has its teeth in you...
I hope it helps you!

Greetings!

Here you can buy hot tea, cold ale, strong grog, fresh oranges, rich soups, and delicious steaks.

Do you want to have a drink or a snack?
Anything you like.
Anything you like.

name.en: Ask for a carrot for the nose

text.en: Here, take it!
Anything you like.
A bad day of fishing is better than a good day of work!
Have a good haul!
Are you raising a bird mount? You already have excellent fishing gear. Sit down, fishing is good here today!
My name is Chereh. I'm kinda in charge here. Watching out for hapless swimmers and jacklighters. But if you want to fish - just ask me for the gear!

name.en: Ask the fisherman about the Ice Fish.

text.en:
There's an unusual fish in our Crystal Lake. It's the Ice Fish. It lives on the bottom where the water is so cold that you'd turn into an icicle if you dived deep enough. You can catch it only during New Year's celebrations. People set off fireworks and have fun - and the fish gets closer to the surface to watch the bright lights.

I'd be amazed if you catch it. I'll even give you a special bait, but it only lives about a day, and it's hard to find. Remember: if you lure the fish, it will increase your chances of catching it.

name.en: Ask for a bait for the Ice Fish.

text.en: Here it is. It's icy cold, so don't freeze your hands off.
I'm sorry, that's all I have. Come back tomorrow!
Straight from the lake!
Straight from the lake!
Sorry, the birds are resting and can only give you a ride. Come back when it's time to hunt.

name.en: Ask for a Roc for the Winter Hunt

text.en: The bird is yours for free! Look after her and take care.
Keep it up! You're no coward, huh? Remember, if you fail this time, you can come back and try again in an hour! Just don't run anyone over...

You want to try and ride all the way from the top to the foot of this mountain? Well, I'm afraid it's not going to happen right now - the track is not ready yet. We'll tramp down the snow and reattach the ribbons - you know, the usual. Stop by later!

Hey! You want to have the best fun this icy rock has to offer? That can be arranged!

It's called Slalom, and it's the craziest race in the world! It seems simple - you just need to ride the board from the top to the foot. The one who finishes first, wins. However, the track is tricky - you'll have to avoid stones, trees, and other racers, and the speed is crazy! I'm telling you, not everyone is going to make it to the finish line.

Do you still want to participate?

Greetings! Welcome to the foothills of the highest mountain in the region! Only the bravest and reckless will dare to climb it in this weather. The wind is blowing hard, the Elementals are throwing icy boulders at you - lovely, isn't it?

Your mount will help you here – one of the creatures that are adapted to the local conditions: a Snowbug or a Snow Fury. Or even a Snow Owl, one of those that nest on highest slopes - if you can tame it, of course.

The first one to the top wins. The second gets a smaller reward, and the third one an even smaller one. Don't stop, or you'll freeze!

name.en: Get to the top of the hill for sledging

text.en: Don't know where you can sledge? No problem! Just one snowflake, and I'll take you to the top of the hill.

Come on, join us in a snowball battle! Build your snow fortress and defend it from the enemies! If you last for several minutes, I'll give you a nice reward!

Just don't go anywhere outside the village. It's against the rules!
Hey there! We're playing snowballs here. You want to join us?

You'd rather attack than stick to defensive tactics, wouldn't you? Huh! Then go throw snowballs at someone sitting in a fortress, and win your reward!

Just don't go anywhere outside the village. It's against the rules!

So, are you going to make a snowman? Then you're going to need some branches for the arms, a carrot for the nose, and a lot of snow!

Come on, let's do it!

You need some branches, a carrot and snow. You will find branches in the forest, a carrot can be easily obtained in the village, and snow is everywhere around us.

You need to make three balls out of snow, then stick the branches where the arms should be and the carrot as a nose - and the snowman is ready!

Oh, I'm looking over my domain...

After all, I'm wherever winter is. Although winter in Sarnaut is a different matter. But there are places where I still have power. This is one of them.

name.en: I've never seen you here before.

text.en:
Yes, I had other things to do. But I decided to drop by... Well, it's fun here. Winter is not just severe cold and frost. There are also thaws, Christmas trees, and holidays! While the nights are dark in winter, the day begins to lengthen.

My strength has been growing for some time now, so I will visit these snowy lands often.

There are not many of us left - the deities of the old era when the world was one. What happened in the last year? It was like a window was opened and something fresh came into our world... That, I do not know.

name.en: The Tekyan worship a crocodile - does that bother you?

text.en:
Oh, those funny children! No, let them worship their crocodile. We are similar in many ways, although I never needed my own people. My followers are those who honor winter, who believe in the power of icy rivers and sparkling snow.

After all, winter is a dream everyone needs. A dream can be both good... and evil. But you know that. I'm sure you've had a chance to meet Cold. He is harsh. If he could, he would freeze the entire world.

And I'm the one who ensures that Winter comes and goes. This is the essence of the cycle of the year. We all come out one after another: Winter, Spring, Summer, and Fall. We do our best even though it's not easy, since the world is divided.

name.en: I know what you did last winter...

text.en: What's that?

name.en: You lived in a cottage on a hill by the forest...

text.en: Everyone has to live somewhere...

name.en: And pickled snowballs in a birch barrel...

text.en: So what? It's not illegal!

name.en: You spun yarn and wove canvases...

text.en: It's just a hobby. What's wrong with it?

name.en: And forged icy bridges over rivers...

text.en: Yes, I have many talents...
What of it? You're such a bore.

name.en: And placed the crescent moon into a crystal pail...

text.en: You should try it, it's fun.

name.en: Sewed fur coats for the trees, opened paths for sleighs...

text.en: I do it for the community! Trees get cold, too...

name.en: And then hurried back to rest in your cottage.

text.en:
Am I not allowed to rest?

I wonder how you know all that? Were you watching me...?
Hello, hello! What a meeting!

Hello stranger! Welcome to our village! Please don't be afraid if you hear explosions. Those are fireworks in your honor!

If you want to launch your own firework, you can buy it from us. What do you say?
Let's make some noise in the sky!
Hey! You want a souvenir? Go on, choose what you like!
We have the best goods here!
Do you like something?
This is lowest possible price!
Greetings, dear friend! Welcome to our village. We live simply and sure know how to have fun! I bet you'll love it here.

Oh hey!

I can teach anyone to ice skate! Do you want to try it? It's easy: just put on the skates, then push with your feet and use your arms to balance! Just watch out for the obstacles, and don’t skate on snow and thin ice, which is darker. See, it's not difficult at all!
Hey there! We're playing snowballs here. You want to join us?

Hey! My name is Brody, also known as Sculptor...

I must say, I'm not a real sculptor yet, but my snowmen are top-notch! There's nothing better than sledging. What? You don't have a sledge? Don't worry, I'll let you borrow mine. Go up there and try it yourself!

The sacred lanterns standing along the roads are not here just to give light, but also to drive away Frost Spirits, terrible spawns of winter which can turn anyone into a lifeless statue. They are only afraid of light, laughter, and high spirits, so this is why we decided to build here a resort for all the people of Sarnaut and devote it to Genlun!
I knew you were into fishing right away!

Hello! Hello! I'm new to this village, it's nice to meet you. I'm the best Roc trainer out there! My Rocs won't just give you rides - they will also be your faithful companions on a real winter hunt! Come to me every hour at the 20th or 40th minute and see for yourself.
Have a nice trip!

This resort offers various ways to have fun - races on snow boards and sledges, snowball battles and figure skating. Those who prefer less extreme entertainment can enjoy fishing on the frozen lake, drink some hot mulled wine, and launch colorful fireworks into the sky!

Come to the Snow Resort and have the best vacation ever!

Do you need coins?
Remember that exchange rates may vary depending on demand and supply.

You wish to purchase crystals? Or perhaps you have too many and wish to exchange them for some gold? I can help you with that!
Exchange rate is calculated based on the amount of Crystals I currently have. Everything is fare and square - as soon as the rate changes, I'll let you know.
The more Crystals people buy, the higher their price is. And vice versa.
First, choose if you are selling or buying. Enter the required amount, and I will tell you the price in gold. If it's fine with you, confirm the deal. I will double-check everything, and we'll seal the deal!
If the exchange rate changes while we are bargaining, I will freeze the deal and tell you the new rate. You will be able to decide if the new rate suits you or not.
Simple, fast and convenient!
How much do you need?
Currency Exchange is unavailable at this time.Smugglers have it hard!

Here comes another walking purse... Agrh!

[The beast's hoarse voice turns into ferocious roaring. The beast roars emotionally, gesturing as though it's trying to tell you something. You should probably address your questions to Captain Solonus.
Argh, argh, argh! Rrragh! Rragh, argh, argh!
Come here, friend! Captain Solonus will procure anything for you!

The main difference between a cross-faction auction and a regular one is that here both the League and the Empire can see the goods and buy them from each other. Other than that, it is the same auction - a place where everyone can try to sell their items or buy something unique that can't be found anywhere else.

It's very easy to use the auction. If you decide to sell something, you will need to talk to me and fill out a special form. First you need to select the item you wish to sell. Then specify the time period, the starting bid, and the buyout price. Not setting a buyout price may improve bids! Once you filled out all the required fields, confirm the request. I will put your item up for sale immediately. Not free of charge, of course. A small auction tax is imposed on all sale proceeds.

I can also help you find something useful at the auction. There's a different request form for that. You can search by quality, level, or name. If you decide to purchase something, you can buy the item immediately if it has a buyout price. Or simply place a bid that is higher than the current bid. But remember: other buyers can outbid you at any time.

All sales proceeds and all items purchased are mailed to you. Unsold items can also be retrieved from the mailman after the action ends.

Come on, join the fun known as the Auction. It's so exciting! Like a battlefield!

Chewacca and I got tired of sitting around in Skewer, especially when they caught Caligula. Slushy Slug controls everything now, the nasty worm.

"I have a bad feeling," I said, and we bailed. Got into a jam on the way and had to run from the imperials, but then we met Ilenia and Denis who offered us this new opportunity.

They smuggle goods through Howlem these days, but there's a way to do it legally.

So we picked this place - it suits us perfectly, and now we can arrange cross-faction trading. If you need to sell anything, talk to me.

Ilenia can exchange crystals for you, and if you need a bank, Denis Zharin will help you.
Up and away!

name.en: What resources do I need to upgrade the Keeper?
What resources do I need to build the Stronghold?
Where can I find Guild Coins?
It’s hard to be poor... It’s easy being rich

text.en: Please... Spare a coin? I could share something interesting with you... For example, a prediction or a World Mystery.
It’s hard to be poor... It’s easy being rich!
The Grey Prince is keeping an eye on us! A coin here, a coin there...
The twelfth regiment reports that enemy forces have been spotted in the area and they must be eliminated.

Enemy’s location: southeast - Wormfaces.

Enemy’s location: southwest - Gibberlings.
What do we know about the Wormfaces? These creatures maintain constant telepathic contact, forming a council of a kind which they call Superintelligence.
I detected high energy emission underground, in the Wormfaces’ territory. I believe they have a functional golem somewhere in the catacombs.

Look at it. Isn't it marvelous? But everything that moves needs fuel or food.

Sparks are a great resource for sustaining all kinds of life, be it a creature or machine. I have a couple of tasks for you. If you handle them, we can make our Keeper stronger.

Greetings!

We are building this fortress for the glory of the Empire and our illustrious leader Yasker. Every day gives us a new challenge, and we face it like the valiant citizen of the Empire we are.

Look at it. Isn't it marvelous? But any creature needs a resource to continue its existence... or a semblance of one.

Sparks are a great material for sustaining life both in living creatures and machines. I have a couple of tasks for you. If you handle them, we can make our Keeper stronger.

Thank the Fates! I'm glad we're here!

Being part of an epochal event like construction of a Stronghold? I'm beside myself! I'm so proud and happy! Well... yes, I need to pull myself together and focus, yes, yes.
Please... You and your guild are famous around here, so please help the old man out. We did nothing to deserve this!
Bloody orcs are out hunting. Ore is mined in the mountains, to the east from here, and these animals want to get their hands on some good iron...
The locals say they saw huge creatures near the fortress. There’s an orcs’ camp in the north, so that must have been mountain trolls.
I saw a trail in the east that leads to the old ruins. I’d swear there was an underground tunnel, and the ruins looked a lot like a June temple.
Hello.

name.en: Give the Matter of Creation (5 pc.)

text.en: I’m afraid we’ve reached the processing limit for today. Come back tomorrow, child of Chaos!
Wonderful! How much would you like to turn in?
Wonderful! How much would you like to turn in?

name.en: Keeper's XP limit is reach. What's next?

text.en: You can use the resources to complete quests, which will reward the Guild with Guild Coins instead of Keeper XP. You can spend the coins on the Stronghold vendor's goods.

name.en: Stronghold XP limit is reached. What's next?

text.en: You can use the resources to complete quests, which will reward the Guild with Guild Coins instead of Stronghold XP. You can spend the coins on Stronghold vendor's goods.
Accepted! The Guild will never forget your help.

name.en: View the assortment of Keeper abilities

text.en: Make your choice!
Your help is important to Sarnaut. Best suppliers send their wares here to aid your cause.

name.en: View the assortment of Keeper abilities

text.en: Look!
You can look your fill, but I’m not selling anything to guild members below the Officer rank!

name.en: Give the Matter of Creation (5 pcs.)

text.en: Wonderful, synthesis will begin immediately.

name.en: Give the Matter of Creation (1 pc.) and pay {money}.

text.en: Wonderful, synthesis will begin immediately.

Very well! How much would you like to turn in?

Remember that each Trophy grants you 1 Stronghold XP within your available XP limit.

name.en: Ask about your results in Heroic Adventure rankings

text.en: This is what I know...

name.en: Is this Nihaz's Citadel? It's time to storm!

text.en: Get ready...

name.en: Where can I find a Demonologist trainer?

text.en: You should find her by the control room where she's messing around with her bunch of demons.

name.en: Where can I find a Scout trainer?

text.en: She's the ordinary girl on my right by the stairs... To tell you the truth, she makes me shudder.

name.en: Where can I find a Bard trainer?

text.en: Look around... She's over there, at the front of the ship, the bloody crazy orc.

name.en: Where can I find a Warden trainer?

text.en: Oh, he did a good job growing a flower garden in my cargo hold! It doesn't smell like sailors' sweat and mana anymore, though I'm afraid some termites might make holes in the hull... You can find him in the cargo hold next to the treasury. Don't forget to pluck a flower!

name.en: Where can I find an Engineer trainer?

text.en: That dead man! Oh, I'm sorry, it's not entirely politically correct... The Arisen removed me from piloting my own ship! The damned bookworm got to the steering wheel, and my ship flew, full steam ahead! Even she turned against me... You can find him in the control room.

name.en: Where can I find a Mage trainer?

text.en: The damned mages must be thinking that this ship is their property! The Supreme Mage pulled off a pandemonium right on the balcony at the stern. You can't miss him if you head to the scanner hall.

name.en: Where can I find a Psionicist trainer?

text.en: Oh, he's my only sane passenger. He's sitting at his desk all the time scribbling something, so calm and quiet, just as I like. You can find him on the second deck by the stern.

name.en: Where can I find a Summoner trainer?

text.en: Oh, another rot-stinking thing in my bilge... Can't you do without corpses? I've seen the injured taken to him, and not a single one ever returned... That's not what I call a healer! He's in the engine room.

name.en: Where can I find a Paladin trainer?

text.en: There was a duel! A duel on my ship! Go to the stern, stop at the open part of the deck, near the mannequins. They've been fighting in the open since dawn. You'll find them by the pools of blood.

name.en: Where can I find a Healer trainer?

text.en: She's preaching to my crew. I often hear them say "What's the reason for living? Why aren't we serving the Light?" instead of "Yes, Captain! On my way, Captain!" She's on the main deck. You'll recognize her by a crowd of my sailors.

name.en: Where can I find a Warrior trainer?

text.en: There was a duel! A duel on my ship! Go to the stern, stop at the open part of the deck, near the mannequins. They've been fighting in the open since dawn. You'll find them by the pools of blood.

Ah, there goes another one! I knew it was a fishy business! Take a side job, they said! Earn some dough, it's just a couple of heroes, take them to the edge of the Astral... Heroes, indeed. Writing on the walls, cursing all the time... Those Imperials now have a council in my engine room, they're handing out leaflets. What are you smiling at? Do you think, Kania is any better? There's a clerical tent on the main deck! They're deaf to duty and dead to shame! Do me a favor, stay in your cabin. I'll be very grateful. My ship's in a bad enough condition, I'm afraid it might not last long.

By the way, the Orcs have been drawing on the walls. Wipe them clean, will you?

name.en: Ask to go to Cargo Hold

text.en: You want to know what we have in the cargo hold, don't you? Here's the first rule... oh, wait, you should have heard this joke. So, you want to stretch your muscles and crush a few skulls?
You can come in now.

name.en: There's an arena on the ship? That's where I'm heading to.

text.en: Don't go yet. Get drunk first. You don't fight on the arena sober.

name.en: All right, fine, I'm getting drunk...

text.en: And don't let me see you sober!

Are you ready for the Season of Blood, kylys? Fine combats, eternal glory, and shiny rewards are waiting!

To gain access to the tournament, visit Allods Online website. Once you’re in, you can start earning Symbols of Blood in combats and exchanging them for valuable prizes!

Gather your friends and join the Circle of Equals with your party! Here nothing matters but your dexterity, wit, and teamwork skills. The prize for the champions is positively enormous!

name.en: How do I earn Symbols of Blood?

text.en:
First, you need to gain access to the Season of Blood. As I already said, you can do that through Allods Online website.

Having purchased access, you can start completing special quests. Those will be rewarded with the Symbols, kylys. You can also buy some on the website, together with the access.
The Snowbug is slow but stubborn. His wings protect the rider from cold and snowballs. It can fly, too.
Let's go!
The Snow Lizard is really fast. Too fast to freeze!
Let's go!
The Snow Owl has adapted to extreme conditions. It flies higher than others.
Let's go!
You haven't tamed a Snow Owl yet! It will not serve you.
Receive an offensive potion.
There's something boiling in the cauldron. Are you brave enough to take a sip?
Receive a protective potion.
Liquid rainbow fills your empty vial as you put it in the cauldron! It quickly transforms into a Potion of Swiftness!

name.en: Get the Potion of Critical Damage

text.en: Liquid rainbow fills your empty vial as you put it in the cauldron! It quickly transforms into a Potion of Critical Damage!
Liquid rainbow fills your empty vial as you put it in the cauldron! It quickly transforms into a Potion of Brutality!

Liquid rainbow fills your empty vial as you put it in the cauldron! It quickly transforms into a Potion of Bloodlust!
Liquid rainbow fills your empty vial as you put it in the cauldron! It quickly transforms into a Potion of Determination!
Liquid rainbow fills your empty vial as you put it in the cauldron! It quickly transforms into a Potion of Luck!

Liquid rainbow fills your empty vial as you put it in the cauldron! It quickly transforms into a Potion of Vitality!

Get a Special Potion.

Every day you will be given special tasks that will help you create items for upgrading equipment.

These tasks will not require you to do anything you haven't already done. Just normal heroic activities - defeat these and save these... But don't worry: there are mundane tasks, too. Like converting Enchanted Shards and Matter using Tools, for example. Practice makes perfect!

Completing these tasks will earn you Enchanted Matter, Amalgam, and Gold.

Once a day, you can turn down a task to get another. If you turn down two tasks, you'll have to wait until the next day.

To stop receiving these daily tasks, talk to me.
Alright! If you want me to start giving these quests again, just tell me!

name.en: Brush up on equipment crafting basics

text.en:
First of all, we are talking about the second rank equipment, also known as Precious Equipment. You can identify it by the number II on each item. Unlike the first rank that can be found anywhere, or the third one that is really hard to get, the second rank requires only patience and persistence, along with a handful of resources.

First of all, you will need boxes with loot. You can find them everywhere: on astral allods, in Skirmishes, in raid adventures. There's plenty! I'll give you one from my personal stash for teaching purposes.

These boxes contain fragments of equipment. They will require some work before you can turn them into something suitable. You'll need tools for that. The better your tools and fragments, the more material you will get, which means you can craft a full set of equipment sooner! There are different tools. You can buy common tools for gold. You can craft yourself better tools or get them from the Boutique or by participating in Skirmishes. Participants of the Guild Dominion can receive the best tools! You should try out different tools and see for yourself.

You will also need a suitable workpiece. It can be crafted by a member of a Profession or purchased from other players.

Once you have the workpiece and materials, all you need to do is craft the equipment! It's simple: the anvil will do everything for you. You just need a bit of gold.

To craft a Hero’s Insignia, you need Enchanted Dust and Amalgam. Enchanted Dust can be obtained by converting Enchanted Matter using tools. It can be obtained by helping in adventures on astral allods and by completing Distortions.

Amalgam can be acquired by converting Drops of Amalgam that are earned in Skirmishes, Tka-Rik's Cave, or obtained by completing special alchemical quests. Once you have all the components, use the Anvil of Artifacts. You will be able to create the insignia in the appropriate section. To upgrade a piece of equipment, use a Hero's Insignia on the item.

Universal Tools are of the same quality as crafted tools. But they are easier to get - the Boutique is always at hand, after all. And they are a pleasure to work with.

Using them to convert equipment parts will provide the largest amounts of materials. Like any other tools, they can be used to convert resources: raw materials can be turned into dust.

Here you go. These tools are much better than common crafted ones. Although they are not as easy to get. Tensess knows crafting them would take less time.

Using them to convert equipment parts will provide the largest amounts of materials. Like any other tools, they can be used to convert resources: raw materials can be turned into dust.

The material we get from the Astral is pretty good, but to use it most effectively, we need special workpieces. Professions can craft suitable workpieces. Blacksmiths craft armor, leatherworkers make leather, and tailors make cloth. Weaponsmiths craft weapons. There is a fifth type - jewelry workpieces. Any Profession can make those.

But what if you need a workpiece from a Profession you're not trained in? Or you don't want to waste time at some workshop?

There's a solution: ask other players, and they will happily sell you everything you need. There are plenty of lots at the auction, but remember that a seller always sells goods at an upcharge. So a Profession is not just an interesting, but also a profitable occupation.

Over the year, you will gradually unlock better quality workpieces. To learn new recipes, talk to the master of your Profession in the capital.

Did you come to see my menagerie? They're so sweet, aren't they? Each in its own way. I'm happy to know that my babies can make people smile even in these dark times.

name.en: I want to tame rare pets!

text.en:
Oh, do you? Excellent! It's quite amusing, although not very simple. I dedicated all my life to this business. Well, listen.

This is the thing I took away from a crazy Arisen. He was using it to torture animals. I'm not going to tell you what I did to him... And then I gave it a good thought, and I decided, waste not, want not, right? I untied this, fastened that, and look at it now! It's working for a good cause.

Life sensor will let you know if there's a rare animal (and not only animal) within 200 yards. It registers only animal presence. It won't react to every living being.

It's called a Tamer. I didn't rename it, only adjusted its properties. It can reduce animal's natural suspicion and aggression. You know, just to keep them from swallowing you whole.

Here, take it. Don't worry if you lose it. I can give you another.

Even if you fail to catch a pet, you will receive the Pet Symbol - proof of your efforts... 100 of these symbols can be exchanged for one random pet.
I told you, I've got them all!

Just another blind kitten, whose eyes are about to open. Boy, do I like what I'm beginning to see! Our old names will mean nothing soon, you'll see.
It was... wonderful! Forgetting everything and starting afresh! This time we can make it. Right?

name.en: The Darkness fills your mind. Fight it!

text.en:
Oh, Darkness? Darkness is good. It hides everything I don't want to see. Darkness is the new order of things. The undisturbed, quiet world, ready for the new dawn, for the change. Ready for new beginnings.

It's very near. And it's far away... Ah...

Why am I here? I'm just a harbinger. The Dark condescended to you. It's the greatest honor.

What am I heralding? Ugh, the ability to listen has never been your forte. The message has been delivered. Now it's just a matter of time.

name.en: You're talking nonsense. What's the meaning of all this?

text.en:
I remember... I remember a dream, which is a rare thing.

The dream about the future. About what's going to happen later, on another Earth, under a different sky. The grandchildren of our grandchildren are going to live in the light of Darkness. Our names and our deeds will be gradually erased from history.

Ah, don't you worry, your help is valuable the way it is. You're on of the protagonist! The main character of the Show!

The monumental character, both tragic and comic, like the fate itself.

name.en: Move along. You are not welcome here.

text.en:
It's all right. The amazing new world will welcome everyone.

It's weird, though. All roads lead back to you, through all the wondrous places and mysterious times.

I wonder if you're aware how lucky you are.

You're witnessing the beginning of the End from the front-row seat. Such Show is a once-in-a-lifetime event, you know.
...The Sphere slowly pulsates and slightly raises above the ground, expressing its consent.
...The Sphere seems to be woven from bright flames. It hovers in the air and radiates the sense of calamity and ease.
Ha, let it roll!
Together with my girls and boys will show them who's the master!
You're right. We better get going.
Strange things happen here, friend. The secrets of Time Void are inexhaustible indeed.
You're right. We better get going.
Yep.
If you say so.
You're right. We better get going.
Alright, let's not waste time!
Thank Nezeb! I've been waiting for so long!
If you say so. You first!
Yep!
I got it. We will handle this quickly!
I don't like this...
May fortune favor us!
Our road will be tough and dangerous. We will need your help.
What is it you want?
Strange things happen here, friend. The secrets of Time Void are inexhaustible indeed.
What do you want, sugar?
Let them attack! We will let them taste our Imperial blades!
Wherever I go, my sword will cut my way through!
Strange things happen here, friend. The secrets of Time Void are inexhaustible indeed.
That's one hell of a place, right?
Huh?
Some nasty critter can jump at you from the bushes at any moment, so we need to keep our eyes open...
This place is saturated with ancient magic. Be careful, friend.
Let it roll!
Doesn't hurt to try!

name.en: Osip's ghost came to me and demanded that I return Ath-Zak's freedom!

text.en: Well. Why do you care about his pleas? Oh, right, I keep forgetting. Well, let's talk since you're here anyway.

name.en: I challenged you more than once! That's what I'm going to do now!

text.en: Oh, wait, wait a minute. What challenge are you talking about? We're too adult for that kind of stuff. As custom has it, why don't we make a bet? A simple one. Without room for cheating. I'll be generous. You can have not only Ath-Zak's Spark, but also the Sparks of his girlfriend Luja-Gialla and the June Great Mage Tka-Rik. If you can complete the trials, of course.

We're not playing riddles. That's Simargl's thing.

We're going to play hide-and-seek! All three Sparks are currently here, in the Holy Land.

You can find the Spark of Ath-Zak's beloved one, Luja-Gialla, on Eljune. His teacher and Great Mage Tka-Rik's Spark is in the lands of Asee-Teph. His own Spark is somewhere arounds on the Plateau. Find them in this order without any hints or someone else's help, and consider yourself a victor.
Ah, peanuts! Your Spark goes to me and remains forever in my box. Have you ever lost?

Hello! Looking for something?
Yeah, quite recently! He was auditing the warehouse, and then he went to the Headquarters to do some paperwork. Well, I don't even know how to read.
There he is. Can't you see him?
Hello! How are you?

name.en: I'm looking for Quartermaster. Have you seen him?

text.en: I do, every day. He's been around doing some paperwork. You're late, he's just left. He was going to the checkpoint to see how the guys are doing.

"Defeating the great tiger wasn't easy, but the man and the girl were skilled and crafty enough. The Miktlan ruler Witzliwitle stood up and said,

"Say your names!"

"I'm Tka-a-Lithan Ric-ti-a-Nic," the man said.

"I'm Skik-a-Sbal Ici-ti-a-Kimi," the girl said.

And the Miktlan ruler sent the brave girl and the brave man to the Junes' greatest teachers, Shilonen, Coatl, and Atslan. Shilonen once was a sage and a philosopher. Coatl was a great magician. Atslan was a skilled warrior. The three teachers taught them everything they knew. The smart Tka-a-Lithan Ric-ti-a-Nic has become the greatest mage, ruling the elements. The strong Skik-a-Sbal Ici-ti-a-Kimi has become the strongest warrior, so swift and agile that no one could make out her moves.

The Junes' power grew. Ten years after the man and the girl appeared they decided to challenge the dragons."
The stele is covered in June words.

"The wind howls among the rocks. A fire dragon is flying in the sky. There's fire in her eyes, flame in her jaws. Sharp eyes are watching her every move. The Junes are at the ready. A lot of Dragon Hunters have been trained over these years.

Can anything pierce through the scales that are tougher than stone? Can anything compare to the wings that cover the sky? Is there a fire hotter than the dragon flame?

Only time will tell. War golems roar. Ballistae are sending arrows in the sky, one after another. The dragon is furious. She's on a rampage. She breathes fire. Mages enter the battle. Tka-a-Lithan Ric-ti-a-Nic is in the vanguard.

This time, it's happening! People outpowered the fire dragons. The dragon cannot believe she is defeated. She hits the ground. Her wounds are bleeding. Hunters rush toward the dragon. Their spears are forged from celestial iron, they glitter in the sun.

What to expect from this fight? The monster is dangerous even after it lands. Skik-a-Sbal Ici-ti-a-Kimi is there first. She dodges the gigantic paws and tail that flip and hit the people. The dragon is furious. Rivers of flame burn down dozens of hunters.

The battle rages on... The fire dragon is agonizing. Mages hit her with lightning bolts, golems shower her with stones, and the first among Hunters finally drives her spear into a flaming eye. And the dragon's final blast hits her.

Is there need to mention what happens next? The Junes are happy. Dead body of their eternal enemy lies in front of them. The Junes are grieving. Many lives ended on this day. Tka-a-Lithan Ric-ti-a-Nic is on his knees... he has lost his love."
The stele is covered in June words.

"You've taken my heart. I'll take yours," Tka-a-Lithan Ric-ti-a-Nic says as he draws an obsidian blade.

The bleeding dragon's heart is delivered to the Main Temple. Dragon blood is running like an endless stream. Greatest heroes of the Junes pass a goblet full of dragon blood. They drink without knowing that blood endows them with strength, longevity, and eternal thirst for dragon blood...

What happened that night? The Junes go out to the terrace to see a creature of an amazing beauty, shining like the sun of God... One after another, they kneel before him.

"I am your Creator. My name is Sarn," his voice thunders. "My children, you have done an extraordinary thing! The enemy put me in chains. Today you broke one of the chains. You are the chosen ones. You're the embodiment of my intention. You have my blessing. Your goal is to destroy all the dragons, find each of the cursed monsters, and exterminate their kin without pity. You can do it! And them... I will be free."

Inspired by the Creator's blessing, the Junes swore loyalty to him. Now the dragons will taste their fury! Incinerated cities and dead people will be avenged! Junes will forever chase the dragons - to the edge of the world!
The stele is covered in June words.
That's right.
You have seen the ANSWER on the first stone. Do you know what the question is?
Only the one who understands our story is allowed to go further.
Go up the ritual plate. Fall asleep on it and gain the knowledge that failed to save us, but it might save you.

text.en: Wrong!
Wrong!

name.en: What is worth knowing in the first place?

text.en: Correct! You read a story on the second stele. What danger was concealed in the beginning?
Wrong!
Wrong!
Wrong!
Wrong!
Correct! The last stele summed it up. Answer: can you go all the way to the end?
How long do we have to spend here?

name.en: I saw your name on a note on the Misty Slope. What do you know about the June tablet with Tka-Rik's history?

text.en:
Hush, hush... How did you...? Ah, never mind. With lots of spies around, this doesn't surprise me. There's nothing to hide, too. Yes, the Great Mages and adventurers have been obsessed with Junes' antiquities.

And since there's a truce, we elves also engage in the search. We could make an unexpected discovery, allowing my House to win the Big Game!

All seems in vain, though. The Junes knew how to keep their secrets. Besides, the friend that kept me company has gone missing. Be careful, there are forces that don't want the mysteries to be uncovered.

As for the tablet, I'd be happy to help you, but the ancient June tablet, my only clue, has been stolen by a kid troll. You can find him yourself if you like. They live nearby. He must have grown since then. Be warned, if you start searching, you might lose your head.
Good luck then. Hero. Oh, and I want you to have these papers. They'll help you decipher June language. You couldn't have guessed that yourself.
[The squirrel stares at you, you stare back]
Give the squirrel, take the tablet. Living is better than dead.

name.en: In fact, you don't need a squirrel. All you need is friendship and attention, but your circle can't give you that. Besides, the squirrel is a living being, just like you. It's not a toy! Objectivization is the appanage of narrow-minded persons. You're capable of so much more. Think what you can change within and without yourself.

text.en: Err... wha?

name.en: Here's the squirrel's dead body. Goof off with me again, and you will share its fate.

text.en: Take it and leave. And never come back.

name.en: Um... Hello! You look peaceful, unlike your kin. Do you know anyone who's recently found an ancient tablet?

text.en: A tablet? What's that?

name.en: It's a slab with a surface that bears an inscription.

text.en: Oh, I get it! I took your tablet. To play.

name.en: [Make a drawing of a tablet in the sand]

text.en: Um...

name.en: It's square in shape and it's got letters.

text.en: Oooh?

name.en: I need it badly. Will you give it to me?

text.en: Give? No way! I trade. Find me a squirrel, and you can have your... Tab...let.
All kinds of loafers hang around here...

name.en: Why do you need a squirrel?

text.en: Not gonna tell you. Bring me the squirrel. Then you can have the tablet.

name.en: It's quite a task to find you! I'm doing some research for... you know, Historians. I found a note in the ruins of the dead city of Uskul. It mentions that one of the artifacts I'm interested in has been delivered here.

text.en: Oh, the Historians sent you? I greatly respect your society. I've always wanted to do what they do! Oh, the romance, excavations, and ancient mysteries! I'm crazy about them! My cousin is a Historian... was...
But, you see, I'm stuck here! All because of the family pressure. "Get a real job", they said. My friends never took it seriously, either. I even attended a training...

name.en: Will you finally tell me where the artifact is?

text.en: Oh, right. Sorry, I got carried away. My ignorant colleagues, pardon me saying, took the tablets away together with garbage. You'll hardly find them. They must have ended up in a museum. I didn't just give them away! When I first saw the tablets, I knew right away that they were a big deal. I spent nights deciphering them! I'm not a scientist like you, but I managed to sort them out.

Here's what I found. There are other hidden mechanisms in June ruins. One of them is surely located in the ruins. No idea which ones, but they're the only ruins on Asee-Teph that aren't in the middle of greenery. The tablet also said that "our buildings will never turn to dust", and a stone that allows to see hidden paths... This might be a hint. I could go there myself, but I have work to do. Would you mention my name when you speak with Historians? I could escape, you know! I'll put that down for you, just in case.
Thank you... and good luck!
Yes? May I help you?
No ship will fly without a meteorite.

name.en: Is that your pendant? I found it on a kitten's neck in a brothel.

text.en:
What?

That's not the kind of question you ask an Elven girl!

It isn't mine!

Must be Louis's. I know his secret hobby.

name.en: Have you seen pilgrim Fedor Svyatoslavov around?

text.en:
What? Who?

Huh!

What's wrong with you? Just let an honest goblin work!

There was this girl with a shovel. She also wanted to know about that pilgrim of yours. She sneaked around, sniffing, putting her nose in every corner, writing down something.

I don't care. She can do whatever she likes as long as she doesn't get in my way.
I'm busy. Leave me alone now.

name.en: Hello! I have a present for you. Where can I find a girl named Lara?

text.en:
Ba-a-ah... Thank you, ba-a-ah...

Are you looking for the treasure huntress?

She was here, ba-a-ah... Asking around about the June ruins. That's a ba-a-ad place. There's evil in the ruins!

Marianna is good, ba-a-ah... Bu-u-ut now she's gone! They came in the middle of the night and took her, ba-a-ah... I don't know who. This piece of cloth is all that's left, ba-a-ah...

name.en: Give me this piece of cloth.

text.en: Here you go, ba-a-ah...
Stra-a-anger... What do you want, ba-a-ah?

name.en: Oh wise Treant, do you know about the Junes' decision, witnessed by the sky, water, and woods?

text.en:
Humm... Do you want to know the words, pronounced so long ago, shortling?

Aye, I do remember them... My grandfather's grandfather wasn't even a seed when the words were said... humm... We remember. We remember many things... humm...

The same year when the Darkness first came, people with the red bark were fighting in the ruined city...

Some of them decided to turn to the Dark. They summoned him at night, begging, reminding him about the given promise... humm... The Dark only laughed. He said, by the break of dawn the people with the red bark will be free from the Curse...

When the sun rose, they cried with horror. Those who rejected the Dark's help looked at their kin and recoiled with disgust... humm...

Their appearance was horrendous. They weren't people anymore. They were beasts with tentacles on their faces. No longer the sun-loving Junes with red bark. They became cold and slimy creatures, fond of dump dungeons.

They had nothing in common. That was the Dark's gift... humm...

name.en: What happened to those who rejected the Darks' gift?

text.en:
Humm... The history says nothing. The sky won't talk about it, the earth won't say it, the wind won't whisper in the leaves...

Unless the filth that's eating the earth talks. Someone once told me that sometimes it sings. Humm... I don't know his name, but this man's fate was bound to astral... Something happened to him out there, in astral... something very important. I'm sorry, that is all I know... humm...

If you find him, give him a piece of my bark. He should remember our talk.
Which came first, an acorn or an oak? Humm...

name.en: I was going to ask something else. Is that your pendant? I found it on a kitten's neck in a brothel.

text.en:
But where... I didn't...

That's embarrassing. I just happened to pass by. I must have caught a twig and the cord snapped. It's true! I swear to the Light!

Alright, give it to me, it's mine!

...Marianna who? Oh, Marianna! Yes, she's a rare girl. Very curious. We talked all night, and she kept writing everything down. She almost left her notes behind on my table. Or under the table? Or...

...

Well, what did you want?

O, I see this question in your eyes.

Yes, there's real holy water in this spring!
Lucky? Call us captains Lucky!
The June history is an example set for us.
Hey! Don't trust goblins.
Hey there.
What can I buy cheap and sell expensive?
Oh, hello.
Well, hi there. What do you want?
Hello!
Hello!

name.en: Is that your pendant? I found it on a kitten's neck in a brothel.

text.en:
Oh, don't show this to anybody, will you?

Don't get any ideas. It isn't mine. It's just... I wouldn't want to frame Louis.

Ouch! It slipped!

Don't tell anyone, you hear me?
Hello! Did you need something?
Greetings.
Meteorite is rare nowadays. Supply from Coldberg must be uninterrupted.
