name.en: Do you remember your talk with Stoneroot? He told me that sometimes you can hear astral singing to you.

text.en:
Yes, I heard this voice before, during the Great Astral Campaign.

We were going to the demonic portal when we heard this song. Oh, Tensess, it was so beautiful! Tears came to our eyes as we listened... It was like a mother's song over the cradle... So sad... So touching... We heard it with out hearts!

It's a song about everything we lost.

I'm a hermit now. I came to Eljune, and heard this song again as I was walking along the shore.

Go... and listen! It's somewhere close by... It's wandering imperceptibly, and only those who can listen will hear it.

Human talks. Water flows. Bird flies. The sales are up!

We get all sorts here, asking around about the Forestfolks. Historians!

One of your crowd visited recently. A girl. She was writing something down in her book. Books are good, better than birch bark.

She bought our blowguns and arrows. Arrows are good, too. One arrow like these can kill a troll.

We're trading with other tribes.

Such as Lizardmen. They're weird. They can't take a joke. They don't buy clothes made of leaves. And they've got scales! They hate arctic raspberries. But they love fish.

And then there's goblins. They aren't good persons. Always trying to cheat.

Others are even worse. They have just enough brains not to eat one another.

If it weren't for the port, trade would be much worse.

name.en: What are these clothes made of leaves?

text.en: Do you want to be part of nature? Alright, here you go. For you, it's free.
Only got pike. No other fish. Woe!
My fishing net is empty. Just weeds and mud. Fish gets scared and goes away. Spirits are angry with us.

It's better without lake monsters! Now that we banished them, the sun is shining once again. And there's plenty of fish. I wish we could get rid of pikes. They eat down smaller fish! Soon there won't be any for us.
Um, well... See, there's plenty. Just take it. The river is full of it.
It's getting cold.

name.en: Do you know what this reed pipe is for?

text.en:
The pipe... Where did you get it? It's a secret!

Alright, I'll tell you, although we don't tell out secrets to strangers.

There's a legend that is passed from generation to generation.

A powerful race once lived here. You call this race the Junes.

Forestfolk were just a part of a large nation that united Waterfolk and Mountainfolk. We were proud and numerous. We occupied all land and wanted more. So we engaged in warfare with Junes!

Of course, they were much stronger. In the end, we lost. We couldn't count the victims, and the Junes chased us down to the edge of the land. We ran and scattered across the world...

We begged the Junes for forgiveness!

And they spared our lives. They switched to a war with dragons...

By that time, our folk has split. Those who could talk with trees became Forestfold. Those who speak with the river became Waterfolk, and Mountainfolk were the people of mountains.

June helped us like no one helped us before. And there was the day when they needed our help!

Their people split as well. Some of them remained the June people and came to this village, which has been on this river bank for thousands of years. Rumor has it, it was warmer before.

But their Curse was awake! It followed them. A June gave his life to protect his own kin and my tribe. We saved our lives while he was standing guard.

We've been worshipping the hero ever since. Sometimes his spirit pays a visit.

name.en: May I participate in the ritual?

text.en: I'd normally say no, but you're a great hero! Here is our tribe's mask.

name.en: What happened with the Junes next?

text.en:
I don't know that.

Could you find out what happened with my family? Lua-Katley was my wife. We had two children, Tui-Yum and Lai-Kuwa.

I know that the Curse has been following the Junes around. I managed to hold it off by destroying the portal that the Curse created. Here's a fragment.

I don't quite understand what's going on in the world, but I think you can find the trail of the Curse. There should be a place out there that has a connection with the Curse... and the likes of it.
Oh, naive people... Why do you do this dance?

I'm a June... or rather, I was it once. Our people fell under the rage of our Creator's Curse. We ran, but the Curse has been following us everywhere. I stayed to hold it off and let my family escape.

I just won some time. I hope it was enough for my family...

[The spirit is looking at you in surprise]

You're the spitting image! Well... What do you want from me, little non-Forestfolk?

They just enjoy worshipping.

Did they tell you about the reason of our war?

The lesser people were the reason why the evil gods appeared. Unwise, they worshipped elementals. Two elementals, to be exact. They offered bloody sacrifice. The more they prayed, the stronger the wicked creatures became. This is how the two monsters came to life, Ayateotle, the master of frost, and Sheytekutli, the master of fire. They caused too much pain...

This is past now. I feel that you've found a stash with my story... or followed the footsteps of someone who found it. It doesn't matter. Now you know everything.

Marianna Lopatina's Log.

July 1, 1018

I found a pilgrim, who is also a Demon Hunter among other things!

And I say, he's got a keen eye! He knows his way around demons, like he has a nose for them.

The Hunter told me that he found ruins with traces of a demon so powerful that even Octulhu would be like a kitten to a tiger. He said that the battle of this demon and a mage had bent the earth. Over time, water accumulated there.

I wonder if I can find this place. My search might be coming to an end!
You see a carefully folded log page.

Stop! If you take one more step, I'll summon the Catacomb Masters! You'll die an awful death!

…

No, wait... it was... so long ago.

Oh, my beloved Ath-Zak! What happened to us?

Bits and pieces.

Zak saved me on Ignos... and then Zak turned out to be my beloved Ath-Zak. They defeated the Curse together with the wise Tka-Rik. I don't know what happened next. I only remember the darkness... and voices. A lot of voices. Moaning, crying, whispering...

name.en: What do you know about Tka-Rik?

text.en:
Tka-Rik was one of the magicians in an old book from my childhood. This mage is sleeping on a remote island, and when he wakes up, the good old times will return.

We're remote descendants of those who escaped from June cities, when the Curse came. Now I know that Tka-Rik and I went our separate ways then. He opened up a portal that carried my people far away from these lands.

Life became a legend. The legend became a fairy tale.

name.en: What do you think about Nihaz and his game?

text.en:
Be very careful. Nihaz is treacherous. He never lies to you directly, but you shouldn't trust him. The Dark God enjoys playing with us, beckoning us with false hope.

You risked so much for us. I'm eternally grateful.
Remember! You'll only have one chance when it comes to the results.
Take it. I know you can find Ath-Zak, wherever he is! I'll be waiting for us to meet, just like I waited back then...
Who are you? Where's my beloved Ath-Zak?

My beloved Nancy!

I'm leaving you this note in case you'll be looking for me. Our holy father Ivan, the Devotee, gave me advice to visit the place known for its holiness. The first Chapel of Tensess! A great miracle happened here. Suddenly, an evil astral demon appeared and smashed the ship! But those who died in astral were brought back to life by the grace of Tensess. They appeared right here!

The chapel is locked and abandoned. It upsets me greatly. I know that Goblins are to blame! They're wicked creatures, thieves and hustlers! I heard an interesting story about them, though. They say that the ship that got wrecked in astral was carrying two goblins. They went into the Purgatory. One of them saw a Servant of Tensess and got scared! He started confessing his sins, promising to sacrifice mirra. The other goblin heard that and offered to sell mirra! And it's been like this ever since: one goblin received Tensess's forgiveness and became a gift collector; the other goblin was cursed and banished from the Purgatory forever.

Well, one way or the other, my beloved Nancy, I should visit the smugglers. Have a row with them. Why have they neglected the Chapel? The mongers have the guts to collect money from pilgrims! Their leader lives somewhere around here. He takes ughing sessions on a meadow, whatever that means. I'll give them an ughing session!

I will see you soon, my darling. I miss you. I'll return to you as soon as I sort this thing out.
There's a roll of parchment that smells like incense.

Marianna Lopatina's Log.

June 18, 1018

I'm so angry! It took me a while to catch this idiot! Thank Tensess, I've got the tablets now. And this is the missing part!

I restored the missing fragment. It's a story of the great fall of the city June Itsmal.

"For the city was great and the citizens were proud. Gifts were brought to June Itsmal from all over the world.   Beautiful ships arrived at Takalik harbor. June Itsmal ruler, the great Xolocipilli, was brave and wise. He used to kill the fire dragons.

Everything changed in one day. The Curse came to the city. The walls were tall, the gates were strong, but all defenses fell. The Curse took lives with just one stare. Mighty golems taller than the tallest trees have come to battle. But even they couldn't stop the Curse. The towers fell. Xolocipilli's palace fell and buried the city ruler underneath. Only a few survivors escaped the ruins of June Itsmal in the dead of night.

What happened next? Whoever wrote this, they clearly survived! I need to find the next piece...

I asked around if anything interesting was found lately. People tell me that they saw one girl of easy virtue bragging about a pretty stone with strange inscriptions.  Not much of a trace, but that's all I have.

Boy, it never gets old.
It's another log page.

name.en: Unfold the sheet folded into four

text.en:
Marianna Lopatina's Log.

June 19, 1018

I think I'm onto something. An elf told me about a battle between goblins and the Free Traders' Mercenaries that took place recently. That was rough.

It started the other day when a stranger arrived. Louis told me he was asking about Junes! Someone's been hunting June artifacts. And that someone was spotted asking the mercenaries about any interesting recent findings. Perhaps, he was the one to hire goblins.

Well, anyway, those bastards wanted to break into Asee-Teph. The fight was furious! Rocks falling everywhere, arrows flying around, swords clinking. I wish I could see it!

Unfortunately, this means that those tablet will be very hard to find.
There's a roll of parchment. Who could leave it there? It looks like a page from Marianna's log.

name.en: How do you like my music?

text.en:
I loved it! We didn't have a good concert in a while. Since the King and Jester band left. It was such fun!

A whole crowd gathered. All kinds of people were in it. The cheerful troll brought a keg of good beer. There was a girl asking about the June treasures... and there was... what was his name... the one with horns! Constantly whining. I don't remember...

What? You've been looking for the girl? She and that guy with horns, they hugged each other and went away along the eastern road.

Listen, if you ever see him, hand him this bottle. Let him drink it and remember the party we had! Maybe it helps him stop whining.
I've been to places where the living envy the dead...
Why have you come back here?

The book isn't the one you're looking for, but it's interesting. It's called "Bertilia's Final Report about the Holy Land Events: Historical Evidence". It's come a long way. Bertilia has collected the most interesting extracts from research papers.

There's an instruction written in red on the cover.

"Urgent. To Zayan."

You're reading a page from the folder. It's called, "Marianna Lopatina's Log, August 13, 1018"

This is the last page of my log. All other pages are stolen by goblins. There's something wrong in the Holy Lands. Now I'm thinking about coincidences. The Ath-Zak legend is called "Cursed Lands".

Are the Holy and the Cursed Lands all that different? When the world wasn't split apart, it took only a few day's travel to get from Gipat to Eljune.

Now it's time to sum up my travel. Junes' fate is clear. They fell under the Curse that has been hunting for the Junes. They separated. Some of them became Wormfaces, others managed to escape.

The outcasts are now condemned to misery. I spoke with a Tep Cultist. He was kind enough to share some information, even under the threat of being disassembled into gears.

Tep took great interest in June heritage. He and his servants met the Junes who escaped from the Curse. There was hearsay about a city in the mountains under a spell so powerful that it drove the Curse away.

This city was where Gipat is now. Was it Tka-Rik's farewell gift? We can only guess the future. Hundreds of years later, the Aro tribes arrived at these lands. They assimilated with the June descendants and created a mixture that rewarded the world with creators of a rare talent.

My readers probably have already guessed. Today it is known as the Dead City. Nothing lasts forever. The Curse was destined to find June descendants early or late. Some of them escaped again. More Kanians than Junes, they now live in the Settlement.

Zak found his distant relatives in the Settlement. Is this the destiny mocking us? It's up to you to judge.

I'm going on a new expedition. I want to find out if Jigran is a legend or reality.

You're reading another page from the folder. It's called, "Noel de Blizare's Journal". Here's a fragment.

I never regretted going on this expedition!

It has everything my teacher advised me, Alphonse De Ardeur, the great natural scientist.

The Holy Lands are full of various life forms. I talked to almost all of them! It makes you think: what could one discuss with a troll? How to find an approach to a Mantis? What could Harpies tell you?

And I'm saying, there's a way to everyone's heart. I, for instance, talked to ogres. They are considered rude and cruel, and unjustly so! There's beauty in everyone. It may be too deep, but it's important to find the right words.

I managed. It turns out, the poor primitive minds are susceptible to speech. It you talk, and talk, and talk, they respond. But not everyone is capable of it. I'm remembering poor Adele de Grandeur... She had a brilliant mind and several PhDs, but she choked up and skipped a beat... and became ogre's meal.

What's also important, these people are keeping their history. They write songs and poems, carve pictures on bones. I learned a lot. The ancient legends from the June times, stories about wars of the past...

Junes were belligerent. With the education they received from our Elven ancestors, they became a truly fearsome power. They built routes that allowed them to navigate through the portal network. We've begun to figure them out just recently! Not to mention golems, both small and big as mountain!

Lamias, for example, remember the June wars very well. Alphonse was right about them. Lamias worshipped a snake goddess. Junes found her and fought to kill. Fancy that, they killed a real deity, albeit minor. No wonder the dragons wasn't a problem for them.

I'm sending my notes to Bertille de Pluie. She's so smart, she could compile a great book from them!

Bertille's handwritten note: "Someone must explain this fool that personal contact is something completely different from her own definition."

You're reading another page from the folder. "A letter from Yaver Amenia, Evette de Doucer, and Antoinette de Grandeur to the Council of Historians on allod Neigh." Here's a fragment:

Dear colleagues, we have completed the study of the June ruins on Eljune. In the course of our research, we reconstructed the history of this location.

June Itsmal was one of the largest June cities. Located in the bay, it had an exit to the open sea and the ocean surrounding Yule. This made it a major trade port. The city comprised not only the immediate area of today's June Itsmal, but the neighboring quarters, located on a vast area from the Jakala Ruins to the Icemirror Lake.

Goods from all over the world were brought to the city. The evidence was found that trade was conducted with Tekyan people from Irdrich and with a mysterious "fifth tribe of people".

The city sustained serious damage during the dragon war. On numerous occasions it was burned almost to the ground, but recovered every time.
The fatal blow was made when the June Curse appeared here. Research proves that it is the original form of astral demons, enhanced with extraordinary power.

Most citizens died; the rest were able to escape through open portals. The final wave of survivors avoided death at the last moment by miracle. We may safely state that the Junes have chosen a tactic of scatter, splitting into small groups and spreading across the continent. This allowed them to avoid the Curse for a long time. However, this also led to a gradual cultural regression and assimilation with other people.

Wormfaces later visited the ruins. Obviously, they became sacred locations for former Junes, who kept memory of the past.

You're reading another page from the folder. "Joint report of Nomarkhs Semerkhet, Yasskul Khufukhaf, and Taltal: the Holy Lands research." Here's a fragment:

The conclusions based on the results of our research are fully consistent with our preliminary assessment, stated during the historical conference, "The June impact on Zem culture."

The following has been proven:

1. A significant cultural impact took place, expressed in the urge for a ritual, where every Zem must visit the former June state and examine the ruins to develop motivation to search for immortality. This fact is confirmed both by the testimonies of witnesses (including the authors of the report) and by the numerous traces of Zem presence on Asee-Teph.

2. Proven fact: a journey of a famous Zem known as Tep that place around 2470 AD (Old Era).

3. The study of the "Tensess Temple" object has provided evidence that the journey has made a deep impact on the individual's personality and mind.

4. It has been established that soon after the journey Tep discovered the nature of Sparks and began a large-scale construction of Spark storage facilities, also known as "Tep's Pyramids".

Conclusions:

With a high degree of probability, we conclude that Tep's journey to the ruins of the June civilization invested in his scientific breakthrough and discovery of the nature of Sparks and Immortality. Speculations on the nature of knowledge (in particular, the marginal theory that the god of Death appeared before Tep and personally gave him the knowledge) is left to the readers.

You're reading another page from the folder. "Sarang Petosiris, Tep Cultist's speech". Here's a fragment.

Tep? How dare you call this name?

Tep is the greatest necromancer ever! In my past life, I was honored to help him! Tep was studying June magic then.
Junes... oh yes, they achieved so much. So, Tep studied them. His primary field was magic of blood. June knew a thing or two about it. Blood conceals great power. It has the life power of the Spark. By consuming blood, you consume someone else's power. Why do you think the Great Mages drink dragon blood? Or the demonologists drink demon blood? Or vampires!

Tep went even further. June magic didn't help them when the Curse appeared... the first demon.

Yes, that's right. The legendary June Curse was a demon. Didn't you know it? That's weird. I've seen it as clearly as I see you. And you might see it some day! Why? What do you mean - why? It's there somewhere. What did it look like? The last time I saw it, it was following the real Junes. They're extinct now, of course. But there are so many people with June blood in their veins! Why do you think the astral demons look so much like the Curse? It's out there! I can't believe you live in this world and know so little about it.

Tep now consumed Sparks instead of blood. A straightforward way is always faster. But he needed a stock. A stock of Sparks. It wouldn't work our if Tep hadn't found a record about the Box. Nih's box, of course.

Basically, this world is a trap for Sparks. Nothing can leave it. Tep found the source of power that's holding it inside without letting anything out. How? I don't know.

Based on this power, he built pyramids. He also created the Plague. You'll have a taste of it when Tep comes back...

Ouch, don't hit me!

The note stops abruptly.

You're tired of reading, but you turn the page. It's "Thibault de Desirae's thoughts on some paradoxes on Coba Plateau". Here's a fragment.

The story that happened here, on Coba Plateau, keeps haunting me. When Tep was constructing the pyramids, preparing to destroy his people, this place was the center of his cult.

Contrary to popular belief, the greatest battle between him and the Zem Mechanics took place here, in a place now known as Spectral Gorge. That's where the pyramid with a destroyed top is.

My expedition conducted research and established some facts, contradicting the popular interpretation of the story.

First of all, there's the question, who buried Nefer Ur and other mechanics on Hickut (now known as Xadagan allod), although they died here, on Coba Plateau.

Besides, we failed to discover residual plague in soil and water, although given the power of infection, this place must still be dead.

Here is an interesting fact learned by my colleague Noel de Blizare from legends of local people, now living in the Holy Lands.

According to them, death came here. It breathed its black breath, and life itself agonized. Just when there seemed to be no hope, a beautiful girl, a great sorceress, came here. Morning glory flowers grew in her footsteps as she walked. With her power she destroyed death and left no trace. It took her a while to bury all the dead people. She sealed the eternally dying Tep in his main Pyramid known as Asee-Teph.

Who could that be? A Great Mage from the past? An unknown goddess? I'm afraid, we'll never know the answers. Maybe, Zayan knows something?
You're very tired, and yet you have many trials ahead. Enough reading for today.
Hm. That's weird.

name.en: You... Aren't you going to try and eat me?

text.en: Huh? I don't know... I'm not sure...

Let me tell you. I might understand it all along the way myself. Just don't hit me.

So, I was living my happy life here. We're no sophisticated people. If we catch fish, we eat fish. If we trap a rhino, we eat the rhino. A tiger? Cool! You're the tastiest, though.

Hunting has been dangerous lately. As it went some time ago, you just had to wait by the fence and grab the first one that emerged from there. And then make barbecue or a stew.

Then the Tavern owner returned. Ooh, he's scary! You may not notice. We, ogres, have the guts for such things. Terrifying. Walking up there has become weird, as if eyes were staring at you from the sky.

Now it's hungry times. And there's this girl. She came herself! She looked so delicious, our mouths watered. And she went on and on about something.

They gave her to me. I was going to make a stew, but she didn't get scared. Just kept telling me stories. I was caught up in them. I was hiding her for a few days, and you know what? I think, we made friends! She had to leave. There was research to do. I didn't go with her, although she invited. She even managed to teach me how to read - very slowly, and even left me a book. She said I should read a book if I wanted to find her.
It's been stolen! Those crafty and nimble, who got themselves a ship... We don't approach them. It's all death, and nothing else.

name.en: What are you planning to do now?

text.en: She came and she went. You've come, and you're leaving, I guess. I'll leave too. I will do the research. Just need to learn how to write to leave notes, too.
Hey, stop! State your password.

name.en: I have no idea, all I have is this letter.

text.en: Oh, that. Alright. You must be looking for Key, but I don't know how to put it... He's been missing. He went to this camp, it's been a few nights that he's gone. I can't leave. I promised I'd wait for him, and I'm a coward... Will you help us?

name.en: I need to find him, too, so why not?

text.en: Wonderful! I have a plan, and now I have someone to carry it out. Listen up. I made a goblin mask. It isn't perfect, but they aren't geniuses, either. Wear it, get inside, and find my boss. Listen carefully to goblin talk. They'll give you an idea where they keep him. Or where they used to keep him.
Yuppie! Let's wait.
It's all ready now.
Greetings!

name.en: Hello! I was looking for you.

text.en: I'm always happy to help, but why?

name.en: I talked to your... ...colleague near the hive. He says you know where to find a gibberling I need.

text.en: Ah, the brave and adventurous one? I knew he had many friends! He wanted to solve the Quicksand riddle, and I helped him. Gave him an ancient Zem artifact. I always carry one or two with me! I have no idea in which backpack, though...
No way. That one was a daredevil. You don't stand a chance. I'm not taking this responsibility.

name.en: I had a vision. Or rather, a note from my friend. What I'm trying to say is, have you seen a sneaky gibberling around here?

text.en: Huh? All that I can see is termites and your queries. Wait a second. I think I can help you. If you help me first, of course. Scientist's word!

name.en: What do I need to do?

text.en: You see, I've been here for a few weeks, and I can't leave this place. My negligent assistant went to collect information about the previous Hive hierarchy, and disappeared. The termites must have eaten him by now. They probably scattered his notes around.

Just wait.

That clown liked to confuse things. I'm sure the names were one big headache. He studied the June language and was very proud about it. He wanted June to become an international universal language.

What nonsense! Scientific logic must be the universal language, not some ancient blabbering.

Why don't you help me out? Sort out his notes and bring me the clear information about the Hive's hierarchy. There should be six types, described in five notes.

You can go now.
No, something's wrong. This doesn't correspond with my studies. Go and try harder.
Alright, good. Who was the second in the hierarchy?
I put that down. Who was next?
Alright! Who was the fourth?
Go it. Who was the second-to-last?
And finally, who was the last?
Let's have a look...

name.en: I've found all notes. Now I'm prepared to tell you about the Hive hierarchy.

text.en: Wonderful! Who was the leader of the Hive?

You could do.

Listen closely. I can't help you, but there was this crazy colleague of mine. She was and Elf, loved to talk, and hated systematic labor. She studied local fauna that shows mild signs of intelligence.

If anyone saw your friend, that would be her. I have no idea where she is now, but she left a note, Nih knows why!

I haven't read it, but you might find it useful.
Don't get in my way!

Everything is so hazy... You see a different place... but you realize that it's Coba Plateau, only thousands of years ago. You see a skinny man in white robes. Only his amber eyes can be seen under the mask. He leans over a June stele to read the text on it. He's silent and thoughtful.

He hears a hail, "Tep!" He looks around.

Everything around is blurry and sparkly. You can see consequences of a terrible war that happened in this land. Traces of battles, dead bodies... no living thing dares to approach the bodies. There are no vultures or scavengers here. The "non-life" seems to be caused by an unknown disease that killed everything.

Suddenly you see a girl with light ginger hair and delicate features. She walks between the bodies. Waves of the black disease are rolling away from her.

"You can do it," she says to herself and lifts up her hands to cast a powerful spell on the world. "You are the soul of the world."

A series of blurry images brings you a gibberling's cunning face. You immediately realize that this is the one you've been looking for! You can't see his partners in the fog, but there's one phrase you can make out, "Termites? That's nothing! Anyone could beat them! They're just tiny insects." You're keeping this memory for a long time.
What do you want from me?
The reminiscence stops. You feel like you could emerge in it.
A little battered, but just about serviceable. What's inside?
There's a roll of parchment. Who could leave it there?

I don't see why people love this Well so much. The morning sun is a thousand times more beautiful, and you can see it from everywhere.

I'm a simple centaur. I'm not even a shaman who talks to spirits. I can't see the whole picture. Come to think of it, why is it even called "a well"? It's no good for collecting water. Oh heavens, it is a weird place, indeed.

While I was grabbing a bite, I overheard a conversation. They were talking about Demon Hunters whose camp they liberated from demons a while ago. They're so brave! They fly through astral and hunt astral monsters there. They've been everywhere. I decided I should pay them a visit and listen to their stories. I hear nature is very beautiful there.

My hooves are aching, but adventure is calling! No time for rest!
There's a roll of parchment. Who could leave it there?

I was too arrogant to ignore my aches... I hit my head on a branch and twisted two ankles! Thank the spirits it happened near the camp. The locals helped me and gave me food and water. They also told me a lot of stories. It almost feels like home.

I didn't leave home just to settle down somewhere else, even in a nice place like this. I looked at the sky and felt that my heart was full. The open road is calling my name again. Where should I head? I remembered the story of Kyros and Aellona. Kyros, the poor fellow, defeated our chief and earned the tribe's respect... After Aellona died, he went mad and messed up everything. Such a sad story, but also beautiful. I could write a song about it.

I decided to visit Aellona's grave. I'll leave in the morning.
There's a roll of parchment. Who could leave it there?

I didn't expect Polis to be such an amazing place. Aoidos managed to build so many things here. What a gifted nation! Just like us.

I came across a weird vagabond who was looking for something, mumbling nonsense. I tried to run away, but he just wouldn't leave me alone! One thing led to another, and here we are, relaxing after exploring this city's every nook and cranny. To understand how much fun we had, just imagine how hard it is for a CENTAUR to climb onto a roof. I'm not sure I can repeat that!

My friend loves secrecy and conspiracies! Poor fellow, he just can't see past these mysteries. I should remember to leave him a note about my future plans. It should make him happy.

name.en: No secret. I'm looking for your friend, because his sister asked me to.

text.en:
There has to be a secret.

Something. A secret or a mission.

A deadly one... Or it's an invitation!

A summon to a school of wizardry and witchcraft!

name.en: I'm telling you, all I need is the note! I've never seen you in my life!

text.en:
Oh, now I understand. It is a trial.

A test of moral values, so to speak.

The destiny I have been waiting for.

For forty years, from then till now,

I've been expecting my fate

to find me. Oh, this requires deeds, not words.

I am prepared, my friend.

name.en: All right, here's how it goes. "Wherever moon shall meet the shiny sun, the fate will overtake the chosen one."

text.en:
Oh, heaven, joy, and bliss! A riddle

to solve! Then I will know what to do.

The goals will be set, and the direction clear.

Now that it's done, will you vanish? Disappear?

Dissolve into thin air? Am I right?

name.en: A-ha. Just hand me the note.

text.en:
The note says:

I'm sorry to leave you, my friend, but the road's a-callin'.

Besides, even if I stay, will I manage to find a job in Polis?

You helped me see something. If you keep searching persistently, you're bound to find something. I didn't know that at first, but then I realized: you've got your purpose - live up to it. You should never care about what people think. It requires willpower. Above all, don't lose yourself while trying to reveal a secret!

Perhaps, you can catch up with me. If you're interested, I'm heading to the South of Dion Mountain Range, beyond the Pearl Slopes, to see the real demons people are talking about.

name.en: Have you seen Centaur the Traveler here?

text.en: The demon is staring at you. After a while, you sense that he tries to communicate something to you. It feels like a consent.

He keeps staring. You see another stream of images. The demon seems to have empathy with the centaur. Is it friendship? Oh no, it's a mixture of feelings. Parting, such sweet sorrow. Appreciation of Centaur's choice. And yes, indeed, the Centaur has left another note.

name.en: Can you give it to me?

text.en:
The demon hands you the note in silence.

Demons are amazing. I didn't expect them to be this beautiful. They use images to communicate. Images appear directly in your head. Isn't it wonderful? It's weird how many people might consider them evil or dark creatures. Of course, they can scare you, and they can't take a joke, but they are so, so beautiful!

People despise rats as well, but have rats ever hurt anyone? They're living beings who want their share of food and water! Hardly any rat ever crawled inside a house with malicious intent!

Some demons never heard of centaurs, so I left a note to the most curious of them. He gave me something in exchange...

This is a lovely place. I'll sleep it off here, and then I'll head to Triquetrum. Aoidos mentioned "energies" there. I need to see them.
What do you want?
There's a roll of parchment. Who could leave it there?

I think I know what Aoidos meant by "energies". We'd say this place was "blessed by the spirits". They might have over-blessed it a bit. Everything here seems ordinary and miraculous at the same time.

The most interesting places are never talked about. You only get to know them by chance: overhear a conversation or spot a turn in the road... I'm getting more and more confident that I made the right decision. You can't just sit around peacefully when there's a big world outside with so much to see!

I hope some other strange adventurer who finds my notes and follows my tracks will never regret their decision!

I discovered that I left my favorite toy behind. It's not that important, but it holds so many good memories. I'll drop by our camp tonight. Just need to make sure not to run into my sister or friends.
There's a roll of parchment. Who could leave it there?

Just think about it. No two-legged creature can imagine how hard it is to sneak quietly on four muscular legs.

I got carried away and walked through the whole the camp! I can't brag about it to anyone, but it's something I can write down in my notes!

Familiar places look different at night. You get to notice things you never noticed before. It makes you understand things you couldn't until now. But enough of "philosophizing", as Aoidos used to say.

My sister was asleep as I grabbed the toy. I think she sensed my presence but never woke up. I don't know how. She might have sighed in a special way. I grew up with her, so I can feel her with my heart.

I know she will forgive me. She won't think I escaped.

There's only one place left to visit. It's the Site of Power. They say that the swords are always clashing there. I'll go to the champions' camp and get myself drunk to leave these lands without a second thought.
There's a roll of parchment. Who could leave it there?

All right, the swords here aren't always clashing. I didn't see a single battle while I was here. I guess I was incredibly lucky.

Boy, did we get drunk! I couldn't imagine so many people can ride my back all at once! An idea of giving people rides never occurred to me in the first place.

I received a mug with my name on it - somebody carved it with a knife. I was called "a great man and an average horse". They also invited me to stop by whenever I'm around. I will stop by on my way back, perhaps.

They say alcohol won't solve your problems. It sure won't, but a good party can chase away the gloom. It's important to maintain the balance... It's very important.

I'm going to the Dionic Archipelago. I've heard a lot of wonderful things about it. I'll see you on the docks, my imaginable follower.
There's a roll of parchment. Who could leave it there?

The docks don't seem extraordinary after you've seen Polis. Just barrels and crates... The flight was something to remember, though. I've never... flown? or sailed? Never traveled much. Anyway, a sensation's worth a thousand words.

I found a way to entertain myself, though. I assumed an air of importance and started walking around, opening boxes and barrels, examining their contents. People regarded me with suspicion, but no one dared to approach me. I looked very confident and somewhat menacing. I took nothing, though. I was just curious. Only one thing looked intereting: a sphere made of a semi-transparent gemstone, with fine dust whirling and glowing inside...

It's getting dark. The dockers told me there was a village not too far away. I'll spend the night and hit the road in the morning.
There's a roll of parchment. Who could leave it there?

It turns out, I'm fond of villages, no matter who lives there (unless it's someone who wants to rip out your guts). They all look alike in a way. Whatever happens in the world, they live their own lives, look after their households, be it centaurs or humans...

I'm getting more and more romantic. I wonder if the travels induced this in me, or if it's an adventurer's disease, common for all wanderers. I neither can nor want to figure it out! I think I'll just go with the flow.

I've been dreaming about lying alone on a pasture, far away from home, without knowing what lies ahead, simply admiring the stars. It's time to make the dream come true. Let me find the nearest pasture and head right there.
There's a roll of parchment. Who could leave it there?

So, I've been watching the sunset. I'm writing this note while the sun is still up, so I wouldn't ruin a starry night by scribbling things down.

Whenever the stars are seen, I don't feel like writing. They make you feel so small and unimportant... You start thinking about what's happening up there, the amazing and significant events.

I'm feeling nostalgic. I suddenly remembered my sis and my dear village. How are they doing back home? I'm not homesick, but it'd be nice to know that they are doing fine.

Back to real life tomorrow. I'm taking part in all kinds of local entertainment - as a spectator at first. I'm going to Coliseum in the morning. In the meantime...
There's a roll of parchment. Who could leave it there?

It's such fun! Pegasus flights, ball throwing, the crowd cheering... The applause, I was explained, is clapping hands, all people at once. I tried that with my hooves. I think it made me deaf in my right ear!

Whatever they say, it's worth trying. I can't wait, my hooves are shaking. All right, I'm up for it. My next stop is Pegasus's back. End of story.
There's a roll of parchment. Who could leave it there?

My request to participate made the jaws drop. They tried to talk me out of it, but their leader decided that a Centaur riding a Pegasus was a great publicity. He gave me the most powerful stallion!

Now picture their faces when I took out a piece of parchment and started scribbling, right up in the air, on the Pegasus's back! As if I were an incredible poet of ancient times! That's what I'm doing right now. The parchment crackles and leaps out of my hands. There's too much magic here! I don't know if I can hold it. Got to find something calmer after the flight. Like a local maze, where you can easily get lost...
There's a roll of parchment. Who could leave it there?

I can't quite understand where I am. All turns look the same. Here's a gazebo, and there's another one. I sat down to collect my thoughts while I'm writing another note.

After my spectacular ride, they allowed me to take part in other activities. I'm a local star - or, maybe, a local crazy. Go figure!

This place is... creepy. Not only paths, but thoughts get twisted here. Someone evil created this place. Someone, who enjoys watching helpless wavering. Why on earth did I come here? And these Minotaurs... are staring. Some would say, we're alike, but it's hard to imagine two more different species if you ask me.

I must choose something simpler next time. An obstacle course, for example. The whole trick is to run to the final line and finish first. Unsophisticated, but fun!

Now I should find the way out. In the end, they might remember to find me and get me out of here... I hope.
There's a roll of parchment. Who could leave it there?

Oh spirits, I don't know what to say! Some places and events just change your very essence over an instant! The Observatory took my breath away.

I learned a lot. They told me about other worlds, about Architects and time travel, about the endless astral. News like this take time to digest.

It will take even longer to see it all!

Whoever is reading this note, I'll say goodbye. I don't know where I'm going, but it's somewhere far away. I'm looking for... I don't know what, but I must find it.

Go your own way. I'm sure it will be legendary. If you want it, of course.

I left a gift for my reader. Find the small crate. It contains the most needful thing.

Take it with you. In a way, I'm grateful. It was a journey that we took together.

Good luck, whoever you are.
Alright.

name.en: Tell me how I can find him

text.en:
My brother went for a journey. I knew that his heart was calling him. I knew this was bound to happen... He doesn't know how to survive outside the camp!

I can't judge him. I don't want him to return only because I'm worried, either. Let him find his own way. I just need to know that he's okay! What if he needs help?

He left this note. All I know is that he went to the Well... Here, you can read it.

name.en: A-ha. It's high time to find your brother.

text.en: Thank you! My brother may be young and unreasonable, but I love him dearly.
Stormbringer! Have you received my letter?
Centaur the Traveler's first note You have already seen it. The eighth note must be in another house.
There's a roll of parchment. Who could leave it there?
There's a roll of parchment. Who could leave it there?

Oh spirits, I have the strangest feeling. It's like guilt for being alive when Aellona is dead. Enough of being sad, though. I should leave a note in a safe place, away from prying eyes...

I'm asking myself why I'm doing this. Do I want to leave a trail? Do I secretly hope that someone might follow my tracks? Do I expect someone to find me? My sister, a secret admirer, or just someone simply wandering around the world?

Since I started making notes, I should continue. Now I'm wondering where it will take me!

It cheered me up. Where will I go next? I think I'll visit Polis. It isn't far from here. I heard it was a lovely place full of people. Maybe I can find a friend there.

name.en: You're the strange Aoidos, the recipient of Centaur the Traveler's note?

text.en:
You call me strange, but you're equally strange to me!

Your pace is fast, your looks are weird, your questions are strange. But you're right.

It's me. What do you seek? A world mystery?
Listen, stranger. What are you doing in the Aoidoi vault?

name.en: I found the Echoes of Power... Power from other worlds!

text.en:
I did not doubt you. I will preserve this knowledge in the immense chambers of my memory.

And on the pages of the book, of course.

It's over there, on the table.

Eternal movement is the true meaning of Eira.

Endless air spaces, giant canyons and gorges. Winds sweep over misty valleys; storms and thunderstorms rage.

This world carried the seeds of freedom within itself.

Every motion and aspiration was born here, and it was from here that it spread to other worlds.
Precious crumbs of knowledge about other worlds, collected by the hero of our world - Sarnaut.

There are no heroes without victory over monsters, but monsters also need worlds that spawn them.

Sherk is a world of endless swamps where everything is mixed together. This world was extremely dangerous for anyone who dared to travel here. Endless struggle is the true state of the inhabitants of Sherk.

Bearing the same name, its deity was a giant monster which slept in the depths of the local warm and muddy ocean. Its children, left unattended, kept trying to reach other worlds.

But they were closely watched at the time.

This world is eternally young. Constant flowering and renewal is the essence of Fiore.

It was here that new life was created. It later spread throughout the universe. Fiore constantly spawned new creatures which then populated new worlds.

Fiore was the world where the All-Mother lived. She ruled over the other gods as they created life in the universe.

This world was forgotten soon after it was created. None of the gods wanted to rule over the Darkness which was its essence.

Ossu spent most of his existence away from his luminary, in the Darkness.

But occasionally Ossu returned to his star, and then the frozen salty oceans melted, and crimson rays illuminated the whitish rocks which stuck out like bones.

During these years, the creatures of Darkness that lived here hid in the very depths of the crevices, waiting to awaken again when the light left.

Eresh is the stronghold of death, also called the "Kingdom of No Return".

At that time, its ruler was the Guardian. He made sure the Sparks of the dead were sent to Eresh. Each Spark left its home world, flying to the inner worlds where the Guardian and his judges determined its fate.

Some of the Sparks were reborn in Fiore, some remained in Eresh, but there were also those who left the world altogether, and their fate remained unknown.

Besides the judges, there were also soul carriers in Eresh. Their task was to accompany the Sparks into the depths of Eresh.

The path to the world of death was protected by seven gates which were inside the Ganzir palace. No one could leave its walls without the permission of the guard.

When Dizz was created, it was already old.

It is a hot, dusty planet where time speeds up. Every rock will be crushed into dust, all water will dry up, and flames will go out.

Dizz's sun quickly died. Hanging like a huge ball over the horizon, it witnessed the creation of those who carried the essence of Destruction - the Void Dragons.

Dizz became the Father Time's domain, a place where he waited for his turn to lead the universe to the end he envisioned for it.

This world was the source of every precious metal and stone the gods needed. In their desire to improve the universe, they descended into vast caves full of gems and dug passages in the depths.

Then it turned out that the surface of Erde was also rich - gardens were planted here, blooming and fragrant.

This world was ruled by fire.

Hot deserts, raging volcanoes, oceans of lava - this world was not a calm place.

However, a flame is also necessary. It was Pyro who became the source of the power that allowed the hearts of new worlds to be ignited.

The great forge of the gods was built here, the place where their artifacts were created - they were needed to create the next planets.

The last of the created inner worlds is Eden, the world of life.

Eden was also created by the All-Mother who wanted to gift it to her beloved daughter, a goddess.

This world remained hidden, and its location was unknown for a long time, but those who visited it said the planet itself was a huge Garden of Eden, covered with many Great Trees - giant plants created by life itself.

The great creation continued.

Among the gods that were created by the All-Matter and Father Time were those who endured the calamities of the previous eon. And the most skillful, most capable among them was the great Sarn, the God of Light.

It was Sarn who was entrusted with creating a new world, the brightest gem that shone in the universe, and Enod became this world. Sarn's creations were beautiful beyond measure, and the people he created exalted their creator.

Enod was built of gold, crystal, and white marble, its cities and towers reaching up to the heavens. A white sun shone in the azure sky.

If Enod was the world of Light, then Inis was the world of order and harmony.

Its creator was the divine Juvius who values regularity and symmetry above all else. There was not a single crooked line on Inis, and the people that lived here had the most thorough laws and regulations.

Any dispute that took place in the universe could be brought to trial in Inis, and everyone knew that the only correct and fair decision would be made.

In the beginning of this eon, the universe was empty. The last eon ended with a terrible war that devastated the universe.

But there was a great Eidos, home of all the gods. It was the beginning of everything. Everything that had to be created originally existed in Eidos.

And although the gods were at enmity with each other, peace reigned in Eidos, maintained by the royal couple - Father Time and All-Mother. Infinitely wise and capable, they were determined to rebuild existence.

At the very beginning, twelve inner worlds were created...

Agva was the complete opposite of Pyro.

An ocean planet, covered with endless waters, where violent waves beat on the shores of coral atolls and small sandy islands.

Agva is a place of tranquility, healing, and comfort. Whenever someone needed to be healed, they came to this world and immediately received what they sought.

I don't like this idea... But since I can't stop you, I'll do my best to help you and not let you destroy the world right now.

I swore to repay my old debt, and I will. Nobody knows how to work with flows of pure energy better than I do, because as soon as you open up a Seal, it will flood the whole place with energy. I will distribute it between our sorceresses so that they can prevent either of the gods from winning, and also protect us. And you... Cut, chop, burn - do whatever it takes to stop the gods from prevailing over each other!

name.en: Start the Battle of the Gods

text.en: Interfering with gods' business is dangerous, bid it's even more dangerous to sit idle when the fate of the world is at stake! After the Seals are destroyed, the biggest battle in the history of Sarnaut will begin! I will not ask whether you are ready for that - nobody is. Just let me know when we start.

name.en: Open up the Seals and hope that the Architect and Sarn will just destroy each other

text.en: There is no place for mortals in the battle of gods. All that we can do is pray. If in several minutes the world does not disappear in a fire vortex and does not turn into solid stone, than we did the right thing.
Are you worthy?
Let's start!
Let's start!
Let's start!
The huge gates stand in the way.
The gates open with a rattle.
Behind these gates is a June treasury, guarded by ancient sentinels.
Hak, the leader of the Destroyers, has the key. First you will have to get his permission.
Gates silently open... Prepare for battle!
Get ready!
Get ready!
The gates shut with a rattle.
I'm speechless. This is... unbelievable. Please give me some peace and quiet to reflect upon what has happened so that I can write this down without missing any details.
I hope I won't regret joining you in this venture...
Well... We won't have another try!
This is a wise decision. You better stay away from that battle and let luck decide our fate.
Teleporting.
Teleporting.

name.en: Sirius, the Guard of the Star Gates

text.en: Teleporting.
Teleporting.
Teleporting.
Returning.

The Portal is shivering with the energy raging in it. You can only hope it won't throw you out of the Astralosphere.

Where do you wish to go?

The Gates are open; the Seal is broken, but there is a small problem. There it is, right over your head. If I am right, and I am always right, it is called the Void Dragon. It does not belong to our world, and I'm afraid I don't know its weaknesses. All that I can do is alter the gravity so that you can battle the beast from close range, but no more than that. I am hanging on by the skin of my teeth here.
Come on!
Come on!
Wow... I didn't expect that from my father!
Well... It's better to regret doing something than not doing something, right?
Come on!
You quitters! This could be fun... Do you have any other heroes there? These ones won't fight!
Teleporting.
I can't believe it... We did it!

name.en: Ask what is going to happen next

text.en:
I... don't know. You see, the world is free now - more than it has ever been before! The shackles are broken, the castles are in ruins... Sarn's madness and the Architect's callousness are no longer a threat to Sarnaut. Now we are the only ones responsible for the future of the world! Now we are the creators. Finally, my dreams will come true...

And you should visit the capitals and tell our governors about what happened here. Maybe the fact that you have saved Sarnaut will soothe their wrath. But if they decide to execute you for teaming up with a traitor and entering a criminal venture that could destroy the world, you will at least die a hero. Maybe I will even mourn... but not for too long - I have many things to do!

name.en: Ask what is going to happen next

text.en:
Well, our plan worked. Sarn and the Architect destroyed each other, this is certain. What's next? I don't know. You see, the world is free now - freer than it has ever been before! The shackles are broken, the castles are in ruins... Sarn's madness and the Architect's callousness no longer threat Sarnaut. Now we are the only ones responsible for the future of the world! Now we are the creators. Finally, my dreams will come true...

And you should visit the capitals and tell our governors about what happened here. Maybe the fact that you have saved Sarnaut will soothe their wrath. But if they decide to execute you for teaming up with a traitor and entering a criminal venture that could destroy the world, you will at least die a hero. Maybe I will even mourn... but not for too long - I have many things to do!
I hope they don't execute you after all - where else will I find such a reckless and bold hero who would dare to challenge gods?

Looks like a great battle is upon you. I'm sorry, I will not be a part of it - I don't have the right to risk my life fighting rusty June scrap metal. And also, who else will be there to sing songs about your heroic deeds and pay our last respects to you?
Let's go!

Sweet sparks are coming to my Prism! They were lost on the Secret Paths... Poor things!

Will you play a game with me, sparks? If you win, I let you go. If I win, you will stay stray forever in my worlds. For I am the lock, and I am the key, and I make rules on the Secret Paths!
What?! I can smell living flesh! What are these doing here?!

Kyros-shmyros! You can't just walk in here! It's the Purgatory, not a thoroughfare!

There was no Kyros in here. I would remember a name like that...

Wait. What is that noise?

The flow of time is frozen in this place. Even my heart is quiet, obeying the rhythm of the Planar Rim.

Your enemy is waiting in the middle of the Bridge of Times.

With the death of the Wanderer, time resumes its normal course. The dark skies of Secret Paths are clearing.

The gates of Purgatory are wide open - all you need to do is cross the Bridge of Times.
I think you can beat me? Your courage is fascinating.

You are not worthy of fighting me!

My warriors will destroy you, and then I will drink wine out of your skulls!
Well... Let sacred combat decide who's in the right!
You’re not like the people of the Whitestone City. Spirit is weak in their stone bodies. What’s driving you? Why are you helping them?
The Well of Souls is our greatest sanctuary. I can show you the way to it.

A mere thought of these filthy creatures swarming our sanctuary makes me shiver with fury! Too bad I've never held a sword in my hands.

I will show you the way to the Well, but then - you're on your own.

name.en: Teleport to the Well of Souls

text.en: Get ready...
Here is the Well of Souls. Now it's the time to step into the unknown!
Teleporting
Where are you going?

The mysterious portal glimmers with otherworldly light.

Where are you going?

Something is wrong with this place. I can sense... Chaos. a Shard of the Great Darkness.

The tissue of reality is very narrow in this place. I think you can enter the Purgatory... if you cross the bridge.

If you change your mind, I can take you anywhere you want.

The floating Menhir emits an otherworldly power. The mysterious energy is intoxicating... and inspires awe.

This looks like an entrance to the Purgatory.
Teleporting
Where are you going?
Are you leaving? Because you should!
Exit
Does the mortal want to ask a question?
Get ready...
This is the Observatory entrance. Before you step in, state your intentions.
The Pegasus is ready to deliver you to the Observatory.

Savant is still imperfect, and it must construct certain structures which will allow other architects to travel to that layer. See those capsules near the walls? That's what they are used for. A little bit of magic, and they will work they should. Six of you will be able to enter the energy layer of Savant.

And be careful - it's not just a piece of an altered allod! It's the Archon's domain, and he sets the rules there.

Unfortunately for him, I'm here to break them.

I don't know why he needed to create his "subreality". Maybe, he cannot complete the process of ordering without it. Luckily, the physical and the energetic dimensions of Savant are tied together. If we do something to him in the energetic dimension, it will affect him in this dimension, too.

In what way? I have no idea. And we need to find this out!

Are you ready? You should be!

I can open up the way to the Archont. You just need to approach him and stay alive. It is just as difficult as it sounds, but I believe in you.
So, you're finally ready? Don't just stand here - go finish the monstrosity!
If you survive, your battle will be praised in songs in all taverns across the world. If you don't... Well, you still will be praised, but in a much more tragic manner.
The higher you climb, the harder you fall. Congratulations - you have just taught an ancient truth to an ancient creature.
It is indeed.
The exit from Savant domain is in front of you. Do you wish to leave?
Teleporting...
Behind these gates is Fractal - the last Architects' bastion on Dane. Only a raid of 12 members can stand its trials!
This won't be easy...
Get ready...
Teleporting...
Teleporting...

Savant is the last of Archonts who attacked Dane. The power of this creature is unknown.

We should prepare for the worst.
Teleporting...
Do you wish to leave Fractal?
Teleporting...

The portal system allows easy travel through the Architects' fortress.

Where would you like to go?
Teleporting...
Teleporting...
Teleporting...

name.en: Point of No Return (Master, Archont of Creation)

text.en: Teleporting...

name.en: Point of No Return (Master, Archont of Creation)

text.en: Teleporting...

It was a remarkable creature. To create its own dimension and sustain it solely through willpower is something our Great Mages wouldn't dream to do.

This wasn't of much help for it anyway. This invasion can now officially be declared over! Well done!
Of course. Right after we level this place to the ground.

Huh! The cannons of Eclipse could have fired on this fortress for ages with no visible result.

Anyway, I helped you get Eclipse inside, and now it will provide us support in battle. I assume that we need to reach the top of that tower.
Are you trying to get yourself killed? Well, as you wish.
Don't expect it to be easy.

So he has broken into our world. Who is he? I have no idea. But the Archonts clearly needed him for some reason.

Whoever he is, we need to shut down the Path and don't let anyone else come in. If we fail this one, we will fail everything.
Right after you!
Are you sure you can do that? The fault is all yours if you can't!

Implements of war should be buried in the deepest abysm. The Astral will devour what's left of this Archont. Demons will tear it apart. Among all creations of Sarn, they must be hating the Architects more than anyone.

What an irony!

Are you so willing to give your life? That's what playing with Threads has done to you.

Now when we're finished with the crippled ones... we can proceed with the fully functional and incredibly powerful Architects, who have just announced us their target number one!

What do we do? We knock on their door, of course.
It is crucial not to mix up the buttons.
It is crucial not to mix up the buttons.

A miracle of magitech thought, ready for operation. Its construction does not inspire too much confidence, though.

But there is no other way up to be seen.
Looks like we will have to use this horrible machine once again.
Come what may!
You're not looking for an easy route, like that tenderfoot Marianne? That's good! You need to meet the threat face to face!
Hold on! This isn't going to be easy!
I am a healer, not a fighter. The path of war is not my path. If you wish, I can weaken our enemies using the power of Light.
Wise decision! May Tensess bless us!

Are you ready to move on? I know I'm not. But I guess we don't have a choice.

I can try to affect the Architects' brains, or whatever it is they use to think. What do you say?
As you wish. Get ready!
Oh... I'm not a fortuneteller, but I have a feeling that this is going nowhere good!

Are you ready to move on? I know I'm not. But I guess we don't have a choice.

I can try to affect the Architects' brains, or whatever it is they use to think. What do you say?
Oh... I'm not a fortuneteller, but I have a feeling that this is going nowhere good!
As you wish. Get ready!
Gash-halee... Tyk heard about you. You fight like a lynx! We you walk, the snow is red.

Tyk was never defeated! You are strength! Your minion is strength! Tyk look at the best chief!

Tyk make a vow - your head on a spike. Tyk failed. Tyk ashamed!

Booka-Booka chief now kill Tyk. Do you fight Booka-Booka? Tyk will help you, goon-galash!
Pyk don't catch such prey. Pyk catch beasts, tunga-too!

Pyk remember, you came with furry two-hand two-leg beast! Pyk will catch it easy! Mrr... Murk was it name! Funny.

Pyk respect your hunt. You kill not to kill. Pyk kill to eat! Pyk eat, tunga-ha eat! Booka-Booka chief, hulu-tarsh, now forget my hunt and want to kill me! Pyk don't want! Pyk will help you.

Mmm... You come - the ground moans. You come - the wind howles!

Humm... Myk hears all. Myk, and mounts, and snow, and sky are one.

Humm? Spill Tungar blood and then ask for peace? Hany-ash, you black heart!

But not all blame is yours, humm. Booka-Booka chief goes against you. Booka-Booka send tunga-ha to die. He always get lost in the hazy mountains! Dark spirit save his soul, hum-hum!

Humm... Myk will help you kill Booka-Booka. Then Myk will go. This ground is nothing now for Myk.
Tunga smack! Kaput!
Tung! Tung clomp-clomp. Stabba stick, tunga die!
Tunga zzing! Kaput!
Ugh... Zip! Zap! Tung-Tung kaput!
Tunga squash! Kaput!
Aheem... Shaman boom-boom? Goody gods! Shaman die!
Where would you like to go?
Through this Portal, you can teleport to the Otherverse. If you are lucky, you won't even turn into a cloud of stardust or burn in an energy outburst.

Your goal lies ahead of you. Do you still want to interrupt the Passage? Deny the Ascent? Give in to the chaos that is devouring the worlds? Let it be so. I will help you reach Locus, but then it will be entirely up to you.
I will reorder our world to let you reach Locus. I... The Architect will not like it. Parts of the Whole are already on their way here, so you won't reach your destination without a fight.
It is your choice. But I do not think you will make it. The Order cannot be changed!

Oh, Light, I wish I could go with you, but I can't... Me and Elizaveta are drained. All we can do is share the grains of force that we still have left with you. I hope it will help you reach Locus and turn it to dust!
May the Light be with you, child. Go and remember - the future of our world is in your hands!

Ah, demon's spawn! Such a terrible headache...

Me and the prioress are exhausted. I will send my mental messenger with you to carry the remains of my strength. I hope it will help you. This monster is way too strong for me right now!
Wait a second... Here you go! Try not to die!
Aho, friend! We're about to start a nice hunt!
May ancestors' spirits bless you!
Teleporting

There is another world behind this Portal. Nobody knows what is waiting for us there.

But whatever it is, it will fall.
Where would you like to go:
You can go to other parts of Ferris.
You can feel your home world behind this Portal. Sarnaut is waiting for its heroes.
Teleporting
Teleporting
Teleporting
Teleporting
Teleporting
Teleporting
Teleporting
Teleporting
Teleporting
Agreed!
Agreed!
Agreed!
Agreed!
Agreed!
