Agreed!
Agreed!
Agreed!
Sign with blood and find a replacement for the lazy designer.

name.en: We must return to the Observatory

text.en: Hurry. The Council is about to start.

name.en: We must return to the Observatory

text.en: Hurry. The Council is about to start.
...You managed to notice Nezeb's sharp blade as he drags it out of sheath.

My friends, I appreciate your care, but this is just too much. Wait outside, will you?

(Skrakan is speaking to the members of the Conclave)

Dear Council members, thank you for electing me, this is a great honor. It is with caution and unease that I accept your decision. I recognize the great responsibility you are endowing me with. I solemnly promise and swear to govern and rule justly and reasonably. I will not give you any cause to regret your decision.

With all due respect, may I ask who you are? Why did the guards let you in?!

I have to ask you to leave immediately, otherwise I will have to order the guards to arrest you.

name.en: Step back and stand by the door

text.en: ...You are forming a line by the door as you wait for the end of the ceremony.

You must look like the local guard. Steal their uniform and take their positions. When the time comes, you must make sure every member of the Conclave survives. Don't let Tensess and Nezeb kill anyone - or one another, which is even more important!

name.en: Listen, here's the thing. We've lost the gear.

text.en: Oh Sarnaut gracious, how could you lose a dozen sets of gear? Anyway, here are a dozen more.

I don't need the Observatory to see who you are and why you're here. The supreme good, you say. I say, hypocrisy. It doesn't matter, who you obey and who you serve. How is "your" Cosmos any better? Is it because he preserved the Aoidoi's free will? Allowed Sarnaut history to run its course? Freedom is a faulty principle. Freedom is the matter of Chaos.

Look at me. What I managed to achieve! Look at my accomplishments! They're mine! If my purpose requires blood, even if it's blood of my own people, so be it.

Give up. While you can.
So be it!
It leads downstairs to the treasury.

Oh, you’re here already? Harmony de Conte, traveling minstrel, at your service!

So he’s our enemy? That’s unfortunate... I’m not sure I can bring myself to harm him. Just look at him! Hasn’t he suffered enough? He hasn’t seen the rays of astral suns or felt the wind on his skin for thousands of years! He’s been breathing dust and fumes... There should be ballads about him!

But I see you want to put an end to his suffering. Well, you may be right: it’s our duty, and death is our job.

I’ve managed to learn something about this poor creature. His sensitive ears are both his weapon and his weakness. He can’t see at all, so he relies on sounds to orient himself. I have a few ideas...

name.en: He hears us! Do something! Play louder!

text.en: I never thought I'd say this, but you better cover your ears!
Ah, the Ball of Shadows?
Ah, such manners. I will have to teach you a bloody lesson...

Have you ever danced under a blood moon?

No? Well, no time like the present...
It’s not the best time to distract me, child.
It’s not the best time to distract me, child.
It’s not the best time to distract me, child.
Hold on tight!
We are the fear of death, Hiero... Reach out... Touch me...
Hiss
Evil Laughter
Make your choice!
Make your choice!
Make your choice!
Make your choice!
I've been waiting for this so long...
The dark flickering of the portal reminds you of the Plague and Catherina's obsession.
Ah, there you are. Don't worry, not all of the undead have passed away of old age.
I've been waiting for this so long...

So these motley clowns are my reinforcements? I expected someone more... Anyway, to hell with the expectations. I must work with what I have.

Long story short. There's a demon under this Mound, and I'm planning to subdue it. You have a chance to eye-witness my triumph.

Any questions?

name.en: We're going to help you. What do we have to do?

text.en: It's easy. Look...
Did you expect me to go all the way through the catacombs with you? I'll see you at the exit.
The plan is simple. We'll turn Tep's Plague against himself. Sounds ambitious? Not when the fate of the world is at stake!

name.en: Let us put an end to it!

text.en: Let's roll!
Hurry! The future of all civilizations depends on us.
Are you the reinforcements from the capital? Well, Tep is holding down his pyramid. We managed to occupy the perimeter and defend against his Machinarium, but that was it. You're our only hope now.
Every second counts, you'd better hurry.
Every second counts, you'd better hurry.
Let's go!
It's worse that we had expected.
One can only hope that none of those infected with Tep's Plague left the pyramid through the portal.
Ready to return to your allies? Have you taken your reward?
Refuse
Agree
You see a crystal in front of you and hear a quiet whisper; you can see Kanaan’s smile, and he’s whispering: Come forth...
You can feel the darkness and the eternity...
Well, as you wish.

Look what that brute did to our bright halls. No winds of the world can eradicate this smell of blood! Blood everywhere!

Time does not wait, warriors! Kanaan and his bastards will not leave this place alive!
There is a different time and an unexplored space behind the Whirl. Are you ready to face the first opponent chosen by the Observatory?
There is a different time and an unexplored space behind the Whirl. Are you ready to face the second opponent chosen by the Observatory?
There is a different time and an unexplored space behind the Whirl. Are you ready to face the third opponent chosen by the Observatory?
There is a different time and an unexplored space behind the Whirl. Are you ready to face the fourth opponent chosen by the Observatory?
Good luck!
Entering.

name.en: What are you going to do?

text.en:
Hell if I know.

Wrokag and other shamans will soon be rushing back to me. All they dream of is breaking away from the Empire. Can’t judge them on that - orcs are not built to depend on feeble humans! But what are they expecting of me? I abandoned them for so many years - well, I was dead - and they still haven’t started anything resembling a rebellion...

They’re just a herd of sheep. And I’m not going to lead it.

It’s pretty fine here. It’s peaceful. I haven’t seen those horned guys before - where did they come from? What? An explosion in the battle of gods? Alright, tell me this some other time.

Oh... I need a drink! Do they have a tavern here?

name.en: What do you think about the war with Nihaz?

text.en:
No idea. The more I think of it, the scarier it seems.

But this is exactly what our enemy wants - to scare us. We have to keep looking for a way.
This place gives us many possibilities... And I’m not sure whether I want to use them.

name.en: What do you think about the war with Nihaz?

text.en:
The Zem people chose a bad time to resurrect. All I remember from my second life is one endless war... Always fighting for something. Always rushing. Always afraid to lose...

Maybe the war with Nihaz will be the last one. Soon some of my people will ask themselves - what had we resurrected for? Where is that second life?
Why did you have to blow up the bulwark of Imperial science? Well, I shouldn’t be surprised... Destroying things has become your hobby a long time ago.

name.en: What do you think about the war with Nihaz?

text.en:
...The demon seems to hesitate. You can sense several “pallidly colored” waves of his emotions before Ollum finally answers.

‘A slaughter,’ thinks Ollum. ‘Demons will fight until the end. But they cannot outlive the god of Darkness.

There is no hatred or fear in his thoughts. Something more like... disappointment?
...The demon is carelessly hovering and doesn’t seem to notice you.

name.en: What do you think about the war with Nihaz?

text.en:
The best way would be to avoid that war. War is chaos and regress. There will be no winners in it.

I will do my best, but that’s not enough. Be strong.

That’s what makes chaos so dangerous - it always finds a way to survive.
What a curious construction. Is it called the Observatory? I feel very calm here.

name.en: What do you think about the war with Nihaz?

text.en:
Urgent progress. Accelerated production. Creative genius and assiduous work.

This is all we need. As soon as you find out how one can arrange that, please let me know. One thing I can say for sure - Umoir soon is going to go through an industrial revolution. There’s no room for rustic superstitions when there’s a war coming.
My advice is: less counsels and meetings, more action.

name.en: What do you think about the war with Nihaz?

text.en:
The future is hidden in a haze... A fiery black, sinister haze. I have a very, very bad feeling about this.

The only good news is that the first sprouts have shown up in the New Land! The ice fields are melting, the snow banks are growing smaller... The earth is awakening! I hope I live to see the day when it blooms!
Oh, hello, child. Don’t look at me like I’m a ghost!

name.en: What do you think about the war with Nihaz?

text.en:
Well, I have some thoughts... But that’s pretty much it. I should travel a bit, to clear my mind.

The Order? Oh, right, the Order. Nefer Ur will take care of it. Our views concur in many respects.
Cosmos is still showing off his Observatory... Alright, I admit it’s an impressive device.
Receiving rewards
Receiving rewards
Receiving rewards

name.en: Tell me about Armando de Doucer.

text.en: As I understand it, de Doucer saw necromancy as a tool of acquiring more prestige. I have nothing against the Dark Arts - they are no more dangerous than any other weapon in good hands. However, Armando and his clique turned to Vampirism... In other words, they gave up their minds. Since that day, his life started to unravel and eventually ended in the City of Demons. Pity, because the boy was a talented one.

The last June hero! In the time period picked by the Observatory he is the powerful entity that you encountered in the Dead City. Another victim of Nihaz’s plans... No, I’m not in a position to judge you. The whole story perplexes me. The Wormfaces could be our allies in this battle.

Cairage is alive and well. I've been told he tried to rebel against the Demonologists on Sogot. He didn't like their methods, and I can't say I don't agree with him... Quite a few heads rolled - demons, Demonologists - before they managed to imprison him. Just imprison! They couldn't kill him... or perhaps they didn't want to. You'll have to do it yourself.

name.en: Tell me how Nezeb left the Conclave.

text.en:
The origins of the conflict between the League and the Empire are lost in the dark mists of time. We know it started with the rivalry of two mages, Nezeb and Tensess, who used to be close friends. What caused it? It is unknown.

Many believe it was Nezeb's greed for power, others blame Tensess and his indecisiveness. And even fewer people mention a third person – one who divided the two friends, ensuring that they went their separate ways. Only one thing is certain – one day a quarrel broke out between them. It was a sad day for the entire world.

Your are going to witness this conflict... and take part in it.

It is an interesting episode. I find it hard to find the time slice it fell out from. I gather, it's one of the alternative events of the near future.

Here is the end of templar Hiero's story. The poor fellow lost his entire family and turned to Light, longing to return his loved ones by the power of his own faith alone. Alas, it isn't the way the Gift of the Light works! Hiero's despair only led him to the edge of insanity and opened the door for the Darkness in his heart. And the door to our world.

name.en: Tell me about the Great Dragon.

text.en: A, Fiery Father. The last idol of the Draconids. A magnificent creature, though I don’t harbor any warm feelings for it. He died a silly death for foolish reasons instead of protecting the Draconids and helping us in our battle against Nihaz. We could use his omnivorous flame.

name.en: Tell me more about Maverick, the Walker of Secret Paths

text.en: This can't be good... Maverick should have never appeared in the Whirl, under no circumstances. I'm afraid, it isn't even a trip to the past, it's... I don't know. This creature is immortal and unpredictable, as well as many other Planar Rim emanations. Even I stay away from this place. Be careful...

name.en: We must talk about the Fourth Whirl.

text.en:
Yes, we must. I'm also wondering where the Observatory could find this... script. It looks like it's fond of alternative realities now. This can't be good...

I'm not the one to tell you how dangerous I am if you ever dare confront me. I don't think I can give you advice. Maybe, you should stop before it's too late.

name.en: Tell me about Hoof, the traitor minotaur

text.en: Long, long time ago in the Winter Palace... Actually, only a couple of years ago. There was a minotaur, who, if you'll pardon the expression, wasn't too smart, just like most representatives of his race. But he was exceptionally greedy. This was his undoing. I'm sure you remember the story. You put an end to it.

name.en: Tell me about the Prophet, the mastermind of fanatics

text.en:
It could be funny if it weren't sad. Everyone remembers how oversusceptible mortals established our beloved Sculptor's cult.

Architect, our friend, took this phenomenon in cold blood. He just let it be. "Watching the unusual behavior," he said. There's no need to remind you how it all ended... The Observatory will tell you the story.

The Dead King’s name was lost in history... I’d say it was very well hidden since even the Observatory doesn’t know it. Maybe some powerful sorcerer had put an oblivion curse on it?

Anyway, the Dead King was the last ruler of the Dead City and was worshipped by its ghosts until his ultimate death. The Observatory wishes to relive that moment.

name.en: Ask about Kazul the Astral Watcher.

text.en: Kazul was a very mysterious creature. Gurluxor's magic turned that Searing Eye into something much more than just that... An ultimate sentinel. The Great Mage's watchdog fell in the uneven battle of the Demons' City, but his power is still echoing across the corners of time. It is echoing loudly enough to draw Observatory's attention.

That elven dame's fate was tragic. But then, what else can you expect when you're at the same time a genius and a great fool? However brilliant Celestine de Ardeur was, her obsession with Tep played a bad joke on her - the Summoner punished her severely for her failure and integrated her mind into the Pyramid control system.

Nihil's final breath of relief was heard by the Observatory. This is why she's doomed to go through her death over and over again until the Observatory is satisfied.

Initially, Thalos was just a statue created by Ionas. He was the symbol of the Games, the majestic Keeper of Fire. Now he is a living creature, a container of tremendous power and a vehicle for the dark god's evil will.

Thalos is just a small manifestation of Nihaz's power, so don't delude yourself... He can still easily destroy you. He razed the entire stadium to the ground in just three seconds. If it had not been for me and the Observatory, it would have happened in the real world and not in the dimensional pocket. Though hurry up - my power won't hold it back for too long.

Elves of the de Doucer house were not the first ones to fall prey to vampirism. A long time ago, on allods so distant no one these days even knows of their existence, vampires were already terrorizing the honest folk.

Of course, there were those who opposed them. I think you will be glad to hear that eventually vampires were wiped out. The Observatory offers you to witness the last hours of one of the mightiest vampires of those times - Blood Father Kanaan.

name.en: Tell me about the Clockwork Knight.

text.en:
This must be still fresh in your memory! The Observatory takes great fancy to Catherina's personal guard. Efficiency, loyalty, incredible power with a very elegant touch of classic magic.

I must admit this even makes me think of building my own mechanical guard... I promise they won't attempt to kill you.

If you want to witness the four elements of magitechnology once again - the second Whirl is at your disposal.

This one's a mysterious story. Why this name was given to a Cyclops even though two of his predecessors were a different species, I have no idea. Maybe, a cross-species love affair? Anyway, Brainum's life was short but busy. He was smart enough to plunder ships of small princelings and stay uncaught. Just like a dragon, he used to hide his treasures in the empty halls of the Ancient Mound, where no living thing dared to come.

Eventually, his greed played an evil joke on him - the undead of the Mound, disturbed by Morrana, a goddess of death, took his soul. The goddess cursed him, and now he is doomed to guard his ancient gold until the end of times.

Or rather he was doomed - until certain heroes took him down to the bones.

Zayan de Desirae took particular interest in her! To an extent that I even sent him to examine her temple personally. It took him a long time to get back...

Euriala was the most beautiful creature, the embodiment of Elven values. She was considered the Goddess of Beauty. No one dared question her high status. Her talent in magic was outstanding. Her kindness and valor were matched only by her beauty.

It was her valor that led to her fall. She was on the front line when Nihaz attacked Sarnaut. She watched as the world descended into darkness. One by one, her comrades died in her arms. At some point, she was on her own in this confrontation. This was when Euriala hated the entire existence: she despised Nihaz, the Great Mages, and even Sarnaut's legendary heroes who got tangled up in the threads of time and failed to come to her aid.

Overflowing with rage, the perfect beauty turned into an abomination, as though this was the Dark God's joke.
Our world is a grain in the ocean of Creation. Maybe in this place you can comprehend the scale of the Universe and walk among the distant stars.
Our world is a grain in the ocean of Creation. Maybe in this place you can comprehend the scale of the Universe and walk among the distant stars.

Its possibilities are not known to me... yet. This place was born in the exact same moment as me. Just as I am beginning to unfold my wings, the Observatory is still expanding its horizons.

However, it already has one property that we may use. Every mighty opponent that any hero of Sarnaut had ever faced left its imprint in the world. Those imprints entice the Observatory. It wants to relive those moments over and over again, feel the taste of time, understand its course and its laws... The Observatory rewards those who can help it learn.

You will find four Whirls here, and each one conceals one enemy. How long each of them are going to stay there is a mystery to me. The Observatory might get bored and replace them by the next time you are back.
The door is over there.

name.en: Who is hiding behind the Whirls now?

text.en:
The Observatory made its choice:

First Whirl: The Dead King.

Second Whirl: Kazul.

Third Whirl: Nihil.

Fourth Whirl: Thalos.

name.en: Who is hiding behind the Whirls now?

text.en:
The Observatory made its choice:

First Whirl: Kanaan, Blood Father.

Second Whirl: Clockwork Knight, Catherina's Guardian.

Third Whirl: Brainum the Third, Treasury Keeper.

Fourth Whirl: Eurial, Forgotten Goddess.

name.en: Who is hiding behind the Whirls now?

text.en:
The Observatory made its choice:

First Whirl: Ath-Zak.

Second Whirl: Great Dragon.

Third Whirl: Armando de Doucer.

Fourth Whirl: Cairage.

name.en: Who is hiding behind the Whirls now?

text.en:
The Observatory made its choice:

First Whirl: Catherina's fall.

Second Whirl: Death of Hickut.

Third Whirl: Nezeb leaving the Conclave.

Fourth Whirl: Hiero.

name.en: Who is hiding behind the Whirls now?

text.en:
The Observatory made its choice:

First Whirl: Hoof

Second Whirl: Prophet

Third Whirl: Maverick

Fourth Whirl: Cosmos

name.en: Tell me how Catherina got under Sarn's influence.

text.en:
Oh, it's recent. I'm sure you know everything from your stay at Umoir. But now you can see it with your own eyes.

Don't let Catherina know that you saw it. You shouldn't sting her conscience again.

name.en: Tell me how people of Hickut died.

text.en:
Hickut's death is well documented. The Zem people are very meticulous when it comes to history.

Tep has brought enough trouble on this world. Observatory will show you a battle between a handful of brave people of Hickut and the crazy Necromancer's machinarium. Nobody survived this slaughter... except Tep. And he isn't what you would call a victor.

Yes, Hedus-Avior-Mirach is what they called me when I was whole! The river of time carried those days away. Nihaz imprisoned me here a long time ago. He used me as a power source for this Citadel and all sorts of operations. I resisted for as long as I could, but in the end, I lost myself in this prison. Curse Nihaz to eternal damnation! Thank you for freeing me. Now I can become one with eternity... Farewell.
What a glorious battle! Our squad took a few hits during the landing. But thanks to you, we made it.
Great. That's one enemy troop down. Perfect timing!
That Wigo! We will surely encounter him. He's always got us into trouble. I hope I can persuade my kindred to leave him and come back.
Unbelievable... It's unbelievable! I have never seen so many undead. That's not all. More are coming.
We're moving out soon. Danas and Naira will strike from the flanks.
I have a feeling we've been watched since the moment we arrived.
We're here. We can't move forward yet. I hope it'll change soon.

See that thing my drone is scanning? I'm almost sure it's somehow connected with this thing's power circuit. Give me some time, and I'll come up with something. Just a little tweak... and we could short-circuit this thing. Ha!
Banshee and I are ready when you need us.
Let's go. This goblin had an idea.
Generator is now disabled.
Something is spinning in the center of the device.
The generator is being disabled.

name.en: Return to the Assault Level at the camp.

text.en: Teleporting.
The portal is not very stable, but it can teleport you a short distance to save you some time.
Before you stand the gates to Sardrok, and beyond them lies the domain of the sinister Old Man.
Travelers are advised to leave this gloomy place before it's too late.
Can I help you?

I could never think Catherina will turn out to be so double faced! Now it’s time to pay for my own blindness. I an the only one who can drive Dawn through all anomalies and catch upon Eclipse!

She cannot escape. Eclipse is a powerful ship, but Dawn moves faster! We must get her before she goes deep into the Astral!
You can sense a strange pulsation of energy...
Teleporting
You can sense a strange pulsation of energy...
Teleporting
Retreat!

name.en: How did Catherina succeed in imprisoning the Dragons?

text.en:
Now that is a good question. I am not sure that I know the truth, but I think someone really powerful helped her in that. Even a Great Mage has very little to set against a dragon.

I don't believe Catherina could become a traitor. She might behave like a teenager sometimes, but she's really smart. I have no idea what she might need the dragons for. My intuition tells me this all is going to be very, very bad...

I guess we're at the point of no return. Now it's all or nothing. We need to find out, what she's plotting. This all feels so wrong, I don't know what to do. Do you understand me?.. Don't let anything happen to you...

Prepare for the most unexpected things.

Landlubbers! How dare you set your foot on board of my darling Eclipse! I'm going to hang you all on the main royal yard and let my crew laugh at your squirms!

Do you think you are heroes? You sucked in some power and you're on it together with the heretics, so now you're obviously thinking you're capable of defeating our Queen's army? Har! She's foreseen this!

You know what technology is? It is an order. An absolute, total order. No mistakes made or forgiven. I will teach you this lesson...
Stop me? You wish!
Whew, we could hardly beat them. Now that we've defeated the captain, there's very little left to... hey, what's the noise? Look out!
That was pretty hard. I hope we can make up with Catherina in time!
Heil to you, heroes! What do you need?
Beware!
Beware!
Beware!
Good luck, friend.
Good luck, friend.
Good luck, friend.
Good luck, friend.
Good luck, friend.

So Catherina tricked two dragons into slavery! I heard rumors about that, but didn't quite believe them. Who could have known, that they would turn out to be true!

There is no time to find out how she managed to do that. Our enemy has got a powerful weapon in the hands. The world is in great danger.

Hold on to your arms, the battle will be hot...
Can't you just walk there?.. Oh, alright...
Can't you just walk there?.. Oh, alright...
Alive... Such a weird sensation...
Hurry up, we don't have much time.
Don't chat too much. We don't have time.

This is a curious story. Their sparks first met at Tep's Pyramid. Now they meet in person.

I guess you are the cause of this meeting. You have been able to make the Astral do, what you need. You needed allies, and they came to the rescue. Your will, plus Sarn's power, plus their own conscience - and there you go.

You don't have to worry about the consequences. As soon as you leave this place, they will disappear. Simple, like that.

I outsmarted myself. I studied Skrakan's archives in search for the source of power. He described a strange event in Gorluxor's Tower, when a strong demon appeared out of nowhere... Just imagine all the energy! Unbelievable magic and supreme technologies! I could bring the world back to peace, take it under full control and power...

Only it wasn't just another random demon. It was one of the first children of Sarn, his own Avatar, created during the times of June Curse. While I thought I was bringing him under my control, it was seizing my consciousness. This is why I happen to help the Leper spread...

The Leper is just another side of creation. This is life, made of the very same primal matter. The only difference is that it's able to corrupt other forms of life. Sarn has gone mad. His gift of the Creator now serves the evil and makes his wicked fantasies come true.

While my mind was under control, I was able to touch his consciousness, but never dared. I was scared by an ocean of madness and malice...
You're more stubborn than I'd thought.

It's unimaginable! Just one little shard of Sarn's soul, encased in the avatar he created himself - what a huge power it turned out to conceal! He could have done so much with this power, but he preferred his pathetic attempts to break free... You know, I think I nearly pity him. Hm, it's not typical for me.

This is the Seal. If you could only sense all the primal, natural magic here! It's under our feet, and all around us! If you could only understand, how tempting it is... but I do not dare touching it. I've learned my lesson. Nihaz, who created the Seals, was a way stronger and craftier than Sarn. Oh, even if the God of Light strived to conform to him, we can only guess, what the God of Darkness was apt to perform...

We'd better leave this place. It's not good for mortal beings.

I am going to return to Skytower and make it right. My allod is my prison now, just like the Seals are prison to Sarn. I'm not mad, though, and I'm not going to try and break my prison!

I will have to make peace between the pagans and the followers of the Light. I must admit, outcasts acted their best at this war... Besides, if it weren't for them, you would have never reached this place. Establishing peace won't be easy. I will have to engage all diplomacy I can, and at the same time, to make sure that neither Empire nor League have their fingers in my pie! My play is too artful to let them into it. The Leper - a common enemy - will unite us... and they don't need to know that it's so weak now, that it's no danger at all for neither of the sides.

What next? Only time can tell. This union might help Umoir prosper... As to you, you certainly deserve my gratitude. Thank you for showing me many unexpected things. Believe me, it's not so easy, given all my experience.

Go now. Leave me. I have to give it all a deep thought...

name.en: Keep the chase in the Astral

text.en: Ready!
Ready!
Way down leads to the treasury.
Well, well... What do we have here? Precious works of ancient elven art from the times before the Change? What a timely discovery - I'm feeling like destroying something beautiful!
Well... Good luck!
The one who doesn't risk... lives long enough to see their grandchildren.
The doors lead to the Castle Hall.
The doors open with a quiet squeak.
The gates open with a quiet squeak.
The heavy doors are elaborately carved.
The doors open with a quiet squeak.
The heavy gates are intricately carved.
Exiting
Entering
Entering
The gates lead to Winter Palace - the tycoon's residence, captured by Hoof's bandits and the followers of the mad prophet.
Entering.
Use the Portal to teleport to any port of the Castle.
Teleporting...
Teleporting...
Teleporting...
Teleporting...
Possible to return
Let's go back

Well, well... The doors are locked, and no sign of the Sculptor. It looks like the principal culprit decided to avoid meeting the eager audience. What a shame! I hoped to have a little chat with that otherworldly creature, but instead we will have to sort out all the mess that he'd left behind.

Ascension Hall? Yeah, right. If anyone can ascend in there, it's your pal Sculptor, who escaped the lab on Ferris and brought his friends to Sarnaut - thanks to you and the Surveyors!

You think the fanatics had been cutting people up and trying to make homunculus out of them for no reason? I heard something when I was pretending to be a helpless captive, and I didn't like it at all...

name.en: Ask what happens in the Ascension Hall

text.en:
I don't understand why the Sculptor had to complicate it all so much. Maybe he is incapable of believing himself, and had to use faith of others? Who knows...

Here, in the Ascension Hall, fanatics voluntarily sacrifice themselves and make sacrifices of their captives. They believe they can become "creatures of a higher order". Idiots! Their "deity", as well as their "religion" were invented by a crazy goblin - that's why they assembled this thing out of all sorts of trash they could lay their hands on. But the power of faith works miracles, and putting in enough effort can bring to life even a chair.

This is how fanatics' faith and sacrificial blood endowed a pile of old garbage with divine strength, and all the Sculptor had to do was to direct it. We need to put an end to this!

name.en: The door leads back to the stairs.

text.en: The door leads back to the stairs.
The doors open with a quiet squeak.
The heavy gates are intricately carved.

Behind these gates is what the fanatics call the Ascension Hall. Here the followers of the crazy Prophet created monstrous chimeras out of parts of Architects and humans. But what is the final purpose of the Sculptor who stands behind the fanatics? The answer is near - we just need to open the door...

What is waiting for you behind the door? Maybe, you should just open it a little first and take a quick glance inside? However, if the fanatics don't scare you, you can just kick it open and take your enemies by surprise.

name.en: Break into the Ascension Hall (difficult battle)

text.en: The door goes off its hinges with a rattle.

name.en: Cautiously sneak into the Ascension Hall (regular battle)

text.en: The doors open with a quiet squeak.
These doors lead to the castle treasury. Looks like Hoof decided to literally live on his gold!
Hoof will not surrender voluntarily - first you will have to beat him up!
The door goes off its hinges with a rattle.
The doors open with a quiet squeak.
The heavy doors are elaborately carved.
The doors open with a quiet squeak.
Are you ready to hear the Prophet's word of the New Order that will come after the Ascension?
Enter and listen, for a believer's word is an uncut diamond, and a wise man's word is a shining gem!
Enter and behold!
Enter and behold!
Let's do it!

I am the official representative of the Free Traders in Nezebgrad. According to my contract with the City Council, I have an exclusive right to buy up and resell valuables obtained in the Astral, Distortions, and Skirmishes.

You can become my regular customer, but with one condition. The great leader Yasker encourages all heroes to unite in the name of common cause. This is why the program of mutual help has been developed. Let me explain to you how it works. As we have learned from history, everybody chooses their own way to serve the Empire. Some control the monsters' population on allods, some eliminate the external threat in the Astral, some fight for the Empire in local conflicts with the League... and other enemies. All those heroes bring a part of their rewards to me and trade them for special coins, which, in their turn, can be traded for other valuables. That's a very useful initiative!
Let's do it!

The Free Traders have entrusted me with running their honorable business here. I redistribute trophies among fine heroes of the League. Yes, those rewards that you obtain in the Astral, Distortions, and Skirmishes.

I would gladly share all this with you, but you have to pay the price. The times are hard, so we should stand shoulder to shoulder and help each other so that everyone can get some great equipment and weapons. It's pretty simple - some clear allods of all sorts of monsters, some explore the depths of the Astral, some shed their blood in battles with the Empire... and other enemies. All those heroes bring a part of their loot to me to receive special coins for that, and use them to buy valuables obtained by other heroes. Everybody's happy! Isn't that great?

On behalf of the Free Traders, I salute you!

Let me remind you that the prices are flexible and change depending on the demand. Purchased goods are non-refundable!

The Free Traders welcome you!

Remember that the prices are flexible and change depending on the demand. Purchased goods are non-refundable!

Olé, olé, olé! Sarnaut is the best!

I wish we could play real football! Just imagine, you run up to the gates, kick the ball, the stadium roars... You scored a goal! Oh, it's such a pity Sarnaut doesn't have its own football team. I bet we would've won all cups!

Do you want to take a look at football uniforms? See, they're from different countries! It's very good for goblinball, too. Try it!
Best goods of Sarnaut!

The time of Arg comes when the sun is so scorching that you hardly step outside! It is a time when nothing compares to the beauty of the smooth surface of the deep lakes, glittering like silver in the sunlight! The magical moon shines brightly, like a silver coin against the night sky. On this day, those born under the sign of Arg will be blessed by their Patron!
Trade!
Make your choice!

The time of Patron Ferr comes in late autumn, on the brink of winter, when the first lattice of ice appears on the puddles and icy winds nip at our summer-soft cheeks. And his patronage is granted only to those of a stout, hardened body and an unbending will... Those who are as durable as iron!

When the raging cold starts giving in to the reviving nature, it marks the time of Patron Xos. As bright sunrays reflect off the melting icicles, the flames of life begins to stir and awaken in the hearts of those favored by Xos' patronage. For Xos will only bestow his blessings upon those who are as ardent as phosphorus!

The gloomiest time of the year belongs to Patron Irsen. They say that the caustic and irritable old man Irsen would accept no weather but heavy clouds overhead, a piercing chill and lifeless trees. The old Great Martyr laughs at those who run for shelter at the first sounds of falling rain. And his patronage is granted only to the clever, quick to reply to weaklings' whining about the foul weather with a wry joke. This is the time of those born under the sign of Irsen, those who are as caustic as arsenic!

These grim days are the time of Patron Caprey. The dull sun is like a copper coin that gives less and less warmth with each passing day... The children of piercing cold and lashing winds will never break under the blows of fate. They are flexible like copper! They are those lucky ones the great Martyr Caprey offers his favor to.

Once a year Novograd and Nezebgrad celebrate the day of the Bard. The festival fills the cities with crowds of people in bright costumes and colorful masks parading along the streets. They are celebrating all night long, and the sounds of laughter and merry songs echo around the streets and squares till the first rays of dawn.

People say that even the Patrons take a rest from their labors on this day. They come down to the city to watch the parade and enjoy the beautiful music. The celebrations do not end the morning after the parade. People enjoy an extra few days of holiday afterward. Every bard, every minstrel, every troubadour, even a boy with a simple flute can obtain holiday gifts from me!
Sing and dance, dance and sing!

No one has learned the secrets of Nature as deeply as Wardens. They command the powers of wind and water, earth and fire. They speak the languages of thousands of creatures, and animals eat from their hands. The Warden's way is the way of balance. It is tough but honorable. The ones who live in harmony with the Nature will be glorified!
At this time of year, Wardens celebrate their holiday and praise the Nature. I am glad to offer you special wares to commemorate this holiday!
Are you looking for something?

Look around. Can you see all these engineers with their crafty devices? Do you know why they are here? It's their professional holiday, the day of Motorcade. They share their inventions, demonstrate blueprints to one another and develop new curious machines together. Don't miss the fun!

If you are also fascinated by the machinery, why don't you take a look at my souvenirs?
I have only the best goods!

Every Great Mage has a treasure they guard the most - a book to write down the most powerful and dangerous spells. Mages keep such records throughout their entire lives, which tend to last quite a long time. Every year the book gets thicker. Spellcasters decorate their books with steel fasteners, seals and images of horrid demons. Protective spells cast on such a book can animate the demon, which spells a world of trouble for any petty thief!
Ordinarily such books never leave the spellcaster's treasury. And there are only a few days in the year when magicians bring out their battered heavy volumes, wipe the dust from the covers, and get down to work recalling old spells, recording new ones, and meeting other magicians to exchange their knowledge. Mages call this day Librarium and consider it a professional holiday. During Librarium I can offer mages unique magic souvenirs!
I have only the best goods!

According to legends, once a year, the deadmen rise from their graves to start their terrifying Dance of Death. Woe to the traveler who got pulled into their ring! That unfortunate wretch would dance until he falls dead, just to rise from the grave the next spring and dance again from dusk till dawn, clattering his bones and scaring the mortals.
This legend is known for hundreds of years, but I have yet to meet someone who saw the dancing undead with their own eyes. Summoners call the Dance of Death their holiday, and I offer them special wares during the celebration.
New loot from the graves! Just kidding, don't worry!

The Intercession is a special day. On this day we praise the Light for everything it has blessed us with: the eternal life and the Holy magic. The Church of Light and the Trinity Church are disputing who we should thank in particular: whether it's Tensess, Nezeb or Skrakan. Let us forget the arguments for a while and laud the Light and its gifts! As far as the Healers are concerned, we have got the sacred garments and relics for them!
Happy Intercession day! Let the Light bestow its blessings upon thee!

Have you looked at the stars on a warm summer night? How beautiful they are! A glittering threads of diamonds on black velvet... Exquisite lace of constellations... I can't find the words to describe my excitement!
But the most beautiful time is Star Shower! For a few summer nights the sky is crossed with shooting stars. Young and old alike are making wishes which will come true for sure. These nights Psionicists draw up the most accurate horoscopes and make the clearest predictions!
I'm offering special goods to every Psionicist who visits me during the Star Shower celebration!
Hope for the best!

name.en: Ask about the Day of Wrath

text.en:
At the dawn of its existence, the Church did not intervene in human affairs. Both the priests of the Church of Light and the clergy of the Trinity Church would preach, bless, heal, perform burial rites and spread faith in the Power of Light. No-no, the Church never forced anyone to accept faith in the Light - true faith can only be accepted with an open heart, not by coercion! Still, there were those who stood in the Church's way.
Heretics, renegades and other kinds of vicious savages not only denied faith in Light, they also attacked priests, plundered churches, destroyed chapels... It was then that the clerics summoned the Wrath of retribution upon the heads of the wicked! There were some priests who took off their robes, vowing to protect their faith through force, and took the fight to the enemies of the Light! Those valiant souls became the first Paladins, loyal servants and fearless defenders of the Church, wielding the power granted by the Light.
I have only the best goods!

No, you don't have to be afraid! The Demonologists are our allies like the Healers and Paladins. They just follow their own, special path! And today is their Pandemonium holiday. Today, all followers of this dark path are celebrating a great event - about a hundred years ago, a group of mages decided to unlock the secrets of astral creatures, wanting to protect the other inhabitants of Sarnaut from their deadly onslaught. And today, all Demonologists are eager to demonstrate their skills.
Starting on day 6 of the holiday, you can repeat daily quests for 1 Anniversary Platinum Coin.

name.en: Spend 1 Anniversary Platinum Coin and complete all daily quests again!

text.en: Done! You can do all daily quests of the holiday again!
Pandemonium Goods

Everybody has their own destiny... Some are destined to make scientific discoveries, others - to create artistic masterpieces, bake bread or raise children. But there are also those whose life consists of short breaks between bloody battles. Those whose lot it is to fight constantly from birth to death. These are called warriors, and there is nobody in the world who could compete with them in honest one-on-one combat!
The art of war does not tolerate laziness or weakness. A true warrior is always ready to repel the enemy, and only during the Swordring can a warrior throw off their armor, put down their sword and drink ale in the company of like-minded veterans, chatting about past deeds and testing their strength and combat skill against other warriors, for their own enjoyment and that of the audience. And warriors that call in to the Holiday Commitee Officials during the Swordring can acquire special festive goods.
Take a rest from battle, feast and make merry! With Swordring!

Look alive, my hearties! Today marks the anniversary of the birth of a person without whom there would be no League! It is he that we Kanians, Elves, and Gibberlings should thank for the peaceful, prosperous existence we enjoy now. His wisdom, dedication, and compassion have made the League into a great power, capable of squelching any aggression. If not for his astute sense and sharp wit, who knows what havoc the demons' invasion would have wrought on Sarnaut?
So it is with all our heart that we congratulate our Great Mage Aidenus, and we wish him... well, each of us can tell him our wishes individually. As for me, I wish him the strength to maintain his dedication, his purposeful and passionate quest to help the people!
Come see me for birthday souvenirs and gifts, if you're so inclined.
Do not forget to congratulate Aidenus!

name.en: Ask about the Day of Fun

text.en: You can buy a permanent Lobster for 12 Platinum coins or trade it for a temporary Lobster and 2 coins. You can exchange your temporary Lobster through the Stable.

name.en: Exchange temporary Lobster for permanent Lobster and pay 2 coins

text.en: Congratulations on your new Lobster!

name.en: Buy a permanent Lobster for 12 Platinum coins

text.en: Congratulations on your new Lobster!
My goods are magnificent!

Citizens of the Empire! Today we celebrate the birthday of a person without whom there would be no Empire! The great leader, who led the Empire to prosperity and united under his rule the proud Xadaganians, the powerful Orcs, and the Arisen, to create a great nation! A person who personally fought against the demons during the Night of Astral Portals, and emerged victorious!
So we congratulate our constant leader, the Great Yasker with all our hearts, and wish him eternal health!
And you, if you like, can acquire some souvenirs of the holiday and some gifts from me.
Don't forget to congratulate Yasker! You'll see, he'll be happy!

Hyrd's time is the hot and sunlit days, when you can sunbathe on the beach, enjoy swimming and take part in competitions of quickness and dexterity! This is the time of those who are as swift as mercury!

Those born under the sign of Lex are as sharp as silicon!
Lex's time is the blooming hour of nature. Crops appears in the fields, and even the bookworms divert their attention from dusty volumes to the beauty of the outdoors!

Those who were born under the sign of Rokoit are as strong as chromium!
Rokoit celebration takes place at the turning point, when nature shakes off the snow, emerging from its dormancy, and starts blossoming in the gentle sunrays. On these days, those born under the sign of Rokoit will be blessed by their Patron!
Choose whatever you like!

Those who were born under the sign of Ulf are as passionate as sulfur!
The revival of nature marks Ulf's time, when trees are blossoming, the sun is shining, and hearts beat faster! Ulf is gracious to those who are hot-tempered and passionate.

Born from the struggle between chaos and order, the Aoidoi became a true sensation for the other people of Sarnaut. This majestic and wise civilization was granted a source of power comparable to the power of the gods themselves! The origin of the Aoidoi is rather unique: the Aoidoi are children of two gods, creatures created by a cosmic catastrophe that put an end to a long confrontation. Now they celebrate the day when Polis, their first city, was founded. The festival itself was organized by Dominus Dionysius and named in his honor.
Starting on day 6 of the holiday, you can repeat daily quests for 1 Anniversary Platinum Coin.

name.en: Spend 1 Anniversary Platinum Coin and complete all daily quests again!

text.en: Done! You can do all daily quests of the holiday again!

name.en: Unlock the ability to become an organizer for the Dionysia

text.en: You are now a participant of the Dionysia! Celebrate this event heartily!
Dionysia Goods

name.en: Ask about the Hour of the Awakening

text.en:
Hour of the Awakening... According to legends, this is when the first of the reborn Elves opened his eyes and saw the new world. The snow was melting, springs were prattling, and buds started to swell. Nature was waking up after long winter sleep!
Elves spend the whole week in delight and silent contemplation. Even the Great Game is paused for the time of celebration!
Every elf who visits me during this holiday will be offered special wares at a huge discount!
My goods are magnificent!

Gibberlings are eager for adventures. They love travels, discovering new lands and creatures.
At this time of year the most famous Gibberling adventurers gather to celebrate their achievements. They boast of the artifacts they found and tell stories of their adventures.
Every Gibberling who visits me during this festival will be able to buy rare goods from distant lands.
I've got the best goods for adventurers!

Ugra-Xada is a very old word... Not many Xadaganians remember why their favorite holiday is called so.
Thousands years ago, before our world was shattered, the Great Nezeb left Kania, a state that was immersed in sin and vice. He met proud and honest nomadic tribe in the southern steppes. These skilled horsemen and fearless warriors called themselves the people of Ugra. They believed they were descendants of an ancient god Ugra. When Nezeb defeated their leader in an honest fight, nomads believed that he was god. The great Xadaganian state was born that day.
I'm offering special holiday items to Xadaganians during the celebration.
Remember the history of your state and be proud of it!

Unity Day is the greatest day in Kanian history.
Long ago, before our world was torn to pieces, the great nation of Junes died. New tribes emerged from the ruins of the ancient civilization. They called themselves "Aro", which is translated as "humans". Their tiny dominions soon became engaged into petty squabbles. They were losing their best warriors in endless conflicts, until orcs invaded to their lands. Single tribes could not withstand them...
One day, when earth was red with blood and the sky was covered with smoke from burning villages, leaders of the remaining tribes managed to set their discords aside and swore eternal friendship to each other. United army of Aro defeated the Orcs and kicked them back to wilderness. The Orcs still remember this defeat...
Once a desperate measure, this union grew into a true friendship. Eventually the tribes welded into one strong nation, the great Kania.
Let everyone raise a toast today to the glory of our nation! I offer special festive goods to every Kanian who visits me.

Sabantuy is a traditional orcish holiday. In the olden times, when the orcs were wild and led a nomadic life in the vast steppes, only once a year all the orcish tribes would gather for a celebration. Mighty fighters would compete in crushing rocks with their bare hands, drinking up barrels of beer on a wager, and hammering each other on the head until only the toughest orc with the strongest forehead would remain on his feet. The winner would earn a war club as a reward, as well as the respect of the tribe. A lot has changed since. The orcs have become esteemed citizens of the Empire, but the tradition of celebrating Sabantuy remains.
When the holiday rolls around, the orcs still drink beer by the bucket, hammer each other on the head with ritual clubs, make lots of noise and fun, and, of course, play their favorite game, goblinball. Besides, any orc that visits an artisan during the celebration can become a lucky owner of valuable gifts and souvenirs.

Today is the Great Feast! Ah, I wish I could see Howlem now. You Pridens celebrate as passionately as you fight!

I have traditional Priden costumes in my assortment - so beautiful and warm! - and also some hunter's horns.

Have a nice holiday!
My goods are perfection incarnate!

name.en: Ask about the Opening of the Eyes

text.en: Opening of the Eyes and Lips was a burying ritual among the ancient Zem when the deceased person was symbolically reborn for the afterlife. The ritual gave the name to the day when the Arisen celebrate their return to life. Don't expect to hear the thunder of salutes and drunken shouting: the Arisen don't like wild celebrations much. Meditations, reflections and discussions about science and future of mankind are more to their liking. On that day, however, even they can't help but pamper themselves with wonderful holiday souvenirs!
My goods are perfection incarnate!

See that rainbow in the sky? One may ask, how come there's a rainbow without rain? The answer is simple: alchemists are celebrating their professional holiday!
Dozens of alchemical labs work day and night, producing potions and brews, and alchemists dust off their tractates and start their quest for the philosopher's stone with renewed vigor! The caustic multicolored smoke raises into the sky, entwining into a beautiful rainbow.
We congratulate all alchemists on Rainbow Holiday!
I have special goods for alchemists today!

Hear the ringing everywhere? That's not bells. That's our merry blacksmiths. They hauled their anvils onto the street and are hammering the hell out of them for everyone to know: today is their holiday, Hammerstrike Day!

Since ancient times, blacksmiths were respected and feared, they were almost considered sorcerers. And for good reason: unlike tailors or carpenters, they work in flames and smoke, sparks flying, hammers clashing deafeningly. Skilled hands turn a piece of metal into a strong set of armor or delicate lace. I ask you: if that's not magic, what is?

Today, we honor the blacksmiths. Do you belong to their trade, by the way? If so, I'll be happy to exchange your anniversary coins for holiday souvenirs!
Congratulations, merry blacksmith! Now, what item is to your liking?

Needle Eye is a professional holiday of tailors.
What a wonderful holiday it is! Tailors demonstrate their best masterpieces to their colleagues and passers-by, they hang beautiful tapestries outside of their shops, boasting about rich patterns and durable weaving. During the holiday you can buy fine boots, luxurious coats and embroidered cloaks at huge discounts - there is a long-time tradition to keep prices low on the Needle Eye Day.
Tailors who visit me during the holiday will be able to buy special items.
Best goods from the best tailors!

A long-long time ago, at the dawn of times, our ancestors' own skin was their only clothes. After a while it occurred to them that whipping a hide from someone furry would be a nice idea. This is how the craft of tanning was born. Today is tanners' professional holiday. Our greetings and souvenirs to all those who scrape, tan, lime, scour, mill, shape, dye and sew!
Best souvenirs for best crafters!

This is a special day. Though it is dedicated to all those who craft deadly weapons, today we celebrate peace, which our sharp swords and martial prowess enable us to preserve. Weaponcrafters of the capital have a day off their honorable duty and demonstrate their astonishing blades and shining armor! Teenagers wrestle jokingly in the streets - and to tell you the truth, so do the grown-ups! If you are a weapon maker, you can buy memorable souvenirs from me during the event.
Congratulations, merry weaponsmith! Now, which item is to your liking?

Many ages ago, before the League and the Empire existed and the world was still whole, experienced hunters and their apprentices would head deep into the woods for one week to face challenging trials. Sneak up to an elk, catch a cautious hare with a sophisticated snare, find a hiding place on a plain... The hunters staged plenty of tests for their apprentices! After this week of trials, which they dubbed the Silent Days, the apprentice became a full-fledged hunter.
The world has changed, but the tradition remains. To this day the Scouts test their rookies, checking their dexterity, observation, archery and stealth. It has been tradition on the Silent Days to congratulate those who have become Scouts and remember those who once were one...
Take your pick. Today I've got special items for all Scouts!
Remember your history and take pride in it, citizen!

If you want to say something important to everyone, the Megaphone is perfect for that. But don't overdo it. Each subsequent purchased Megaphones will cost a little more. However, at the beginning of the next game week, the price of the Megaphone will return to its normal level Let me know if you want to buy a Megaphone. If you have enough money, I will sell it to you.
Sorry, you don't have enough money.

Biting frost, blizzard and chilling colds - that's what awaits those born under the sign of Plam. Those who survive the hardships of this time of the year are transformed into stern, tough and reliable protectors of Sarnaut and develop a heavy temper. As heavy as lead!

At the turn of the year, when the earth is covered with a thick blanket of snow, comes the time of Patron Stagan. A sole mistress over the land, the winter shows no mercy to the weak and stupid. Of those born in winter, only the most durable survive to see spring. Those lucky souls are favored by Patron Stagan's blessing, for they are as durable as tin!

The golden halo of the sun hovers in the midday sky... Golden rye sprouts up in the fields... Gold and laces distinguish those favored by Patron Uar's blessing! The hottest days in the midsummer are the time of Uar, the time of those as spiteful as gold!
I can tell you about the League holidays. If you visit me during a celebration that applies to you, I will sell you special holiday items.
Hello! If you want to learn about Imperial holidays, I'll be glad to tell you! If you visit me during a celebration that applies to you, I will sell you special holiday items.

A Prophetic Card is a valuable item. If you are lucky enough, it will reward you generously.
But the card itself will not reveal its secrets. In order to decipher it and receive your prize, you should buy an Ancient Compass from the Boutique. You may also choose to delve deeper into the secrets of the card by spending more Compasses and receive additional rewards. Your chance of winning a top prize increases with each attempt.
Roll up, roll up!
Your future is obscure, and even the Ancient Compass cannot guide you. This is not a good moment to play with fate. I will highlight the time when you can use the Prophetic Card in your calendar.

Oh! A Prophetic Card is a rare and valuable item.

If you are lucky enough, even one card might reward you generously. Why, of course! You can't toy with destiny!

It's not that simple, though. The card will not reveal its secrets by itself. In order to decipher it and receive your prize, you should buy an Ancient Compass from the Boutique. You may also choose to delve deeper into the secrets of the card by spending more Compasses and receive additional rewards.

Your chance of winning the grand prize increases with each attempt. Go for it, and may the odds be ever in your favor.
Roll up, roll up!

Hm... Your future is obscure, and even the Ancient Compass cannot help you. This is not a good moment to toy with fate.

I will highlight the time when you can use the Prophetic Card in your calendar.

A Prophetic Card is a valuable item. If you are lucky enough, it will reward you generously.
But the card itself will not reveal its secrets. In order to decipher it and receive your prize, you should buy an Ancient Compass from the Boutique. You may also choose to delve deeper into the secrets of the card by spending more Compasses and receive additional rewards. Your chance of winning a top prize increases with each attempt.
Roll up, roll up!
Your future is obscure, and even the Ancient Compass cannot guide you. This is not a good moment to play with fate. I will highlight the time when you can use the Prophetic Card in your calendar.
T92 Arty's job is to damage Maus. But first, Maus must be highlighted by one of the T50-2 Fireflies. Use the Aim ability to increase the accuracy of your shots. Camouflage ability helps avoid danger.
Tanks are combat vehicles developed by our engineers in the secret military labs. Choose the one you prefer and go ahead!
Go!
Go!

name.en: Jump into the tank and complete the tutorial

text.en:
Should you need help in combat, I will aid you using the communication device.
Choose your tank and join the battle!
Go!
Go!
Go!
Go!
Go!
Go!
IS-7 Heavy is slow and sturdy tank used to disable Maus. Aim to its vulnerable spots - turret, sights or tracks, and shoot!
My team of engineers created this mechanical monster, but now I pray that you will stop it!
I can trade your medals for useful rewards.
Make your choice!
T50-2 Firefly is light and fast, but once it started moving it may not stop, otherwise the heat will blow out the engine. T50-2 mission is to highlight Maus, enabling T92 Arty to shoot.
T14 Polite is a universal tank which can easily take down Stumps and GiWis and even breach Maus' armor with a piercing shot. Polite's active shield protects it from Maus's direct fire.

It is sad that things turned that way. We never intended to use Maus in combat; it was supposed to be a weapon of deterrence... And now our creation has rised against us! Some insane goblin is grinding the allod to dust in the name of "revolution"!
Luckily, we have other combat vehicles at our disposal. They are weaker than Maus in one-on-one combat, but smart teamwork will help you succeed.
There are coffers with construction materials and precious metals spread across the Summerhold. As you know, goblins are crazy about shiny baubles, so Maus' driver will attempt to destroy the coffers and collect the resources. You must defeat Maus before all coffers are gone!

T92 Arty can shoot from a huge distance and inflict incredible damage, but it is as accurate as a drunk gibberling. The good thing is, if T50-2 Firefly highlights the target for Arty, it will increase the accuracy greatly. Note that if Arty misses, the ground is engulfed in flame which damages allied tanks.
Weapon of mass destruction.

Experimental engine of this tank is boosted and requires constant flow of air from movement to cool down. Firefly is the only tank that can highlight Maus to increase the accuracy of other tank shots. Firefly has no armor and can be destroyed with a single shot. Wrecked, it leaves a patch of burning fuel which damages the allied tanks!

The latest product of Nezeb Cart Factory! A universal vehicle which can fire swiftly and precisely, and its armor-piercing shells can even make a hole in Maus' skin.

It also has an active shield. It is useless against GiWi and Stumps, but it can save you from direct Maus' shots.

This tank is strong enough to disable Maus temporarily: a precise shot to a track pins Maus down, damaging the sights prevents the steel monster from shooting, and hitting the turret surely draws the attention of Maus' driver! But remember that due to slow speed, IS-7 is vulnerable in the open.
Type 59 ST is a well-rounded tank designed for mass production, fast and strong enough to break through the Maus' armor.
Type 59 ST is a support tank whose main task is hunting down Maus' minions - Type 704 Stump and GiWi Type E. Only ST is capable of breaking through their defenses.

Greetings!
Not so long ago, a breakthrough discovery has opened up a pathway to a distant, unexplored Astral. This Astral lacks the familiar allods, shows no reflections of heroic adventures, and there are no clear routes of travel.
Instead it is full of bizarre phenomena, anomalies, and strange creatures that have never been encountered in the nearer layers of the Astral. Who knows what kind of danger lurks there? Demon Hunters consider it their duty to destroy any threat that might be hiding there, and they will use everything at their disposal in the pursuit of this goal.
During your travels in this distant Astral, you might meet powerful demons. Having defeated a demon, you'll be able to use an astral trap to capture its body's astral essence. You will also find unstable anomalies, either just-forming or in the process of disintegrating, and these can be captured as well.

Bring me any anomalous emanations you've collected in the far Astral and you will be able to trade them for rare items or special equipment. For each 100 killed demons you will receive a Treasure Chest, which I can exchange for Transforming Crystals or components for crafting Glyphs.

Artillery is a stationary weapon located at ship's bow. It deals huge damage if used properly. After activation, it inflicts more and more damage over time, but also consumes more energy and may cause overheating.

In ship-to-ship combat, artillery is most effective against shields, and least effective against hull. Artillery always inflicts huge damage to astral creatures.

Regular artillery is well-balanced and inflicts medium damage at a little risk of overheating.

Large Artillery is a long-range model. It consumes more energy and inflicts about the same amount of damage, but its range is higher.

Compact Artillery is a short-range model which inflicts a lot of damage on a short distance at low energy cost.

Pulsating Artillery is a shield-piercing weapon. It inflicts huge damage to shields, but its energy consumption increases rapidly. They are not effective in long-lasting battles or against hulls.

Focused Artillery is a "drill" for enemy devices. It inflicts low damage at first and is ineffective against hull, but the damage grows rapidly, slightly overheating the reactor. Focused Artillery quickly destroys ship equipment, rendering it helpless.

Advanced Artillery is a heavy-weight model that inflicts more damage and consume more energy than the regular one.

Charged Artillery consumes a lot of energy, but inflict the highest amount of damage across non-specialized models.

Cannons represent main ship armament. Up to 16 cannons can be installed on a ship, 8 on a lower deck and 8 on an upper deck. When choosing a cannon, several parameters should be considered:

Damage dealt by a cannon is directly proportional to the energy it uses, but if the energy consumption is too high, the damage will increase slowly.

Rapid-firing cannons are very efficient and deal significant damage over time, however, heavy-caliber cannons deal more damage per salvo.

Depending on a model, cannons deal Fire, Astral, Lightning or Acid damage. Astral demons always receive full damage, but enemy ships do not.

Fire damage is equally efficient against shields, hulls, and devices. It has no special features.

Astral damage is very effective against shields, but useless against hull.

Acid damage has low efficiency against shields, but it destroys hulls quickly and is deadly to enemy crew.

Lightning damage does not affect hulls and has normal efficiency against shields, but it disables enemy devices rapidly. Also, each successful hit reduces movement speed of the target.

Keep in mind that there are cannons that inflict damage in a 120 yard radius. They are very effective against groups of weaker demons, but such shots consume a lot of energy.

A fully equipped ship has the following devices installed: reactor, motor, helm, turbine, visor, scanner, six shields, two artilleries and 16 cannons. Devices are maintained by three Goblin Repairmen. I will tell you about the devices in detail. But for now, here's the basics.

Each device class has several types. For example, there are long-ranged cannons and rapid-firing cannons. Each type is most efficient for a specific purpose.

Device performance depends on its rarity and generation (I, II, III etc.). Within each generation there are devices of standard (most common), rare (improved), and epic (highly efficient and very difficult to obtain) quality. Newer generations represent a significant boost in efficiency. For instance, a standard second generation device is similar to epic equipment of the first generation.
Equipping a ship is a challenge in itself. Durability, speed and combat characteristics of your ship depend on your choices. Let's start from the beginning.

Motor is the source of moving power. Its main stats are speed, acceleration, and weight load. If your ship is overloaded, its speed decreases.

Regular motors maintain decent speed and consume energy at a standard rate. They do not have any special advantages.

Bolstered Motors are slower, but they allow carrying heavy weights and consume less energy.

Stream-Lined Motors are fast, but they consume more energy and support only a standard weight load. If you installed one, make sure not to overload your reactor.

High-Speed Motors have increased energy consumption rate. They can carry heavy weight at a medium speed and provide the best acceleration.

Reinforced Motors can boast of top speed, acceleration, and load weight at the same time, but they also have the highest energy consumption rate. When moving at full speed, your reactor may become overheated.

Swift Motors have top speed, acceleration, and load weight, and their energy consumption rate is standard, but they cannot carry heavy weights, so better use them at lighter ships.

Turbine allows you to change your ship's altitude through a series of propulsions varying in strength and duration. Stronger impulses make you ship move faster. Such maneuvering allows to evade attacks of enemy ships or escape Astral demons.

Regular Turbines maintain medium strength and duration of impulses.

Reinforced Turbines have greater strength and duration of impulses.

Stream-Lined Turbines have maximum impulse strength, but its duration is standard. It allows you to quickly move your ship upwards or downwards, but within a small range.

Bolstered Turbines have maximum impulse duration which allows you to change altitude within greater range.

Goblins can fix equipment damaged in a fight or in an accident. Goblins vary in action radius and repair duration. The longer a goblin works, the more damage will be repaired.

Goblin Tinkerer can repair equipment located far away, but only works for a short period of time. Use it to repair several slightly damaged devices.

Goblin Mechanic repairs equipment located in a medium range and works for a standard period of time.

Goblin Repairman fixes equipment in a small range (only 1 or 2 nearest pieces), but for a longer period of time. It can repair a completely disabled device and keep it operational under enemy fire.

Visor is a device used for maneuvering and navigation within an Astral region. Not only Visor keeps you informed on a course of travel and combat, but also has various special functions.

Visors are not divided into types, instead each model is given a unique set of functions. For example, let's have a look at advanced Visors:

Pirate's Cooling and Balancing Visor is useful in fights against large packs of Astral monsters, as well as in regular exploration. However, it does not have Sharp Turn and Energy Discharge functions.

Pirate's Cooling and Reversal Visor is less convenient for traveling because of a missing Shield Boost option, but its Sharp Turn ability is helpful in combat against other ships or single demons.

Cooling, Balancing, and Reversal Visor has a greater variety of functions ensuring its effectiveness in fights against single demons or packs. However, it does not have Diversionary Shot and Local Jump abilities useful for rapid movement.

Pirate's Balancing and Reversal Visor is effective in longer fights against single targets, where the absence of Intense Cooling and Energy Discharge abilities is not crucial.

The reactor is the heart of a ship. It supplies all equipment with energy. If the reactor is disabled, the ship cannot move, attack or defend itself.

The reactor channels energy from surrounding Astral to ship equipment. High load may overheat it, causing energy bursts and shutdowns.

Important stats of a reactor are maximum load, which shows how much heat it is guaranteed to stand, and cooling capacity, which indicates how much heat is dissipated per second.

A regular reactor has standard consumption rate, a good balance of durability, load and cooling rate.

"Pulse" Reactor has higher cooling rate, but its maximum load is lower, so energy bursts are not uncommon. It can easily deal with medium energy consumption, but higher loads may cause overheating and malfunctioning.

"Athlete" Reactor has high maximum load, but its cooling rate is rather low, which may cause shutdowns. It can manage extreme peak loads, but they should not be too frequent.

"The Kid" Reactor has low maximum load but its safety levels and cooling rate are very high. It can be used even when overheated.

"Cauldron" Reactor boasts of high load and good cooling rate, but it is not very safe. Operate it with care.

"Candle" Reactor has the lowest maximum load and the best cooling rate. In addition, it is fully protected from mana bursts when overheated.

"Star" Reactor has the best maximum load but low cooling rate. It never becomes disabled, which means that your ship will be provided with energy at any circumstances. It is useful for huge one-time consumption.

Helms are used to steer the ship, they are important both in combat and travels. They vary in turning speed and energy consumption. You have to decide for yourself if you want to increase maneuverability in exchange for energy payload.

Regular Helm has well-balanced stats.

Large Helm provides maximum maneuverability, but its energy consumption rate is also the highest.

Reinforced Helm provides increased maneuverability at a reasonable energy cost.

Small Helms are the slowest, and their energy consumption is extremely low.

Scanner is used to find various objects in the Astral, such as isles, wormholes, enemy ships and demons. It also plots a route to destination points, and in case of an emergency scanner can hide your ship from the most demons. All scanner operations consume Astral Emanations. There are scanners optimized for different tasks, their consumption rates vary depending on the model.

 "Watchman" Scanners are useful for traveling to Astral isles. They consume less emanations when searching for isles and routing to them.

"Sentry" Scanners are best used in combat - they consume less emanations when searching for enemies and rendering the ship invisible to demons.

"The Eye" scanners are useful for traveling between regions. They have lowered cost of searching for isles and wormholes.

Astral shields grants your ship protection from enemy attacks by absorbing incoming damage. If a shield is disabled, demonic attacks or gun shots may reach ship's hull and devices.

Shields must be switched off manually to recharge. After switching off, the shield consumes a certain amount of energy, and gradually restores to full.

The most important stat of a shield is Strength, which indicates how much damage it can endure before becoming disabled. Charge, Recovery Rate and Energy Consumption are no less important - they show how often recharging can be performed, how long it takes and how much energy it consumes.

Standard Astral Shields have balanced durability, recharge time and energy consumption.

Massive and Glittering Astral Shields have increased strength and better recharge time, but they consume a lot of energy. Make sure not to overheat your reactor, otherwise you will lose the ability to fire or recharge shields.

Pulsating and Shining Astral Shields are the strongest, they require little energy, but recharge slowly and less frequently. They can be used to absorb a high amount of damage at once, and then spend the remaining energy to kill the enemies quickly.

Resilient, Shimmering and Sparkling Shields are the least powerful but fast-recharging and economical. They are useful for absorbing steady sustainable damage, but you will have to recharge them frequently.

Embossed Astral Shields provide good protection and recharge rate at low energy consumption. They are a perfect match for powerful weaponry.

name.en: Ask about the dangers lurking in the Astral

text.en:
It's not the Astral itself that's dangerous, but rather the high probability of encountering demons or pirates eager to appropriate your ship's cargo. So if you don't want to get one in the stern or take a trip to the purgatory, listen to me very carefully.
The safest place to be for you is always the capital's allod. There you are protected by astral howitzers, which are state-of-the-art technology! Those guns can blow any enemy ship to bits with a single salvo.
The rest of the sector where your capital's allod is located is relatively safe, too. In fact, the home sector is a good reference point for the ship's navigation system. Upon sustaining critical damage, the ship will simply jump to the hangar without sustaining any losses. However, nobody is safe from boarding, the pirates' favorite tactics...
By the way, in any other sector the emergency jump will be done blindly when the ship faces a lethal threat. All cargo will be dropped into the Astral and the hull will sustain severe damage. However, the chests can be loaded back on board if you return to the site of battle... That is, if the pirates don't get there first.
And remember, no emergency jump is going to save you if the ship's reactor explodes or if you get too deep into an unstable zone, as the ship will simply blow up.
 And if for some strange reason you happen to find yourself in the Kanian Archipelagos, the League capital's allod, you can forget about emergency jumps altogether - a battle lost in a sector adjacent to the enemy allod will result in the ship's death. Remember, we're not the only ones with howitzers installed on our coast - the enemy has got them, too!

Remember, a jump may be interrupted by an incoming attack!

Welcome to the Astral hangar! What can we help you with?

Damaged ships should be repaired after returning to the hangar. I can help you with this process, but you will need to bring me the proper materials before it can begin.
The repair process can take some time. The duration depends on the extent of the damage. However, the repair process can be accelerated by completing special tasks. You can check on the progress that's been made by talking to me at any time! I'll be happy to keep you updated.
The repair process ends automatically if you depart to the Astral. And if the ship has been repaired to full, you can simply summon it and proceed with your travels.
