text.en: Alright!
Guests in my nest? Quite peculiar... What made you spend valuable Spark talents on my questionable hospitality?
Welcome! I'm Nickolas Booksy. Who are you? Oh, it doesn't really matter. We need your help, whoever you are.
It goes like this...
The frog stares at you sadly. You recall tales of spellbound princesses... Why don't you try and kiss her?
Beasts! Locking a friend in a cage! This is unbelievable. I, oh I mean, you are going to avenge me!

Robbery and assault! We goblins are peaceful, just digging here for ore... Since orcs and Xadaganians left this place, saying the mine is empty, but there's plenty of gold ore left. It's enough for us, in any case.

Goblins are quite laborious, so we scrupulously separated the remaining gold from dust, and carefully put the gold in crates. But there was a scum among us, Ghim the Greedy is his name. He gathered a ganged and broke into the mine riding guess what? I bet you can never guess! He was riding a huge cave troll!

So, he got into the depth of the mine and triggered a few stone jams, you know, to block out the chasers. Smart scum, eh? Like all goblins are!

But nevermind the stone jams. We've got a couple of bombers here, Dub and Step, they're going to help you clear them up. Dub's been around here, while Step went to search the caves, so you'll have to find him. Help us. We goblins can be grateful, you know.

Thank goodness, you're here, mighty and fearless warriors. Our forest suffers great misfortune, a plague making all the animals mad! For the sake of a delicate summer wind and a health-giving brook, I adjure you, please, please help us! Kill the mad beasts and let the happy times return!

Look at it! Someone must be tired of all the killing and decided to join a simple lumberjack? To what do I owe this honor? Ah... You’re looking at the tobacco. Yes, it’s an unusual one. Can you feel the smell? That’s right! Strawberry! Tobacco smelling as real strawberry, can you believe that? I bought it from the Imperial traders. To add strawberry to tobacco... What a cruel thing to do! What will be next? Anyway, do you want to fish with me? I’m kind of bored here on my own. Do you want to try the tobacco, too? Alright, but first you must roll up your pants.
You came here to hear my new single?
Get ready!
Whew... I hadn't hoped to stay alive... Thanks for saving me!
Let's go kick their bottoms!
Z-z-z-z-z-z-z-z-z-z...

name.en: Wakey-wakey! You are sleeping the war away!

text.en: Huh? What? What's up? Who're you?
Oh holy camoly! Oh them demons! Let's go give 'em hell!
What a hot day it is. Roll on, our guys're in trouble!
I hope they'll hold out till we come...
That portal over there is the headquarters. We recollected all our forces. Now, are you ready to fight?
Let's do it!
Thanks for your aid! We've been calling in for reinforcements, but if it weren't for you, they would have found our bare bones on arrival!

This stronghold traces its history back into the centuries. It all started with the cordon lines built here by the Kanians to protect against orcish raids long time ago. It has seen many sieges, happened to burn to the ground, but was rebuilt every time...
When the World broke into pieces, a part of the stronghold disappeared in the Astral, but a bit of it remained - nobody knows what's keeping it.
We discovered and restored it, so it has become one of our strongest keeps. Demons didn't even dare to approach! But a while ago they managed to plant a spy inside these walls to open the gates to the foe... If it weren't for your aid, the Okhotsk Keep would have fallen long ago!
Here we are.
Die, fools!
Let the blood be spilt!
It stinks.
It stinks.
Phew, smells like humans! What are you doing here, heroes?
Who are you to ask me of such things? Let’s see what kind of heroes you are. See those undead and toads on the waterside? Go and kill them all!
I can do that, but I have a rule: I can only carry the undead. But I can fix that for you in no time, haha!

name.en: Take us, or you’ll regret it!

text.en: Oh, I’m just an old man, have mercy! Alright, I’ll take you...
You again! You need to cross the swamp?
Oh, that’s a tough job for an old man! Alright, hop on the raft.
Who the hell are you? Why must I give you rides? Ah, you're heroes! We'll see what kind of heroes you are. See those zombies and toads along the coastline? Show me how brave you are, kill them all!
Alright, I can do that, if you insist. I've only got one rule: I don't ferry the living one, only ghouls.

name.en: Ferry us, or you'll regret it!

text.en: Oh, very well, you win. Come on.
I can smell the human breath! What are you seeking here?
You again? Want me to take you back?
Oh, I'm so old and powerless, anyone can take advantage over me... All right, come on board.
I can't believe my eyes! The living souls! Go on, tell me what has happened! Where are we? What is this starry, endless space around us?

name.en: Ask about Sarnaut and the Peaceful Cemetery

text.en:
Thank goodness, someone has managed to stay alive after the Cataclysm... How's it going in a broken world thousand years after? Is the great House de Tristesse prospering? Never heard of it? Ah, this is rather sad...
How I would love to leave this damned land... But my dreams are so vain. Everything that this land holds is in Sage's power. And thus it will be, until he is defeated.
He was a real menace - a necromancer by vocation, a capturer by nature, he gathered an army of the undead and unleashed war against his neighbors. The latters were lucky to defeat him and his army.
The army was beaten hollow, Sage himself was buried, and the grave was enchanted so that he could never rise again. Time passed, the enchantment faded, and finally Sage turned able to revive himself and the deadmen on the graveyard.
You have to defeat him right away, before he regains full power, otherwise it will be trouble!

name.en: Ask about the masters of the Cemetery

text.en:
Sage is in command here. He's the wraith in armor of steel, he's the ghost of a mighty necromancer. He arose all deadmen on this cemetery from their graves.
Hell Sheer is his number two. He's the head of the epic heroes squad - four captured souls of the four knights for him to leech force from. Destroy their graves to deprive Sheer of control over them.
Sage's other servant is Nergthrut Legpuller. During his lifetime he was a real stalwart: sturdy, merry and smart. His sense of humor grew nasty over the years, though. He once swapped fireworks for real explosives just for fun, and was blown sky high along with the other victims of the practical joke. If you make up your mind to fight him, listen carefully to his gags and play along: giggle or weep, just make him burst out laughing - then seize the moment to hit him hard!
As long as the Ferryman is concerned, I know nothing about him. Nothing at all. He's weird and grim. I'm not even sure if he's serving Sage or he's only pretending to do so. Make sure to keep your eyes open!

name.en: Ask about the ghosts of the Cemetery

text.en:
Sage made slaves out of all the dead people that had been buried here, all of them. He hasn't got me, though, for I know a thing or two about wizardry! But he's getting stronger day by day, so it won't be long till he reaches out and grabs me to join his ghostly team...
I'm not the one who stands. There is a trader Boris Greedoff. He'd already been under a curse, so Sage failed to entrap him. Boris used to be a scrooge in the old days, a real grabber, drained dry whole villages, so people finally laid a curse on him. His soul is restless till he returns all the misbegotten. And by the way, he'd nearly done so, and could free his soul, when the world broke apart!
Here's a handful of Holy Ground. Find the trader's mausoleum and scatter it around. You can't miss it, it's really huge. As soon as Boris arrives, accept his gold and may he rest in peace. He's suffered enough.
I've been dwelling here for thousand years... Take this gold, but release me, I beg you!
Take it all, take it all! Yuppie, I'm free!
The tombstone is covered with mud and dust.

name.en: Wipe the dust and read the inscription.

text.en: You fail to read the ancient elven letters on the tombstone, but a ghostly figure slowly condenses from the thin air.

It’s you again, my good-for-nothing pupils! Look what you’ve done to the village! It’s all cemetery now! Why did you need to give my death into the hands of this young fool? She found no better thing to do, but to expel me from my own home, to make matters bad and worse! Failed to overpower the darkest book, now she’s one of its servants!

What?! You need my help?! Don’t even dare to count upon it! You’ve triggered this mess, now face the consequences!
That was a good dance!
You can see the energy pulsing.
You can see the energy pulsing.

name.en: Tell about your travels and ask what happened at the isle

text.en:
This is a true miracle - I can see now how kind Mistress can be. I wish we got any wiser from the good! But no, the likes of us can never get enough.

As the evil spirits got quiet, diggers started to dig and miners started to mine wherever they wanted, deeper and deeper into the mountain, greedier and greedier! Goldie tried and reasoned them, but they just won’t listen! They said, if Mistress ever shows up again, the chief will invite even a stronger hero to take her on a leash! So, we played our way into trouble, that got her angry! Boy, was that a scary night! Howl, and rumble, and cries of horror! And then it was all gone, disappeared. I’m the one who managed to survive - evidently, I haven’t sinned as much as others! That’s right, I never dig, just sit around and pray to the Light all day...

Shall we pray for the peace of their souls?
Cin cin! May Tensess protect you.
You again! I’ve never seen anyone come back from the forest! Sit down, tell me everything...
Select your destination:
Teleporting!
My oh my, how in the world could this happen? Tekyan never spilt blood of another Tekyan! Not even after our gods were gone, and left us in the cold and dark.

I'd thought we were alone in this snowy land, but now I know there's another settlement of the likes of us in the North, beyond the mountain. They are our former neighbors in Tequatl. However, we didn't recognize them, when they showed up. They are not calm and wise Tekyan, like they used to be. They are hateful and mad! They came about shouting about the Light, started crashing our homes, chopping down trees and spilling our blood... They obviously wanted us to abandon Genlun and pray to their new idols. Who are they? New immortals? They are indeed immortal - I've seen their wounds heal and the dead rise. Who did this to them? Who turned them into monsters? For the sake of the sanity, please, save us, let these crazy ones go!

My heart is aching! Dark and sad was the day when the Tekyan met the one who carries the Light. If only she could go away with you! At first, she attempted to broker a peace between the two settlements, but then...  You can see how this all ended. Tekyan are spilling Tekyan blood, and I can't protect them! I cannot raise my hand against my friends! I am helpless here, so you are their only hope. I beg you, please put an end to this fight! You have saved the Tekyan from false gods before – do it again!

Great warriors, huh? It's easy to be great if you're not afraid of dying! No blade or claw can put an end to your life as long as you believe in the Light. This must be very convenient? But does this make you great warriors? I don't think so. You want to prove yourselves? Alright then. I will teach you a couple of tricks with one condition: you will not use your gift of resurrection. Kill all the enemies on this island without dying, and then I will share my skills.

Oh... Do you even know how to hold a sword?
Whoa, great. Now we’re talking!
I thought so. You ain’t got the guts.
You are not alone! Thank Tensess, you’ve brought in support!

As I returned to Posad, we gathered a great meeting of all our citizens, and here's what we decided: dismiss Mira Hooves from his leader's position, and appoint me instead. We didn't sentence him to death, though, just let him go, and then it turned out that we shouldn't have: less than a week later he returned with a whole gang of bandits and began to rob and kill our civilians! There's more to it. He's even gone as far as setting peace with Newsor Rotheart, the damned demonologist! Murderers and foes are all around the town! Save us, get us rid of this misery...

name.en: Isn't there anyone else you can lay your hopes on?..

text.en: Are you kidding? Half the guards ran off just at the sight of danger... We sent a messenger to the Queen, but she refused to even talk to him... Mercenaries' price is a way too high. There's a strange knight, who's been drinking at a local bar for a few days now. He's been promising to help, but taken no actions yet. See, you're our last hope... You and Tensess himself...
Welcome, warriors! Where are you coming from? There are bandits in our forests, would you like to take a walk and stretch your legs a little?

name.en: Accept the fighter to the party

text.en: I'll be with you in a wink of an eye! I'll just have to finish my beer, polish my cudgel, brush my beard, feed my horse, pray to Tensess, and I'm good to go!
Hey, strangers! Ring a coin in my pannikin! Stop for a while, have a rest and enjoy a fabulous dance! Have fruit, and sweet baklava, and fresh sorbet!

Iblis and all his seytans, this goddamned pest, may his name be cursed forever, sworn on his mother's grave that not a single living soul will ever find out about our deal! It looks like he needed the note as a proof, to get away with his intent, if it is revealed!

It was I who helped one of Sultan's wife conceive. The old man swindled me and never paid the price! So I dragged Vizir into it. He's so hungry for power, that he gladly agreed to help me. See, if Sultan is in grief, he won't be able to rule, which means, all power goes into Mehmet Pasha's hands! One tiny snake in a fruit basket will bring in so much misery for Dersaadet... And revenge is so sweet!
Dushman, gitmek! You have selected your destiny! Your blood will turn into poison!
Who the Iblis are you? How dare you enter my chambers? Guards! Guards!

name.en: Tell the princess about the curse

text.en:
What? I was a snake, and all my people were lamias, and you had to fight us? Nonsense. I'm a Sultan's daughter, not a stupid girl who believes in such things.

Guards! Where are you?

What is this green thing outside?

Oh... It turns out to have been real... I thought I was dreaming about a snake that bit me, and then you woke me up... It was not a dream, then!

Alas, what am I going to do now? For the sake of all the world's riches, leave now. Leave, please. I want to be alone.

What?! How dare you defame noble Mehmet Pasha?! My father has no friend who is more loyal and trustful, than the Grand Vizir! Do you have evidence? If you fail to prove it, you will be thrown into boiling oil... alive!

A letter? What a familiar handwriting... I cannot believe it, it cannot be!

Leave me. Here's for your service... and leave me now. Father, I can't believe it, how could this ever happen...

Guards! Take these ruffians and throw them into zindan! No, better chop their heads off! And then boil them in hot oil!

Guards, where are you? Help!

Wohoa! Why walking around here, friend? No strangers can walk here! It is dangerous for you! I can help you get upstairs, to the docks. Two silver coins, and my magic carpet will lift you in a wink of an eye, fast and safe, like in mother's arms. Do you agree?

name.en: Pay 2 silver coins to return to the docks.

text.en: Hold on tight, it's going to be real fast!

name.en: Pay 2 silver coins to return to the docks.

text.en: You're poor as a mouse! Go away! No money - no ride!
Save us, I beg of you! Janizary shut the bridge and rob everyone they see. Sultan's gone missing, Vizir is passive... We've got no hope, but you!

Hallelujah, we're saved! May your name be praised in centuries!

Janizary went out of control, when Sultan turned out to be missing. May the Lord forgive my words, but I think, it's the Grand Vizir who gave Janizary order to keep us low and quiet. Oh, I'd rather have my tongue cut off, than find out that this is the bitter truth...

May your days last forever, strangers. How may I help you? I know no more than others do. One fairy tale I heard might seem curious to you, though.

A while ago our beloved sultan, may the Lord extend his days, wished to beget an heir to his throne. Months went on, but none of his wives conceived. Sultan summoned doctors and healers from all over the universe, but all was in vain. Then one day the Grand Vizir told Sultan about a witch who knew a recipe of an ancient magic potion. She was summoned and ordered to brew the potion for the sultan. And in exchange the sultan promised to fulfill one of her wishes. Her wish was as follows: if a son was born, he would be the next the sultan, but if a daughter was born, the witch will take her with her.

The sultan gave his word. Nine months passed, and a beautiful girl Guzel was born. The sultan loved her with all his heart and felt that giving her away would be like ripping it out. He ordered the guards to throw the witch out of the city. So the witch cursed the baby girl. As soon as she turned eighteen, a snake would bite her, and she would die, said the witch.

A tower floating in the Astral was built. No snake could ever reach it. Guzel would have to stay in this tower until she turned eighteen years old. This day has come. Today is her eighteenth birthday!
May the lucky star always shine upon your home! Would you like some fresh fruit or lovely sweets? I can give anything to the one who saved us!

I don't know much, travelers. I was selling sweets and spices under the city wall, when Rustem Aga brought Janizary, may his name be cursed forever. They turned my tables upside down, kicked my back, ruined my goods... They blamed me of poisoning. Lord forbid, how could I be a poisoner? I never did any such thing!

name.en: Ask about the reason for accusations

text.en:
I have no idea! The only thing I know that a servant of the Grand Vizir ordered a basket of fresh purple pomegranates - a very rare and delicious fruit. He mentioned that the fruit was meant for Guzel, the charming Sultan's daughter. Vizir's maid picked up the basket in the afternoon, and the next morning Janizary came.

It turns out, that if I pick the fruit, I am the poisoner? I am under suspicion? Woe to me! I've been dishonored!
Guzel, my beautiful Guzel! How could this ever happen? How could I be so blind?

Mehmet Pasha betrayed me! He repaid good with evil! Glittering gems and gold bedazzled him!

The prophecy came true. A snake came out of a fruit basket and bit Guzel! She died but then rose again as a horrible monster! I prayed to the Lord, begging him to have mercy on me and bring back my beautiful daughter... and then Mehmet killed me! He brought up a dome that no living things could enter, so my loyal guards could not rescue me. Then... He came out into the square and announced that grief and despair had made me commit suicide. Mehmet Pasha stole my throne and my daughter, but he could not rob me of my hope!

I overheard him brag about some potion brewed by a witch. This potion is supposed to return life into a dead body. I am not going to ask you to revive me - I broke my vow, and I am paying for it. But please, save my beautiful Guzel! Find the magic potion, kill the monster she turned into, and pour the potion into the body! I believe this will bring Guzel back to life, and she will be her normal self once again! Hope and faith, that's all I have left...

Ay woe! Misery stretched its wings of despair over Dersaadet! Our Sultan, may the Lord give him a live of thousand years, has suddenly disappeared! He went to say his morning prayers, and we've never seen him since! Now there's a magic dome over the mosque, and it won't let anyone in or out! Nobody knows what goes on inside.

Janizary took their chance and started robbing and murdering people. Their leader, main bandit, is Rustem Aga, may the heaven and hell curse him forever!

And look at the high tower, where Sultan's daughter Guzel lives! Look at it! There's green magic fog, that looks like a viper! It's hurling malediction upon all of us!

Grief and despair!
You have come to do what? You've nothing to do here! Gitmek! The Grand Vizir said kill and destroy, and if you don't like it - it's off with your head!
What? You dare threatening me? I will rip off your skin and make a drum out of it!
A very strange hut... It looks like a normal house, but something is wrong about it.
Indistinct noises come from the inside - groans and mumbling. Wait... What is it?
I don't get it!

name.en: Go home, your wife is looking for you!

text.en: No! I say no! I won't go anywhere without a Christmas tree!
What do you think? I need to find a damned Christmas tree! My wife told me not to come home without it. And I better do what she says...
Stop the whining! Follow me!
Follow me!
Help!

Don't you see, eh? I've been bewitched! I snagged a wand from the hut. It turned out to be a magic one!

Do you happen to know how to use magic wands? Can you unspell me?
You be careful, though...
Enough with this nonsense! There is no way a distinguished scientist and theorist like me can vegetate in this hole!

Yes, you have understood correctly. All that "devilry" you may have heard of in the village is nothing but field test operations of our latest intelligence equipment. By the way, those tests failed. You know what it means? It means that we are staying here until we succeed!

I'm so sick and tired of those bureaucrats shoving me around. Imagine the stink they will raise when they find out that someone has broken that hugely expensive third version of the walking hut, stuffed with intelligence devices, and stolen the only prototype of Variator! The thieves will probably think that it is just a regular wand at the best-case scenario. Or a digging stick at the worst. And it's a real wonder of magic technology!

Well, you know the truth now. You will have to decide for yourself what to do about it. I don't really care. Don't forget that, If you jeopardize our mission, my colleagues will try to eliminate you. Where they are? Haha, they are right in front of you. How many real animals you think are left in this forest?

It's too small! Do you hear me? Too small!!

Take this magic stick. I don't know how it works. Take it and conjure me a Christmas Tree! And a big one!
It's too small! Too small!!
What's the good of it now... It's spring already! Now I will have to carry it all the way back!
What a Christmas Tree! The queen of Christmas Trees! My wife has to see it!
Greetings, my lords. May I ask you what brings you to this Tensess-forsaken hole? The capital has finally sent some real fighters instead of pot-bellied priests?
Well... May it be so! I will reduce you to ashes!

I'm afraid I do not deserve mercy. The misdeeds that I caused are beyond redemption.

But I still love him! If I had to do it all again, I'd do the same thing. And you... You killed Alister! You killed my beloved one! And now you have to die!
There is excuse for my misdeeds, just as there is no forgiveness for you! Kill me or die!

Until recently, we heard nothing of them. And now vampires are threatening us in the night, and werewolves are prowling around the village in the daylight!

Where did they come from? I have no idea! I thought that maybe someone from the village broke my ban and went to the old ruins in search for treasures, and found... the treasure, damn it! All kinds of nasty things dwell there. That's why we have sealed the portal with a special key.

It's a tragedy! Humans and elves used to live in perfect harmony! I owe all my knowledge to the elven patriarch, Alister. He is beautiful as an ancient statue and is wiser than Aidenus himself!

I cannot imagine what could have possibly happened. What could transform these beautiful creatures into spawns of darkness? Nevertheless, it was for real.

I figured out what happened when I saw the first victim. Immediately, I went to the elven enclave to see Alister... I saw that I was right. All elves had turned into bloodsuckers! And there is no way I can take down their patriarch - I am as weak as a kitten comparing to him.

It is hard to believe that, but once it used to be a thriving trade town. And here it was a tiny village, where peasants raised turnips and cabbages.

Now... it is all that's left. The town was cursed. The dead rose against the living! How? Why? I do not know.

The few ones who survived fled and destroyed the bridge to the town. Now its streets are only filled with ghosts and the undead...

The road to the town was sealed. To unlock the portal, you will need a special key that my former mentor forged. There are only two of them - I used to have one, but then I gave it to the priest, and Alister had the second one. And I'm sure he won't just give it to us...

The Inquisitors? Ha!

When things got pretty tough here, they sent a squad of clerics, led by thick-headed priest, who swung their incense burners and stank out the whole place with mirra. They took the key to the portal and went to the ruins. They said, only a Holy ritual could cleanse the evil that was hiding there!

So, they took a pile of magical reagents from us and stepped through the portal. It was the last time we saw them.

There was a huge explosion! Lightning bolts, and windwirls raised to the skies! I doubt that any one of them survived. Now they must be roaming the town streets as well...

name.en: Show the Werewolf Chief Amulet to the Sorceress

text.en: Hmm... Raven feather and magical thread. So what? This werewolf could be anyone while he was still alive! I have nothing to do with that!

name.en: Show the letter to the Sorceress

text.en: What a strange letter! The one who wrote it must have been maddened with pain. To threaten an elven archmage, huh! That peasant woman had lost her mind if she dared to write of her love to Alister and demand that he fulfill some promise. Demand! From a vampire patriarch! It is strange that Alister read this scribbling at all...

So this is it... The walking dead gave me away, right? Sad to hear...

Well, may it be so. Do you want to listen to my story, or are we getting straight down to the business?

I loved Alister... I was ready to do anything for his love!

I turned Mstislav into a werewolf to keep the peasants in their homes even when the sun is up. My beloved one can't stand the daylight!

Then I lured the Inquisitors into the old town and lied to them about the ancient evil in the ruins. They wanted to kill my darling!

And I spoiled the ritual by adding the dead man's blood to the ritual bowl. All for the love, all for him!

And he... He betrayed me! I gave him my heart, and he trampled on it! He forgot my love at the moment when he stopped needing me...

Greetings to you, dear guests! You came to our village at a dark hour...

A fierce evil has sprung among us! First, people started disappearing at nights. We found their cold bodies afterwards. There was not a drop of blood left in them!

Then it got worse. A fearsome werewolf appeared in the nearby woods. If someone steps outside of the village walls, consider 'em dead! We wrote to the capital and pleaded for help. They heard us and sent an Inquisitor with an escort. He talked to our sorceress and went to the ruins of the old town. We have not seen them ever since...
From the bottom of our hearts, we thank you! Accept this humble gift as a reward.
Sorry, we have nothing else to thank you with...
You say, those were vampires? Nasty bloodsuckers? How, how did we deserve that punishment!.. Thank you so much! If it were not for you, we'd all be dead.
Sorry, we have nothing else to thank you with...
I see... I told that priest to stay away from the ruins! A great evil must had settled in that town if even the servants of the Light couldn't handle it...
Sorry, we have nothing else to thank you with...
These ancient June ruins are overflowing with magic...
Teleporting...
Teleporting...
These ancient June ruins are overflowing with magic...
Teleporting...
Teleporting...
These ancient June ruins are overflowing with magic...
Teleporting...
Teleporting...
The ruins are silent... It seems that it needs to be activated with some kind of a key.
We're going!
We're going!
We're going!
We're going!
Choose your destination:

The Portal network of the Sorcery Workshop is still working - June magic is reliable, as always. However, to activate the rest of the Portals, you will first have to reach them.

Where do we go?
Teleporting.
Teleporting.
Teleporting.
Teleporting.
Teleporting.
Your foot hit against an invisible obstacle. Some evil force must be guarding this idol.
Oops! Quag doesn't seem to like it...

The chaotic scribblings can hardly be read, and you can only decipher short phrases.

"...reactor is dead... ttacked the rock... four surviv..."

"...hiding in the thicket... lying... collect bodies... to eat!"

"...isle is cursed... bosun gone to the jungle... howls and croak..."

"...one more ship... hull is crushed... killed everyone! They killed everyone! Damn savag..."

"...saw my friend... dea... came for me!"
Half-decomposed remains obviously belonged to the shipboy. Several sheets of paper are scattered around his body - it looks like he tried to write a note before he died.

Clustered pages of the book are covered with tiny neat handwriting - incomings, expenses, balance, wages... Nothing interesting. But there is a scratchy drawing on the last page. It depicts a stone with a giant toad-like figure hovering above it, and a group of people at the foot of the stone, surrounded by some weird creatures.
The sailor's bones are picked bare by the local fauna. A spine of a book is protruding out of the hole in his belt bag.

It's a fragment of a logbook, stained with blood. Looks like the devices of the ship that tried to moor to the allod suddenly went dead, and the ship crushed into the rocks.

The back of the sheet reads: "They will find us! They will devour us all! Quag wants our blood!"
The skeleton is squeezing a piece of paper in its bony hand.
This ugly idol is spreading the vibe of hunger and malice!

Those who wish to use the Portal net of the city should first visit all places of interest in East Overshoe.

Where would you like to go?
Teleporting.
Teleporting.
Teleporting.
Teleporting.
Teleporting.
Teleporting...
The Portal is closed due to quarantine. to restore its operation, first activate the connected portals.
Choose your destination:

The Portal network of the Forgotten temple is still working - June magic is reliable, as always. However, to activate the rest of the Portals, you will first have to reach them.

Where do we go?
Teleporting.

The Historians' camp is destroyed, and everyone who was there is dead... Except for this creature. I wonder where it came from?

The one thing I can see is that it's really, really hungry.

What do we do?
The Dragon swallowed the food in an instant. It looks like he's already in love with his feeder.

name.en: Prompt the Dragon to follow you

text.en: The Dragon clumsily gets out of the eggshell and shows you that he is ready to follow you to the depths of Astral.

The Dragon’s bones crack in your hands.

You feel a mysterious power that fills you. There is something evil about that power...
The Dragon happily purrs and drums his wings. It was not a good idea to burn a Fire Dragon.

This must be the journal of the expedition trapper. He writes about exotic birds and exotic diseases, but there are also his personal notes:

"The egg moves more and more often. Looks like it is resistant to the cold... I hope it doesn't die after it hatches. I don't want to burn the rest of my fur in attempt to obtain another egg. And we won't come to the Dragon Ring again any time soon."

"I saved some food - fire Dragon cubs are always hungry. I hope our cook's dishes are edible and we don't end up in Great Yao."

The book cover reads that this is the journal of Gregory Hlestin, one of the researchers. The pages are covered with his neat handwriting and are full of official language. It looks more like a battle log than a diary. However, the last entry says...

"Nezeb as my witness, today that comet has approached the allod closer than ever. Saad-Croy may say whatever he wants about my eyes getting old... My eyes! The eyes of the best Imperial Cannoneer! What a lame joke.

Elementals are behaving strangely. Supposedly, the comet stimulates their activity. We should reinforce the patrol.

Apart from the above-mentioned, no

...

WE ARE UNDER ATTACK!

THEY ARE WORMFACES!"

Looks like a lab log. Nothing really interesting - just analysis of mineral samples and copies of carved drawings from the ruins. From underneath the ornamented cover, a note peers out.

"Sveta! Meet me downstairs! My shift's at three."

Sounds like a promising message from an Orc guardian. Does love know no limits?

Another researcher's diary. This one looks like a compilation of random thoughts and speculations. The author seems to have been too absorbed with his work to make proper records.

"Almost two thirds of the temple are destroyed and dissolved in the Astral. But the arenas are still there. The nature of force fields (?) is unclear..."

"Weird devices that look like stone calendars (?) serve as portals between the destroyed parts of the allod. They look newer than everything else (?). SUSPICIOUS."

"Strange flares coming from somewhere around the volcano. It will be funny if it decides to wake up."

"We found weapons. A lot of them. It seems that THEY (?) used the temple to train fighters (?). We need to find a way to reach the volcano. Using the ship is way too dangerous."

"The guards report that they saw some creatures next to the bottom of the volcano last night. (?)"

I... I don't... Why?!

Those were Wormfaces! Everyone who could resist went crazy one after another. Those who remained sane were simply killed... by our allies. Our allies! Arhivina killed Pierre... He won't resurrect, I can feel it. I know it! What did she do to him?!

And why?! We never did any harm to them! We didn't even know they were here...
Teleporting.
Teleporting.
Teleporting.
Teleporting.
New Bay is a small city, and Aoidoi use the local transport net instead of Astral cannons. Where would you like to go?
Teleporting.
This Demon isn't eager to kill anyone. It must be local.

Demon reverently nods, greeting you. You realize then that you already met a long time ago - on the Wandering Island.

What is he doing here?

You can see something resembing a grin on Goliath's face.

He must have changed a lot since your last meeting. His anger and blood lust seem to be gone completely. This is surely a good thing, but... Now his striving for the Astral and the Beauty are gone, too.

What keeps Goliath here?

What keeps all Demons here, in Sarnaut?

name.en: Ask about the leader of the invasion

text.en:
Goliath shrugs his shoulders. His emotions are clearly readable - disapproval, caution, and... pity? From the depths of your consciousness, fiery letters emerge and arrange themselves into a name - Or'Khan.

Looks like Goliath used to fight alongside him. Now they are leading different paths. Or'Khan just cannot stop. He must destroy, for he cannot live - or BE - otherwise. Then you perceive another message - Goliath wishes you good luck.

Or'Khan must die. It is his fate.

The Demon is impatiently shaking his sword... If that terrifying weapon can be called so.

The invasion doesn't seem to bother him at all.
The Demon makes a sound that can be interpreted as an approving harrumph.

The Demon emits waves of resentment. However, he's not irritated by you, but by some creature on the bridge.

In spite of the invasion threat, this Demon doesn't seem to be willing to leave the burgeoning grove in the city center. He has trapped the enemy Demon on the bridge, but he cannot hold him back for too long.
The Demon shakes his head. He seems to be taking his job very seriously.
The small Demon is lost in his small demonic thoughts. He doesn't seem to notice anything around him.

The Demon growls aggressively.

Come to think of it, one can even call it cute.

Thank goodness, help is here! But how did you... Ah, it doesn't matter!

Welcome to New Bay, the most thriving Aoidos colony in the whole Archipelago. At least it used to be so, before Demons started falling from the sky a couple of hours ago!

No, these Demons are fine. They're with us. Is it hard to tell them from each other? Well, let's say, if it's not trying to incinerate you, it's friendly.

The levitation network, that used to connect the two parts of the city, went dead instantly. In this part of the colony, there aren't many warriors - mainly craftsmen and poets like myself. We cannot call for help. Neither can we find out what is going on in the other parts of the city.

I also heard that some kind of a monster is hiding in the water.
Datura's charms have lost their power. You can leave this cursed place at any time.

name.en: Tell him you came for the shard

text.en: So, that's how it goes, eh? Ah, well, a favor for a favor, that's the rule. I haven't slept for a long while. All these forest animals... wouldn't let me sleep. Prowling, rattling, munching all the time... Rid me of 'em, and I'll give you the shard.
Look what the stupid wind blew in!.. So many of you! What are you looking for in my forest?
That's how it goes then? Well, I guess, I'll have to get rid of you personally.

name.en: Ask the Ghoul if you can have the shard

text.en: The shard? You know, the Silent Sentinels have only got a single duty - to maintain order at the cemetery. Look, how many ghouls are walking around. Make sure they find the eternal peace, and I'll give you the artifact.
Look at the living flesh! Haven't seen it in a while.
Now it is your turn! The Silent Sentinels will stand forever!
A fragment of inscription can still be seen on the ancient monument: "...it will preserve this city's peace and protect its citizens forever."
The stone monument is standing still.
The monument is moving...

name.en: Ask what a Gibberling family is doing here.

text.en: You know, friend, there are only two things that are worth something. It's great puzzles and great treasures! We look for ancient mysteries and find ancient relics. Collectors are willing to pay crazy money for them. The danger! The risk! The unknown! And a lot of running around.  living the dream!

Here's the plan. Our target is the tower, which is locked. Can you see the vortexes in the sky? We're sure that they are the manifestation of artifact's power. The very artifact that was used to seal the Mage's home, and then broken into three pieces. It gives us three shards to recover. The only problem is that each is guarded by a bunch of angry monsters! Now that you're here, we shall deal with them quickly, grab the shards, restore the artifact... And that's a pretty good place to start.

The only thing we know for sure is that a town was here. It is unclear what destroyed it, but the vortexes in the sky suggest a magical disaster. I'm not an expert on magic, but my intuition rarely fails me.
Oh, wow! There's a whole library!
We dispelled the barrier, but it cost us all our crystals! We placed them in the barrier, it vanished, and the crystals turned to dust.
Oh, hey! Hunting for treasure? I don't think there's enough for everyone.
Lara is sound asleep.

name.en: Open first pages of the journal

text.en: My experiments are over... By sheer luck, I managed to create a truly magnificent thing. This item... It is a crystal that conceals power beyond anything I had witnessed so far. It can control the structure of things, changing their properties and perhaps even their magical essence! If my assessments are correct, this artifact will serve our city well.

name.en: Open the journal in the middle

text.en: The crystal is amazing, but its power is scaring me. Great power carries with it great unpredictability. All the challenges we have faced during the last years... The plague, awakening of the dead... Is it the crystal to blame? Is it my fault? I must stop the influence, find a way to destroy it.

name.en: Open last pages of the journal

text.en: The crystal seems to be sane. I could break it into four parts, but at a great price. The city is deserted. Streets smell like death. Very few people were able to escape. As for me... my end is near.
An ancient scorched journal.
Hello! We've been here for a while trying to get to that tower, and we can't! Indie has a plan, but there's no way we could do it alone. Try talking to him, see if you can make something of it.

It's my special field brew. I made it of local snakes' venom, spider poison, bats... What's wrong? I mean, it's really refreshing, although a little lethal... The Light hasn't gone anywhere the last time I checked. On the plus side, it turns you into a ferocious warrior! Makes you unstoppable!

name.en: It's too easy to die without it. I'll pass.

text.en: Well, it's a "no" then.

name.en: As they say, live fast and die young! Hand over your potion.

text.en: Here's to you and to your funeral!
Listen up.

name.en: Will you help me again a little bit?

text.en: Oh come on now, you've already sent all the lads away! You get to work and deal with that rat after all!

name.en: Will you help me deal with that rat, folks?

text.en: Sure will! I'll be tellin' my buddies to grab anything edible and drag it along to the cafeteria. They'll be feeding your critter a bit so it doesn't eat your own sorry selves while you're dealing with it. Hehe.
You gotta help us out first!
I'll tell you everything now!

Right. The dutyman's armband is both power and risk.

The horrors fear and hate the dutymen. Sometimes, fallen enemies are trying to curse the dutyman to make him more vulnerable. But that gives him more strength to defeat new enemies.

And if the comrades are nearby, the curse would afflict them as well. That's how it is!

Are you ready to take on the dutyman's armbands?

Receiving!
Not a problem! There are heroes not only among the dutymen. Correctly gauging the strength of your squad is the key.

A true pioneer's response!

Onward, the squad on duty! Get the Mirage rid of this menace!

name.en: Wait here, we'll sort it out

text.en: Oh, so you've come to help us? Oh yeah, this is a night to remember! These vampires have overrun the entire camp!
Will stakes of aspenwood work? Ahem... Oh, it's you again. Got any questions left?
Pioneers? What? What are you doing here? I don't seem to remember you. Are you vampires?! Aaaaahh!

name.en: Calm down, we are the rescue party. Uniform is worn for cover.

text.en: Ah. I see now. Please forgive me. These vampires have overrun the entire camp! That's why I've been quite a bit nervous.

name.en: Tell me about the Pioneer Camp

text.en: *Valera is telling something.*
You cannot access the secret Superdove project data. But you are allowed to admire its perfection.
This is a hologram of a fascinating project "Superdove George".
I'm not a fighter, but there's something I can do. Here, take this portable lightning arrester. It will prevent you from burning on the spot.

Those cultists, they beat me up and left me for dead! I would have become a source material for replicants. Thank you for saving me! Now it's time to take urgent measures.

There's a lever down the corridor, it summons guards. They'll help you clear the lab of the cultists.
There's a testing lab where we used to perform experiments on reviving dead bodies. The cultists have sewn up a huge carcass and are trying to animate it!
Long story short, there was a catastrophe. I can tell you more...
Well, all I can tell you is good luck!
You don't look like a squad dispatched by the City Council... Are you the reinforcements?
Just a small injection...

You should know that the Animality Potion is so last century! We're experimenting with meldonium-based serums. Theoretically, we may obtain a formula that will allow to knock the world flat. Literally.

Would you like to try one of our latest prototypes? We were in the middle of testing it when cultists started their operation. We lost all data, now we'll have to collect it all over again...

Yes, we will. A scientist must remain scientist in all situations.
What now?
Living beings! Finally!

Are you alive?! Are your Sparks free of the Stele's power? You can save us all! Both our armies, the League and the Empire, are caught in a trap. Sparks of everyone who died in this battle are controlled by this awful device on the hill. Destroy it and free our Sparks!
Beat 'em!
Hush! Hear that noise? Those are demons in the cargo hold, and they’re coming!
How's everything?
Great! But now there’s fire from the shore.

Who are you? What do you want?
I have no idea! Go look for it in the woods!
No way. Get out.
Come in, but I’m watching you!

Shhh... Don't tell anyone... I can... You know what I can do, right? I can help you with something... I can help you get experience... Lots of experience... Do you want to use my services? Go right ahead, but just don't tell anyone...
Good luck, my friend. Come back if you ever need anything!

name.en: To whom should the invitations be delivered?

text.en:
Now, if you wanna help, here's the list of those who you must invite to the party.

First, it's Fith the Forester, a Blue Corporal from Igsh Military District. He's a real man, always ready to fight! Can't even remember when I last saw him without bruises on his face...

Second, it's Shildar the Wily, a Red Captain... you got me, right? That's gonna be some show, right? Don't tell anyone, though. I don't want the joke to be spoiled.

And third, it's Marianna Preminina, IMD Commissar. Real headstrong woman with an iron fist! But I can tell everyone will be glad to see her here.

All clear? To the rear! March!

name.en: To whom should the invitations be delivered?

text.en:
Of course. Here's a list of guests for you.

First, it's Timofey Gromov, a distinguished druid. He might look gloomy and thoughtful, but he is a true druid, very skillful. Kanians and Gibberlings adore his magic of Nature. Who knows, may be we have a chance to see a miracle...

Second, it's Pakhom Rogov, construction council agent. He's not very widely known, but he's pretty, so the ladies here are going to love him. We're making up a legend for him now, you know, for the ladies.

The third and the last one is Vladimir Zalesky, the League commander. A real hero, a legend for kids, he's got a few stories to tell, for sure.

Do you have any questions? No? Then I'm hoping to see all the guests here soon!

Is that meat? Looks disgusting. And stinks, too. Let me have some... What are you staring at? My bro once tried to eat an Astral demon. Imagine, how hungry he was! It's a pity he couldn't. The demon fell into ashes!

Listen up now. The lion is as moody as a grumpy old man. One minute, he's calm, another minute, he roars and charges at you! So, you need to soothe him first, if you want to feed him.

If you see he's falling asleep, find courage, work up your nerve and roar at him! That'll wake him up, for sure! Don't overdo it, though. If he's too annoyed, you will have to talk to him mildly to pacify him.

As soon as he's calm, not too sleepy, not too annoyed - it's high time to feed him all your steaks. Come back to me, when you have it done.

You have brought the meat? Excellent. Hm, looks good enough... I think.

Now, our lion is as moody as a grumpy old man. One minute, he's calm, another minute, he roars and charges at you! So, you need to soothe him first, if you want to feed him.

If you see he's falling asleep, find courage, work up your nerve and roar at him! That'll wake him up, for sure! Don't overdo it, though. If he's too annoyed, you will have to talk to him mildly to pacify him, like a baby. As soon as he's calm, it's high time to feed him all your steaks. Come back to me, when you've finished.
We're having a party here! Don't go too far from here.
Flowers, and tapestry, and musicians! Just imagine, how beautiful it all will be!
Nochee tluckamay wan siuamei keepeei manoy kooaly tluckateesay!
Start with a weaker opponent.
This one will be tougher!
It's not easy to handle this one!
The final fight is the toughest one!

name.en: Ask Marianna if she has found any assistants.

text.en: Looks like this time we'll have to save the world by ourselves. Unless you decide to flee, of course. In that case I'll make it alone!
Looks like the world needs saving once again... You with me?

name.en: Ask about the End of the World

text.en: So much effort! Finally, we'll find out whatever he has predicted!
How come you can't see him? He's right there. Squint your eyes, bow your head, wink... See him now?
Yes, I've found an alternative option... However, touching it gives me the creeps.

name.en: Ask if the Wand is ready

text.en: Yes, the Wand is ripe. It is glowing... With darkness. I've seen a lot, but this stuff makes my skin crawl.

name.en: Ask for a new Versatile Translator

text.en: Hey, what the hell! What kind of help is it? One assistant is clumsier than the other! One carries bits of astralium in his pockets and then complains about some outgrowth. Another one tried to use the seventh page of the Great Mage's Diary to kindle a fire. The third... May he rest in peace... Argh! I've found the translator, here it is. Don't lose it again!

name.en: Ask for a new Wand of Summoning the Dead

text.en: A new one? You think there's another thing like that in Sarnaut? I hope not! How can one lose such items at all? Can you imagine what can happen if it gets into the wrong hands? Luckily, I noticed it and picked it up. Here, take it and don't lose it again!

name.en: Ask for a new Semiotic Restorer

text.en:
What?! That's the only prototype! Where am I going to get another one?
Consider yourself lucky that, while some keep losing unique devices, others find them. Here it is. And see that you don't drop it again!

name.en: Ask for a new Wand of Summoning the Dead

text.en: A new one? You think there's another thing like that in Sarnaut? I hope not! How can one lose such items at all? Can you imagine what can happen if it gets into the wrong hands? Luckily, I noticed it and picked it up. Here, take it and don't lose it again!
Just don't pass out. It's not exactly an optimistic picture.
Take your pick!
Take your pick!
Select whatever you like!
Take your pick!
Three packs of demons have been defeated. This is a good victory. If you like, you may summon another, stronger pack to try and obtain the Demon Spark.
Alright. You have completed the trial.
You may choose to complete the trial. You may also collect more spheres to fight Demon of Greed!
I can grant you a gift that lets you safely collect Orbs of Greed. But you will have to pay 10 gold for each collected orb!
As you say. I can see you know no greed.
Do you know the feeling of lust for blood? This is a scary thing, but it is so pleasant and fulfilling! Don't suppress it. Fight! Win! Then you might survive...
Go ahead, the enemy is waiting!

Even little children know that there are four basic elements in Nature. Some think that they relate to the primal matter. Others think that... Oh, let's cut the chat. An awful monster will arrive soon. It devours the four elements and finishes the meal with primal matter... and this is not an exaggeration, mind you!

The Great Worm, Elemental Devourer is a dangerous opponent. It's attracted here by the elementals that I accidentally summoned. Luckily, its favorite dish is at the same time its greatest weak point. Together with the elementals, it may swallow the stone, gulp the fire, and when two opposite powers meet, the Devourer becomes weak.

Destroy the Elementals to receive their power for a while. Bear in mind, that Stone and Ice Elementals will leave pools of oil and water behind. You may use the pools: set oil on fire, freeze water, or treat the Devourer with good old Lightning, while it is in a pool. While it's frozen, you may try and throw stones at it, and see what happens.

Try different combinations. I bet you will have fun with this demon! Make it suffer!
Ready! Go!

Long long time ago, when the grass was green and the skies were blue, it used to rain fire on the heads of the warriors of the Great Astral Campaign. Were it demons who caused trouble, or great mages, carried away with their magic - nobody knows. But the fact is, the warriors had to beware of the burning stones falling from the sky.

I'm telling you this, because a huge demon is going to arrive soon, and the weather forecast is not that good. Klavdia Kalugina is predicting rains of white hot stones and flame.

You might have to go in for running a bit - the demon can teleport.
Ready! Go!

Now let's see how greedy you are. I'm going to summon a lot of magic spheres. Each sphere will burn you like fire, as you pick it up. You may heal yourself, you may pray to your Patron, whatever. Or you may just pay me, and then no harm will be done!

What will you choose?

You are about to fight a mighty demon, called the Demon of the Void, and its minions. You might not survive through this battle! Make sure to kill the minions first, it will weaken the demon. Their blood has different effects, depending on its color. The blue will heal you, the red and the violet will damage your enemies. Beware of the glowing blood, though! Now I must fall silent. From now on, you're on your own.
Ready! Action!

Do you like hunting? I bet you do. You should be familiar with the old Gibberling hunting tradition - luring the prey by the smell of hot blood. You know the rest, don't you?

I'll give you a lure that attracts demons. Destroy them, as they approach! The trial counts as soon as you finish three packs.
Ready! Go!

So, you're fond of winter, eh? I don't care much myself. A decent mage can maintain any temperature he or she finds comfortable, even in the coldest weather. Only if the frost is cast by another mage, we have to really fight for the life.

Can you feel how the air is getting colder? The frost is coming... Not that old Father Winter with his long white beard, but a mighty demon! The cave, however, knows how to protect itself. It will spawn spheres of heat. If you collect them on time, the demon won't have a chance to freeze you to death. If not... oh well...

Beware not to slip and trip! If you break your head this way, your death will be the most stupid in the history of Sarnaut.
Ready! Go!

So common demons are of no problem to you, eh? How about some invulnerable demons? Do you want some? I'll give you a hint: if you defeat the minions first, the boss will be a piece of cake!

Shall we start?
Ready! Action!

Slaughter... Just the sound of it makes me shiver. I've seen this, and I didn't like it. Neither will you!

If any blood will be spilt, it will be the blood of demons.
Ready! Go!

Demons have their Sparks, too. They differ from ours, though. Their Sparks are able to transform, mutate or even divide to create new Sparks. Hard to believe, eh? You'll see that yourself. Each new Spark will soon turn into a new demon, so hurry, if you don't want to fight a whole squad of demons!
Ready! Go!

Are you tired of fighting demons? The next trial will give you a break - a bit of luck is all you will need.
It's easy. This is the portal that you have to enter. If you are lucky, you have two trials less to complete. If not - well, it's your bad luck. Go ahead! I believe that the luck is on your side!
Good luck! You're going to need it.

name.en: Trial: In Search of the Hidden

text.en: They say, a sapper has only one chance for a mistake... You will have to see, if it's true. There's a bomb hidden in the cave, and its timer is already counting down! You have one minute to find and demine it, or else!
Pay attention now!

They say, cultists are now using the demons for hunting and carrying heavy loads. You are smarter than that, aren't you? Won't you try and tame the demons?

You will have to lure three demons into their cages. They will eat you if you fail, mind you! Better make it quick, if you don't want to turn into their prey.
Ready! Go!
You may take a little rest and prepare defensive spells for the next trials. You're lucky, I'm in good mood today.
Easy as Pie
I hate to wake up so early! Do you? I bet you do. The demon you are about to fight will be irritated because of the early wake-up, too. Try and wake him as gentle as you can.
Ready! Go!

Have you heard about hydras? You know, when you cut off one head and see two more growing? It's the same here. You destroy a Spark, and it divides into two new ones. Sparks are no hydras, so they have their limit. This means you have a chance to defeat them all!
Ready! Go!

Do you smoke? Do your knees hurt? Do you have any lung disease? No? This is good, because you will have to run about like a crazy hare!

You need to collect yellow spheres. Sounds easy, eh? I'll let a crowd of hungry animals out then. It'll be fun!

Oh, I nearly forgot. Pick up blue spheres to find spells that will stop the blood-hungry crowd.

So run, hero, run!

Suffering... Do you understand what it means?.. When somebody dies, it feels like you are dying. If somebody's hurt, it hurts you too! Many living things are connected, and so are the demons. You will see it yourself.

Special bonds will bind your enemies and boost them. However, if one of them dies, the other will die too.
Ready! Go!
You may take a little rest and prepare your weapons for the next trials. You're lucky, I'm in good mood today.
Easy as Pie

You're not the only one who's scared. Demons are afraid of you, too. You'll see that yourself. I will summon a whole lot of demons, and your task is to throw a stone to beat as many as you can, before they flee. Fifteen will be enough!

Sounds easy, doesn't it? Haha, we'll see!
You're not that greedy!

Hello! Long time no see, eh? Does the helm of the last June fit you alright?

Are you here to pass the trial? Excellent. Remember, you only have three attempts. We are not playing games here! Are you ready?
The more trials you complete, the more enemies you manage to defeat, the higher your chance to receive the main prize!
As you wish.
Full speed ahead!
Full speed ahead!
Here you go, don’t lose it next time.

Greetings! How may I help you?

Greetings to this Allod's keeper!

You must be the Great Mage who is holding it together? You aren't? Then... is it the meteorite ore? How curious... What an amazing place!

I was a student of Great Mage Tritogor. He's the mage that was supporting Forox since the day when Bogsha disappeared in the Misty Valley. As if one tragedy wasn't enough! Something... dark possessed my teacher. Forox almost got deserted under his rule. We were able to evacuate people, but...

You see, not so many people survived.

I beg you, the Keeper of this allod, allow us to stay here, at least for a while! I give you my word to faithfully serve you... And I can offer my services as an alchemist. All Forox science, including the secret of Embrium processing.

You probably have extra Expansion Tokens and Crystal Chips. I can sell you a rod that can turn them into Horizon Stones. You can send these stones to Horizon. I can also exchange your Coins of the Dark Times for Horizon Stones.

In Horizon, you can get a chest with powerful items of the Draconic Aspect and various boxes with useful items. You can send them to Allods Online and get the rewards inside.

You must know my cousin, Prince Dakkar who is quite famous... I want to be famous, too, so I started hunting all kinds of dangerous creatures.

As you know, once they put things in order on Umoir, all sorts of vermin decided to settle at the edge of the allod, meaning right here. New enemies joined the old ones. That's what you and I will be dealing with. We'll do it this way: I mark the enemy on the map, you go and kill it, then I pay you, and we divide the loot 50/50! Yes, I knew you'd agree.
