So let me just mark all the courses as completed for you.
Philosophy allows us to discuss abstract things, but without understanding them, we are blind.
Hey, cap. I'm going to teach arts and crafts to the stonefaces.

name.en: Nogrom? What are you doing here?

text.en: I told you, I'm a professor. Why? Amos invited me. The pay isn't bad here. You almost say that like it's something amazing.
Greetings.

Everybody has sinned. Even Tensess says in his Testament, that "there is no single creature in the world who never violated any virtues. May this not become an obstacle on the way to the enlightenment! Everyone can abandon the old sins and let the Light into their souls by saying: Nay to Evil, I Praise the Light!"

Here you are, you have come and said the words to receive the blessing of the Light. May those who was harmed by you, forgive you, as the Light has long done!

Go in peace!
Greetings.

Everybody has sinned. Even Tensess says in his Testament, that "there is no single creature in the world who never violated any virtues. May this not become an obstacle on the way to the enlightenment! Everyone can abandon the old sins and let the Light into their souls by saying: Nay to Evil, I Praise the Light!"

Here you are, you have come and said the words to receive the blessing of the Light. May those who was harmed by you, forgive you, as the Light has long done!

Go in peace!

Amazing times are coming, New Child. There’s no pure faith in you yet, but your time has not come to an end. You’ll live.

I’ll show you the Light.

Sentinel. Servant. Gatekeeper. No more, no less. As long as there is Light, I’ll be here as well. And while I’m here, there’ll be Light.

Tell me, New Child, are you ready to accept my Gift?

name.en: Is that the Gift that all Aoidoi are looking for within themselves?

text.en:
The ways of your people are unfamiliar to me, New Child. You are looking for a talent that will set you apart from them? Light and Immortality will be your talents, if you wish it. You will live for as long as you like. If your body dies, your spark will return to Sarnaut in another one. That is the order of things.

Are you ready to live, New Child?
And remember: we’ll meet again...

name.en: Tell about the Power of Light.

text.en:
So it begins...

I can’t say this strange power does not worry me. Everything in our world is bound together by the cycle of life and death, and it’s so rude to disturb it.... It sounds like violation of natural laws. But at the same time, I’m thinking about how practical this power is, and how it can fight demons without fear. We already have one immortal Aoidos among us - Kyros. I wonder if your Gift came from the same place?

About Kyros...
My friends are nowhere to be seen. They must have remembered they're mortal after all.

You see, even Sarn, as mad as he was, was abiding the rules. Among his creations, there wasn't a single mortal - and there were reasons for that. Without a defined lifespan and the rebirth cycle life just... stops. It doesn't evolve. Stagnates.

Take the Great Mages. So much power, such many years of age, and what good do they do? The world doesn't stand still; it progresses. Look at the League and the Empire! Immortality has plunged them into an endless war. You kill each other over and over again, and there is no end to it. How long do you think this war will last if they all suddenly realize they are mortal?

Now even the dominae want to embrace the gift of immortality, thinking it will help them somehow. I will not let my people follow that path. I will not let another war happen.

This is the mission of a Dominus of War!

Unfortunately, it is so. I am the weapon of Creation. In order to fight immortality, one must be immortal. Many things are predestined before we are even born - much more than you think.

I'm sorry though that it took Aellona's death to make me see the truth. She deserved a full life. You can't even imagine how much good and beauty she could bring to this world. And now nothing can bring her back.

But this is for the best. Now nothing holds me in this world. I can fulfill my destiny.

name.en: What do you want to do?

text.en:
You still don’t understand?

I will destroy the immortality. I will strike at the very heart of the cursed Light. I will overthrow the Servant of Tensess and take his place by the gates. The eternal guardian of the border between the living and the dead... I will be the overseer of life and the judge. I won't let thousands of immortals deplete the power of Sarnaut, depriving it of any hope for development.

So be it!
Who is there?

Me and Whip were telling Aoidoi about the Holy Power and its miracles. About the mystery of resurrection and true faith... That is when those beasts broke into the village. I knew I was their target right away. The Aoidoi did, too, and they tried to protect me. But centaurs were killing everyone. Whip took down several of them, but then they started shooting... He covered me with his body.

Then they... took me away. They tortured me to make me tell them things they can read in any church book! About Tensess, about the Purgatory, about the Servant of Tensess who guards it. About our faith. Of course, I told them everything... Then they went away and left me behind. I was too scared to try and escape - there's a whole village of them here!

I saw an Aoidos among them. He was tall, blue-eyed, with stone horns...

You see, his words make some sense. The inhabitants of Sarnaut really do overuse their gift. Especially that strife between the League and the Empire is driving me mental.

But I'm really not fascinated with the idea of some troubled teenager guarding the Purgatory and deciding whether I should die for good or live on. We need to do something about it. I have an idea... However, we should settle that local issue first.

The centaurs have reached the Well of Souls and occupied it. As far as I understand, Kyros and his mysterious sorcerer are intending to open up a portal using the energy of the Well.

We should use their portal, too - of course, if we don't stop them before that. But first we will have a horde of centaurs to deal with.
This surprises me, honestly.

A familiar feeling overwhelms you as you approach the demon. It seems to be trying to say something, but with fragments of images and thoughts.

One of the distinct messages inside your head says: "No war. We come in peace".

The demon seems to be anxious - now your head fills with peculiar images. His message, however, becomes clear and consistent.

You see that the invisible bonds that were connecting every demon to Sarn were gone when he died. Demons learned a new word - liberty... But not all of them understood it. Ollum - that's the name of the demon who is trying to speak to you - is a chieftain of a small pack.

You suddenly realize what the demon wants - he offers Aoidoi his pack in exchange for the access... to the power of the Well?

name.en: Why would demons need the Well?

text.en:
As a reply, Ollum generates another train of imaginative thoughts. Here demons learn the culture of the living things, their language... Here they get rid of their ancient instincts, forced by Sarn on them... And here they leave Sarnaut.

Demons want to leave Sarnaut?

Ollum is shacking his head - that's supposed to be a nod. You see his request: he wants you to deliver the message to a "chief Aoidos".

Well... You can fulfill his request for now. You can kill him later.

name.en: Tell that demons drank the blood

text.en: Excellent. Now I need to concentrate...

If the demon had hesitated, you didn't notice that. You heard his consent in your head even before you finished speaking.

Now you just need to give blood to other demons.
Greetings, friend!
Right into the city of the stone monsters? Oh my...
Did something happen?
Bon voyage!
Greetings.
Right into the city of the stone monsters? Oh my...
Did something happen?
Bon voyage!
Welcome to Polis. You are welcomed here.
What do you want to know?

name.en: How long have you been here?

text.en:
This is not a simple question, but I'm ready to answer it.

The layer of Creation in which we dwell isn't subject to the laws of nature which control time and space. One of those laws is: time is an arrow which flies from the past into the future. Time is a straight line, and whichever two moments we take, one of them always precedes another. We cannot think of the Universe working any other way... But sometimes, it's possible.

After the death of the two gods, Ammer was born. Time and space were going wild, breaking all the existing laws. Time was spiral; it was a wave, a ripple on water.

And space was... Did you see that Astral storm? It was like the matter of Chaos falling into millions of shining pieces, with lightning bolts cutting through the sky and piercing the reflections of a thousand suns.

We were at the very heart of that storm.

It was a strange time, and we tried to sort it out all on our own. We knew the kernel of Chaos, for Sarn was its father. We knew how to protect our minds from it, for the Architect was our teacher.

Finally, we found balance and emerged from the endless wormhole into real Sarnaut. For you, that process took... less than three months, I assume? For us, it was several decades.

There's no point in fighting nature.  We could only wait and patiently arrange the chaos of time into the "arrow of time". We believe our birth was a natural reaction of the universe to a violation of its laws. Our purpose is to heal it. And our reward is life.

You may ask why we don't look combatant, and why we are all stargazers and sorcerers? The reason is that we had no one to fight. We were surprised by this gift - the ability to ignite the fires of war. And only when demons showed up on our doorstep, we realized what it was for.

name.en: So each of you has a gift?

text.en:
Not everyone, but many. Some devote their lives to their gifts and serve their people. Like me. I can see the Threads of Fate. I make predictions by looking at the canvas of the future... I predicted your arrival, Stormbringer, albeit I don't know why you were given that name in my visions.

Some find their vocation in sculpture, for example. The beautiful statues of our city are their work. Each one of us have a Purpose in life. This is the legacy of the Architect.

Don't be afraid of this name. He once was a great and noble god. But then, just like Sarn, he faced darkness which he couldn't handle... and became corrupted.

We can see our path clearly. We all have our purposes, but we live as one.

name.en: How are we going to fight demons?

text.en:
Several of our dominae went to the west. Demons were seen in a dangerous proximity from Polis, and I can feel that something terrible might happen unless we interfere.

First, we must counterattack. Demons are aggressive and primitive, and this plays into their hands right now. If we throw them back from our border, we will win the necessary time. Then your people will arrive, and we will be saved.
Where would you like to go?
The east coast is way too dangerous right now. I can't sent anyone there without an approval from the dominae.
We're packed today. The League and the Empire must be fighting for another allod! Well, I can't complain.
Congratulations! You're our client number 10,000 today! You win a free resurrection! What are you waiting for, get out!
We'll meet again!
For the Light and the Empire!

name.en: Ask to help in battle with the demon

text.en: Friend, it would be a great honor to fight alongside you! Let us burn the evil!

name.en: Ask to help in battle with the demon

text.en: You see, I'd love to help you kill that demon, but my command would not approve of that.
The Light will shine on you, child.

name.en: Ask to help in battle with the demon

text.en:
A good fight is always a pleasure!

Don't think that I'm too old for that. These hands can still slaughter hundreds of evil creatures!

name.en: Ask to help in battle with the demon

text.en: I would love to help you, but I can't battle alongside my enemy.
Aellona doesn't move...

The last hope vanishes as soon as you touch the lifeless body.

Aellona is dead and gone.
Aellona! What happened to her?
No... No!
She's gone...

It's the least I can do...

She died by my fault.
Welcome, stranger.

I am just a humble custodian of our residence. If you wish to learn more about our people, you should speak with the dominae.

However, I can tell you something.

Each Aoidos carries the memory of demons, stranger. We knew that one day we will have to face them, but still their invasion caught us off guard.

The magic of the Well protects this refuge from their claws and fangs. Demons can't enter this place, but anyone who steps outside the barrier will most certainly fall victim to Chaos.
My name is Aellona. I am a Domina - it is my title and my great responsibility. Why were you looking for me?

name.en: Ask how Aellona knows about the expedition

text.en: Well... Dominae bear a piece of the Creators' memory. We possess our knowledge right from the minute of our birth, and we also feel each other, wherever we are. So, we knew that you were coming. That's why we're just surprised, not shocked.

name.en: Ask what Aellona is waiting for here

text.en: Kyros, my beloved one, is a strong warrior. He forbade me from following him, but now this troubles me, for I can feel he is wounded, and there is no one to help him.

Other Aoidoi do not approve of my passion for battles... But this is not my fault that the Creators chose to endow me with the gift of swordsmanship!

I can see you want to ask many questions. We should go back now and have a conversation over a glass of beer in the Refuge.
Let's go!
How can I help you, friend?
My head hurts so much... I remember there were demons, and we were fighting them, but after that - nothing...
Alright... Breathe in, breathe out... I'm fine, I'm fine now.

name.en: Tell the fighter to prepare for a counterattack

text.en: Make Them Pay!
My head hurts so much... I remember there were demons, and we were fighting them, but after that - nothing...
Alright... Breathe in, breathe out... I'm fine, I'm fine now.

name.en: Tell the fighter to prepare for a counterattack

text.en: Make Them Pay!
My head hurts so much... I remember there were demons, and we were fighting them, but after that - nothing...
Alright... Breathe in, breathe out... I'm fine, I'm fine now.

name.en: Tell the fighter to prepare for a counterattack

text.en: Make Them Pay!
The Throne Room of the Dead City changed quite a bit over the summer...

You must be wondering what I am doing here. Well, just like every one else involved, I am very interested in the legacy of the fallen gods. Coming here in my true incarnation would prompt unnecessary questions, so I'm kind of acting incognito.

I supposed that after Sarn's death demons would break loose, and I was right. So when I noticed a large pack of demons heading toward this place, I joined the demon hunters who were chasing them.

This is it, basically. I would tell you more, but I'm afraid I don't have the time.

name.en: Ask what Eladia plans to do

text.en:
What am I planning to do? Well, have a cup of coffee, take a bath, listen to Etienne de Blizar's opera... But first I need to survive, because there are much more demons here than I expected. We barely survived the first attack. This place must be feeding them with some kind of power. I can only learn more about that if you helped me sustain that defensive barrier.

I can feel the echo of powerful magic coming from the north. I don't know who's fighting demons down there, but right now I could use help from anyone.
This dead fighter wasn't a hunter, but neither was he a demon. His body looks strange...
Ποιος είσαι εσύ?

name.en: Try and talk to the stranger

text.en: Σταματήστε! Μην έρχεστε πιο κοντά!
The stranger looks at you in surprise.
The stranger does not extend his hand in return. Looks like force is necessary...
Φύγε μακριά μου!
What... Who are you?!
What do you want?
Alright, alright. Just don't kick me!
There are spiders around here! While I waited here, I learned more about them than I ever wanted to.
You're... You're an entomologist, right! And tell Nezlobina that I’m alive and that I’ll visit her soon!
Hands off, you pleb! Great Dragons will come and take me away from this barbarian land!
Have you got any good news?

name.en: Ask for a chronometer from the ship

text.en: Be careful with it!
Aho, frriend!

name.en: Tell about the deal with the Spring Spirit

text.en:
Ay-hya, spirits are not to be trifled with! The gibberling family is lucky to be alive.

Here, take these seeds. We should make the master of the spring happy, eysh!
Zzz...

name.en: Try to wake up the soldier

text.en: Mom, I said I'm not going anywhere! Let me sleep...
Just one whiff... Aaagh! Don't! Get off me!
It's still warm. It smells like regular tobacco, but there's also a subtle scent of rot...
Get ready! I'm opening the Portal!
Get ready! I'm opening the Portal!

My name is Amos, and they call me the wisest of Aoidoi.

Only time will tell if it truly so.
This is unforgivable... His impatience already killed Aellona. If we give him a free rein, he’ll destroy us all.

name.en: Big words for the Dominus of Wisdom

text.en: Wisdom is not forgiveness of all sins. I need to ensure my people’s wellbeing. And I don’t need Cassandra to tell me that Kyros is a threat.
Unfortunately, this moment in history couldn't be averted.

Did I foresee it? Both yes and no.

I could see the picture of the future, but I couldn't work out what was leading up to it. My gift is complicated, Stormbringer. I didn't think that any of the dominae is capable of treachery, for we can hear each other's thoughts. And Kyros was one of us.
I didn't expect that from our old friend.

It's our fault, too. We shouldn't have put so much pressure on him after his loss. If you want my opinion, what Amos said wasn't very wise. Kyros was looking for someone to put the blame on, you say? Wasn't it us who had just put all the blame on him? We got what we deserved.

I wonder what Kyros wants... I don't think he himself understands that. If he did, then we'd know.

Oh... I need a drink.
So Kyros turned his back on us all. This was very reckless of him.
Is everyone alive? Seems like that...

Kyros was always striving to devote himself to our people. Even now, in the hour of madness, he couldn't commit that terrible crime. But I'm afraid his future deeds will hurt not only us, but the whole world...
I remember the moment Kyros was born. He had such bright eyes. So much strength in his gaze...

Kyros is lost. I can feel his pain, his despair... This sense of unfairness sits deep in his heart. Without it, he wouldn't have his gift.

Aellona's death distorted that feeling. Kyros misses his beloved one but... in the end, he just feels sorry for himself and wants to blame it all on someone. It is easier for him to blame it all on immortality than on himself.
There are some trails on the ground.

It looks like this was a herd of horses. But not wild ones - the prints of horseshoes can be seen clearly.

And Aoidoi do not breed horses...
A long spear. Who it belonged to?
An intricate pattern can be seen on the shaft. The blade is rather rough and was clearly made by means at hand. However, it is sharp enough to pierce the skin of a wild animal.
This was clearly an attempt to make a magic circle out of some strange crystals.
The crystals are cold to the touch. Whatever magic they contained, now it's gone.

This allod makes me seasick.

And I have sailed all the three seas left in Sarnaut.

The Secret Paths. The forbidden layer of the Planar Rim. Even Great Mages don't know how to get there. That place is made of so many thin threads and matters that even a slightest interference can wipe out a part of Sarnaut. And maybe even other worlds.

And now Kyros tries to get there. I say "tries" because if he had already succeeded, we wouldn't be speaking to each other right now. I suppose he failed, and instead the portal took him to some other place. Not too far away, I guess. You should ask the dominae about that - we've got to make at least some use of their telepathy.
Hello. Did Ionas send you?

I'm very sorry, but I couldn't save that warrior. Eight arrows damaged his internal organs, and he had several broken and fractured bones. The arrows were also poisoned...

You can examine his body and belongings. Maybe you will find some answers. He died without regaining consciousness, so I couldn't ask him anything.
An angry expression is frozen on the orc's face. He must have been infuriated with the circumstances of his death.

Celestia has extracted the arrows from the body. They have the same kind of patterns carved in them as that mysterious spear did.

The huge hematoma on the orc's chest resembles... a horseshoe?

Whoever killed this orc, he must have also been to the place where Kyros tried to open up a portal.

The orc also has a blood-covered bag on him.

Box lunch and propaganda materials of the Trinity Church.

He must have been a priest...

Oh dear Nezeb... Yes, a reaver called Whip the Fiery was the bodyguard of preacher Maya Milostina. And she didn't come back either... Now I see why. She must have been kidnapped.

Our hands are tied! We're on a foreign land! Damn it... We must first settle it with the dominae.
Let the Race begin!

It’s not the time yet. View the race schedule in the Calendar, Stormbringer.

The race starts daily at 11:15 AM; 2:15 PM; 5:15 PM; 8:15 PM; 11:15 PM.

You are going to be one of nine gladiators fighting at the Arena. When you inflict damage or defeat an enemy, you score points. If you are defeated, you lose points. Participants who score most points will take prize places.

Everybody is fighting against everybody.

Good luck!
Good day. A perfect day for some sports!

name.en: Join the queue to the Gladiator arena

text.en:
You are now registered as a participant!

You may have to wait for a while before your opponents join the battle. You can see the queue progress in the Skirmishes list.

Oh hello! Please take me to the central portal!  We must get there unnoticed. I will follow you, sneak when you sneak, speed up when you speed up. But if we are noticed, I’m going to return to this cage. It will remain open, but we will have to start all over again.

Don’t look at me like that - these are the rules.

Oh hello! Please take me to the central portal!  We must get there unnoticed. I will follow you, sneak when you sneak, speed up when you speed up. But if we are noticed, I’m going to return to this cage. It will remain open, but we will have to start all over again.

It’s so exciting, isn’t it?!

Oh hello! Please take me to the central portal! We must get there unnoticed. I will follow you, sneak when you sneak, speed up when you speed up. But if we are noticed, I’m going to return to this cage. It will remain opened, but we will have to start all over again.

Alright?
This is the Labyrinth entrance.

Vigilant: cannot be distracted, cannot be sneaked by; one can only walk around his field of vision or hide behind terrain elements.

Keen: can be distracted but notices if one tries to sneak by him.

Absent-Minded: can be sneaked by but cannot be distracted.
I am in charge of the Labyrinth. You can come here everyday and make an attempt to pass the trial. Tell me when you’re ready.

You need to find three Aoidoi in the Labyrinth. To release them, you will need Crystal keys, so collect them on your way. After releasing the Aoidoi, take them to the central portal.

Don’t let the Minotaurs notice you! Every time they do, you will be fined. The less penalty points you have by the end of the trial, the more rewards you will get.
Greetings!
Before you begin your trial, let me explain the rules.
What?! I don’t give away no mana batteries. I’m calling the guards now...
What are you doing here?! Get out of here, now, you leeches!

name.en: How could poison get into the caldron?

text.en: If only I knew, Stormbringer. Of course I tried the food first, even before the Domina, but as you can see I’m perfectly fine. How could poison get into the caldron in those two minutes... I’m sure nobody approached it! I take my job very seriously.
A shame! Shame on my art!

name.en: Did you discover the nature of poison?

text.en:
Both yes and no. I found the answer, but it only generated more questions.

I know it’s magic poison, but this kind of magic is unknown to us. With every minute, more and more soup in this caldron turns into deadly poison. The aggressive substance devours matter... and transforms it. The caldron itself is corroding - we need to find a safe place to contain this terrible thing. And I wouldn’t dare to pour it on the ground...

Cassandra is getting worse, Stormbringer. She’s still alive because she’s an Aoidos; our bodies are built to sustain poison. But she won’t last forever...

Here’s a poison sample. We need all knowledge that we can possibly obtain. Find the most experienced sorcerer that you know and show this thing to them! Hurry up!
I wish I could say “Good day”, but it’s not...

Damn it! Where did you get it?! Do you even know what that is? It’s Tangible Darkness, the Primary Poison!

What’s inside of this bottle wasn’t meant for the eyes of the mortal. It’s not even a substance, it’s... Nothing. It doesn’t belong to this world. It is the opposite of everything that exists.

Now when it’s here... and it took shape, because you can’t exist without a shape in this world even if you’re Nothing. Darkness... Could it be Nihaz’s villainy? But why? Anyway, now we need to decide what do we do about this thing.
Cheer up. The Aoidoi are being way too kind to us! You should enjoy it while you still can.
Cassandra lies still. You can see darkness sparkling under her eyelids.

name.en: Remind of Soliskar’s duty and tell about the Darkness

text.en:
Grr... Well, you are right. I am bound to fulfill my duty and help you... Let it be so.

I am indeed familiar with the Darkness. Dragon fire can banish it from our world. But since it’s inside Cassandra, my fire will also destroy her... Hmm... I will take a look at her and see what I can do. I can’t promise she will survive.
You again... I wonder why do we keep meeting.
The Observatory. My humble residence. You will discover more when the time comes - your fate is wedded with this place.

So Soliskar tied herself and Cassandra with bonds of life? What a sacrifice... And she did it because of her duty to you. Because you had saved her from the sorceress possessed by Sarn. Who had been, in his turn, imprisoned by Nihaz. And Nihaz, as Klavdia assumes, is responsible for the poisoning... The circle has closed, right? But something doesn’t add up in this story. Why would Nihaz do that? Why would Soliskar doom herself to dependence on a fragile mortal life? Because bonds of life (and death) are called so for a reason. This all is very odd...

Well, we’ll learn everything in due time, I suppose. Now let’s return to the Games!

name.en: What will happen to the Games?

text.en: Nothing! Things will take their course. I think Phoebus is done with his trial - you will love it! Good luck.
Greetings!

So you have swallowed the bait. Everyone - you, Cassandra, the rest of Aoidoi, the rest of Sarnaut... Nihaz got just what he wanted.

Yes, you understood correctly - I was the one to show him the way in. Don’t let your anger get in the way of reason - we are all Nihaz’s enemies, both you and I. His arrival will help us all, however hard it is for you to comprehend it. We desperately need to behold the power of the Dark God and realize our own futility. Because if we don’t see the terror which is upon us, we will never understand we don’t have the time for our petty strife.

It’s hard to talk bearing the weight of the times on my shoulders, Stormbringer. Let me...
We have the whole infinity of time... And we’re infinitely running short on it.

name.en: Offer to participate in the games

text.en:
Me? But... I’m a musician, not an athlete. What’s the point?

Alright, I will do as you suggest. Maybe I will find some inspiration in it... Or not. But still better than idling around.

Oh, Stormbringer... Hello.

Not bad, right? The games, I mean. I wonder what it feels like to be an athlete.

Everybody’s going to watch me fail! No-no, Stormbringer, thank you, but I will just disgrace myself.

However, riding Amos’ chariots seems fun...

That’s incredible... There’s so many different creatures in the world. All have their own traditions and history... Own tastes and habits. And still they’re here to see the Games! Isn’t this exciting?

I wish I could participate but...
Greetings!

You will have to leap over obstacles. There are three types of them: low, high, and long. This means you can make three types of leaps: short, long, and high. Choose wisely!

Collect bonuses as you race. The more you collect, the bigger will be your reward. The trial is time-limited, so concentrate!

Are you ready?

name.en: Remind me what we are trying to do?

text.en: Your goal is to find and release the Aoidos who is locked in the cage on the Labyrinth’s edge. On your way, you need to collect 5 cage keys and avoid the Minotaurs.

There are three types of them.

Vigilant: cannot be distracted, cannot be sneaked by; one can only walk around his field of vision or hide behind terrain elements.

Keen: can be distracted but notices if one tries to sneak by him.

Absent-Minded: can be sneaked by but cannot be distracted.
Be careful. Come again if you need to ask about the rules.

Great. Those were the basics.

When you come here again, the rules will be harder. You can tell Ionas everything went perrfectly!

Use the portal to exit the Labyrinth.
How is it going?

There are three types of them.

Vigilant: cannot be distracted, cannot be sneaked by; one can only walk around his field of vision or hide behind terrain elements.

Keen: can be distracted but notices if one tries to sneak by him.

Absent-Minded: can be sneaked by but cannot be distracted.

I will remind you what you need to do on our way. And right now we need to go through that teleport behind me.

Are you ready?

name.en: Ionas sent me to participate in the test trial.

text.en:
Oh, wonderful. The Labyrinth is almost completed, and we have one corridor ready for the test trial.

Your goal is to find and release the Aoidos who is locked in the cage on the Labyrinth’s edge. On your way, you need to collect 5 cage keys to unlock the cage. Avoid the Minotaurs!
Greetings, Stormbringer!

Listen, I have an idea. A Spring Spirit dwells here on Ammer. Those springs hate dirt. If you let it know that these beasts are drowning in their own dung, it will be enraged... And rain all the cleansing power of nature on them!

You just need to make sure it doesn’t kill them. Sometimes those spirits can get carried away...
The sky is clear above this land, cuat.

name.en: We have those dirty Pegasi in our stables and...

text.en:
Dirty beasts, you say?!

Listen closely. Take my Spring Stone. Take it to the dirty beasts. Lift it above your help and call on my power!

My children will come to your call and clean your stables. Now go! You bore me.
What do you want, you insolent creature?

name.en: Ask how do you bring the balls back

text.en:
Oh, they are charged with magic right now... This won’t be easy. They will try to escape, and there is no magical barrier here that can hold them! We must catch them before it’s too late.

There are three kinds of balls - blue, red, and yellow. There are a lot of blue ones, fewer red ones, and very few yellow ones. The blues ones are peaceful and slow. The red ones will try to kill you! And the yellow ones just like to fly around like crazy - it won’t be easy to catch them.

Ah, and take this rune. It will help you put the red balls to sleep for a short time - just to let you put them in the bag. Hurry up, Stormbringer!

In the first phase, you need to fly through the rings. It might seem easy, but it’s not.

In the second phase, you need to catch as many yellow and blue balls as possible. Each blue ball gives you 1 point; each yellow ghostly ball gives you 10 points.

In the third phase, you need to throw the balls - once through each ring. If you do it on your first attempt, you will score additional points.

Beware of the red Bouncer Balls! They will attack you and try to throw you to the ground, and then you will lose points and time!

The more points you score, the higher is your reward!

In the first phase, you need to fly through the rings. It might seem easy, but it’s not.

In the second phase, you need to catch as many yellow and blue balls as possible. Each blue ball gives you 1 point; each yellow ghostly ball gives you 10 points.

In the third phase, you need to throw the balls - once through each ring. If you do it on your first attempt, you will score additional points.

Beware of the red Bouncer Balls! They will attack you and try to throw you to the ground, and then you will lose points and time!

The more points you score, the higher is your reward!
Do you remember what you have to do? If you change your mind, tell me, and I will bring you back to the Coliseum.

name.en: How do I catch a ball?

text.en:
When you’re standing next to a ball, use “Catch the ball” ability to... catch the ball!

Try and catch this blue one above us.

Mount the Pegasus and use “Wing Swing” ability. You’ll see what happens next...

Get into the air and fly three times through any rings above us.

name.en: How do I throw a ball?

text.en:
When there’s a ring in front of you, use “Throw the ball” ability and try to be precise!

Now get into the air and try to throw two balls into the ring above us.

Well, you’re not hopeless. Go back to Dionysius and tell him you’re ready.

If you have any questions, shoot away!

name.en: Ask about flying one more time.

text.en: What do you want to hear again?
I will teach you how to fly Pegasi! Whether you want it or not.
Well, let’s start the real trial! I’m teleporting you to the start on the tower top. Grab your Pegasus and fly!

name.en: I need the right gear for the fight with Thalos.

text.en:
That’s true. Thalos is a formidable enemy. I have something that once belonged to Kyros.

Here.

name.en: I’m going to fight Thalos. What should I do?

text.en:
Before you is the Whirlpool of Time – a special portal that sends you to the void where I temporarily exiled Thalos. There you can fight him without putting our world at risk.

Hurry up! There is little time. My charms won’t last long.
Time’s short...

name.en: Enter the Whirl and challenge Thalos

text.en: Entering.

Beyond the Whirl - is another time and unknown space...

Are you ready for a dive?

Well... you too. Let me introduce myself - Dakkar de Desirae, the prince of the House. This is my beloved wife, Svetlana Valir.

Are you going to participate in the Games? Good to hear that! We should encourage the wonderful endeavors of this young race.

Great Astral! I barely recognized you! Back in that terrible castle you looked much less... intimidating. I wish I could listen to the stories of your adventures! All I hear recently is the news from my rivals from other Houses. The Great Ball is coming, you know. Things aren’t going that smooth in the elven community...

But let’s not talk about that!

Are you going to participate in the Games? Good to hear that! We should encourage the wonderful endeavors of this young race.
I’m listening.

Are you from the Empire? Well, I don’t care! Mark my word - if you keep fighting because of those silly patches on your shoulders, you’ll bring yourself to your doom.

Take Kanians and Xadaganians! They’re all human. They’re absolutely the same! And what are they fighting over? Something that happened even before the Cataclysm? Bah! Idiots.

Well, have a good day, anyway.

name.en: How is it going in the New Land?

text.en:
Remember how I told you we were going to turn the New Land into a garden city? Froddy sticks to his word, huh. With Nordrak’s help, our sorcerers are driving the cold Astral streams away from the allod, and the glaciers are finally starting to melt!

The plants are following the call of the Great Tree! The grass is starting to grow, and in a couple of years this place will be all green, mark my word!

Extreme fertility!

Look at this! As soon as you drop a seed on the ground, it shoots up into the sky in a blink of an eye!

We need Ammer soil in the New Land!

A lot of things. The only reason I’m talking to you is that I remember your heroic deeds on Dane. I must say I’m tired of the endless attempts to reconcile us.

Maybe I’m too old for this?..

Apart from a hundred Imperial soldiers around me? Apart from the Great Imperial Mage? Apart from these strange unfamiliar lands? Nothing, absolutely nothing!

I know I shouldn’t be so anxious and trust my men-at-arms... But I just can’t. Maybe I’m too old for this?..
Hm...

That’s right. I must say these lands are much prettier that those under the gray skies of Xadagan.

I remember how they called me the Arisen-Who-Lived. I’ve had so many other names since then...

The world changes, and only one thing stays the same - idiots are fighting idiots. There’s no secret that I put my hopes on the Aoidoi.

They are way too pure and naive for war. They can put an end to this! We all should finally learn the lessons of the past.

name.en: I remember you from the Holy Land!

text.en: And I remember you, too. I can’t say those are pleasant memories.
Nefer Ur looks at you, waiting for something.

name.en: So how do you like Ammer?

text.en:
Everything is so pink and shiny. The ladies are pretty, huh.

I’m on my leave warrant, officially. So I can just relax without even thinking of all the military stuff. I’m in the Astralborne forces, you know. We are dropped into battle right from Astral ships! It’s fun, though usually we don’t last long. I’m a lucky long-liver, huh.

It must be nice to live without war. Maybe we can teach the younger generation to be friendlier...

Because if we don’t, we all just might die out one day, haha!

Oh, I know you. You’re the hero of Dane!

I’m on my leave warrant, officially. So I can just relax without even thinking of all the military stuff. I’m from the Astralborne forces, you know. We are dropped into battle right from Astral ships! It’s fun, though usually we don’t last long. I’m a lucky long-liver, huh.
What do you want?
Teleporting.

name.en: Tell about the stands of the League and the Empire

text.en:
Well, I should have guessed. Even the brightest of minds can’t take a stand against the masses. Dust fighting dust, year after year, century after century. Fate has given them common enemies, but they still can’t forget their strife. It’s a shame. But this is how our primitive society works.

Except our next enemy can just wipe us all off the face of Sarnaut.

Nihaz is coming.

What are you going to do?

name.en: Explain why the people of Sarnaut are ignoring the threat of Nihaz’s arrival.

text.en:
Your deeds may be great but they led the people of Sarnaut to thinking that if you had defeated Nihaz once, you can do this again. Ha!

But there was no first time. The Dark God was running away from boredom, not from death. And the death of his old friend has drawn his attention to your world again... It’s a shame nobody listens to Klavdia. Her connection with Sarnaut is deeper than anyone else’s.
My people call me the Dominus of Creation. May it be so.

name.en: I need to know if anyone suspicious has left this place recently.

text.en: Of course, I'm happy to help! There have been many flights, both from here and from the House de Delice's residence, but I can say for sure that no one suspicious has left the port. It's where Tassilon de Ardeur works!

name.en: Here's the king's decree that shuts down flights from Irene.

text.en: Understood. It will be done.

name.en: I need to know if anyone suspicious has left this place recently.

text.en: Absolutely not. There have been no flights from here. And I can assure you that no one suspicious has left Irene from the House de Delice's residence. It's where Josephine de Ardeur works.

name.en: Here's the king's decree that shuts down flights from Irene.

text.en: Let's see... I'll get it done.

name.en: I need to know if anyone suspicious has left this place recently.

text.en: I guess I must be honest. There have been no strange flights from here, and I can say the same about the House de Blizare's residence where Sherman de Ardeur works.

name.en: Here's the king's decree that shuts down flights from Irene.

text.en: I see. I'll get it done. No problem.

name.en: I need to know if anyone suspicious has left this place recently.

text.en: No. You can trust me: just some regular boring flights – to brothels and residences. I know for sure that there have been no strange flights from the House de Blizare's residence where Sherman de Ardeur works.

name.en: Here's the king's decree that shuts down flights from Irene.

text.en: Let me see... Got it.

name.en: I need to know if anyone suspicious has left this place recently.

text.en: Of course not, I would've reported it at once! There have been no special flights from here! But there were some from the House de Delice's residence...

name.en: Here's the king's decree that shuts down flights from Irene.

text.en: Yes, yes. I expected something like this...

name.en: I need to know if anyone suspicious has left this place recently.

text.en: Hm... Since the king sent you... I can tell you there have been strange flights both from here and from the pier in the northern districts where Tilbert de Ardeur works. But that's all I can tell you!

name.en: Here's the king's decree that shuts down flights from Irene.

text.en: Hmm... Yes, everything is in order. I'll get it done.

We have... discussed it with Louis.

Here, a royal decree that orders the closing of all ports on Irene. You will need to inform all the gondoliers of this.

But anyone could run an errand like this, not just the Hero of Sarnaut. Think of it as an extra precaution and a smokescreen. I’m almost certain the general has already left Irene, along with the artifact, and he’s being hunted as we speak.  You’ll have to speak with all the gondoliers and find out if anyone suspicious used their services, and if they did, ask where they went.

Some of them will probably lie. You can be sure that Panto near the palace and Tilbert in the northern districts will tell you the truth, but I’m not so sure about the others.

Hear them all out, and then use your brains to analyze their words and identify contradictions.

Return to Louis once you figure everything out.

name.en: Louis ordered me to return the artifact to you.

text.en:
Yes, yes, of course... Remember the secret meeting you escorted me to?

Ah, love is so fickle and fleeting...

Anyway, I gave the artifact to a very sweet Xadaganian - let’s call him “General”.

Back then I already suspected they’d try to steal the artifact from me and decided it would be safe to get it off Irene – just for a while, of course, and by someone no one would suspect.

Well, it seems I was wrong. Eurial was smarter.

name.en: Where is the general with the artifact now?

text.en:
He should have secretly left Irene. Since Renard knows everything, we have two options.

First: the artifact is still here. In that case, we need to close all ports on Irene, so we can quietly find out where it is.

Second option: my general managed to leave Irene. Then he probably has people after him, and you will have to chase them all down.
Ah, ... I know what you want to talk about.

name.en:
[Report what you heard from the gondoliers]

Something is not right here.

text.en: Yes, I see... One of them definitely helped the person we are looking for. Did you find out who it was?

name.en: All gondoliers have been informed of the decree. Everyone will comply with it.

text.en:
Excellent. In the meantime, Blanche and her intelligence service combed through Irene. By the looks of things, neither the artifact nor the general is here, and they haven’t been for a while. And someone is trying to conceal this fact.

What did you learn from the gondoliers?

name.en: I believe we should question Sherman de Ardeur, the gondolier of the House de Blizare’s residence.

text.en: No, I’m certain they are trying to divert our attention. I’ll need to think...

name.en: I believe we should question Josephine de Ardeur, the gondolier of the House de Delice’s residence.

text.en: That’s strange, she doesn’t seem suspicious. We should look more carefully at the gondolier’s statements.

name.en: I believe we should question Tilbert de Ardeur, the gondolier of the northern districts.

text.en: I disagree. I believe you are wrong. Nothing indicates he’s the one.

name.en: I believe we should question Panto de Ardeur, the gondolier of the palace garden.

text.en: Hmm, no. He wouldn’t lie to us. I trust him.

name.en: I believe we should question Tassilon de Ardeur, the port gondolier.

text.en: Right! Everything points to him! According to Panto and Tilbert, who wouldn’t lie, and Josephine was also telling the truth. In that case, if what Josephine said was true, then it was Sherman who lied. And if he lied, then someone did leave the port... We need to question him immediately.

name.en: I believe we should question Alice de Ardeur, the gondolier of the House de Vevre’s residence.

text.en: Yes, her words are suspicious, but I think she’s just trying to confuse us. We need to keep looking...

You can't handle Tassilon alone, and you'll probably need help again in the future. We'll give you a magic scroll that will allow you to summon our best servants. You have already met them: Ivok, the smartest Aviak, and Potis, the strongest of them.

With their help, you can overcome his resistance. Just visit him with these two and put pressure on him: order Potis to intimidate him, and once it's working, let Ivok reassure him. This should wear him down quickly. And your silence will be the thing that will scare him most! Can you handle it?
That's what We like about you! Here's the scroll. Hurry! Once you learn everything, don't waste time reporting back to me. Go to Blanche right away.

name.en: We found out where the general went – it's somewhere on Ferris. Unfortunately Eurial followed him there.

text.en:
What?! And you came to me with this? Instead of setting out at once...?! That was the right thing to do! Haste without a plan makes waste.

Now listen carefully. The bad news is we don't know where the general is going exactly. And there's no time to find that out.

The good news is we know the local teleportation master, Sarang Ashturi. She has spent years on Ferris – she should know a little about everything that takes place there.

The second good news is Ivok's perception and Potis's eyesight. Ferris's landscapes are too... Vast for you to be able to find any traces on your own. So if you find out where the general was headed, listen to them.

Is your task clear?
Then don't dawdle. We'll ensure you'll have no problems with the portals.

name.en: [Tell her about the search in the snow, the camp, battle with Eurial, and the artifact]

text.en: Wow, what a story! I'd listen to that every day! I hope someday I'll be a part of something like this myself...

name.en: As the local portal keeper, you must know everything that's happening around here?

text.en: Of course! Why do you ask? Such curiosity from the Hero of Sarnaut...!

name.en: I'm on a very important mission and I must know if there have been any strange trips to Ferris lately.

text.en:
Ooh, adventures... I wish I could go on one!

You must be talking about the Xadaganian general that decided to mount an expedition to the icy place, and about the crazy Lamia queen that's looking for him? Why are you staring? As though anything ever happens here...

I don't know much, but I'll tell you what I know. I heard this general wanted to make camp somewhere near the Frozen Lake, the one in the center of the Bone Valley. I'll mark it on your map.

You should hurry. The vipers looked angry... Once you deal with all that, come back and tell me everything, alright?
People don't talk to me often...

name.en: Why did you need the artifact?

text.en:
I needed it because we were going to the Dragon Bay. The skeleton of one of the Great Dragons is buried there, along with the never-dying heart, the source of dragon blood. The Bond is the artifact used by the Great Mages of elves to bind dragons and collect their blood... It's quite a useful thing...

The Empire needs new Great Mages, so a new source of this blood would come in handy.

And Ferris is the Empire's territory. As an Imperial citizen, you might agree with me...

name.en: Why did you need the artifact?

text.en:
I needed it because we were going to the Dragon Bay. The skeleton of one of the Great Dragons is buried there, along with the never-dying heart, the source of dragon blood. The Bond is the artifact used by the Great Mages of elves to bind dragons and collect their blood... It's quite a useful thing...

The Empire needs new Great Mages, so a new source of this blood would come in handy.

I know the League sent an expedition to Ferris, too, but it's the Empire's territory! Any speculation about it being a part of ancient Isa is irrelevant.

name.en: So how did you, an Imperial general, come to know the elven queen?

text.en:
Love knows no bounds!

Lucretia is a delicate flower among all the weeds. Intrigues weigh heavily on her, and she longs for adventures. I got her attention with stories of my feats, and she showed me a lot... in the art of love.

At any rate, I didn't betray my homeland. Everything I do serves a purpose. I want there to be peace between the League and Empire. The Empire really needs peace right now.

name.en: Elven queen and Imperial general? And you're a couple?

text.en:
Love knows no bounds!

Lucretia is a delicate flower among all the weeds. Intrigues weigh heavily on her, and she longs for adventures. I got her attention with stories of my feats, and she showed me a lot... in the art of love.

I heard many Leaguers are tired of the war... And I personally know those who became close with someone they had only seen through the eye-slit of their visor before. So it shouldn't surprise you.
What a beast! It's a miracle we escaped.
Oh Tensess, Nezeb, and Skrakan... Everything hurts...!

name.en: General George Bekin is alive and will be alright.

text.en:
I'm glad to hear that! I told you Eurial is capable of anything! She is a viper waiting for an opportunity to strike while everyone falls for her innocent act! A "lovely creature", a "living embodiment of the ideals of the elven race", a "goddess of beauty"... If only you knew how they praise this upstart! She's hiding something, some dark mystery of her origins, I'm sure of it!

Oh, my poor George... I hope I'll see him again soon.
You did it...! I'm safe! What about my dear George? How is he? Is he okay?
Please tell me you found him! I can't endure Renard's glares any longer, it's like he's trying to set me on fire with his eyes.
Only our trusted patrons who have the key.
I'm listening.
No, guests are not allowed here. The mistress's personal chambers.
Of course! Just use your key!

name.en: Could you give me your clothes?

text.en: Whaaat? Why would I?!

name.en: Do you know any places that should be avoided?

text.en: Hmm... Why do you need to know? I don't like weirdos...

name.en: It's my first time here, I don't want any trouble.

text.en: Ah, that's wise! You can go anywhere, there are no secrets. Just stay away from the door guarded by the lamia - it's a private zone, only for the best customers, like me...
Only those who are dressed in a certain way and have a key! What are you bothering me with this? Bring me something to drink...

name.en: I'm a secret admirer of Eurial and would like to know everything about her...

text.en: Ahhh! You're not the only one... Now go... Bring me some wine...

name.en: I'm a spy looking for secret information!

text.en: I see you're off your rocker! Go away... And come back with wine...

name.en: Could you give me your key?

text.en: What now? I don't carry it on me – because of people like you...
Huh...? What is it...?
Thanks!

name.en: Could you give me your clothes?

text.en: Wow! What is this, a role-playing gag?

name.en: Yes, I want to trick my friend so he thinks I'm someone else!

text.en: I like tricks! I won't give you my clothes, of course, but I left another set in my secret stash at the top of the main building – a spare one in case I fall in the water or something, haha!

name.en: I'm a spy, it's a disguise!

text.en: Right, already heard this one...

name.en: I want to try it on

text.en: You need a couturier, it's not something I do!

name.en: Do you know any places that should be avoided?

text.en: The edge of the allod! Why? Are you spying on us?

name.en: It's my first time here, I don't want any trouble.

text.en: So boring... Just standing next to you makes me feel drowsy.

name.en: I'm a secret admirer of Eurial and would like to know everything about her...

text.en: Hah... Take this elsewhere!

name.en: Of course! I'm a spy looking for secret information!

text.en: Aah, I knew it, haha! Go wherever you want, just avoid that door guarded by the lamia. It's a special place...
It's for trusted people, like me! You can't get in without a special outfit and a key!

name.en: Could you give me your key?

text.en: I can't imagine why you'd want it! But maybe I could use your help with that...
I went on a bender a while ago, must have dropped it somewhere... Could you look around, please?
Yes? I did lose mine, but... Hm... I found another one... Listen, throw this one away, and forget all about it!
Oh, hello!

name.en: Could you give me your clothes?

text.en: Hmm... While I understand why you might need that, I can't help you. Sorry.

name.en: Do you know any places that should be avoided?

text.en: Oh, what a strange question...

name.en: It's my first time here, I don't want any trouble.

text.en: Trouble... Life without trouble is boring!

name.en: I'm a secret admirer of Eurial and would like to know everything about her...

text.en: I know what you mean! I understand... There is a special place – the door guarded by the lamia, but I doubt they will let you in...
You need to be dressed a certain way – it's what Eurial's trusted people wear. Like me, for example.

name.en: Of course! I'm a spy looking for secret information!

text.en: That's a stupid joke...

name.en: Could you give me your key?

text.en: Oh, well. Maybe? I don't know. I found one just recently, but... Why do you need it?

name.en: I want to see what's behind that secret door!

text.en: Sorry, but this is not some game!

name.en: I want to know more about my beloved, Eurial...

text.en: How sweet! For love, I'll pretend I've lost my key – it won't be the first time!

name.en: I don’t know, perhaps we could become closer?

text.en: Oh, sorry... I'm not interested...
Oh, hello!
How would I know? I haven't been there. But the place is packed right now, so with your talents you'll be able to get lost in the crowd. You'll figure out the rest.
Just no more questions.
Good luck there.
Pretend you don't know me.

I have a very important meeting, and there will be attempts to disrupt it even here, so this disguise is not enough. I asked you for help, because your company won't draw attention, and if things go south, you can protect me. And also because you won't ask too many questions. So, are we going? We don’t have much time.

This shard is called Secluded Sanctuary. The name fits. People rarely come here – only when they seek solitude. It's a great place for secret royal meetings, if you disregard the complete lack of guards.

They say special magic dwells here – whatever the cause, no one has found an explanation for the local lake's infinite supply of water which flows to the beautiful canals in the city and the river in our forest.
I'll tell you after the meeting.
Great.
Oh, ! You're just in time...

name.en: The king said you needed help...

text.en: But let's not talk about it here... I want you to escort me somewhere, and we can't waste any time!

name.en: What do I need to do?

text.en:
I need you to do something for me outside the palace grounds. It would be too suspicious if we left together, so we'll meet there.

Among the shards of Irene, there's one you have probably never visited before, and the gondoliers won't offer to take you there. You'll go to the gondola near the palace and ask the gondolier to take you to the Secluded Sanctuary.

Constance and I... we'll find our own way there and wait for you on the pier.
I'm listening!

name.en: I'm here on a secret mission I can't talk about.

text.en: Truly? This is where our interests cross... But my mission is not that secret. I'm looking for my sister. I have reasons to believe there's a connection between her and Eurial. You have probably found something inside – give it to us, and you can leave.

name.en: I'm afraid I can't do that. But later...

text.en: There will be no "later"! You do realize you either hand it to us, or we'll... take it, right?
Thank you for this.

I didn't want to alarm the queen, but I think someone was watching us from the windows of the next building... I hope I'm wrong, but we need to be careful. I don't think her date... Oh, I mean meeting, will take much time.
Turning uncouth heroes into dignified young people! We, the House de Grandeur, will do everything in our power to make sure you do not embarrass yourselves at the royal reception.

No specific instructions – you have to feel it in your heart! To make it less complicated, I will approve of your correct behavior and disapprove of bad one. Know that I assess your every move, and the more elegant gestures you use to express yourself, the better!

But all in all... Enjoy your evening! Try some wine or engage someone in conversation.

Just don't speak with Solemna de Ardeur – you won't hear anything good from her, that's for sure.

name.en: What will I get for this?

text.en:
You heroes never do anything for free! What about invaluable social skills?

...Fine, of course we reward those who make an effort. I'll be watching you, and you can come get your reward at any time. But remember: the greater the effort, the better the reward!

You can get your reward either during the lesson by talking to me, or we'll reward you afterwards along with everyone else.
Join us! A lesson is in progress!
But don't stray too far, the next lesson begins soon! We'll just clean up a little...
That's it...? Well, I'll find some kind of consolation reward for you, but you might want to stay a bit longer and earn something worthwhile...

name.en: No, I've had enough, I want my prize!

text.en: Oh, if you say so...
You did quite well! Are you sure you want to take your reward now? I think you can do even better...

name.en: Thank you, but I'm feeling a tad exhausted.

text.en: That's too bad... Here's your well-deserved reward!
I'll be happy to reward you with our best prize! Please don't leave us before the lesson ends – show other heroes a proper way to conduct oneself!

name.en: It's difficult to express my gratitude for the opportunity! Of course, I'll stay and be an example for others.

text.en: Splendid, splendid!
The audacity! Get out before I report your "performance" to the guard!
You already got your reward, don't try and trick me! If you want another, wait until the next lesson!

That farce of the House de Grandeur and their attempts to teach something they don't know themselves. Arranging "free lessons" to "teach others manners"!

Maybe you could help me... liven up this event? Break a glass or something...

Just don't do what they ask you to do and show them what impropriety means. Smash glasses, dance on the table – let yourself be free.

They didn't let me organize the tenth anniversary, Catherina handled everything! Now I'll show them what a good party looks like!

I'll back you up so no one will throw you out early. Just make sure to give it your everything.

name.en: What will I get for this?

text.en:
What about the fun you'll have in the process?!

Fine, I have gifts you'll appreciate. The bigger the mess you make, the happier I'll be!

You can get your reward either during the lesson by talking to me, or we'll reward you afterwards along with everyone else.
What, you don't like this farce either? We are alike, you and I...
Stay close – it's going to start soon, and I'll find a fun activity for you...
You have already received it. Help me next time – you'll get more!
Pfft, that was pitiful. I expected more from you. I'll find something to give you, but are you sure you don't want to stay longer?
Here, then.
That was fun! Are you sure you've had enough? I'll give you your reward, of course, but I think there's potential for something better here.

name.en: No, that's quite enough, or I'll have a headache in the morning.

text.en: Oh... Well then, come back soon!
Hahaha! You should've seen her face! I didn't know heroes could do that!
Hahaha... Huh? What? Yes, here it is. Thanks.
Pfft, you? For what? For following Cecilia's orders? Go see her, then.
A true social event! Don't waste your time – enter and prove yourself, and if you need something, speak with Cecilia de Grandeur, she's in charge of this event.
We ask you to take part in this noble endeavor – it's in full swing!
Soon a social event will take place here! I suggest you speak with Cecilia de Grandeur - she is in charge of this event.
Oh, ! Don't stray too far, our lesson is starting soon!
Fun under the guise of decorum! Come in and speak with Solemna de Ardeur, or jump in and enjoy yourself! Don't let snobbish comments discourage you!
What are you waiting for?! Come in before you miss it!
Here we are holding a rather unusual event: under the guise of decorum, we learn to be ourselves and have fun! Speak with Solemna de Ardeur – she should be somewhere on the podium.
Next lesson will begin soon! Don't miss it!
Ugh... I can't run anymore... If you want to beat me up, do it. Just don't make me run...

name.en: I'm not going to beat you up!

text.en: Oh, , it's you! Sorry, I didn't recognize you. With my lifestyle, it's usually safer to run away... Why are you here?

name.en: The king wanted to make sure you were fine and to remind you of your responsibilities.

text.en: Of course I'm fine, didn't you see me running?! The Hero of Sarnaut could barely keep up! As for my responsibilities... Yes, I got carried away, perhaps. I'll get back to work... Tonight, I think.

name.en: I'll report back to the king.

text.en: Go ahead.
To what do I owe the pleasure...?

Oh, ! I've heard about your skills.

You wish to challenge me? Go ahead!

name.en: They say you're the best fencer on Irene!

text.en:
If they say so, then I am.

Let me guess... You want to challenge me, too?

name.en: Yes! Fight me, then we'll see who is the best.

text.en:
That's quite... ambitious of you.

But if I fight everyone who wants to challenge me for the title, I'll have no time for my personal life. First prove you are really worth my time.

Well, let's say... Win a hundred duels on Irene.

But pick strong opponents, not weaklings, or else you won't learn anything. You don't think defeating me will be easy, do you?

Once you have honed your skills, find me. I'll give you a fight.

Ciao!

Oh, that's too bad!

Do you want to play another character?

name.en: How do I take part in the play?

text.en:
We have three roles in our play: King Grallon, his daughter Princess Daguta, and the mysterious Traveler whose name is unknown. You can choose any of the roles. Talk to me when you do. Hurry, because someone else may pick the role.

Our audience experiences a range of emotions during the performance. We must ensure that the play elicits all sorts of emotions from them. So a good actor watches the audience, trying to engage them with their acting. Give them a full spectrum of emotions – and they will be elated!

Perhaps we won't find enough actors for the play... But that's alright! My assistants will fill in the rest of the roles. Of course, it's better when characters are played by people who understand each other, so if you have friends who might be interested – invite them here.

name.en: How do I take part in the play?

text.en: Oh, it's very simple. I'll tell you when the time comes. For now, just enjoy the performance of others.

Oh, it's a famous story closely tied to Irene!

The last elven kingdom used to be here. During the Cataclysm, it survived only thanks to a mysterious artifact that King Grallon kept close – the Key of Creation. The king had a daughter, young Princess Daguta who was trying to get herself a husband.

Everything was fine until a mysterious Stranger showed up at the gates, guided by his own ambitions and desires! He seduced Daguta, compelled her to steal the Key, and thus doomed them all!

King Grallon escaped with a handful of courtiers, and they watched Irene sink into the Astral. But as we know now, the allod wasn't completely destroyed \...

Theater! What can be better than theater? You can experience the whole range of emotions! Tell me, what do you prefer? Crying, laughing, or unbridled fury?

What role would you like to play?

Theater! What can be better than theater? You can experience the whole range of emotions! Tell me, what do you prefer? Crying, laughing, or unbridled fury?

Do you want to try?

Oh no, don't answer! I can already see you on the stage of my Theatre! When the time comes...
I have a role for you in the next act. You just need to wait for it to start!

You look gorgeous as this character!

Now act!

Theater! What can be better than theater? You can experience the whole range of emotions! Tell me, what do you prefer? Crying, laughing, or unbridled fury?

Do you want to try?

Speak with me before the next act begins, and I will let you pick a role!

Splendid, the role of King Grallon is yours!

The play starts in a few minutes. Or as soon as we find actors for all the roles. Perhaps you know something who could be a good fit? Then call them!

Splendid, the role of the Traveler is yours!

The play starts in a few minutes. Or as soon as we find actors for all the roles. Perhaps you know something who could be a good fit? Then call them!

Splendid, the role of Princess Daguta is yours!

The play starts in a few minutes. Or as soon as we find actors for all the roles. Perhaps you know something who could be a good fit? Then call them!
Welcome to the Rose and Hibiscus! Do you have any questions?

name.en: What is there to do around here?

text.en: Talk to other patrons, rest, dance, try cocktails and hookahs, swim in the pool. There are also individual pavilions if you'd like to get away from the noise.

Sounds great!

Now let's find you an outfit.

name.en: Everything is ready. I want to go to the garden.

text.en:
Wonderful! You look quite alluring.

The door of our garden is open for you. Step inside and find Beauty and Pleasure.

Enjoy your stay!

Welcome to the Rose and Hibiscus, the garden of pleasures!

Before you dive into the sea of pleasures, you will need a proper name and outfit.
You must be under the guise of Ardent Love to enter the Garden of Pleasures.
Don't waste my time.
Someone you shouldn't know about.
Isn't it obvious? I'm the head of Irene intelligence and its only representative you will meet.
What's wrong, Guest of Irene? Are you bored?
Would the Guest like to play a part in a play?
Does the Guest like to wear masks?
[The interlocutor is listening carefully]
Does the Guest wish to play spy games? Interesting!
One of us. Great. I have a job for you.

name.en: Could you remind me where our meeting points are?

text.en: Oh Tep, the people I have to work with... We always meet with our informers somewhere we won't draw attention: in a theatre, in a square in the northern district, in the garden near the palace, in the middle of the main street, near a brothel, or at the lake at the Secluded Sanctuary. If you forget this again...

name.en: How do I recognize the informer?

text.en: Is this your first time? I think I've seen you before... Hmm. You'll recognize them easily - by their carnival mask. Or should I also tell you what an informer does?
Oh, you're hopeless...

name.en: Where do I look for the informer?

text.en: He will be waiting for you SOMEWHERE HIGH WHERE VOICES CANNOT BE HEARD.

name.en: Where do I look for the informer?

text.en: He will be waiting for you WHERE THE STONE GUARDS ARE SLEEPING.

name.en: Where do I look for the informer?

text.en: He will be waiting for you WHERE YOU CAN HEAR THE APPLAUSE.

name.en: Where do I look for the informer?

text.en: He will be waiting for you IN THE GOLDEN GARDEN AT THE KEY POINT.

name.en: Where do I look for the informer?

text.en: He will be waiting for you NEAR IMMORAL BEAUTY.

name.en: Where do I look for the informer?

text.en: He will be waiting for you BETWEEN THE DWELLING OF SHIPS AND THE HOUSE OF FOOLS.

Find our informer. He'll give you the information and tell you who it's meant for. But be careful: sometimes Irene intelligence replaces our informers with their agents, and if they catch you, they'll know you're one of us. Remember: our informers never carry a weapon.

But if you were, say, a double agent, you could still tell them everything and get what you need... What was I talking about?

name.en: How do I decipher the code?

text.en: First time? Alright, I'll give you a hint – just change all letters to the next one in the alphabet.
A beautiful day, isn't it?

name.en:
I'm here for the information.

[Give the password]

text.en: , is that you? Oh Tep, another minute and there'll be clash of blades... I'm also an undercover agent. What do you want?

name.en:
I'm here for the information.

[Give the password]

text.en: Great. Here's the package, it's all there. I wrote the info on the liaison's whereabouts and appearance on the package. It will be gibberish for anyone else, but you'll figure it out...

name.en: I'm on your side. I'm a double agent, too.

text.en: What?! You... Here, take it, I don't want any problems! I won't tell anyone! It's all written on the package – the place and the person who should get it!

name.en:
Hmm, that was awkward...

[Finish the conversation]
I'm on your side. I'm a double agent, too.

text.en: Ugh, I almost... Alright, colleague. What do you want from me?

name.en: I need information for the liaison.

text.en: A part of your mission, right? I have the package Take it... And good luck.
Hello.
What?
Is this some kind of joke?
Good afternoon!
How about that. You have the information?
I don't understand...
How do you like the weather?
Ugh, I thought you weren't coming. Give me the package.
Ahh... Alright...
Oh, it's so nice here...
Where were you? Do you have it?
What?
Hello!
Great, you took your time. Good work. You have the information?
What?
Hey! How are you?
Got it. You have everything?
Are you hallucinating?
Hello, hello!
Yay, we won't be killed today. Do you have it?
Ahem. But oh well.
Hello.
Oh, I was just starting to enjoy the wait. Give it here.

name.en:
[Hand over the package]

It's all here. What are my next instructions?

text.en: Got you!

name.en:
[Hand over the package]

It's all here. What are my next instructions?

text.en: Great. Instructions for all agents for the next few days: hunt down the blue raven. Go now.

name.en:
[Hand over the package]

It's all here. What are my next instructions?

text.en: Great! Instructions for the next day: do not touch the hedgehog's prickles until it falls asleep.

name.en:
[Hand over the package]

It's all here. What are my next instructions?

text.en: Got it. Directive for the next day: do not jump into the canals unless you have scared the fish away.

name.en:
[Hand over the package]

It's all here. What are my next instructions?

text.en: Well, well. Good. Instructions for the next day: do not be silent near entrances on the main streets.

name.en:
[Hand over the package]

It's all here. What are my next instructions?

text.en: Keep that up. Instructions for the next day: take care of the little swallow. You can go now.

name.en:
[Hand over the package]

It's all here. What are my next instructions?

text.en: Good job, soon you won't have to run errands anymore... Your next instructions: do not give the bear white honey. See you soon.

name.en:
[Hand over the package]

It's all here. What are my next instructions?

text.en: Very well. This is the instruction: drink water from the lake where hedgehogs swim.

name.en:
[Hand over the package]

It's all here. What are my next instructions?

text.en: Yep. New instructions for all agents: dance under the moon near the blue canals.

name.en:
[Hand over the package]

It's all here. What are my next instructions?

text.en: How about that. Your next instructions: watch the lovely sunrise after buying wine.

name.en:
[Hand over the package]

It's all here. What are my next instructions?

text.en: Good job! Instructions for the next day: tame the deer that want to eat grass!

name.en:
[Hand over the package]

It's all here. What are my next instructions?

text.en: Everyone is here... New instructions for all agents: sit on the stump until the blackbird returns to the nest!

name.en:
[Hand over the package]

It's all here. What are my next instructions?

text.en: That’s good. Your new instructions: march where everyone can see you so the cats run away!
Great, you took your time. Good work. You have the information?
Huh? Go away...
Hello there.
What response do you expect?
Greetings.
Huh? Oh?
Greetings.
What?
Irene is so beautiful!
I'm sorry, I don't understand.
It's a nice day...
You want to play charades?
How's life?
What are you on about?
Ugh...
Whaaat?
Good evening.

name.en: Where can I find the Harlequins' puppeteer agent?

text.en: He should be at the harbor now.

name.en: Where can I find the puppeteer agent?

text.en: You can find him in the palace square.

name.en: Where can I find the puppeteer agent?

text.en: He should be in the Hornbeam Alley now.

name.en: I'm ready to start my mission.

text.en:
Finally someone good! We don't have much time, and we're running out of whatever's left. You must act as a carrier agent. Receive your assignment from the puppeteer agent and get in touch with their liaison. We have grounds to believe that he's the one that distributes the instructions among other working agent for the next 24 hours. Find out what the instruction is and return to me. They've got a lot of gophers. They'll hardly take any notice of you. Most importantly, you must follow the whole chain step by step from the controlling agent to the liaison without raising suspicion. Act quickly. If you take too long, you'll have to start over.

What do you want to know?

Huh, what do you think? I'm fixing this... Elves can't hold any races without me. Who will fix their rides if they break down? Oh, sorry, not rides but "magical sledges, the latest achievement in elven engineering science". Pshaw...
Tep take them...

I'm mostly resting. I also make sure every racer can safely finish the race and return to the city. As you can see, it's hard to get out of here on your own... Though why would you? It's such a nice forest...
Speed is life!

If only you knew how many people I interact with daily... Though it can get lonely at night, that's true. But I don't mind! They say there'll be another noble entertainment here soon – boar hunting on horseback! With something like that, peace will become a distant dream...

Seriously, where will they get boars...?
I could take a walk around the forest...
I could take a walk around the forest...

name.en: Strange place for racing... And the format...

text.en:
I know what you mean. Our House wanted to arrange spectacular races, but reality sometimes plays a mean trick on you. You see, Irene is not well suited for classic races, so we had to think of something else... If only you knew how we fought de Desirae for the right to disturb the peace at the Secluded Sanctuary! We had to build walls to fend them off!

Not to mention the tricky magic that hides our races from inquisitive eyes so no one disturbs our noblemen! As though races are a less dignified activity than drinking wine.

But you know, people seem to like it. So in the end we only have true fans here. I believe I’m... Pleased.

It’s simple: the residence of de Delice, residence of de Blizare, then through the port and the main street, through the park and the square of the Northern districts to the local pier... The task becomes more interesting then: you need to find a checkpoint in all three parts of the forest in turn: northern, eastern, and southern.

Everyone picks their own route. The only condition is you need to go through all checkpoints in the correct order and reach the finish line!
We haven’t seen you at our races in a while!

name.en: How do I participate in the race?

text.en: Just choose your transport, and if there are free spots in the upcoming race, you’ll be teleported to the start!

name.en: Tell me how the race goes.

text.en:
The first one who wishes to start a race picks their transport and begins preparations. The preparation lasts 1 minute, and that is when other participants can join. One race can have up to 10 participants.

The race starts once the minute is over. Your goal is to cross the checkpoints in order as fast as you can. The next checkpoint becomes visible once you cross the previous one, so you won’t be able to fool our magic!

To be faster than anyone else, use the abilities of your transport and plan your route carefully!

At first we wanted to reward the racers for the top places, but it turned out such competition provokes... Varying responses, so to speak.

So instead you can beat the records for this route and get medals as a reward, along with an honorary title!

It’s the Hares! They are incredibly fast and blend well into the landscape of Irene. And thanks to our magic, they can jump even when they are already in the air...! Though they would need a break after three such jumps.

The dance starts here in the Ballroom every 15 minutes.

To participate, you need a dance partner. Many people gather in the hall before the dance. Among them are the elves of great houses and guests from other lands, like you. Invite someone.

Then wait until I give the signal.

If this is your first time here, don't worry. We made sure even inexperienced dancers can perform the Ice Dance. The guiding aura will show you where to go, and I will tell you which pirouettes you need to perform during the dance. The better your dancing, the higher His Majesty will rate your talent, and the more ecu you will earn.

It might be difficult at first, but you will master it after a few dances. If you still feel unsure, talk to me before the dancing starts. I will enchant your skates, and they will move around the room on their own - you will only need to perform pirouettes.

The hardest thing for a beginner is to keep up with the guiding aura. I can enchant your skates so they follow it automatically. All you have to do is perform pirouettes at the right moment.

Of course, I will only rate your Grace as you perform pirouettes, and your reward will be lower than what you can earn if you follow the guiding aura properly.

If you change your mind, talk to me at any time before the Dance, and I'll remove the enchantment.

Well?

Done!

Now take your place in the Guiding Aura. As soon as the dancing starts, the skates will move on their own!
