If you change your mind, talk to me at any time before the Dance, and I'll remove the enchantment.

Done!

I believe in you: you will be able to perform the Ice Dance without any help in no time.
I like your attitude!

The ballroom is the largest room in the Galleon. Dancing requires a lot of space!

This year, thanks to a wonderful gift from the House de Blizare, we were able to organize a special event for our guests, the Great Ice Dance that I personally helped put together!

You absolutely must take part in it.

name.en: Tell me about the Mask of the Free Bird

text.en:
Oh, that mask! It's a true miracle! Its magic allows you to turn into a bird and fly! The enchantment is not perfect, however, so the transformation is temporary. But a fairy's aura can replenish the mask's magic...
How, you ask? You will have to find that out once you take to the air.

You can purchase the mask from me, but it will only start working once you have gained a friendly reputation with the House de Pluie.

Although, if you don't have the mask yet, I can lend you one for this task.

name.en: Borrow the Mask of the Free Bird

text.en: Here! And watch the timer: if the enchantment runs out, and you are still in the air... Poof! You fly straight into the Astral.
A good hunt is great both for the body and mind!

Noblemen are hunting noble beasts! Well, almost...

Our House decided to create a more accessible version of an ancient form of entertainment - horseback hunting!

Except we have deer instead of horses and enchanted Irene Hedgehogs instead of game. That's should make it easier and more exciting!

There's nothing tricky about it: just mount a deer and try to catch a hedgehog with a magic net, and if you get bored, you can become a hedgehog yourself!

You can pick a role and tell me about it: magic will take care of the rest.

If you want to join as a hunter, we will give you an Irene Deer and a magic net. Your objective is to catch as many enchanted hedgehogs with it as you can! You can catch any number of them - the hedgehogs enjoy this activity!

If you want to become prey, we will cast a spell on you that will turn you into a hedgehog. Run away from hunters - the longer you stay uncaptured, the more points you will earn! You can run for as long as you want - until you get tired or bored.
Brave decision!
Brave decision!
You have the honor of representing His Majesty's interests in the lands of Al Rihat. You'll be rewarded, of course.

I have no tasks for you right now.

His Majesty's interests in Al Rihat are represented by ambassadors with proper combat training and certain reputation level with the royal family.

In your case it's just a formality, but all formalities must be observed at the Court.

Come back later.
Isn't it legendary? Everything must shine and look awesome! Our luxurious feast's visitor must have everything they wish for. Do you think this happens by itself? No way. There's one man behind it.
My brother and I must sign this? Why would we? Excuse me, but you have yet to prove yourself by serving the magic and our House.

Well, I can sign it. Your deeds speak for themselves. You have proved that the future of magic is safe with you. I have my brother's permission to sign it on his behalf. Dragons are the base of the Great Mages' power. This world wouldn't survive without them. Do you even realize that everything started here, on Irene?

name.en: Irene Vipers were the dragons that turned the elven mages into the Great Mages.

text.en: Now you understand that they used to fascinate the elves. It led many to ruin, and some to madness. There's great power in dragon blood. We all use it. Are we worthy of it? This question has yet to be answered.  Here's the signature.
Darling, I'd sign your papers with great pleasure if only you have earned our House's trust. I'm sorry, but it won't happen until you've earned it.

Beauty is a great power. Do we have the right to judge the world by our own values? Did we become someone else when we abandoned Beauty in favor of Pleasure? I often think about it. Look at the Irene Viper through the eyes of the first elves. What do you see?

name.en: Dragons are truly beautiful. I understand why the first elves were fascinated by them...

text.en: I'm glad you can appreciate their beauty. You've come a long way. I'll sign your permit.
Hah! Do you want my signature? You know what? I'll sign it. But you have to prove your worth to my House first.

Dragons. My people are infatuated with them. You know the history. We wanted to be like them. Many of us are still drawn to them. And Anastasia, too... I think you both have a similar appreciation for their beauty and grace. I have one of her ballads – it's about a dragon. A dragon who knows his days are numbered. Dragons don't belong in our world. Alas! Is that what you think?

name.en: Dragons are not of this world.

text.en: That is true. I'd love to visit the world they came from. Perhaps I will! Who knows? I'm ready to sign your permit.
I'm sorry, buddy, but time is money. I mean, it's only fair if you spend a little of your time helping my House before asking for something, am I right?

Dragons. Hmm. They've been pretty marketable lately. Of course, this happened after my cousin Hugh de Pluie, the Oligarch, discovered the dragon island deep in the astral. Together with his friends, he stole the eggs and hatched tiny dragons. This is how the rare creatures came about. Of course, they're no match for the Great Dragons such as Soliskar or Agrus, not to mention the Dragon Keepers but still, they're dragons, aren't they? They're ruthlessly exploited, but how do you think this will end?

name.en: Agrus dreams of getting back at all the Great Mages and their subjects.

text.en: Yes, that's the word on the street. The dragons are gathering an army. They got over the defeat at the Dead City, and now they're preparing to challenge us again. They want to leave Sarnaut. But at what cost? Who knows... Well, alright. Hand me that permit. I'll sign it.
My dear friend, we're willing to sign your papers... after you serve the cause of my House.

Our dragons are the descendants of a female dragon named Sturegga. She was captured by the first Conclave of Great Mages. They took her blood to brew their potion of might and immortality. That Conclave consisted of seven Great Mages: Pascal, Elleken, Oberon, Canaan, Maeve, Nemeina, and Melusine. It was destined to fall apart: Canaan turned into a vampire, while Elleken and Nemeina left the others in pursuit of their own goals. I learned this at Zayan's history lessons. He taught me when I was a boy. Do you understand what the former members of the Conclave were after?

name.en: Did they want to complete the Transformation? And make the elves equal to dragons?

text.en: That's right. They wanted to finish what they started. But the other members didn't care for it. By then, dragons had been defeated by the Junes. It made the elves realize that the dragons weren't the immaculate, perfect example. This understanding shaped our today's society. I'm saying all this to make you see how important dragons are. Give me your permit. I'll sign it.
My friend, you've done so little. Unfortunately, I can't trust you.

Dragon blood holds this world's greatest power! The power that allowed us to stop the astral. As an alchemist, I have spent years studying this substance. A long time ago we came to understand that their power... is not of this world. Just like the power of the Great Trees. They have a lot of things in common, but many things are different. Dragon Flame is the ideal eradicator. It destroys even non-combustible things. Great Tree saplings are strong enough to create new matter from the Astral. What do you think?

name.en: Perhaps they embody the eternal powers of Creation and Destruction.

text.en: I agree with you. We have a theory that the entire Universe with all the worlds in it is ruled by these Powers: Creation and Destruction, Life and Death. Two sides of a coin, and neither exists without the other. You understand the nature of things. I'll sign your permit.

name.en: Ask to sign your Dragon Acquisition Permit

text.en: Dragons. I've never considered them fascinating. Dragons are monsters! Heroes are supposed to kill monsters. You took down the Fiery Father also known as Sheratan. We elves know other names of dragons. Alsirr, Zuben, Nashira, Rewati, Regul, Rukbat, Sargas, Sirma, Situla, Tegmin, Elnat. Twelve Dragon Keepers. Twelve giants who tormented the world until the Junes dealt with them. Only their children survived and gave birth to all other dragons of this world. They don't really belong to this world. Dragon still hate us all. Do you realize it?

name.en: Dragons want to leave Sarnaut... and return home?

text.en: But they can't do it on their own. They need help. The dragons tried to create their own... First Priest... Lickflame Tinderbox. He was the only one that could open the Star Gates with the Key. Neither Soliskar nor Agrus can do it. Now that they're dead, the dragons are trying to create new ones... or find an ally among the Great Mages. Mages whom they deeply hate. However, strange times call for strange alliances. You know what lies ahead. I'll sign your permit.
Always choose the path of the Light, my friend, and perhaps eventually you'll be able to earn my trust.
I knew Renard had a hand in this. It’s outrageous.

name.en: The king is asking me to settle your disputes.

text.en:
Louis wants everyone to get along!

But Renard has gone too far. House de Delice has the right to do what they think is necessary. I admit we shouldn’t have made Iris a mediator between me and Yasker... But we should be able to negotiate freely.

name.en: You were secretly negotiating with Yasker?! How could you?

text.en:
Oh please, me and Yasker have known each other for a while. In 957, he occupied Ignis... They even made a... what was it... a “motion picture” about it. Of course, it wasn’t accurate.

What matters is he’s willing to listen.

name.en: It’s good that someone still strives for peace.

text.en:
I’m glad you understand. I’ve known Yasker a long time. In 957, he occupied Ignis... They even made a... what was it... a “motion picture” about it. Of course, it wasn’t accurate.

But it laid the ground for negotiation. Just don’t tell Rysina. She can’t know about this.
Look who is here!

name.en: I’m glad your sister is alright.

text.en:
Yes, it was a close call...

…

Listen, about what happened at the residence of that viper... I’m sorry it got to that. But you have to understand - we were worried about Iris’s disappearance, and we had no other leads.

name.en: Let bygones be bygones... I’m sorry, too.

text.en: Phew, I’m glad you’re not holding a grudge. I wouldn’t want us to fall out after what happened on Umoir. Besides, I might need your help. Do you think we can win?

name.en: Our chances aren’t good, especially after Renard tells everyone about the negotiations with the Empire.

text.en: Yes... People will be angry. But we shouldn’t blame the vampires. This is a difficult time for them, too. People should know that Annette and the others are fighting Nihaz for our world!

name.en: I believe the odds are in favor of the House de Delice.

text.en: I’m glad you believe in us! We need to win, and people should know that Annette and the others are fighting Nihaz for our world! Maybe we should make a speech in their defense.
Ah, there you are!

name.en: There I am. Did they hurt you?

text.en: No, though I had to spend a while in that monastery on Lumenara... I was afraid that viper would poison me, but the only real threat was boredom. All they do there is pray, read pious books, and sing in a choir...

name.en: Were you actually a mediator between Antoinette and the Empire?

text.en:
What else could I do?

After my escape, I still had some connections over there, so I was able to bypass the Committee and contact Yasker’s people directly.

They wouldn’t have caught me if I hadn’t taken an interest in that viper Eurial. She’s clever. Spotted the tail quickly and struck back. I don't know who she is but she’s clearly someone to fear.

name.en: What are you going to do now that you’re back at the Court?

text.en: Nothing. My spy career is over, so I’ll spend my days like my sisters, in blissful idleness. Though perhaps I’ll join Gala in her diplomatic work, rescuing vampires, werewolves, demons, and other unfortunate souls.

name.en: Weren’t you afraid of returning to the Court because of some conspiracy?

text.en:
Yes, listen carefully: Eurial is not who she says she is. I know she recently visited both House de Grandeur and House de Vevre. Do you know what they have in common? They both once lived on Grok.

There it is. I’ve learned that soon after the Cataclysm, she went there with her parents. She was a young girl then, but there was already something intimidating about her. No one but the Great Mage Claud de Vevre knew who they were, but the locals gave an accurate description. They lived in his Tower for a while, and then simply vanished.
All these intrigues are giving me a headache.

name.en: Antoinette is your friend, so you must have known about her negotiations?

text.en: Of course! She helped me contact my George... but here on Irene I had to rely on Constance. And you, of course.

name.en: How long has this been going on?

text.en:
Since the first truce! That was when we first exchanged our prisoners - the same way it happened on Yazes. George was our prisoner back then... He was wounded and had a long recovery. I often visited him at night... And he told me a lot. Alas, soon he had to leave me.

That’s when I spoke to Antoinette. By then, she had already decided we needed a solid peace.

name.en: I have to say, it all sounds really strange.

text.en:
It’s not strange.

The world we are building will have less wars and more love. All nations will work together, and our unity will help us defeat any enemy that threatens our existence.

name.en: What if the House de Ardeur wins?

text.en:
I’m afraid there will be no peace then.

Renard wants peace on his own terms, and Yasker is not willing to make significant sacrifices. Which means the war will flare up again.

While the cardinal is confident of his victory, it may be the beginning of the end.

name.en: I hope you know what you are doing and the snake in your bosom won’t bite at the worst possible moment.

text.en: What can she do? She has no House, no family, she’s just a bastard or unwanted child of some nameless performers. I have everything under control.

name.en: Eurial is dangerous! She might have powerful connections that are plotting horrible things! We need to seize her and lock her up before it’s too late!

text.en: My dear friend, you’re spending too much time with Imelda de Luner! What connections, what horrible things? It’s nothing uncommon among the Great Houses. She’s probably a lovechild of de Vevre and Grandeur. Or do you think Nihaz has a hand in this, too? Discuss this with Elhe de Doucer. She could use another source of inspiration, and your tales should do splendidly.
As expected, the dirty dancing of our archduchess is no longer a secret. I see you can’t wait to hear everything.

name.en: So you were right, and Antoinette was indeed negotiating with Yasker, trying to arrange a truce.

text.en: Of course! We’ve been watching her for a while. When I say “we”, I mean the League, of course. Pavel Isaev is very interested in the affairs of the House de Delice! We have finally exposed them.

name.en: What was Iris’s role in this?

text.en:
She was a mediator between her mother and the Empire. Antoinette’s life is in the open, but her disgraced and exiled daughter won’t surprise anyone if she starts hanging around seedy areas, looking for adventures.

Admittedly, we didn’t suspect her right away. Only Eurial managed to bring Iris’s affairs to light.

name.en: Don’t you think Eurial’s playing her own game?

text.en: It’s possible, that’s why I have her watched, too. I can’t trust anyone in this business. Even myself, haha!
Hello, catcher of flying paper...

name.en: What are you doing here? Caspar is looking for you.

text.en:
Listen... When I saw all these important people, I got scared... Now I’m afraid to go there... And perform? I feel nervous! I can’t breathe!

I believe the band can do without me! I’m sorry.

name.en: Your instrument is an important part of the symphony!

text.en: Anyone can pick up the bugle and play! You just need to blow hard!

name.en: You are representing a Priden tribe, the band won’t be complete without you.

text.en: There are many Pridens! Ask any of them! Anyone will agree if you ask them!

name.en: There’s no time to teach a new musician. You have training!

text.en: Any Priden can learn to play the bugle! They teach us when we’re just cubs... So everyone on Howlem knows this tune!

name.en: Caspar picked you for your spirit!

text.en: I understand... But I’m afraid I’ll disappoint him, you, and the audience, eysh... I just can’t...

name.en: You can do it, Tamira Windsong! I believe in you!

text.en: Your words are nice, but they don’t touch my heart, because we are strangers to each other. Your belief in me does not awaken my own belief.

name.en: Is that what Howlem spirits teach? Faltering in the face of fear?

text.en: Yes, the First say you need to fight fear... I believe you’re right, eysh. I can’t let my ancestors and my people down. I’ll overcome my fear and go back. But... I’m lost and can’t find Caspar... Will you take me?

Maelle Alder is a stone proof that our people once relied both on magic and weapons like sword and bow. They say she could take out trolls with one strike... I wonder if she has any memory of the Battle for Beauty?

It would be interesting to pit her against this... Thalos? The one the Aoidoi created. It would be a sight for sure. Perhaps we could arrange a competition? If only we had a few functional June golems...

I admit I feel like a village bumpkin around here. Our House is famous for its history, but it’s not very wealthy. The opulence here is... astonishing. Although I’m still an uninvited guest they’re doing their best to avoid. They fear me... well, I’ll wait for Gala to make her move.

name.en: You are so certain you’ll win?

text.en: Of course. I must win! Once I become the ruler of elves, I will change the world. I will make it better. It will be a time of harmony and prosperity, love and welfare... Together we’ll eliminate all threats and do the impossible...

Hello again, . Renard has done well. When he’s not meddling, he can be very efficient. His creations will serve me... If my House wins the Great Game.
I think I’ll commission two more castles from him. Ignis is not as big as I’d like it to be, and I have a large family that needs space.
That was grand! I always dreamed of seeing Renard humiliated, and you managed to destroy all his arguments!
Winning always feels nice! I knew that our efforts would bring us victory in the Great Game sooner or later. Relying on diplomacy was a good idea.

Psst, ! How about some ancient magic?

It’s a great idea - awakening these statues. They used to stand guard over the ancient kingdom, and now they’ll help us win this competition.
Wow, such power! Perhaps these creations are the future. Living creatures will stop waging wars on each other, and statues, golems, and Mechanoids will be fighting in their stead...
I am glad Antoinette has won - after all, she is our ally. I think her reign will be beneficial to all our Houses. Peace will allow us to focus on existing magical problems.
I don’t doubt it! We rehearsed for days. I hope no one gets the jitters before the show.

name.en: It was a very interesting performance!

text.en: No one had any doubts about it. My wards gave it their all. I believe we should do it again. Interracial orchestras are the future!

Welcome to the Great Ball, !

Soon the most beautiful thing in existence will fill these halls - music!

I hope everyone is ready?

That was amazing! I knew a band like this will be popular, but I had no idea how much!

What does it prove? That all races can work together and live in peace!
House de Delice deserved to win, we have to admit that. As you can imagine, my vision of Sarnaut's future is concurrent with hers.
Hah, I knew my House could create something incredible. This Castle is magnificent!

name.en: How do you like it on Irene and how do you feel about being freed by the League and not the Empire?

text.en:
I’m glad I was freed... But there was this one gal from the Committee, a really hot thing who enjoyed interrogating me. I didn’t mind at all... ahem... I mean, we had a mutually beneficial arrangement.

Other than that, I guess I should feel grateful...?

name.en: How do you like it on Irene and how do you feel about being freed by the League and not the Empire?

text.en:
I’m glad I was freed... But there was this one gal from the Committee, a really hot thing who enjoyed interrogating me. I didn’t mind at all... ahem... I mean, we had a mutually beneficial arrangement.

It’s too bad the League didn’t free the others sooner. Captivity was really hard for some of us.

I’m a technomancer. Like many others in my House. I combine magic and technology into a single entity. Right now I’m resting, then I’ll work on the commission I received recently. What’s this commission? I’m sorry I can’t tell you right now. But it involves Catherina and the Empire. So I’ll have to go back. This time to Igsh, though, not Suslanger.
I’m a bit nervous, to be honest... Everything is so gorgeous here, but I need to concentrate on my speech... Hmm, maybe I should have a drink, perhaps it will make me more eloquent?
Well, you will make an excellent defender at the trial.
Remember the main thing: always tell the truth... but try to omit all... inconvenient details.

Yes, thank you for your interest, but I’m not ready to show you my masterpiece. Today I’ll see what the others will offer and perhaps sign a few contracts. Besides, my cousin Hugh should arrive soon. He’s one of the Tycoons, and the loveliest ladies will accompany him... Don’t miss it!
Galleon Castle would be more beautiful if there were more statues. Nude figures carved in cold marble! And more paintings, of course!

To be honest, I was counting on a slightly different outcome! But perhaps we should look on the bright side. Peace contributes to trade, so we will get richer over time. It will help me win next time! Hugh suggests a new idea: we take the imperial Dream Factory, improve it, shoot stories, build mobile "theaters", sell tickets!
I think I’ve seen her. No, I’m sure. She’s here... I can’t believe it...

name.en: Have you seen Eurial? Is she at the Ball?

text.en: Yes! I can’t believe they let her in. She even winked at me, the viper! Please be careful. Eat and drink only from the common table... I hope she doesn't poison anyone...
Honestly, I was afraid I wouldn’t see Iris... all these games of the Great Houses are dangerous.

name.en: Are you going to get married?

text.en: Don’t be hasty, my friend. I’m just a soldier, and my beloved could be a daughter of the future queen of elves. Who knows, who knows...
It’s... lovely here. Renard did a good job.

name.en: What do you think of Galleon Castle?

text.en:
It’s impressive...

Though I’m afraid our cardinal has lost the advantage of surprise over the last ten years. Galleon Castle would have been astonishing back then. Today it’s familiar... and the Great Ball is meant to shock and amaze.
We are impressed by what we’ve seen. All that will serve Our people.

name.en: As far as I know, the House de Desirae took part in the construction of one of the first Galleon Castles, and it would have been granted to them if the House de Ardeur had won.

text.en:
Yes, but Armando ruined those plans.

The third Galleon Castle was constructed in secret on Lumenara allod, and our House took no part in it.

One of the first Castles became the Darkblood Citadel, but these days it’s more of a monument to our mistakes and miscalculations. And it will stay on Tenebra as a reminder.

name.en: Is there any news from Aidenus? What does he think of the events?

text.en: He is troubled by our reports. At least we don’t have to worry about a war against the Empire. And if Antoinette wins, we should find a way to eliminate the Imperial threat before a new conflict arises. At any rate, our House will support the League...

name.en: You wanted to speak with Elizaveta Rysina about the Church and the new dogmata...

text.en: Oh yes, I believe we came to an understanding... Actually, we’ve been getting along quite well ever since you and I went to that horrid Otherverse. Adventures bring even enemies closer.

name.en: So what about the plan to unite the churches of the League and Empire?

text.en:
It’s more about uniting those who believe in the Light. Pridens, the Tekyan, Aviaks... Many in Sarnaut share our faith, even if it takes different forms.

We’ve reached agreement on some issues... Knowing that the Source of Light is a faith that exists thanks to the God of Darkness Nihaz, we can no longer believe in it the way we used to. We still have a lot of questions: are there other Sources of Light outside Sarnaut? Sarn was the God of Light, but he fell. Are there any others? I suppose our Church’s mission will be finding answers to these questions. There will be many disputes and revelations... But in the end we will find the truth.
Well, it’s quite beautiful here. Renard and Romain have done a good job. I’m impressed. Brother invested so much into this Castle, it would be a shame to lose.

name.en: Does the potion actually stop time?

text.en: I doubt anything can truly stop time! But slowing it down while you yourself become faster... That’s possible! I used to work on accelerating reactions, but they have a limit... But influencing time itself – that’s a new one...
That’s what I was talking about. Alright, we might not win, but we didn’t lose face. I’ve already received a few orders for a few batches.
Even though I’ve won before, I’m still nervous, . How will it go? I hope there will be no undesirable side effects.
It looks like everything went well, . I’ve made quite an interesting potion, haven’t I? Just imagine the possibilities!
How beautiful and elegant. Absolutely fantastic!

name.en: Are you talking about the gondolas?

text.en: Yes, them. The place was in ruin ten years ago, and it was impossible to get across the chasm. So we needed to think of transportation... It was our House that created these elegant, light, and maneuverable gondolas that connect all city districts.
This is where the history of elves is being made.

name.en: Have you learned anything about what’s happening here?

text.en: The Great Game is underway, and it’s usually the source of anything unusual here. Houses are willing to do a lot to win, as Armando’s example has shown us. Although I have a feeling that this time we’re dealing with some ancient House...

name.en: What do you think of it?

text.en: I think we’ve discussed this before. I belong to the House that has been gone for centuries - House de Dernier.

name.en: So Princess Daguta and King Grallon...

text.en: Lower your voice, . Slow down. We’ll talk about this later.
My dream has finally come true!

name.en: So you are the creator of Galleon Castle?

text.en:
I’m the chief architect. Many members of our House worked on the Castle. It’s an incredible creation that can exist autonomously for years in the depths of the Astral...

Of course, what happened to the first Castle was unfortunate... Despite that blow, we found strength to build another one. We gave it a few upgrades but followed the old project plans for the most part.

name.en: As far as I know, Nihil created the artificial intelligence for the previous Galleon Castle.

text.en:
Please call her Celestine... Nihil is a terrifying creature in Tep’s service, but the Celestine I knew was a clever, kind, and charming girl who at times became overly engrossed in her ideas that went beyond what we’re used to...

To honor Celestine, we named the AI of the ship after her. I hope I managed to transfer some of her traits to it. Let her live on in this form.
Galleon Castle! It finally works the way it should.

name.en: So this is a third Galleon Castle?

text.en:
Ahem!

You could say that, though I don’t consider Gorluxor’s creation a proper one. It’s like a... Pirate copy?

Our beautiful castle where you can simply live was turned into some terrible weapon for destroying allods! It’s not what we built it for... Though admittedly the idea appealed to many... Still, I’m against it.

We started the construction of a few more Castles. There will be dozens of them in a decade.
Ugh, I didn’t think I’d ever set foot here again... After everything I’ve done, I never expected to be let in.

Eh, I’d rather not tell that to random strangers, especially those from the Empire. But if you are curious, I’ll give you a hint...

This Galleon Castle is not the first one. Not even a second one. In short, it’s because of me. Or rather, because of love. For one very convincing bastard.

Thankfully, my cousin Romain helped me... Or else it would’ve probably cost me my head!

name.en: So Romain managed to divert suspicion from you?

text.en:
Yes, he practically saved me!

Even though I had to spend the next few years swabbing decks.

Damned Armando! I hear you killed him three times. That’s too bad. I’d kill him thirty three times, and that still wouldn’t be enough...

name.en: It’s good you drew conclusions from this story...

text.en:
You said it. We are both afflicted by gullibility. Me and my sister, Celestine. She, too, believed people who shouldn’t be trusted. It’s terrible...

I think I need a drink. I feel awful...
Hey, it's you, ! I've got a problem, and we need your help.
What would we do without you, ? There's nothing worse than an unfinished job just before a deadline!

name.en: Louis! Been a while, hasn't it?

text.en:
Yep. See, I had to leave my small business on Eljune. I'm selling holy water!

You see, there's no saying "no" to the head of my House. It was fun. I didn't have to take care of anything. Just relaxed in the cabin while the money kept coming in. And then there were lovely pilgrims... Remember Lara? Oh...

Anyway, I've always wanted to attend the new Great Ball. I'd be happy to if I didn't need to work!

On behalf of the House de Blizare, I welcome you, ! I'm Maximilien de Blizare, the head of this House and the Great Mage of Gelida allod.

On behalf of the House de Blizare, I'd like to thank you for helping me with my great scientific experiment.
, welcome to the glorious House de Vevre! I'm Caspar de Vevre, head of the House, and the Great Mage of the Florenta allod.

Ugh... Let me catch my breath. I'm tired of running after these sheets. Caspar won't give me a break!

Remember Gipat, ? Remember how you had to figure out who killed me? Should anything happen, blame the head of my House.

Oh, that Gipat... I hear people still gather in the arena to fight. I guess it's their idea of fun.

We grew tired of collecting dragon symbols pretty soon. I, Semyon Gromov, and the Brave Family joined Seaside the Bloodthirsty, Maxim Kulakin, and Yaver Useranat, and organized special battles of our own. Perhaps you took part in them at some point. You know skirmishes? Teams of three or six? It was our idea.

Of course, the Free Traders helped a lot. But we were the pioneers!
Greetings! I'm glad to see you in this lovely place. I'm Orphus. I teach the magic of music to the Aoidoi.
Oh, marvelous fate, ! I'm so happy to meet someone I know in these lands. What brings you here?

Yes, that's where I came from. We were glad to receive the invitations from the elves. I didn't come here alone. We are many! We listen to the sweet voices of the Muses, so we heeded the plea of the god Dionisius and decided to help with whatever the Mage named Caspar is plotting!

name.en: I'm helping to organize the Great Ball at the king's request.

text.en: I'm happy to see that you have a chance to take part in the deeds of the people so capable, gifted, and talented! We were glad to receive the invitations from the elves. I didn't come here alone. We are many! We listen to the sweet voices of the Muses, so we heeded the plea of the god Dionisius and decided to help with whatever the Mage named Caspar is plotting!
Hey! Greetings!

name.en: I don't often see Gibberling musicians.

text.en: You have probably never been in Lightwood. Everyone there plays the bagpipes! We're the Whistle Family: Mjolle, Vagajr, and Ygujl. We love music and everything connected with it. We decided to take part the moment we heard about the elf's idea.
Greetings, comrade!

name.en: Do you want to take part, too?

text.en: Oh well. Why not? I was the best trumpeter back at home, on New Igsh! I played the wake-up tune near the City Council every day! Diddy-diddy, diddy-dum! You understand, don't you? We can't miss the chance to show the world that we're capable of something!
May your day be good, friend!

name.en: Would you like to participate in the elven concert?

text.en: Why not? My name is Pelagiy Guslarov, I am the best story teller on the Hangah allod. I collect ancient legends and folk tales, and sing ditties. I was honored to receive an invitation to Irene. It is with pleasure that I'll wine and dine at the feast! Since the masters are so generous, why not help them?
The trick is to keep up the rhythm and hit the drum as hard as you can.

I got bored sitting around on Eljune in Takalik Harbor and doing nothing. I hear elves are throwing a Ball! Sending out invitations and stuff. So I packed my things, and came here. They have, like, everything here: booze and chicks, it's so much fun!

name.en: Hello! Haven't seen you for ages!

text.en:
Your mug looks familiar. Have we met?

I know! On Eljune!

I remember you! Remember how we rocked at our concert after the King and Jester band left? Did you know I was left there alone? I missed my ship after the party.

But that's nothing! I heard about the Ball, packed my stuff, and came here. They have, like, everything here: booze and chicks, it's so much fun!
Aho, frriend! May the ancestorrs bless you.

name.en: Are you here for the concert?

text.en: I am! Rright from Howlem! I've always wanted to be a rrock starr. I couldn't miss this. I say, this is an unusual place. Do you sense anything? I have a feeling that someone's watching us. Some spirrits of this place.
Greetings!

Sure thing! I've always wanted to give a public performance. I didn't have a chance to make a really big concert at Xadagan. My kin is pretty reserved. What's the point in making a concert if the audience shows no emotions?
Greetings, . You have come to the Great House de Grandeur. My name is Albert de Grandeur. I’m the the second Head of this House and the Great Mage of the Lightwood allod!
Greetings, . You have come to the Great House de Grandeur. My name is Baudouin de Grandeur, I'm the vice-head of this House and the Great Mage of the Stellar allod!
It's good to see you, . You're at the residence of the Great House de Pluie. My name is Guillaume de Pluie. I am at both the head of the House and the Great Mage of the Tempesta allod!
Hey, it's you...

name.en: How do you feel about being freed by the Empire and not the League?

text.en: The League doesn't good look, for sure. But you're wrong to expect me to jump for joy. Some day I'll be back, and I'll burn everything down.

name.en: How do you like it here on Irene?

text.en: It's better than your prison, but that's obvious.
My butterfly collection! I'm nothing without it.

name.en: How do you feel about being freed by the Empire and not the League?

text.en: I'm enraged! I'm a renowned lepidopterologist! They locked me up in prison and took away my collection! They fed me scraps and pigwash! The war has to end. The elves must stop getting involved in someone else's affairs!

name.en: How do you like it here on Irene?

text.en: What? Here? It's not bad. Not bad at all! Beautiful scenery. Unlike the grey landscape of Igsh I'm used to. I think I've seen a new butterfly species.
Hmm... did they let you in here? Unwise...

name.en: How do you feel about being freed by the Empire and not the League?

text.en: The League tried to free us while the Empire was messing things difficult for them... and you helped them! If Yasker thinks we're too stupid to see through his deception... I feel sorry for him.

name.en: How do you like it here on Irene?

text.en: It's wonderful. My mind and body are relaxing after your prison. And look at all the beautiful girls!
Hey there! Your face is familiar! How are you doing?

name.en: How do you feel about being freed by the Empire and not the League?

text.en: Oooh, it was so rude of the League! I expected to be rescued, even imagined a knight on a shiny... dreadnought! But they simply forgot about me! But you freed me. That's something. Come over tonight. I'll thank you properly!

name.en: How do you like it here on Irene?

text.en: I've always dreamed about the Great Ball! I had to skip the previous one. I was too young. Oh, but this one is so much fun! I'm glad they invited you.

Just like my House, I'm interested in alchemy. Combat alchemy, of course. Why else would the Empire have taken me prisoner? I study explosives, choking gas, et cetera. All this mana energy is quite interesting, but trust me, alchemy has many secrets, too. Today we use gunpowder to blow things up, but if... ugh, it's top secret, I can't tell you that.
Another gawker, great. What do you want?

name.en: I want to apologize for not freeing you sooner!

text.en: Oh, really. You know what? Stick your apologies where the sun doesn't shine. You didn't try hard enough.

name.en: How do you like it here on Irene?

text.en: What's it to you? It's way more fun than the Imperial prison, of course.

Isn't it obvious? I'm a lepidopterologist. I study butterflies. I even had a collection that I carelessly took with me on a journey. An Imperial cruiser intercepted our ship. I ended up in prison and lost my collection. I was humiliated, insulted, and mistreated! Now I'm trying to regain my mental equilibrium here on Irene.
My butterfly collection! I'm nothing without it.

name.en: How do you feel about being freed by the Empire and not the League?

text.en: This is outrageous! The war has to end. The elves must stop getting involved in someone else's affairs! Just think of it! I'm a renowned lepidopterologist! They locked me up in prison and took away my collection! They fed me scraps and pigwash!

name.en: How do you like it here on Irene?

text.en: On Irene? It's not that bad. I think I spotted another undiscovered butterfly. Beautiful scenery. Unlike the grey landscape of Igsh I'm used to.

Hmm. I'm a professional scout. I used to recruit agents on Igsh. I was caught, arrested, and sent to prison. Now I need to figure out what to do next. I might use the Hall of Changes: dye my hair, change my face, or even become a lovely lady for the time being, hehe. But holidays first.
I'm glad to see the League's renowned hero!

name.en: How do you feel about being freed by the Empire and not the League?

text.en: I know they've been trying. They dropped off their troops on Igsh, captured the XAES... it's a shame it didn't work! But I guess there's only so many battles you can win. If the plan worked, we would have won the war. The way things went... well, there was peace and the anti-architectural alliance.

name.en: How do you like it here on Irene?

text.en: Wonderful! Just look at all the beautiful girls! My mind and body are relaxing after the Imperial prison.

I'm pretty noble by blood! I'm Caspar de Vevre's second cousin once removed! Now that I'm free, I'm thinking of writing an autobiography. I'll write down everything I've been through! "Humiliated and Insulted" will be its title. It should be quite a volume.
Hey there! I don't know you in person, but I've heard a lot. How are you?

name.en: How do you feel about being freed by the Empire and not the League?

text.en:
Oooh, it was so rude of the League! They were supposed to save me! But they simply forgot about me! It was so humiliating! Me, an aristocrat, in the hands of arrogant Imperial rabble!

I remember fantasizing about being captured... tied and slowly undressed... it seemed so hot! That wasn't what happened in real life. I was freezing in prison, and the food was bad.

name.en: How do you like it here on Irene?

text.en: Oh, it's fun! I'm glad they invited you. I've always dreamed about the Great Ball! I had to skip the previous one. I was too young. I'm glad to finally be here, after everything that happened.

name.en: I've been curious... how come you have so many daughters?

text.en: You know, if your life is long, which is the case with us elves, and your passion is everlasting... your love bears certain fruits. My beloved daughters are the fruits of love. Souvenirs from men I fell in love with.
Greetings, my dear friend. What brings you here?

name.en: I am acting on king's behalf. I can't tell you about any affairs of His Majesty.

text.en:
Oh, sweet Louis, always full of secrets. The king is my good friend, so I'm always willing to help you. And so are my lovely daughters. You and your friend can count on my hospitality.

Have you visited the Rose and Hibiscus?

Oh, you should! Get settled in my residence and visit it. You can ask me or my daughters any questions. You can ask at least those girls that are here. Hmm... I wonder where the little Iris is. What are the guards doing?

Some rules they've got here! This place means business, I can tell.

I wonder if they'll even let me in, huh.
The inscription on the frontal page goes, "This is private property of Iris de Delice. No one can read it but the owner."

name.en: Open the second to last page

text.en:
I find all this very disturbing. I need to talk to Gala and maybe Cantor about what's happening. Hardly anyone will trust me, I'm afraid. If I'm right, we're in grave danger.

[There's a note between the last pages of the diary]

My dear Iris! I was astonished to learn you're gathering information about me. No offence, honey, but I need you to send over everything you've got so far, otherwise the consequences will be very unpleasant. Neither I nor His Eminence would want that.

Sincerely yours, E.

name.en: Read the last page of the diary

text.en: It's pretty creepy. I don't know what to do now. I can leave my shard, because I'm not allowed to show up in the "upper society". Well, I guess it's time for a sweet candy! No one will go looking and no one will ask for names since everything is in plain sight.
We've been very busy since that nasty cardinal started pestering us! Aurora is on Ignis, Beata is back there on Al Rihat, and poor me is in charge. I'm the eldest. My head is spinning!
Hey! Welcome!

name.en: Do you happen to know where Iris is?

text.en: Hm. Zizi is a super important person. He never tells anyone where she's going and with whom. She could at least share her boys!

name.en: Do you have any idea at all where she could be and with whom?

text.en: She loves heroes, you know – the type that can erect a flag on top of an enemy fortress. Yeah. I guess she's with one of them.

name.en: Are vampires here, too? Aren't they afraid of revenge of the Houses de Desirae and de Ardeur?

text.en: You can't tell, but deep down they're nervous. You know, de Desirae could forget about it if Roxane gives up her rights on Nocturne.

name.en: Where do they want to go?

text.en: The vampires will probably stay in Amarantha unless Catherina objects. You know, we have a plan to relocate all the undead to a separate allod. I think it's named Jigran. Marianna Lopatina has recently rediscovered it. The elven part of House de Douceur is likely to reside on the Nea allod.
Oh, a familiar face. I knew we'd meet soon.

name.en: I hear your mother's looking for someone.

text.en: Yep. It's Iris. Poor thing, life was harsh on her. That's why she's doing strange things now. Her reputation is ruined. Any appearance among the noble can trigger a scandal. What else is she supposed to do? I mean, other that participating in questionable affairs. Poor thing.

name.en: Do you think someone knows where to find her?

text.en: I know a man has courted her... You know, de Vevre, the war hero? He doesn't care much about reputation, so... perhaps, he's Zizi's best option.
Glory to the arch-duchess, the eternally beautiful, wise, and generous patroness!

name.en: We hear Antoinette is looking for someone.

text.en: Oh, right! Iris. I haven't been following her. She's got a lot of weird ideas. You know, after what happened on Igsh.

name.en: Who can tell me where to find her?

text.en: The girls always have some maids around. Sweet servants who always know who goes where and with whom.

Yep, that's me. I mean, no! No! There's also Zoe, but she's a baby. So that makes me what, the second youngest daughter? I'm a, you know, an adult, all grown-up and responsible! That's me! Now I'm babbling. I'm sorry. It's just that... I'm your fan, and here you are, in all your glory! And I lost it. Kind of. What am I saying? I lost it! Sorry.
Oh, I can't believe it's really you! I'm seeing you with my own eyes!

name.en: Hello! Yes, it's me! Do you know something about the sister your mom is looking for?

text.en:
Erm... No. Wait. Give a moment... I can't believe I've met you in person.

I'm so excited I'm going to puke!

Phew, that was close.

Whee! Is it really you? Can I touch you?

name.en: You can touch me all you like as long as you answer my question.

text.en: Um... Do you mean Zizi? Or Iris? I've seen her with... no, I can't tell you. Although you must know... those who fought the architects? You must have dealt with them, too, so you know enough... Oh Tensess! What am I saying? It's so embarrassing.

name.en: How are you doing after the war?

text.en: Thanks for asking. Everything's in order. War changes people... We survived many things. We lost many. Some comrades remained on the battlefield. I see them in my dreams. I'm questioning myself – why did I survive when they died?
Hey, buddy! I didn't expect to meet you here on Irene. Do you remember... How we captured that stronghold? Those were the days.

name.en: I hear, you're friends with one of Antoinette's daughters?

text.en: That's right. Who told you? Yes, I'm courting Iris. She's a sweet girl, even though she's been through a lot.

name.en: Do you know where I can find her?

text.en: I have no idea. She disappeared quite suddenly. She left all her things behind, at home. I'm very worried about her. This allod only looks safe. Something's going to happen.

Oh traveler! You are standing before the gates that lead to eternal joy! Everyone that enters should know: your wishes are heard! You will find here what you have been looking for!

What are you looking for?

name.en: I hear the arch-duchesse is looking for her daughter. I wonder where she might be.

text.en: We don't disclose information about our visitors. Overly intrusive and prying individuals shall be banned.

name.en: Are you grateful to the Great Yasker for setting you free?

text.en: Pfft, right. It's great that it's over. I'm tired of hiding in that filthy IMD and feeding on fried termites and other junk. When Ignat Petrovin was arrested and sent to the Suslanger camp, it became really boring.

name.en: How do you like Irene after the Imperial captivity?

text.en: I'm free, no thanks to the League. I'm tired of hiding in that filthy IMD and feeding on fried termites and other junk. When Ignat Petrovin was arrested and sent to the Suslanger camp, it became really boring. I'm a little grateful to the Imperials now that it's over, although I understand that their reasons were purely diplomatic.
Hello, heroes! Have you seen a ladybug around? I've seen one. I really like ladybugs. Some day I want to become one.

name.en: Uh, no? Look, do you know anything about Antoinette's daughter she's looking for?

text.en: Iris? Yes, I know a little. I'm her servant. Her and her sisters'. Iris is weird. No wonder! After everything she's been through! It could have happened to me.
No. I know for sure that none of the sisters saw Iris before she disappeared.

Hello there! Here you are, . Want see a local specialty? Huh! They say de Delice have something that no one has ever seen here before.

Hey, what's with the face? The king and his missions again, eh? What are they after, huh? Go on, spit it out.

name.en: I need to figure out Antoinette's problem with her daughter, Iris.

text.en: Women are nothing but trouble. Let's just ask her directly.

name.en: We should keep a low profile.

text.en:
Ugh, the knife-eared and their scheming! I hate the way they drag you into their intrigues.

Well, a low profile it is, then. I'm not good at it, though, so you'll do the talking. In the meantime, I'll scan their brains and find out what they're truly thinking. Afterwards, I'll wipe this conversation from their memories. So you'll be in the clear.

How do you like the idea?
Hello, hero! I see you've managed to visit our celebration.

name.en: I see you've managed to leave Nihaz's Citadel for the Ball.

text.en: My current business requires my presence. Now that Wigo is done with, I may not fear a stab in the back. We still have to face the challenges thrown at us by the policies of the Great Houses. Can we deal with them? This is the question.

name.en: Was it reckless to connect your life with House de Doucer vampires? House de Tristesse wasn't involved in their crimes.

text.en: I'm afraid no one cares about such tiny details. No one will sort it out. The society regards me, Armando, and even Canaan the same. In their eyes, we're all smeared in blood. My House's destiny has a lot to do with the shard of the Seal of Darkness, the notorious Evil Mirror. House de Doucer is connected to Tep's powers that he obtained from another shard. The darkness is our shared destiny.

name.en: Does it mean you're in charge of all vampires?

text.en: Such a responsibility would be too much for me. There are a lot of independent vampire families scattered throughout Sarnaut. They don't obey me. You know, I think we can make a deal. Apart from the offer of amnesty (if it's approved by the Great Houses), we also have a vaccine. We can't have it before Nihaz is dealt with, but still...
We're pouring happiness in glasses! What happiness are you looking for today?

name.en: Ask for a cocktail for Sweet Candy

text.en: I can't say no to Sweet Candy! My best cocktail for the most charming lady. On the house.
Just go, don't look around. I'll take care of it.

Hah! Hey hop!

How is it going? Did Iris tell you something?
That's what I call a party! Elves aren't boring at all, hehe.

name.en: Iris's gone missing. Have you seen her?

text.en: What do you mean, missing..?

Well, who's entering the garden of pleasures today?

Listen to your heart, it's calling out your true name!

Sounds great!

Now let's find you an outfit. Try on our suggestion. We wouldn't want to bore you with fittings and measurements on your first visit here.

Do you like it?

You can try on a different outfit if you like.

Wonderful! You look quite alluring.

The door of our garden is open for you. Step inside and find Beauty and Pleasure.

Enjoy your stay!

Welcome to the Rose and Hibiscus, the garden of pleasures. Is this your first visit?

Before you dive into the sea of pleasures, let me tell you about our house rules.

The Rose and Hibiscus is the place where we hang out and enjoy beauty. All flowers of our garden are equally beautiful. Each is worthy of attention and respect. By entering this door, you agree to leave your former self behind. This place knows no factions, Houses, or faces. There are only masks and nicknames. True names must be respected and never revealed. And of course, there's no room for weapons and armor that hide the true beauty of Nature's creation.

Follow these simple rules, and you will enjoy true pleasure in our beautiful garden.

name.en: Keep it down! Don't you recognize me? Remember who helped you out with clothes in Nezebgrad?

text.en: What a surprise! I didn't expect to see you here. Thanks for helping me back there.

name.en: You don't recognize me, do you? Remember who helped you out with clothes in Nezebgrad?

text.en: It's you! I thought you looked familiar... but I didn't expect to see you here. Thanks for helping me back there.

name.en: Did you manage to escape town?

text.en: Ha! Money makes the world go round. I could steal something from the Bunker. I talked to the local smugglers. Of course, I had to spend a week in your underground water supply system. But then I got on board of the ship to Avilon, and finally arrived at Novograd. I wish I were a writer, I could write a book. Nice talking to you, but I need to go.
I'm used to different clubs. This one feels like home. That's strange...
There I am! Who are you? I can't recognize you in this mask, darling. I don't do private dance, mind you.

name.en: Wait! I'm here on the king's orders. He asked me to find you.

text.en: Wow! What does His Majesty want with a humble person such as myself?

name.en: He wants you back at the court.

text.en: What a generous offer. As if I were looking to return to the company of hypocrites, who show their bravery only while wearing masks. On the other hand... I have something to tell him. There's a conspiracy on Irene. We're all in danger.

name.en: I can help you get to the king.

text.en: Say I believed you. But first, I need a drink. Can you bring me a cocktail? I need to pull myself together.

You must be under the guise of Ardent Love to enter the Garden of Pleasures. Thing is, our visitors are hiding their identities. This allows them to feel relaxed and not fear the consequences. A pleasure is only a pleasure when you don't have to pay a price. Those wanting to enter must contribute by purchasing this mask from a hostess, who controls the gifts of our beautiful and generous arch-duchesse.

name.en: Can I borrow the Mask of Ardent Love?

text.en: I can offer it to you for a certain sum of ecu. But as a special guest, you can also borrow it for me for a time.
Have a good time.

name.en: Tell the king everything you know.

text.en: It's curious. It means, Renard gives Eurial assignments? At this stage, it looks like traditional intrigues before the Big Game. Of course, the girl must not suffer. However, I know the Cardinal. I'm sure she'll be locked up for a while, that's all. I'm curious about his minion, though.

name.en: What are you up to, Skulnar?

text.en:
Me and Murk just felt sad that you can't really have a good time here, and then we started talking, and it turned out that we both grabbed something from home...

Will you join us? Let's move to that spot under the stairs, have a drink...
Hehehe...
Let's keep going!
We should do something else... My head is buzzing...
Hello, !

name.en: Who are you? How do you know me?

text.en: Oh Tensess, why so aggressive? I'm just a mage and potions master from the House de Vevre who has not been officially invited to the Galleon. So I've been hiding in invisibility...

I noticed you were having fun and couldn't help myself. I agree that this ball needs more entertainment!

But you're so boring about it. Just drinking until you fall over in the middle of the ballroom!

I have a few potions... I can guarantee you will enjoy yourselves more if you try them! I and my allies from the House de Vevre use them often...

name.en: Ancient Moon! What brings you here?

text.en: What do you mean? We were invited here. A whole herd of centaurs arrived from Ammer and Frontier. We are... as the elves say, a delegation! We live in the forest, hunt all kinds of animals. As for the reason you haven't met us before... Well, we're good at hiding.
Stormbringer! Glad to see you.

name.en: Wow... Me and Skulnar wondered if... Could you take us for a ride?

text.en: What? It's a Ball, there are guests, tables with food. It's not a place for rides!

name.en: No one will notice, we'll be quiet!

text.en: I really doubt no one would notice that! I have powerful hooves, we'll be as loud as a storm!

name.en: That's fine, everyone does it here all the time!

text.en: I don't see any other centaurs or minotaurs giving people rides.
Fine! But I can't carry both of you, I'm not that strong!

name.en: You'll do fine! Skulnar only looks big, he's nothing but air!

text.en: Alright, but... There's nowhere to go, it's too packed.  I was barely able to enter the room.

name.en: We'll cast a spell to make ourselves lighter!

text.en: What is this spell? Never heard of it!

name.en: If we fit, then you can do it!

text.en: I wouldn't want to embarrass myself by toppling over and dropping you!

name.en: We just rode hares, I'm sure we can ride you!

text.en: I'm not a hare! They have two legs, and they are good at jumping.

name.en: The waiters have quick reflexes - they will clear the space for us!

text.en: Fine, if they are so fast, why not give it a try?

name.en: They'll figure it out. We'll knock aside anyone in the way!

text.en: What if we run someone over? We'll have to get a healer, and we'll have to answer for that!

name.en: That's true... What did you see yesterday? Skulnar is missing.

text.en:
Skulnar? Hmm... as the new queen, I'm concerned about the disappearance of people in my domain.

Then I'll tell you what happened. The three of you tried to get Louis to have food brought to the second floor of the Galleon - the poor man did his best to pretend he wasn't seeing you!

And then you started acting like you were riding something... What? What centaur? Ancient Moon? Here, at the Ball? It sounds like you weren't just drinking last night...

As a result, you and your friends were sent to some waiter... Where is he? Ah, there he is, near the entrance!

I remember you leaving the room and then returning with this waiter and food, but without Skulnar. I assumed he stayed outside to clear his head...
! Let me guess: your head is killing you, and you don't remember anything?
Oh, what a night...

name.en: Why are there so many harps here...?

text.en:
Oh, I see you're not as interested in music anymore. I hope the same goes for your friend, because I'm really tired of this...

Yesterday you came here to make music, but after a few... unsuccessful attempts decided that the instrument was the problem - or so I was told.

You found the only musician with access to the warehouse - me, that is - and forced him to keep bringing you new harps - either the tone was wrong, or string texture, or the color...

But you were trying to create art! How could I refuse you?

But an hour later, I did.
You went to the third floor, grabbing some loud people and a Gibberling family on the way, while me and a couple of other waiters were cleaning up here... They should be somewhere on the third floor.

name.en: So there were two of us?

text.en: Before your first fans showed up? Yes, I'd say so. You and your musical Priden friend.

You and your friend... I remember you... Where is that ignorant orc? I'll tell him straight to his face what I think of him...!

If he's sober, that is...

What, you don't remember? How could you forget such boorishness!

This... Skulnar tried to make me paint his portrait, but I told him that elven beauty is the only thing I work with.

Then he took away my paints and said he'd paint a self-portrait! And started painting right over my new masterpiece!

I tried to stop him but couldn't even move his hand...

name.en: Do you know where we went next or what we'd done before that?

text.en: How would I know... A minute after the orc finished abusing my painting, I heard shouting from the central hall!

NO! I'll burn it and bury the ashes on Umoir!

Ah, art is helpless before brute strength... Unless it's a martial art, of course.
...I told you, there's enough food on Galleon to feed half of Kania!
Ah, there you are! Slept well? Where's your huge inspiring friend?

name.en: I don't remember what happened yesterday...

text.en:
Oh, I remember that well!

You and your friends managed to eat all the food on our floor, and then came to us and started asking if we were hiding anything else.

When Skulnar, as he introduced himself, realized there was no food here, he delivered a long speech that any party should have twice the amount of food needed to feed everyone!

Well, you went downstairs to look for food there. Afterwards, judging by the noise, you went somewhere on this floor to play the harps...

And my colleague was so inspired by this Skulnar's speech that he has spent the last few hours trying to convince me to rethink the guest experience at the Galleon so this never happens again! What an idiot!
...We can't leave it like this! We are the staff of the Galleon, we must respond to such complaints and do our best to ensure that this never happens again!
Oh, you're here! Where's your big friend? I could use his help...

name.en: I don't remember what happened yesterday...

text.en:
How so? Don't you remember how the three of you came to us to find out where else you can get food on our floor, because you ate everything else?

And what a shame, we couldn't help you with that, so we just sent you back down...

But Skulnar's speech inspired me! I won't leave it like that, it won't happen again! I'll become the Galleon's steward if I have to!

You went downstairs, and then you returned - to satisfy your spiritual hunger, apparently, if the peculiar music I heard coming from one of the rooms was anything to go by...

My colleague and I have been arguing ever since that the situation needs to be resolved. Overcoming his resistance is the first step! I can do it!
The elf is unconscious. He keeps muttering, "Of course, of course I can paint his portrait... Of course..."
No, I can't, please stop...
AHHH! Don't touch me, I can't crawl on ceilings!

name.en: What are you on about? What happened yesterday?

text.en:
Hmm, you sound normal today... I'll tell you if you stop touching me.

Yesterday I sobered up sometime towards the end of the binge on the second floor, but you didn't... You dragged me here and tried to throw my whole family at the ceiling. It was funny at first...

name.en: Did we have an orc with us? A big one?

text.en:
I didn't see any, which is good - we'd probably be a smear on the ceiling by now... So you lost someone, too? Once I'm fully awake, I'll look for my family. Maybe they're on the Galleon's roof. You're lucky I don't hold grudges...

You should ask someone on the second floor. They definitely remembered you there, and you made quite a mess...
The Zem is unconscious. You notice that his legs are slightly damaged. It looks like someone tried to use tools on them... Why?

name.en: I need to know where Eurial and Skulnar went.

text.en: Yes? Since Skulnar is your friend, I can tell you. They went to the pier near the Palace. That's all I know.
I'll take a break for parties for the next year...

name.en: Do you know what happened yesterday...? And where my friends are?

text.en:
Happened...? So many things happened! Should I tell you how you tried to throw Gibberlings at the ceiling, or how you tried to check if it was possible to unscrew a Zem's leg in field conditions?

But... I don't remember any of your friends... But there was a Priden, a handsome one...

name.en: And a big orc in a suit? You wouldn't forget him!

text.en: Oh, why are you bothering me with this? Yesterday was much more fun... If you want to interrogate someone, go interrogate your friend, he must be somewhere nearby. The last time I saw him, he couldn't walk anymore...
Zzz… Ah? ?

name.en: Murk! It’s good that you're here. Where's Skulnar? What happened here?

text.en: Skulnar? Skulnar...

name.en: Yes, Murk. Where is Skulnar? A giant orc!

text.en: Ahh... He's not with you? Maybe he went to take a leak...
What can I do for... Ah, it's you! So Skulnar hasn't returned yet?

name.en: What? What do you know about Skulnar?

text.en: You don't sound as friendly now... Fine, we're friends now, we understand each other. You can tell me about any of your problems!

name.en: Can you just explain what happened yesterday?

text.en:
Well… you came here to get food. I sent my guys to get some, and we were waiting for them at the entrance. We talked, I told you about my family...

Then Eurial showed up. I've never seen her this close before. You got really angry at first, I wondered if you two had a past... You know...

Then you two got friendly. She said that Skulnar didn't look well, although to me he looked fine, just drunk - but in this state, you were easy to convince... She said she knew an excellent healer who would help him, and that Skulnar would return to you in half an hour.

They went somewhere on the pier, and we stayed here waiting for the food...

name.en: The thing is, Skulnar is missing. Have you seen Eurial afterwards?

text.en: You should have said so! Now I see why you're so concerned! No, I saw neither Eurial nor Skulnar, but they could only take a gondola from here. I think you know where to go now...
Hero of Sarnaut! We're glad to see you sober up.

name.en: Tell me, what were you doing in Kobold burrows under Irene? Where is Skulnar?!

text.en:
What are you on about?

...Ah, I know! Is this your new role? So emotional and expressive! You need to rehearse some more, and then we'll talk about our new play.
The local boatman didn't see anything, I already asked him! But we'll find Skulnar without him.
Let's use our biggest advantage - my nose. I can pick up his trail as soon as you ask me to.
I don't like this...
Well... Shall we start, ?
As soon as I'm queen!
I'll have to explain everything to my agents... HOW could we let this happen?!
I'm with you, ...! Besides, when this is over, someone has to tell the queen how it all happened...
It looks like you've almost figured it out...

A special ritual that will help us all if you do not interfere. I can't tell you the details, but I'm sure Elleken will tell you everything once he's done.

This story has been going on for a thousand years, and soon it will come to an end!

I suggest you don't spill blood needlessly. We are not enemies and not even villains, . It's just that few understand... our goals.

name.en: What about Skulnar? Is he here somewhere?

text.en: Yes, he'll stay alive and well as long as no one interferes. I wouldn't mind if you just stood there, but one wrong move...

name.en: I can't just stand here and wait, Eurial. You have too many secrets.

text.en:
Well, suit yourself. We have fought once. I won't underestimate you this time!

Just tell your friends to stay out of it. Let's keep this... between us.

name.en: I can't just stand here and wait, Eurial. You have too many secrets.

text.en:
Well, suit yourself. We have fought once. I won't underestimate you this time!

Just tell your friends to stay out of it. Let's keep this... between us.
Secret passages! Right here, under our land...! I mean, the future queen Antoinette's land, of course.
These catacombs, ... They are too ancient and mysterious.
I don’t understand... how did they fit everything inside...? How much is there?

name.en: You're not attacking? I need to pass!

text.en:
Zvik! Zvik!

Now I'm the smart one! I know what to do. The Traveler told me what to do!

You and I will talk! Zvik!

I can't let you pass! But if you turn around and leave, I'll forgive you for killing my subjects!

I won't kill you when the Kobolds capture Irene again!
A mighty hero showed up, just as the Traveler promised! You smell like blood... Zvik, zvik! But I can't let you pass!

Well, I knew Louis was plotting something... His plan to give the orcs a Great Mage to weaken the Empire sounds rather risky.
It's no wonder Lucretia tried to put an end to this as soon as she got wind of it. She risked a lot when she sent George to Ferris with the Dragon Bond - no one knew what she was trying to accomplish. And Elleken's daughter Eurial went after him.

So the orc Horde will be revived? I'm not sure I like this scenario. Their Great Feast, the cult of strength and brutality... It's not what we need right now.

I suppose I should assist the Empire with this issue. I want to unite, not separate.
The hero returns victorious! You must be used to it by now.

Yes, the king did contact Elleken. Don't look at me like that: he just promised to make Skulnar a Great Mage, and it was necessary.

That whole performance with the theatre, however, was distasteful. They must be mad. They believe we turned our backs on our ideals, forgot about the Beauty in our pursuit of Pleasure. But that's not true!
It seems we averted all the troubles at this Great Ball. No one died, no one turned into a vampire.

I'm glad it's all over! I was so scared. And now this awful Eurial is captured, your friend is unharmed, the Ball is over, and everyone is alive. Someone could've been poisoned. I'm glad it didn't happen!

But I must say this adventure could use more of our brave Aviaks. If I ever tell this story to anyone, I'll make Atis, Potis, Amis, and Ivok the main characters, sorry. Ivok especially, yes.
Is it over? How wonderful.

If you have questions regarding our actions, remember our lessons. We told you: without orcs, who are the lifeblood of the Imperial war machine, Xadagan is not a threat!

The best path to peace is to stop the war before it begins. Other Heads of the Houses will agree with me. Albert and Baudouin, for example. Once Antoinette became our ruler, these two apparently forgot about Our quarrel. The House de Desirae is gaining allies again.

Together, We will present our terms to the League. There will be no war with the Empire. Don't even think about taking advantage of its vulnerability!

That way we'll put an end to all wars in no time.
We can see by your face that Elleken told you everything... Well... We had to keep some things from you for the good of everyone.

Yes, we always get drawn into some ancient mysteries... Just like on Ferris! I feel bad for Skulnar, we only recently met on Coldberg. He's a great guy, eysh!

Alright, we'll rest a bit here, and then I'll go back to Ferris. They are preparing another expedition. Don't forget your old friend Murk, you hear me? You'll call me if something interesting happens, right?
Aho, friends! I'm glad you made it!
! You are both here... What happened?

I suspected Elleken had something to do with that, but I didn't know what he was plotting.

Journeys to another world? Well, Catherina and Ollum will definitely be interested. But there's a small problem: there are no Star Gates left in this world, they turned into dust when we sent the Architect through them.

Not to mention the fact that you'll need a map first. A navigator is useless without a route.

Elleken is right about one thing: there are monsters beyond the barrier that separates Sarnaut from other worlds. We have already seen the Architects. I'm certain there are other hostile creatures in that endless space.

name.en: Why didn't anyone help me fight Elleken?

text.en:
Elleken is extremely powerful - even my powers weren't enough to breach his defenses. Unless I had drown power from the Well, but then the consequences could have been disastrous. Experience means a great deal - I might be old, but compared to him, I'm just a greenhorn.

I could only pinpoint a potential exit point from these catacombs.

name.en: What do you think about Elleken's further plans and Skulnar's destiny?

text.en:
Elleken will bide his time. He has done what he planned, and now Skulnar has no other choice but to complete the Great Mage training. Otherwise his new powers will destroy him.

As I said, without the Star Gates or anything that can replace them, we can't even begin to consider leaving Sarnaut. But the first Great Mage knows how to wait. He is patient, so... If the new Gates do appear, we'll have something to worry about.

As for Skulnar... I feel sorry for him, he didn't choose this path. He needs to be trained... But no one in the Empire will do it. The League won't do it either.

So I have no choice but to try and make him a Great Mage myself. That would be... uncommon.

Skulnar is not the only one Elleken abandoned here. We have his daughter, Eurial. Soon I'll take them both to the allod of the Nea Historians. I will train Skulnar there and see if I can make our "viper" change her views.
You can speak with the rest if you like. Come find me once you're done. I'll send you and Skulnar to get some rest, while I... discuss what happened with everyone involved.

name.en: I'd like to get some rest when it's over.

text.en:
That's correct. But I believe His Majesty has questions about what happened... As do everyone here. Let's spare them a few minutes before we leave, if you don't mind.

Ready to leave and get some rest?
It's like nothing has really changed, but I keep having these visions... Something is coming, , I can feel it. This was nothing. Well, we're on vacation, so let's enjoy it...
Hello, hello, ...
I'm great! Another adventure is over, the Hero of Sarnaut had the most fun... But I'm used to it. Take your seat!
It's nice here... Peaceful.

name.en: What's going on here?! What about Skulnar?

text.en:
It's the result of my experiment! You have probably figured out a few things. I'll tell you the rest.

You and I are quite similar. I used to be one of those who are now called Great Mages. I wanted the best for my people. Our ideals of Beauty required that we change the world... But then we met dragons and realized we were not perfect. I was one of those who planned the Change.

As you can imagine, we failed to accomplish that. Nemeina and I wanted to keep trying. But everyone else was against it. The dispute culminated in our departure from Irene.

What is it you think we have in common? Just like you, I received a Revelation of Nihaz. I realized that this world is a prison! There are other worlds full of the primordial, true Beauty!

name.en: What do you need Skulnar for?

text.en:
It's simple. To get to other worlds, we need Star Gates! But traveling between worlds is dangerous... The space is inhabited by creatures so hideous your imagination would fail to draw you a picture. We need a navigator for traveling between worlds. The one who will infallibly pick the safe path.

My experiments showed me that an orc would be a perfect candidate for the role. This race, forgive my frankness, is rather dull, but their intuition is rarely wrong. There's only one problem: the navigator must be a mage, and not just any mage, but a Great one. And the orcs' magical powers are lacking, as you know.

Then I remembered my Key of Creation. One of the artifacts Nihaz left in the world. By then, Grallon had the key, but you already know this story.

I got the Key and went to the Grok allod. The Great Mage Claude de Vevre was once a student of mine, and unlike the other members of the Conclave, he had a rather liberal view on what was considered forbidden. Together with Nemeina and our daughter Eurial, we chose an orc and used the powers of the Key of Creation and the Key of Chaos on him! The result exceeded our expectations!

name.en: But something went wrong? Something always goes wrong.

text.en:
Of course!

Orcs are a savage people, and Lorzub the Fierce - that was our test subject - went out of control. It turned out he had a lover, and they were about to escape together. Alas, our attempt to get him back resulted in his death. By then, the Conclave got wind of what we were doing, and we had to leave Grok. Claude had the Key of Chaos.

Claude learned that Lorzub had a son. Alas, that line got lost among the Tribe of the Fierce, and Claude's attempts to find the orc who could wield magic ended in failure. Then the Shamans and the Empire heard of it. The Committee has full reports on what happened on Grok - when they killed Claude, they found his notes. But the Empire gains nothing by giving this information to the orcs - that's why they will keep calling it a "random astral mutation".

Before his death, Claude hid the Key of Chaos, and it remained hidden until Grok was destroyed by an Octulhu on the Night of Astral Portals. You know this creature as Ar Kanim. And then you extracted the power of the Key of Chaos, also known as the Key of Astral Iron, from its blood.

End of story? Not quite. Then I learned about Lorzub's descendants... Alas, they died fast. Faster then I could get to them. But then you and that mad Cosmos managed to get Skulnar out, and I'm grateful you did.

Now I needed to bring together Skulnar and dragon blood. Irene was perfect for that. I used my connections with the House de Vevre and made Caspar invite him. His Majesty Louis's help came in handy as well - he, of course, knew everything and saw it as an opportunity to get ahead of the Empire.

I don't care. I need Skulnar only as a potential guide for other worlds.

name.en: You can't do it, I won't let you take Skulnar!

text.en:
Oh, don't give me that.

This orc was created with a purpose: he will become a Great Mage. That's his destiny, and you can't escape destiny. Sooner or later, it was bound to happen. I simply decided to hurry things along.

There's still a lot you don't know about the things that take place in our world. Powers that guide you are older than Sarnaut itself. Things happening here are just a part of the Great War. Some day you will learn everything, like I once did. Why Nihaz captured Sarn, why they quarreled, whose daughter the Soul of the World really is, and other important things.

Only then you will have the true freedom of choice and will be able to make it depending on your interests. For now, don't meddle. Master must finish his work.
Sooner or later all secrets turn into revelations.
Renard! The puffed-up idiot!

Oh, I'm so mad!

The schemer, the villain, the despot! He dares to spy on my daughters! This spider has turned Irene in his cobweb! A spy on every corner! A scout behind every fence!

My poor daughters and I are doing everything to bring real peace to the unhappy, broken Sarnaut. But there are still those who want to ruin everything. They hide behind false ideals, they saw hatred, which bears the poisonous fruit of war!

Oh, my poor daughters! You were through so much! My babies... Aurora, Beata, Claire, Diana, Ellen, Fleur, Gala, Hermina, Iris, Justine, Laura, Maude, Nadine, Odetta, Pauletta, Renee, Sandrine, Tiffany, Ulrica, Vitalina, Ivetta, and... what was it... oh, yes, baby Zoe!

What do you want? Peace? Or a continued war with the Empire?

name.en: Peace sounds like a good option.

text.en:
You get me, don't you?

We're bringing closer the moment when peace establishes in Sarnaut! We already reached truce! We settled things with the Empire, demons, architects, even vampires!

The war will be over soon. If House de Delice wins the Big Game, of course.

name.en: The League is the League. The Empire is the Empire. They aren't destined to be friends.

text.en:
You're wrong, just like Renard.

We can always come to terms. History knows many examples. Just ask Zayan. Besides, you will see a proof very soon.

I'm not the only one who believes in it. So does Queen Lucretia de Desirae, my best childhood friend.
What an unruly woman...!

Enemies? With her? What nonsense. The hen and her chicks aren't worthy of it.

The good of the nation is my top priority. The elven nation, that is. Today our lives are entangled with the League. It means, what is bad for the League, is bad for elves.
