Yes, we reached truce with the Empire. At what price? The God of Darkness is a big enough threat. We didn't have a choice. The damned Cosmos also threatened to wipe us out unless we make "friends." What is a friendship worth, when sworn enemies are holding knives behind their backs, ready to stab a "friend" at the first opportunity?

She thinks I'm spying on her. On her and her girls. Ha!

I'm spying on everyone on this allod! Tep knows what's happening here! Especially when they lifted the blockage and let everyone on this allod! See for yourself: the Xadaganians are sending encrypted letters, smaller races are rioting in the city, savage Kobolds are digging in ancient tunnels! Peasant actors are throwing show after show! What an awful mess!

I couldn't do it without my assistant. Lamias? What about them? They used to serve House de Grandeur, but I'm paying them better. They serve me now. They do more good than the noble Aviaks, who are only looking for fights.

Am I wrong, trying to unravel Antoinette's scheming? She wants the Empire to drive a wedge between the League and the elves!

name.en: Antoinette wants peace. Peace is better than war.

text.en:
You're so naive! It's weird, coming from a hero!

Peace is possible only when the enemy gives up. I'll believe in peace after I see House de Ardeur banner on Yasker's Tower. The gang must be brought to justice. First the trial, then complete demilitarization, and an irrevocable ban on the Imperial ideology!

Because the other option is the red flag in the sky of Novograd, drills, military lifestyle, and barracks all over, like on Igsh. See? It's one way or the other. There's no third option.

name.en: Contradictions between the League and Empire can't be settled!

text.en:
I was thinking the same thing!

A solid hostility is better than fragile peace. We can sign truce all we want, we can negotiate all we like, but the essence can't be changed. The League and Empire have completely different ideologies. We want different things. We have different ideals.

The attempts to find common ground are a waste of time. And for the benefit of the enemy. We're working for the Empire, while the Empire is working for us. I know that. I bribed dozens of Xadaganians generals, hahaha!

We're here for the good of the Empire, !

But an order is an order, right? No temptations can seduce a patriot of the Empire, whose moral is impeccable and goals noble!

It's not as though I always understood the elves, ...

But they know how it's done. We're more used to hay, straw, and manure, and look at this neat place! I'd hate to say goodbye to the elves.

name.en: I want you to sing another song

text.en: One song per minute! Guild rules! Come back later.

name.en: Can you sing a good song about the Empire or a bad song about the League?

text.en: Of course! Two silver coins, and I'll come up with something.

name.en: Can you sing a good song about the League or a bad song about the Empire?

text.en: Sure thing. Two silver coins, and everybody will hear it.
Do you want a song? Toss a coin!

"Hello, my dear diary!

I'm Princess Daguta de Dernier. I'll write my thoughts, impressions, and other stuff in you.

Let me introduce myself. You know the name, and as for the rest... I'm a heir to my father, King Grallon, the last of Irene kings. Sadly, my mother died during the Cataclysm, which shattered the world into allods. Irene is now one of the allods, a lonely island, which is floating in deep astral."

"Long time no see, diary!

I guess I need to tell you about my life. Life is hard. I want to find someone truly worthy of me, but it's pretty hard. I met many people, I gave my love to many, but I haven't found an equal.

Unfortunately, each of them has too many cons that I can't deal with. I'm very vulnerable. If I reject someone, I can't stand the sight of him anymore. This would be a big problem if it weren't for my father's loyal servants, always willing to help. And, of course, the endless astral, always willing to accept the rejected man's body...

I continue my search."

"Diary! You won't believe this!

A mysterious unknown stranger has arrived at our allod for the first time in many years. He explained that he managed to find the ancient ways that lead through the astral. Amazing!

If you only knew how pretty he is! How wisely he speaks! He charmed everyone in the palace. Father allowed him to stay, although we didn't know the name of the stranger.

We exchanged a couple of words. He knows more about Irene than all of us combined!

I must earn his love! There's no other way to be!"

"Oh, my diary! Woe is me!

The stranger I wrote about earlier! He's neglecting me! He's very sweet, gentle, and kind, but I simply cannot win his heart!

I don't understand what he wants. Father can't help me. Now that the Stranger brought back the old tradition of Great Balls, it's much more fun on Irene now than it was before. But still, I don't understand why he neglects me! I'm the true treasure of Irene!

It's time for us to talk! Tomorrow! Tomorrow I'll ask him directly why he doesn't like me.

I'm prepared for anything to make him mine!"

"Hello again, my diary!

I'm advised to write more about myself. Here goes. I'm pretty young, according to my people's standards. I was six when the Cataclysm happened. Now it's the twelfth year of the new era. I don't have any siblings. No family at all, except my father. He says we do have a very old next of kin on distant allods. I know nothing about him.

Irene isn't as big as I want it to be. I've learned every corner of it over these years."

"Hello, my dear diary.

As I said, Irene is a pretty small allod. Ker-Is, the capital, is the only city. Years ago, we owned the whole peninsula, with a lot of cities in it: from Tir Toingire to Hay Brezal, from Mag Mell to Aiman Ablah...

It was a fairy land, well protected against any invaders with a magical wall, impassible for anyone with hostile intentions. The Cataclysm ruined almost the entire kingdom. We are the few that lived."

"Hello again, my diary!

I told you that we lived on a small island that was left from our kingdom. We don't have many people here. Only about a thousand elves in the entire capital Ker-Is. I think I know them all in person. How boring!

I read a lot about the past, about the tournaments, balls, and celebrations... Nothing happens nowadays. My father, the king, is still grieving.

But I'm done grieving!"

"Hey, diary, I'm back!

I need someone to complain to. I'm looking for someone worthy of me for a long while, but there isn't anyone. Irene is small. We don't have any equals, and therefore, I'm destined to die alone!

Father doesn't even want to hear about finding me an inferior husband! It's so unfair!

I'm so angry, I'm going to seduce our stable boy!"

"I'm happy to see you again, my diary!

The news is, my father was super angry when he found out about that one time in stables. There was no scandal, though. But I wish there were! I could give him a piece of my mind!

In the meantime, I'm secretly dating my beloved Raul in the nearby forest. Egladien is a beautiful place with a grim history. There was a time when it was called Filthy Forest because of the trolls that lived in the thicket and made an ugly mess of it.

It was in the ancient times. Brave knights got rid of the trolls, anyway."

"Hello, my dear diary!

I'd like to share another story of my life. There was a scandal when my father's servants stumbled upon me and Raul in the forest and reported us to father.

I'll stand my ground: since our remote allod is isolated from the rest of the world, there's nothing left for me to do but make love! Isn't pleasure the point of living for any elf? Father didn't even contradict it. He just gave up.

I'll act as I want. I'll do what I like. No one can order me around any more."

"I'm happy to put down a few lines in you, my dear diary.

Many things happened lately. I don't like the stable boy Raul any longer. He's too annoying, and always jealous of me when I talk with other lovely young men. There are plenty of them in the palace.

I don't want to get upset. What shall I do?"

"We meet again, dear diary!

Here's what happened: I talked to two lovely court squires, Nicolas and Michael. They're brothers, and they're very fun. We talked about a lot of funny things. I complained about the stalking boyfriend, and they promised to help me.

And you know what? They did! They went straight into his room, tied him up, put him in a big bag, and threw him into the astral from a cliff!

It's a bit too much, but I'm afraid, this is the only way out on a small allod, where everyone knows everybody. After all, how could I face him after I dumped him?

The brothers are lovely. I'll thank them... both."
May the Light be with you, !

name.en: What can you tell me about you House?

text.en:
House de Ardeur is one of the greatest elven Houses. We achieved much, both in glorifying the Lights and in engineering, making a fine example for other elves. Mirage and Galleon Castle are our inventions. Our leaders, siblings Renard and Marianne, are the Heads of the Church of All Elves.

Lumenara is our allod of origin. A bright lighthouse in the astral abyss, an amber-lit shelter for everyone who wants to change this world. Thanks to Renard, all our technical innovations are on this allod, and thanks to the power of Light, it's a truly safe place. We're not alone on the Lumenara allod. The Aviak tribe, our loyal servants, defenders, and assistants inhabit this place.

name.en: What do you think about the other Great Houses if I may ask?

text.en:
We respect House de Blizare. We share their passion to exploration and development of this world. House de Desirae are our old friends and allies, who helped us construct the Galleon Palaces. House de Pluie are our trading partners, spare parts suppliers, and supporters in spreading the teachings of the Church of Light.

Our relations with other Houses are not so light. House de Vevre are troublemakers. Too careless to rely on. House de Grandeur are incredibly arrogant, rejecting everything new in life. House de Delice... well, I don't even want to talk about them. Decadence and filth!

Every House has an exception. There's no painting them with a broad brush.

After the Yazes events, I decided to dedicate myself to theoretical theology. Yes... yes! I mean the Master we came across while storming the Gorluxor's Tower. I was especially interested in his Light Side. After all the events, it's very important that we understand the essence of Tensess's Gift. The data was strictly classified, but extremely interesting!

I can send you my work when it's finished.
Oh, beautiful Irene! I've always wanted to visit. Just imagine the scenes I could play here, !

name.en: What can you tell me about you House?

text.en:
House de Grandeur is truly great. I can't put it in a nutshell. First of all, we're famous for our interest in magic. Magic is everything for us. We even have two Great Mages: brothers Albert and Baudouin. They govern two allods, Lightwood and Stellar. Our House has the biggest number of magisters of magic among elves!

Stellar, our main allod, is covered with a peaceful forest under a vast starry sky. The main elven magic school is located on Stellar. Elves start school in a very young age. The Lightwood allod used to belong to Kania. Today it is the residence of the Gibberlings. We help them settle down, resolve their conflicts with local forest people and Kanians, who still live on the Lightwood allod. Apart from elves, we have lamias on Stellar. We're teaching them magic. We have formed a regiment of magic support under command of a mysterious person...

name.en: What do you think about the other Great Houses if I may ask?

text.en:
House de Blizare shares our passion for knowledge. They know almost as much as we do about magic, although they're more passionate... about the practical side. We deeply respect House de Delice, which is always willing to give support. Besides, we respect House de Pluie that helps us with rare magic books and artifacts.

We treat House de Ardeur with caution. They're fanatics. Their "high-end technology" contradicts the ancient teachings of magic! House de Vevre? Too carefree. All they ever want to do is sing songs. House de Desirae members are greedy for power. They're manipulative schemers with sticky fingers.

I have friends in every House, but this has nothing to do with politics.

Oh, you know, we've returned from Howlem just recently, after they stopped hosting theatrical plays. I couldn't possibly miss the Great Ball! No way! There's a bunch of curious stuff this year. So we decided to meet on Irene. It's more fun than the boring Tenebra. Did you know that we had our own theater over here? No one knows the owner's name!
I have a gut feeling, ... Something big is ahead.

name.en: What can you tell me about you House?

text.en:
About House de Vevre? Not that I'm related to it. I'm a Demon Hunter, we have our own brotherhood. On the other hand, every elf relates to their House, and the ties can't be broken. I'm sure my professional success affects my House.

Ah well. Our House is famous for fine arts. Music, mostly. There are a great many bards in my House. On my allod, we even have a bard academy, which provides professional education in music. I'm not very good at it, so I became an Oracle. But of course, music isn't our only thing. My House is full of great spies. That's where the Oracles can flourish!

Our allod Florenta is always in bloom. There are no other seasons but summer and spring. The allod is covered in flowers and bushes, the aroma is amazing, the bees are buzzing so loudly that you can't hear anything else. We also have harpies, who have been serving the House for many years. We tried to give them everything we own, and thus made them more civilized than any other harpy colony in Sarnaut.

name.en: What do you think about the other Great Houses if I may ask?

text.en:
Speaking of official relations and the public opinion, here's what I have to say: House de Blizare is our ally. It's full of highly intelligent elves, pleasant to speak with. House de Delice and us have a mutual affection... as advocates of free love. Of course, there's House de Pluie that deeply appreciates our musical and other art creation.

Speaking of dislikes, we hate the way House de Ardeur is treating us! They're hypocrites, fanatics! House de Grandeur is chin-deep in their "magic research", way too deep to be an interesting company. As to House de Desirae... they've been the ruling house for so many years that they make us sick.

It's only natural that I have different kinds of relationships with members of all these Houses. I can't generalize them. Apples and oranges, you know.

name.en: What are you busy with now?

text.en:
I arrived at Irene with a group of Aoidoi from Ammer. Other than that, I've been trying to patch up a misunderstanding after Sogot events. What can I say? Nice going, Zakhar Krestov, thanks for nothing. It nearly gave a heart attack to our Hunter Commander, Negus Baruti.

I wouldn't trust the demonologists if I were you. I wonder how many of them there are among the elves.

I was going to go to Sogot after the Great Ball and try to figure out what happened. I'm especially curious about my friend's fate... August de Grandeur's.
We're attracted to Irene by the light of the science called History, .

name.en: What can you tell me about you House?

text.en:
Omigod! I'm a simple historian! Don't ask me about politics. I haven't been home for ages. I have no idea what's going on. Ask someone else. Or if you're curious, I can tell you a bit about the history.

House de Delice used to be famous for its portal magic. It was common. There was next to no connection between allods after the Cataclysm. The Great Mages knew how to open temporary but very costly portals. Later, House de Delice came up with stationary portals, which were cheaper and more stable. I hear, it involved some June magic, but even so, making working spells of relocation in the chaotic astral... was not easy. Years went by. Everyone mastered the portal technology, and the glory of House de Delice began to fade. It was like this until the moment when Antoinette became the Head of the House. She placed her bet on diplomacy. We've been known as masters of negotiations ever since.

Ignis, our native allod, is a tropical atoll with an active volcano in the middle. Despite this, our land is lovely. The soil yields rich harvests, and magic protects us from dangers. Werebears are the servants of our House on Ignis. We tamed them and brought to obedience.

name.en: What do you think about the other Great Houses if I may ask?

text.en:
Let me tell you about the latest rumors. We're allies with House de Vevre. That's probably due to the easy attitude toward life. Both Houses are known for our... relaxed morality. We're also friends with House de Grandeur. They're open for cooperation and generous with good advice. There's, of course, House de Desirae. Queen Lucretia and Antoinette are old friends.

As to our rivals, I'd say, we lack understanding with House de Ardeur, which has become way too holy lately. We're far from agreement with House de Blizare, too. All they're thinking about is their inventions. And there's, of course, House de Pluie. The cynicism of their "business approach" is simply shocking.

Of course, this isn't my personal opinion. Common elves of the Houses may disregard the politics.

name.en: How are you? What are you up to?

text.en:
I've just visited a scientific conference on Nea. We discussed the final report on Junes. Yes, the studies in the Holy Land are officially completed, but my colleagues will still work there on their own accord.

And now we're heading to Ferris... perhaps. Herbert de Vevre's researchers completed some preliminary works, gathered interesting data, which needs thorough study. The only problem is the quarantine, applied by the League and Empire. I hear, they're about to lift it. The Imperials and the Gibberlings are ready to dispatch their expeditions. What are they looking for? I don't know.
Can you believe it, ? They took my alchemical bombs and fireworks at the port!

name.en: What can you tell me about you House?

text.en:
Haven't you ever heard about the Great House de Blizare? Unbelievable. Alright, I'll tell you. My House is famous for our knowledge of magic, not in theory, but purely in practice. The field we shine at is alchemy. Yes, that's what I do.

Our allod Gelida is quite chilly, but thanks to our potions, we don't have any problems. It's always warm in our palaces even if a blizzard is storming outside. We share Gelida with forestfolks. We taught them many things in exchange for their eternal loyalty. They serve us now.

name.en: What do you think about the other Great Houses if I may ask?

text.en:
Yes, you may. We're allies with House de Ardeur. They came to help on many occasions. They're our true friends. We have a connection with House de Vevre, very easygoing and fun. We share common interests in magic studies with House de Grandeur.

We lack agreement with House de Delice. What a disgrace! It's a never ending debauchery, nothing else. House de Pluie lost their honesty in business deals. And House de Desirae is too greedy for power.

name.en: What are you up to? What are you doing on Irene?

text.en:
We're restoring Dane after the war with the architects. We put cities in order, but the north, especially the Wasp Yar, is still swarming with cultists. There's also the unfinished gate, the notorious architects' portal. Master's death locked it, but the Fractal is still active. We might need to seek Sculptor's help to control the local beasts. Although many don't trust him.

What we need is to combine our efforts. There have been so many new things lately, it makes my head spin. I want to ask Maximilien de Blizare, head of my House, for an opportunity to study the material that the architects use to create their bodies.
Glad to see you, . We glorified your feats by holding them up as an example for the pathetic Imperials!
You look familiar, . Where have we met? Are you the one that bought a whole lot of Pointy Ears in Nezebgrad?

name.en: What can you tell me about you House?

text.en:
Hah! The Great House de Pluie is natural in sales. Some say that we're too deep in business, banking, and other down to earth stuff, despised by many. There's beauty in it, believe me. Besides, House de Pluie is hosting the best artists, sculptors, and jewelers. Their works grant our superiority in the market.

The stormy Tempesta, our home allod, has harsh weather conditions. Our houses are built at a lake shore, on cliffs, but we don't care about the location: our homes are comfortable and well protected against any weather. Local minotaurs are our loyal servants. They made excellent guards for our goods.

name.en: What do you think about the other Great Houses if I may ask?

text.en:
My House gets along with House de Ardeur. Their chaplains are always willing to offer spiritual support and cure. They're our advocates. We appreciate House de Vevre. They share our passion to fine arts, but their field is music. House de Vevre is one of our major customers. And finally, House de Grandeur. They're also our clients, they buy ancient books and scrolls with spells.

We don't have any relations with House de Blizare. They're too arrogant and patronizing. They despise the "filthy money" and business people. House de Delice. They want everything cheap. We just can't afford doing business with them. House de Desirae has crazy taxes!

I personally can find common grounds with any elves, regardless of the House.  It would be stupid to miss opportunity, based on prejudice. Am I right?

name.en: What are you doing on Irene?

text.en:
I want to develop my project of cultural expansion of the Empire. We had great success, established delivery of smuggled goods on Igsh. There's no other option of ending this war other than imposing our vision on them! We need propaganda, which must be stronger than local agitators' and commissars' nonsense!

Our most popular and best selling item is the Pointy Ears magazine. I arrived at Irene to find new models. You know, some hot chicks! Real hellraisers!
, did you know that Irene was discovered on the day when your journey began?

name.en: What can you tell me about you House?

text.en:
Don't tell me you've never heard about us. We're famous! But alright. House de Desirae, one of the most ancient Houses, was related to the last royal House of Irene, which enabled Margo de Desirae, the mother of the king, to declare herself the queen. That was when the other Houses decided to elect the ruling House at the Great Ball. House de Desirae won several times. We connect our current success with Prince Dakkar, our king's son. He rekindled the popularity of necromancy among elves, and Conclave lifted the ban! Some unpleasant events took place after that Ball. House de Doucer, or rather, Armando, the head, was mean enough to kill the prince's bride, which was a flagrant violation of the Great Game rules. Louis de Desirae declared the House outlaws, and confiscated their home allod Nocturne.

Today House de Desirae owns two allods, the small Tenebra and the big Nocturne. Tenebra was captured by the powers of Darkness ten years, but this story is widely known. As to Nocturne, it was also influenced by Darkness. Armando's father, the Great Mage Gramon, used an incredibly powerful deadly spell during a demonic attack. It worked. The effect was so devastating that, apart from killing most demons, it took the life of the Great Mage and devastated the allod, filling it with the shadows of the dead. This is how Yoggor turned into Nocturne.

Our House's servants are Kobolds. Even death can't prevent them from fulfilling their duty.

name.en: What do you think about the other Great Houses if I may ask?

text.en:
Our king, may his name be covered in glory, supports good relations with two Houses: House de Ardeur, headed by Renard de Ardeur, who supports his policy and helps rule the elves, and House de Delice, headed by Antoinette de Delice. She's Queen Lucretia's close friend.

We're rather frosty with the other Houses. All of them, Blizare, Vever, Grandeur, and Pluie, dislike our king and his rule. They don't stand a chance of winning. You have to have the support of more than half of the other Houses, which no one has today.

name.en: What are you doing on Irene?

text.en:
I'm a historian. Irene is the greatest historical mystery. What do we know? The last king of Irene, Grallon, held the allod together with an extremely powerful artifact, the Key of Creation. A stranger arrived at his palace and seduced his daughter Daguta. He used her to steal the Key, and the allod started falling apart. Eventually, it was broken into shards, but didn't disappear. Why? Some say, it got into an astral bay, a quiet place, where the time flows differently. Others insist that according to an ancient legend there's a sleeping dragon under the royal palace.

In any case, I hope to study this issue. Can you help me with that?
, I'm so happy I met you. Have you seen my servant, Constance?

name.en: Lamias almost got her again. Ivok will take care of her.

text.en:
I'm worried about Constance. It's all Eurial's fault! She's the Cardinal's mole.

Antoinette is certain that Renard is plotting something. Did you deliver the letter?

name.en: I had to deliver the letter for her. The messenger wants you to be extra careful.

text.en:
Oh, I'm so grateful! What you do is very important for me. I need to ask you one more thing. Don't tell anyone.

I can't let anyone use this information against me, Antoinette, or Louis.

name.en: Will the king be angry with me for what I did for you?

text.en:
Don't worry about that. You're too important to cause my husband's discontent. The truly dangerous one is Eurial!

I don't want Constance to suffer, either.
I'm happy to see you again! What news do you have... good or bad?

Oooh! I can't... can't walk! For Tensess's sake! The letter! You must deliver it! I'll be alright, just find the messenger at the Harbor.

Don't read the letter. The password is, "Spring is the time for love."
Oh, my mistress... I'm so worried... How could this happen? There are spies behind every corner...

I knew I could rely on you.

I need to deliver this letter to the harbor. And I would, if it weren't for the damned snakes! They're following me around.

Please, help! This letter must be delivered to the right hands!
Hm, this is a lovely city. I could live here.

Whaaat? What love?

Oh, right! I know. Who are you? Where's the harpy?

name.en: Constance suffered an attack! She couldn't come.

text.en:
Oh blimey. So our secret affair has lost its covers. That general won't be pleased.

What else do you want?

You managed to deliver the message! Wonderful! Keep it up, comrade! That general will be pleased.

We had some security issues. I recommend you increase your level of alertness. The situation is risky. Tell the queen that we need to strengthen the security.
Comrade, how can we discuss it here, with an enemy eye, an enemy ear, and an enemy nose behind every bush? Secrecy comes first!

Here I am, the real me!

You failed both of your attempts. You won't get any answers. It's all fair!
I promised an answer to a single question. You got it. That's all.

I'm the real one!

Since I'm the real one, I can answer your question. Just one. Ask me.

Wow, at the first try! I praise your intuition.

Since I'm the real one, I can answer your question. Just one. Ask me.

Am I me or not me?

Guess which one is real.

Ooh, that's a good one. I'm Corinne, but you already know that.

One of the leading actresses in the play we're all involved in.

Oh, but we're all just masks. Don't you get it?

name.en: What do you want with Skulnar?

text.en:
You care about your friend, it's so sweet!

He arrived at this world with a purpose.

It's so wonderful to have a purpose, isn't it?

He's our little guiding light. We'll light it soon.

We need light to make way in the darkness.

So far, this is all you need to know.

From a land far far away!

Our Messere has been waiting for this for so long!

This allod was his homeland.

So far, this is all you need to know.
You've found the real me, I can answer your question. Just one. Ask me.

Ha ha! Ta da da dam.

How do you like this crazy world?

name.en: What do you want with Skulnar?

text.en: A flower will grow from a grain. You can make a mug from clay.

name.en: What does this mean? Who are you?

text.en:
Too many questions. It's boring.

Let's play. You'll get your answers if you win.

name.en: Your actress loses a mask. Here she is.

text.en:
Nonsense.

That's right, this is Corinne's mask, my theater's lead actress.

But you're wrong to think that the mask was lost, and you've found it. On the contrary, the mask found you. It chose you.
It's very simple. What don't you understand? It's common. Happens all the time.

Yes. Where should I begin?

Let me start with the events you were part of.

Ten years ago you witnessed House de Doucer's intervention in preparations of the Great Ball on Tenebra. My House was building the Galleon Castle, which was supposed to bring us victory, but Armando didn't let that happen. Tenebra was devoured by darkness. The Ball was postponed.

Over all these years the Ball was brought up on several occasions. And there were reasons to postpone it even further... until now.

The Great Ball will begin shortly. You must take part. You can hardly say no.

name.en: Tell me more about the Great Ball.

text.en:
The Great Ball is just a part of the Great Game. The Great Game is the reason for living of my people.

Every elf acts for the good of their House. Those who achieve a lot, gain power and influence, and rise over the others.

You need to come up with something truly unique to win the Great Ball. Something substantial. Something that will be valued by everyone, that can make a change.

By the victor's right, the winning House will determine the policies of all elves over the next decades. Until the next Great Ball.

Each of the seven Great Houses wants victory, of course.

Like in any other race, there are favorites.

Two Houses are leading the race: our House de Ardeur, and House de Delice.

Most importantly, we have different views on many issues. House de Ardeur supports alliance with Kania. House de Delice stands on neutral grounds. They believe that with the truce we can achieve a stable peace.

Each House, except for House de Desirae, has taken sides. We can discuss it later.

name.en: How can I get to the Ball?

text.en:
It's easy.

I'll give you the invitation from King Louis. He heard a lot about you and wants to meet you in person. The letter explains how to get there.

Louis is a crafty politician, a genius of scheming. He used accusations against Armando to gain control over his home allod. When the ruling House is changed, he'll do everything to keep as much control as he can.

Prince Dakkar is his son.

I need you to do something before going there.
Oh Tensess, I'm sick of prison food.
The rescue mission is clearly being delayed.
Where's my butterfly collection?
That can't be! Really? Is this some kind of joke?
Oh, finally. Your Xadaganian hospitality is making me sick.
Whaaat? I'm not going anywhere until I have my butterfly collection! I've been gathering it for over a century!
Hands off, you totalitarian scum!

name.en: All elves are granted an amnesty. You're free, you can leave Igsh now.

text.en: Nice try, I don't believe you. We know better than that.

name.en: I have an order signed by Yasker. The Empire and the League have reached the truce.

text.en: The truce, you say? Alright then, although it's hard to believe. Don't touch me! I'll walk.
Hands off, you bastards!

name.en: All elves are granted an amnesty. You're free, you can leave Igsh now.

text.en: You're only trying to lure us outside.

name.en: Here's the order signed by Yasker. All elves are being transported from Igsh over 24 hours.

text.en: I wonder what's got into the tyrant and dictator. I'll go, alright. But don't touch me, or I'll scratch out your eyes.
Aaaaa! I need help! Not the mines again!

name.en: All elves are granted an amnesty. You're free, you can leave Igsh now.

text.en: Nice try! I'm not buying it.

name.en: Yasker sent me over to supervise your release and transportation from Igsh.

text.en: I can tell you're lying... ah, whatever. I'm sick of being here anyway.
Greetings, friend! The prison is in perfect condition, the number of jailbreaks isn't any higher than in the recent years. I already sent an explanatory note about the incident with the elven girl.

name.en: Deliver the Elf Amnesty Order to the prison warden.

text.en:
This makes things much easier.

Who do we have here... let's see... Ardeur, Blizare, Vevre, Grandeur... Yep, those are our inmates. We have a problem with Desirae, Delice, and Pluie. They escaped. If I could have it my way, I'd send them to community service forever. I can't count the times we caught them. And now what? We have to release them? Of our own accord?

Come on, we have no choice. This is a mission of national importance! I'll get the paperwork moving and the portal set up. We'll transport the prisoners from Igsh.

You won't have to look for the inmates. We know exactly where they are.
Boohoo. I'm sick of being here. Can I switch jobs?
Wow! Is it true? Finally!
Psst! Are you looking to trade?

name.en: Hello! Are you going to the Great Ball?

text.en: Of course! It's been thirty years! What a unique event! The most powerful magicians will throw the greatest talent show! I can't miss it.

name.en: What can you say about the League? What's House de Grandeur's attitude?

text.en:
I don't even know what to tell you. I've been teaching young mages here in Novograd forever. I'm used to everything. The League is like a sweet home.

People are tired of wars. There's some new trouble every year.

I completely understand those who are sick of it.

name.en: Good afternoon! Are you going to the Great Ball?

text.en:
But of course.

How can an elf miss this event? Especially when such an important decision is at stake!

name.en: What can you say about the League? What's House de Ardeur's attitude?

text.en:
House de Ardeur is fully devoted to the League.

Renard, my brother and the head of the House, is one of the most active League supporters. It's hard to find a House that is more passionate about our common cause. Aidenus can count on us. Tell him that. We won't leave Kania and the Gibberlings unsupported.

It doesn't mean that we want war. I'm sure the upcoming union of the League and Imperial churches means a long-term peace.

name.en: Hello! I believe you can't just drop everything and visit the Great Ball?

text.en:
Oh, come on. Why not? The portal is set up. Everything else is automated.

I can leave a holographic image of me to avoid questions and rush to the Ball.

name.en: What can you say about the League? What's House de Delice's attitude?

text.en:
What can I say?

I don't mind the League, and I've grown to like Novograd.

But my House.... Antoinette and her daughters are in charge. They've got their own ideas. You know, this and that. Bring back the vampires, sign truce with the Empire. This may be rational. The League and Empire made a pact on Dane and defeated the architects. Could they achieve it on their own?

We're being threatened again. The darkness, the new demons. They will crush us if we're apart. We stand a chance if we're united.

name.en: Hey, are you invited to the Ball?

text.en: Of course. This year, my House de Desirae hosts the Ball. I'll surely go there when it starts.

name.en: What can you say about the League? What's House de Desirae's attitude?

text.en:
That's a tricky question, huh?

Our king is the central figure. What can our attitude be? Isn't Louis de Desirae, together with other Great Mages, Aidenus, Catherina, and others, part of the Conclave?

Look at it this way. We have done a lot for the League. What the elves got in return? That's another question. I'd say, it's mutual. Others wouldn't.

name.en: Hi there! Will the beautiful elven girls be able to enjoy your singing at the Great Ball?

text.en:
Of course!

I wrote several potential hits! Do you want to hear?

name.en: Some other time. What can you say about the League? What's House de Vevre's attitude?

text.en:
Ugh... But oh well.

We're all for the League. Alliances are cool. As long as they aren't directed against someone.

I don't get it, why don't we all form an alliance? We're on peaceful terms with the Empire. We settled things down with demons and architects.

How about a global union, huh? PanSarnaut League? Anyway, House de Vevre wants to make love, peace, and music, not war.

name.en: I don't need anything. Are you going to the Great Ball?

text.en: Ooh, believe me, this isn't something you want to miss. You'll be sorry for the rest of your life.

name.en: What can you say about the League? What's House de Blizare's attitude?

text.en:
Ugh, politics.

Well, then... House de Blizare shares the League's ideology. Not so much the Empire's. We hate slogans and military drills. I know, people are sick from hostility, but believe me, we have very little in common with the Empire. All our alliances will be temporary. Sooner or later, war will break out.

My kin are dreaming to reform the Empire. They smuggle in clothes, erotic magazines, stuff like that. Time will show if it works. But I know for sure, talk won't change much.

name.en: Are the elven people preparing the Great Ball?

text.en: It's been cooking for a while. I know it'll take place very soon. I'll surely visit. Maybe, I'll even sign a contract or two.

name.en: What can you say about the League? What's House de Pluie's attitude?

text.en:
The League is cool. Very cool. The shipments are growing, the trade is booming.

I'm a little sceptic about the truce with the Empire, though. They're pretty weird about trade. They're okay with the Free Traders, but they just can't stand us on the market. Is that the idea of the truce?

My House thinks the truce is no biggie. The Empire is still our enemy.

name.en: Pass the Invitation to the Great Ball

text.en: Thank you. Thank you so much... I'm glad I'm not forgotten. I've been here for ten years! It's time to find myself a replacement. I wish there were volunteers.

name.en: What's going on out there? How are the werewolves doing?

text.en:
Life goes on.

After you defeated Vakula, the werewolves elected a new leader. He never cared about the treaty, though. He said it wasn't fair.

So they stayed here. They don't attack anyone, at least. No one's going to hunt them down on foothills, in forests, and mountain caves.

The nobility is talking about rioting again. It's been ten years since the rioters were executed, their kids have grown.
Were we watching the werewolves? On the contrary, they were watching us.

name.en: Pass the Invitation to the Great Ball

text.en: Thank you so much! It's an honor to receive the Invitation to the Great Ball from your hands.

name.en: How are things in the Siveria?

text.en:
It's all going great.

The undead from Men-Khatton don't give us much trouble. We have a real trading node here.

Gibberlings bring goods for transport to the New Land. Tiger and White orcs also deliver... whatchamacallit... The tribute... Yasak!

We do missionary work: we heal, teach, and share our faith in Tensess. And thanking our Mother for that.
Hello, hello! What brings you here to our frozen land? The call of duty?

name.en: Pass the Invitation to the Great Ball

text.en: Oh, is it for me? Thank you so much! Of course, I'll be there.

name.en: How have you been doing after the mysterious island event?

text.en:
It's all going great.

I've seen Amanda recently. She's back from Umoir.

She and I, along with some old friends from the mysterious island, are preparing an expedition. But that's after the Great Ball, of course.

We want to check some theories about Isa and the Gibberlings.

Ton and I are waiting for someone else here.
Welcome back! I'm glad to see you! What brings you here?

name.en: Pass the Invitation to the Great Ball

text.en: It's quite unexpected to receive this from your hands. Thank you for the great honor.

name.en: How are you doing in Siveria?

text.en:
Hmm. Not so bad.

After that one time, I've been supervising the local harbor, looking for smuggled and counterfeit goods. This is a crowded node, it keeps me pretty busy.

Siveria is slowly being populated, mainly by Gibberlings, but Kanian saltworkers, hunters, and woodcutters, also come here.

The nobility has been visiting us over the last year. They're plotting something. Mark my words.

I'll be happy to visit a big city and the Great Ball. I hear, they are going to grant amnesty to House de Doucer. I can't wait to see.

name.en: Pass the Invitation to the Great Ball

text.en: How interesting! Invitation to the Great Ball. From your own hands! It is a truly lucky day today.

name.en: What are you up to? What are you doing in Lightwood?

text.en:
We're still hunting the bandits in local forests and mountains.

We destroyed the biggest gangs ten years ago, with your help, but some petty bandits are left. We're hunting them down. We'd finish them, but the war is always in our way. You know, the demons, the architects...

Over the last year, the bandits have been receiving help from outside the allod. Someone brings smuggled weapons, puts in stashes on the shore, and quietly leaves. We don't have enough ships to patrol the whole place.

I'll set up a great manhunt after the Great Ball. The new gang, the Rats, are a pain in merchants' neck. I need to chase the rats down and execute them.
First and foremost, we are looking out for the League's best interests! We also look after the interests of elves and our own House.

name.en: Pass the Invitation to the Great Ball

text.en: An invitation? To the Great Ball? Are you joking? You're delivering it into my hands? I'm lost for words...

name.en: How are you doing here in Darkwater?

text.en:
Same old, same old. Many thought that everything will go back to normal after the victory over the Castle's curse. However, the Kanian authorities doesn't seem to have resources for this place. The locals somehow manage to survive, but I'm telling you, they have a lot on their plate.

We have a problem with bandits in Valir. They have some hideouts in the thicket. And I suspect someone's been helping them over the past year. There's word on the street.

Settlement dwellers arrested several bandits and tortured some information out from them. Discontent nobility is supporting the bandits. Someone way more powerful is supporting the nobility. Rumor has it... should I tell you? Rumor has it, the Gray Prince is involved.

name.en: Pass the Invitation to the Great Ball

text.en: Thank you for passing the invitation. As a representative of the ruling House, I'm glad that you've been tasked with it. You're famous among my people. Not many can achieve so much over a short period of time.

name.en: How's House de Desirae doing on Tenebra?

text.en:
On Tenebra?

Well... We're still dealing with the consequences of the dark emission from the Citadel. It has affected most living things on this allod.

We've lost our former Galleon Castle. Luckily, House de Ardeur could find another solution, but I can't discuss it yet.

We've learned how to handle the dark emission. Haven't we faced something similar on Nocturne?
This place sends shivers down my spine... The Tree... What is it? The essence of life?

name.en: I need to get to the Astral Atoll to Daniel de Pluie

text.en: This is the right ship! The ship to the Astral Atoll departs every two minutes from this pier. Don't miss your ship and watch out for the astral.
Wow! ! It's been a while! I didn't expect to see you again!

Receiving visitors!

Why? It's a comfortable location. Quiet, on the one hand. On the other hand, lots of ships pass by. I can get to Novograd if I need to.

Daniel and I are meeting someone here. We're going on an expedition, but we need to discuss everything first.

There's one thing I can tell you. It's Ferris. It's quarantined for now. The place is dangerous, with all these crazy Mechanoids and modificants.

But still. What is Ferris? We know for sure that this is the place where the Sculptor landed. Where was Ferris before the Cataclysm? Why does its fauna looks exactly like that of Howlem, which is a part of Isa? Are you getting my drift?

Do you want to join us? There's always room for you. I can't help but notice the change in you. When we first met on the mysterious island, who could have thought?

name.en: Pass the Invitation to the Great Ball

text.en: Ooh! How cute! Just look at this paper! And the cute lettering! You know, I've always dreamed to receive such invitation. Delivered by the elven celebrity in person! I'm happy.

name.en: How are you? How is House de Ardeur doing on Tenebra?

text.en:
I'm waiting for a friend of mine, Adele de Ardeur. She should be here in no time.

As for the House, we've left Tenebra a while ago. Not much to do here. Admire the desecrated masterpiece? Our Galleon Castle, that the disgusting vampires turned into the Citadel of Darkness? No way.

Our engineers left for our home allod Lumenara. They took up a new project. Do you want to know more? Patience! You'll see it soon.
Darkwater! What an uncivilized location. It smells like swamps and frogs. Pah!
We're happy to see the famous hero we heard so much about! Welcome to Irene, the glorious city of Ker-Is, to the royal court!
Al Rihat! I've been here before. There's no point in telling you about this city's history.

The elves are in touch with their motherland. The kingdom lost many of its subjects, but still captured imagination of every visitor. Irene was the abode of the most skilled people of craft. The goods were highly valued in all corners of the world. There's no saying about fine arts and culture! Artists, poets, sculptors, all of them created incredible masterpieces.

Several dynasties replaced one another over thousands of years. The Ollatars, the Vellunds, the Derniers, and many others.

Many elven Houses were blood relatives of the Royalty. Every House head recognized the suzerainty of the Irene kings. Many heads of Houses received noble titles as a token of appreciation of their merit to the throne. The noble titles were proudly worn by House members and passed down in generations.

name.en: How did Great Balls come about?

text.en:
The tradition existed before the Cataclysm.

The great feasts, where every House sought to overcome, transcend, and impress everyone.

In the beginning, the Conclave used the occasion to solve their issues. It was an honor to become a student of a Great Mage, especially the one that had lived before the Cataclysm. Soon, they began bringing other comprehensive issues to everyone's attention.

Everything was ruined after the Cataclysm. Many elves died. Those who survived under the Great Mages' protection, couldn't meet their kin from other allods.

The Irene allod survived. The last king had an artifact, the Key of Creation, given to him by the Conclave. The power of the Key was enough to support an allod.

Soon, a tragedy happened. The Key was stolen, and Irene disappeared into the astral. Grallon, the last king, used a portal to move himself and a handful of subjects to the Yoggor allod, supported by the king's distant relative, the Great Mage Gramon de Doucer.

Grallon was very old by that time. He didn't live long after that. Many claimed him as their blood relative. House de Desirae, the House of Grallon's wife, was one of them. But Gramon de Doucer took another decision. He restored the tradition of the Great Balls.

It wasn't visited much in the beginning. After a while, elves learned to create cheap and stable portals. The Great Balls attracted many participants. The old era was kicking in.

The leader was chosen in a competition. A queen's relative, the Great Mage Margo de Desirae, strongly objected. She declared herself the new queen of elves. From that moment, the House that won the Great Ball was considered the ruling House of elves.

You shall meet King Louis de Desirae, son of Margo and father of Prince Dakkar. After the victory in the year 990, House de Desirae defines the elven politics. Everything will change soon.

You need to appear before the king.

name.en: How can I find the king?

text.en:
Take the gondola at the pier, and it'll take you there in no time. I could take you there, but Irene's legislation states that all visitors must come through the harbor. Let's not break the rules, shall we? Show your invitation to the Pier Keeper, and go. I'll go ahead to introduce you to the king.

I'll see you on Irene.
The invitation to the Great Ball, of course. I need to see the invitation to take you to Irene. Come back when you have one. You can always find me right here.

Allow me to greet you on behalf of all elves.

Do you have the invitation?

I must look up the list of visitors. It'll take a minute.

Everything is great,. Welcome aboard.
The show begins soon! I need to pull myself together. The future depends on me.
Wow, look who is here!

name.en: How do you like it here?

text.en: What, don't you know me? I feel uncomfortable, don't really know what to do around here... Let's go grab a quick bite? I don't want to approach the tables on my own!
Nice...
Huh? Fine, fine... I'm having a good time so far! There is Caspar and Murk...
I've eaten too much...
Look who remembered an old friend...

name.en: They invited you, too? You look unhappy...

text.en: Yes, they did... Why should I be happy? You're always off on adventures, and I'm alone and forgotten.
Let's go...
Much better now! Skulnar is planning something, I hope you'll join us!
It's going to be a nice evening!
Some of us still have to work...

The note in neat handwriting reads:

Year 305, House de Desirae wins, Great Mage Margot de Desirae writes "Dialogues on Service", substantiating a point of view that explains why elves should educate lower races and have them serve elves. Those who are resistant to training (humans in particular) should be avoided.

Year 319, House de Blizare wins. Great Mage Bernard de Blizare creates "The Treatise on the Essence of the Astral", with a theoretical substantiation of the existence of the Astral.

Year 335, House de Grandeur wins, Vincent de Grandeur creates "The Book of Astral Curses" which summarizes all known spells associated with the astral.

Year 364, House de Delice wins. Ervier de Delice invents a stable stationary portal between the allods that allows you to travel in a relatively simple way, albeit with a colossal expenditure of magical energy.

Year 384, House de Desirae wins. Viola di Desirae writes "Odes of Love", a collection of the greatest elven love lyrics.

The note in neat handwriting reads:

Year 404, House de Delice wins. Florian de Delice finds a solution to the dispute between the elven Houses and settles the conflict over territory.

Year 419, House de Doucer wins, Renalda de Doucer restores the list of ancient elven spells found on Yoggor.

Year 443, House de Delice wins/ Florian de Delice solves the problem of settling the status of the Small elven Houses.

Year 464, House de Pluie wins. Thibault de Pluie creates an economic treatise on trade, banks and auctions.

Year 479, House de Ardeur wins, Gaben de Ardeur makes a breakthrough in the study of the properties of June crystals.

Year 499, House de Pluie wins, Gracienna de Pluie creates a unique piece of jewelry - the Diadem of Drops.

The note in neat handwriting reads:

Year 515, House de Blizare wins, Justine de Blizare completes a study on the influence of the astral on the flora and fauna of allods.

Year 538, House de Vevre wins. Majel de Vevre writes an opera about Irene, one of the greatest works in the genre.

Year 556, House de Grandeur wins, Neven de Grandeur writes a work on the history of magic from the founding of the elven kingdom to the present day.

Year 583, House de Desirae wins, Rival de Desirae creates a ten-ingredient salad recipe.

Year 596, House de Delice wins. Denise de Delice paints one of the most beautiful paintings in history - The Birth of Beauty, depicting the awakening of the first elves.

The note in neat handwriting reads:

Year 620, House de Douceur wins, Great Mage Gramont de Douceur creates a deadly spell that can annihilate an entire allod.

Year 639, House de Pluie wins, Gerard de Pluie creates a treatise "On the Enjoyment of Life".

Year 658, House de Vevre wins. Perpetua de Vevre creates a collection of works by the inhabitants of the allods, "Tales and Other Fables".

Year 676, House de Blizare wins, Fabiola de Blizare discovers a new healing principle that significantly accelerates tissue regeneration.

The note in neat handwriting reads:

Year 707, House de Vevre wins. Great Mage Catherine de Vevre negotiates with Tensess, which culminates in the creation of the League.

Year 724, House de Ardeur wins, Lienar de Ardeur creates holographic illusions.

Year 741, House de Grandeur wins, Baudouin de Grandeur discovers new principles of the art of summoning elementals.

Year 762, House de Pluie wins, Guillaume de Pluie concludes a new trade agreement between the elves and Kania.

Year 779, House de Doucer wins, Great Mage Gramont de Doucer founds a magic academy on Yoggor which has now been transferred to the Stellara allod.

The note in neat handwriting reads:

Year 800, House de Grandeur win. Albert de Grandeur will settle the conflict between the Kanians and Gibberlings, then enter into an alliance with them. The Gibberlings receive the Lightwood allod in exchange for the secret of astral flights.

Year 823, House de Ardeur wins, Raymond de Ardeur creates the prototype of the first astral ship.

Year 845, House de Blizare wins, Maximilien de Blizare invents a new potion that greatly speeds up reactions.

Year 864, House de Pluie wins. Guillaume de Pluie formulates the principles of cultural expansion, which should transform other civilizations, passing to them the ideals of the elves. Elves finally step out of isolation.

Year 884, House de Vevre wins. Caspar de Vevre writes the Triumph of Beauty symphony, one of the greatest works of the elves.

The note in neat handwriting reads:

Year 901, House de Doucer wins. Umbert de Doucer comes up with a plan of attack on the Kirah allod and starts a new war with the Empire. Astral ships will be used in this war.

Year 924, House de Blizare wins. After repelling an attack of astral demons, Great Mage Maximilien de Blizare writes a military work about their vulnerabilities and the ways of dealing with them. In the future, this information becomes the basis for the creation of the Order of Demon Hunters.

Year 937, House de Grandeur wins, Estelle di Grander predicts the future. Recorded, her predictions become known as Estelle's Quatrains. The Conclave decides to classify some of the information they contain. Estelle's prophecies rehabilitate the elven Oracles who are now free to practice.

Year 962, House de Ardeur wins. Raymond de Ardeur and his student Celestina de Ardeur solve the mystery of the Imperial astral energy and improve its principles.

Year 990, House de Desirae wins, Dakkar de Desirae demonstrates extraordinary skills in the field of necromancy. From that moment on, the Conclave finally lifts the prohibitions on necromancy.

We're preparing a speech for the trial! As the main participant and witness of almost all the events, you will also have to testify!

Don't worry, it's simple. Only Renard is against us, the rest of the Heads of Houses are rather neutral. We can win them over!

Remember the main thing: always tell the truth... but try to omit... inconvenient details.

Shall we begin?

name.en: Are you satisfied with the outcome of the Great Ball?

text.en: Of course! The vampires of Amarantha hoped we would be able to make the Heads of the Houses change their mind. At least now they can count on the help of the elves. Perhaps the rest of Sarnaut's vampires will join me soon.
I understand why Antoinette relied on diplomacy. The main milestones in the history of the elves are associated with the formation of alliances and the resolution of various disputes.

name.en: My vote has been cast for the House de Delice!

text.en: This is very touching! You managed to make a major contribution to our victory, and the fact that you voted for me... My gratitude will be eternal. If you need something, Ignis will always welcome you.

Oh, it won't be an easy choice... There are so many interesting things. I would even support Renard, but, alas, this is not in our political interests. Perhaps Guillaume? They used to paint me, too... There is "Naked Truth"... It hangs in the palace of a certain ruler, behind a curtain. Hmm! I will probably support Caspar de Vevre, his idea of the ensemble is exactly what I want myself! It's decided. House de Vevre!

name.en: My vote has been cast for the House de Grandeur!

text.en: I see you understand the importance of magic! It's the essence of our world. And while we didn't win today, you made the right choice. Someday we'll win.

name.en: Which House you and Albert will support?

text.en: I want science to win this competition! So Maximilien, I guess? Though Antoinette's idea is very tempting. The world... gives scope for scientific exchange of ideas. Although, if you think about it... It's decided: House de Blizare!

name.en: I give my vote to the House de Vevre!

text.en: Did we win you over with our concert? I knew it! Admit it, it's marvelous when different voices sing in unison! My House... did a lot of harm in its time. Perhaps I can atone... Perhaps...

I was quite impressed by this trial... And the vampires' sacrifice! I already started composing a new symphony, or rather, an opera about the tragic story of their fate! I liked a lot of things: Galleon Castle, Guillaume's painting... But I'll probably support Antoinette. It's decided. House de Delice!
Bravo! We wouldn't have done this without you. Your help on Umoir, and now here... I don't know how to thank you! I think I will admire you the way Ivetta does it!

name.en: I give my vote to the House de Pluie!

text.en: Oh, you appreciated my masterpiece! I believe it's a sure sign that you know your art! There aren't a lot of us artists, but we all support each other.

Impressive, isn't it?

True art does not need fanfares, so I didn't try to draw too much attention to my masterpiece. All these performances are nothing but pointless bustle, but this is something to remember!

I haven't decided yet.

Caspar's symphony is a great accomplishment. But if we talk about creations, it pales in comparison with everything that surrounds us. I'm talking about Galleon Castle, of course.  It's decided. House de Ardeur!

name.en: Did the Empire get what it wanted?

text.en: The operation was executed perfectly! We achieved the expected result. Unfortunately, good news comes with bad news. Hmm... Orcs. We seem to be having a problem on one of our allods. Another delusional prophet shaman... He went into the desert and ate cacti, and now he's confusing minds with his appeals. I guess I'll have to leave Irene soon.
Antoinette's victory is what we wanted. However, remember that elves are deceitful. Do not believe a single word she says. She can undermine your faith in our ideals and leaders!

name.en: The League was unable to achieve what it wanted?

text.en: Unfortunately, House de Ardeur did not win. However, I would not declare mourning yet. Antoinette is not going to leave the League tomorrow, and peace... Well, we have already made peace. There is still something to talk about, what we can offer. We will discuss the situation at the Council of Governors. Besides, I'm told the Empire has its own problems.
To be honest, I look at this and see that it's all about women! Antoinette has enough daughters to seduce a whole regiment. They confuse and tempt everyone around!

House de Ardeur!

If we elect them, we will get an era of scientific progress combined with religious fervor. A war with the Empire awaits - most likely a long but victorious one. Light will illuminate the most distant corners of this world, changing it forever!

Is this your final decision?

House de Blizare!

If we elect them, we will give a powerful boost to the development of magic and alchemy. Where will these efforts lead us? Perhaps the Demon Hunters will bring about changes that will make the elves better? Turn them into something else?

Is this your final decision?

You've made your choice! Celestine will take it into account when counting the votes. Whatever the result, remember that your vote is just a drop in the ocean, even if weighty.

Now go and upload the votes you've collected to Celestine.
We are flattered, but let us remind you that this year Our House cannot be elected, therefore We advise you to choose another House.

House de Delice!

If we elect them, we will begin a new era of peace and prosperity. We will make peace with the Empire, launch joint and grandiose construction projects... We'll be united by common goals... Interpenetration of cultures will begin... What do they call it on Igsh? Convergence? Will this peace lead to something new? Or will we drift apart again? Only time will tell.

Is this your final decision?

House de Grandeur!

If we elect them, we will return to the old days when elves relied entirely on magic. Old curses and ancient spells will return. I think the elves will abandon all these technologies in favor of magic... They will walk a different path, going back to closed borders and impregnable allods, protected by the power of their Great Mages.

Is this your final decision?

House de Pluie!

If we elect them, we will enter an era of free trade. Its volume will grow every year, and our allods will become the manufacturers of the most amazing things for the rest of Sarnaut. By selling and buying, lending and holding money, we will dominate the world - not by force of arms or the power of magic, but with the help of finance...

Is this your final decision?

Of course. There is no rush, but please remember that thousands of elves throughout Sarnaut are now waiting for the final vote. And not only elves, because changes in our society will affect everyone who is involved in world politics...

So which House will you support, ?
Which Great House is worthy of leading the elven race?

House de Vevre!

If we elect them, we will spread our cultural influence throughout Sarnaut. We will master all the new technologies of the Empire, and we will surpass and improve them. Their "motion pictures" will serve as evidence of our way of life, and gramophones will play enchanting music.

Is this your final decision?

name.en: Now I know the opinion of all our leaders

text.en:
So the votes are collected, the opinions of the Houses are heard. The time has come for the last voice, which is by no means the least important in Our court. We mean your voice, . Over the past days, you have done a lot on Irene, everyone here knows you even if you don't know everyone as well as you should...

Well, it's time for you to make a decision, too.
After thirty years, We will be glad to shift this heavy burden onto Antoinette's fragile shoulders. Let's see how she handles it.

name.en: Which House will Your Majesty support?

text.en:
It is undoubtedly a difficult decision to make, !

Renard de Ardeur has done a lot. His Galleon Castle is a true miracle, the best creation of my people. Something we've worked towards and dreamed about when we saw the endless seas of the astral. He managed to accomplish everything he wanted.

Antoinette de Delice has also achieved a great deal. Her diplomatic efforts have brought the exiled children back into the fold of my people, and now she will endeavor to make a lasting and permanent peace with the Empire. But this enmity is thousands of years old. How many lives will be saved if she succeeds? But it was rightly said that every life is equally important, be it yours or that of this Orc Psionicist...

And you're about to make your own choice! As for me... It's decided. House de Delice!

name.en: I give my vote to the House de Blizare!

text.en: I understand. My potions made an impression. Perhaps you'd like to do more tests? We could make you stronger and faster! Think about it when you have time.

The time for alchemy will come, I'm sure. We are not only making aphrodisiacs, we are now entering completely new spheres of knowledge! Explosives, elixirs that change the essence of the one who takes them! With time, we can change the world!

It's a difficult choice...

Albert and Baudouin impressed me with that archer. What if we give her explosive arrows? And experiment with different compounds that can make her stronger?

Though Galleon Castle is a true miracle. It's a unique achievement.  Although... It's decided. House de Grandeur!

name.en: I give my vote to the House de Ardeur!

text.en: We were so close to victory! The thing is, if this Ball had taken place ten years ago, we would have won... The Galleon is still magnificent, but it's yesterday's news. Perhaps we should think of something new? We could continue developing the Galleon Castle's AI. She can't do much right now, but with time she might evolve into something greater.

name.en: I know you are seeing Marion de Doucer! And she's a vampire!

text.en:
Ah, I see you're resorted to discrediting tactics? I have to admit, I'm impressed... I wonder how you figured that out, I could swear I left no evidence!

Well done ! You are becoming an expert in espionage. As for Marion: firstly, I deny everything, and secondly, you yourself said at the trial that vampires are not to blame. It's all Armando's fault. Thirdly, she's too good a lover.
I hope no one expects us to abandon our plans even if Antoinette wins?
We will win next time. And then...

I've seen a lot of beautiful but largely impractical things.

A painting? Lovely, but we have plenty of those. All palaces are covered with pictures of naked maidens and steamy scenes! A concert? I'm sorry, but I'm not a fan of ethnic music. I prefer opera. An alliance with vampires? Don't make me laugh.

So only the statue and potion remain. Both can be useful in times of war. I must decide what's more useful.

Although, Marianne here enjoyed both the music and the painting. Fine, I'll support the creator. It's decided. House de Pluie!

name.en: Can anyone from your House become my companion on Irene?

text.en: You already have a companion: Triss. Look for her calling card in your bag!

name.en: Can anyone from your House become my companion on Irene?

text.en: Considering all your accomplishments and certain circumstances... Yes, there's someone who can't wait to explore everything around here. Her interests seem to align with yours. She has managed to wear us all out, I hope you'll help her channel her energy into something productive. If this is agreeable to you, I believe she'll be ready in no time. So what do you say? Does it suit you?

name.en: Can anyone from your House become my companion on Irene?

text.en: I don't think we are ready for this. Every member of our House is important to us, and you have yet to prove your reputability and earn our trust.

name.en: Yes, I want to part with my current companion.

text.en: That's great. I hope we'll have fun together!

Then here's her calling card. You have probably seen these already – all Houses on Irene use them. Special magic will allow your companion to instantly teleport to you anywhere on Irene – just take it in your hands and read the name on it! If you read the name again, your companion will return to the residence!

name.en: Can anyone from your House become my companion on Irene?

text.en: It looks like you already have a companion from another House. If you want to part with them, then it's alright. Otherwise it's impossible – we value our House's prestige above all!

name.en: Can anyone from your House become my companion on Irene?

text.en: Even considering your merits, I don't think this is the right time. Our relations with your current patron House are far from good.

name.en: I think you need a break, Triss. Return to the residence.

text.en: Ohh...
Hello, hello!

name.en: Can anyone from your House become my companion on Irene?

text.en: You already have Rosan from our House with you.

name.en: Can anyone from your House become my companion on Irene?

text.en: Hmm... Yes, it's possible. Actually, it would be a good thing! There is... an interesting young man. We are proud of people like him – young geniuses, but he could certainly benefit from being more... sociable. A member of a Great House should be recognized in social circles! He has a lot of respect for you, so you are probably our only chance to get him to take a walk around Irene. Are you interested?

name.en: Can anyone from your House become my companion on Irene?

text.en: I'm afraid not. You have yet to prove your trustworthiness to our House.

name.en: Yes, I want to part with my current companion.

text.en: Great. Show him around Irene!

Yes, this is his calling card. Everyone uses them on Irene, even other Houses. As soon as you read the name on it, he will immediately appear next to you. If you read it again, the companion will leave you.

name.en: Can anyone from your House become my companion on Irene?

text.en: It looks like you already have a companion from another House. If you are willing to part with them, it will please us!

name.en: Can anyone from your House become my companion on Irene?

text.en: We trust you, but we're not so sure about your patrons. We suggest you change them before asking about something like that.

name.en: Rosan, I need to be alone. Wait for me at the residence.

text.en: Huh? Alright...
But, what if... Wait, no...

name.en: Can anyone from your House become my companion on Irene?

text.en: You already have Lea de Desirae with you.

name.en: Can anyone from your House become my companion on Irene?

text.en: Perhaps it can be arranged. One of the members of our House has always wanted to explore Irene in the company of a true hero, but she is quite... timid herself.

name.en: Can anyone from your House become my companion on Irene?

text.en: I'm afraid you have yet to prove your trustworthiness in the eyes of the king and our House.

name.en: Yes, I want to part with my current companion.

text.en: I can't blame you. Here, this is Lea's calling card. Be kind to her.
That's great. Here's her calling card. Just read the name on it, and Lea will instantly teleport to you in any part of Irene. Read it again, and she will return to us. Have a good time!

name.en: Can anyone from your House become my companion on Irene?

text.en: We heard you already have a companion from another House. Are you willing to part with them?

name.en: Can anyone from your House become my companion on Irene?

text.en: As a ruling House, we cannot allow this as long as you have one of our rivals as your patron.

name.en: Lea, you can go. Return to your House.

text.en: Oh, alright...
It's so beautiful here, isn't it?

name.en: Can anyone from your House become my companion on Irene?

text.en: You already have Lier with you!

name.en: Can anyone from your House become my companion on Irene?

text.en: What a wonderful idea! You'll get an excellent companion, and we'll strengthen our authority. Which is why one of the best representatives of our House will go with you: Lier de Delice. Everyone adores him!

name.en: Can anyone from your House become my companion on Irene?

text.en: I'm afraid our House does not know you well enough.

name.en: Yes, I want to part with my current companion.

text.en: I hope they won't be upset. Here, the calling card of our handsome diplomat, Lier de Delice!

Exactly. I believe you'll like him, too. Here, take his calling card. As soon as you read the name on it, he will immediately appear next to you. Use the calling card again, and the companion will understand that it's time for them to leave. Good luck!

name.en: Can anyone from your House become my companion on Irene?

text.en: I've been informed you already have a companion. Do you wish to part with them?

name.en: Can anyone from your House become my companion on Irene?

text.en: Oh, we have nothing against you personally, but your patron House... It won't do.

name.en: Lier, I need to be alone. Return to the residence.

text.en: Great.
What is it?

name.en: Can anyone from your House become my companion on Irene?

text.en: You already have Grim de Grandeur with you.

name.en: Can anyone from your House become my companion on Irene?

text.en: Yes, there's a young man. I'm sure his bold ideas... Will be to your liking. He's a little arrogant, but your authority is unquestionable.

name.en: Can anyone from your House become my companion on Irene?

text.en: I'm sorry, but we doubt the sincerity of your respect for us and for magic.

name.en: Yes, I want to part with my current companion.

text.en: That's a correct decision. Our best innovator will gladly join you. Here is his calling card, and we'll get rid of the old one...

Here's the calling card. It's enchanted: just read his name, and he will teleport to you. To make the companion return to the residence, just read his name on the calling card again. Only within Irene's borders, of course.

name.en: Can anyone from your House become my companion on Irene?

text.en: As far as we know, you already have a companion from another House. Are you ready to part with them?

name.en: Can anyone from your House become my companion on Irene?

text.en: You share our values, but the same cannot be said about your patron House.

name.en: Grim, I would like you to go. Return to the residence.

text.en: Got it.
What are you up to?

name.en: Can anyone from your House become my companion on Irene?

text.en: Unless our information is outdated, you already have Elia with you.

name.en: Can anyone from your House become my companion on Irene?

text.en: We believe it will be a mutually beneficial commitment. There is a young woman with an astute business sense who is looking for some company. She believes a joint exploration of Irene will help her develop her communication skills. Are you interested?

name.en: Can anyone from your House become my companion on Irene?

text.en: Alas, it's impossible at this time. We are not sure we can trust you yet.

name.en: Yes, I want to part with my current companion.

text.en: That's reasonable. This is our young entrepreneur, Elia. She'll be happy to join you. Here's her calling card.
I'm glad to hear that. Here's her calling card. Do you know how to use it? You read the name on it, and the companion instantly teleports to you. You read it again, and the companion goes away.

name.en: Can anyone from your House become my companion on Irene?

text.en: Unless our information is outdated, you already have a companion from another House. Are you ready to part with them?

name.en: Can anyone from your House become my companion on Irene?

text.en: No, it's not beneficial for us. Considering who your patron House is, it will only bring harm to our reputation.

name.en: Elia, I don't need you anymore. Return to the residence.

text.en: Well, I see.
I'm listening.

If you build a good reputation with one of the great Houses, they will be happy to allow a member of the House to travel with you as your companion on Irene. Not only will it let you spend time in pleasant company, you will also gain bonus reputation with the House your companion belongs to. Of course, no House will provide a companion for you if your patron House is their rival.

You can discuss the possibility with any quartermaster of a House.

name.en: Aquila, I don't need you anymore. Return to the residence.

text.en: Pfft...
Ah... What do you want?

name.en: Can anyone from your House become my companion on Irene?

text.en: You already have Aquila from our House with you.

name.en: Can anyone from your House become my companion on Irene?

text.en: What an interesting and timely desire! Yes, the best member of our House has been dreaming of exploring Irene with you! Take her with you!

name.en: Can anyone from your House become my companion on Irene?

text.en: It’s not the time. Show us that your love for music is as strong as our own!

name.en: Yes, I want to part with my current companion.

text.en: Magnificent! We can finally get a good companion for Aquila!
Here's her magic calling card. Just read the name on it, and she will immediately join you! Use the calling card again, and the companion will understand that it's time for them to leave.

name.en: Can anyone from your House become my companion on Irene?

text.en: We heard you already have a companion from another House. Are you ready to part with them?

name.en: Can anyone from your House become my companion on Irene?

text.en: It looks like you have entrusted yourself to the patronage of a wrong House. You need to choose another Patron House!

Oh Great Ball, the kingdom of beauty and luxury. For me and you, a lot of work, too. Just look around! All of them wish to change their appearance before the Ball.

I am the Master of Changes. I can make you look completely different. I bring changes into your life, whether it's just hairstyle, hair color, physique, or gender. I can go even further! My thorough knowledge of magic and physiology will allow me to change your race!

It will cost you a few more Carnival Masks. The number depends on how profound the changes will be.

So, have you made up your mind?
So many new faces! Many of them look unfamiliar, but who knows, whose soul is hiding behind the mask?

Don't you know? I command all Aviaks on Irene. I train Aviaks, maintain discipline, report everything to the king! Now I'm watching over the Galleon Castle! Then I'll go back to Irene to prepare the troops for the assault on Forox. We will overthrow the evil mage and restore the true faith! Yes... yes! We're setting out soon, I'll need to gather the Aviaks!
Greetings, guest! Have you been to Irene before? Have you noticed how beautiful it is?

Can you imagine what the Ball of Seven Houses is like? It's quite a spectacle! A storm of emotions! And passion! A competition in style, elegance, and originality! And I, Antoine de Ardeur, will do my best to steal the scene. I want to put on a costume show! To stage a battle between the League and the Empire. Of course, the preparations took longer than I expected. The thing is, during the show, our actors become overwhelmed with passion! Not every costume can survive that, you understand! I had to look for replacements! But now I'm ready to show the result!
Let's welcome our important guest! Perhaps you need a costume? I'll be glad to be of assistance!
Just a modest couturier from Novograd! Of course, some say I'm the best couturier in the world! And... I believe they are right.

Cooking, of course. I'm a cook after all! There can't be a Great Ball without a great feast! So we're cooking day and night! And this time it's not just the elves we need to please - but also humans, Gibberlings, and even Orcs!
Greetings! What brings you to Irene?
Formerly a prisoner of the Empire, and now a common cook here on Irene. Why are you so curious? You have to admit, you can't have a proper Ball without a feast!

name.en: I've never heard about House de Amfas. Tell me about it.
