text.en: Really? Weird. This is a minor House. However, we're pretty famous. We served the Great Mage Pascal in the dukedom of Mebir! My noble ancestor was the butler in Mebir tower! Alas, we had to run away after the Cataclysm. We found shelter at the allod Malar. We have to preserve our etiquette skills in the society of savage Kanians... it isn't easy, but somebody's got to do it. I've been told that the guests undergo etiquette training here. Let's see if the training complies with the ancient elven traditions! We can't allow to distort our traditions!
Oh, what joy, what beauty! Just look around you! It's like in the good old times!

Bruno de Amfas, at your service. I represent House de Amfas at the Great Ball. Royal etiquette and traditions are my specialty. I've always dreamed of coming here, and now I have this opportunity! Who could have thought that Irene would be found and chosen as the Great Ball site! Look how well this place has been restored! As if it hadn't been ten centuries!

name.en: House de Ark? What House is that?

text.en: The glory of our House has long gone. Our House used to be rich, prosperous, and famous. Alas, time takes its toll. We lost too much during the Night of Astral Portals, when the Ark allod was destroyed and the Great Mage Erast died. But we remain optimistic. We grant shelter to Sarnaut travelers. You can see our residences in all corners of the world.
Greetings! Oh, the charming antiquity! Irene is amazing, isn't it?

I'm Colette de Ark, a herbalist. You might think, what a weird profession for an elven lady. Sometimes life leaves you no choice. I'm staying in a stronghold of one of the guilds, helping them cure local peasants.

name.en: House de Avale? Never heard of it.

text.en: Unforgivable ignorance. House de Avale is a glorious house, although it's not one of the Great Houses. Our abode is the Florenta allod. One of the Great Houses gave us shelter. We're few, but we're united. Our profession is pet training. You know, cats, dogs, and the like. Everyone's crazy about them. I think that taming a real Irene fairy would be a real challenge. Not just anyone with a basket of berries, but a truly beautiful fairy. The one that can be found only on Irene.
Oh, Irene! The motherland of magic fairies! I'm dreaming to find them!

name.en: Fairies? Who are you? Why do you need them?

text.en: I'm Linda de Avale. Haven't you heard the legend? These creatures were made by the most powerful Mages of the first Conclave. They needed someone to test their elf-transforming spells on. Over time, fairies spread all over the world, but only here, on Irene, you can find the primal fairies that remember the names of their creators. I want to have them as servants in my House.

name.en: What is this House de Craner? What is it famous for?

text.en: House de Craner was a source for the royal army of the Velund dynasty! I have to admit, we're in decay now. Alas, the true masters of sword aren't valued among elves today. They prefer magic! Or rather, preferred - until recently. When the war with the Empire began, many elves decided that a good sword, especially enchanted, does a better job than an ice comet or a fireball! That's when our skills came in handy. My House has opened a fencing school in Lightwood. Among our students there are elves, Kanians, and even Gibberlings.
You there! Hello! Would you like to cross swords with me? I don't insist, but just in case.

name.en: Greetings to you, too. What's your name?

text.en: I'm Conrad de Craner, a noble representative of my ancient House. You must have heard about me. I performed numerous feats in my life. But my dream is to fight in a duel with a true master of sword! I hear there is such master on Irene. Bussy de Tristesse, a fencer who has never been defeated. I might throw a glove.

The thing is, all the events, which Zayan describes in his latest work about the recent past, are all made up. None of it happened in reality. In fact, Nihaz never locked up Sarn. On the contrary, Sarn locked up Nihaz. He chained him to a rock for giving people the gift of magic.

I carefully analyzed his work and found a number of inconsistencies. Here's my version: in fact, Sarn is an evil tyrant, obsessed with spreading the Light, wanting to control everything. Only the Dark God Nihaz can do good to Sarnaut. All he ever wanted is for us to progress and develop. Nihaz can give us knowledge that will make us gods!

name.en: How about the death of the world and other events?

text.en: Ah! Mirages. Nothing but mirages, created by Cosmos, Sarn's evil minion. He used the Observatory and with the help of the traitor Klavdia created an illusion of the future, where Nihaz allegedly "destroyed" the world. If you think about it, this is just stupid. No idea why Nihaz might need this. Wasn't he trying to explain to you how this world works? Didn't he help you fight the insane cultists of Sarn? You shouldn't believe Cosmos or anything he shows you in his so-called "Observatory".
Oh, hey, I know you. You're Zayan's acolyte. He constructs his dubious historical theories based on your deeds and visions.

name.en: Wait a minute, aren't you Zayan's student?

text.en: Well, all historians are his students, in a sense. Just like my good friend Roxane, the head of our House, I belong to those who avoided the fate of turning into a vampire and escaped in a shelter on Nea. Zayan is wise, but he's mistaken. None of it really happened.
I'm just vacationing here! It's nice to know there's a place where you can rest from never-ending military service. Will there ever be a time without war?
Greetings! It's nice and peaceful here on Irene! Quite a nice change of pace from war...
Magister of the League Defenders! I fought on Asee-Teph and in other battles. Which ones? I'm sorry, I can't tell you that.
I'm here for the sole purpose of having fun... Intrigues? War? Let's forget about that for the time being and relax here on Irene.
Greetings!

Felix de Grandeur, the trainer of all mages in Novograd, at your service! My House appreciates magic in all its forms, so it's not surprising that I became the one who teaches all the young mages of the League on the Kanian Archipelago.

name.en: What is this House de Fore? What are you doing?

text.en: Our House is known for popularizing our philosophy and formula in life: "everything for pleasure." We're the most famous hedonists and people of leisure in Sarnaut. We strive to achieve as many pleasures in life as we can. We're always busy lounging in our hidden shelter on Ellanash allod. We taste delicate food, listen to elegant music, study the most elaborate erotic practices...
Good afternoon! Where can I... where can I find the Rose and Hibiscus? Although... you don't know, of course. Why would you?

Jessica de Fore, at your service. I arrived at Irene to satisfy my passion to exquisite pleasures. It is widely known that there's no other place like the Rose and Hibiscus! Alas, I heard, it's not to easy to get inside. I'm looking for an opportunity to visit.

name.en: House de Gloire? Is this a thing?

text.en: Oh! Haven't you heard about our House? It is no equal to the Great Houses, of course, but it used to shine back in the day. Members of my House were permanent members of the Dernier royal dynasty entourage back in the day when Irene was a kingdom. We lived a carefree life, without worries, without thinking of the future... and then the Cataclysm struck. Not many were saved. We were scattered on different allods. We reunited just recently under the shelter of the glorious House de Ardeur on the allod Lumenara.
I would love for the Great Ball to start! I can't wait to dance!

name.en: Good afternoon! Tell me about yourself.

text.en: My name is Jennifer de Gloire. I represent the minor House, but my true goal is to dance at the Great Ball. I know that preparations take time, but I just can't wait for it to start. Oh, the dance! The pinnacle of elven grace! What can be more beautiful than unite in harmony with other elves?

What a question! Look around you, and you'll get your answer. I'm the owner of a fair number of newspapers and magazines, including a few spicy ones. Compared to them, Sharp Ears would be a Trinity Church leaflet about the principles of the moral code of an Imperial citizen, trust me! I brought my hottest girls with me... Alas, my birds have flitted away, or else I would've introduced you. Well, you are probably busy anyway, right? So am I! I won't keep you, it was nice to finally meet you face to face!
Oh my, look who is here!
Ha ha! Don't you recognize me? We haven't met, of course, but you know quite a few of my colleagues. You are looking at another member of the famous Tycoon Club. Not the last one, I'm sure.

name.en: I need to know about your House.

text.en: Oh, House de Conte! We're eternal travelers, wandering minstrels, roaming around Sarnaut and telling stories. We were like this centuries ago. We'll be like this in centuries to come. We do have a residence. We return to Stellar, under the cover of the eternal and endlessly wise night. We exchange the things we learned along the way, record our songs, and come up with new ballads.
Harmony de Conte, traveling minstrel, at your service!

Yes, we have! In Cosmos Observatory, in the lair of the blind demon Cairage... But I can't tell for sure if I saw you or some other hero. The Observatory is a weird place. It's like a room full of mirrors, with unique reflections in each of them. As far as I know, Cairage was dealt with in our world.
Can't you see? I'm standing here. Thinking. About life. You know, my House is far from perfect. Perhaps you've heard about its accomplishments? Then you understand...
Ah, it's you.
How much did you drink? Tell me! Or is that you fooling around?

name.en: What about the House de Luner? Never heard of it.

text.en: Phew! No way. Who hasn't heard about House de Luner? Oh well... Not many, I guess. That's because we're hiding from everyone on Nocturne. We're interested in collecting the most shocking secrets of Sarnaut! Did you know that Yasker and Rysina were lovers? Oh, come on, the word is on the street! How about this: Catherina is Aidenus's daughter! Amazing, right? And she was pregnant... from Sarn! Cool, huh? Wait, don't go! I can tell you about Zayan and Klavdia! Don't you want to know?
Psst! Hush! Walls have ears! Keep your voice down!

name.en: Who are you? What are you afraid of?

text.en: I'm Imelda de Luner. I'm... not afraid. Of anything. It's just... You know. It's Irene, right? It's swarming with spies... and plots... and conspiracies... Haven't you heard the story of the Great Ball? Everyone wants to win the Great Game. And the easiest way is to spy on your opponents! Find out about their plans! I overheard many... you know, many curious things. Did you know that the so-called artists stopped on Florenta allod on the way? I don't trust them. They're not who they say they are. I'm sure they're... cultists!

name.en: Tell me about your House de Mork.

text.en: Uh, haven't you heard? But oh well. We're madly famous. Although, sadly, we're not a Great House. We live on the allod Tempesta under the protection of House de Pluie, but nothing can falter our honor! You can track our House's history back to the times when Ollatars ruled the Irene allod. House de Mork was famous for its loyalty to the throne. Many daughters of our House became queens, and noble knights took positions of majordomos, councilors, and marshals. No one dares to offend the name of my House and get away with it.
Do you know where I can find the elf Giacomo de Vevre?

name.en: Who are you? Why are you looking for him?

text.en: My name is Geronimo de Mork. The filthy scum gravely offended me! The thing is... that my fiancée... Julia... Well, she's a little carefree. The bastard abused her naive vulnerability, fed her a pack of lies, and seduced her. I caught them naked in bed! Just as I grabbed my sword, the bastard jumped out of the window and ran away. I'll beat the crap out of him, I swear! Just let me find him. He'll know better than to seduce girls!

I'm watching history unfold! I'm wondering what our wards think of the recent developments. I'm talking about minor races, of course. Aviaks, Harpies, Lamias... They have their rights, too, you know! And we often forget how difficult their life is...
Oh, a familiar face! I wonder where I've seen you before. I know you...

Oh! I'm a historian! Like many of us, we couldn't miss this event. Zayan himself is here. Of course, we have much to do... For the past few years, they keep bringing new things to our allod Nea. Unfortunately, we have no time to sort through that.

I told you - I'm resting! You think it's easy keeping watch over the portal all day long? I had to step away a few times - there was once a conference on portalology issues... Anyway, it doesn't matter! I left an excellent illusion on the Kanian Archipelago - no one would notice.
Hey, hey. Quiet! Since you've recognized me, you understand why I have to keep a low profile.
So you don't recognize me after all? Alright! I'm Hugues de Delice, the main portal keeper of Novograd. I control the portal in Aidenus' Tower. I decided to take some time off and visit this allod.

I came to support my House... No, not in the Great Game - thankfully we don't participate this time. Considering what happened the last time, they could probably use my help. Especially since the best summoners of our House are currently working with the prince...
Hello!

I am the trainer of all summoners on the Kanian Archipelago... I've been doing this for several decades - ever since Prince Dakkar won the Great Ball and the Church gave us permission to train new demonologists...

name.en: House de Roche? What's that about?

text.en: It isn't special. We've always been blocked out by more famous and glorious Houses. After the Cataclysm, we ended up on Yoggor. My House served House de Doucer for a long while, but after old Gramon died, and his heir Armando committed the notorious crime, we were forced to change sides. Nocturne is Yoggor's new name. After the eclipse, it belongs to House de Desirae. We're their loyal servants. Just the same as we were to our previous lords.
Good afternoon! I'm glad to see so many new faces on Irene.

name.en: Good day to you. Who are you?

text.en: Wilhelmina de Roche. Nice to meet you. It's so good to be on Irene! Let me tell you more about myself. I'm the tutor of Prince Dakkar's children, Antoine and Julie de Desirae. Or Anton and Julia Valir if you use their mother's name. They stayed with their mother, so I had the chance to visit the Great Ball and make my dream come true. I miss my students, but I'm sure they'll be better off on Nocturne than in the busy palace of their grandfather. Although these kids surely know how to keep everyone busy.

name.en: House de Ruse? Tell me more about it.

text.en: My House is just a minor House you have probably never heard of. We live on the Gelida allod, by the grace of the reigning House de Blizare. Gelida is a harsh place, where winter lasts forever. But the forests are full of animals, and rivers and lakes are full of fish. The mission of my House is to provide food for everyone. Trade alone can't cover all our needs.
Hey-ho! Welcome to the blessed allod!

I'm Domingo de Ruse, friend! I'm a great hunter. I arrived here because a Royal Hunt was promised to me. Have you heard of it? How come? Let me tell you. There is a tradition: they organize a Royal Hunt after every Great Ball. There's a great location for hunt, the Egladien Forest, full of all kinds of game. Just imagine how we seek, chase, and kill the prey... and how it will be running away from the hunt in panic!
It's nice to see you here, Stormbringer!
I'm a student of Orpheus's! I was invited here, and it's a pleasure to see so many familiar faces.

Isn't it obvious? I write sonnets! Oh, gone are the days when my faithful lute and I wandered the roads, discovered new things, went on adventures, met famous heroes... But I must say, life in Novograd is quite exciting... And I have Irene to entertain me - it's a place I'm always happy to visit whenever I'm invited!
I'm happy to see you here among the elven people!
Allow me to introduce myself. Charles de Vevre, a famous bard and the trainer of all bards in Novograd.

Irene in general and Egladien in particular are a nature reserve full of rare plants. Many species were lost after the Cataclysm, but it turned out they still grow here! Royal Leaf, for example! Or Trifle Herb! I collect samples that I will later move to the greenhouse. Field work is what I've dreamed of since they got me out of that Irdrich sarcophagus. Imagine waking up with a bunch of wires connected to your every orifice!
What are you doing in this forest?
I'm a herbologist. I study various living creatures, primarily herbs...
I make new deals, of course! Wood from Umoir is gaining in price, but copper from Suslanger mines is going down... There's so much to do!
Hello, hello!
I'm a famous negotiant! I trade things for other things - that's usually the way it goes. I sell short-supply goods and buy overstocked stuff.

name.en: I've never heard about House de Venar.

text.en: Hmm. I admit, our name isn't habitual in Sarnaut... Alright, I'll tell you: our House lives on Ignis, Antoinette de Delice is our Great Mage. She gives us shelter and protection. Ignis is a curious allod: a country of eternal summer, with sandy beaches free from crowds of tourists, unlike the Summer Atoll. I remember, fifty years ago when Yasker and his soldier occupied Ignis, the Xadaganians only hanged out with the girls instead of fighting. Anyway, it's a bit on the tight and boring side. I'm trying to persuade Antoinette to open at least casinos, but she won't allow that. So I have to seek fun elsewhere.
Glory to you, my good friend. I'm glad to see you on Irene.

Gunter de Venar, at your service, my friend. I'm a famous racer. I raced on Kirah, on Ammer, but... I heard rumors that races might be organized here, on Irene. You understand, I couldn't miss the opportunity! What can be better than speed? Fresh wind in my face! Nothing. Tell me if you hear about the race, alright?

I came to the Great Ball like everyone else. Our family couldn't stay away! Especially since we represent the leaders of our House. While I'm here, my sister Gertrude controls Tenebra - she's Amanda de Desirae's mother. As for my daughter, Leticia - that insolent creature is traipsing around the woods on Umoir... If you run into each other, convey my indignation to her.
You don't need to bend the knee, there's no time for formalities.
Marguerite de Desirae, the governess of Tenebra allod and Prince Gaston's wife.

What an odd question! What does it look like? I'm celebrating the greatest event in our race's history. It's interesting to see representatives of the Empire here. Trust me, I've been to Igsh! At least I wasn't captured like many others. I, Volot Cursefist, and the League Sharpshooters had time to retreat, and then a landing ship picked us up. We spent some time in Nezebgrad during the war. It was nice. I hear things were different in the Empire!
Hello yourself!
I'm just a vogt in the League Army. It's not particularly glorious, but it's an officer rank, so I'm happy. I started as a taskmaster.

Recent years changed elves. Perhaps you've noticed that? The narrow-minded people of my House believe our good old magic is a solution, that it will rule the world... But look at other nations. What have they achieved? Many follow their example. Bullies are reaching for their blades, others dip their arrows in poison... But maybe future is about something different? About being one with nature? Druids... Animists... Shamans... We should learn from them. I hope some day elves will have their own forest guardians...
Welcome to Irene!

I used to be the head of the herbalist guild in Novograd, but then it merged with an alchemist guild... Pfft. As though alchemists know anything about herbs... Who knows the healing properties of plants better than us?

I came to visit the Great Ball and speak with the heads of the Houses. I have something to tell them. The world is changing, but it's as dangerous as ever. Our order was created for the purpose of battling demons. But there are other threats besides demons. And not every demon is willing to become your ally. They may no longer have their Creator, but they still pose a threat. They say there's the Council of Thirteen, the council of leaders of the largest packs... They are closely allied with fanatics, and they are ready to act.
I'm happy to see you again after so many years.
You forgot me already? I guess the amount of time you spend on the road makes it easy to forget things. I'm Pascal de Vevre, Commander of Demon Hunters.

We had a little poetry competition here with this charming Aoidos... Just think about it: we elves are the first of the races that appeared in this world... And the Aoidoi are the last of them. There is an abyss of epochs between us, but we are so alike!
Ah, it's wonderful here on Irene, it's a great place to fall in love and write poems...
You don't know me? That's strange. Selene's name is known to everyone who knows anything about beauty. And everyone is familiar with my poems.
I sell potions. Still, this is the welfare of our House, and we could use some money. Unfortunately, I don't have anything to sell right now. Just sold a large batch of aphrodisiacs.
Greetings, from the bottom of my heart!
I'm Charlotte de Blizare, a modest merchant from Novograd. I used to sell earrings, now I'm dealing in potions. Especially "secret potions", if you know what I mean.
Our House has a lot of enemies, and I'm protecting my masters from everyone who might want to harm them! There is no higher honor for a Harpy than to fall in battle, protecting the House de Vevre!
Greetings, warrior!
I'm Kelena, the commander of Harpies protecting the House de Vevre against external threats! I'm the first sword master of my tribe, a veteran of multiple battles against our enemies!
I watch over other Kobolds, of course! There are many... savages here! They sow discord and confusion! That's why they need someone to watch over them!
Greetings on behalf of all Kobolds!
Hex Zauber, Chancellor for Kobold Affairs. I'm making sure my brethren work together for the good of the House de Desirae.
I stand guard... in accordance with the ancient treaty... with the House de Grandeur...
Greetings, traveler!
I'm Yagaina! The queen of all Lamias, the ruler of our people...
I stand guard! Strange things are happening here, suspicious people lurking about... Watching... Don't give me a reason to get angry! And don't distract me.
Who goes there?
I'm Goldhorn, the Minotaur Tribe Chief! We are defenders of the House de Pluie! No one shall pass!
I'm not sleeping. I'm keeping watch. We Werebears have a quick ear - should something happen, I'll be there... Now go away. I'm resting.
Zzz... Let me sleep!
Can't you see? I'm a Werebear. You've never met a Werebear? I'm a village elder from Ignis. They call us Snorers.

Why shouldn't I be standing here? Are you throwing me out? I have the right to be here after everything I've done for them. They put me here... so no one could see me. Just go away, would you? Don't piss me off.
What are you doing here? Get out.
I'm a Zverg! A mechanic from the workshop on Gelida. We have mines where we mine different ingredients for elves.
Hello! Oh, why am I so bored in a place like this?
Hello! I need food.
Right on time. We were going to have some wine. Can you bring us something... you know, something that goes best with wine?
I have no time! No time at all! Can you get me some frog leg soup?
Of course! I need something light and merry to drink. With bubbles, you know? Light and bubbly, yes.
It would be great if you could find me a bottle of Irene semi-sweet wine. My throat is dry, and I'm bored as hell.
Hello!
Hello! What's up?
Good afternoon!
I have nothing to tell you.

name.en: You are clearly upset by something...

text.en:
Of course - just look at these boxes! Not the boxes themselves - they are fine - but the contents! There's soap inside! They are filled to the brim, but the soap is no good! Doesn't lather, looks terrible, and the scent... The scent is nothing unusual, but compared to everything else...

I'm a local expert, if you must know. I know the whole production technology - I'd make better soap myself, but I don't have materials... Just bones, and even that is hard to come by because of those hedgehogs in the forest.

How does one offer this soap to our posh crowd...? I'm glad it's not my job!
What did I do to deserve this...?

name.en: Don't you think you're exaggerating the extent of the problem?

text.en:
How could you think that? Without soap, Irene will turn into a pigsty inside a week!

...Fine, I'll send my review with the request for a new batch. They have to learn sometime! They have to! They can do it when they want to!

Thank you for the question!

First, I would openly describe the recipe and manufacturing technology. I'm not a fool, and there are other experts, so we'll quickly identify problems and discuss ways of solving them... Or we'll at least try.

Second, I wouldn't be hasty. You can't be hasty with such important batches. With more time at my disposal, I can be more accurate, so I won't have to redo everything!

Third, I'd hire more qualified workers. It's hard, of course - you need to pay them, and you have to find them to begin with... But it's doable! I think...

Anyway, I'm writing a book about this. When it comes out, read it - it will describe everything in detail!

name.en: I want to know more about House de Delice patronage

text.en:
Oh, this is wonderful.

House de Delice is famous for its portal magic. We invented stationary portals to travel between allods. But now our House is staking on diplomacy. Our effort resulted in an agreement with vampires, which will be signed during the Great Ball. This isn't the only thing we could achieve. We're ready to resolve any conflicts and assist during negotiations with the Empire - and stop the war forever.

Gain our Patronage, and you will receive a great number of rewards:

First of all, beautiful outfits in the colors of our House. The widest range of underwear.

Our House servants are powerful werebears. You can have one of them as your companion.

Once you earn a friendly reputation with us, Lyr de Delice will join you. He's famous for his romantic victories and can win any heart!

And here's your cherry on top: we recently purchased a cheap batch of Matter of Creation, required to build a Guild allod. We'll gladly share it with you for your loyal service to our House.

name.en: What will I gain from the Patronage of House de Delice?

text.en:
It's good that you decided to refresh your memory! You already have our Patronage.

By working with our House and glorifying its name, you improve your reputation with us. The better we know you, the more services and rare items we can offer.

First of all, beautiful outfits in the colors of our House. The widest range of underwear.

Our House servants are powerful werebears. You can have one of them as your companion.

Once you earn a friendly reputation with us, Lyr de Delice will join you. He's famous for his romantic victories and can win any heart!

And here's your cherry on top: we recently purchased a cheap batch of Matter of Creation, required to build a Guild allod. We'll gladly share it with you for your loyal service to our House.

name.en: I want to accept House de Delice Patronage

text.en:
I'm glad to see you on the side of House de Delice!

Complete quests on Irene under our Patronage, and you will serve our House and increase its prestige and glory! Each completed daily quest given to you by the king and his servants will count as a quest in favor of House de Delice. In return, your reputation with us will grow.
I'm happy to see you, ! Welcome to the Great House de Delice! I'm Antoinette de Delice, the head of the House and the Great Mage of the Ignis allod.

name.en: I want to know more about House de Vevre patronage

text.en:
I'm glad you've come to me.

House de Vevre is famous for its love to fine arts and music. There are a great many bards in my House. On my allod, we even have a bard academy, which provides professional education in music creation. Besides, we have excellent scouting skills. There is no secret that our oracles cannot reveal.

Gain our Patronage, and you will receive a great number of rewards:

First of all, beautiful outfits in the colors of our House.

Our House servants are elegant harpies. You can have one of them as your companion.

Once you earn a friendly reputation with us, Aquila de Vevre will join you. She's a talented musician, who will cheer you up in your travels.

Here's your cherry on top: we found a great number of ancient artifacts, known as Moon Dragon Armor. We'll gladly share them with you for your loyal service to our House.

name.en: What will I gain from the Patronage of House de Vevre?

text.en:
It's good that you decided to refresh your memory! You already have our Patronage.

By working with our House and glorifying its name, you improve your reputation with us. The better we know you, the more services and rare items we can offer.

First of all, beautiful outfits in the colors of our House.

Our House servants are elegant harpies. You can have one of them as your companion.

Once you earn a friendly reputation with us, Aquila de Vevre will join you. She's a talented musician, who will cheer you up in your travels.

Here's your cherry on top: we found a great number of ancient artifacts, known as Moon Dragon Armor. We'll gladly share them with you for your loyal service to our House.

name.en: I want to know more about House de Blizare patronage

text.en:
You did the right thing by coming here.

My House is famous for our knowledge of magic. We focus the practical rather than theoretical aspects of it. Our interests lie in the field of alchemy, the queen of magical sciences. There's no waving a magic wand and shouting incantations. Only a strong mind can comprehend it. Almost all popular recipes of elven potions are developed by the specialists of our House.

Gain our Patronage, and you will receive a great number of rewards:

First of all, beautiful outfits in the colors of our House.

Our House servants are skilled mountainfolk. You can have one of them as your companion.

Once you earn a friendly reputation with us, Rosan de Blizare will join you. He's a talented alchemist, who will gain his combat experience with you.

Besides, we know how to synthesize the Unsteady Matter, which will come in handy if you want to reforge your armor. We'll gladly share it with you for your loyal service to our House.

name.en: What will I gain from the Patronage of House de Blizare?

text.en:
It's good that you decided to refresh your memory! You already have our Patronage.

By working with our House and glorifying its name, you improve your reputation with us. The better we know you, the more services and rare items we can offer.

First of all, beautiful outfits in the colors of our House.

Once you earn a friendly reputation with us, Rosan de Blizare will join you. He's a talented alchemist, who will gain his combat experience with you.

name.en: What is this type of dragons?

text.en:
You want to hear about the dragons? It's an old story.

When the transformed elves woke up, they found that the dragons were gone. All Junes were dead.

Several days later, the Conclave found several dragons. These fire-breathing creatures were much smaller than before, but just as beautiful. The transformed elves decided to use them for their own needs. They gave up worshipping them. The ideals were fragile! The Conclave captured a female dragon named Sturegga. Her offspring were trained as riding dragons. The elves of Irene tried to keep it secret. The dragon blood was the greatest treasure. They couldn't allow it to land in the wrong hands.

Rumor has it, Sturegga, enslaved and chained by the Great Mages, is still asleep in the depths of the allod.

The wonderful wise creatures are very valuable. They have an even higher spiritual value for my people than material.

Each of the young dragons is the elven national treasure. You have to have permits from all Seven Great Houses of Irene and accomplish something meaningful for the city to get a dragon.

It's a hard way. But that's the law. Only those who earn the trust of our people can have the honor to travel with the Irene Viper.
Careful. She hates sharp movements.

What are you doing? Hanging around? Doing nothing? Pestering people?

Alright, no offence. I have a business offer. Do you like me?

Oh, that sounded wrong. That's not the type of fairy I am. I have someone who owes me. How about I sell her to you? She can be your servant. All I need is the shiny things elves use for payment and some fairy dust, tee hee hee.

Bring me enough, and you can have this Spark-Shark all you want.
It's everywhere on Irene. You just need to look. Some guests find it, but since they don't really need it, they might share it with you, tee hee hee.

Gambling, mostly.

Why? Otherwise life gets boring. Only underground rats lived here till the elves came back. We enjoyed ourselves the best we could.

I don't have enough shiny baubles. Bring more shiny baubles, and the game will be more fun! I have to beg big guys like you for them!
Hello, hello! Have you got shiny baubles?
We take our job seriously. We're diplomats.
We sell pleasure. My goods are for those who consider love the most important of all arts.
What a simpleton. All you should do is fast, pray, and read the dicta of Holy Tensess...
There's nothing more important that alchemy, the queen of all sciences.
I'm a House de Desirae representative. Long live the king!
Magic is power! There's nothing more important than magic.
We sell arts. It isn't cheap, of course. But we don't sell cheap stuff.
All you need is love, love... Love is all you need. Nah, I'd rather not.

name.en: How to earn Royal Goodwill? What will it give me?

text.en:
I can issue a royal decree and assign you a noble title if you prove yourself worthy to the king. Here's what we're going to do: you can earn the elves' trust on Irene by completing different quests: Mine, Bianca de Desirae's, she's my fav, and Henry de Desirae's, he's the royal usher. In exchange, you'll receive the Royal Goodwill Certificates. I'll give you a new title as soon as you have enough certificates.

Along with your title growth, you will have new opportunities, gain access to new places, and will be able to talk to more people.
At your service! Where would you like to go?

Just a minute.
At your service! Where would you like to go?

I work at the best place on Irene!
At your service! Where would you like to go?
In a jiff!

The southern districts are not ready to receive guests. Come back later! I'll take you there.
But of course.

It will only take a minute!

The old district is not ready to receive guests. Come back later! I'll take you there.

At your service! Where would you like to go?
Oh, my head is killing me...
I don’t know... When I woke up, I was alone here. The last thing I remember was falling into a trance... And then... no, I don’t remember anything. Maybe others have recovered and left?

Yes, everything is in order. Let’s see...

I’ll need to introduce an element of chance. But someone else has to do it, or the reading won’t be accurate. You will help me.

First, pick a number between one and three.

One. Hmm, very well... Let’s see what we have...

The reading is unclear. Alright, you need to pick one of the three cards. Do it quickly, don’t overthink!

Finally, we need to determine the flow of the reading - right to left or left to right? Which will it be?
Finally, we need to determine the flow of the reading - right to left or left to right? Which will it be?
Finally, we need to determine the flow of the reading - right to left or left to right? Which will it be?

Hm... I shouldn’t question the cards, but... It can’t be. Were those lunatics right? Is that our fate...? Oh, dear, I feel uneasy. No matter how I read it, there’s only one outcome: darkness and death! And not just for you and me... The whole world is doomed!

Hello. Did you need something? Your face looks familiar...
My premonition wasn’t wrong, I know it. The answer is hidden here...
In these troubled times, it’s important to maintain balance in the world.
Rusted fragments sing dreadful songs of the past and future...
Sometimes the Well calls to me as though it wants to tell me something...
It’s too bright in here...
Progress and only progress can save Sarnaut!
Destiny is a dreadful thing, my friend.
That's how the story of the June heroes ended. Klavdia Kalugina took the Sparks of Ath-Zak, Luja-Gialla, and Tka-Rik. She probably still has them.

name.en: Ask about the stories of the Baneful Valley

text.en: I have made copies of all the documents that you managed to collect in the Baneful Valley...

Greetings!

I am a member of the Order of the Chronographs, a special department within the Historians' organization.

Our task is to continuously document all the information that comes to us. Any data will be recorded and subsequently transferred for general use to the archive on the Nea allod where our permanent base is located.

name.en: Learn the story of the All-Mother

text.en: Well, the value of such data is difficult to underestimate, because this is the story of the creator of the gods herself. Of course, as historians, we must approach everything with skepticism, but this narrative is very important as an outsider's view of the struggle between Nihaz and Sarn.

"All that has been created will perish.

All that has perished will be recreated.

The existence is a great circle. There is no creation without destruction. There is no destruction without creation.

The circle has no beginning or end.

The divine couple has always existed: the All-Mother and Father Time. I, All-Mother, is the goddess of life and creation. Father Time is the god of death and destruction. Together we led our worlds through the cycles of births and deaths. We created and destroyed.

We were not alone. Our passion gave birth to our divine children, subject to us. Each of them played their own role. Each of them obeyed the universal laws. There were twelve Domains in my hierarchy. Each Domain was responsible for a single power. Each Domain had a master.

Only I, the All-Mother, the goddess of creation, and my divine husband Father Time, the god of destruction, were eternal Lords of our Domains. Other gods were immortal and lived very long lives which ultimately had to end. The circle kept going, and gods were destined to die.

Many years have passed."

"Each world was once created. At the moment of creation its death was predefined. Father Time knows no pity. He watches the sand of time in his hourglass.

There's a point in the circle that is called Judgment Time. Ancient prophecies come true. War is raging in multiple worlds. The Twilight of the Gods is imminent. This is the time when the figures on the board change. The wheel turns. Those who was on top will fall. Those who were beneath will rise.

This is the fate of the world predetermined by me, the All-Mother, and by Father Time. Evil against Good. Evil rises over Good for just an instant but its fate is predetermined as well. It will fall. The Good will win, there is no other way. The sacrifice is great, but after night comes day. This is the law that we established.

This is what happened last time. The ancient God of Darkness, now known as the Forgotten, has risen in all of his power. The worlds are burning, seized by the legions of Darkness. But the God of Light Sarn has also risen. He led the resistance against the Darkness and destroyed the Forgotten once and for all. This was predetermined. Everything happened just as we had planned.

The new day has come. The circle is turning once again."

"Many gods fell in the war with the Forgotten. Many worlds were destroyed. The survivors gathered in Eidos where the primal images of creation are stored. Everything that had to be created originally existed in Eidos.

I set to work, creating new worlds to replace what was destroyed. I created the twelve inner worlds first, in accordance with the number of Domains. Each of them should have been led by one of the survivors or newly born gods.

Sarn was one of the survivors, the greatest hero of the past war. He rightfully took the place of the God of Light.

Father Time and I chose two young goddesses among the new gods: Hirkalla and Hinanna. They were supposed to lead the Domains of Life and Death.

Only the Domain of the Forgotten, the Domain of Darkness remained without a ruler. None of the surviving gods wanted the responsibility."

"Millions of years passed since the victory over the Forgotten. The new god of the Domain of Darkness appeared. Hinanna, the younger sister, brought him to the door of Eidos. We accepted him and allowed him to take the vacant place. Each of the gods was supposed to played a role. The God of Darkness was accepted in our domain.

Hinanna's decision did not surprise me. She was a beautiful young goddess who was also stubborn, moody, gullible, and impulsive. She traveled the worlds a lot, found her chosen ones among gods and mortals, toyed with their lives.

At some point, the mysterious God of Darkness attracted her attention. No one knew where he had come from. Some thought he was a mortal who managed to become a god. This was extremely rare back then.

Hinanna showed him the way to Eidos, even though her sister Hirkalla warned her that his intentions weren't pure. There was something sinister about the traveler, so she decided to keep an eye on him."

"Hinanna was happy to see new faces. She and Nihaz, the God of Darkness, traveled between worlds, watched the fates of mortals, learned their secrets, discovered ancient artifacts of past eons.

The power of the new God of Darkness grew by the year. Ancient monsters, who still remembered the Forgotten, accepted him. None of us had any objections. The Darkness was the natural opposite of the Light, and the Domain required a master. At that time Father Time and I considered him an ordinary "Master of Darkness," one of many. As other gods, he was supposed to start a war and fight the Light, and finally perish, like the Forgotten before him. This is what we thought, so we never worried.

Only Hirkalla sensed that the circle has changed. We considered her too young to rule the Domain of Death. She was in charge of the Guardians of Ganzir who ruled the postmortal fates of all living in our worlds. Thanks to this, she saw that Nihaz was helping, teaching, and protecting mortals as best he could in his travels with Hinanna. She realized that their faith in him gave him even more power."

"In doubt, Hirkalla decided to talk to him. She gathered herself, and went to the throne of Darkness to dispel her fears. At that time, Hinanna took interest in another mortal, and the God of Darkness was left alone.

They had a long conversation. Hirkalla voiced her doubts, and Nihaz answered them. Few people knew what they were talking about, but Hinanna returned from her journey and witnessed the end of the talk.

The younger sister learned that Nihaz wanted to overthrow me and Father Time. He considered our concept of the world despicable. He mocked the idea of the circle and the renewal of worlds. Nihaz believed that the gods should make mortals our equals, teach them the laws of creation and eternal life.

Hinanna rushed to our divine throne straight away to warn us of the betrayal. I was furious. I ordered that Hirkalla be brought before me."

"She was brought to us, and we condemned her for her disobedience. She silently accepted it and went to live in exile. Since that day, Nihaz was unwelcome in Eidos. Unfortunately, by that time many of the gods were on his side. The creators that didn't want the destruction of their worlds listened to him. This rebel was loved not only by those who belonged to the Darkness but also those from the Domains of Chaos and Death. Even gods of elements joined the rebellion.

I didn't expect him to turn to mortals, helping them fight monsters and improving their lives. His was praised for giving knowledge and teaching crafts. Nihaz's gifts were poisonous, but he gave them generously to his followers. Mortals who sought immortality and divinity all rebelled.

Anxiously we have watched from our thrones the growing numbers of Nihaz's army. There was still time until another cycle of destruction and rebirth, but this war couldn't wait. It came to us."

"Hirkalla, our beloved daughter, then joined Nihaz. With all her heart, she accepted his teaching about the freedom of choice, the breaking of the great circle, and giving the mortals freedom to become gods.

Our worlds were thrown in a long war. Nihaz and the other gods fought against me and Father Time. Sarn, the God of Light, was one of his main enemies in this war.

Nihaz's efforts bore fruit. Gods died one after another. The most terrible thing happened when Nihaz and the others dealt a fatal blow to Father Time. They overcome him near the World of Destruction where he engaged in a battle with the Darkness. Only a God can kill a God. Nihaz dealt a fatal blow to Father Time who was already wounded, then took away his power. Since then, he became something greater than the God of Darkness, but he did not achieve what was after."

"'We were wondering what he really wanted. Sarn suggested that his true goal was to become more powerful. He destroyed many gods, including his former allies, Gods of Death and Chaos, and took their power.

Disturbed by what happened to my husband, I started to avoid battles. Eden, the world of Life, became my shelter. The story was simple. I knew that my daughter Hinanna would gain enough experience and wisdom to eventually become the ruler of the divine garden. The Garden of Eden was hidden from Nihaz. Everyone was safe. The war was continued by Sarn, Nihaz's complete opposite. He successfully destroyed legions of darkness marching through our worlds.

But even a great warrior can be betrayed. There was a traitor in our ranks. To my surprise, it was Hinanna. Jealous of her sister and the glory she achieved by serving Nihaz, she decided to chain sides. Hinanna lured Sarn into a trap. After fighting Nihaz, the God of Light was captured."

"Hinanna strove to be equal to her elder sister. She strove to surpass her. At that time Hirkalla already possessed the power of Darkness and ruled the World of Death. Jealous of her sister's might, Hinanna wanted to seize what she possessed.

She gathered secret forces, wore her best clothes and jewelry, and embarked on the journey. She approached the colossal gates of the underground world, awoke the guardian by banging on the doors, and fiercely demanded that he let her in.

But one cannot enter this world without obeying its laws. Hinanna had to give all her clothes and jewels along with all her powers to pass the gates of Ganzir. And she fell under the power of the World of Death ruled by her sister. The young goddess never expected this. She was dead while still being alive, condemned to the worst fate imaginable.

I knew not what became of Sarn. I knew not of the fate of the younger daughter. Although I felt sorry for the gullible Hinanna that fell victim to her own stupidity, there was a much worse threat hanging over our worlds. The Architect came from a faraway world. The heartless Order where mind and will were one. Nihaz and I had to fight the invader.

I came out of my shelter every once in a while. Having destroyed an emissary of the new enemy, I felt that my lost daughter and a forgotten friend were once again close. When the ship of the missionary of the Order was torn to pieces by my Great Trees, he fell like a ball of fire upon the lifeless world. I gazed upon the barren land and saw only vile dragons loyal to Nihaz. I realized that they would summon their King, so I left this world. I returned to Eden but never gave up my attempts at finding my lost daughter.

What is mortals' time to me? A blink. It's been five thousand years. My heart is still yearning."

name.en: Ask about the history of the Great Balls

text.en: This information was collected during the Great Ball on Irene... An interesting document written by Adele de Ardeur. I can show it to you.

The note in neat handwriting reads:

The Great Ball is a demonstration of the accomplishments of all the Elven Great Houses. At each of the Great Balls, one of the Houses showed something grandiose. It all began when the Elves recovered from the past Cataclysm, created portals on their allods, and started visiting each other.

Year 265, House de Doucer wins. Great Mage Gramont de Douceur, with the consent of the other Heads of the Houses, creates new rules for the Great Balls. The first Great Ball takes place on the Yoggor allod.

Year 275, House de Vevre wins, Orelina de Vevre writes the poem "The World's End" that describes the history of the Cataclysm and the subsequent events. The second Great Ball was also held on the Yoggor allod, but later it was decided to hold the Ball on the allod of the winner of the last Ball.

The note in neat handwriting reads:

Year 305, House de Desirae wins, Great Mage Margot de Desirae writes "Dialogues on Service", substantiating a point of view that explains why the Elves should educate lower races and have them serve the Elves. Those who are resistant to training (humans in particular) should be avoided.

Year 319, House de Blizare wins. Great Mage Bernard de Blizare creates "The Treatise on the Essence of the Astral", with a theoretical substantiation of the existence of the Astral.

Year 335, House de Grandeur wins, Vincent de Grandeur creates "The Book of Astral Curses" which summarizes all known spells associated with the Astral.

Year 364, House de Delice wins. Ervier de Delice invents a stable stationary portal between the allods that allows you to travel in a relatively simple way, albeit with a colossal expenditure of magical energy.

Year 384, House de Desirae wins. Viola di Desirae writes "Odes of Love", a collection of the greatest elven love lyrics.

The note in neat handwriting reads:

Year 404, House de Delice wins. Florian de Delice finds a solution to the dispute between the elven Houses and settles the conflict over territory.

Year 419, House de Doucer wins, Renalda de Doucer restores the list of ancient elven spells found on Yoggor.

Year 443, House de Delice wins, Florian de Delice solves the problem of settling the status of the Small elven Houses.

Year 464, House de Pluie wins. Thibault de Pluie creates an economic treatise on trade, banks and auctions.

Year 479, House de Ardeur wins, Gaben de Ardeur makes a breakthrough in the study of the properties of June crystals.

Year 499, House de Pluie wins, Gracienna de Pluie creates a unique piece of jewelry - the Diadem of Drops.

The note in neat handwriting reads:

Year 515, House de Blizare wins, Justine de Blizare completes a study on the influence of the Astral on the flora and fauna of allods.

Year 538, House de Vevre wins. Majel de Vevre writes an opera about Irene, one of the greatest works in the genre.

Year 556, House de Grandeur wins, Neven de Grandeur writes a work on the history of magic from the founding of the elven kingdom to the present day.

Year 583, House de Desirae wins, Rival de Desirae creates a ten-ingredient salad recipe.

Year 596, House de Delice wins. Denise de Delice paints one of the most beautiful paintings in history - The Birth of Beauty, depicting the awakening of the first elves.

The note in neat handwriting reads:

Year 620, House de Douceur wins, Great Mage Gramont de Douceur creates a deadly spell that can annihilate an entire allod.

Year 639, House de Pluie wins, Gerard de Pluie creates a treatise "On the Enjoyment of Life".

Year 658, House de Vevre wins. Perpetua de Vevre creates a collection of works by the inhabitants of the allods, "Tales and Other Fables".

Year 676, House de Blizare wins, Fabiola de Blizare discovers a new healing principle that significantly accelerates tissue regeneration.

The note in neat handwriting reads:

Year 707, House de Vevre wins. Great Mage Catherine de Vevre negotiates with Tensess, which culminates in the creation of the League.

Year 724, House de Ardeur wins, Lienar de Ardeur creates holographic illusions.

Year 741, House de Grandeur wins, Baudouin de Grandeur discovers new principles of the art of summoning elementals.

Year 762, House de Pluie wins, Guillaume de Pluie concludes a new trade agreement between the Elves and Kania.

Year 779, House de Doucer wins, Great Mage Gramont de Doucer founds a magic academy on Yoggor which has now been transferred to the Stellara allod.

The note in neat handwriting reads:

Year 800, House de Grandeur win. Albert de Grandeur will settle the conflict between the Kanians and Gibberlings, then enter into an alliance with them. The Gibberlings receive the Lightwood allod in exchange for the secret of astral flights.

Year 823, House de Ardeur wins, Raymond de Ardeur creates the prototype of the first astral ship.

Year 845, House de Blizare wins, Maximilien de Blizare invents a new potion that greatly speeds up reactions.

Year 864, House de Pluie wins. Guillaume de Pluie formulates the principles of cultural expansion, which should transform other civilizations, passing to them the ideals of the Elves. The Elves finally step out of isolation.

Year 884, House de Vevre wins. Caspar de Vevre writes the Triumph of Beauty symphony, one of the greatest works of the Elves.

The note in neat handwriting reads:

Year 901, House de Doucer wins. Umbert de Doucer comes up with a plan of attack on the Kirah allod and starts a new war with the Empire. Astral ships will be used in this war.

Year 924, House de Blizare wins. After repelling an attack of astral demons, Great Mage Maximilien de Blizare writes a military work about their vulnerabilities and the ways of dealing with them. In the future, this information becomes the basis for the creation of the Order of Demon Hunters.

Year 937, House de Grandeur wins, Estelle di Grander predicts the future. Recorded, her predictions become known as Estelle's Quatrains. The Conclave decides to classify some of the information they contain. Estelle's prophecies rehabilitate the elven Oracles who are now free to practice.

Year 962, House de Ardeur wins. Raymond de Ardeur and his student Celestina de Ardeur solve the mystery of the Imperial astral energy and improve its principles.

Year 990, House de Desirae wins, Dakkar de Desirae demonstrates extraordinary skills in the field of necromancy. From that moment on, the Conclave finally lifts the prohibitions on necromancy.

Year 1021, House de Delice wins, Gala de Delice secured the acquittal of House de Doucer and the vampires. House de Doucer has been restored as a small House, the allod Jigran has been granted to the vampires as a place of residence.

name.en: Ask about the Saga of Three Gibberling Brothers

text.en: It's a unique chronicle in a special style. There are a few embellishments, of course, but it tells us about the history of the North and Isa. It's good that you've heard it. Now everyone can hear it.

name.en: Read the Saga of Three Gibberling Brothers

text.en:
Evil storms raged,

White snow fell,

The house stood strong,

Steady and unshakeable.

He who was the oldest

Among the harsh leaders,

Became a father for the first time -

To three brothers.

Thorri was the first,

Lok was next,

Wald came last,

Votin was their father.

Three Gibberlings -

Their sprout was strong!

It was noisy in the house,

Fun every day!

The children were growing up,

Year after year.

Thorri boasted of his strength,

Lok was the most cunning of all.

Wald loved to listen,

Sitting next to his father:

What others say,

Who believes what.

Who brings news

To their home.

At this time,

News was the same:

Hordes of evil Orcs,

Who came uninvited,

Besieged again

The Gibberling lands.

They burn, break, destroy,

Everything that can be touched.

They are getting close

To the Ash Tree.

The Gibberlings seek

Salvation in the sea.

Votin with his troops

Defends the Great Tree.

The years went by

Quickly for the brothers,

And their father's troops

Grew bigger and stronger.

The time came for vengeance

On the Orc people!

The old Votin

Sent the sons to battle.

Thorri chose a hammer

Forged by the Zvergs

And left his father's house

Without saying a word.

Lok said goodbye

To his mother and father,

To his uncles and aunt,

And other relatives.

Wald said a few things

At the threshold of the house.

He promised to return

Once the Orcs were defeated.

The three brothers left,

Watched by sharp eyes.

And words followed them,

Full of spells.

It was a maiden

Of a different kind.

She was called black,

Her fur darker than soot.

Her name was Seida.

Braiding threads

In wonderful patterns,

She saw clearly

Signs and omens

In the Fabric of the Universe.

Regarding the fate of the three brothers

Seida was silent.

Numerous Orcs

Were slain by Thorri's hammer.

Many were scared into fleeing

Straight into Lok's traps.

Then came an avalanche

Of iron shields.

The hird's weapons clanged,

Sharp spears gleamed.

Scarlet flowers

Bloomed on Isa's snow.

The Gibberlings' fury

Spared no Orc.

And the enemies fled

In a terrible panic.

It is true that in unity

Was the Gibberlings' strength!

"It's time to go home!"

Thorri told the brothers.

There were spoils:

Silver, gold,

Wonderful armor,

Marvelous weapons!

They would have something to show

To Votin and the others!

The journey home was long

The brothers whiled it away

In conversation.

Lok said, thoughtful:

"And where, brothers,

Did these Orcs come from?

Old man told us

They didn't exist!"

"They say the Orcs once lived

In the warm lands of the south

Far away from here.

But they went overseas -

Humans drove them out.

And also dragons,"

Said Wald

Wo knew the sagas.

"What are Humans?"

Lok asked.

"Humans are Humans,
We have not met them.

But the Orcs know

That somewhere in the south,

Where there is enough land,

There are plenty of them.

There would be even more of them,

If not for the dragons

That burn down

Everything they see.

The dragons feel hatred

For all the living.

The Orc nomads' camps

Died in flames.

After leaving the steppes,

And building boats,

The Orcs moved straight

To Isa as a horde.

The brothers were quiet

For the next part of the journey.

They thought about Orcs,

Humans, and dragons.

The home was now

Only one day away.

Thorri said to Lok

One night in camp,

"I wish we could go back,

Drive the Orcs back to the Humans.

Save our home

From this endless threat."

"That’s right, brother!"

Lok nodded, thinking,

"It’s a pity we are few in number,

And we have no dragons!

I wish we could get

More weapons

From the wise Heidruns,

Praidens, or Zvergs."

They kept going,

Talking all the while

About upcoming battles.

Look - they are home!

In celebration of another victory,

A feast was held.

Brothers were honored,

With raised cups.

Many Gibberlings

Drank beer there,

Ate fish

And a lot of cheese.

And tales were told,

Each better than the last,

Around the mead hall

Deep into the night.

In the morning, early,

When it's dark,

And the fog is still

Over the water,

Three brothers left the house

And went to the square.

They saw a maiden there,

Black as midnight.

"Glorious is your path, brothers!"

That was Seida's voice.

"I ask you to hear

What the Threads promise us."

"Tell me, sister,"

Lok intervened quickly.

"Will we be rid of the Orcs?

Will we drive them out completely?"

Seida answered,

"Sagas will sing about you,

They will carry your feat

Through the centuries to your descendants.

But I see dangers

That threaten the whole of Isa.

Horrible fate awaits us!

The power of insidious Fate!

The Threads of the universe

Tell me this:

Soon the world will plunge

Into the void of oblivion!

The roots of the world will crack,

Rocks will fall into the abyss,

And sea waters

Will boil all at once.

The wolf will swallow the sun,

And the stars will die out.

Darkness will swallow Isa,

Devouring everything.

Many souls will die,

Many words will be forgotten,

And the people of Isa

Will perish in the pitch darkness!

That moment is called 'Yok',"

So said Seida.

The brothers fell silent,

Horrified…

"But there are sprouts of hope

Amidst the nightmare,"

Seida said again,

"Isa will survive!

A new world will arise

From the wreckage of the old ones,

Great-grandfather, Prophetic Ash Tree

Will be our salvation.

But Fate is treacherous!

Centuries later

Trouble will come again,

Darkness will cover the whole world.

I see it so clearly:

The tree is dying,

The ancient enemy has been awakened,

There is no rest for the dead!

Deadly Frost will come,

And countless enemies

Whose skin is white.

I see it through time.

Blood ties get stronger:

Pilgrim's children

Will take ragged weaving

And tie it into a whole.

And the flower of hope

Will bloom at the Tree,

The news will rush further

To the wonderful land of stars.

This is just the beginning.

I see an ominous city,

It is full of the dead,

Summoned against their will.

Light and darkness in battle

Argue with each other,

But in vain:

Their fate is inevitable.

A new god will rise -

He who took the power

From the unfortunate sisters

Who forgot the law:

What Fate decides

Will happen.

There is no power in the world,

That would change that."

The maiden Seida's

Speeches have faded.

The Gibberling brothers

Conferred for a long time.

"You won't scare us!"

Thorri said,

"While my hammer is in my hand,

I will not accept this fate!"

"If the pattern is known,

And not yet woven...

We must take the Threads into our hands

And fool Fate!"

So said Lok,

The cunning trickster.

Wald, after much thought,

Supported the idea.

"Since Seida does not know

How to avoid Fate,

We will seek advice

From other peoples."

So it was decided,

And there was no reason to delay.

On the same day, the three brothers

Set off on another journey.

The path took them far away,

To the foot of Muspel

Where good Heidruns

Settled among the grass.

The Gibberlings were greeted

By Ilko, the chief of the horned ones.

The people welcomed the guests,

Offering mead.

"Tell us, wise one,

How to argue with Destiny?

How to avoid Fate,

What do the Threads say?"

The Heidrun chief said,

"Yes, Fate is harsh.

What it decided to weave

Will surely happen.

We gave this evil force

A different name.

We call it the Weaver

That spins Threads.

But we believe

That another power exists.

It gives a chance

To those it favors.

If Luck loves

Her chosen one,

They will avoid Fate

And deceive the Threads.

But while she falls in love quickly,

She falls out of it just as easily.

The circle will come around again,

And luck will pass."

"In our villages

We have these maidens.

Amorous for a day only,

And then - nothing,"

Lok said jokingly.

The brothers nodded:

"This is no good!

We need a sure way!"

Ilko thought for a while,

Then said,

"If you don't wish to wait

For the Star of Fortune...

There are other sagas

Which sing about marvels

About the one who created

All the living things.

He rarely appeared,

But whoever saw him knows:

Num is the creator of the living.

He must be wiser than all of us."

"That's right, Ilko,

Since he is the father to all of us,

He must know for real,

How to escape fate.

How do we find

Num who is invisible?

If he has a house,

Maybe that's where he is?"

Wise Ilko said,

"Num's house is unknown.

But there are signs

That can show the way.

When you see a Rainbow,

He is at the edge

Farthest from you.

Look there.

Where the sky shines,

From horizon to horizon,

Num will be close,

You can find him.

Where the winds were born

And the fires of volcanoes,

There are traces of creation,

And Num's abode.

But those brave ones

Who do not believe in fate

And who want to fight it

Should remember this:

By challenging the might

That is stronger than gods,

Brave madmen

Will bring doom."

"We will not be stopped

By threats of Fate,

A warrior does not fear

Empty words,"

So saying,

The warriors left.

The path took them far away,

To a place full of signs.

The north received the brothers,

Where the radiance of the sky

Illuminates the earth

But does not warm it.

The path is long and difficult,

The journey takes many days.

There is nothing but ice and rocks,

And spoils are scarce.

Every day is shorter

Under the dim sun,

The night grows boundlessly,

Darkness brings cold.

One night a storm

Wakes up the brothers.

A veil of snow

Covers everything around them.

They see through the snowstorm

That someone is approaching -

A silhouette

With a shaky gait.

Once the fire dispelled

The darkness that hid the image,

The brothers were horrified:

It was a frozen corpse!

Features and clan marks were hidden

Under the iron mask.

His armor was covered

With hoarfrost patterns.

Thorri swung his hammer

At the evil spirit!

But suddenly the uninvited guest

Said quietly,

"Who are you and why are you here?"

The brothers were surprised.

"We are Gibberlings

Looking for the house of Num."

"Like you, I once searched

For the House of the Creator...

The road was not easy,

I fell, killed by Frost."

"We do not fear Frost!"

Thorri answered.

"It is worth fearing

The Evil God of Cold.

Here he reigns supreme,

Eradicating life.

The deadly frost

Kills outright.

Be afraid to meet

The ice maiden here.

If you look even once

Into the eyes of an Isfrun,

You will turn to ice,

And your life force will fade.

Even the Junes fear

The powers of the harsh ice.

There are many other

Creatures of nightmare here.

Ice worms,

Jotunns and Wargs...

If you go further,

It will be even more dangerous.

Icy expanses

Are not for the living!"

"We will reach our goal,"

Said the brothers.

"The Threads of our Fate

Have become stronger!

Thank you for your advice...

What is your name?"

The dead one told them,

"They used to call me Nagle."

As the storm subsided,

They said goodbye to the guest,

And set out.

Many days passed.

Thorri often lifted

The hammer when necessary.

Many different creatures,

Some of them nameless,

He struck down with a blow,

Powerful and brave.

Lok scouted out the land.

With his cunning tricks,

He sneaked into the dwellings

Of snow giants.

After stealing food,

He returned to his brothers.

Wald, full of advice,

Knew the habits of monsters

And taught his brothers

How to avoid them.

Thus they reached the sea.

The end of their journey was close.

Massive mountains nearby

Were the borders of this world.

There, in the distance,

Burned a flame brighter than the sun.

It was their destination,

The end of distant wanderings.

The brothers found there

A strange old man

With a white beard,

Wearing scarlet clothes.

"Are you called Num?"

Lok asked fearlessly.

"Teach us, old one,

How to avoid Fate!"

"Foolish children!"

Num said angrily.

"In vain

You came to my halls!

I do know of a way

To avoid fate.

But it is infeasible

For the Sparks of mortals!

To argue with fate,

You must be free

Of all the chains

And fetters of the world.

But you are held tightly

By the Thread of Fate,

A vigilant Weaver

Spun it before your birth."

The brothers listened,

And in heavy thoughts

Set out for home.

Their families were waiting.

The threshold is in sight.

Within reach...

But wait, listen -

Bells are ringing!

This means the Orcs

Attacked viciously again.

The brothers did not wait -

Rushed to help!

A hard-won victory -

The brothers survived

Miraculously in this battle.

Such is the will of Fate!

Accepting the Threads,

The Gibberling brothers

Resigned themselves

To their great fate.

Future alliances

Needed a base

They were destined to build.

Votin gave Thorri

His mighty troops,

Lok will appease the Zvergs.

Wald will think of a way

To approach the harsh Pridens.

Great-grandchildren will continue

Their Threads in the Pattern.

What is meant to be will happen!

The Orcs will be gone from Isa!

Sagas will remember

Thorri, Lok, and Wald!

The glory of the Gibberlings

Is preserved for centuries!

name.en: Ask about the search for the Sparks of June heroes on the Holy Land

text.en: Oh, it's a very interesting story that happened to you... If you like, I can tell you what you learned in the course of that search

It all started with a letter from Osip:

"Ugh, I finally got myself to you. Wasn't it a brilliant idea to mail myself in a letter? It's better than having to find a ride. Or going on foot! I'm not a horse, you know.

What are you staring at? Do you think I was all comfy? Think again.

Alright, , listen up. I don't have all day. You're a hero, right?

I know you are. Well, and I am not!

There's something that's been tormenting me, I can't stand it anymore. My friend's Spark is in the hands of this bastard! You get special treatment from Nihaz. Everybody knows that, even the ghosts. I'm telling you, if you show up and ask for Zak's Spark, he's going to give it to you right away. Well, maybe not right away... So, anyway. We'll see.

If you don't do what I say, I'll show up every night and howl over your bed while you sleep.

What are you waiting for? Kingdom come?"

Then you went to Nihaz on the Coba Plateau, and the following conversation took place:

"Osip's ghost came to me and demanded that I free Ath-Zak's spirit!"

"So. Why do you care about his pleas? Oh, right, I keep forgetting. Well, let's talk since you're here anyway."

"I challenged you more than once! That's what I'm going to do now!"

"Oh, wait, wait a minute. What challenge are you talking about? We're too old for that kind of stuff. As custom has it, why don't we make a bet? A simple one. Without room for cheating. I'll be generous. You can have not only Ath-Zak's Spark, but also the Sparks of his girlfriend Luja-Gialla and the June Great Mage Tka-Rik. If you can complete the trials, of course."

What is this trial?"

"We're not playing riddles. That's Simargl's thing.

We're going to play hide-and-seek! All three Sparks are currently here, in the Holy Land.

You can find the Spark of Ath-Zak's beloved one, Luja-Gialla, on Eljune. His teacher and Great Mage Tka-Rik's Spark is in the lands of Asee-Teph. His own Spark is somewhere on the Plateau. Find them in this order without any hints or someone else's help, and consider yourself a victor."

"What if I lose?"

"Ah, peanuts! Your Spark goes to me and remains forever in my box. Have you ever lost?
"

And so an agreement was reached.

Nihaz suggested the following conditions:

"Oh, Eljune...

Do you remember the adorable ruins? That's all that was left of the great June civilization. And they were smarter than us. It was hard enough for you to kill two dragons, but Junes defeated eight Great Dragons and a few smaller ones. Junes are gone now. Do you think someone would run around the ruins of your cities, wondering what happened to you?

Let's get to the point. A very curious adventure seeker was here, very curious about the Junes' death. She was logging her findings. Somebody stole her log, tore it apart, and scattered the pages all over Eljune. Find her notes and walk the same path, and you could find Luja-Gialla's Spark!

Where should you start? Well, I can tell you that whoever stole her log got what they deserved! Balancing between the League and Imperial troops is dangerous. He's food for ravens now."

So you had to find the brave traveler's notes. I won't go into detail regarding your search since it's of no interest to history. Marianna's notes and the evidence collected are much more important. We recorded everything carefully.

Here it is:

Marianna Lopatina's Log.

June 16, 1018

Arrived at Eljune today. Going to look for June artifacts. Rumor has it, goblins have recently found a cache full of journals. However, all these idlers care about is gold. They'd take the coins and throw away the clay tablets. There's a good chance I can find something really interesting! If all goes well, everyone will forget the incident with the prankster.

P.S. I hear there's a place famous for its drinks. I'd better check it out first, see if anyone tries to pay with June coins.

Marianna Lopatina's Log.

June 17, 1018

Lucky me! Found a couple of tablets. I'm going to translate them now. It's curious. These records belong to the Junes that lived here when their civilization fell. I don't quite understand the text, but I know the words about the darkness and death. It looks like a battle... and a giant golem seems to be involved. Then it mentions the Curse. Has the author lost their family and run? The note stops abruptly.

I asked around about the other tablets. Apparently, some pilgrim was collecting them. Ugh, another saint! He went on and on about how he wanted to visit the place where the greatest miracle had happened, the first resurrection!

I've got to visit this place.

Here is a very interesting note from one of the pilgrims who got some of the tablets:

"My beloved Nancy!

I'm leaving you this note in case you start looking for me. Our holy father Ivan, the Devotee, advised me to visit the place known for its holiness. The first Chapel of Tensess! A great miracle happened here. Suddenly, an evil astral demon appeared and smashed the ship! But those who died in the Astral were brought back to life by the grace of Tensess. They appeared right here!

The chapel is nailed shut and abandoned. It upsets me greatly. I know that Goblins are to blame! They're wicked creatures, thieves and cheats! I heard an interesting story about them, though. They say that the ship that got wrecked in the Astral was carrying two goblins. They went into the Purgatory. One of them saw a Servant of Tensess and got scared! He started confessing his sins, promising to make an offering of Mirra. The other goblin heard that and offered to sell him Mirra! And it's been like this ever since: one goblin received Tensess's forgiveness and became a gift collector; the other goblin was cursed and banished from the Purgatory forever.

Well, one way or the other, my beloved Nancy, I should visit the smugglers. Give them a talking-to. Why have they neglected the Chapel? The mongers have the guts to collect money from pilgrims! Their leader lives somewhere around here. I should find him.

I will see you soon, my darling. I miss you. I'll return to you as soon as I sort this thing out."

Let's get back to Marianna's notes:

Marianna Lopatina's Log.

June 18, 1018

I'm so angry! It took me a while to catch this idiot! Thank Tensess, I've got the tablets now. And this is the missing part!

I restored the missing fragment. It's a story of the great fall of the city June Itsmal.

"For the city was great and the citizens were proud. Gifts were brought to June Itsmal from all over the world. Beautiful ships arrived at Takalik harbor. The ruler of June Itsmal, the great Xolocipilli, was brave and wise. He used to hunt fire dragons.

Everything changed in one day. The Curse came to the city. The walls were tall, the gates were strong, but all defenses fell. The Curse took lives with just one stare. Mighty golems taller than the tallest trees have come to battle. But even they couldn't stop the Curse. The towers fell. Xolocipilli's palace fell and buried the city ruler underneath. Only a few survivors escaped the ruins of June Itsmal in the dead of night."

What happened next? Whoever wrote this, they clearly survived! I need to find the next piece...

I asked around if anything interesting was found lately. People tell me they heard a working girl brag about a pretty stone with strange inscriptions.  Not much of a lead, but that's all I have.

At least it's not boring..."

Marianna Lopatina's Log.

June 19, 1018

I think I'm onto something. An elf told me about a battle between goblins and the Free Traders' Mercenaries that took place recently. It sounds serious.

Louis also shared a couple of useful contacts. Someone's been tracking down June artifacts. And that someone was spotted asking the mercenaries about any interesting recent findings. Perhaps he was the one to hire goblins.

Well, anyway, those bastards wanted to break into Asee-Teph. It was quite a fight! Rocks falling everywhere, arrows flying around, swords clanging. I wish I could have seen it!

Unfortunately, this means that those tablets will be very hard to find.

These notes were found on a pirate ship. A bunch of smaller notes written by the crew is attached. The text is only partially preserved:

Marianna Lopatina's Log.

June 23, 1018

Pirates captured me! This is so exciting!

Found several new tablets in Takalik Harbor. Since I'm imprisoned in this stinky cargo hold anyway, I have time to continue translating the tablets.

"Oh, glorious June Itsmal! Oh, great cities of Uskul and Miktlan! They have fallen to the fury of the June Curse. There's no escape. The curse cannot be lifted. There's nowhere to run. Almost all golems have been shattered. The portal network is destroyed.

We have only one way out left. The Dark One promised us salvation. He was the one to warn us about danger. If we'd killed treacherous Sheratan, the last Fire Dragon, the world could split in two, like a giant egg.

Wise Shilonen, Coatl, and Atslan want to seek assistance with him. There are those who oppose. Tka-a-Lithan Ric-ti-a-Nic, also known as Bane of the Fire Dragons, does not trust the Dark One. He suggests we return to the city and use the old portals."

The note stops abruptly. I hope I can steal the key when the goblin brings me food.

"Bosun's Notes"

"Bloody captain!
Well, we captured a ship of this elvish girl. It carried heaps of cargo! 21 silk cushions!
And the elvish girl was so pretty, leggy and all.
Just when the crew got excited, he tossed her overboard! And the cushions, too.
What a nasty piece of work!"

"We arrived at the Pirate Outpost. I say, that's where all the action is!

You can find all kinds of ships here. Some of them I haven't even seen out there, in the Astral. There were the Lord, and the Breath of Void, and the Striga! Breathtaking! We didn't have much time, though. We had some cargo to sell. Something that we brought from the Dead Sea.

We sealed the deal on July {num2}. This day will be remembered! We haven't made this much, like... ever!"

"Sailing Master's Notes"

"Bloody captain!

The June treasure will do us no good, no doubt!

I hear, Junes are cursed people. They brought demons to our world.

Captain shouldn't have gotten involved..."

"First Mate's Notes"

"Bloody captain!

We got ourselves into some dirty business. Here's how it happened. We made it to a port and got ashore. First thing we did was go down to the tavern. There was this fat bearded man in boots. Couldn't put down his newspaper.

So, he spotted our captain, beckoned him with a finger, and offered a good price for that crazy girl jumping about the ruins.

Captain was going to say no, but the money clouded his mind, his eyes lit up! He couldn't turn it down."

"Captain's Notes"

"Oh, these lovers of June artifacts!

Everybody wants this junk. They keep looking for something new.
