The word about our journey quickly spread among those, who tried to capture the Star Gates in the Dead City. Namely, the Wormfaces from mountain caves, demons, cheated by Catherina, and Draconids... who cause the most problems.

Shortly before your arrival the power went out. The thing is, Draconids captured the local mana station and caused the outage.

I expect it to get even worse. Go now, or it will never happen. League and Imperial fleets are fighting a demonic onslaught near Suslanger but new demons keep arriving. From all Astral...

Here's what you need to do: enter the mana station and figure out why it stopped working. Besides, as Skulnar has been behind the Gates and seen what it's like, we need to get hazmat suits stat. No, assault shells won't work in these conditions. You can find equipment crates all over the camp. Unfortunately, most of the equipment didn't survive this mess. Try searching the boxes. We need half a dozen of suits. Backup won't hurt.
Hold on!
Told you, we'd see each other again. Honestly, I was more of you than the fight you started here.
Oh please, hold the drama. Told you, we'd see each other again. Keep doing what you've been doing.

What do you think I'm doing here? Approaching the final stage of my plan, of course.

You've got something that's mine. Namely, a unique mystic orc, trained to be a Great Mage and able to guide me along the Star Trail.

I'm here for my property.

By the look on your face, I can't have it... and that's a quandary. I could absolutely neutralize all of you, so to say, including Eladia. But it'll take time, and I'm in a hurry. Here's the deal: I'll ask my Draconid friends to stop crashing the place, and you will keep me company in my journey.

As a bonus, my loyal friends will help you repel attacks of other... contenders for leaving this world.

Oh, and of course, I shall switch the station back on to feed the Gates.

Tell that to Eladia. She seems to be the decision maker here, am I right?
Hi! I can teleport you back to Great Mage Simon in the East. I'm also offering fresh water.
Cheeky. But what choice have we got? That Great Mage caught us in a weak position. It's not that we had that much of a choice here. Keep an eye on him, he can pull some trick.
Yes, I'm ready... I just need a short breather. Whew, what a journey! It was a nightmare!
Hello, hello! We're getting ready for the new attack. My fellows can rip anyone apart! But to tell you the truth, the battles are getting boring. I wish Eladia finished her monstrosity faster.

Aho, frrriend! It's been a harrrd day. Worrrmfaces, scalies, and demons are crrrawling from all corners. Attack after attack, without any breathers. We had to leave the old camp behind and retrrrreat to the Gates, and the ginger-hairrred witch still can't get her machine rrrunning! These are dark times, I swearrr by the tip of my tail.
What do you want? Can't you see we're busy? Leave us alone.
What do you want from me, little hero? Speak with the elf. Let's see what destiny the Great Mages have in store for the world this time.
So? Has Eladia agreed?

name.en: She wants to hear about your terms.

text.en:
As I said, all I need is to enter the Gates. You let me and Sturegga pass, we can keep you company until we reach your destination, and then we'll say our goodbyes. You can keep Skulnar.

Besides, our Draconids will help you defend the Gates from other races, trying to break out of Sarnaut.
Ugh, last time the first leap took us to a different place. Come on, instinct, don't let me down! I don't want to wander forever!

name.en: Can you return me to the Suslanger? Got one thing to deal with...

text.en: Sure thing. Eladia gave me a special stone for that. Good stuff. What you got? Ah, never mind. Take care. Are you flying?
Um, let me see... ah, here it is.
Congratulations on your first step along the Star Trail. As you know, this is a crowded place. Here we can see the consequences of one of the encounters.

It was a good call to take the Sculptor with us. He's part of a higher Architect. He could easily control the ones we see.

However, Klavdia thinks that if we perish too, the Sculptor will be Sarnaut's only chance against Nihaz. He's her bargaining chip.
Woah! Just look around! How beautiful! While you're getting ready, I'll make some calculations for the future journeys. Maybe, Skulnar won't have to jump back and forth.
You're too weak, Mortals! You can't even survive in the void! Dragons do not fear endless darkness or vacuum.
It looks like there's been a great war on this Trail. It's way older than our world. Perhaps, even older than the rest of the worlds.
I have a bad feeling... someone lives here.
See those ruins over there? I dread to imagine a weapon that destroyed it.
...why are you disturbing the Guardians?

name.en: Why aren't you attacking? You're Nihaz's servants, aren't you?

text.en: We serve the Endless Time. Overlord Nihaz said nothing about keeping you here.
The Star Trail is full of strangers that cannot enter the world of All-Mother. But you may pass.
What do you want, mortal?

name.en: Why aren't you attacking? You're Nihaz's servants, aren't you?

text.en: Nihaz is only a name. We serve the aspect of Destruction. Follow your path.
Dragons are pursuing their goal. We served Father Time. We serve the one, who took His place. You may pass, mortals.
As you touch the crystal, the black stones of the Tensess Temple on Asee-Teph appear before your eyes.

Here's the thing... We have five crystals. They must be activated in the correct order to open the portal. We sealed it ourselves, hah. We even left an instruction! But I forgot the order anyway... Can you help?

name.en: Alright, what does this stone say...

text.en:
Uh, you see, we wrote it in a way so only a Sarnaut dweller would understand. It mentions only the latest events, hah. The problem is that I wasn't an eye-witness, so I can't judge. I completely missed the Gods versus Fartitects fight. Here's what it says:

We learned the truth about the Light,

That Demons aren't Sarnaut's blight.

The God of Darkness got a new foe:

Threat under mountains and snow.

Walked along Nezeb's sandy path.

You're still here with us? You can reveal it, it's no high-school math.
Yeah, I figured. You jump into the portal. I'll hang around a little longer. Talk later! It's just too beautiful.
Um... there's something wrong here. We should have put down the answers.
We reached all internal worlds. Everything as Nihaz predicted.
Oh, father, you were such a good student of Nihaz! Your plans are too complex to understand what you really want.
As you touch the crystal, Ferris, covered in ice, and all the horrors that live in its laboratories, emerge in front of your eyes.
As you touch the crystal, the memory of Gorislav and Gipatian Ghosts comes to you.
Have we almost reached it? I can't believe it. Are the drrragons... even alive? It's weirrrd. Reminds me of Thicket.
Oh, wow! And the beasts. Oh, and the Gates too. Can you distract them while I'm finding the spare parts?
Dragons of the Void... the Ancients. I heard about them when I was a dragonling. They were our ancestors. The essence of destruction.
As you touch the crystal, the scorching sun of Suslanger burns your skin, and Alice's last moments in this world spring to mind.
As you touch the crystal, you remember the gloomy and sick Umoir and corrupted Catherina's explosive temper.
Ah, here you are. I hope you realize that we couldn't do it without you.

name.en: Teleport me to the Gates-III construction site

text.en: Good luck, comrade!
This is one of the Expedition's harvesters. Have they gone this far?
Tell me why I shouldn't lock you in together with other soft-skinned? There is one thing, however...
Catherina closed the world but it never stopped you. You found a way in.
You're here! How fortunate. First, the aborigines attacked, then the machines went mad, so I just ran... and ran, and ran. And then I found myself here. I'm stuck. Will you help me free?
I'm waiting for the right moment. Don't worry, I'll get the others. I'd rather land in woodfaces' prison than in the middle of the rise of the machines.
Uh, that's much better. Thanks. I'll find my own way from here when it gets quiet.
That's a thing to thank for! I should go to prison, you say? Oh, well then... I'm sure you'll think of something to let us out. I'll take a short breather and go.
Ugh, where are they? I can't go anywhere without my goggles.
Yes, yes. The prison. I remember. I'll be on my way soon. I don't want to rush to get to prison.
I've lost my goggles! Can you believe it? They should be here but I can't find them, I'm almost blind! Will you help?
I know! You're the messenger of the green people! Do they want me back in their prison? Alright. I know, they rule everything and everyone here.
And those who fail to obey them will suffer... the consequences. Why would they need our cows, though?
Do you think I'm a woman in need? Haven't you learned anything from Ferris? No way. I escaped to think through a rescue plan. And here's what I'm thinking...

You see, the green people are pacifists by nature, right? Aha. So they sent you to break down mechanoids. They don't want to do it with their own hands. That's also the reason why we all ended up in prison and not dead.

So, they're pacifists. This means...

...that they're easy to persuade to let us go. As... as goodwill ambassadors!

Honestly, I hate the whole idea of the stand between the Expedition and the Forestfolk. We're nothing but occupants on this land. We broke in, started tearing down the trees, pumping out ambrosia... I know it's for a good cause, but I deeply hate the approach.

And then you go on breaking the remaining mechanoids, and I'll go to prison. We must go apart, because you attract too much attention. I'll sneak quietly in the shadow. I'll see you there. And then we'll figure out what to do with the prisoners. Alright, chop-chop.

name.en: I'll be on my way then?

text.en: Go.

name.en: Gather your people. I'll take you to the base.

text.en: Excellent! Thanks a zil!
What boring plant life world... thankfully, the war made it more fun.

name.en: I'll get you in the end.

text.en:
Easy! You're a funny creature.

I see that my father did some work on you. There's something in you, you know. Ideal destroyers, created by the God of Light and bred up by the God of Darkness.

Let's calm down and talk. You're not strong enough to challenge me.

Don't you get it?

Maverick can open portals to other worlds. He had been looking for Eden for quite a while, until he found it. The rest was only a question of time.

For one thing, I didn't expect you to get here so fast. But you got me curious. Only two from your world got to get here before. The one you know as Sage... although I don't really understand what's so wise about this pathetic local deity. The other one... the Children call him Madman. He's got a way more interesting personality.

He told me about you and your world. If even one percent of you resemble Madman just a little, your world is a gem compared to the rest of the Universe.

You're a little like him. And I can make good use of all of you. I'll give Madman his body back. And then... no, it's too early to announce.
Stay away from my plans. Ciao!
Alright, you got me interested.
How dare you cross a goddess?
Billions of years passed before my eyes...

name.en: Report what happened to the Expedition, Herbert, and Elena

text.en:
Gah!

Don't get me wrong, I'm happy that we've found them. I hope they'll get in touch soon. But the Children... they won't let us to a thing on Eden. What are we going to do? We'll have to make a deal and exchange ambrosia for something. I wonder what they'd be interested in...

As to mechanoids, they're in defense state. They attack everything that seems hostile... which is pretty much everything around here. I must say, Ivan and Felix were outraged. You broke down a lot of very expensive machines. I'll try and justify your actions for them.

How curious. Another Nihaz's child? The goddess of Darkness and Death?

She's a very dangerous creature, threatening both us and All-Mother. We must convince the willful goddess to unite our forces against Nihaz's messengers.

I also wonder whom Hirkalla was talking about. What are the Sparks that came from Sarnaut to Eden? If the Sage is the Umoir god that, as you say, has left our world... then who is the Madman?

A Great Mage that we know nothing about? A new ancient god? If Klavdia didn't have Tep's Spark, I could think that it was him. But she's had it since the Pyramid.

Yes, our research.

The results are very curious.

As I said, the builders of this city were quite advanced. They mined metals, dug quarries.

The settlement was destroyed by someone else. It looks like an external attack. There are traces of strikes and repairs. It stopped helping at some point, though. They either left the city or all died.

I'll try to find out more. Return to All-Mother and try to make that deal.
Yes? So, what happened here?
Darkness is only a part of existence. It never had all the answers.

name.en: Send me back to the Sanctuary

text.en: Sending

name.en: Why can't I take the exam here?

text.en: First of all, you need to show my Children that you have learned your lessons, because they need to believe that you are not one of Nihaz's minions.

name.en: I think I'm mixing things up. Let me start again...

text.en: As you wish...

name.en: I'm not sure about the second question. Let me start again...

text.en: As you wish...

name.en: I'm not sure about the third question. Let me start again...

text.en: As you wish...

name.en: I'm not sure about the fourth question. Let me start again...

text.en: As you wish...

name.en: I'm not sure about the fifth question. Let me start again...

text.en: As you wish...

name.en: I'm not sure about the sixth question. Let me start again...

text.en: As you wish...
What is the foundation of all things?
These are important elements, but they are not the foundation but the top.
That's right. Fire, water, air, and earth manifest themselves in many ways.
What? This is… some nonsense. Think again.
What is the Circle of Life?
Where? What kind? Think again.

name.en: Death is part of the cycle, just like life.

text.en: That's right. Without death there is no life. Everything you see is interconnected and balanced. Everything serves what was before and what comes after. Everything is necessary.
I don't think you understand my question.

name.en: Without death there is no life.

text.en: That's right. Death is part of the cycle, just like life. Everything you see is interconnected and balanced. Everything serves what was before and what comes after. Everything is necessary.
What? What are you saying?

name.en: I will answer the third question!

text.en: Let's proceed. What divine powers do you know?
A strange set of concepts. It seems that my lesson hasn't sunk in.

name.en: Sarn, Nihaz, the Architect, and Genlun

text.en: These are gods, not powers.
That's right. Tell me, why didn't I destroy the Darkness?
Yes, I didn't want to destroy it, but why?

name.en: Darkness is part of the circle

text.en: That's right, darkness is as much a part of my design as everything else. Why do we consider Nihaz a rebel?
My strength is not about fighting. It's about being able to create. But Nihaz is no match for my children.

name.en: He has deviated from your plan.

text.en: That's right. Nihaz did not want to perform his role and decided to destroy the Great Circle.

name.en: Well, Darkness is evil, and therefore he is evil.

text.en: No, Darkness itself is necessary and not evil.

name.en: Nihaz is cool! He knows how to kick ass.

text.en: Sometimes I wonder about your sanity when you say things like that...

name.en: I will answer the fourth question!

text.en: Why is balance so important?
True, but what happens if someone takes too much?
True, but what happens if the connection is broken?

name.en: If the balance is upset, it will be bad.

text.en: True, but what happens if the balance is upset?

name.en: Needs and opportunities need to be balanced.

text.en: True, but what if it doesn't happen?

name.en: The Circle of Life will be in danger.

text.en: What needs to be done to prevent this from happening?

name.en: The chain will break and everyone will feel bad.

text.en: How do we avoid this?
What can we do to prevent it from coming?

name.en: Someone will die, followed by others.

text.en: How do we save them?

name.en: Make it so everyone can procreate freely.

text.en: Such a solution would eventually lead to disaster. But could life recover from it?

name.en: The best solution is to leave everything as it is.

text.en: Well, that shows your indifference, but let's say we do that. Can a garden exist without a gardener?

name.en: It need someone to maintain balance.

text.en: If they fail, what will happen?

name.en: Every garden must have its own gardener.

text.en: But would a garden exist without a gardener?

name.en: No, we'd have to start over.

text.en: You don't believe in the power of life? That's unfortunate.

name.en: Without a gardener, the garden is doomed!

text.en: The gardener, of course, improves the garden, but the garden is not that weak on its own.

name.en: Life will always find a way.

text.en: That's right. Life will find a way and correct all mistakes, but if we want our gardens to flourish, we need someone to maintain the balance.
No, life is stronger than this. It's much more powerful than it seems.

name.en: I will answer the fifth question!

text.en: You named the divine forces and the forces of nature, but what is the name of the powers of the demiurges?
These sound like the heralds of doomsday, not the powers of the demiurges. Think again.
And that's right. What can you say about death?
No, that's not correct. What do demiurges have to do with those?
That's correct, even though they're usually named differently. What can you say about death?
No, these are not the powers of the demiurges. We will not talk about them now.
It looks like you don't understand my lessons!

name.en: Death is the other side of Life.

text.en: That's right, but what are the forces of Destruction?

name.en: We have conquered death because we have the Gift of Tensess.

text.en: You have only violated divine laws. And this is not the Gift of Tensess, but the Gift of Nihaz!

name.en: We need to find a way to finally defeat death.

text.en: Once you become truly immortal, you will lose life in its entirety.

name.en: Death and Life form one whole in the cycle of existence.

text.en: This is the correct answer. But what can you say about Destruction?

name.en: Time is the most destructive thing in the universe.

text.en: That's right. But what can resist Time?
No, it's not. It's just one of the powers.

name.en: Everything is coming to an end.

text.en: That's right, the circle is turning and Destruction is the fate of all worlds. But what opposes time?

name.en: The end of all worlds, which we must prevent.

text.en: Even the combined power of the gods cannot defeat time.
No, Nihaz wants to break the Great Circle itself, and Destruction is part of the Circle.

name.en: Creation can withstand the passage of time.

text.en: That's right. But how is Creation different from Life?
Nihaz can disturb a thin stream, but the river of time will sweep him away.
Life obeys time, though it fights against it, constantly losing.
No matter how strong Order is, unstoppable time will turn it into ruins.

name.en: Creators of worlds resist the destructive entropy of time.

text.en: True. But they create Life. What is the difference between Life and Creation?

name.en: These are one and the same.

text.en: No, Life and Creation are different things.
There is no conflict between Life and Creation, although they are not united.

name.en: One is created by the other.

text.en: And this is true. Creation is the beginning of history, and Life is history itself.

name.en: This is a difficult question with no definitive answer.

text.en: The answer here is unambiguous, and if you understand the essence of my lessons, you know it.

name.en: The difference between them is subjective.

text.en: The truth is absolute. Think more about this question.

name.en: I will answer the sixth question!

text.en: What do you know about heroes like you?

name.en: There are many of them, and each of them serves their people.

text.en: True. But who creates heroes and why?

name.en: Heroes are loners in the crowd that deifies them.

text.en: True. But who creates heroes and why?

name.en: Each of us is a hero, but in our own way.

text.en: True. But who creates heroes and why?

name.en: Heroes themselves arise under the influence of circumstances.

text.en: No, heroes are created by gods, they are chosen by higher powers. But what should heroes do?

name.en: Heroes come when they are needed.

text.en: A hero comes at the call of the gods who have chosen them. But what is the hero's duty?

name.en: Heroes are created by the gods as an answer to people's prayers.

text.en: That's right, a hero is chosen by the gods. But what do we need a hero for?

name.en: The hero appears from among the people.

text.en: Chosen by the gods, needed by their people. But why are they needed?

name.en: The hero performs feats for a beautiful lady.

text.en: Who is that beautiful lady that your heart wants? But the truth is, the gods choose the hero, endowing them with a special destiny. But why?

name.en: There are no heroes, there are ordinary people in extraordinary circumstances.

text.en: Don't extraordinary circumstances indicate that the hero has been chosen by the gods? But what should such a chosen one do?
This is true, since such creatures threaten their people. But where do monsters come from?
Treasures are usually guarded by monsters. But where do those monsters come from?

name.en: The hero must save beautiful maidens!

text.en: But who threatens beautiful maidens if not monsters? Where do they come from?

name.en: The hero must fulfill the wishes of the gods!

text.en: What can the gods desire but for feats to be performed in their name? Feats require the presence of an enemy that you will fight, and where will this enemy come from?

name.en: The hero must become the strongest in the world!

text.en: The only way to become strong is to pass tests by slaying many monsters. But where would they come from?

name.en: The hero doesn't owe anything to anyone - they will decide what to do.

text.en: What kind of a hero are they, then, if they don't perform feats? Their only task is to fight monsters that are a threat to people's lives. But where do monsters come from?
The truth is, monsters are needed for a hero to become a hero, and so they will indeed appear at some point. But what is the hero looking for at the end of their journey?

name.en: Monsters are creatures of Chaos, Darkness and Death.

text.en: These powers often spawn monsters, especially Chaos. Monsters have always existed and will continue to exist, and there will always be a hero who defeats them. But what will the hero be looking for?

name.en: Monsters are the essence of the world that has not been discovered by the hero.

text.en: True, because where the hero has passed, monsters are no more. But what is the hero looking for?

name.en: Gods themselves create monsters for heroes to fight.

text.en: Yes, this is the fate of all heroes - to fight monsters and perform feats. But what reward does the hero want at the end of their journey?

name.en: Monsters are those who roam the border of civilization and savagery.

text.en: Yes, because civilizations are created by heroes who hunt monsters and move borders. But what are all the heroes looking for?
This is partly true, because there is no hero without monsters, and perhaps there are no monsters without a hero? What does a hero who defeats monsters want?

name.en: The hero is looking for treasure!

text.en: There are no treasures you can take with you to the realm of no return. Everything is meaningless in the face of death, and every hero, in the end, is looking for a way to avoid it. But do they find it?

name.en: The hero wants to break the chain of cause and effect!

text.en: A pointless and pathetic attempt. The laws of the gods are unbreakable, and mortals are unable to violate them. Only the immortal can challenge the gods. But will the hero find immortality?

name.en: The hero is looking for a beautiful maiden!

text.en: Times are cruel, and whoever is beautiful today will wither tomorrow like a flower in fall. Only immortality can bestow infinite happiness, and every hero strives for it. But can they attain it?

name.en: The hero wants to overthrow the gods!

text.en: Only a god can challenge a god, only an immortal can resist an immortal. The fate of mortals is bitter, and every hero is looking for ways to escape their fate. But can they?

name.en: The hero is looking for the meaning of life!

text.en: Many people follow this path, trying to unravel the true meaning of my design. But a mortal cannot follow this path - they will fall before reaching the end. Only an immortal knows the secrets of the world. But can the hero find their immortality?
That's right. But can they find it?
There are no forces that can break the grip of death.

name.en: Yes, they will fight for it!

text.en: There are no troops capable of storming the realm from which there is no return.

name.en: Yes, they'll figure out how to attain it!

text.en: There are no wise men who know how to escape a fate that is inevitable.

name.en: Yes, they will prove that they are worthy of it!

text.en: There is no such feat that is rewarded with this favor.

name.en: Yes, they will beg to have it bestowed upon him!

text.en: There are no words to soften a heart that has already passed judgment.

name.en: No, the hero's destiny is to die.

text.en: True.

name.en: Take me back to your avatar

text.en: So be it.
Alright. The old tribe knows no pain, but they die just like us.
I'm glad the All-Mother trusts you now.
Well, if you've earned the All-Mother's trust, alien, then I'll trust you, too.

name.en: Why are the corpses of the Expedition members here?

text.en: Where else would they be? These fools have gone where they shouldn't... Like everything in our world, they will now facilitate the birth of a new life. The dead gives rise to the living - such is the eternal cycle.
The Darkness is lying that death can be escaped. You will prove it...

name.en: What are you trying to say?

text.en: If you stop acting crazy and listen to me, you might change your mind about what's happening...
Well, let's talk.

name.en: What do you want to tell me about Eden?

text.en:
Don't want to be strung along anymore?

This ideal little world is not that simple at all... There was a lot going on here you weren't told about.

I saw your Catherina study the ruins of an "unknown ancient civilization"... What do you think happened to this ruined city?

Once upon a time there were travelers just like you. They built houses, looked for metals in the ground, cut down trees...

The All-Mother destroyed them all. No other alternative is acceptable to her. The same fate awaits you, if you listen blindly to her. Think about it.

name.en: What do you suggest I do?

text.en:
Perhaps you've had enough of the gods? It's time to take fate into your own hands.

Do you want to fight Nihaz?

But do you really need to call on some goddess to help you? What do you personally think about it?

You have to decide.

name.en: What are you trying to say?

text.en: Do you still not understand why they don't want to die?
They used to be the same as your new friends, but their Tree's lifespan has come to an end. Now they are doomed.
Cruel, senseless sentence - just like everything my mother does!
I extended their lives as best I could. But she? She could give them new ones. But she won't do that.
I opened their eyes, exposing the blatant injustice of what happened to them.

name.en: Ask Felix why the truce was broken

text.en: We're tired of waiting. I'll tell you everything, just be willing to listen...

[Rhubarb murmurs thoughtfully]

I was just a snail crawling along the edge of a blade, a sharp blade. It was my dream. This is my nightmare. I crawl, I crawl, and I stay alive.

…

[Rhubarb seems to wake up. He glares at you]

We trusted you and you repaid us with betrayal!
Traitor! You are all traitors! How treacherous! How deceitful!

How foul...

We agreed that the harvesting of Ambrosia would be stopped! But your mechanoids started harvesting it in the Ambrosia Valley, a sacred place at the very roots of the Great Tree...

We are not going to tolerate this kind of insolence any longer. Our warriors are going into battle to throw you out of this world!

name.en: You are crazy! I'm on your side!

text.en:
Your tribesmen cannot be trusted!

We agreed that the harvesting of Ambrosia would be stopped! But your mechanoids started harvesting it in the Ambrosia Valley, the sacred place at the very roots of the Great Tree...

We are not going to tolerate this kind of insolence any longer. Our warriors are going into battle to throw you out of this world!

name.en: What gives you the right to say that?

text.en:
Foul hypocrite! All this time, you and the others have been working for the Expedition!

We agreed that the harvesting of Ambrosia would be stopped! But your mechanoids started harvesting it in the Ambrosia Valley, the sacred place at the very roots of the Great Tree...

We are not going to tolerate this kind of insolence any longer. Our warriors are going into battle to throw you out of this world!

I don't know whose side you're on!

Go back to your tribe! Get out of my sight!

name.en: I had nothing to do with this!

text.en: Then go to the Expedition's camp and deliver my message! Your tribesmen will answer for this betrayal!
Return to your tribesmen, you vile traitor! Get out of my sight!

name.en: Why did you decide to break the truce?

text.en: Haven't we given you enough time? What have you been up to? Your task was to arrange for us to be allowed to harvest Ambrosia. What have you accomplished?

name.en: I demand that you take the Harvesters back to the base!

text.en:
Making demands? I must have misheard.

What right do you have to demand anything from me? Perhaps you've become too attached to these aborigines? Do you want to be executed for treason?

Your task was to arrange for us to be allowed to harvest Ambrosia. What have you accomplished?

I'm tired of waiting. We're wasting time. How much longer do we have to wait for something to change?

These negotiations are a joke.

Your task was to arrange for us to be allowed to harvest Ambrosia. What have you accomplished?
Yes? Or maybe you got them to agree to help us in our fight against Nihaz? Is this All-Mother ready to join us?

name.en: Well... it's not going as well as we hoped.

text.en:
That's what I'm talking about...

These gods are useless. They are nothing but trouble.

I'm tired of this. We'll solve our problems ourselves. If we can get enough Ambrosia, then we'll be as powerful as the gods.

From now on, anyone who stands in our way will be crushed. If the Children try to stop us, we will burn everything to the ground!

Now report back to Catherina about everything you've learned. I'm preparing a general offensive to protect our Harvesters.
How is it going? Not very well, I see...

name.en: The Children are not willing to give us the Ambrosia.

text.en:
I suspected it might end like this.

We have nothing to offer them. Advanced magical technology? Holy icons? Gibberling beer? They don't need any of this.

They won't back down and compromise.

Well, if we can’t come to an agreement, then it's going to be easy.

name.en: Hirkalla told me about that civilization - the ruins you had discovered. This is what she said...

text.en:
Well, if that really is the case, then we won't be able to negotiate with the goddess either.

Sorry, but I'm not ready to give up the comforts of civilization to wrap myself in leaves and live on a tree.

We have no other choice. To save Sarnaut, we need the Ambrosia.
I'm glad that you decided to give your heart to Eden. Help my Children. They're in dire need, for our world has never had to face an invasion.

I knew that you'd choose your own world. But I hope I managed to explain things to you. Your Expedition also needs your support, for Nihaz has long been obscuring your hearts. Come back for new lessons when you're ready.

name.en: I want to be a friend of the Children

text.en:
It's never too late to change sides. Eden needs your help. Remember that you won't be able to choose that any time soon.

Is the Hero of Sarnaut sure of the choice?
Fine. The Children need your help. The Darkness is coming to our Forest.

name.en: I want to be a friend of the Children

text.en: You can't change sides. You've chosen one just recently. One that changes hearts too often cannot be trusted.

name.en: I want to serve the Expedition again

text.en:
I'm glad you remember us. The Expedition needs your help. Remember that you won't be able to choose that any time soon.

Is the Hero of Sarnaut sure of the choice?
Fine. In this case, I have a lot of complex and interesting work for you.

name.en: I want to serve the Expedition again

text.en: You can't change sides. You've chosen one just recently. You've sworn loyalty to the other party just recently.

name.en: I will be a friend of the Children

text.en:
This might be the right choice. If there's a chance to make a deal with All-Mother, it can be made only by helping them.

Are you sure that your choice is final, though?

name.en: I will be a friend of the Children

text.en: Fine. Try getting their help. We still need to fight Nihaz at some point...

name.en: Helping the Expedition is my duty

text.en:
Good. I knew I could rely on you. We don't know yet if we can make a deal with All-Mother, but we already have some pending problems. Ambrosia is way too valuable for Sarnaut.

Are you sure that your choice is final, though?

name.en: I will be a friend of the of the Expedition

text.en: Fine. We've got a lot of work for you. Our job here isn't done. We're only starting.
There's still time to think. Do it.
Now you need to earn Children's trust. For starters, complete their quests and learn All-Mother's lessons. You might actually learn something interesting.
The Expedition is counting on you. We have a lot of problems in this world. The most important is ambrosia.

If you want my children to trust you, you must earn their trust. Help them. Rhubarb, Waterlily, and I will give you quests every day. You will receive special valuable items for these quests. We use these items for trade. Talk to traders in our world, they will offer some goods that don't exist in your world.

But you need to make the right choice. The Expedition is also willing to pay for your services.

You can make up your mind and change sides.

name.en: I need to discuss it with Catherina

text.en: Fine.

Do something to help our cause if you want the Expedition to trust you, even though you're friends with the locals. Ivan Chelezny, Felix, and I will give you quests every day. You will receive special valuables for these quests. You can use these items for trade in this world. Talk to traders on the Expedition base, they will offer some goods that only Expedition members can have.

But you need to make the right choice. The Children are also willing to pay for your services.

You can make up your mind and change sides.
What did you decide?

I am just a glimmer of my true essence, the avatar that is imprisoned. What you hear now is the echo of my words.

But I'm glad you decided to give your heart to Eden. Help my Children. They're in dire need, for our world has never had to face the likes of the Expedition.

I am just a glimmer of my true essence, the avatar that is imprisoned. What you hear now is the echo of my words.

I knew that you'd choose your own world. But I hope I managed to explain some things to you. Your Expedition also needs your support, for the threat of Nihaz has been hanging over you for too long.
I'm glad you decided to give your heart to Eden. Help my Children. They're in dire need, for our world has never had to face the likes of the Expedition.
I knew that you'd choose your own world. But I hope I managed to explain some things to you. Your Expedition also needs your support, for the threat of Nihaz has been hanging over you for too long.

name.en: I want to be a friend of the Children

text.en:
It's never too late to change sides. Eden needs your help. But you won't be able to change your mind again any time soon.

Is the Hero of Sarnaut sure of their choice?

[Your reputation with the Expedition will be reset to Neutral!]
Good. The Children need your help. The Darkness is coming to our Forest.
You cannot change sides. You've chosen one just recently. One that changes their mind too often cannot be trusted.
Now is not the time to switch sides, Child of Sarn! Finish your adventures on Eden and maybe we can discuss this issue again.
There is a battle going on now,  We'll talk when it's over.

name.en: I want to serve the Expedition again

text.en: You cannot change sides. You've chosen one just recently. You've sworn loyalty to the other party just recently.

I'm glad you couldn't forget us. The Expedition needs your help. But you won't be able to change your mind again any time soon.

Is the Hero of Sarnaut sure of their choice?

[Your reputation with the Children will be reset to Neutral!]
Good. The Expedition will need your help. We are suffering heavy losses in this war, so every soldier counts.
Now is not the time to switch sides. The war is in full swing and you need to complete your adventures on Eden before we can return to this discussion!
There is a battle going on now,  We'll talk when it's over.
I will not speak with a traitor to Sarnaut.

Well, it's unfortunate, but I can understand your motives.

Is that right?

name.en: Yes. I will defend Eden together with the Children.

text.en:
It's a pity. I saw great potential in you, and you give up your future to protect some natives from another world. Everyone in Sarnaut will know about your decision!

And even if you change your mind, coming back will not be easy!

name.en: Expedition. I will do anything for my home world.

text.en:
This is good news, but I want to make sure you don't falter at the crucial moment.

Is that right?

name.en: Yes. I will defend Sarnaut with the Expedition.

text.en:
Great, I knew you could be counted on. Some natives from another world are less important than saving all of Sarnaut! I will try to let everyone in Sarnaut know about your feat.

Once everything is decided, remember that even if you change your mind, the Children are unlikely to welcome you back with open arms!
There's no time, ! Decide now!
The Expedition is counting on you. We have a lot of problems in this world. The most important is the Ambrosia.

name.en: I could persuade the All-Mother... Maybe

text.en: That's how we wanted it to go when we sent you with Waterlily. But as you can see, you didn't get anywhere. Perhaps you managed to find allies among the Children who can act as an intermediary? What about this Waterlily?

name.en: The All-Mother is stubborn and proud. She will not give up her plans

text.en: I already got that. Although when I sent you to negotiate with them, I thought we could find some common ground. As for Waterlily, she didn't seem to be as antagonistic. Perhaps it will be possible to establish communications through her?

name.en: Do we have a chance to settle the matter peacefully?

text.en:
I don't see any room for compromise yet. We desperately need the Ambrosia, and the Children are zealously guarding their trees...

And if I understand the ideas of this All-Mother correctly, she does not want the worlds created by her to follow the path of technological development.

name.en: Waterlily trusts me, so there is a chance.

text.en: Then you should do everything to win her over to our side. But as far as I remember, Skulnar the Fierce and Eurial went with you. For some reason I don't see them with you - where are they now?

name.en: Waterlily is completely devoted to the All-Mother

text.en: This proves that the Children are fanatical. They believe in their goddess. Fortunately, we have experience in fighting gods and those who believe in them. However, I have a question. Skulnar the Fierce and Eurial were with you. Where are they now?

name.en: Skulnar the Fierce and Eurial sympathize with the Children

text.en:
Is that so?

I always suspected that Zayan’s apprentices couldn't be trusted. While we needed Skulnar as a navigator on the Star Trail, the viper had no place here.

Fortunately, we can do without them now. The path is clear, the Gates can create a passage from Sarnaut to Eden without any help. And if we need to get into another world, we will find someone else for the job.

The only thing I don't understand is... Which side are you on?

name.en: Skulnar and Eurial have betrayed the Expedition!

text.en:
I knew it!

Zayan’s apprentices can't trusted, and neither can Klavdia. All these Orders of Creation and Balance are nothing but trouble. When Felix and I return to Sarnaut, we will deal with them all.

And Felix has already warned me that Skulnar the Fierce is very dangerous. Over time, he and his orcs will become a real threat to the Empire which is currently our ally. And as they say, the enemy of my enemy... is my enemy!

And Eurial is the daughter of Elleken, the Great Mage who has been wanted by the Conclave for crimes for over a millennium. She is his supporter and accomplice.

Fortunately, we can do without them now. The path is clear, the Gates can create a passage from Sarnaut to Eden without any help. And if we need to get into another world, we will find someone else for the job.

The only thing I don't understand is... Which side are you on?

name.en: So I have to make a choice...

text.en:
Yes, you are the only one who hasn't decided yet. You need to make a choice.

If these Children and their goddess are so dear to you, you can go to them. I'm only letting you do this because I remember your past exploits. But the next time we meet, we'll be enemies. And if you are willing to defend our world, then I will be glad to see you in our ranks.

Whose side are you on? Decide! It's now or never!

name.en: Announce that you are joining the Children

text.en:
You learned my lessons, so I didn't doubt your decision. I see this Expedition does not represent everyone who lives in your world. You, Eurial, and Skulnar can stay in my domain.

However, I see the threat coming from Catherina and Felix. They can't win, but they can do enough damage.

You will have to banish them, just as you banished Hirkalla. Help my Children, and they will give you everything my world has to offer.

name.en: May I hope that you will help us in the fight against Nihaz?

text.en: Yes, Child of Sarn. Once we are victorious, I will go with you to your world. If my lost daughter is crying out for help, how can I refuse?

name.en: What do I need to do for us to win?

text.en: I do not know much about military affairs, but my Children have been steadily improving in recent months, preparing to repel the onslaught of the enemy. They defeated the Old Tribe with your help, now this knowledge will be used to fight the Expedition. Rhubarb will tell you the rest.
Here is the thing. Catherina sent a message telling everyone to come back. I think you understand what that means.

name.en: Is the Expedition planning an offensive?

text.en:
Sort of. The scouts report that the Mechanoids are heading for the Valley.

Which means there will be another fight here soon, nuts and bolts flying every which way.

However, if Felix thinks everything will be simple, he'll be disappointed. The Children are also decent warriors, and they are getting stronger every day.

name.en: Felix and Ivan decided not to wait after all.

text.en:
Yep. They didn't want to wait until we're finished here. Though I doubt they actually expected us to do anything. We were probably sent here like lambs to be slaughtered, with the expectation that the All-Mother would condemn us and this would be his... what was it... casus belli, yes.

But this Xadaganian is fooling himself if he thinks this fight will be a cakewalk. The Children are already good warriors, they trained while we were just sitting here.

Yeah, sort of. The peacekeeping mission turned into simple recon, heh. The Committee loved doing that back in the day. Well, we've seen a lot...

But I'll tell you what - this battle won't be easy. There are considerable forces on the side of the Children, and they are, in fact, not bad warriors. If Felix sticks his head in here, there will be losses.

name.en: What are you planning to do?

text.en:
Me? Well, it wasn't Catherina who sent us to this world, but Klavdia, so I will try to do what she asked us to do. Try to persuade the mother to help against Nihaz, that is.

And what the Expedition is doing there doesn't really matter to me. Life, you know, taught me to stay away from all these Xadaganian mechanical things. I think you understand me.

The most important question is what you're planning to do, heh.

name.en: Will you side with the Children?

text.en:
In a situation like this, I'm on my side first and foremost, heh. I'd rather keep my head.

But look, Klavdia sent us here, right? She knew Catherina and Felix would start something, so she told us to find the All-Mother and ask for help. The war with the Children will not help our mission in any way - rather the opposite, heh.

 In short, our goal is to save Sarnaut, not the Expedition.  You do as you wish, and I will stay here.

name.en: We need to help the Expedition!

text.en:
You think so? But I'm not sure. Look, Klavdia sent us here, right? What did she tell us?

Help Catherina and Co.? Or make arrangements with the All-Mother?

The latter. And if we start fighting with the Children now, what will happen? Will we reach agreement? Or we'll get beans? And what about Nihaz, then? He'll just come and destroy everything?

In short, you do as you wish, but I prefer to stay away from this Felix. I'll sit here, heh.
Wow, looks like we're in a bind.
Apparently our friends at the camp did not wait for the end of your training. Now we have to decide what we're going to do.

name.en: We'll have to pick a side.

text.en:
That's right. The Children or the Expedition.

On the one hand, representatives of our home world who came here for the Ambrosia. A power that has the potential to make us gods.

And then there are the Children, the inhabitants of this world who shouldn't have to suffer because we need this resource. And a powerful goddess who seems to be able to help us.

The choice is not easy.

What do I do? I know better than anyone in Sarnaut what it's like to follow the path that Nihaz mapped out for you. And you know, I don't think that's right at all.

It's great to be powerful - but at what cost? Elleken committed unthinkable atrocities for his own purposes. Tep doomed his people. Ath-Zak was a hero who rejected the temptations of Nihaz. So what do I want to be? A hero or a villain?

Yes, I noticed that you are learning the lessons of the All-Mother. And Skulnar is also leaning towards the Children. But what should I do? You see, my father would of course have chosen to side with the Expedition, but right now I'm not so sure that I want to be on the same side.

I know better than anyone in Sarnaut what it's like to follow the path that Nihaz mapped out for you. And you know, I don't think that's right at all.

It's great to be powerful - but at what cost? Elleken committed unthinkable atrocities for his own purposes. Tep doomed his people. Ath-Zak was a hero who rejected the temptations of Nihaz. So what do I want to be? A hero or a villain?

Yes, I saw you running errands for them. But it looks like Skulnar is leaning towards the Children. But what should I do? You see, my father would of course have chosen to side with the Expedition, but right now I'm not so sure that I want to be on the same side.

I know better than anyone in Sarnaut what it's like to follow the path that Nihaz mapped out for you. And you know, I don't think that's right at all.

It's great to be powerful - but at what cost? Elleken committed unthinkable atrocities for his own purposes. Tep doomed his people. Ath-Zak was a hero who rejected the temptations of Nihaz. So what do I want to be? A hero or a villain?

Obviously, we must help the Children defend their world. I think it would be right.

But if you want to help the Expedition, I won't judge you for that choice. Though I'll be sorry if our ways part.

I don't think the All-Mother is right about everything, but I'm not sure Catherina and Felix should be followed either.

name.en: I think you are making the right choice!

text.en:
I'm glad you agree with me. So we'll be on the same side. Sarnaut's interests are not focused on ravaging other worlds. Verbena told me that Nihaz had plundered many worlds, stealing their power. We must choose another way.

We will help the Children defend their home and drive back the invaders who do not represent all of Sarnaut.

It's a pity you don't agree with me. So we'll be fighting on different sides. But Sarnaut's interests are not focused on ravaging other worlds. Verbena told me that Nihaz had plundered many worlds, stealing their power. We must choose another way.

Yes, the members of the Expedition are our compatriots. Not all of them, though. I think it's more important to protect this world which could be our ally!

name.en: Tell them what you have managed to learn in Eden

text.en:
Oh, Catherina. She has always been ambitious. I thought Sarn's story would be a lesson for her, but alas.

To challenge a goddess whose powers we don't even know? Start a war in a foreign world without thinking about the consequences?

Catherina, Felix, and this Ivan must be stopped.

I don't know how, and I don't want to be the one whose words lead to sacrifice. However, I think these Children have every right to defend themselves. After all, this is their world, they are the masters there, and we are the guests.

Try to find Expedition members who are on your side.

name.en: Tell them what you have managed to learn in Eden

text.en:
It saddens me to hear that innocent people suffer from the actions of those who live in the same world as I do.

The inhabitants of Eden do not deserve to be threatened with weapons and have their resources stolen. After all, they didn’t do us any harm, they didn’t even know we existed until recently.

I think you should help these... Children.

Although it is difficult to stand against your own people, sometimes it's necessary. We were wrong when Citovras and I went after Kyros and almost caused the destruction of the Gift that allows you to rise from the dead.

We were bound by an oath, but now I think perhaps we should have spoken to Kyros and tried to dissuade him.

name.en: Tell them what you have managed to learn in Eden

text.en:
Neither Klavdia nor Catherina consulted me when they started building these Gates-3. Now you are reaping the fruits of your own recklessness. The Observatory's gaze is directed into the future, and I can say that the likelihood of the Darkness coming to our world has not decreased, but increased.

Nihaz and his followers are cunning - they will find a way to turn everything you do to their advantage.

Luckily for you, I have taken steps of my own to repel a future onslaught on Sarnaut.

I don't see any steps you could take to remedy the situation right now. Catherina and Klavdia put us at a disadvantage in the negotiations - we set these Children against ourselves while being forced to ask the All-Mother for something.

I think we need to wait for the resolution of this conflict. And what role you will play in it depends only on you.

I'll give you one piece of advice - beware of Hirkalla. This "daughter" of Nihaz is extremely dangerous. Perhaps in some ways even more dangerous than her "father".
Stormbringer... I haven't seen you in a while.

name.en: Tell them what you have managed to learn in Eden

text.en:
You bring some very interesting news...

Well, I assumed there were many interesting things outside of our world...

And now, our task - of the Elves and the House de Delice, is to become ambassadors to these many worlds... I think we'll find a reasonable approach.

As for Catherina and these Children... I'm wary of giving you advice.

We need to find a solution that would satisfy both parties.

But remember this - you and I are residents of Sarnaut and must act in our own interests first and foremost.

Finding a compromise on our terms is your task.

name.en: Tell them what you have managed to learn in Eden

text.en:
Oh, I knew Catherina would do something like this. Cutting down the Great Trees... How absurd.

No, this cannot be allowed to happen... We need to stop her... How? I'm afraid I'm not ready to advise you. I believe there will be those who can help you.

We need to find those who will agree to side with the All-Mother and protect the Great Trees.

Despite the fact that the Expedition members were handpicked by Felix and Catherina, there have to be those who are not comfortable with what's happening. Pay attention to the Gibberlings - they know what the Great Tree means to us. Perhaps the Pridens will also remember Howlem and what saved it?

Surely there are Kanians who do not trust Catherina.. And while I do not believe it myself, maybe the orc shamans will be on our side?

Extreme fertility!

Look at this - just plant a seed here, turn your back for a couple of seconds - and the sprout is already reaching for the sky. I can imagine how greedily it absorbs nutrients from the soil...

We need Ammer soil in the New Land!

name.en: Tell them what you have managed to learn in Eden

text.en:
Oh, wow. Let me think.

Of course, I don't like it. Machines, technology... It's all nonsense. The strength of the Orcs lies elsewhere, even though we can utilize whatever Xadagan produces.

So this Felix wants to take the power of the Ambrosia for himself?

That's not going to happen!

What do we do...

Are these Children warriors? Perhaps shamans? Hmm, you say they're doing alright...

Well, try to organize resistance. The Empire has brought a horde of machines there, but these natives can still put up a fight.

name.en: Tell them what you have managed to learn in Eden

text.en:
Yes, this is extremely interesting.

As a Historian, I am in awe of your discoveries. But as a person who has a certain experience, I am horrified by what you have done...

I guess neither Catherina nor this goddess will listen to my advice.

However, if you are interested in my opinion, then I would suggest finding a compromise. What kind? That's for you to find out. You know, I've known you for a long time, and I believe that while you've made some mistakes, you have plenty of experience. You will find a solution.

This Expedition was originally a gamble, and we have yet to deal with the consequences.

name.en: Tell them what you have managed to learn in Eden

text.en:
I see. Another world, a world where the Sparks go... Interesting.

After learning about Nihaz and Sarn, I assumed that sooner or later we would meet other gods who are just as cruel and indifferent to the interests of mortals.

But it turns out that everything that exists is the result of some goddess's actions... The goddess who wants to continue the eternal cycle of Life and Death.

I need to think about this.

What advice can I give you?

Our entire history, the history of the Zem people, is a search for victory over death.

Therefore, from the point of view of this... All-Mother, we are quite the heretics.

And while Catherina's and Felix's attempts to lay claim to resources in a foreign world might seem wrong, I'm afraid we have no other choice. We need technology based on the Ambrosia - with it, we'll be able to impose our will on the gods.

name.en: Tell them what you have managed to learn in Eden

text.en: [Ollum looks distressed and disappointed]

[Ollum looks worried]

Waves of emotions emanate from the demon. Eventually you figure out what he is trying to convey.

The demons would like to find a new world, but neither Catherina nor the All-Mother are good options for them.

The ambitious sorceress wouldn't want to let the demons out of Sarnaut while the ancient goddess's thinking rejects the idea of demons altogether.]

name.en: Tell them what you have managed to learn in Eden

text.en:
[A shadow of recognition passes over the Sculptor's face]

The All-Mother. The Goddess of Creation. The beginning of Order and Chaos.

Yes. I remember. As a result of our meeting, I was separated from the Architect's mind.

Shades of chaos are innumerable.

It does not matter who wins - the Expedition or the All-Mother.

To defeat the Darkness, you need powers that can be found in your world as well.

name.en: Tell them what you have managed to learn in Eden

text.en:
Interesting! It’s a bit of a pity that I didn’t get to take part in this Expedition… But they don't trust me since I'm an orc, heh.

Felix was put in charge, and only the most reliable orcs were selected.

Therefore, I wish you success. But as a veteran, I will watch from the sidelines.

What advice do you want from me?

We are the residents of Sarnaut, which means we must act in the interests of our world, and not some other.

Moreover, we don't need those who want to impose their will. We will impose our own order! The time of Trees and shamans has long passed...

What?! This girl thinks too much of herself, hah.

If I see her, I'll thrash her with a belt. Right there in the square. I'll show her a damn rebellion...

name.en: Would you like me to give a message to Fury?

text.en:
Oh, my daughter. Yes, the trouble is, while the father was shedding blood on the frontline, the troublemaker grew up as bold as brass.

In short, tell her I'm going to thrash her with a belt when I see her. Right there in the square. I'll show her a damn rebellion...
What do you want?

name.en: Tell them what you have managed to learn in Eden

text.en:
Haha, foolish mortals. This elf deceived you... But that's your problem, so deal with it yourself.

When the dragons wanted to leave this world, we would never have gone to this world of Life.

We heard rumors about the activities of this goddess, and Sheratan once saw how she briefly approached Sarnaut, crushing the Child of Order.

She is not needed here.

Get out of the World of Life as quickly as possible. You won't find anything there that will benefit you.

All these promises are just lies.

If you are looking for the Great Trees, then it's better to look for them in Sarnaut.

It's you again, two-legged creature...

Fate brings us together more often than I'd like.

name.en: Tell them what you have managed to learn in Eden

text.en:
Fate prevails over everyone, even gods and demiurges. The All-Mother is also subject to its unstoppable power. Who knows what's in store?

If you were destined to go to Eden, it was inevitable.

If we had the weaver's looms since the time of Old Isa, we would know what threatens us. But a lot of knowledge is lost, and it's hard to imagine the future.

You and I saw the future where Nihaz took over. Horizon or New Isa - it didn't matter. The darkness won. I know what Alice told you - the guest from the future whose Thread was broken. This is another version.

Your destiny is to be a Weaver, therefore your choice will be decisive.
So, what do you have to say?

name.en: Tell them what you have managed to learn in Eden

text.en:
Ugh, I don't even know what to tell you...

Alright, let's stay calm...

NO! WHAT IN THE WORLD ARE YOU DOING?!

YOU HAD A SIMPLE TASK - TO FIND MY MOTHER AND SECURE HELP!!

WHAT IS CATHERINA DOING?

Go back to Eden immediately and order them to stop stealing the Ambrosia... from these... natives.

Yes, I understand that my mother can be difficult, but all you need to do is arrange for her to come here. I'll figure the rest out myself.

Catherina went off her rocker, apparently. Power drove her crazy. But that can be fixed - we already gave her a thrashing once.

What else do we have?

An ambitious imperial general? A greedy Free Trader?

Small fry.

I think you can easily deal with this whole rabble. So your task is to help the All-Mother get rid of especially impudent invaders, and then ask her to come to Sarnaut.

name.en: Tell them what you have managed to learn in Eden

text.en:
That's some bullshit, to be honest. Talking trees, gods, planets... If I didn't know you, I'd think that someone with a massive hangover was telling me their dream.

And Skulnar stayed there, you say?

Well, I wouldn't advise you to believe the Xadaganians. This Felix is a piece of work, I've heard all about him. In fact, he is aiming for Yasker's position, and this... Ex-pe-di-tion... is a good way to win authority. And together with Catherina, they might even try and crush the League.

If what you say about talking logs is true, then they are pretty good guys. Not as good as the Orcs, of course, but still decent warriors!

I take it Skulnar is on their side? Then we need to help them! And punching Xadaganians is a good cause all around.

The old goat is still alive? Can he even raise the belt?

It's the same thing every time. He should retire already. It's rightly said that if an orc lived to twenty five, he's not an orc but a piece of shit! And he's almost forty. Senility is around the corner!

Guess I'm going to punch him in the face the next time I see him. I owe him a few grudges.

name.en: Do you want to me to tell Crazystorm anything?

text.en:
The old man? Oh, I'll do it myself. I've been thinking of visiting my ancestral home, so to speak. It's the same thing every time. He should retire already. It's rightly said that if an orc lived to twenty five, he's not an orc but a piece of shit! And he's almost forty. Senility is around the corner!

Tell him I haven’t punched him in a while, and I'm itching to kick his ass. Gotta be a sign that I'll see him soon.

name.en: Tell them what you have managed to learn in Eden

text.en:
Well, I've always known that Klavdia can't be trusted. She constantly gets us into various adventures.

Fortunately, Catherina is smart enough to get out of these situation in a way that benefits our world.

Catherina should be fully supported in her activities. The Ambrosia has already proved its effectiveness in the field of mana engineering, and we need a constant influx of it, which means Eden is a key point for our interests.

I think Felix is a fairly experienced warrior who knows what he's doing, but their forces might be unequal. We have a small expeditionary force on our side, and theirs are the resources of their world and the goddess who created it.

 I believe you can handle this mission and provide our world with the Ambrosia.
This flower of the Great Tree contains All-Mother's memories.
This flower of the Great Tree contains All-Mother's memories.

This flower of the Great Tree contains All-Mother's memories.

But you are not ready to see them yet.
This flower of the Great Tree contains All-Mother's memories.
This flower of the Great Tree contains All-Mother's memories.
This flower of the Great Tree contains All-Mother's memories.
This flower of the Great Tree contains All-Mother's memories.
This flower of the Great Tree contains All-Mother's memories.
This flower of the Great Tree contains All-Mother's memories.
This flower of the Great Tree contains All-Mother's memories.
This flower of the Great Tree contains All-Mother's memories.

Hinanna strove to be equal to her elder sister. She strove to outperform her. At that time Hirkalla already possessed the power of Darkness and ruled the Death world. Jealous of her sister's might, Hinanna wanted to seize what she posessed.

She gathered secret forces, wore her best clothes and jewelry, and embarked on the journey. She approached the colossal gates of the underground world, awoke the guardian by a loud banging, and fiercely demanded that he let her in.

One cannot enter the Death world and disobey the laws. Hinanna had to give all her clothes and jewels along with all her powers to pass the gates of Ganzir. And she fell under the power of the Death world, ruled by her sister. The young goddess never expected this. She became dead while being alive, and condemned herself to a worse fate.

I knew not what became of Sarn. I knew not of the fate of the younger daughter. Although I felt sorry for the gullible Hinanna that fell victim to her own stupidity, there was a much worse threat hanging over our worlds. The Architect came from far-away world. The heartless Order, where mind and will were one. Nihaz and I had to fight the invader.

I came out of my shelter every once in a while. Having destroyed an emissary of the new enemy, I felt that my lost daughter and a forgotten friend were once again close. When the ship of the missionary of the Order was torn to pieces by my Great Trees, he fell like a ball of fire upon the lifeless world. I gazed upon the empty ground and saw only vile dragons, loyal to Nihaz. I realized that they would summon their King, and left this world. I returned to Eden but never gave up my attempts at finding my lost daughter.

What is mortal's eternity to me? Only an instant. It's been five thousand years. My heart is still yearning.

All that has been created will perish.

All that has perished will be recreated.

The existence is a great circle. There is no creation without destruction. There is no destruction without creation.

The circle has no beginning or end.

The divine couple has always existed. All-Mother and Father Time. I, All-Mother, is the goddess of life and creation. Father Time is the god of death and destruction. Together we led our worlds through the cycles of births and deaths. We created and destroyed.

We were not alone. Our passion gave birth to our divine children, subject to us. Each of them played their own role. Each of them obeyed the common laws. There were twelve Domains in my hierarchy. Each Domain was responsible for a single power. Each Domain had a master.

Only I, All-Mother, the goddess of creation, and my divine husband, Father Time, the god of destruction, were eternal Lords of our Domains. Other gods were immortal and lived very long lives, which ultimately had to be over. The circle has always spun, and gods were destined to die.

Many years have passed.

Each world was once created. At the moment of creation its death was predefined. Father Time knows no pity. He watches the sand of time in his hourglass.

There's a point in the circle that is called Judgment Time. Ancient prophecies come true. The war is raging in multiple worlds. The Twilight of the Gods is impending. This is the time when the figures on the board change. The wheel turns. Those who was on top will fall. Those who were beneath will rise.

This is the fate of the world, predetermined by me, All-Mother, and by Father Time. Evil against Good. Evil rises over Good for just an instant but its fate is predetermined as well. It will fall. The Good will win, there is no other way. The sacrifice is great but day comes after night. This is the law that we established.

This is what happened last time. The ancient God of Darkness, now known as the Forgotten, has risen in all of his power. The worlds, possessed by legions of the Darkness, are burning. But the God of Light Sarn has also risen. He headed the resistance against the Darkness and destroyed the Forgotten once and for all. This was predetermined. Everything that's happened is just as we planned.

The new day has come. The circle is spinning once again.

Many gods fell in the war with the Forgotten. Many worlds were destroyed. The survivors gathered in Eidos, where the primal images of creation are stored. Everything that had to be created originally existed in Eidos.

I set to work, willing to create new worlds instead of what was destroyed. I created the twelve inner worlds first, in accordance with the number of Domains. Each of them should have been led by one of the survivors or newly born gods.

Sarn was one of the survivors, the greatest hero of the past war. He rightfully took the place of the God of Light.

Father Time and I chose two young goddesses among the new gods: Hirkalla and Hinanna. They were supposed to lead the Domains of Life and Death.

Only the Domain of the Forgotten, the Domain of Darkness remained unowned. None of the surviving gods wanted to take his place.

Millions of years passed since the victory over Forgotten. The new god of the Domain of Darkness appeared. Hinanna, the younger sister, brought him to the door of Eidos. We accepted him and allowed him to take the vacant place. Each of the gods was supposed to played a role. The God of Darkness was accepted in our domain.

Hinanna's decision did not surprise me. She was a beautiful young goddess, stubborn, moody, gullible, and impulsive. She traveled across the worlds a lot, found her chosen ones among gods and mortals, toyed with their lives.

At some point, the mysterious God of Darkness attracted her attention. No one knew where he had come from. Some thought that he was mortal, who managed to become a god. This was extremely rare back then.

Hinanna showed him the way to Eidos, even though her sister Hirkalla pointed out that his intentions weren't pure. She thought that he was weird and scary so she decided to keep an eye on him.

Hinanna was happy to see new faces. She and Nihaz, the God of Darkness, traveled between worlds, watched the fates of mortals, learned their secrets, discovered ancient artifacts of eons.

The power of the new God of Darkness grew by the year. Ancient monsters, who still remembered the Forgotten, accepted him. None of us had any objections. The Darkness was the natural opposite of the Light, and the Domain required a master. At that time Father Time and I considered him an ordinary "Master of Darkness," one of many. As other gods, he was supposed to start a war and fight the Light, and finally perish, like the Forgotten before him. This is what we thought, and never worried.

Only Hirkalla sensed that the circle has changed its spin. We considered her too young to rule the Domain of Death. She oversaw the Guardians of Ganzir, who ruled the post-mortal fates of all living in our worlds. Thanks to this, she saw that Nihaz was helping, teaching, and protecting mortals as best he could in his travels with Hinanna. She realized that their faith in him gave him even more power.

In doubt, Hirkalla decided to have a straight talk. She gathered herself, and went to the throne of Darkness to dispel her fears. At that time, Hinanna took interest in another mortal, and the God of Darkness was left alone.

They had a long conversations. Hirkalla gave him her doubts, and Nihaz answered them. Few people knew what they were talking about but Hinanna returned from her journey and witnessed the end of the talk.

The younger sister learned that Nihaz wanted to overthrow me, All-Mother, and Father Time. He didn't think much of our concept of the world. He mocked the idea of the circle and the renewal of worlds. Nihaz believed that the gods should make mortals our equals, teach them the laws of creation and eternal life.

Hinanna rushed to our divine throne straight away to warn us of the betrayal. I got furious and ordered to bring Hirkalla before my eyes.

She was brought to the trial, and accused of being insubordinate. She silently took her sentence and was off to the exile. Since that day, Nihaz was persona non grata in Eidos. Unfortunately, by that time many of the gods were on his side. The creators that didn't want the destruction of their worlds listened to him. This rebel was loved not only by those who belonged to the Darkness but also Chaos and Death. Even gods of elements joined his riot.

I didn't expect him to turn to mortals, helping them fight monsters and improving their lives. His name was praised for giving knowledge and teaching crafts. Nihaz's gifts were poisonous but he gave them generously to his followers. Mortals, who sought immortality and divinity, raised a riot.

Anxiously we have watched from our thrones the growing numbers of Nihaz's army. There was still time until another cycle of destruction and rebirth, but this war couldn't wait. It came to us.

Hirkalla, our beloved daughter, then joined Nihaz. With all her heart, she accepted his teaching about the freedom of choice, the breaking of the great circle, and giving the mortals freedom to become gods.

Our worlds were thrown in a long war. Nihaz and the other gods fought against me and Father Time. Sarn, the God of Light, was one of his main enemies at this war.

Nihaz's efforts have given fruit. Gods died one after another. The most terrible thing happened when Nihaz and the others dealt the fatal blow to Father Time. They got him near the World of Destruction, where he engaged in a battle with the Darkness. Only God can kill a God. Nihaz inflicted a fatal blow to Father Time, already wounded, and took away his power. Since then, he became more than the God of Darkness, but hasn't reached what he was looking for.

We were wondering what he really wanted. Sarn suggested that his true goal was to raise his own power. He destroyed many gods, including his former allies, Gods of Death and Chaos, and took their power.

Worried by what happened to my husband, I avoided any battles. Eden, the world of Life, became my shelter. The story was simple. I knew that my daughter Hinanna would gain enough experience and wisdom, so eventually she was to become the owner of the divine garden. The Garden of Eden was hidden from Nihaz. Everyone was safe. The war was continued by Sarn, Nihaz's complete opposite. He successfully destroyed legions of darkness, marching through our worlds.

But even a great warrior can fall prey to betrayal. There was a traitor in our ranks. To my surprise, it was Hinanna. Jealous of her sister and her glory with Nihaz, she decided to switch to the stronger side. Hinanna lured Sarn into a trap. After fighting Nihaz, the God of Light was captured.
Darkness clouds my eyes...
No one dares to give me orders!
No, wait, wait! Don't leave me here...

name.en: Perhaps you are the one the Sage spoke of?

text.en:
No... The Darkness took him... I stayed here...

She beckons with promises, but I no longer believe in such things.

It doesn't matter, I was once the ruler of a kingdom far away from here...

After death, I... got lost... But death is only the beginning of the journey. In the end, I was carried away to the Star Trail...

Where I met it. Darkness.

It's very interested in people like me... It wants to raise an army. Go to war against the gods of Light and Order. Sweep them off their thrones.

I don't want to be part of someone else's plans...

Moreover, it's more interested in... you.

name.en: Me? Right... I won't serve it.

text.en:
We all thought so at the beginning of our journey. The light gave me strength, but my path... led me into darkness.

The same fate awaits you!
You'll see.
Sarn promised me unlimited power! Where is it? I surrendered my garrison, and what did I get in return?!

name.en: Do you have something for me?

text.en: Just a little darkness...

name.en: I can't find the ghost named Artem Furazhkin

text.en: Keep looking! They are around here somewhere!
Kania is rightfully mine! Valirs have ruled these lands for generations, and they will reclaim their power! Sister... if you could return from the world of the dead, so can I!

name.en: Do you have something for me?

text.en: Just a little darkness...
I did not believe tales of treasures and miracles. I thought they were in great trouble, so I hurried to help. I did not stop to think how I would return home...

name.en: Do you have something for me?

text.en: Just a little darkness...
Where are my knights? Where are my warriors?! There were thirty three of them...

name.en: Do you have something for me?

text.en: Just a little darkness...
I didn't want this, Father! Will you ever forgive me? Damn Wanderer! He fooled us all!

name.en: Do you have something for me?

text.en: Just a little darkness...
Not everyone can fool death. I did it... Twice... And now? Now everyone can do that?!

name.en: Do you have something for me?

text.en: Just a little darkness...
Ugh... Ugh... Wait, what? I'm a reasonable creature that understands the nuances of thanatology... Is there life after death? Yes or no?!

name.en: Do you have something for me?

text.en: Just a little darkness...
Valir and Kania! They are bound together... For thousands of years, my family has ruled over our Empire. And they will continue to do so...

name.en: Do you have something for me?

text.en: Just a little darkness...
Damned yokels! What do you even know?! I would have accomplished so much more, were it not for the cursed patriarchy!!

name.en: Do you have something for me?

text.en: Just a little darkness...
Oh, it’s you again! Well? Have you found the treasure? Yes... Go three steps to the south, five to the east... A treasure! A treasure full of June coins! No one will leave here alive, you hear me?!

name.en: Do you have something for me?

text.en: Just a little darkness...

Fools! What have you done? The dead have been torn from their graves by the forces of darkness, their rest disrupted... From now on, there are no barriers for those who were outside the world of the living...

name.en: Do you have something for me?

text.en: Just a little darkness...
Did you find them all?

name.en: Yes! All ghosts have been found!

text.en: Great, now we can rest easy!
Did you find them all?

name.en: Yes! All ghosts have been found!

text.en: Great, now we can rest easy!
And again the trenches of Metalville, the whistle of shrapnel, and the rumble of artillery... Stand fast! We will not retreat from these ruins. The attack of the Reds will be repulsed!

name.en: Do you have something for me?

text.en: Just a little darkness...
Agrh! Cursed humans! It's the moon, it's just the moon... Its brilliance penetrates the darkness of the night, its call.... drives you crazy... Ooh!

name.en: Do you have something for me?

text.en: Just a little darkness...
These lands were ours. An ancient pact with darkness. Salvation was close, and we made a deal. It was... the right choice. The right...

name.en: Do you have something for me?

text.en: Just a little darkness...
Dig, you fools! This mountain is full of gold and meteorite, we will be rich! The Empire will never get through the rubble, you hear?!

name.en: Do you have something for me?

text.en: Just a little darkness...
Yes, yes, children... True wisdom is ever to be found in simplicity.

name.en: Do you have something for me?

text.en: Just a little darkness...
A harsh fate befell my native Yazes... But who could have known... Dina and I thought that by defeating Urd, we had prevented the worst, but the worst was yet to come...

name.en: Do you have something for me?

text.en: Just a little darkness...
Oh, Mary, where are you, my soul?! We were ruined by the envious villain, we will not find peace in this world or any other...

name.en: Do you have something for me?

text.en: Just a little darkness...
