It seems that these Threads are stretching straight from the crown of the Tree, and if you listen closely, you can discern a chorus of voices belonging to the owners of the Threads. We believe that this is a reflection of the Threads of everyone who has ever lived on Isa.

name.en: Tell me more about the Great Ash

text.en:
We do not know the exact history of the Ash, but we are convinced that it has a miraculous origin and serves as a bridge between worlds. From the darkness of centuries, a story is passed down - once our land was barren and empty - endless darkness dispersed only by fiery mountains among the icy deserts. And dragons reigned in this darkness. They were immortal and almost omnipotent.

But one day a ball of fire tore through the heavens. It fell on the earth and split it. And the dragons also fell, soaking that land with their blood. And he was born from that blood - Num, the creator of the living, and with him the First Spirits. But an island also rose from the melted waters, and the first of the Great Trees grew on the island. The Ash!

The Ash is a sentient being, our first ancestor. Our families of triplets are called "sprouts", like the sprouts of a tree, and our natural wanderlust is like the scattering of seeds the wind blows away from the parent tree.

Our beliefs were formed a long time ago, back in the days of the ancient Isa, and they have barely changed. They are based on belief in omens, signs.

Everything in the world is interconnected — everyone has their own Thread of the Path. And the Threads of the Path are intertwined, forming the Fabric of the World. Tracking the events taking place in the world, and signs of changes in the Pattern of Fate, one can predict the location of the threads in the next rows of the Fabric of the World.

Despite the uniqueness of each creature's Pattern of Fate, there are common elements of the Pattern that unambiguously indicate a specific scenario.

name.en: What else can you tell me?

text.en:
Since ancient times, in every large Gibberling village, there is a special house with a sacred loom in it. The Thread Keepers weave the great canvas on it - the Fabric of the World, and thereby determine the Patterns of Fate and try to direct the Threads of the Gibberling Path in a way that will form the most favorable pattern for us.

Thus, each generation of Gibberlings has its own "chronicle" - an endless carpet in which the fates of the entire tribe are entwined.

It should also be said that nothing prevents a clan or even an individual sprout from having their own signs and interpretation of certain patterns. Sometimes they diverge wildly, and the community has to hold a meeting to interpret conflicting signs or contact us, the Thread Keepers.

The Gibberlings learn to interpret signs all their lives from an early age. In Skalgard, no one would step out of the house if they spilled salt at breakfast. And if they see signs that Luck favors them, they would take on a seemingly impossible quest. It is said that some Gibberlings are born with great luck, which helps them get out of hopeless situations.

Those blessed with the gift of foresight are rather popular with their clan. Not everyone is allowed to disturb the Thread Keepers with their everyday issues, so it's often the seers that do readings for smaller matters. If, of course, it's a real seer, and not an enterprising fraud!

The loom is a real miracle. At the dawn of time, Ase himself carved it from the wood of the Prophetic Ash, and Emla etched sigils onto it, imbuing the loom with the great power to influence fate.

The yarn that is used for the threads is of great importance. For the Carpet of Fate, wool yarn is used, because it is filled with more vitality compared to plant-based yarn. Hair yarn has even more power and can have a huge impact on the owner. A thin and smooth thread promises an easy fate, while a rough and prickly one means a path full of trials. The color of the yarn chosen for babies will predict their personality. A knot accidentally tied on a thread is a serious disaster, and an accidental breakage of the thread promises a tragic premature death! Even the direction of the twisting of the thread matters: clockwise - for reflecting reality and divination, counterclockwise - for changing the already established fate.

name.en: What else can you tell me about weaving?

text.en: Weaving of the Carpet of Fate is an unusual process. The Thread Keepers enter a prophetic trance. For weaving, we try to choose a particularly good time, when the border between the material and the mystical world becomes thinner, and the woven patterns acquire a truly fateful meaning. During such hours, simple spinners are forbidden to sew, weave and knit, so as not to accidentally create trouble for themselves, and even fishermen are strictly forbidden to make nets and tackle on their boats. If anyone disobeys, the item spun or woven at the time should be destroyed.

name.en: Can you tell me about your beliefs and traditions?

text.en: What do you want to know?

Who are you and what do you need from me? Your insolence is outrageous, young wanderer. I am busy - do you not see?

Wisdom lies in the contemplation of beauty as well.

name.en: I want to know about the northern runes!

text.en: Well, I must respect the guest's desire. What rune interests you?

name.en: Tell me about the runes of the First

text.en:
The runes of the First? I will tell you everything.

There were many First ones. It would be impossible to count them all. Some long forgotten. Or never known. But the rune names... I will tell you about those. The ravens were Turaax, a friend to the Pridens, then Huginn and Muninn, friends to the Gibberlings. Kutkh was very cunning. There were many other First ones, soaring into the sky. Orn was an eagle, Roc - a rook, Vali - a falcon, Makchirgue - an owl.

And just as many of the First walked the earth. There were wolves among them. Akkya was a wolf. Stjorn was a panther; Heldig and Ekhe-Hoor were bears; Sakhyl - a fox; Jorm, Nidhogg and Haad were serpents; Kottr - a cat; Jofur - a boar; Hafur - a goat; Rhein and Roich were deer; Hvalur was a whale, Ratatoskr - a squirrel…

name.en: Tell me about the runes of the heroes

text.en:
You wish to know about the runes of our heroes?

Among the Gibberlings, there were many heroes whose names the runes now bear. Ase and Emla are our ancestors. Wotin is a mighty leader, the father of Thorri, Lok, and Wald. Skaldr and Baldr are other heroes, skalds of ancient times; Freya and Iduna are the daughters of Emla; Wik, who built the first ships; Bers, who was a terrifying warrior; and even Seida who was a famous soothsayer. We remember and honor them all.

name.en: Where did the black Gibberlings come from? Like Seida?

text.en: The sprouts were strong and hard to break. But there was also a black sheep in the herd. The family was split: one went into exile - the one who used to be a Thread Keeper. But she survived and came back, but what was broken could not be restored. Her descendants are all black. Seida and Unn are one of them.

name.en: Tell me about the forbidden runes

text.en: There were runes that were rarely used. They were created in honor of the gods, monsters, and villains that people rarely mentioned. Among them was Kharyskhan, the leader of the Urun. Giants: Thrym, Aegir and Ymir; shifters: Garm, Hati, and Skoll. The werebear Bjorn; Alviss, the leader of the Zvergs; Ilco, the leader of the Heidruns; the guardian of the underground fire Surt; finally, Yol - the spirit of the year of change; Bolverk - the villain that betrayed the Gibberlings; Nagl - the dead wight; and Num himself, the creator of the living.

We have been to many places on Isa. Some of them are not even marked on the map.

There are interesting things there - creatures that no one has ever seen and various treasures. We collected a few things, but the headman said it's garbage. Still, someone would surely want to wear their great-grandfather's armor.

Maybe you'll buy it? We can sell it to you for Gibblers if you are interested.

There are almost no migratory birds left on Isa, except the seagulls circling over the Empty Sea. But there are still penguins out there. These birds do not fly, but swim well - almost like fish. They are funny to observe, so we breed them for entertainment. If you win the trust of Isa's Gibberlings, we can sell you one of them.

Squirrels have always been our friends, but ordinary squirrels on Isa are rather small. Our riding squirrels are quite a different matter, however. It's a special breed that lives on huge trees like our Great Ash. There are few of them left, and we cherish these creatures, so if you want to ride a squirrel, you must first win our trust. And have some of our coins, of course.

There are almost no migratory birds left on Isa, except the seagulls circling over the Empty Sea. But there are still penguins out there. These birds do not fly, but swim well - almost like fish. They are funny to observe, so we breed them for entertainment. If you win the trust of Isa's Gibberlings, we can sell you one of them.
Thank you so much! I heard... You help everyone...
Life is hard in our city... you'd do many things to get some bread...
Hiccup. I drink because I seek compassion... Not joy, but sorrow... I drink because I want to suffer!
Hiccup. I drink because I seek compassion... Not joy, but sorrow... I drink because I want to suffer!

name.en: What do you think about Luzhin's accusation?

text.en: Pyotr Luzhin is an honest and responsible man! A real lawyer! Don't listen to them - Mr. Luzhin never had that kind of money - 100 rubles! And he had no care for Raskolnikov's sister! He was going to marry me!
Good day! Amalia de Luner at your service. I am just a modest owner of apartments that I rent to all these unconscientious tenants!

name.en: What do you think about this situation with Luzhin and Marmeladova?

text.en: I know what happened – and despite the fact that we are friends with Pyotr Luzhin, I will tell you everything! This morning Luzhin went to the bank and withdrew 100 rubles. He divided them into two parts – 10 and 90. I saw it with my own eyes - he slipped these 90 to this unfortunate girl, Sonya!
I'm an old acquaintance and neighbor of Pyotr Luzhin! What he did is a complete disgrace!

name.en: What are you playing at? Tell me what happened...

text.en: I am outraged by your insinuations! Yes, I know Mr. Raskolnikov, but we have never quarreled! And I had no idea this floozy knew him! As for the rest, I'm not telling you anything. Try and prove it!

name.en: I'm ready to prove that you're lying!

text.en: Go ahead. You can't prove anything!

name.en: I'm ready to prove that you're lying!

text.en: Go ahead. You can't prove anything! You can't fool me!

name.en: You didn't propose to Raskolnikov's sister.

text.en: Hah, and what does that prove? That Amalia is telling the truth, and Raskolnikov is lying!
Well, let's see... Then it means Amalia is lying, and Raskolnikov is telling the truth! And then what?
Then it means I'm telling the truth, and Raskolnikov is lying! Well, how can you prove that I planted the money?

name.en: You had a fight with Raskolnikov.

text.en: Let us suppose that's true. Then I lied to you, and Raskolnikov was telling the truth! What about the money?

name.en: You didn't know that Raskolnikov and Sonya were friends.

text.en: And that means I told you the truth. And so did this floozy's mother, Ekaterina! And if I'm right, then who stole the money?

name.en: You knew Raskolnikov and Sonya were friends.

text.en: Then it means I lied to you, and Sonya's mother, Ekaterina, also lied or is confused about something... What are you getting at?
Then Ekaterina is right, but Sonya is lying! Lying without remorse! That's what I'm saying!
Then Sonya is telling the truth, but Ekaterina is lying... So? Let's say I did. What about the 90 rubles?
That would mean Amalia is right, but my treacherous friend Lebezin lied to you! I'm waiting for your conclusions.
Suppose I did. Then Lebezin was telling the truth, but Amalia lied to you! What, then? Can you draw the right conclusion?

name.en: You didn't slip the money to Sonya!

text.en: Hahaha! That's what I was telling you! She stole the money! So Lebezin and Sonya are lying to you!

name.en: You slipped the money to Sonya!

text.en: So you believe Lebezin and Sonya are telling the truth?
Die!

name.en: Did I make a mistake somewhere?

text.en: Ahaha! You seem to be confused! Come back once you figure out who is lying and who is telling the truth!

So you believe I'm lying but Sonya is telling the truth? If so, it means that I really did quarrel with Raskolnikov and knew that he was friends with Sonya, and so you believe I had a motive to take revenge on him... Which means Ekaterina is lying, and Raskolnikov is telling the truth. And so Amalia is also lying, and Lebezin is telling the truth, therefore he indeed saw that I planted the money! Yes, the evidence is clear! Bastards!!!
I'm Pyotr Luzhin, and I happen to live in this dreary place. I'm a lawyer.

Yes, alas, I know this scoundrel! The thing is, he's my sister's fiancé. But that's in the past now! When he showed up here, I knew right away who he was and told him everything I thought of him. He's been nursing a grudge ever since. He's probably trying to get back at me.
I'm a simple student. I live here and study at the university nearby.

name.en: What can you tell me about this situation?

text.en: I didn't steal money from him! Yes, he offered me 10 rubles to help us out, but I didn't take the other 90! I didn't even touch it. It must have been planted!
Oh, bother... Today has been one trouble after the other. Why did I take those 10 rubles?
Sonya didn't take his money, I'm telling you! She didn't even take 10 rubles! And she doesn't know this Raskolnikov!
Husband is a drunkard, stepdaughter is a hustler... I'm a poor woman with no means of support...
It's no use. It looks like he's dead already.
Semyon Marmeladov seems to be crushed under the carriage.

name.en: Yes, he got run over by the carriage... It was an accident!

text.en: It's the end of the world! Spiders! Spiders everywhere! Murderers!! Murderers!! The end is near... People!!
Die!
Murderers! Murderers! He stole from us and drank it all away! He ruined my life! And now he's dead! Murderers...
You can't help me... Sonya! Daughter! I'm sorry!
You father was run over by a carriage... So embarrassing...
Ekaterina saw it and... lost it... There she is, wandering the streets...
This is horrible! He's dead... Oh, Tensess. What a nightmare...

name.en: Tell me what you know about the murder...

text.en: Oh, I didn't see much... Just a silhouette... With a big axe...
Let me introduce myself. I'm Dmitry Razumihin, a simple student...

name.en: What do you know about the arson?

text.en: It wasn't just arson! It's the dawn of a rebellion! Glory to Alice!
Long live the revolution! Soon we will overthrow the dark goddess!

Alice? Verkhovensky?! Alarming news... I need to consider what to do next... I fear that my friend Rodion Raskolnikov might also be involved in this...

As for the murderer you're looking for, let Petrov check those who owed her... I can't think of anything else.

Arson, you say? I heard about it... We have a club here, and everyone is ready to riot, to overthrow the empress... A girl gave a speech recently... What was her name... Anita? Alina? Alice! Yes. So someone decided... to set fire...
Hmm... The right lung is comprised of three lobes... The superior lobe of the lungs has inferior borders extending posteriorly to the fourth rib for right and left lung...

name.en: What do you know about the arson?

text.en: Oh, it's not arson. Probably just a prank... But they say a lot of things will burn down soon - police stations, palaces, and even churches... That's what Verkhovensky said...

Man is governed exclusively by the calculation of his own advantage. What we call sublime emotion or ideal aspiration-all that, in the general course of life, is completely insignificant in comparison with each person's pursuit of his own advantage.

name.en: Have you heard anything about the arson?

text.en: I recently read some kind of appeal... Pyotr Verkhovensky calls for a rebellion against the authorities and suggests starting with arson...
Allow me to introduce myself: Mikhail Rubtsov, a student of this university... How do you do?
Ah! Yes, I've heard about it... Some students recently received these... what are they called... components... That can be assembled into... what's it called... an incendiary device!
It's a pity I don't have enemies. I would hug them, press them to my heart, and forgive them without thinking, from the bottom of my heart.

name.en: What do you know about the conspiracy?

text.en: Soon we will strike again! Praise the Awakened!
Conspiracy, you say? I heard about it... We have a club here, and everyone is ready to riot, to overthrow the empress... Without Alice this time!

name.en: What do you know about the conspiracy?

text.en: Is this a conspiracy? It must have been a prank... But I hear a revolution is coming. My opinion? It's nonsense. This is hardly a revolution.

name.en: Have you heard anything about the conspiracy?

text.en: I read something recently... Some Pyotr Verkhovensky is inciting people to rebel against the government.

name.en: What's going on at the university?

text.en: I heard something recently... Two students received these... what are they called... leaflets! And now they're scattered everywhere! Take a look for yourself. It's garbage, that's what!
Let us celebrate the emancipation of women!

Ahh! Damned obscurantists! They won't embrace gender equality! You hear "What should we do?" and "Who is to blame?", but I went and opened a sewing workshop and created a place for women where they could realize their full potential! And now I'm going to study medicine too!
You were all fooled... You believed it was easy to change the world...

It all started with the university... First Alice showed up and organized a club. She explained why her sister's rule was bad. Then this Verkhovensky came. He threatened everyone and bullied them into frankpledge, made them spy on each other...

Even those who initially had doubts were forced to take part in everything he planned... And those who refused mysteriously disappeared...
When I heard Iaver Bazar say we shouldn't recognize authorities, I felt so elated... as though I had seen the light!

name.en: How did you end up here?

text.en: Iaver Bazar opened my eyes! Down with authorities! I'm an old acquaintance of this great scholar. I owe him my rebirth... When I heard Iaver Bazar say we shouldn't recognize authorities, I felt so elated... as though I had seen the light! Down with authorities! Down with the Great Mages! Down with the gods!

It wasn't the money I needed, I needed something else...

I wrote an article for a newspaper some time ago...

An idea occurred to me: since ancient times, outstanding people have sacrificed the weak without hesitation! How many died during the Great Experiment? And how many people did Tep kill for the sake of his research? My idea was this: people, according to the law of nature, are divided into two categories: the bottom - the material that serves only to produce its own kind, and the worthy people who have a gift or talent...

These people are destroyers, those who destroy the present for greater good. In other words, outstanding people like Tep move the world forward. They are given more power than others, and they determine what is allowed and what is not.

Thus, villainy is permissible if the goal is good. The whole world is divided into people and nonentities.

I imagined that I, too, was a genius, a destroyer, and for some time I truly believed it. I needed to know as soon as possible whether I'm a nonentity or a person. Will I be able to cross a line? Am I brave enough to reach for something and take it? I'm a person...?

I came up with the theory, but I was not able to actually do it, to go for it... so that means I'm not who I thought I was.

name.en: What led you to this idea?

text.en:
Not what... Who!

Her name is... Aisa. Now she is here - in our world... The fates of the people she came across were changed, pulled out of the general pattern. Aisa can change my fate or yours.

But it's... meaningless. I still couldn't become what I wanted... I'm not a "person"...
Did I kill the old lady? I killed myself, not her!

name.en: Well, tell me what you can do.

text.en: After I confessed, Porfiry told me that my punishment will be keeping order on Jigran until I redeem myself. You'll benefit from this, too. Call me and I'll come - I'll serve my sentence and help improve your reputation with the townsfolk.
Thank you! I escaped from Aisa, but many could not. The Fateweavers still caught up with me. If it weren't for you...
I don't remember the way... I've been here for so long... The last thing I remember is falling from a height.

name.en: It's too high for me to climb.

text.en:
To be below or above is to be at the end or the beginning of the path of my fate.

If you see my fate, can you see my tracks, can you follow them from end to beginning?

Can you "fall upwards"?

name.en: You are a Paladin, and I'm a hero.

text.en:
Are you ready to hear me out? You won't like what I'm going to say...

Let's walk to the Cathedral...

As you can see, , Hiero came here with a whole army. His Paladins are quite resilient. While the Great Mages bowed before the Darkness, the Healers and Paladins rejected Hirkalla's rule. It was thanks to their faith that they managed to establish a foothold in this capital of shadows.

Now citizens come to this Temple - those who fear the Darkness. Our strength grows. Eventually we'll be able to challenge Hirkalla.

I believe in the Light, but there are many who have doubts. Look at them - they are scared and exhausted. That's how the Darkness finds its way into their hearts. When their Faith falters, the shield that's protecting the Temple gets weaker, too.

We shouldn't underestimate the Goddess of Darkness. She has a great force on her side, and many believed in her false resurrection, so we should be wary. But our caution shouldn't mean fear and dismay!

name.en: Now we can talk in peace.

text.en:
That's right, . Her eyes and ears are everywhere in the capitals of the League and Empire. You never know who succumbed to Darkness and who is still faithful to the Light. The temptation is too great, but believe me - I understand that Hirkalla is lying. Only a handful were resurrected. The rest turned into incorporeal shadows doomed to suffering. We, the Arisen, know what it's like. Most of us are bodiless Sparks, after all.

But there is good news as well. You managed to send a signal to Enod, and there has been a response. Three of the Children of Light, who had been observing Sarnaut for a long time, contacted Hiero and his warriors. Our task now is to hold our position until the forces from Enod arrive.

The main thing is to keep the barrier up. The Light from the Temple is spread using special beacons, but it's powered by our Faith. The stronger our Faith, the greater our power.

The Goddess of Darkness will spare no effort in her attempts to destroy this place. So we must keep our faith strong.
Our prayers have been answered! Look around you and believe.
Is there anything the power of Light can't do?

I represent Nefer Ur and Scientific Council here. We have our own view of Hirkalla and her pets. And Alice - I would love to speak with this elusive individual. By the way, do you have anything to say about this "Resurrection of Tep" that everyone is talking about? I just don't understand - I thought Klavdia had his Spark... How did Hirkalla get her hands on it? Or is that madman not actually Tep?
Hello, hello! I represent Nefer Ur and Scientific Council here. I observe and write up reports.

Oh, do you really want a lecture? You can ask the Healers about it.

Oh, well. I'll be brief.

Every living being, be it a human, elf, orc, animal, or even demon, has a Spark. No one knows what it actually is. You can call it a visible soul.

Free Sparks cannot linger too long in our world - they continually lose energy, fading over time.

In his time, Tep learned to extract it from Sparks. If you catch them, you can take what you need and use it for various purposes.

Your dark girlfriend released all Sparks from the storage that was similar to Tep's Pyramid.

That's why Jigran is full of free energy right now. Free for all.
A whole ocean of Darkness cannot extinguish a radiant Beacon of Light

My brothers came to Jigran before the dark goddess. The Elves of the House de Delice built this Cathedral to accustom vampire exiles to the Light.

But something else happened - Darkness swallowed the world, and it made its nest here. It wanted to chase away the Paladins, but they stood strong - and then Hirkalla threw her forces at them. But then a miracle occurred - her forces couldn't do anything. A strong shield of faith kept her dark creatures away from the Cathedral.

The number of brothers and sisters grew, and then they summoned me. Then...

You contacted Enod. Three observers came here: Ieziphael, Serahael, and Varadael. With them, our protection grew even stronger.

Then Alice came. I had no reason to trust her, but she explained that she wanted to fight against Hirkalla. I had no objections.

Their clash was... spectacular. The echo of their words resounded throughout the city - you can find it if you want.

Then Alice disappeared. And Hirkalla is sitting in her palace, dreaming of getting rid of us.
Do as the Children of Light do.
I think everyone should learn to love life more than anything else.

Most of them exist on the verge of transforming into a silent Spark - they don't have enough energy to act without an ether body. They need energy not to become Sparks. You can either take it from other, weaker entities, or someone powerful can grant it to you.

Unfortunately, most decided to harvest Sparks of the other awakened. Those people are called owners of dead souls, and some even sell them.

There are also the distorted creatures of Darkness and mindless ghosts. They are nothing but predators who steal our energy.
Where can I get a new coat? I don't even have money...
I came here to ask for mercy, not justice.
I feel like I'm falling into a deep abyss, but I shouldn't save myself. And I can't.
Oh, my dear friendlady, enough empty talk. Let's talk business first...

name.en: What do you know about the missing ghosts?

text.en: Oh, if you help me, I'll tell you what I know... And not just that: once you've talked to everyone, come back me - I'll give you good advice.

name.en: What do you know about the missing ghosts?

text.en: My friend, information is valuable. If you do me a favor, I will tell you everything I know.
Falling in love does not mean loving. You can fall in love even if you hate them!

name.en: What do you know about the missing ghosts?

text.en: Eh, yes, I would be glad to help, but I have a problem... If you can handle it, I'll tell you everything!
Everyone respects a good person.

name.en: What do you know about the missing ghosts?

text.en: My throat is so dry I don't feel like talking. If you help me with that, I'll tell you everything.
Uhh, why are you here, buddy? Would you like to try some kebab? Good kebab. Fresh!

name.en: Selifan asked me to pick up a box of wine...

text.en: Who is Selifan? Do you mean Ivan? I don't remember him, hah! But you know what? If you bring me ten Sparks, it will refresh my memory!
Well, buddy! For you and Selifan, I'll spare nothing. If you're planning a boozy evening, don't forget Zlatan!
Woof?
Woof?
Where is my dog?
What? That's not her!

name.en: Well, now we found her for sure!

text.en: Do you take me for a fool?
Woof?
Woof?
Woof?
Huff?
Grrr...
Woof?
Come on, you think I don't understand? The good of the empress is above all!

name.en: You have a suspicious look on your face

text.en: Whaaat? Ah, you bastard!

name.en: I'm looking for a Paladin spy, is that you?

text.en: What? How dare you?! This is an insult!
Greetings! My colleagues and I decided to go to the circus...
How strangely business comes to me, an inexperienced widow! Perhaps I had better wait a little longer, seeing that other buyers might come along, and I might be able to compare prices.
Do you really think I would take money for souls that have ended their existence in some way?
Don't you worry, please. I'll let everyone go, of course.
Can you believe that I alone drank seventeen bottles of champagne after dinner...?
But I've been saving up! Collecting them! Even went hungry on occasion! You must lend me three thousand. I need them, brothersister! At any cost!
I have a good liqueur stashed away, if no one has drank it!
There is no accounting for tastes. One man loves the priest, and another the priest's wife. Why are you here? On business or looking to get your ass kicked?

name.en: Here are ten Sparks. Let me pass.

text.en: Excellent, we'll settle the rest later...
I don't take bribes. If you offered to, say, lend me ten Sparks - that's a different matter. I can borrow them from you.
We don't see visitors here often. Especially the living ones... It's a dreadful city...
I feel something new... But first we should probably leave this place...
It's a strange feeling - to be alive again.
I knew we could handle him if we ever met again... The Great Summoner, pfft.
I'd rather not chat in this tomb. Let's get out of here first, then talk.

name.en: Tell me what's wrong with the story...

text.en:
Well, the ghosts are those who died and then came back to life.

They lived in the Old Era. Performed different deeds, both heroic and mundane.

But everything changed for some of the people I knew. They were famous, they were an important part of history. But now...

They are odd people out. Unwanted. Discarded.

I... don't understand who could have done that. I might be the only one remembering the old version of the story.

Understand who interfered with history.

I doubt that it was Nihaz or Hirkalla - I would have known if it was them.

It can't be Cosmos - right now his ability to manipulate the Observatory is very limited.

Someone else is operating on a different level. You and I must find them. I suggest you ask my sister and her minions. They have to know something... I hope you don't mind becoming a spy?

Oh please, no need for all that, . For some odd reason she seems to favor you, so you're the perfect candidate for infiltrating her ranks.

You'll have to play along for a bit.

Do what she says. Kill if she tells you to. Lie if she tells you to. Don't worry about getting your hands dirty. We need to save Sarnaut! By any means necessary!

Hey, hey, just don't get carried away, . You are a spy, not her loyal servant...

Your task is to worm yourself into Hirkalla's confidence. She seems to favor you for some odd reason. Pretend to follow her orders, no matter what she asks of you. And at the right moment... you'll betray her. For the good of Sarnaut!
I'd celebrate our victory over Tep, but this is worrying.

name.en: Alice says your destiny was changed

text.en: What a strange thing to hear! Is there a force that can change someone's destiny? Alice told me you had certain abilities. That you are a Weaver! Perhaps you'll tell me about your adventures?

name.en: Or you'll help me find the one who changes destinies?

text.en:
Yes, I believe the awakened can do without our help for now. We have dealt with the worst trouble for now - Tep.

We need to find out who has stolen peoples' destinies! I'm sure we'll find an answer to this question in Hirkalla's palace. Her generals receive reports from all over the allod. If anything strange has happened, they'll know of it.
I can't believe it. I run my hands over my body but still can't get used to it.
Eidos was once crushed by Nihaz's rebellion. But I'll give my sister a dose of her own medicine - her kingdom will not withstand the wrath of the Awakened.
No! I don't want to!
Yes! We are always ready!
What should I do?
I wish it would all start soon!
You can't love what you don't know!
Our lovers of freedom are first and foremost lackeys and only seek to clean someone's boots.

name.en: Would you like to stop supporting Verkhovensky?

text.en: If you give me some Spark energy, I'll consider it.
Nature is not a temple, but a workshop...
Rest assured...
Ah, there you are, gentlemen!
Books? What do I get in exchange? Spark energy, perhaps? At least three measures.
I see!
What's the problem?
{PayClubFee_False}{PayClubFee_True}

The analysis allows us to understand the following: the Spark is a multi-component entity contained in the concept of "soul". The Spark contains a certain "primordial flame" which makes it the basis of life. The flame is surrounded by a multitude of things that include the Threads of Fate. Invisible and ethereal, they extend from each Spark out into space. Mine are torn. Or rather, cut.

Now I remember: it was like a dream, a shining figure holding scissors in their hands. They... cut the Threads. Changed not only the future, but also the past. They... must be stopped!

name.en: Well, tell me what you can do.

text.en: It's simple - you kill local creatures, bandits and other vermin, and I'll show you how to get the necessary components for potions. I think additional properties will be useful to you on your journey through Jigran. You will conduct the tests at your own risk, I can't guarantee anything.

name.en: What are you and the nihilists planning?

text.en: A small revolution will strip away my sister's power... Or not. In any case, it will reveal her true face. She pretends to be kind, resurrecting everyone, restoring Sarnaut... Once she has to destroy the awakened, no one will believe in her good intentions anymore!

Do you doubt me? Didn't I put an end to Sarn and the Architect by pitting them against each other? I'm doing the same now - bringing together these madmen who rejected the gods, Hiero's Paladins who never question their own righteousness, and Hirkalla's minions who swore allegiance to the Darkness! They will weaken each other, and we will achieve our goals.

Some believe that victory can be achieved without getting your hands dirty, that there is always a simple and honest solution... But not me... And not you. You must understandmust understand - sometimes it's necessary to do things that are not... quite right.

You don't need Hirkalla - I will resurrect the dead myself just as I resurrected the Aviaks and the Tekyan. I will restore this world... my world! Not her.

name.en: So we need to choose a side?

text.en: Yes, you have to make a choice... Decide which of us is right...

name.en: You're right, let's put an end to Hirkalla's rule!

text.en: Glad to hear it! But this choice will affect the future, so you need to be absolutely sure of it!
You won't regret it! Now listen carefully...

name.en: Hirkalla is right, and you've gone mad!

text.en: It pains me to hear this... But I'll ask again. This choice will affect the future, so you need to be absolutely sure of it!
I think you'll regret this... Get out of my sight! Go to her...
This Cathedral is an eyesore... It's time for some architectural improvements!

name.en: Alice decided to start a revolution!

text.en:
I'm aware. Do you think I'm blind and stupid?

All her plans are obvious to me. Oh, these goddesses of nature... And some consider them "good", even though their flowers are poisonous. Our "evil" is more honest.

Where did that monk of yours go? Did you find what you were looking for?
Tep! He's back... We made a terrible mistake when we freed his Spark... Now he's the lord of the Death Domain, the rightful ruler of Ganzir...
Light... it seems Light... is leaving this place! We are all doomed, because Tep's revenge will be inevitable... Sarnaut will become a mass grave!
Damn it! Tep! Liar! Traitor! I... will get to you and send your Spark so far into the abyss that you'll be stuck there until the end of time...

It was Tep! All this time... Tep was under Alyosha's guise...

He gained new powers... Remember how Nihaz wanted to get the powers of Sarn or the All-Mother? But he couldn't do it himself!

And Tep took my sister's divine power and mine - not all of it, or we wouldn't be talking right now, but it was enough for him to become the god of Death, the absolute ruler of this Domain.

We will see the consequences soon, everything will plunge into a nightmare. We must get through our disagreements. if joining forces with Hirkalla will help us survive, then so be it.

What a bastard! And I gave shelter to that vermin...

Yes, he sucked out some of my strength... Probably most of it. It's time to call Nihaz, but we can't reach him...

Tep has already broken into Eresh and subjugated it - it won't take him long to settle in his new role. After that, he'll be able to kill simply by wishing it.

My little sister is also a treacherous witch, but now Tep poses a significantly greater threat. We'll call it a truce for now.
What brings you here?

Every living being, be it a human, elf, orc, animal, or even demon, has a Spark. No one knows what it actually is. You can call it a visible soul.

Free Sparks cannot linger too long in our world - they continually lose energy, fading over time.

In his time, Tep learned to extract it from Sparks. If you catch them, you can take what you need and use it for various purposes.

Hhirkalla released all Sparks from the storage that was similar to Tep's Pyramid.

That's why Jigran is full of free energy right now.
Moo?
Did Pechorin send you? Have you broughtbrought it?

I see you havehave it with you! Wow, what a rhino. There is no other like it in the world! Brick must be livid. But who cares, let him keep looking - tomorrow I'll be on the other side of the allod... And I brought my sister as agreed... She's already in the Fortecia.

Hah! Haven't you heard? Pechorin made a deal with me - I give him my sister, Squirrel, and he helps me steal the rhino from Brick! A girl in exchange for a rhino - it's the sweetest deal I've ever made! Well, goodbye!
Oh, I could use a little pick-me-up...
Oh, thank you! It's better than nothing...
I could use some hot soup...
I wish I had some oranges...
It's time for lunch, gentlemen...
Vodka and some spicy herring...
I wouldn't say no to a rabbit for dinner...
So you're here?
Oh, there you are! A beautiful day, isn't it?
Ah, Pechorin, you will answer for everything!

Is she dead? Dead?

Boring. I hoped that under the bullets boredom could not exist – a vain hope! In a month I grew so accustomed to the buzzing of the bullets and to the proximity of death that, to tell the truth, I paid more attention to the gnats – and I became more bored than ever. If I must die, I must! The loss to the world will not be great; and I myself am already downright weary of everything. I am like a guest at a ball, who yawns but does not go home to bed, simply because his carriage has not come for him. But now the carriage is here...My soul is corrupted by light: my imagination is restless, and my heart is insatiable. To me everything is of little moment. I become as easily accustomed to grief as to joy, and my life grows emptier day by day.

My destiny was stolen, you say? Well, perhaps. Once I was a different person. Then despair was born within my breast – not that despair which is cured at the muzzle of a pistol, but the cold, powerless despair concealed beneath the mask of amiability and a good-natured smile. I became a moral cripple. One half of my soul ceased to exist; it dried up, evaporated, died, and I cut it off and cast it from me. I vaguely remember something...

I met a stranger who said something to me... If only I could bring that moment back...

Well, if you need help, call me. Next? We'll go home to wash down our grief with a glass of tea... You can see how it all turned out.
I really messed things up...

name.en: Tell me what you can do.

text.en: It's simple - call on me for help, and I shall answer. If things get too hot, I'll call on my comrades. Together we'll defeat all foes!
Well, that's good! It's time for the second part of the plan.
Well, show me!
Now we can go! I almost asked Hirkalla myself... Call me Sevia by the way. That's my real name...
Oh, an uninvited guest! I've been waiting for you... What news do you bring?

Oh, interesting news indeed! I... can't believe I'll see Nezeb... almost half a century later...

I should probably change... He won't recognize me in this...

You know, once we... But never mind that!

Help me find something suitable... I haven't opened these chests in a while... I'll refresh my binding spells for the jinns.
It's very lovely, but I believe we'll have to do some fighting first. A ball gown is a tempting choice, but let's not get ahead of ourselves.
Who do you take me for?! Honestly, I don't even know where it came from...
That's a bit too dark! We are reviving him, not burying!
Excellent! Exactly what I need. I was once a commander of Nezeb's Falcons. When I stepped down, Vlad took over...

The same way you got to the Cave of Wonders on Suslanger - I'll create an experimental portal. I don't want to use the secret trails right now - it will take too long without the Wanderer, and we'll end up next to the Well anyway.

It will be harder to get to the deep Astral, but that can wait.
We got out! Now we'll quickly get to the deep Astral and the Seal...
Well? Are we going to Ferris? I visited it once, before the construction of the facility... It's a dismal place...
I'll teleport us straight to the Fodiator! Then I'll use the Seal as a ritual table. You and the jinns will cover me. You won't even need to leave the ship.
Excellent! We are in the right place. I have the Seal and the power we harvested.
Yes, it will take some time. Don't let anyone interrupt me, because I'll have to start from the beginning! Be ready to deal with uninvited guests...

name.en: Has everything gone according to plan?

text.en: Even better! Instead of one Great Mage, we got two. We can return to Jigran.

SirMadam !

There is no passage! By order of our empress, a barricade has been installed here to prevent dark creatures from entering the city and attacking her subjects!

Wait for her instructions. She will deal with these creatures soon. After that we will dismantle the barricades.

What else? Would you like to serve me, ? Excellent. Speak with my generals - they will have plenty of tasks for you. If you earn enough respect, you will be rewarded.

We won't let anyone out of the city for now - it's too dangerous. These creatures are everywhere... I'll deal with most of it, but it will take time, but for now the barricades will remain in place.

Await further instructions.
Sarn created perfect destroyers. That's exactly what I need. With them, I can change the whole universe!

name.en: How do I get him up?

text.en: He's just lying around... Should I read the news to him? Or make dinner? There is nothing in the pantry. Just the pudding...
Self-conceit ought to be the very salt of life. Look at you, running back and forth. I'm good here...

name.en: Get up! We need to talk!

text.en: Get up yourself if you need to... Why must we hurry? Surely we can wait and do it all later...
Ugh, I am sick and tired of your pudding...
{PayClubFee_False}{PayClubFee_True}
He's in a bad way today. Normally he would eat breakfast, scold me... But today he just lies there...

name.en: I was instructed to take what you owe to Ilya Oblomov...

text.en: That's not going to happen!

name.en: I was instructed to take what you owe to Ilya Oblomov...

text.en: Like hell you will!
Foodstuffs! They are not quite fresh or appetizing, but they are fine for ghosts! Take your pick! Before they go to waste!

name.en: How much for the food for ghosts?

text.en: Ugh, I wish I could sell it to you, but look around you! These nihilists showed up, yelling and breaking everything. Scared away all my customers, you're the only one left. Please get rid of them! Deal?
That's very interesting... These creatures are not from our world...

name.en: What are we going to do?

text.en:
These Dark Maidens are emotional parasites who feed on fear and other strong emotions. They say they came from the world of Tantibo, all thanks to Hirkalla... As the Goddess of Darkness, she probably knows how to control them.

We should talk to her... Let her explain what's going on. If the Dark Maidens are stealing fates, Hirkalla should know about it.

Like a weight has been lifted off my chest...

I've been lying here too long... My fate was stolen, you say? Is fate something that can be stolen? I don't know...

Alright, I'll go for a walk. Call if you need me.

name.en: Well, tell me what you can do.

text.en:
You see, I have considerable connections, so rest assured that the nobility will immediately hear of all your noble exploits that I will witness. Which will improve your reputation!

The ghouls have become loud again. Go there and summon me by using my calling card. Then give them a good thrashing in my presence. Your reputation will improve within a minute!

name.en: Well, tell me what you can do.

text.en:
Around the city, shady people

Hid treasures in chests.

And in those chests, there is a double bottom

Or a false wall...

Valuables are inside.

I figured out those secrets

And I am ready to help you.

I will get the reward out of the chest.

Do you want an example? There is a chest

Not far from here.

I'll mark it on the map.

Go there and summon me. We'll open it together.
Faith does not contradict knowledge, it only leads the mind along the right path.

, as we managed to find out over the year, the Goddess of Darkness is not omniscient and not omnipotent. Her strength is limited; she is unable to keep track of everything.
But remember - she is extremely dangerous. Therefore we will proceed with extreme caution. Our task is to get to a place where she has no power.

I suppose we should join Hiero and his Paladins at the Cathedral on Jigran. Their faith is so strong that they were able to create a protective barrier around the temple.

At the research institute, we have created a device that will allow us to travel to Jigran undetected.

But first, let's pray, . And ask the Light for guidance...
You are an aberration in the fabric of existence. A blot. A mistake! And I will fix this mistake!
I'm the one following in your footsteps! Beware, for I am close... You will not escape Fate, !
She... it was her fault!
Not me... The Scissors... The power you let into our world! You played with fate without thinking about the consequences. I couldn't save her. But beware, the scissors are coming for you, !
How dreadful.... Something terrible... happened...
Today you see a heartbroken father. I'm very worried about my daughter... She is in trouble. My daughter went on a long walk... And disappeared!

, we have learned a lot over the year and can say for certain that the Goddess of Darkness is not omniscient and not omnipotent. Her strength is limited; she is unable to keep track of everything.

But she is dangerous. Her minions are everywhere, especially here in Novograd. Therefore we will proceed with extreme caution. Our task is to get to a place where she has no power.

, I suppose we should join Hiero and his Paladins at the Cathedral on Jigran. Their faith is so strong that they were able to create a protective barrier around the temple.

My brother sent us a device that will allow us to travel to Jigran undetected.

But first, let's pray. And ask the Light for guidance...

name.en: Are you worried? What's troubling you?

text.en: I can't contain myself... I am in love! In love! Alas, she is noble, rich, and she cannot belong to me! At that terrible moment, when I learn that I'm not destined to possess her, there's only one thing left to do: die...
Oh, it's a simple game... You take a card, I take a card, then another if you need it. If you have more points, you win, but if you get more than 21, you lose.
Take a card!
Playing with fate is a dangerous thing, but playing with luck is even more dangerous!
Exciting! What could be more important?
Oh, it's a simple game... You take a card, I take a card, then another if you need it. If you have more points, you win, but if you get more than 21, you lose.
Take a card!
You have a four.
You have a nine. The total is 13 points.
You have a Jack. It counts as 10, so you have 23. That's too much. I have 16. I win! Let's go again?
Just 13? I have 16, I win! Let's go again?
You have a Queen.
You have a six. The total is 16.
You have a three! Looks like luck is on your side this time! You got 19! I only had 17, I should have taken a risk and drawn another card... you win!
16? Not bad! But not enough to win! I have 17! Let's go again?
You have an ace!
You have a Jack. Wow, 21! Luck smiles on you! I have 18. You win.

name.en: What's this grandma's secret Herman spoke about?

text.en:
Ah, it's a family legend! My grandmother, Countess Golitsyna, was once considered a great beauty... Even the Great Magician Elleken himself was in love with her. But alas - my grandmother preferred cards to love. One day, she happened to lose in a big way... And then, in exchange for one date, Elleken revealed to her the "secret of the three cards"...

However, he did so on condition that she would not tell others about it... Alas, she could not keep her promise - she told the secret to her husband and lover... And then, Elleken appeared to her and said,

"You will receive a fatal blow from the one who, while being madly in love, will come to ask you about the three cards."

Ah, that Herman! He pines for my cousin, but he's afraid to talk to her. Yes, he's poor, but so what... just propose to her and be done! But no, he'd rather suffer...

And you want to join our community, I see. I could put in a good word for you if you work off my debt to the owner of the local casino... Oh, don't worry, it's a couple of simple errands!

Well? Shall we play?

Every living being, be it a human, elf, orc, animal, or even demon, has a Spark. No one knows what it actually is. You can call it a visible soul.

Free Sparks cannot linger too long in our world - they continually lose energy, fading over time.

In his time, Tep learned to extract it from Sparks. If you catch them, you can take what you need and use it for various purposes.

Hhirkalla released all Sparks from the storage that was similar to Tep's Pyramid.

That's why Jigran is full of free energy right now.
Hehehe... Didn't you know that casino always wins?

name.en: They say you owe money to Ace... He asks you to pay it back!

text.en: Ah, I thought he would wait a little... Alright, I'm an honorable man. I pay my debts. Now I'll have nothing to eat, but here... take my money and go!
I come from a noble but poor family... Oh, I wish I could marry a rich bride... That would improve my situation... But for now, I'm forced to earn money by playing cards!

name.en: Don't try to talk me out of it. Pay what you owe the casino!

text.en: Ah, all people are odd people out. Leave me a couple of kopecks for a drink...?
It's like this: they are born, they live, they die. I will die... and so will you... Why shouldn't we have a little fun?

name.en: That's true, but the debt must be paid!

text.en: Ah! What impudence... Well... I lost a little, it happens... Here, take it...
I am actually a lady-in-waiting to the Empress of Kania! Do you even know who you are talking to?

name.en: Goga Ace wants you to pay your debt.

text.en: Do you expect me to just give it to you? What if I beat you up?
Honestly, why does everyone expect from me what they don't expect from others? There is no evil and good, just prejudice...

name.en: When will you pay your debt to the casino?

text.en: Whaaat? A debt?!
I was afraid of the abyss of wisdom...
What? Casino? Interesting... Perhaps I should visit it. Pull a prank on someone... I love pranks and mischief!
I love locking a new acquaintance in a room with a bear and watching their reaction!

name.en: Here's your invitation to the casino

text.en: Oh! Maybe I should go? I'm not a stranger to losing... What's another hundred of servants...?
I am from ancient nobility! My lineage is as ancient as Valir! I have noble rights!

name.en: You have been invited to the casino. Will you come?

text.en: Oh, how interesting! And why not? I'll go. Perhaps I'll find my admirer there...
Oh, Dar Ulgorn is a nice place for a walk... The city is quite impressive!

name.en: Wouldn't you like to go to the casino?

text.en: Ooh, a casino... Everyone plays cards there, right? I really want to go, but I'll need to find a chaperone!
What am I to do if I love him and the other one, too?

name.en: Your Majesty, would you like to go to the casino?

text.en: Play cards? Hmm, perhaps I should have some fun?
Eh, things were different during my rule... The nobility was more noble, and the bourgeoisie was more modest.

name.en: Would you like to go to the casino?

text.en: Casino? Hmm, interesting! Well, now I'm gonna go pray and maybe I will, at least to see what's going on over there....

name.en: Would you like to go to the casino?

text.en: Play? What an interesting idea! I think the Empress can do without me for a while...

name.en: There's a casino nearby, here's an invitation for you...

text.en: Oh, really! It's quite boring here, time for a change of scenery! I'm going to the casino! I need a carriage!
But who are you? What do you want?

name.en: A friend sent me... He asked me to deliver this letter...

text.en: Lisa is more precious to me than anything else in the world! But I am poor, and she is rich! The heiress of a noble family... I'm no match for her, no match at all... But if I were rich... Then everything would be different!
Oh god, oh god! Is she... dead?
I came to you against my will, but I was ordered to fulfill your request. Let Herman save Lisa, marry her... And three cards, three cards, three cards will win.

name.en: Herman didn't kill you, he's not guilty!

text.en: I knew the price of Elleken's secret would be my life... I was not destined to be resurrected again, so tomorrow I will leave this world for good...

So that's why he's here! Not for me! He wanted to know the three cards! It wasn't me he wanted, it was the cards...

Oh my God, oh my God! I loved him...! Monster! Murderer! Fiend!

I didn't want this, I only wanted to know about the three cards...!

She's dead, but I still don't know the secret! She's dead! It came true...! But I didn't learn the secret! What do I do now?

Yes, I'm poor... Without a coin to my name... The three cards were my chance, but I missed it... I'm scared! So scared! It's here! The Countess's ghost! She has come for me!

name.en: You think the countess's ghost came after her killer?

text.en: I didn't kill her, it was an accident!
If you want me to go somewhere, I need {price} measures of Spark energy... Because I'm very sleepy... The local fumes are draining my life force...
No, I can't do that yet...
Greetings! It's interesting to see living things in this swamp... I'm studying the local ghostly creatures here.
Why? I'm not going anywhere, I'm studying the local fauna which passes from a ghostly state to a fleshly state.

name.en: Would you like to go for a walk?

text.en: No, sorry, I have no desire to walk through the swamps – it's too easy to drown around here... Why would I?

name.en: You know, you look a lot like an elf I know...

text.en: Oh? Interesting... Well, it happens...

name.en: If you come with me, I'll show you something...

text.en: You know, this doesn't make me want to go anywhere. I can look at all sorts of things here... There are Junes, gnats... What else do I need?

name.en: If you come with me, I'll give you something...

text.en: I have everything I need! Look: a microscope, a net, storage containers...

name.en: I really need you to come with me!

text.en: Oh Tensess protect me, why are you pestering me?!

name.en: I need you to play an elven maid for a nasty old lady!

text.en: I can't do that. I'm a male elf. And I'm not a servant.
Well, how do I explain this... There is certainly a difference...

name.en: But you look exactly like her!

text.en: It's flattering, of course, but I think your old lady will notice the difference...

name.en: Have you ever played a part in a play?

text.en: Ah, once upon a time... But it happened so long ago...
I have no energy for this! If I could have {price} measures of Spark energy, I'll go...
No, I can't do that yet...
Oh, help me! The ghosts have drained all my strength! Perhaps you have {price} measures of Spark energy on you?
No, I can't do that yet...
Hey, newbie! You say we need to go back... But I'm hurt. I need {price} measures of Spark energy... to move faster.
No, I can't do that yet...
It looks like the elf is dead... The Countess's ghost will be very unhappy about this. We need to think of something, find some kind of replacement...

Queen of spades! That's her... the Countess! Damn it!

Three, seven, ace! Three, seven, queen...!
Yes, the secret is mine. I'm going to win!
Greetings to you, my dear friend!
Some kind of ancient evil is radiating from beyond these new walls...
Spoilers
Spoilers

name.en: Julia Lemkova said that you would be able to decipher the recordings

text.en:
It's curious indeed.

Yes, there are mentions here...

Of a missing daughter...

Lost and forgotten,

But that's all there is.

The details are vague.

Is that speaking of her,

Or of another, altogether...

And that's just a part of the records!

The remaning part, though

Is hidden in the Sardrok Palace
Who dare bother my?
Hah!
My remember dis thing. My let human pass!

name.en: Take the parts of the amulet

text.en: What brought you out here to this bleak land?

name.en: Give the sparks to the June

text.en: {False}{True}
Greetings to you! The Junes will have their vengeance!
Why are you standing here? What are you looking at? You don't respect your elders! You should listen to your elders!
Katerina is crying and sobbing

Ohh... Aaah... *sob* I can't... I can't stand her...

She keeps berating me... *sob* my mother-in-law...

Ohh... *sob* they married me off to a man I didn't love! *sob* This is no living with her! I'm a disgrace to the family now... *sob* I wish I'd died...
*sob* You can't... You can't help me... Go away...
Oh, Oak, what is this? Why...

It was under this oak tree that it all happened. I cried so much and hurt myself... I can't escape this sin. I can't escape it. It's not good, it's a terrible sin that I love another. Where can I go? Who can help me? My God, I am perishing! I don't need anything, and the light of God no longer matters to me! And death would not come. You call for it, but it does not come. It would be better if I was struck by lightning and killed on the spot.
Maybe I should ask the healer for advice? She is wise... she knows a lot... Maybe she can help me... Go, I beg you, ask... I won't go myself... I'm ashamed...
Look at my owls! Aren't they amazing!
Here's Brownie! She's the fastest in the forest, at night she can spot a mouse from over 300 steps away!
Here's Snowflake! She's the toughest - she can even bring a young deer... If she finds one, of course...
Oh, you are all so stupid! Damn you, damn you! You are incapable of anything!

So there are other lands beyond our borders! How amazing! And we sit here knowing nothing. It's good that there are kind people: every now and then you hear what's going on in the world, otherwise we would die like fools.

name.en: Take a look - is this Chestnut's collar? Unfortunately, I had to deal with her...

text.en:
Ah, that dog... It's a pity, yes... But...

I must say the dogs you brought me eat less than she does... and they don't try to eat me! I suppose getting a hound from the Wild Hunt wasn't the best idea...
It's been a while since we had such a terrible thunderstorm! My grandfather once said... oh, never mind...
Oh, that thunder! Something will happen today, I'm sure of it...

name.en: We can't find Katerina! Perhaps you've seen her?

text.en: {False}{True}

name.en: Katerina has disappeared! Have you seen her?

text.en: {False}{True}

name.en: Have you seen Katerina? She has disappeared!

text.en: {False}{True}
Oh, what a thunderstorm... I hope it won't cause a forest fire!

name.en: What will happen to you now?

text.en:
The storm gave me power... And... I liked that power!

Jigran is full of powerful sorceresses and goddesses who don't need to listen to their parents, their husband's relatives, or their elders in general! For example, Hirkalla! Did she listen to her mother-in-law? Maybe I should join her? Why not!

If I'm going to serve, then I'll serve a great woman, not this cruel merchant's wife!

I wished for this thunderstorm to kill me so I wouldn't suffer any more. But this thunderstorm has given me a new life.

My soul feels so light!

name.en: What do you think about what happened?

text.en:
I believe this will be a lesson to us all.

Heavy clouds often gather over those who live someone else's destiny, someone else's life. The storm will break sooner or later. Sometimes it kills. And someone becomes a storm themselves and destroys everything that prevents them from living.

You should keep this in mind and pay attention to the clouds gathering over you and your loved ones.

I admit I'm glad that Katerina chose this path - it's a destructive one, but it's a path of life.

And Martha can rebuild her house.

name.en: What about the one who changes people's destinies?

text.en: I suspected we were getting closer to her... Sometimes you can tell that someone's fate was changed very recently... However, she is no longer here. We should check one more "odd person out".

name.en: Alice is worried about the "odd people out".

text.en:
You know, you seem like an intelligent creature to me. Think about it - what fate? What is fate, anyway? Someone out there decided who everyone would be, and we have no choice in the matter?

That's my mother's nonsense that she put into people's heads. Things like "Fate itself determined your destiny: you, Hirkalla, you naughty child, will fiddle with the dead, but your little sister gets flowers and bunnies. Now accept it and don't complain."

Nonsense! I choose my own path. And no one can tell me what to do!

Let me explain in simple terms. My sister is deceitful from top to toe. I know you've been in regular contact with her. She always comes up with something, trying to manipulate everyone, inventing all sorts of schemes...

Now she is stalling for time - until the forces of other gods, supporters of the All-Mother, arrive in Sarnaut. That's why she created some new legend that she fed you after your adventures in the land of cute fluffy Gibberlings. But I will give you the truth.

There are two forces - me and my enemies. I'm talking about these bigoted fanatics in their Cathedral, which I can't reach yet. Help me end them - I will give you everything you want. Do you want to rule the Empire? Tomorrow Yasker will look for a new job. Do you want countless treasures? I will build you a city of gold. Reveal all the secrets of the world? Zayan will ask you to teach him.

name.en: Are you sure Enod is a threat to Sarnaut?

text.en:
Open your eyes!

It's the Light! There is only one road for them - the road of "good" which they defined for themselves, giving themselves the right to judge and punish.

They will not listen to your arguments, they decided everything for themselves long ago, and their decision will not change. As soon as you disagree with them on something, you are their enemy.

Their Light is not mercy, it's justice! Cruel and merciless. They see us all as a crowd of savages approaching their sparkling city on the hill. Like a jungle that wants to destroy the garden they created. How do they deal with the jungle? They clear it away.

name.en: Alright, I agree. What do I need to do?

text.en:
Very good. I knew you were a smart boygirl.

Follow the instructions of my faithful generals... By the way, I owe you for them, so thank you. While you are at it, you can find out more about these "odd people out", since they interest you so much.

Nihaz summoned me from a very distant world where Light and Darkness are ensnared in an eternal conflict.

The Lord of Light was skillful, and it allowed him to create magic rings. He gave three of them to the dark alvs, seven to the black dvergs, and another nine to free humans. He also secretly created the One Ring - it was supposed to lead all these peoples to the Light.

And then my four dark brothers and I arrived in this world to roam the earth, confuse the minds of its inhabitants, and turn them to Darkness.

These rings did a lot of good. After death, their bearers turned into angelic spirits, but the forces of Darkness managed to create a powerful alliance of dark alvs and human necromancers which opposed the Lord of Light. He was defeated, and his Ring was lost.

Later it was found by a halfling. He put it on - and was transformed. He founded a monastery and began to preach, convincing his brethren to follow the path of Light...

Then another halfling, a notorious rogue, managed to steal the Ring from him.

One day, after a drinking binge arranged by the thief, I discovered that this stolen ring was the very same Ring of Light. I decided to destroy it. I entrusted four most inveterate halfling bandits with carrying it. I also chose an impostor who wanted to become a king, a treasure-hungry dverg, and an arrogant alv who considered everyone else to be scum. One of the warriors of the main state of human necromancers also went with them, but the Light led him astray, and they had to deal with him.

Despite the betrayal of one of my brothers who went over to the side of the Light, my squad of scoundrels successfully reached the Sparkling Crystal Mountain and threw the Ring into its depths. The Lord of Light was destroyed. Later, my comrades and I left this world and joined Nihaz. For thousands of years I have been traveling around the worlds, aiding him to the best of my humble ability.
Ah, my friend! Misfortune is a contagious disease. The unfortunate and poor need to stay away from each other so as not to get any worse.

name.en: You've just been resurrected, why are you a ghost again?

text.en: There is no need to get involved in other people's troubles. If you take it all to heart, it's no wonder you are the most unhappy person out there.

name.en: Don't try to evade the question!

text.en: My friend, we all need Sparks, because in this city it's impossible to exist without paying for our existence... I'm a poor girl, so it was worth dying for this chance.. It's a shame it didn't work out. I won't say any more, I'm afraid they'll destroy me completely.
I don't want to study, I want to get married. Mother!

name.en: You were just resurrected, how come you are dead again?

text.en: Just piss off! What is wrong with you? Say another word! I'll kick your ass!
Go away! Go away! I'm so tired of you, people... Opiskin got lucky! Next time I'll win and get rich. There will be more Sparks than candy wrappers. Mother!
Eh, I was super passionate as a young woman. Few men could handle me.

name.en: Why are you dead? You were just resurrected!

text.en: For me there is no light, no darkness, no bad, no good, no boredom, no joys. I didn't understand anything, didn't love anyone and didn't love myself...

name.en: Come on, tell me what happened!

text.en: Ah, this eternal poverty, a husband I didn't love, and an ardent lover! Why do you care about someone else's fate? But this is the first and last time I participated in something like this. I'd rather die of hunger.

Run...

No!

I have to wait, otherwise... why?!

name.en: Tell her about the ghouls in the river and the promissory note

text.en:
What is this?

...someone's bloodless body was thrown into the canal? Ghouls underwater?!
We are forced to be the rearguard of Hirkalla's army!
{PayClubFee_False}{PayClubFee_True}

The laws of nature are simple and unpretentious - hares eat grass, wolves eat hares.

Who are you in this cycle?
You don't look like a "hare", sirmadam, the shade of your skin indicates the opposite.

In that case, let me warmly welcome you to my hunting grounds.

But a wolf, as you know, hunts in a pack. Your face is unfamiliar to me, which means you are not part of the pack.

Hahaha! Very funny!

But you are right, on Jigran any living soul can become food for another... less living one.

The pack will gladly accept you if you make a modest contribution to the budget of the upcoming hunt. Organizing it incurs certain expenses.

It just so happens that hares are found only where grass grows abundantly.

A mere trifle, just twenty Sparks.

Believe me, it's a symbolic payment for the pleasure you will receive, brothersister.

name.en: What's that about wolves and hares?

text.en:
"Hares" are resurrected residents who have negligible means of subsistence. They are in desperate need of juicy fresh grass. Sparks, that is.

And then it's us – the "wolves". We have what the "hares" need - you yourself have made a generous contribution. This amount became part of the main prize which will go to the fastest bunny.

I just help the "hares" and "wolves" give each other what they need.

"Wolves" and "hares" receive special masks from me. Thanks to them, our glorious hunt can take place in private, away from prying eyes and ears. Whoever takes off the mask leaves the hunt.

Then the "hares" run away and hide. The "wolves" look for "hares" and... well, you understand why wolves need hares, right?

The hunt ends when only one "hare" remains in the field. They receive all the juicy grass the "wolves" contributed to the hunting budget.

Rest assured, you will receive in full what you and I need in these lands inhabited by the dead and ghosts.

Fresh blood and the excitement of the hunt!

name.en: What about the ghouls in the river?

text.en:
Oh. Yes. Unfortunately, the prey of wolves sometimes changes in sad ways. Don't worry about it. Cleaning up is my concern.

Here is your wolf mask. Happy hunting!
Interesting things are happening here, in Hirkalla's court...
They say there was once a necromancer on Jigran who loved to swing his sword. His name was Firez. I'd fight him in a fair fight...
I haven't seen anyone from Gipat here - not even the headman or Osip Bazhov... Where did they go? Are they all in the Village?

Alice was reportedly spotted not far from here... But what does it matter? I know the empress wants her captured, but who can catch that one? She is a quick little girl, hopping through time like a squirrel on a pine branch.
Nihaz instructed me to serve his daughter as loyally as I serve him... And even if I don't like what she does, I obey the Lord...

name.en: Do you know of any unusual cases?

text.en:
So you are interested in all sorts of eccentrics and renegades, ? The city is filled with odd people, and it's difficult to single out anyone in particular... Only part of the released Sparks returned here, and more are coming...

But fine. Recently I was told about a mysterious gambler who frequents a local gambling club but never plays himself. They say he wants to learn the secret winning combination! Of course, it does not exist...

But there is a legend that the Great Mage Elleken knew a certain secret of "three cards" which allowed him to win every time. But as you understand, these are just stories...

name.en: Have you heard about people who act strangely?

text.en:
, this city is full of crazy people, each crazier than the last...

They told me about one officer. They say bullets can't hurt him, and he treats his own fate with complete indifference. He is not tempted by women or worldly fame, nothing interests him. Death also avoids him yet takes those who walk beside him more readily than others.

A police officer once shared this story with me. He read an article by an unknown student in a local newspaper. This student claims that there is a certain category of people who are not just allowed to commit crimes but should do so - they say their destiny is to become great, and everything will be justified in the end.

Pure madness, isn't it?

name.en: Have you heard about any curious cases in the city when someone acted strangely?

text.en:
What? What do you mean, ? Everyone here is strange. They dress strangely and act strangely. I've already punched various dandies in the face for clowning around...

Curious, you say? Meaning funny?

I was told a story recently. There is some gentleman here who lies on the sofa all day. He doesn't do anything - he's too lazy. They tried everything to rouse him, but nothing worked. So he lies on that sofa, haha!

name.en: What do you know about stolen destinies?

text.en:
I don't understand how someone's destiny can be stolen, ... Is there such a thing as destiny? If someone decided that I was destined to betray my friends and then die at their hands, would that mean it's not my fault?

Oh, well... We have enough lunatics around here... Recently some fool came to see his fiancée but had an argument with her father, caused a scandal, was close to throwing himself at the guests, then demanded a carriage and left...

Or another case - not in the city, but in a village nearby - some young merchant's wife cheated on her husband and, instead of keeping silent about it, she told everyone... Does that seem sane to you? They say her mother-in-law is making her life hell... I hope nothing bad happens...

name.en: Have you heard anything about "odd people out"?

text.en:
To me, every other one doesn't belong here... I don't know why they had to resurrect them all, ...

But there is one smart ass among them who, in my opinion, should be chucked off the Bridge of Time...

I met him by chance, at the local cemetery... He digs up corpses, practices black magic. We started a conversation, and then he said, "I don't recognize any authority, especially that of gods." Gods! Nihaz, our teacher and benefactor!

I was already furious, and he continued, "I reject everything, gods included." Ugh, I would have punished him if it weren't for the empress Hirkalla. And this scoundrel has followers! The so-called nihilists. They don't believe in the Light or Darkness.
I'm going to pass out... {price} measures of Spark energy can help me...
I feel so tired, my legs are dead. If I could have {price} measures of Spark energy, I'll go...
I feel weak... My arms and legs are so heavy... Perhaps you have {price} measures of Spark energy on you?
Oh, help me! These creatures are everywhere - they swarmed in from all directions...
I'm just a secretary, so I beg you... Where did these rats come from?
And each is the size of a cat... How would I go home?

name.en: Will you go to Anton Zagoretsky's ball?

text.en: Ooh, Anton Zagoretsky! Yes, I'm in!
Hello, darling. What are you looking for?

name.en: Will you go to Anton Zagoretsky's ball?

text.en: Oh no, last time was more than enough for me!
Hello, darling. What are you looking for?

One will come out of the fire unharmed

If they spend a day with them,

Breathe the same air,

And preserve their sanity.

A vision suddenly appeared...

A monster drives us crazy...

Hiding in the shadows...

It is watching us, weaving a web...

Slay it, I pray! Otherwise...

name.en: I think I've lost the Shadow Visor.

text.en:
How can you be so careless?

Here, take the Shadow Visor and don't lose it...

name.en: I think I've lost my detector.

text.en:
How can you be so careless?

Here is the amulet. Don't lose it...

Well, does that mean the deceiver has seen the light?

I don't blame her - she's young and naive.

I was foolish, got into an argument with a wrong person...

Molchalin is a scoundrel. But he got what he deserved.

My soul is gripped by sorrow,

And in the crowd I'm lost, I'm not myself.

Are you saying I have lost my destiny?

I felt... As though I had been torn... from my place,

Everything was so strange...

What did you say? "Odd people out"?

But very well. If you ever need help,

Just call me...

Like all the people of Jigran, my father

Wants a son-in-law with ranks and stars.

Oh, you brought him back?

Dear Chatsky... He was right.

We offended him.

Called him mad...

He is, of course, sarcastic...

But not unreasonably.

Are we working or playing tonight?
