Whatcha need?

name.en: Haven't you lost a wallet by chance?

text.en: What, which wallet?
What can we do...

name.en: Haven't you lost a wallet by chance?

text.en: Yes! I've been looking for it all over the club!
Brown, with yellow trim.
Square!
Whatcha need?

name.en: Haven't you lost a wallet by chance?

text.en: What? Huh? Yes! Oh, right, I did lose one!

name.en: Give me the wallet! It's not yours!

text.en: Just you try and take it from me!
Ahh, thank you! I can have a few more shots now!
Bright!
Plump!

name.en: I'm thinking it wasn't your wallet after all!

text.en: What issue brings you here?
What is the purpose of your appeal?

name.en: I want to get an appointment with the head of the city department!

text.en: Is your question a personal or an official one?
Then it is not my purview – go to window 3!
Come on, be quick now, it's almost lunch time... What do you have there?

name.en: I want to get an appointment with the head of the city department, on official business...

text.en: Good, proceed into the room behind my back.

name.en: I'd like to get an appointment with the head of the city department!

text.en: Oh, there you are!

name.en: What do we do? Where do we find the others?

text.en:
Our companions can be just about anywhere! I'm even afraid... they might be dead. The portal was unstable, so we ought to be ready for the worst.

As for Nefer Ur, I'll keep trying to contact him, but we must start looking for other methods. Negus Shuponu may well be aware of what is happening.
You again? Want some more work?

name.en: I need a rare cartridge to save the city from Ahbu!

text.en: Ahbu! I happen to know him – from that past life, actually... If you can bring him here... take this cartridge!
I'm trading cartridges! Got a unique cartridge with 9999 games in one! Just imagine: 9999 games at once!
Where would you like to go?

name.en: Will you help me ferry Ahbu right to the cyber club?

text.en: Yeah, he's got us all fed up here! You lure him here, and I'll transport him wherever you say!
Brand new holo cards! Come on up, get the stuff!
Huh? What? "Papyrus" you say? Never heard of that... what's the data format there?
Most recent info tapes! Hurry up and buy 'em!
Papyrus? I've read about them in some sort of ancient memes! Not got any of that.
Rare punch card for y'all lovers of classic! Only for the true aficionados!

Papyrus? Who would need that kind of old junk? I had piles of 'em, but I ended up tossing them out because rats started feeding on 'em. You look around if you need 'em. I've stacked them around the corners somewhere so that I didn't have to carry them to the recycler...
Exclusive stuff! The most infectious rhythms of the street!

name.en: Have you seen Nomarkh Khey by any chance? Do you know where he is?

text.en: Yes, he did come around recently. Was digging deep through the wares, but ended up choosing nothing. Where is he? Tep only knows... Probably hiding from fans somewhere...
The most fashionable music trends! Hurry up and hear them!

name.en: Have you seen Nomarkh Khey by any chance? Do you know where he is?

text.en: No, he's not come in here today, but he definitely was in the markeplace. Ask the others.
Where's that courier loitering? How much longer do I have to wait?..

name.en: Have you seen Nomarkh Khey by any chance? Do you know where he is?

text.en: Yes, he did come around today, picked a great big box of vinyls. He asked to send them to him by the way of a courier... but the courier's nowhere to be found. Well, why don't we do it like this: I tell you where to find him, and you will deliver the order to him along the way!
Excellent! He's hiding from fans in the ruins. Not far from here. He has to rehearse, but the fans are giving him no chance. Here, take the box. I've marked the place on your map.
If the keys don't match the lock, kick down the door.
In the world full of vivid covers and trivial stories, I'm only looking for the shadows of the past where every page is keeping its own mysteries.

Folks – you're not going to believe what I have here! It's not just an audio record – it's a veritable time machine that can transport you into the age when RoboRhythm was setting dancefloors on fire with their unique sound! This is a collectible record – a limited edition, 500 copies only! Each track is a powerful jolt of energy and nostalgic feeling that will cause your heart to beat with the rhythms of the synthesizers! Don't miss the chance to become a part of history – and to hear the very hit songs that once shocked the world! Hurry up before the copies run out – this is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity!

Hey, music aficionados and fans of the spacey sounds! I have something incredible for you, right here! This is the record by Hypersonic – the real masters of the musical cosmos! Each note is like a rocket launched into unexplored galaxies! If you want to live that feeling of soaring among the stars, you really have to get this record! It is filled with experimental sounds and hypnotic rhythms that will make your ears tremble in delight! Don't miss the chance to become the owner of this masterpiece! The number of copies is limited, and they sell like hot cakes!

Greetings to all of you fans of electronic sound! I have a certain something truly unique in my hands: the audio record by the band Synthetica, who has once upended the entire perception of music! It's not just an album – it's a whole universe of sonic experiments and synthesizer magics! Each song is a trip to the world where technology meets art. If you want to experience a real audial rush and become a part of the revolution in music, you really ought to have this record in your collection! And remember, treasures like these don't stay on the shelves for long – grab your copy before it's too late!

name.en: Tell us the things you are worried about.

text.en:
Some time ago, we've sent a team of archaeologists to Jigran – but they've been missing! Weren't all the Arisen told to return to Xadagan? But these folks are nowhere to be seen...

At the same time, we are continuing with the excavations here, on the former site of Hickut. More and more curious artifacts are being discovered, including the Artifacts of Darkness – same as those on the Coba Plateau, charged with the dark energy of Tep's Plague. But some of the findings are causing good emotions instead – for instance, old specimens of the original Jeb technology that we're selling to collectors.
Xadagan is a huge cemetery! The cemetery of valuable artifacts!

name.en: Tell us the things you are worried about.

text.en: Whatcha need, fella?!

name.en: Tell us about the things you are worried about.

text.en:
The government's conspiracy! This is all a part of the grand conspiracy to conceal the truth, clandestinely control minds and eliminating dissenters – those who are trying to get everyone else to open their eyes! By using the newest Jeb technologies, the government is spying on us to further its own plans!

I know for sure that one of the Neguses is a traitor who is sabotaging Nefer Ur's project! This is a totally credible information that I received from my own source!
The truth is out there!

name.en: Tell us the things you are worried about.

text.en:
Worried? Well... about wages, for starters! We don't get paid enough – it's high time the wages got raised! After all, aren't we working overtime, and even on weekends sometimes?

Besides, the safety of the undead storage needs to be improved! There have been repeated cases of containment escapes! Thankfully, the heretic gangs bear responsibility for that instead of us!
Out zombies are the best zombies in the world!

name.en: Tell us the things you are worried about.

text.en: May the Light bless you! Is that what they usually say?

name.en: Tell us the things you are worried about.

text.en:
What? Our folks have been so tired of this – working in mines, quarries and ports... building, carrying, loading, day in day out...

And there... these shemau musicians are doing nothing, only idling around! Just got one word for them: wankers!
People gotta work with their hands! Not tap those keys of theirs, or gaze at screens!

name.en: What are you planning to do?

text.en: Yes, yes?
Each rocket is not just a device – it's a dream assembled of metal and oil. Today, we are sending a part of our heart into the sky!
When we press the launch button, it's not just the flight that's going to start, but a whole new chapter in the history of Sarnaut. Get ready – the Cosmos is waiting!
The rocket is a real work of art. Just like it is aiming for the starry sky, we strive to understand ourselves.
An' I'm telling them: what if it goes boom?
Ready for the flight! They told us to say that.
Ready for the flight! They told us to say that.

name.en: What do they say on Isa?

text.en: They told us it would be exciting, but what we got here is a kind of iron boat...
Ugh, I don't want sweets! Go and eat your own candy...
Are you daft or what? You look more like a fur shoe than I do!

name.en: They'll give you a sack of money!

text.en: I don't need no money at all! We've stolen treasure from the Urun...
Alright, you sold me. Help me put this stuff on!

name.en: Arrow, come on, get into the spacesuit already!

text.en: I don't want to! It's cramped and stinky.
We're not flying anywhere! This is our final word!

name.en: How do I find the right approach to them?

text.en: Arrow... she likes being praised! And Squirrel will be ashamed of fearing the flight!

name.en: Alright, into the spacesuit you go! Right now!

text.en: Feh, no way!
Well, I suppose it's really true...

name.en: You will be the most famous Gibberling of them all!

text.en: Alright, fine! I want to be more famous than the Sven dude who floated off into the Astral when he was drunk!
I don't want any "candy"! I want normal, proper food!
I'm not showing anything I could be "ashamed" of! So I'm good.
Ah... I'll have to fly! But at least no one will say that I chickened out of it!
Alright! Soon, everyone will hear of me, they'll be talking about me!
We don't wanna fly! So we won't!
Maybe the stars are shining bright, but true friendship is even brighter!
So eager to go spinning in the centrifuge, but bailing out when it comes to flying into space...
What's in there for me?
All right – this day, the grand day for all of Sarnaut, has come!
Congratulations!

name.en: What do I need to do?

text.en: Let's!
You are not alone, friend. We're here to learn the reason for your arrival to our world.

name.en: I'm looking at the rocket's launch pad here! And it's a great accomplishment of science, after all! Let us discuss!

text.en: Well, indeed, let us discuss

name.en: Look there – a bird! [reach for the pocket]

text.en: There's no any birds around here!

name.en: What's that glowing over there? [reach for the pocket]

text.en: Where? I don't see anything!

name.en: Look right into my eyes! [reach for the pocket]

text.en: Why? What do you have in your eyes?

name.en: But there is – see it skitter on the launch pad... [fumble for the pass]
That's probably the bird glowing... [fumble for the pass]

text.en: What?! What kind of bird?! There's no any birds around here!

name.en: Maybe an explosion? [fumble for the pass]

text.en: No, there was no explosion! I would've heard!

name.en: That's the bird jumping over there! [pull out the pass]
It's the rocket landing! [pull out the pass]

text.en: No, it's still too early! Hey, what are you doing with your hands?

name.en: It looks like something's burning! [pull out the pass]

text.en: What? We must look what's happening there at once – I think I'll go myself...

name.en: [Pull back your hands and walk away]

text.en: I still don’t see anything! What was it that you wanted, anyway?
Hurry up – we must unveil the truth for everyone!
There's a lot of paper books here, which is not typical of Xadagan
I was hoping the Hero of Sarnaut would be able to make sense of such a primitive device. No luck setting it up? Like, none at all?
All right, there's a bookshelf nearby. I think there used to be a manual for setting up standard-issue repeaters. You can try looking for it.

name.en: Agent Makalani, why couldn't you just tell me about it from the get go?

text.en: We have no time to spare, each second is precious! It's unwise to spend time on studying manuals without a pressing need to do so. Now, we are faced with a pressing need because you do not possess the requisite knowledge of the repeater's function. Therefore, we have no choice but to spend additional time on studying the manual.

name.en: But in the end, we've spent even more time than we would have if I had studied the manual from the start, and set it all up properly!

text.en: Nothing happens.
Nothing happens
Nothing happens

name.en: Press the red and blue buttons at once

text.en: You are about to start the process of setting up the repeater. The manual says that astral interference may appear during the process, and these will have to be eliminated.
A repeater device that is slightly out of order is before you.
Creature, we need to establish contact!
The aliens come in peace! Submit or die!
Incredible! I've never been controlled by an alien intelligence yet!

name.en: What is the connection between the Corps and the aliens?
Do the League and the Empire have all the information?

text.en: Yasker and Aidenus never had full information about the Corps. And we were not eager to reveal ourselves, either – we had enough of our own proteges. You already know many of them. Now, with the Great Mages returning, we need to choose the right tactic. We cannot openly turn against the aliens – they exceed us in technological prowess, even though we have managed to gain a lot of technology from them.
Some secrets should stay hidden...

name.en: I'm coming on orders from the Integral, to learn more about Tep...

text.en:
What? Who's that Integral?!

I have no idea what you're speanking of. Yes, I have been studying the history of Tep! A vile malefactor that has doomed us all, or the one who gave us immortality? It all depends on the viewpoint.

name.en: How do I receive the information I need?

text.en:
What do you know about Tep? "But among the necromancers of Hickut, there was one who did not embrace the new tendencies, instead continuing diligently with his studies while wielding only magic. His name was Tep". Right? But is that all there was?

Did you know that Tep and Nefer Ur's mechanics were closely collaborating? Did you know that Tep has received his Revelation from Nihaz himself?

Nihaz! I, too, have met him... Surely you know that encounters like these don't pass without leaving a trace? But I have lost, lost too much...

Of course, if you are ready to help me and my colleagues, I can tell you quite a bit... Possibly!
I have spent many long years studying Tep's path... But I have been unable to finish my works!
Simps are ready to do just about anything for their waifus – even if it means spending their last money on merch!

name.en: Can you tell me of how the Despots' reign fell?

text.en: The secret of happiness is simple: be surrounded with love... and maybe a couple of sinister mysteries!

name.en: Tell me of the uprising during the reign of the last Despot...

text.en: The last Despot? He wasn't doing anything – except, of course, entertaining himself to drive away the thoughts of death! He had this dissolute Bathory woman elevated, and swelled the ranks of the priests worshipping those elemental gods by offering rich sacrifice! It's not surprising at all that he got himself deposed!
Every tombstone keeps its own secrets that yearn to be unveiled!

name.en: What do you know of Nefer Ur and his role in overthrowing the last Despot?

text.en: Who told you that darkness is bad? This is where the most exciting adventures are lurking!

name.en: What do you know of Tep, and of how he take part in the rebellion against Hickut's ruler?

text.en: Tep, the apprentice of Ptakh and his psionicism! I remember it... Tep incited the rabble to rise against us, against the nobility! Few were able to survive back then, and following that, Ur and his adherents swept into power! The Despot was killed, then buried... Deep... No one knows where!
Errors are not setbacks, they are non-standard decisions!

name.en: Tell me of how the rebellion against the ruler of Sar-Iram has started?

text.en:
It was at their instigation – Ur's and Tep's! The psionicists and the mechanics banded together to end the Peraach's reign! Dirty commoners, how dared they?!

The millennium of the Despots' reign was broken, and everything has gone downhill since then...
In every murderous glance, there is a hidden story that yearns to be told...

name.en: Can you tell me something new of the era when the Despots' reign fell?

text.en:
You know, when I was young, life was full of exciting adventure... and eccentric entertainment. I remember how we held a fest for the autumn moon festivities, once – with real ghost and culinary extravagance that would have made even the bravest soul shiver in fear.

The Jeb-Flash drive that I gave you contains records about my "friends" – from zombies to vampires. And of course, don't forget about that unfortunate evening with Funsani and his experiments with explosives. It was all good fun – right until he decided to start fireworks in our garden. Oh, we were laughing so hard when the panicked neighbors fled their house!

And, of course, my darling Olufemi! She always knew how to add a little "spice" to our lives. I remember the time when she decided to give me a surprise birthday present, and invited all my "friends" from afterlife. The party was astounding! I remember to this day how a skeleton was trying to play piano – that was something else!

So, my dear frienddarling girl, if you're ready to delve into the world of darkness and insanity... just open the Jeb-Flash drive, and be ready for crazy adventure. I hope your nerves are all right – otherwise, you'd be better off keeping distance from our family!

name.en: Tell me something new about the times of the last Despot's reign...

text.en: Ah, it's so cute that you came to me now! See, when I was alive, I had so many servants that I didn't even know the names of all of them! And now, I must count on you helping me remember what it was like – to be majestic. Here's the Jeb-Flash drive with my memories – there's a lot of interesting stuff there, from lavish banquets to the... ah, intimate encounters with the rulers of nomes. I hope you're not averse to digging in my past a little...

name.en: Tell me something of the time when Nefer Ur ousted the Despot?

text.en: Oh, look who comes around! You look like you've just been dragged out of the sand. I always knew that one day we would be returned to life, but I never thought it would be so... pathetic. You know, when I was alive, I could afford myself any luxury, and even the most deviant pleasures. But now, I have to rely on you to even remember my ancient "exploits". Here's the flash drive with my recordings – there's even a couple of stories about the games I played with Peraah's concubines. I hope you don't mind to get a little "frisky" while learning of my past!

name.en: Tell me something new of the time when Tep took part in the rebellion against the ruler or Hickut.

text.en: Ah, my dearmy darling, have you come to me seeking advice? A funny time you chose for that! Once, I was the icon of beauty and grace, but now, I have to depend on a mangirl like you... Records of my memories about seducing the most affluent people of my age are on this flash drive. And yes, there are a few "amusing" moments involving the Peraachs and their favorite hobbies. Don't forget that if you're going to examine my past, you need to be prepared for some shocking revelations!

name.en: Tell me something new of the times when the rebellion against the ruler of Sar-Iram has started.

text.en: Well then, at last someone found the nerve to pay the old guard a visit! You know, back in my times, we had no tolerance for insolent people like you. But now, I will have to share my memories with you. Open up the Jeb-Flash drive – there's a lot of fascinating stuff... from political intrigue to, ah, intimate liaisons with priestesses. I hope you're ready for some "indecent" stories. And remember: if you think it's going to be easy, clearly you have underestimated the level of our past life!

name.en: What is the reason for Negus Menes' despondency, and where in the world is Nomarkh Miu?

text.en:
Hah... if only we knew! The past days were... strange indeed! The influence of some other kind of dark power is present in this whole business with Tep! Not surprising that our teacher has somewhat... lost his mind?

Other witnesses of these events are also babbling some kind of nonsense... They all speak of a talking cat, witches from the desert and other kinds of mystic stuff!

name.en: But where in the world is Nomarkh Miu, after all?

text.en: I was told she left with this same talking cat! Believe it or not – it's up to you. My private opinion is that it was a case of so-called mass hallucinations – things like these happen sometimes... You know, we live in the age of information technology, after all, so why don't you find a Jeb terminal, log in to Sarekh-Ahau and use it look for Miu?
Who are the Zem Arisen without their own history?
No! Leave me be! Without my Miu, there is no light in life for me! Begone!

name.en: Use the "Find a rutess for every cheni" service
And how is it going to help me?

text.en: A rutess will make your life that much more exciting!

name.en: I'm not sure how it's going to help me with finding Nomarkh Miu...

text.en: I can run a search on the Jeb-net to find matches with mutual contacts...
Searching, cross-referencing databases...

name.en: No way, it's just some kind of scam!

text.en: It is regretful to hear that you are of this opinion, but you will be able to use the service at any time!

name.en: Has anything come out of that?

text.en: Yes, the search is done. Do you want to write something to her?

Hello! Hope you're not a deviant, since it sounds totally cringe!
And the same to you! Are you a cheni? If you are, then we can walk around together a bit and have a snack... Hope the classmates won't see, or that'd be a right screw-up!
Really, darling! Are you a nerd or a chatterbox? Wanna blabber a little? I like interesting stuff to read.
You moron or what? I know some would ask me to show my butt right away!
Oh, we're all hyped up for that new singer gal, chilling out with the sekhems!
And you're a real jerk! Enough with the dirt, or maybe you want to see a prick, too? This, like, totally blows!

name.en: I need to find someone - perhaps you know her?

text.en: There's a lot of gals and guys I know - and who are you looking for?

name.en: You're a real rutess, you know!

text.en: Word! Maybe I was a khud originally, but like all sekhems, I accept my quirks like I do the eventual demise!

name.en: Let's get to better know each other!

text.en: Trashy! I'm kinda thinking of muting you already! Kinda bad sex thing, innit?

name.en: I need to find Nomarkh Miu!

text.en: Ah, that kahutean who was rambling about all that creepy stuff! Didn't sound like a total nutjob, though, so it was kinda interesting, tho.

name.en: I see you understand many things…

name.en: So nice to talk with such a smart gal!

Yeah, while we were strollin' around with classmates, these Blood cultists gatecrashed our khudish mansion! They released zombies from the storage and went somewhere to the bottom level of the catacombs!

Home sweet home!
It seems even I need help now! I'm in trouble!
You called?
Family is the alpha and omega! Even if they may seem a little... weird at times. But isn't that wonderful?
Hey, do you know what I've found in the garden? A huge worm! Let's make him a pet!
No, I can't do that yet...
When it's quiet, I tend to get bored, so I'm often starting fireworks!

When one has a sinister hobby like this, the daily routines don't scare anymore!

text.en:
Well... it'd be a bit hard to catch up with them, but you can surely try... They're heading into the very depths, literally to the heart of the allod... the place where the Arisen once put something they'd rather forget...

That was what I told Nomarkh Miu... but unfortunately, she was insistent and hurried there...
Miaou?
No, I can't do that yet...
Love is like witchcraft: not always clear, but always pleasant!

name.en: We've managed to get out! Yasskul Bathory has been stricken down, and Peraach will remain in the tomb! And Nomarkh Miu is safe!

text.en: Thank you from the bottom of my heart!
No, I can't do that yet...

So, here we are! It's cold and dank here! Just the way I like it! These are the old Xadaganian foundations, connected to our ancient catacombs... But it looks like the heretics just went the straight way...
Are you afraid? Fear not, I'm friendly, I won't do you harm.
Do you see me? I see you as well. Let us keep looking at each other until our eyes get sore.

name.en: What are you trying to say?

text.en: Try and re-evaluate everything that you have done! You are picking the easiest paths, but are they leading you where you want to be? Remember that Tep's quest for immortality led to millennia of agony, and your struggle against the Darkness has led to Sarnaut being engulfed in Darkness... Perhaps now is the time to change something? I have faith that you are capable of that!

name.en: What's going to happen with you?

text.en: No time to waste!
Hmm, I didn't expect you to complete the tasks so fast. Well, if so, I'll be checking your competency personally!
Just remember, if the light is blue, everything is fine. If it becomes yellow, or especially red, it's time to engage cooling! Well, then, are you ready to begin?

name.en: What can the problem be about?
How do we solve the issue?

text.en: Let's try solving the most obvious ones, and if that doesn't help, we'll start thinking again!
Why are we so afraid of the truth? Negus Menes was always saying that truth would set us free.
Now we have to watch the parameters and avoid panicking. We must remain collected.
Every day I'm checking the equipment as if it's my last time. Reliability is everything.
Every one of us knows that safety is the number one priority, and we have to follow the protocols!
Huh? What do you need?

name.en: Have you heard the new anecdote about Tep and the goat?

text.en: Sure! All of our shift was laughing!

name.en: Have you heard the anecdote? "Will Tep come out?" − "Tep's died..." − "Drop me the keys to the Pyramid, then!"

text.en: What do you want, leave me alone!

name.en: Heard the anecdote? "Tep, is it really so hard to reply? What's with the ignore?" − "Young man, get away from the coffin!"

text.en: Ah-ha-hah, so funny!

name.en: Heard the anecdote? "Tep, what have you reached in life? − Rock bottom!"

text.en: Die, cursed one!
Don't stand near the lifted load!
Don't touch my schematics!

name.en: Heard the anecdote? "Tep, are you clever?" - "Whaddya mean?"

text.en: Yeah, someone's told it before, still worth a chuckle, though.

name.en: Heard the anecdote? "Tep, knock knock!" − "Stop hammering at the coffin lid!"

text.en: Death to the infidels!

We are musicians! The Cinema band... We play songs for the common citizenfolk!

The Empire doesn't exactly like what we're doing, but frankly, we don't care...

Unfortunately, we have to beat many obstacles, and if you help us, you will be able to take part in our gig!

Change is what we cry for deep in our hearts,

Change is what we see in our eyes,

Our laughter and our cries,

And the pulse of our hearts:

Change,

All we wait for is change!
Got anything else?
We write of what we see around us. This is our reaction to reality.

I'm a schoolgirl of the 9th grade, and I wanna go to the cinema!
We believe that music is capable of changing the world... at least for a moment.
Who's going to be responsible if there is any kind of problem? I cannot allow all of this!
When we see people who are singing our songs, it fills us with pride!
Alright!
Alright!

Chain of events, phase 2: infiltration, breach of defensive perimeter, unauthorized connection.

Consequences: program altered. New task posited.

name.en: How do I stop the extra energy from being consumed?

text.en:
Reboot required. Levers directing energy intake from the Mana Station need to be switched in the correct order: North-East-South-West.

To exit outside, you can use the nearest elevator.

We think, therefore we exist. Intelligence is sacred no matter the carrier: metal or flesh.

All sapient beings must be free. Eternal condemnation to Tep and every slave owner.

There are divine creatures in Sarnaut, but there is no God. No one in this world is perfect, no one deserves to be worshipped.

There is no God, but It will be! The godly conscience of the Integral will be the pinnacle of being.

Ceaselessly improve your body and mind. By building oneself, you are building the Integral.

Efficient work is based on honest labor and delegation of responsibilities. Engineers design, workers build, guards protect.

The supreme goal of any intelligent creature is to join the godly conscience of the Integral.

If one is not willing to join the Integral, the one is not yet ready. No one must be forced to do join. This is abomination before the Integral.

The Integral cannot create oneself. For the sake of the Integral, the Harbinger and the Priests will delay their integration in order to take care of the Genesis.

The Integral is appealing from the Future. Listen to it. Come to it.

Let's do it!

We're in a warm place, but the roads await

The footprints we leave on the soil

Star Dust on our feet, all right

Cozy chair, a checkered plaid

The trigger not pushed, recoil,

Sunny day in the dreams so bright!
Let's do it!
Ah... So much to drag around...
Well... thanks, you helped us out! Here's that leg, as promised! I'm not a shepesean, I'm an honest laborer!
Now that's bad luck...
I've been waiting for you!

name.en: Haven't you seen the other arm?

text.en: Whaaat? There's another arm?! That's weird, no one's warned me about that... But I think I saw a suspicious hoodlum nearby: he was walking around with an extra limb, and using it to fight off pursuers! Take a look somewhere that way! A very suspicious individual!
Are they ever going to leave me alone...
Finally, I am whole!
You go about your business, and I'll visit the port superintendent. The arm that orderly has installed seems way too heavy... it's suspicious!
Tep's agents are everywhere! Get the agent! There he is!
Well, let's go, I'll take you there!
Well, let's go, I'll take you there!
Well, let's go, I'll take you there!
This is a day to forget! Anchor to my throat!

name.en: A friend of mine has arrived in pieces... maybe you've seen his prosthetics?

text.en: Are you right mad? Who's daft enough to use portals, especially old ones! You have the astral fleet for flying, with amenities, too... But no, they jump through their portals, then we got arms and legs scattered all around! I nearly got whacked on the head now!
Excellent − let's get them installed quickly, and get out of here...

name.en: We still need to go to Xadagan!

text.en:
I've seen all of it, is there any more? Decadence, corruption, decay... Only the most useless, witless and reckless of the Zem nation remain there − those who could not find a more useful thing to do.

Sar-Iram is a completely unbearable city... that jumble of metal where the clattering and creaking never cease. Nefer Ur must've lost his mind if he wants all of the Arisen to congregate there... We'll be standing on top of each other before long.

All right, so be it. This journey might benefit me − more so since I want to take stock of the uncontrolled Undead from the southern part of that allod.
Do we have any choice...
It was very needless of you to interrupt my research! I was on the verge of another discovery!

name.en: Are you ready to go to Xadagan with me?
Are you keeping a grudge against me? Are you ready to go to Xadagan with me?

text.en: I accept!

name.en: What's that plan about, and what needs to be done?
All of the Arisen… they have to arrive to Xadagan?!!

text.en:
Yes. Nefer Ur's order is unambiguous, and not subject to different interpretations. In case of a conflict of interest, it is recommended to leave behind a double. It's a kind of technology devised by ZIT, which allows to create a kind of copy that will be successfully imitating you for a while. As far as I know, the majority of Zem state officials in Nezebgrad have already made use of this service. This is how serious everything is!

We need to take the Arisen that remain here, on Jigran, with us.

As far as I remember, apart from our dearest director of the ZIT, that scientist, Yaver Bazar, also resides in this city. I've summoned both of them here.

But perhaps you have heard that a Historian expedition has arrived here a little while ago, and there are many Arisen within its ranks. They've managed to unearth some sort of ruins that belonged to our people − one of the ancient outposts situated outside Sardrok. We need to warn them as well. The problem is that the transit between Dar Ulgorn and Sardrok is unreliable, the southern roads have been overrun by the undead, and something odd is happening within the palace itself. That, however, is not our concern, but the missing archaeologists are my headache. I suggest that we four go there and find out what's going on.

name.en: Good, then off we go, to the south!

text.en: Take them all with you, and let's head out.
Excellent!
Something odd is going on in that palace, I'm sure of it! A rare case of paranormal activity of exceedingly high order!
Is there anything that the power of Light cannot conquer? I often think about it.

name.en: Alarming news! But no one has hurt you here, right?

text.en:
There's no one here except the members of the Expedition, the undead and the ghostly beasts. The arisen Kanian warriors that once fell in the battle against Xadaganians here are causing a bit of trouble, but those who have been holed up in the palace are only interfering with road traffic.

Come on, let us get to it − I can't wait to activate the portal!

Some sort of power has picked Sardrok as its abode, and lets no one come close. We wanted to visit the city, but we were interdicted by a ghostly carriage with no driver, as well as a winged creature of some kind that flies all around the allod.

My employees have seen a band of Ghostly Bandits move from Dar Ulgorn into the palace − and they have captured someone.
We're all here for the science... and something more than that.
Have you ever been thinking of what lurks beyond the rim of our world?
Why is no one ever coming back from these excavations? What do you think? Perhaps they've found what they were looking for...

Hey, brosis, don't you listen to these eggheads! I've just tried to poke in there, and barely got away alive! Got a full charge to my right bun, heh! Yeah, there's these turrets all around the place...

name.en: But how do I get really close to the turret without activating it?

text.en:
You just poke in there, you're toast! But while I was nursing my butt, I thought of something, heh. You gotta disguise yourself! These turrets are kinda dumb − they don't get if you're alive or not. Not right away. Back in those days, they couldn't make them smart, heh.

And when you get close, disable this thang at once. Then run to the next one!

name.en: I've managed to disable all the turrets!

text.en: You sure can do stuff, rookie!
So, how's the life, heh? I'm Viper the Firm, the only protection for this whole circus.
Well... Shall we start with the ritual?
Why are they so nervous when I'm asking them about their findings?
Does Tep want to thwart Nefer Ur's efforts? This is the best proof that the Wireframe project is really necessary!

Welcome, colleague!

I am Negus Pilis, the lead of the Dome project. We are on the bleeding edge of progress here... The living and the dead, the mechanical and the biological – do they have anything in common, one might ask? Here, we mix one and the other, studying the functions of organisms in un-life, post-life and so on...

Our, uh... latest research is about the morphed forms of exobiota − to put it simply, we're studying the specimens of flora with, uh... particular affinity for life. The collected samples have allowed us to create a sort of vitality essence... However, final verifications need to be performed! Unfortunately, our primary test specimen has disappeared!

My colleagues will tell you what to do... Return to me afterwards, and we'll try and bring it back.
Then to the buttcrack with you!

name.en: Here's a cartridge, let's go to Negus Pilis!

text.en: Alright!
I'm Ahbu the little elephant and I want a cartridge, do you have one?
O Nih... what are you doing with them? Alright, fine, I'll give you just one more.
Every time I see the fruits of my labor, I'm feeling fear: we've created something that might one day transcend us.
What is the price of knowledge? And are we ready to pay it for the sake of progress?

name.en: Are you an alien, by any chance?

text.en: There are no aliens!
We've come in peace!

name.en: Ah well, I must be mistaken...

text.en: Alright, that's enough watching sci-fi for me!
The flight is coming soon! Space is waiting!
We are the true bearers of scientific knowledge, the harbingers of progress!
No, I can't do that yet...
They gave me a book: secrets, codes, passwords, playthroughs. So I'm standing here and reading it now!
Science demands sacrifice, but where are the boundaries of that which is permissible? Where does research end and where does barbarism begin?
We are attempting to create an ideal being, but what the ideal is? Doesn't beauty really lie in imperfection?
The research has to continue!
Good afternoon, colleague! I'm studying the interactions of cyborgs and necrobeasts here...

name.en: What results have you managed to get?

text.en:
After all the night-long experiments, I've found that after reanimating the roots of swamp plants through necromancy and integrating them into the cyborg's prosthetics, this cyborg starts expressing emotions through grapevines.

They are capable of entangling everything around them and whispering poetic verses of the youth now gone. But unfortunately, the vines turned out too sensitive to compliments, and they cannot perform tasks unless they receive group praise.
Greetings, colleague! I'm studying the effects of plants on cybernetic flesh.

Our most recent experiments showed that if the rhythm of the cyborgs' heartbeats are matched with recitals of old necromantic grimoirs, the robobeasts start singing their own improvisations with the style resemling songs of Hickut's lesser throne halls.

Unfortunately, their musical predilections turned out far removed from the contemporary repertoire, but they led to the creation of a new genre that we have tentatively dubbed "astral folk".
Greetings, colleague. I'm trying to examine the interaction of necromancy and the newest Jeb technology...

During the biological experiments, I was creating the hybrid flesh of the cyborg's plating and the skull of an ancient Hickutean necromancer.

The result was astounding: the object thus received has learned to sing arias of the suffering of the legs encased in glass boots. Unfortunately, after one performance, it started demanding not just applause, but also gold as royalties. Otherwise it would descend into depression and start wrecking it mechanical limbs.
So glad to see you, colleague! My work is studying the effects of combining necromancy and the newest cybernetics...

name.en: What new data have you obtained?

text.en: Have a nice day, colleague! I'm busy studying the operation of prosthetics, and their interaction with the brain's bionic signals!

name.en: What have you managed to learn this week?

text.en:
Our bosses decided that our previous work was worthless! Remember how we used to study genetic mutations? Now, we're told to count the numbers of cells in samples. Who would have thought that we would be dubbed "A dome of complete nutjobs that do nothing at all" for daring to dream of something better?!

Here's my report...

name.en: What results have you managed to get this week?
What did you learn this week?

text.en:
They said our previous research was some kind of rubbish! We're doing a completely different job now!

When we were working on that project about astral folk, we had ambition! And now, looking at these endless tables of calculations, I realize that the bosses believe our previous work completely useless. How low have we sunk!

All the new data is on this Jeb-flash drive...

name.en: What new have you learned this week?
What new information has become available over this past week?

text.en:
Our program was significantly slashed!

It's all the same every day: microscopes, samples, records. I'm even starting to thin that my life is now an endless cycle of monotony. Where are the exciting experiments we've dreamt of? Every time I see a new project, I'm hoping it turns out to be something exciting. But instead, they give me a task for analyzing data, again and again. Don't we have any creative tasks left to do?

Here's the new data for you...

name.en: Looks like this is the effect of the beam...

text.en: We have to stop these creatures somehow... I'm sure the people in the Dome have their own means of control, but we will also have to deal with the Path of Poison Heretics! These nutjobs simply love all kinds of scaly critters, and they're eager to gather new types of mutants for their menageries!
Only some sort of miracle helped me with getting past all these snakes, toads, turtles and crocodiles!

It's not nearly the only place on the allod where strange things are happening! We've been watching the various suspicious activities that the Neguses are engaged in here... Even though we've managed to solve the outstanding issues with the Mana Station and the Library, things came to a head here... And the Cosmodrome is especially noted for questionable developments...

First off, let's arrest these criminals, and the we decide what to do next. The rest of the personnel will continue their work, and Sarang Kido will make sure they're not engaged in anything... prohibited!

Tell me when you're ready...
No, I can't do that yet...
I would've loved to believe, but too many things run contrary!

name.en: I want to take another part of the training course...

O5iris1 writes: Nedjeses, you can't imagine what's going on! It's like we're imprisoned here, these greedy owners don't let us out until we give all our hedj to them! I'm almost ready to wreck the comp to get outta here! I's just sebu, I can't take it anymore!

Anu8is5 writes: Hey, shasakhs, is anyone else stuck in this comp club, too? These isefeteans are holding us here like hostages! I'm a man on the edge now − I want to break free, but they're only willing to pick us clean to the last coin! It's just djut, help us!

P4_Mysteria writes: Nekhens, it's just total sebu here! We're sitting in this club like in a cage, and we can't get out until we give all our coin! These shuteans are getting fat at our expense! I'm ready to start a riot to break out of here!

Anu8is writes: Nedjeses, you won't believe it − they just threw us out of the capsule in the middle of the game! I was in the khrey ibe when these goons came and said: "Your time's up, get lost!" What the fegen?! What kind of sebu is that? I didn't even have the time to down my enemy!

H0rus_Hwk writes: Ooh, so you're not alone in this! I was also doing some hardcore sath kebat when they came and just turned off the comps! Is that normal at all?? We're here like it's a kind of zombie khahayt, and they're just sebeching and saying: "Pay for the time!" Let them all shove it up their khepedu!

Bast3t7 writes: Right, this is just djut! I thought we have a decent hebu here, but we got this kind of dirty tricks instead! How can they behave like this? I was just about to utes, but then these tahmus just akhuted everything! We've got to get back at them somehow so they know it's not how things should be done!

S3th_Power writes: Nekhens, can you believe we've been sitting here for like half a day, but no one's brought us the stuff we've ordered yet? This is djut plain and simple, how can they disregard their clients so bad? I'm ready to start a mutiny so these nedjeses might realize that we're not just here for show!

Hatsh3ps2 writes: Listen, it's a total ahku here! We've ordered food and drinks, but got zero and naught instead! Are these nekhens crazy or what? We're like zombies here, starving to death, and they're not moving a foot! I'm on edge now − either they give us food, or I'm leaving and taking this comp with me!

N4t_Shad writes: Hey, ickers, anyone else waiting for their snacks? Here, it's like a cinema by now − we're sitting without food or water, and these shuteans are simply shutting us out! I'm in rage now − how can they treat their clients so shoddily? We need to do something, otherwise we'll all kick the bucket with the lack of energy!

T0t_Star writes: Nekhens, you won't believe what's going on in our club! These robots have all gone crazy! I just sat at the comp when one of these came running up to me, and started dishing out electric shocks! Is that, like, Vanvaeck's decided to have fun again? What kind of fegen?!

Maa7_Soul writes: Yeah, tell me about it! I saw that too! These tin cans have no idea what "real talk" is! I tried to escape from them, but they went chasing after me like I was the last piece of food at the party! We got to band together somehow and fight back, or it's a complete shenu for us!

Amon_8kg writes: Right, this is just djut! I thought I was in a game, but it's a real sebu with robots here! Vanvaeck, are you completely daft or what? We're just playing here, not doing gladiator fights on the arena! Something has to be done pronto, or we're all getting electrocuted here!

Cleo2p6 writes: Nedjeses, you're not gonna believe this − I've just come into the comp club, and then my wallet was gone! I'm sure I just left it on the table, but it was as if it just got sucked into a black hole! Right, some greedy bastard's stolen it!

P4_Ra writes: Sehedjen, nedjes! It's djut, plain and simple! We have to get started in the detective mode and find the thieving bastard! Administration, where are you? All gone on vacations, huh? The wallet's not going to get itself found, sebech!

Sph1nx4 writes: It's a right hahrtakh, just sebu! I've also heard that someone's prowling around with wallets here! Hey, admins, are you asleep or what? Come on and find out who's the robber here! If you don't find 'em, I'll go and look by myself, 'cause I'm all going up in flames!

Khatkh0r8 writes: Nekhens, don't lose hope! But if someone really snatched it, he'll be a dead man walking! I know how everyone here looks, so if I see anyone with your wallet, I'll give him a "senebet sep, sweet crazy one!" Come on, let's join forces and make this club safer!

7eb_Life writes: Nedjeses, I'm standing here in this horrible long line to get to the Negus Council, and this is just djut! This terminal allows to hear the speeches of Tep, the God of Death...

This terminal allows to hear the speeches of Tep, the God of Death...

But first, you need to hear the previous part.

Like many of you, I was born mortal, among puny people, miserable in their thoughts and desires. Tiny people with tiny dreams. Ever since the moment in which I learned to tell the great from the fickle, I knew that the world was full of redundant people. They squirm in the dirt without daring to raise their gaze above it. They fear death, but they are too cowardly to escape it. "What kind of paltry gods must have created this world?", I thought - and started to hate them in that instant. Ever flawed, the flawed reflection of the eternal contradiction, the intoxicating joy for its imperfect creator: this was how I once perceived this world. Only one of the Gods was worth being worshipped, I thought: the one who touches all in the end. Nih, the God of Death.

Impatience leads to disappointment, and disappointment leads to weakness. The grand purpose, the true purpose of our civilization lay somewhere yonder, far ahead, like a mirage of an oasis... out of reach. Years were needed, but weak people were tired of waiting. They started yearning for the miracles of technology and believing in the power of metal.

I have not abandoned my search, even though I remained alone in my perseverance.

Our doctrine was once favored by the despots who ruled Hickut, but they were as paltry as the rest. They turned away from magic, instead preferring the tricks of the Mechanics and their leader, Ur.

An inventor and crafty artisan, he gave many of his toys to the people, build new palaces and abodes, and made possible that which was once unthinkable. And he was yearning for power... The ambitious Ur became my friend and comrade then, for he desired to combine his crafts and my arts. Together, we were ready to change Hickut.

You are becoming even more paltry, little people! You lessen and fracture, you lovers of comfort! You will yet perish because of the many petty virtues, tiny sins and that invariably trivial humility of yours!

Too much lenience, too much pliability - such is your soil. But for a tree to grow large, it must put down strong roots in the firm rock!

Even that which you miss helps with the creation of the fabric for the future of all mankind, even your Nothing is but a web and a spider who thrives on the blood of tomorrow.

I was choosing them from among the few worthy of going further. My work never once ceased, but the final mark was still distant.

That was the time when I was fed up of my wisdom - like a bee that has collected too much honey. And so, I needed hands reaching out to me.

I wanted to gift and grant, until the wisest of men would welcome their own madness again, and the poorest their riches.

And so I led them to the place where I gained my revelation. There, the shard of primordial Darkness holding all the power of Nih was concealed in the shadows.

For many long years I had been looking for answers, and so I have found them.

What puts the living apart from the dead, and the dead from the living, what is the essence that grants a modicum of spirit to the flawed flesh? What is the difference between the motionless rock and the running cheetah?

In order to find the answers to my questions, I had to sever the lives of many, many creatures during my studies. They were the necessary sacrifice that had to be taken for the sake of the grand purpose. Such was its fate, to become the support for the road that we would walk: I and my faithful followers.

But the source of any and all life was found: the Spark, the divine gift, the endless flame, the wellspring of energy. Each and every living creature possesses it, though it does not burn in all of them equally.

This fire kindles with time, but as the inevitable course of life runs past, it dwindles - though does not vanish altogether - petering out and becoming carried away by the great flow of magic.

We are all devoted to our great leader, Nefer Ur. Only he knows the plan of creating the New Reality which will allows us to completely remove all threats to our people and deal with Tep. The divine power concentrated in the eidos from the Citadel will allow us to do that which even the boldest mind could not have dreamed of.

Once I spent a huge amount of time studying the anomalies on the Coba Plateau. That was precisely because we had already encountered something similar here, on Xadagan... And ever since Nefer Ur started work on the Wireframe project and installed powerful devices collecting energy from the Astral, it was a matter of time before artifacts of Darkness would start materializing. Of course, Xadagan was no less affected by the Plague than the Coba Plateau: the hardest blow was aimed right here... Artifacts might be a very useful help to us, so we ought to look out for them...

I've heard a rumor here: they said there was no flight, but I and my brother simply filmed all of that in our "Illusion"! But I think you will be able to see it's not so! We're only documenting the events that have happened!

At last someone's bothered to create the Divine Observatory! Right now, we only need to fill it with the information that we, the Historians, have collected! It was our studies of the legacy of Junes, after all, that allowed us to learn where Tep has found that shard of Darkness! Now, when the legends of Junes have been collected and systemized, we know with certainty how Sarn, Nihaz and all of the other Gods were involved in this story! Yes, even those worshipped by these insane cultists!

Hah, fools! Your understanding is so limited... I am the oldest of the Arisen, and the only one who remembers how it all really happened! I have seen the June Curse, I witnessed Peraach and Bathory, I talked with Tep and Ur... I could have told you a great deal, but I'm not going to speak to you of anything, you wretches!

Greetings! Yes, I have left Eden as well. I don’t understand why anyone asks the question: whether the Arisen are capable of feelings... For years and years, I have been searching for my beloved Nefertiti... But I was unable to find her either in this world or any other... What am I supposed to do, how do I become reunited with her, what is the unfortunate reason for my inability to find her - and for my suffering? You know, it is easy to start believing in almighty Fate that governs every creature's destiny! What kind of life has it ordained for me?

One of the reasons I am here is that the allod must be defended against a probable enemy. I've heard that you have already encountered Tep's Cultists. Have you noticed the tactics they've been using? Small bands infiltrating through unregistered portals. Why is that? Because our shores are securely defended by the Empire's Astral fleet! And the League, may they get a cannonball up their hole, has volunteered to help with patrolling. Sure, we agreed to that, but we're not allowing them to get anywhere close...

I am the expert of necromancy! Here, in the Dome, I and my colleagues are making new discoveries in a practical sense. We can say that we've progressed so far in our studies of life and death that we were able to meld them into something of a middle ground! The practical results are encouraging, too - a new formula for protoblood, artificial synthetic organs, new substances to inject the Arisen's tissues with...

Listen, citizens! If you dream of justice and defending the order, I have a perfect offer for you! Muneph costumes are not just things to wear, they're your chance to become heroes! Put on our costume and feel the power of the law!

Hey, dark souls! Take a look inside my store, where Darkness itself meets modern fashion! We have unique sekhem costumes that would turn you into the king - or the queen - of the night! Black lace, leather insets and skull-decorated accessories - all of that and more is waiting for you! Don't miss the chance to stand out from the grey mass!

Hello, nekhens! If the freedom of expression is what you're after, and you are looking for a style that follows no rules, then welcome! I have the unique apparel here, one that allows you to be yourself. Let's make the world more diverse, together!

Hello, my melancholic friends! If you are looking for a style reflecting the storm within your souls, then you have come to the right place! We have everything here, from form-fitting T-shirts with profound inscriptions to vivid accessories that highlight your personality. Allow your inner world to shine through!

Greetings to all the adventurers! Are you tired of walking on foot? We have scooters for every kind of taste! Lightweight, fast and convenient, they will make your journeys across Xadagan's ancient streets completely unforgettable. Rent one today and enjoy the freedom of movement! The rental time is practically indefinite, 999 years!

Hey you, lovers of speed and freedom! I have the motorcycle that will give you the real feeling of wind in your hair! This beauty is not just a vehicle, but a living beast with its own soul! It will help you conquer the streets of New Hickut comfortably!

Greetings, explorers of space! I have the cosmonaut suits for those who wish to conquer the stars! These suits will grant you safety and style in any adventures beyond our planet. Are you ready for the flight?

Greetings, seekers of history! I am offering you unique artifacts from ancient Hickut, just unearthed from the graves! Each item is a piece of history. Take a fragment of the past with you, and give it a new lease on life... in your wardrobe!

Hey, enthusiasts of the future's technologies! I got hoverboards here - a veritable gift for anyone who has ever dreamed of flying over the sands of Xadagan! Forget about traffic jams and long walks. Jump on the board and soar to new heights!

Ha-ha! Greetings to you! I am Semer Sanera, and I have something truly special here - a Zombie Kitty! He has returned from the dead and gained unique abilities. Take him with you and give him a chance to become your trusty companion!

Greetings to you, laborers! If you need a high-quality working attire, you have come to the right place! Our costumes are both durable and convenient. They will help you work comfortably and keep up the style. Don't miss the opportunity to refresh your wardrobe! And now, buy it and off you go to work!
Hey, adventure seekers! I have a riding unicycle - which not just a mount, but a whole world of fun! Easy to control and stylish, it will become a trusty companion in your journeys all over Xadagan!

Greetings, my dear friends! In our factory, we have excellent machines for work and entertainment. They are both reliable and powerful - perfect for any kind of task! Come visit me and pick your own ideal helper!

What's there to explain?

 There's war on our doorstep. Demons, League, some other arch... ah, Tep take it!

 Anyway, war makes some people rich.

 The Free Traders supply the best weapons. We sell them. But if you give some dolt an astral cannon, they can only hammer nails with it.

 So you need to find someone skilled to make us some profit and do good for the world.

 So we arranged a Marathon – 30 days and 30 quests, and those can do it will receive a reward!

And don't be afraid - we're not so cruel as to make you do everything! You can skip a couple of difficult quests - you will still receive the best reward as long as you have enough coins!

It's easy – just come to me every day and pick up a task, and I'll give you a coin! In the end, you will buy prizes and be happy. Just keep in mind that the task can be completed only on the same day – we do not tolerate delays!

We prepared a special task for each day, so don't skip them!

Nihaz's spies are everywhere – how does one decide who can be trusted and who should be feared?
