text.en: I worry about them more than myself! It's not that...
The Orc shuffles his feet, uncertain.

name.en: Think how much respect it will earn you when they hear about the monster you fought!

text.en: What? No, I'm not afraid to die...
Fury is stunned but still breathing. She was the first to rush into battle...

name.en: What do you need to do to avoid dying from the heat?

text.en:
Firstly, and simply: drink water. Drink a bottle - and the heat will recede!

Secondly, you should rest in shelters where jinns are. They are kind, and their magic protects them from the heat.

Thirdly, take a swim. The water - inside or outside - combats the heat well.

Finally, stay in settlements. In camps and cities, the heat is not an issue.

It's all very simple. Got it?
Then go to the desert and do your thing - and if you get hot, grab a bottle and have a drink. Once you're done, come back. The tasks you have to give heroes sometimes... Amazing.

name.en: What did you want to talk about?

text.en:
In short, I'm from the future! Don't look so surprised. Time travel is not fantasy, but reality!

The thing is, you are going to have certain problems in the future, and I'm here to fix everything. But I need your help!

For starters, we'll have to travel to the future ourselves and stop a certain someone from making an irredeemable mistake. Listen to me carefully and follow my instructions, and everything will be alright.

We're going to the future. When we get there, I'll help you disguise yourself. Your task is to help me slow down the heroes that are particularly active in that time.

But they really are heroes, not villains. They were just... deceived. So they have to be stopped before they do irreparable damage.

So, do you know anything about the pioneers? Yes, they wear red ties and dream of building a bright Imperial future. It doesn't matter if you are the League or the Empire - you'll have to spend some time as a pioneer!

I knew I could count on you! In addition to saving the world, you will also get decent rewards that will help you in your own time! Now go through the portal. You'll receive further instructions when you get there.
I think we have something to discuss...
How did you end up here...?
Wait, I need to insert the crystals...
Oh, you...! Let me calibrate it properly, or I'll throw you into a volcano!

I'm going to smack you...!

...Yes, it's done! Go to the stele in the center, place your hand on it, and focus. I'll do the rest.

name.en: Where am I...? The Orcs are everywhere...Why?

text.en: Wait... You're not the Legendary Orc. You are not even an Orc! And you look pathetic!

name.en: Where am I...? The Orcs are everywhere...Why?

text.en:
The Legendary Orc is testing us!

We started the rebellion just as the prophecy foretold! We overthrew the Xadaganian dogs, gathered everyone, and went to the desert, to the old ship landfill. This is where the new dawn of the Orcs' freedom will come! And we have a proper seer now, the old Shaman Kurgan! He foretold that the Legendary Orc with magical powers will come from this portal... Well, that's you!

What are your orders...?
Hmm... the Legendary Orc wouldn't say something like that... Are you really them...?
Hmm... the Legendary Orc wouldn't say something like that... Are you really them...?
Hmm... the Legendary Orc wouldn't say something like that... Are you really them...?
Legendary Orc, you're with us...! Though you look... Strange. What can you tell us?

It was easy! Of course, we're young Imperial enthusiasts, we never sit idly! A strange substance has recently appeared in the desert. It's called the Ambrosia. I went to study it... but then I was captured by these... oddly dressed fellows.

I'm Alice. A young exobiologist from a biology club. I came to Suslanger like everyone else - to spend a vacation in the famous pioneer camp "Dune", so when the portals went down, I got stuck here like all the others.

name.en: You said something about being in the same boat...?

text.en:
Your ears work fine, it seems! Let's see if the rest of you is up to snuff...

Yes, this morning I realized I've been stuck here for too long. I need to leave, and I suspect you're not planning to stick around either.

Now here's the thing. I can break the lock on the cage, it's just a few screws and wires. But the local Orcs are a different matter. They might be poorly organized, but they're strong. In daylight, they'll grab us easily...

name.en: I'm the Hero of Sarnaut! I can handle a few Orcs!

text.en:
Right... I'm sure.

No, we can't do that. These Orcs are not villains, and they do more good than harm... They just lack self-awareness. What kind of hero kills everyone who gets in their way?

...No, I think we can get out of here without any casualties. We must do it this way.

name.en: Hm... Fine, so what do we do?

text.en:
Wait until nightfall, of course!

...But there's another problem. Our cage is guarded by a really diligent Orc - you won't believe it, but he's actually vigilant day and night! He's standing aboard the ship right above me, see?

That's where I'll need your help. You'll distract him while I'll break the lock, and we'll get out... Then we'll improvise!

name.en: How do I distract him and still get out of the cage afterwards?

text.en: If I knew, I'd be hopping across the desert right now... Think of something!

name.en: I think I have an idea...

text.en:
Your ghost partner? Yeah, I noticed... You have interesting friends!

I think it might work. But even that trick won't help you during the day... Let's wait for the right time and begin.

name.en: Erfar! How did you get here?

text.en:
I've been thinking... what would I do on Gipat? I have no one to wait for, and then there's you... and adventures... I'm not that ancient yet, I might still be of use!

I see you're in trouble? At least you have a friend!

name.en: Erfar, do you know how to... distract people?

text.en:
I'm a ghost! People will pay attention to me if I want them to. Why do you ask... Ooh!

I get it, you need me to help you escape!

Of course I'll help. We're pals after all. Just point me to where you need me, and I'll pop right up... for seven seconds! In that time, everyone nearby will forget about you... Let's test it on the guard near the cage?
Well, hello!

Hey, I'm test-driving cars here, can't you see?

There's a lot of stuff piled up around here, you can put anything together, but first you need to figure out what's what! Get it?

I test drive vehicles, but nothing ever works as it should. Things keep breaking, because everything is jumbled up together. There's no order!
Ugh, why do they keep breaking...
They definitely won't spot us here...

Ah, this? That's just common jinn magic, you'll get properly acquainted with it later.

It's Jinn's Shadow, hides you from anything in the world... Especially from danger.

I borrowed it from a friend in the desert. There are more impressive things out there, trust me!

What can I tell an outsider? Spend some time here, then we'll talk.

I know every local here, and they know me. I'm always happy to help them if there's trouble, and it's the same for them.

I don't care what's happening outside the city - we're too busy maintaining order within our walls... We don't have many guards, and now there's some kind of eruption, then it's the crystals, then thieves... Anyway, less talking, more doing!
The Hero of Sarnaut, you say? We'll see...

I don't even know what to tell you... I'm doing my best trying to stay on top of things! First some merchants arrived, then the incident happened, then a wounded traveler was brought in...

The city is part of the desert, you understand? We have to pay attention to everything around us. We barely have time for ourselves...
Hello! I'm glad to see you!

Well, I... Study. Everything unusual. I used to study jinns before, and now, after the Incident, it's the Ambrosia... There is so much we haven't discovered yet, even among the things we're used to, you know?

I can't say I'm doing really well, but it's a long process - changing the world with your discoveries. Perhaps I'll succeed when I'm old...

But it's particularly hard right now - after I blew up a city district, everyone turned away from me...

It was a pure accident!

I thought Ambrosia explosives were like the Ambrosia, that they would make everything better with their energy! I should have studied the incident carefully...

It turned out an explosion of Ambrosia doesn't affect the living, but everything inorganic gets blown to bits. At least no one got injured, or else they would have kicked me out of the city...
Hmm.. Why didn't I think of this before?

Darn it! Who the hell is this Alice?

I have no idea! I swear!

You might have noticed that she's very much like me. But I'll be damned if I know who she is and where she came from. I suppose, it's just another of Nihaz's tricks. He has a sick 'sensahuma.'

You and I both know one thing: she's clearly lying, trying to buy time. I'm almost completely sure that it was Alice who stole the chronophone. It should be at the pioneer camp.

What choice do we have? All we can do is enter the game. Just like back at the Holy Land where we were looking for Sparks. Well... rather, you were looking for Sparks, and I was rooting for you.

Pioneers accept anyone in their ranks nowadays. It doesn't matter whether you're young or old, belong to the League or the Empire. Such is the time we live in. I don't expect any difficulties for you and Skulnar to blend in. And after you do... there's no mystery that can't be solved by the greatest hero of Sarnaut and the best mystic orc, also known as the chief of the Horde. Research, dig up every tiny detail of Alice's life and history, and find that chronophone!

I've already made an appointment with the superintendent. Get to the Dune right away.
You'd better speak with Eladia. She's got a plan.
As a superintendent, I know everything about everyone. What exactly do you want to know?
Hm... let me see. She joined shortly after the Incident. Other pioneers stumbled upon her in the city. She told them that she was all alone, no papers, no family. So they invited her to join.

She's a member of the pioneer troop three if I remember correctly. Not the best troop in terms of discipline, but we have what we have. They had an opening, so they took her. You want to look for her next to their lodgings. Even if they're out, you will surely see them at the pioneer lineup.

name.en: Why did you let Alice join?

text.en: Why wouldn't I? We allow everyone, who can keep discipline and wishes to become a pioneer. Besides, as far as I was informed, she was left behind in the Old City after the portals were closed. You know, there aren't a lot of places to stay, except the pioneer camp. The city is full of tourists. And the Sanatorium is on another allod. Back in the day they were going to build it next to the pioneer camp but changed their mind. Didn't want to spoil the view. There are no more ships.
I'm busy doing Nina's quest. Go and ask around about Alice and the chronophone. I'll find you when it's time, hah.
I respect pioneers that train one skill a million times, not one million different skills. Well, a million times might be an overkill...

name.en: You want to know about the workout?

text.en: It's easy. I show you a move, you repeat it. Three times, to reinforce. Seven moves total. Once you're done, the workout is completed.
Another day, another lineup. Oh, what an endless pioneer cycle...

name.en: What happens during lineups? What's my duty?

text.en:
Hasn't Nina told you? Or did you simply forget? Alright, listen.

First of all, we do a roll call and a headcount during lineups. Say "ME!" every time you hear your name.

Second, we have a problem with the pioneer troop number two. They're always telling each other stupid jokes, making a lot of noise. Stand next to them and block their attempts.

Third, if you let the lineup be disrupted, I'll have to kick you out.

Got it?

Beverages:

 • Xadaganian kefir. 1% fat.

 • Cappuccino.

 • Sweet cranberry compote.

Main course:

 • Goat barbecue, Suslanger style.

 • Bacon crisps with sour cream.

 • Hashbrowns with green peas.

Soups:

 • Red borscht, meat broth.

 • Cheese soup.

 • Sorrel soup, vegetable broth.
Oh, hey! What are you doing here?
Go now.
We have three troops in the camp. Which one do you want to hear about?

Troop number one is named after Timur Garain, one of the first pioneer of the era before the demonic invasion. Nezeb himself put a triangular scarf on his neck!

There's a curious tradition in the first squad: all members bear the names of legendary pioneer heroes, Suslanger defenders during the demonic invasion. They also wear their weapons and uniforms. As per usual, there are only five outstanding pioneers in this group. Now there's also Katya Rysina. She's very persistent in her studies, work, and sport achievements.

I am the leader of the first troop.

Troop number two is named after Pavel Morozin, another famous pioneer.

It's one of the biggest troops that consists of multiple smaller units. All newcomers join the second troop, including Skulnar and you. Samantha de Delice is a member of the second group. She's a goodwill ambassador, strengthening international cooperation. She represents her aunt Antoinette, who signed a friendship and au-pair agreement with Yasker. Many of our pioneers are visiting Ignis resorts and meeting people of the League.

Anton Kuznetsov is the leader of the second troop.

Troop number three is named after Mishka Kvakin, Timur's sidekick and comrade.

Unfortunately, there are pioneers that don't respect order. Yes, even here, in our beautiful camp! Comrade Dynin decided to gather the likes of them in the third troop to avoid harmful impact on others. Alice is a member of the third troop as well.

Olga Dmitrina is the leader of the third troop.
And I'm floating in a most peculiar way And the stars look very different today

name.en: How did you get to the Dream Factory?

text.en: Recommended by Comrade Rysina for joining this creative group.

name.en: You don't look like a Xadaganian to me.

text.en: Hah! You have a good eye. When you work for the City Council, this tiny discrepancy works out fine. Anything that allows to raise less suspicions. I can't tell you more. Even though you're a Sarnaut hero, sometimes ignorance truly is bliss.

I'm a screen and voice-over actor for Motion Stories at the Dream Factory. Bobbing and weaving, so to say. I can imitate the voice of almost any person in Sarnaut. It's just my hobby. I used to work for the City Council, so impersonations have come into habit. I can be all that someone else can be.
The name's Andrei Sokolov. Culture department officer.
You can start.

name.en: What were you arguing about with the script writer?

text.en: Them scribblers are incredibly stiff. They love colorful phrases and long dialogues. According to them, otherwise there's no artistic value. Ugh, what a rusty scrivener! I'm no Tarkovskin.
What a surprise! Buckwheat porridge is exceptional today.

name.en: You have a weird name. Are you sure you're one of Zem?

text.en: It isn't my real name. But it's a long story that began back at Hickut times. I'd rather keep it to myself if you don't mind. It's... personal. Some day I will shoot a movie about it. When I'm famous.

name.en: But there's no buckwheat at the cafeteria.

text.en: There isn't any at the pioneer camp. At our Factory, we have plenty. I have some in reserve.

name.en: What else are you busy with?

text.en: Apart from Motion Stories? This and that. We're trying something new. Ask Yaver Skel.

name.en: What are you doing on Suslanger?

text.en: A new project. Just picture this: metal... sand dunes... monocycles... and orcs! A whole horde of orcs! Starring Max Madman! It's going to be legen... (wait for it) ...dary! Legendary!
I'm Sarang Siatum, the motion story master, at your service. I'm the Dream Factory director. Ever heard of it? What?! Make sure to visit it at Igsh. The pavilions and backdrops are mind-blowing.

All directors care about is special effects! The more the better! They can sell their soul for the wow-effect! But we aren't making eye-candies for dumb ogres, you know? I have no idea how to explain to that mummy that whatever we show on the screen must be logical, meaningful, and conscious. Otherwise we risk degenerating to Tarantinin's level.

Phew. I should have poked the actor with a chopstick. What a drowsy mug...

What? Don't mind me. Just thinking aloud. Or... plotting. Hehe.

name.en: How did you get to the Dream Factory?

text.en:
Invited by the project lead. At first, I helped design the stage, but then got to write screenplays. Now we're having real shitsto... I mean, creative discussions. But I deliver quality alright.

It's ironic that I was recommended by Sarang Clownie, who is my main opponent. We do find solutions, of course. Even though our approaches are similar, our backgrounds are too different to just agree with one another.

name.en: Is it me or your name isn't typical for a Zem?

text.en:
Yes, it is. It's a nickname.

"Ele" reflects my love to modifications ever since Hickut. Guess who else loves modifies? Elves, of course. How could I miss the reference? It's a nice smile of self-mockery. Unlike elves, I'm more practical. Have you seen Zem healer's uniform? Yes, I'm talking about the one with extra probes. That's one of my modifications.

Thanks to such designs, I was promoted to the Hadron Quarter head and earned the title "Negus."

As to the "Lary" part, it appeared due to the Imperial bureaucratic system. The way they translated a Hickut surname... I don't think that the clerk was even aware that a similar word, meaning "immortality," existed in the Hickut language. Fitting, right? But then again, why not?
I'm writing screenplays for movies. I choose the locations, pick costumes, sometimes even act. Having Incarnations, it would be weird to stick to the same role.

I'm a screenwriter. A mean little Necromancer. Actors can tell you a lot about me being mean. It's only natural. If you act without putting your soul to it, someone has to suffer. So it's either spectators, who watch bad acting, or the actor, who has to repeat scenes over and over again. I take the latter and get a result. And if it's a complete failure, I can always resurrect the actor and make them try again.
Not such a good day.

name.en: How did you get to the Dream Factory?

text.en: It was our screenwriter's idea. They needed a Kanian for the Memories movie. So they invited me, the native Imperial. Weird, huh? But I was so convincing that even the director loved me. Given that he and the screenwriter don't agree so often. So...

I act in accordance with screenplay. Sometimes I just act weird. Most often, I'm a Kanian, but I can also be an Aoidoi, a Priden, or an Orc. But I'll pass on playing an Elf.

Unless it's a girl-elf... never mind me. It's personal!
An actor. Sometimes I can be a tech consult. Bad-tempered. Married. Unstable.

Greetings, comrade. Nawlad Ipaty is my name. By the doings of Destiny, my name rhymes with that of the greatest Director of all times, whose Show is described in textbooks. Yes, you're right, Nihaz is our enemy, but that doesn't cancel my admiration of his merits on stage. By the way, he founded the Heroic Path genre that is now so popular.

name.en: How did you get to the Dream Factory?

text.en: Just the same as I run into any other kind of trouble. One night, I was hanging out in a tavern, drinking tea, telling my stories to whoever wanted to hear them. It turned out that one of the guys I spoke with was the Factory head. He liked my story, so he invited me in a motion story for starters. After realizing that we work well together, the story began.

Uh... There's place on a faraway allod, in the thicket, where I work. It's called Merry Bummer Tavern. I'm the owner, the waiter, and the entertainer. The tavern is literally my home. There's no other way. I can't leave it for long. It's a lure to thieves. As I live and guard it, I have a very short talk with the thieves. But my door is always wide open for honest people. I love serving people and telling them stories. After all, I'm happy to feel less lonely myself!

name.en: What are you doing on Suslanger?

text.en: Doing my job. I'm an actor. I received an offer to take part in a movie. They mentioned it would be orc-styled or something. The main character is some crazy orc, and there's gonna be a bloodbath. You know, I didn't really read into it. I just do what I'm told and start arguing only if something goes wrong.

I'm a backup actor doing gigs at the Dream Factory now and then. My more experienced fellows have better skills but there can't be too many helpers in our line of work. I work at the tavern in my free time. Without blowing my horn, I serve the best tea in all Sarnaut.
Have you ever given a thought to what the cinema does to us and what we can do to the cinema?

name.en: Now I see where you got Kanians and Elves from. It looks too realistic to be make-up.

text.en:
Speaking about interaction, I also mean the environment. We prefer location shooting. But there's no way we could shoot in Novograd. Almost all our actors are Imperials. We invite people from the League only occasionally.

Yes, don't act surprised. I can tell you a secret as a Sarnaut hero: we even have incarnations of the League guys. How? I can't tell you that, sorry. It's the City Council's know-how. Even a hardened hero with a high security clearance can't know it all. Yours is high but not high enough.

Having Incarnations, it would be weird not to use them. For diversity, for a better understanding of each team member's tasks... Each specializes in something and helps other if the task requires. Almost all our people do that.

name.en: Your name doesn't sound like it's Xadaganian.

text.en: It's a publicity bait. See? Even you swallowed it. Can you imagine what it does to fans? They're wrecking their brains whether I'm Nickolay, Nickita, or even Nickifor or Nickanor! Interest toward me means interest toward our crew. What does interest translate to? That's right, money. It all boils down to me taking care about my people.

name.en: I don't remember any of you at the Dream Factory on Igsh.

text.en:
Of course. When did you go there last time? At the times of Asee-Teph battle, I'm sure. Maybe you even had to fight on the Misty Slope.

The motion stories were new back then. We only gathered the first team that had to shoot a movie to promote ideology. Times have changed. Today the motion story is one of the most important forms of art. Thanks to the Progress, the whole production cycle is well-oiled and functioning, so to say. After the Empire and the League signed the peace treaty, we decided to gather another crew.

name.en: How did your crew come to be?

text.en:
After the first public success and the peace treaty, the City Council approved this experiment. I talked to one of the top men... sorry, I can't give you his name or any other details. Classified.

They wanted me to put together another crew that would be less constrained. Entertaining, artistic, educational... I was even allowed to interact with the League if required by a project!

I'm the leader of this merry cir... ahem, I mean, the creative crew, of course. "Art to the masses," so to say.

To think that only recently we didn't have any motion stories, or manavision, or Illusions in ordinary households. All we had was a rattling gramophone, street lighting, and old binoculars to peep on a cute neighbor across the street. But progress can't be stopped. Progress in the full meaning of the word! And my crew and I are driving it! Only due to the Progress we have the Motion Stories now. We have our own little secrets, of course.

name.en: Is it yours? Where's the SACK, Trunk?

text.en:
What...? What sphere? Oh, fine...

You can have it. I wanted to start shooting manavids, but I guess it wasn't meant to be... But you treated me with nothing but kindness, even brought me food. So here, take it.

Just don't tell them I took it, alright? The Factory people won't understand. Tell them Alice took it. She'll get away with it. She even plays a role in that movie.

name.en: Here you go. One of your actresses had it.

text.en:
Oh, you've found it! Let me have it, quick! Oooh, it's intact! Wait. An actress, you say? Now that's not good at all. We don't show our work to the cast before the premier night. Otherwise they'll be unhappy with what we shot. And I don't want to deal with "ooooh, my legs don't look good in this scene, let's get another take on that." I hate it. I hope, she gave you nothing of the sort. Good, good.

Ugh. Alright, at least, now we have the SACK. Now we need to assemble the device. Will you help me?
Hey, welcome to my lair, make yourself at home... if you find room. Choose a place in the shadow. Suslanger is scorching hot. I even had to take my armored hoodie.

name.en: How did you get to the Dream Factory?

text.en: Well, the cameraman needed a break and the culture department needed to execute the plan. So they've been looking and asking around and they saw my works. One of them was a storyboard for a made-up movie. And it suddenly occurred to them, what if they draw each frame and then shoot it? That's something new for the Motion Stories. So we started working together. And then then cameraman returned. We're working together now.

name.en: What's with the name? It doesn't sound like any other Zem name.

text.en:
It's a nickname I got after the Opening of the Eyes procedure.

Those who hired me have never heard of the Arisen before. They noticed that I was skinny, and one of the clerks was, like, "He's as slender as a skeleton! He's the king of skeletons!" My feelings were hurt but only just a little. After all, he was merely stating the obvious. That's how I got the nickname Skel.

It's also way handier to sign pictures using one short nickname. I decided to keep it. I got used to it anyway.
[Skel shows you his posters. Some of them are funny. On one of them you see Catherina and an Eclipse engineer. On another, a mage fiercely fights a violent Demon Kamikaze.]

name.en: Your position sounds fancy. Never heard of anything like this before.

text.en: Mananimation is a recent invention. It's a motion story, where everything is drawn. Actors only record voice-overs for their characters. You might have seen a couple of trailers. The audience loved them! So we decided to keep it up.

I'm a mananimator. I'm drawing fun posters, leaflets, and sketches. I even publish my own magazine. It's called "Skel's corner." You can take a look if you like.

I'm also working for the Dream Factory. They wanted to try the new format. People call it "mananimation" or "mananimated cartoons."

I came back from a spa treatment... And discovered that almost every crew member uses a nickname. Not their real names. You've been shaking hands, not knowing who they actually are...

Now I know why this job is so hard - I have to work with creative people! That's the effect of the treatment! Life can throw funnier insights at you.

name.en: How did you get to the Dream Factory?

text.en:
I once saw a news host on manavision show showing life in Sarnaut. Battles, journeys, fates... you might know the announcer. Later on, he worked with the Goblin Banker, announcing new collectible bundles.

He impressed me very much. He was so eager to tell everything that I fell like show everything that was going on in Sarnaut. At that time, the Dream Factory was hiring a cameraman, so I thought, why not?

I'm a cameraman, I deal with the camera, testing how my actors and I can tolerate stress. And when I'm done, I grab my big scissors and begin to cut. And glue. The footage requires a steady hand, the ability to choose, and a creative approach. When I said "cut," I meant I could cut any slacker there is, hehe.

Did I mention stress tolerance? It's really getting on my nerves.
I'm Konstantin Ulitin. Working for the greater good of the Motion Stories. Sometimes I have to go on sedatives, but only a little.

name.en: Do you know where the blueish sphere is? The Dream Factory brought it with them and lost it here.

text.en: I saw someone taking it to the south-east. The lead pioneer might know something.

name.en: Do you happen to know where the blueish sphere is? I'm trying to find it asap. The cameraman is getting nervous.

text.en: I know what you're talking about but I have no idea where it is. I suspect that the pioneer troop leader might know something. My psychic powers have never let me down.

name.en: Well, if you have abilities, you can tell where the sphere is, right?

text.en: Of course! I mean, no... Oh. I'm still working on my extrasensory abilities. And someday I'll learn to control them...
You, too!

name.en: You don't know anything about the Dream Factory's blueish sphere?

text.en: I don't know? I don't know?! I know everything around here! I'm a pioneer troop leader, after all. Ask the Superintendent, special objects are his responsibility.
...the SACK object? That's right! It was taken to the first cabin to the left of the camp entrance, where the Dream Factory is.
Hello! Is it time already?
Ah, it's you. We're chilling out here.
So we meet again.
Great! You're here! I'm beside myself! So nervous! So?

name.en: What do I need to do?

text.en: I want to give a speech before the start. You know our pioneers. They love making noise, disturb the peace, and break the order. I get very nervous when I'm interrupted. If I stutter three times, I'll have to start over again. Can you please watch them? Hush them if they make noise. Okay? And then we get to watch the motion history together.
That was fun.

There's a neat pile of clean underwear: white socks, stockings, bows, and other girl stuff.

You go deeper to find a strange object and some green dust.
Contains all sorts of pioneers' things.
There's a neat pile of clean underwear: white socks, stockings, bows, and other girl stuff.

There's a pile of paper scraps, crayons, dried candy.

You keep searching to find a strange object and some green dust.
Contains all sorts of pioneers' things.
There's a pile of paper scraps, crayons, dried candy.

Full of pioneer uniforms. Some of them are brand new. There's also Alice's hiking suit.

You go deeper to find a strange object and some green dust.
Contains all sorts of pioneers' things.
Full of pioneer uniforms. Some of them are brand new. There's also Alice's hiking suit.

name.en: Can you tell me where Alice is staying?

text.en: She took the small cabin to the right from the entrance. Opposite the Dream Factory cabin.
How is it going?
Let's do it.
Something went wrong... Let's get you out!
So you've found me, now what?
A chronophone? What chronophone? I've no idea what you're talking about. I know nothing, I've heard nothing, I've seen nothing. There's nothing to talk about.

Hah! Don't hold your breath! I don't know anything! I just went out for a stroll. So I'm... you know, strolling around, here and there. We're playing hide-and-seek. Ever heard of it? Beat it. Don't be in my way.
What? Who? Speak up! Or look for someone else. My ears are plugged, I can't hear a sound.
I can't see you, I can't hear you. Move it.
Who are you? What brought you here? Beat it. We aren't allowed to talk to strangers.

Still trying, huh? How many answers did you find? How many people did you talk to? Five? Do I get it right? Take my advice, buddy, mind your own business. There's nothing you can do about it. And take your orc with you. All he ever does is eats, eats, eats. There's no place for the likes of him in our ranks.

No one expels you formally. But you aren't one of us, either.
The sun is scorching. You need to hurry.
Why the long face? Did you expect to see someone else here?

name.en: Please, grant me the ability to see tracks on the sand.

text.en: My dear young friend, fire of my life, juice of my apple! Your wish is music to my ears, like muezzin's call in the Old Town. Beware! Such power attracts unwanted attention! While you have this blessing on you, you will be attacked by jinns and defenders of the Court of Miracles!

name.en: Wise jinn, if you could kindly tell me where to find the girl Alice with the intricate device known as chronophone.

text.en: Pit of my peaches, water of my river! You're asking the old jinn the right question! I do not know where the chronophone is. Even I can't know that. But finding the girl named Alice is in my power. I will give you the eyes of the wind, the eyes of the desert! You will see all that you need to see! Follow the footsteps of your friend. The first tracks are right here. She was visiting the old man, too. I wish I could have helped her.
So we have a deal? Don't you try to deceive me. Words have a great meaning where there's a great power behind them.

name.en: I need to find Alice. On what conditions?

text.en:
Huh, another deal! Life truly consists of black and white. Although I'm somewhere in the middle.

It doesn't matter though. I can help you with finding Alice. All I need in exchange is your word. A promise. A partnership agreement, as the Free Traders put it.

Deal?

name.en: What are you doing here? And where's Alice?

text.en:
Alice? Alice, Alice... Alice here, Alice there. Everybody needs an Alice. I wonder why. No one wonders what the poor girl needs.

And I did. And I have the answer. I think I can help. Not for free, of course. This isn't charity.

So our deal is simple. She wanted to get away. Erfar and I wanted the heart of a dragon. You see, thanks to the dragon blood that I got from Nezeb, I was immortal. But his descendants forgot our agreement. Erfar needs the heart to return to the living. Alice promised to get it.

Sounds fair. I completed my part of the deal... unlike her.
So she hasn't believed me, after all. Haha! Even if I had that heart, I would never give it to Erfar.

Alice's story is over.

I'll try something else. There's always hope. Actually, hope is everything we have.
Yes, we need to make things right. I postponed it for as long as I could.

How ignorant can you be? You've had the reply right in front of your eyes the whole time.

I'm Klavdia! Her Reincarnation, to be exact. From the future. The present-me has no idea that I'm about to create another Reincarnation.

I'm not too observant. Even I couldn't tell that me was me.

Still don't believe me?  I remember ordering you to find out who Alice was. I didn't know or realize it back then.

Trust me, a lot is going to happen before I become Alice.

name.en: What? Why did you even... why did you have to steal the chronophone?

text.en:
Hah, we're getting closer. I can't change my own future. But I can change YOURS.

Trust me, the future that awaits you... I wouldn't want it for anyone. Anyone, you hear me?

You must not open the Gates! You must not search for my mother! And most importantly, you must not trust my sister!

Yes.

If you disobey me, and I know you will, Sarnaut is doomed. Not the Darkness, but Life itself will become its tombstone. Can I change what's happened to me?

Who am I? Must I exist in your timeline? I'm just an anomaly, neither dead nor alive, stuck between existence and non-existence. By changing the past, I'm deleting myself. I don't have the divine immortality any longer. Any death would be final. I've torn the thread of my fate.

Only one issue remains.
Do you believe me or not?

That's too bad!

But you'll have to learn that I was right. It's time to say goodbye now.

Fine.

Try to convince me from your time that I'm telling the truth. It's time to say goodbye now.
You've got the right to hear the answers.

name.en: What are the Court of Miracles and the Brotherhood of the Last Shelter?

text.en:
Look around. This is the Court of Miracles.

Each allod has one. Have you ever seen a beggar? All of them are working for me. They're physically healthy, only pretending to be sick and injured. As they return to their shelters, their injuries disappear by magic. Hence the Court of Miracles.

Although mine is truly mind-blowing.

As to the Brotherhood... I've always needed someone to guard the ruins and Nezeb's treasures in the sands. Exiles, outcasts, and rebels are a perfect fit. They've been serving me for centuries, thinking that they're rebelling against authorities.

name.en: Tell me about your agreement with Nezeb.

text.en:
I give him information and support in exchange for the immortality. You already know about the Great Mages' Ambassadors. Those who aren't mages but who had dragon blood. You're one of them, but as you know, the power is limited. It has to be refilled. That's why I need dragon blood.

Alas, my source has disappeared together with Nezeb. Yasker wouldn't deal with me. Biiiig mistake. He could have done so much more with me. He's drowning in a sea of petty things he's unable to figure out.

Only the return of Nezeb can save the Empire.

name.en: But Nezeb died at the false June Gates.

text.en:
That's right. Sarn's trap has shut. But our Emperor is still in Sarnaut. I know that you saved his Spark from Tep's Pyramid. Then you met him on Eclipse. Nezeb dwells in the deep layers of the Astral.

Amazed by my knowledge? Now you see that you'd better respect our agreement. I know many things. I have eyes and ears everywhere.

You will help me bring it back. How? I don't know. Yet.

name.en: Anything else that I need to know?

text.en:
A couple of things.

My spies noticed strange activity under the surface of this Allod. These caves belonged to Wormfaces. Their network is still working. Obviously, they're gathering power. The Star Gates in the Dead City are a valuable prize.

Now you have the Gates of your own. They're wanted by all those who want to leave Sarnaut. Watch out, though. The enemy won't give you margin for error if you use them.

name.en: Have your servants brought you the chronophone? I can't find it anywhere.

text.en: Of course, they have. Every valuable thing eventually lands in the hands of the Brotherhood. Here. Make sure you don't lose it again! How did you even pull it off?

name.en: I hear you have the camp logs. Does Alice go out often?

text.en:
She and Fomkin just can't stop getting in and out!

To the town, to the mountains, to the lake! All I do is register their leaves and returns!

Please, talk to her.

name.en: You might have noticed strange things in her behavior.

text.en:
You should talk to Ulyana Radziecka. She's Alice's roommate.

I haven't been following her. Sorry.

name.en: Alright. Tell Alice that I trust her.

text.en: Trust between friends is important. If you really trust Alice, you should know that we all must be extremely careful.

name.en: Make sure to ask Alice! I'll be waiting!

text.en: Don't worry, kylys. I'll ask her.

name.en: Yes? I wonder if she's been sending packages.

text.en:
Her? No, never. Not even once.

But she's been hanging out with Phima Korolkin. He's the one that sends mail. To his mom, to his granny. Picks up parcels all the time. For all I know, he could be sending her letters as well.

When I first met Alice, she was wearing pajamas... or a robe. I asked her if she was a pioneer. She said yes. I asked what happened to her uniform, and she told me she'd lost it.

So I picked up another uniform for her. They didn't find a pioneer set, so I took a school uniform. It looked good on her anyway.

But then I learned that Alice always picks up new uniforms! And never wears them! She just hands them over to her friends behind trash cans at the cafeteria.

Now I'm not sure that I did the right thing.

If you go along with my plan, we'll know what's what.

For starters, it'd be nice to talk to everyone who had anything to do with her enrollment. Ask them what they know about her and how they met her.

You've already talked with Dynin and Nina. You can reach out to the following comrades:

First, Katya Rysina. She isn't in her troop, but Katya is keeping notes who left the camp and when. If Alice goes out, we'll know how often.

Second, it's Mister Postman Igor Pechkin. If Alice has been sending letters, he should know.

Third, it's Esenia Linen. She distributes uniforms. She can tell you who took one for Alice.

Fourth, it's Yana Cutlet. She hangs out by the cafeteria. She should know if Alice eats often.

Fifth, it's Maya Lamb. I know that Alice helped her. Find out what it was.

Sixth, our nurse, Viola de Ardeur. She gives everyone medical exams and takes everyone's weight. She should know if there's something wrong with Alice.

Seventh, it's Zina from the first troop. I'm sure she knows something! Aoidois have a nose for weird stuff.

Eighth, it's Sergey Russule. He's the mana tech club leader. The most suspicious thing is that Alice has joined the club! Besides, I know Sergey. He used to be a slacker and a buzzkill, and now he really got it together. It's strange.

Oh no, don't give me this look. Yes, it requires some running around! Do you want to know who Alice is or not?

name.en: I might be able to help with the storage.

text.en:
Excellent! I'll tell Alice that you want to join the brotherhood of the thingamajig keepers!

We'll beat the pirates together!

We only need to find the other pirate.

I'm sure you are.

It would be great to know what Alice likes. If she has a secret, it might also be her main interest. We need to find out somehow... But how? Slavyana might know. She should know. I'll just go and ask her about Alice's thing. I saw them talking about it once but I only had music in my head and didn't care to listen! I should figure out what she's hiding and make her a good gift.

…

Are you even listening?

name.en: I saved Alice's life in the desert. Twice.

text.en:
She told me about it. She told me about that one time when you saved her from the lizards. However, when you were running away from orcs, it was her who saved you, not the other way round. But oh well.

I've known Alice for a while. If you need to talk, you should talk to her directly.

name.en: Greetings, pioneer. Do you know the girl named Alice?

text.en: Alice? Of course, I know Alice. Who are you?

name.en: I'm a militia officer. Looking for a young criminal named Alice.

text.en: Hah! It's you who arrived with that fat orc, right? The pioneer leader Nina accepted you in the ranks! I don't think that a militia officer needs to be accepted. You're probably doing your own dark stuff here.

name.en: I'm Alice's friend, I need to warn her.

text.en: A friend, you say? Can you prove it? Literally anyone can come here and claim to be Alice's friend.

name.en: It doesn't matter who I am.

text.en: Oh really? Then our talk doesn't matter either. Quit sniffing around, you! Do something useful. Weed the flower beds or sweep the pavement. It's better than hanging around, harassing people with meaningless stuff.

name.en: Alright, you obviously don't understand. Let me put it another way.

text.en: Be my guest.
The library is closed for renovations. I don't lend books at the moment.

name.en: The pioneer troop leader told me you might know something about Alice.

text.en:
The redhead witch?

She should be in prison! Or in a loony bin!
Just take a good look! Does she look like a real pioneer to you? She's an impostor!

Yes! I know for a fact that Alice isn't a pioneer.

I've been a librarian since my family had to quit the League a while ago. But never mind that!

I have my own black list of book thieves. I even blacklist friends of those who delayed a book, because who lives with cripples learns to limp. So pretty much every pioneer is in my list.

I know exactly who was going to Suslanger for this season. Alice wasn't one of them.

I even looked up passenger lists at the port ticket office. No Alice there.
What is it? Go on, tell me.

I see. So we have a group of suspects. We will have to do some running around.

You ought to visit other comrades.

First, it's Phima Korolkin and Kolya Fomkin. They're obviously her sidekicks.

Second, her buddies Maas-Yulee, Lena Tihonova, Sarang Mika, and Ulyana Radziecka. I also think that Samantha might know something. Ask her.

Third, it's Russule. He says he's got a secret, hah. But I know what the matter is! Katya has seen him in town recently. I saw him at the camp at the same time! What a mystery. Two Russules! One of them might be an impostor. Find Russule in town and find out which one is real.
Tell me about it.

I knew it! I knew it!

This Alice isn't a pioneer! Go to Dynin right now! Demand that he kick her out!

I knew it! It's all fraud.

name.en: Hey! Can you tell me something about Alice?

text.en: Alice? What would you like to know?

Alice?

Hmmm... you know, you're right. She's a pretender!

Before she came along, I had been the best student! Now she's the straight A-student. She knows history better than me, she knows astral geography, and even PE is her forte! No normal human is capable of it!

name.en: Hi, Kolya. I'd like to talk about Alice.

text.en: Greetings. What about Alice? Why me?

name.en: You're her best buddy, you can help me out.

text.en:
I'm not her best buddy. I hardly know her at all.

Go talk to Phima. You won't hear a word from me!

Are you threatening me? You think I'm going to just spill the beans?

You're wrong. Alice is my friend. I'm not going to tell you anything.

name.en: Shame on you, Kolya. How can you hide the truth from your comrades?

text.en:
I'm... not... ashamed! I'm helping Alice. Do you want me to speak? No way. I'm not talking, uh-uh.

Alice wanted me to keep it secret. So I'm keeping it.

No! Alice is hundred percent honest! I trust her!

I have absolutely no reason to trust you!

name.en: Kolya, I want to help Alice.

text.en:
Really? Really-really?

If it's the truth, I can tell you, I guess. Alice wanted me to hide something. I don't know what it is, but it's very valuable.

I have no idea where it is now. Only Alice knows that, I guess.

name.en: Kolya, Alice is only using you.

text.en:
No! She's incapable of using people.

She's willing to help everyone! And she has, many times! She's here to save us all. I don't really understand, from what... But it doesn't matter. We all trust Alice.

name.en: I'm not sure you understood me. Let's go over it again.

text.en: Very well, I'm listening.
Good afternoon!

name.en: You're Lena, right? Do you know Alice well? For how long?

text.en: Alice and I met at the Old Town a while ago.

name.en: I know her too. Do you think she has a secret?

text.en: She should... I tried to ask her, but she said it was a big secret not for everyone.

name.en: You and Alice are such good friends, aren't you?

text.en: Friends? Oh well... not really.

name.en: But she tells you her secrets, doesn't she?

text.en: Not at all. And I don't care about them. Why are you asking?

name.en: I know you've been helping Alice.

text.en: I have. But to tell you the truth, I regret it.

name.en: This isn't going the way I was thinking it should go. Let's start over.

text.en: Come on...

name.en: Hello! Can you tell me who asked you to give Alice the uniform?

text.en: Let me see... She's got several packs already! I don't know how but she manages to tear it! Like, all the time! I already gave her the whole summer stock.

name.en: You might remember who it was that asked you to give it to her for the first time?

text.en:
I might be wrong but it could be Lena Tihonova.

That's right! We were out of standard pioneer uniform, and I had to give her the school pack.
Oh, hello!

name.en: Do you know the girl named Alice?

text.en:
Alice? Of course, I know Alice. Why do you ask? We're good friends. She likes music, just like I do. Did you know that? We talk a lot about the latest trends in music. Like differences between the Arisen and Zem music. Which one do you like? I think it's time to throw them together. I want to get sheet music and play. Together with Alice, I think. Do you want to try? I need to ask Comrade Dynin if they have any amplifiers here. I think they have them. We can even set up a concert.

…

Are you even listening?

name.en: Ugh! Listen, did she mention a chronophone? It's a musical device. Kind of.

text.en:
A chronophone... let me see... baritone, astralophone, marathon, megaphone, precious stone... no, I don't think so.

We talked about mana guitars. I showed her mine. It's good that we have a spare guitar in the music club. Alice doesn't have one. I hope Dynin will let her have it. Of course, sometimes he's a lot, but I hope he won't mind. Now we only need to chose the pieces. We could write songs on pieces of paper, throw them in a hat, mix them up, and pick one out randomly. So everyone will be happy. Now the Dune is so full of different races that it's super hard to find the right music. Everyone has a unique taste. You, for example. What do you like?

…

Are you even listening?

name.en: You're an unusual Arisen for sure.

text.en:
That's right. You're a great observer. I was a singer in my past life. You know, among all this sand and pyramids, somebody's got to sing, right? My mates were silent even during their lifetime. I can't tell you how bad it got after death. So grim, it could make your hair stand on end. I like to chat, talk about things, discuss them! I feel very good around Alice. She's a listener. I told her a lot, like I have this project: I want to open a bard school on New Hickut. Which is, in fact, the old Xadagan, but now there's nothing left of it anyway. They dug it down. There are pyramids like you haven't seen before, not even in the Holy Land. It's so beautiful, even though it's so high. You can look down on everyone from up there. It's amazing...

…

Are you even listening?

name.en: Cut it, you're talking too much.

text.en:
That was rude. You don't understand. I was in a coffin for so many years, it's so boring... I didn't feel a thing, but just think of all the things that I missed. Other races didn't waste time, they came up with so many fascinating things! Let's take elves, for example. A lot of my fellow citizens hate elves, but I like them. Not as grim, very fun and always inventing something. They didn't really like us before. It's understandable. When you dig up from the grave, you don't look very pleasant. But now they don't mind us. Especially since we're covering our imperfections. It's not that difficult to be friends with elves. I'm so happy there's no more war! I never wanted it, in the first place. War and music don't have anything in common. Just picture me with a guitar, dashing forward to attack an enemy. It's ridiculous. It's a nightmare.

…

Are you even listening?

name.en: I need to figure out what Alice is hiding.

text.en:
Alice? Hiding? Never heard of it. Ooh! I know! She wants to surprise me and is hiding a gift! What do you think this is? I would love a new mana guitar. Should I tell her? Or not? If she's prepared something... it might ruin it. But I really really really want a good mana guitar. The old one's all shabby. If Alice knew, she would totally get me a new one! She's so kind and generous. Everyone brings her these useless green crystals, and she exchanges them for really great gifts! I've seen it with my own eyes. Perhaps, we should get her something too. I must decide what. She's so versatile, it's a rough choice. Music? Sports? Science? I think I should ask her very carefully...

…

Are you even listening?

name.en: Nah, that's a waste of time. Start over.

text.en: If you say so.

name.en: Hello! You're always hanging around near the cafeteria. Did you see Alice talking to anyone? Who does she usually talk to?

text.en:
Alice? Is that the one in the school uniform? The redhead?

She talks all the time! One person or another!

name.en: Is there anyone that she prefers?

text.en:
Nah, I wouldn't say so. She's a talker alright. A real life of the party.

They've talked with Sarang Mika just recently. She is unlike other undead. She really likes to talk.
Alice steals chops to feed the orc announcer, but shh... it's for your ears only!

name.en: [Tell the story of Alex and Sergey Russule and ask for help]

text.en:
What an interesting story!

I've been thinking why Russule suddenly became such outstanding pioneer!

Well, no trouble at all. We'll just register the mechanoid as his twin brother. We just need to come up with a name. Aoidoi mentioned a very curious one... how was it? Oh, right. Electron! Let's name him Electron.

As to Alex, I was expecting him to ask me out on a date. All the while he was going through all pins and gears in devices!

I will have to improvise.

name.en: Hello! Eugenie told me that Alice was helping you.

text.en: Hello! That's right. She helped me a lot.

This is what happened. I lost Hum Ham. He went out and simply disappeared. I was looking everywhere! In the camp and outside, and he was nowhere to be seen.

Alice offered help. She called Maas-Yulee for help, and the two of them found Hum Ham. He was chasing wild hares and ran away behind the cliff, where the portal used to be.

I'm so grateful to Alice! Especially because she's looking after my pets when I'm gone. Animals love her, you know?

name.en: Hello, do you have a minute to talk about Alice?

text.en: Huh? What? That girl again?

name.en: I'd like to talk with you about Alice.

text.en:
Alice! All talks around here are about Alice!

We had a little chat, too... she's nice. And she knows a lot.

She understands my mission: development of good relationships between the League and the Empire. Alice is a passionate supporter of peace and friendship. She once told me that she did a lot to strengthen the understanding between our states. Without going into detail, of course.

Really? She mentioned that someone was threatening her. She said her enemies could get into the camp.

The thing is, not everyone is happy with the peace between the League and the Empire! Too many people can't live without war. For some, war is a way to get rich! Making their fortune on blood! How awful.

I hope you don't have anything to do with it.
A chronophone? What is that? I'm sorry, I don't know the first thing about Imperial devices.

Help her? She could use help. Do I understand correctly that other pioneers are helping her, but it isn't enough?

We must persuade them day by day that peace is important. We can do so much together! The united states of the League and Empire could achieve so much together!

I'm going to tell Alice that she can count on you.

name.en: I'm Alice's old friend. Where is she now?

text.en:
I'm sorry, she's never mentioned you.

I got to go. Sorry.
Alright.
Greetings! What a wonderful camp! Isn't it?

name.en: Hello! Why did Alice sign up for the mana tech club?

text.en:
Alice?

She's surprisingly knowledgeable. She knows even more than I do.

Alice is a unique mechanic, who can repair anything.

She is better trained than any specialist of ZIT Headquarters.

She's full of surprises. Many things she talks about now exist only as concepts that might be implemented some day in the future.

name.en: Do you know anything about it?

text.en: Me? Perhaps. But it's not my secret to reveal. Sorry.

name.en: Hello! I have a couple of questions about you and Alice.

text.en: Huh? What? Who are you? What do you want from me? What am I supposed to know about Alice?

name.en: You cheated your comrades! You've got a twin.

text.en:
What? What do you mean, cheated?

I didn't lie to anyone. What are you even talking about? What doppelganger? That's nonsense.

I'm not going to discuss it.

name.en: Listen, aren't you sick of fooling around?

text.en:
Oh... You're right. I'm sick. But it's not that I had much choice.

I'm caught in a trap, I can't walk out.

It's all the scientist's fault. Everykin's. It was his idea all along.

name.en: I think I know who can help you.

text.en:
Really?

Then I'm going to tell you what the problem is.

I was one of the pioneers. Eventually, I got sick of the camp routines, lineups, and workouts. It's all the same every day.

So I decided to take a walk in the town. I was wandering around the town, visiting locals, peeking here and there. And then I met the scientist. He was crafting something. I took a closer look and found out that it was a mechanoid with all kinds of gears sticking out of him. Not as they show you in the newspapers, no. He was just like a real human!

The scientist noticed me and was, like, "Oh, young man, you're the one I need. Do you want to be part of my experiment?"

And I was, "What's the experiment, Pops?"

And he said that he was crafting a mechanoid that can't be told apart from a person. Apparently, he wanted to give him my appearance. The mechanoid could replace me in the camp, and no one would tell!

I can't tell you how happy I was! I thought the mechanoid would work for me, and I'd only have fun.

But yes, it happened exactly as the scientist promised. The mechanoid completely replaced me. I'm sick of having fun and hanging around but I simply can't return. It'll be a scandal.

name.en: I'll talk to the scientist and settle it down.

text.en:
Really? Great! You were asking about Alice.

I know how she arrived. I've been in town the whole time. I've seen everything.

The first time Alice came here in a trolley. Right after the ambrosia explosion. She might be connected with it.

She ran about, looked around, and left for the desert.

The second time was with you by manamobile. She hid behind a corner, took off her clothes, and changed into a hoodie that was there on the rope.

Then Lena brought her a school uniform from the camp. That's how she got into the camp. She simply returned in the evening with the others.

I don't think she's a pioneer. She's looking for something.
No one can help me. Why did I even agree... I thought it was for the best. It turned out, nobody needed me.

name.en: You lost me. Let's start over.

text.en: Lost you? Me?! Come on...

name.en: I know everything about the mechanical pioneer.

text.en:
He couldn't keep it together and spilled the beans!

The experiment was unique! A real field test. Just as Yaver Turing suggested. If no one can tell the AI from a real boy, then it is truly alive.

I guess, it was a success. No one could tell them apart, you say? Yuppie! It's time for a doctorate!

name.en: What is the real boy supposed to do?

text.en:
Who? Ah, Sergey Russule! Let me think...

I know what to do! I got completely carried away with ethnography. Started gathering old folk tales, legends, and toasts. I had to ride a camel! There was no other transport.

And then I met her...

What was her name...

Lida... Zina... Oh, right. Nina. She's a local pioneer leader. We had such a lovely conversation.

She won't mind helping us. Tell her everything as it is, and ask her to help Russule. Give her my regards.
Hello, hello! Wow, you're tall!

name.en: I know that you have a roommate called Alice.

text.en: Yeah, so what? Jealous?

name.en: Not a bit. But I need to know what Alice does in your cabin.

text.en: She sleeps, eats, read books. You're such a big guy, how come you don't understand?

name.en: I think Alice is in danger.

text.en:
Woah, for real?

You know... you're right. See that fat orc over there with Nina? In fact, he's an astral pirate. Skulnar the Fierce! He wants to capture her. That's what she told me. This pirate has a sidekick, who could look like anyone. They're camouflaging! How cunning!

name.en: That's right. Good point. I'm scared of the pirates too.

text.en: Hah. In fact, they're looking for something she doesn't have. She gave it to other pioneers to store. They're taking turns hiding it.

name.en: Hahaha, what pirate are you talking about? It's Skulnar the Fierce, the Horde Warchief.

text.en: You don't believe me? Just because I'm little, I don't understand anything? I wish my brothers were here. They'd make you forget how to hurt a little girl.

name.en: Where were we...  All right, let's start from the beginning.

text.en: Fine!

name.en: I'd like to ask you about Alice.

text.en:
Alice? She's funny.

What do you want to hear, pioneer?

name.en: There might be something wrong with her.

text.en:
Oh, pioneer.

She's fine. Excellent health, outstanding physical body, complete absence of flaws... Everyone should be like her.

It was curious to examine her. Medically speaking.

name.en: This... is very interesting! But was there anything out of the ordinary?

text.en:
Isn't this out of the ordinary, pioneer?

By the way, when am I going to see you in my exam room? Remember, Comrade Dynin won't be happy if you bring a disease. We have company. Have you seen Samantha? She is a messenger of good will, the elf ruler's niece. I would hate it if something happened to her.

You have to hurry.
Aho, frriend!
Alice? Of course, I do. Alice is a good friend and a worthy comrade.

name.en: Did Alice tell you to keep something?

text.en: Even if she did, the secret of two people belongs to those two only, doesn't it?

name.en: Do you and Alice ever go hiking?

text.en: Yes, it's a curious allod. And I like exploring it with my friend. We often wander in the desert, observing jinns and ifftie.

name.en: Have you noticed that Alice was hiding something out there?

text.en: You're as annoying as a bunch of hun-hurrs! Mind your own business.

name.en: What if I want to walk with you?

text.en: We'll be happy to keep you company. But we need to ask Alice first. You can join us if she doesn't mind. Alice promised to show me the old portal near the camp. The one that demons destroyed. Nezeb commanded to deliver its shards to another place and recreate it next to the garbage field.

name.en: All right, let's start from the beginning.

text.en: Alright, let's do it.
Ahoy!

name.en: Hi! Can you tell me something about Alice?

text.en:
Alice?

Not much. She's an ordinary girl, very restless. The first troop is well-disciplined. However, the third troop is a noisy lot. So is Alice.

name.en: Tell me about the Exodus of Jinns

text.en:
Oh, my young friend! The extension of my fingers, the strength of my wrists!

Today is an unusual day for all jinns! On days like this, signified by the position of the true moon, sun, and stars, the jinns go on a pilgrimage to their ancient kingdom! They are reminiscing about the past...

On these days, the shelters are left without their guards. Of course, the evil Ifrits do not honor their traditions, which is why they will pose a threat to you and your companions.

Fortunately, you can find protection from their wrath in those treasures their minions are guarding! These gifts of the jinns will help you hide from the wrath of the wicked!

name.en: The Landfill Raiders are roaming the desert now?

text.en:
Oh, my young friend! The strength of my back, the wellbeing of my belly!

To our people, you are all the same... Your squabbles are not our concern. We help all the inhabitants of the desert, because we sense that you will need treasures to fight the approaching darkness...

But as far as I understand, these orcs in the scrapyard were divided into two groups... One is called the Warriors, the others are the Raiders. Some obey the fierce warrior in black, the others revere the mighty warrior famous for his survival skills...

Jinns will help both!

Once these Raiders had no idea how to survive in the Storm... But they have learned a bit of wisdom - they know how to use shelters, and they know they need to look for chests. They are loading them onto their... cars. Of course, you could fight them for their chests before they take them to their camp... Otherwise, those treasures will be lost to you - they will belong to the Raiders.

My young friend, the joy of my heart! Allow me to tell you about the mysteries of this desert!

Great Nezeb, may his name be blessed, hid countless treasures in these sands. They have been hidden for centuries, but the Storm that came to these lands started uncovering ancient caches.

Every couple of hours, the wind grows stronger... First it reveals the smallest of Nezeb's chests, then large ones, and in the end, the Great Treasure - the biggest of them all!

But don't think they will be easy to get, my young friend! The treasures are protected by Ifrits' magic, and to open them, you will need the power of the creatures that guard them. With each opened treasure, your Greed grows, and the greater it is, the more treasures you will find in the last chest.

Be careful! During a Storm, it's easy to die and lose all the collected keys to treasures, along with a part of the accumulated Greed. Most of the dangers can be avoided, but beware of the Wrath of Ifrits - only my brothers can protect you from it in their shelters. If you don't make it to a shelter before the Wrath of Ifrits falls upon you, you will die!

name.en: There are rumors you're looking for lamp fragments...

text.en:
Oh, my young friend, the joy of my heart!

I need your help again - I need an ancient artifact that would help me get rid of the Fire Ifrits and their ruler! It's an ancient copper lamp enchanted with Nezeb's spells! Its fragments are scattered all over the desert...

There are three ways to get them:

First method: the fragments in the sands will occasionally appear during strong magical disturbances, like the Wrath of Ifrits... But they appear shortly before it peaks!

Second method: other fragments were devoured by Uro-Boros - the only creature in the deserts whose stomach is strong enough for that! Defeat it, and you'll get the fragments!

Third method: some of the fragments were discovered by the Ifrits. They locked them in their chests... They guard those chests - and they are only visible during a Storm!

If you collect the fragments of the ancient lamp, I will reward you. You will receive the armor that contains the most formidable of my brethren - Devona.
I haven't seen these sands for centuries... Everything has changed.

Oh, my dear friend, the quartz of my sand, the breeze of my coast - you no longer need the essence of the Storm. You won't be able to get it from Nezeb's Treasure and you won't be able to use it to buy goods on Suslanger. But I'll gladly trade it for Ambrosia if you still have any left...

name.en: Exchange Faded Storm Essence ({sourceCount} pcs) for Ambrosia ({destinationCount} pcs)

text.en: Thank you, my friend. Jinns could use the Storm Essence, and you will need Ambrosia.

You have too much Ambrosia, my friend. I'm trading one Storm Essence for two hundred Ambrosia particles, and your purse is almost full and can't hold them.

Come back to me when you've spent some Ambrosia.

In short, Uro-Boros usually hides deep in the sands where we can't reach it. It only attacks those who stomp loudly, disturbing its peace. It's impossible to predict where it will emerge!

But after a Storm, when vortexes shift the sands around, Uro-Boros sometimes comes close to the surface in the sands of the Jinns or Ifrits. That's when you can lure it out.

The worm really hates it when people stomp around loudly. It test its patience.

We have a plan: if you locate the Worm, give the signal using a signal rocket! Then we'll get into our manamobiles and come to you! After that, we'll kill the bastard!

name.en: What do you need with this Uro-Boros?

text.en:
That thing is making our lives really difficult!

You know there are all sort of laboratories on the western plateau, right? Those scientists tried to tame these creatures so they'd serve the Empire, digging tunnels for them.

Except this worm managed to escape... After eating the Ambrosia, it changed, becoming bigger and angrier!

We couldn't figure out why our patrols kept missing... and then we saw it emerge from the sands!

We used to be real afraid of it, then you and our chief proved that we have nothing to fear! So we're starting a hunt for Uro-Boros! Or else how would we find out which Landfill Warrior is the bravest and smartest?

Yeah, remember Irdrich? Our team was captured by ogres, and you saved us. It's a miracle - we were lying in some coffins, wires sticking out of us!

I still have no idea what happened back there. It's like I hallucinated everything. Anyway, these guys got us out - they were salvaging scrap on crashed ships there!

And why do you think we have so many mechanics here? That's why!

name.en: How did you wind up on Suslanger?

text.en:
We are honest pirates! It turned out that the pyramid guarded by Tep's cultists held all kinds of stuff. Before the League and the Empire showed up to stake a claim, we managed to grab a few things - from the crashed ships and the factories.

We sold everything to the Free Traders and then celebrated it for a month. When we ran out of money, we wondered what we should do next. By then, the rebellion had started. So we traveled to other allods, gathering people who wished to fight. Shamans paid for that - I don't know where they got the money. I hear the Elves were behind it.

Anyway, right before things escalated in the west, we were smuggling goods to Suslanger. And then we couldn't leave it.
Watch the sand, land dweller! And don't stomp so loudly - you'll get eaten!

name.en: Could you give me some water...?

text.en: Oh... I don't have much left either! Alright, take some, but use it sparingly!

name.en: Could you give me some water...?

text.en: You have a bag full of it! Absolutely not...

The desert... the place of my exile...

Betrayed by my sworn brother, dismissed by my teacher, forgotten by my people...

I am no one, and my name was struck from the pages of history that I helped make...

The cursed duel... I could have won it! One thing failed me - my resolve. I was not ready to fight someone I considered a brother! We went through all the hardships together. It made me falter, but not him! He was ready to crush his brother in the name of his ideals. Well, now I understand what I should have done... I only need to cross this...

Desert... the place of my exile...
You see an ancient note... It is unclear where the winds brought it from. It is a miracle it has not yet turned into dust! A miracle... Or unknown magic?

What did we know about this place? Our homeland is the land of green forests and fields. Here the golden dunes stretch to the horizon... And it feels like there is no life here.

But this impression is misleading... My arrival was noticed by more than one pair of eyes. Like rocks falling from the heavens, I drew a line of fire across the sky. I saw those who stared at this "omen" with awe and horror.

Who are they? My teacher spoke of other tribes... The powerful Junes, creators of the empire that ruled this continent? The hard-working Zem who built their pyramids along the River Aether? The proud Knos that crossed the oceans on their ships?

But they all went away. Their time ran out.

Finally, my people - the Aro tribes who are now ready to take their place in the sun... There's nothing for them here! There's the fifth tribe... Ugra.
You see an ancient note... It is unclear where the winds brought it from. It is a miracle it has not yet turned into dust! A miracle... Or unknown magic?

The locals! A pale imitation of humans. Dirty, superstitious nomads! "Descendants of the god of Ugra", "chosen" and "undefeated"! Hah!

But they gave me shelter. Their legends vaguely say that a man "who fell from the heavens" will appear in the desert. He will lead their people to world domination. It's laughable. They are just a handful of tribes living in a forsaken desert. That's the only reason they were allowed to exist. What do they know about the world? About the countless cities of Kania? About indestructible elven fortresses? About the Orcs' Horde which was one step away from conquering this continent?

World domination? Truly, this illusion must be the only gratifying thing the exiles have in this desert!
You see an ancient note... It is unclear where the winds brought it from. It is a miracle it has not yet turned into dust! A miracle... Or unknown magic?

The poverty and wretchedness of local existence is embellished with fairy tales that old people love to tell so much. In the evenings, everyone gathers around campfires to listen to another tale...

Fantasies! Nothing more. Despite having so little, this nation dreams of so much!

They speak of magic! Of dormant jinn kingdoms under the sands that long to awaken. Of treasures in secret caves. Of power that will be bestowed upon whoever finds the passage hidden deep in the mountains.

After laughing about it openly, I agreed to travel to the mountains. Of course we won't find anything there...
You see an ancient note... It is unclear where the winds brought it from. It is a miracle it has not yet turned into dust! A miracle... Or unknown magic?

Where there were only oases in the desert, the walls of cities now rise. The howl of jackals was replaced by the noise of countless caravans.

They are no longer the people of Ugra! They are the Xada people now, the Xadaganians. They don't need to be descendants of a god if they already have a god, and that god is me!

I slayed all the tribal leaders in a sword fight, although I must admit they did not stand a chance against my new powers. But I see beyond all that...

I see a new Empire, cleansed of the mistakes of the past, devoid of the flaws that were so intolerant to me in Kania. My new Empire will be flawless like a sharpened edge. People inhabiting it will not be of flesh and blood, but of stone and steel Having unflinching fortitude, they will be capable of incredible things...
You see an ancient note... It is unclear where the winds brought it from. It is a miracle it has not yet turned into dust! A miracle... Or unknown magic?

The final preparations are complete. The desert is completely in my power, and my forces have approached the borders of my former homeland.

Perhaps Tensess and the others recognize the magnitude of what they are up against. I think they suspect that I managed to entice part of the Conclave over to my side. Many are unhappy with the state of affairs in Kania, the constant disputes between the heirs of Valir.   I will bring a much needed order.

My students will come to Kania with me. I spent many centuries to find and train the Xadaganians that have the gift of magic. Alas, my subjects have nonexistent magical talents, which they make up for with diligence and obedience.

And of course, I will have the jinn people on my side. My secret weapon! I spent many years searching for their shelters, developing subjugation spells, binding them to lamps and rings...

Finally, my last and most secret tool. The Gray Prince and his numerous spies who are ready to open the gates of the cities for my armies...

In a few years, the entire Kania will be part of my Empire!
You see an ancient note... It is unclear where the winds brought it from. It is a miracle it has not yet turned into dust! A miracle... Or unknown magic?

My dear Nezeb, why did you reject our plan? Why did you agree to this insane duel?

We had been preparing for so long... Placed our people in certain positions, hid caches with weapons... We were ready to set out and dethrone the emperor of Valir!

And you ruined everything... Now I stand among the endless sands with no idea how to find you. My people can search every street in the bustling cities of the north. But here in the south, in the barren and deadly desert, I am powerless.
You see an ancient note... It is unclear where the winds brought it from. It is a miracle it has not yet turned into dust! A miracle... Or unknown magic?

You have changed so much over the years, my friend... Really, I did not expect to hear from you again.   Time spares no one!

If only you knew what I had to do to get my hands on that thing that would extend my life... The Conclave jealously guards its secrets, and Tensess no longer trusts me.

The sacrifices I made to get a little drop of dragon blood? I won't talk about it. I'm glad to know that you were able to find one of the hearts here, in the deserts of the south. Although it's upsetting that you remembered me so late!

But our alliance still stands. Kania awaits it hero.
You see an ancient note... It is unclear where the winds brought it from. It is a miracle it has not yet turned into dust! A miracle... Or unknown magic?

I was happy to see your new land. It's so different from the northern countries!

Kania lost the core that allowed it to survive the wars with the Orcs. The former unity is only a memory now: the land is torn apart by disputes and squabbles. The Valir grandchildren are ready to rip out each other's throats for a shred of power. Tensess is too soft to keep them in line.

People are tired of constant squabbles. They remember the hero of the war. You!

It's time to come back and claim what is rightfully yours!
You see an ancient note... It is unclear where the winds brought it from. It is a miracle it has not yet turned into dust! A miracle... Or unknown magic?

Kania ceded its territories to Nezeb, and this gave rise to a new Empire - the Xadagan Empire. Of course, there is still much to be done. The conquest is not over yet. Soon the whole world will submit to our rule.

For now... I'll retreat into the shadows. With a supply of dragon blood, I will exist for centuries, guarding the treasures of our Emperor. The desert offers ideal conditions for hiding what needs to be hidden. Artifacts that grant power over jinns. Treasures that can buy anyone. Knowledge that must be unattainable for the time being...

I will find those who will help me and Nezeb without realizing it. Those who consider him their enemy but serve his interests. Everyone who is unhappy with the current situation in the Empire. It will be the brotherhood of the last shelter.
You see an ancient note... It is unclear where the winds brought it from. It is a miracle it has not yet turned into dust! A miracle... Or unknown magic?
Hello, hello! Wanna eat? You'll have to work for it!

name.en: Tell me what you found on Igsh.

text.en:
Igsh is a metropolitan allod geographically divided into two parts - steppe and desert.  The desert is the bottom of an ancient sea which was exposed after the world split into allods. Steppe is the part of those lands that occupied the entire eastern outskirts of Yul.

Their flora and fauna are quite typical for these territories. However, it should be noted that due to the increasing urbanization, they are significantly degrading. Igsh rhinos and unicorns used for commercial hunting are becoming rare species.

Another threat to the animals is the Necro-Incubator. Its creations wander around the steppes and destroy everything they can reach.

The only prosperous community on Igsh are termites which have grown in numbers in recent years. This tendency is only a part of the general changes of this kind that occur throughout Sarnaut. It appears to be connected with the influence of the astral plane.

name.en: Tell me what you found on Istinsk.

text.en:
Istinsk is one of the recently settled allods. It is a typical allod with steady frosty weather, rich in meteorite and other ore deposits.

Despite the harsh conditions, it has a fairly diverse fauna consisting of typical inhabitants of coniferous forests. Additionally, there is a lake full of commercial fish species in the center of the allod.

However, the mining of ore in the mountains and quarries poses a certain danger to the biodiversity of this allod.

name.en: Tell me what you found on Izune.

text.en:
Izune is an Orc allod which became part of the Empire after the annexation of the Orcs. A typical example of the steppe allods formed when the eastern part of the continent split apart.  The only difference is the old volcano in the very center of the allod where a dragon once dwelled.
