The approaches to the volcano are overgrown with forest, but the rest are bare steppes. Izune is quite poor in resources. The population growth has a damaging effect on the flora and fauna.

n recent years, the allod has seen the increasing numbers of the Draconids who are likely to start competing for the remaining resources with the Orcs.

name.en: Tell me what you found on Xadagan.

text.en:
Xadagan is a sad example of a consumer attitude towards nature. Once it was similar in everything to Suslanger: there were oases and a unique desert fauna in its territory.

Now this allod has become a construction site, all water resources have been utilized, and the desert is now covered in quarries and buildings under construction. According to Nefer Ur's plan, the entire allod will eventually be turned into a huge metal city.

If another life once existed there, it has been destroyed.

name.en: Tell me what you found on Manodar.

text.en:
Manodar is a unique jewel among the allods of the Empire. Discovered at the end of Nezeb's reign, this allod became the granary of the Empire. With its rich black soil and warm, settled weather, the allod capable of producing more than four harvests per year.

Surprisingly, before the start of resettlement, its green plains were rather sparsely populated. The only native inhabitants of the allod are the Waterfolk living in the rivers.

However, there are threats even here - the allod is at a rare intersection of astral currents, which is why it is profitable to build mana stations there.  But the influence of mana stations on nature is still poorly understood.

name.en: Tell me what you found on New Igsh.

text.en:
New Igsh, an allod discovered in the last century, is named that for a reason.  It is very similar to the old Igsh as it's almost an exact copy of it, but there is no Dead Sea here.

The whole allod is covered in endless steppes. It's possible that Igsh and New Igsh were likely part of a single biocenosis, since even their fauna and flora are absolutely identical.

Except New Igsh is much less populated. So it can be an example of what the capital allod was like before Nezebgrad absorbed most of it.
Good afternoon, my friend!

name.en: Tell me what you found on Suslanger.

text.en:
Suslanger is a unique case. It's all about the recent events.

Without a doubt, we are dealing with something unknown.

This "Ambrosia", as someone called it, is something incredible. We are dealing with a form of life that encompasses both animal and plant life. Moreover, it seems that the Ambrosia exists in a form that was not previously considered living - minerals.

We have never had anything like it. Neither the Blight I studied nor the modifiers come anywhere close. I am not inclined to pathos, but I am willing to swear that this is the real concentrated essence of Life itself. It would be nice to understand where it came from...

name.en: Tell me what you found on Vechnoslavsk.

text.en:
Vechnoslavsk is a land of dense forests and swamps. While of interest to any biologist, this allod is largely impassable.  The existing settlements are located on the coast itself, but the depths of the allod are impenetrable swamps full of monstrous mosquitoes.

The swamps are covered with coniferous forests, and the climate can be described as moderately cool. The fauna is represented by numerous invertebrates, amphibians and reptiles, and animals are represented only by saber-toothed squirrels, bats, and martens. At least this is what we managed to find. More detailed research requires better preparation.

I'm a biologist. I came to this allod on vacation. But as it turned out, my arrival was very timely.  We are dealing with a unique case - the appearance of life from another world in Sarnaut. I once visited all the imperial allods and studied their fauna and flora

name.en: Tell me what you found on Yakhch.

text.en:
Yakhch is a unique land in the sense that it's the only allod that has changed a lot over the years. It was once a typical desert allod, but then the Great Tree was planted there.

It changed the desert - it sucked out excess salt, consolidated the sands, and raised the water level. Mixed forests began to grow on the allod, and a different fauna appeared.

Now it's more of a typical allod from the middle latitudes than the hot desert of the south.
Look at the structures we have built! The lawns we have laid. The water supply and heating!
Remember, pioneers: you are the masters of the camp. You! What is required of you, my friends? Discipline!

name.en: How are things in the pioneer camp?

text.en: Everything is great, friend. All pioneers are keeping busy - participating in activity clubs or doing sports. Discipline is maintained at all times.

name.en: How are the preparations for the holiday going?

text.en: We are getting ready! Sewing costumes, singing songs, memorizing poems!

name.en: Can I swim beyond the buoys?

text.en: No! Absolutely not! Buoys mark the perimeter of swimming areas! You are not allowed to swim beyond them!

I'm Camp Superintendent Dynin! I maintain discipline in the camp and ensure that everything is operational. What's important to us? That all pioneers are healthy, discipline is maintained, and everyone is kept busy I'm also assisting with preparations for the upcoming festivities.

name.en: How are things in the pioneer camp?

text.en: Why do you ask? Everything is in order. Where is your leader? Why are you loitering?

name.en: How are the preparations for the holiday going?

text.en: Fine. Are you learning... what I told you to learn? Like I said, "vigorous" should be said more vigorously. And "joyful" - more joyfully. Got it?

name.en: Can I swim beyond the buoys?

text.en: No! I told you already, you can't! Those caught doing so will be sent home. In shame. Of course, when the port is opened.

Is that how you're addressing your superior? I'm Eugene Dynin, the superintendent of this pioneer camp. I maintain discipline, supervise group leaders, and make arrangements for the upcoming festivities.
E2-E4. Standard beginning. Suslanger defense!
Greetings, friend!
Greetings, pioneer!
Why do you ask? Are you snooping around? What are you, a spy? Or an astral pirate?
I'm a pioneer! And who are you? I don't think I saw you among the personnel of this camp, therefore you entered its territory without permission.
Kolya and I are trying to solve Alice's problem. It's a difficult matter. There are suspicious persons sniffing around. They might be the pirates she mentioned.

I'm Phima. I mean, Yephim. Why?

Ah, it's you. How is Alice? Did she have anything for me?

name.en: What exactly are the generals saying?

text.en:
They are unhappy with our great leader Yasker. What's the problem? The peace. There's no war. Meaning, there are no feats, medals, or awards. No rising through the ranks. Who is fighting for us now? The undead.

There's no war, so you can't blame the shortage of toilet paper and sausages on it. There's no war, and people start asking questions - we're supposed to be a leading country, and you see torn wallpaper and cracked plaster inside buildings.  And you can't even blame the elves.

The Orcs are just the beginning. Without war, they're always ready to make a row.

And the question that the generals keep asking - whether we need Yasker - is a different matter.

It's simple.

How did it happen? We overlooked it! All members of the Committee were summoned to Izune and Igsh. Only secretaries remained.

We held out until the Orc generals started deserting. And when they left, the rest followed. Crazystorm thinks he's still the authority among them. But right now the Orcs are keeping an eye on the young. As soon as the warriors realized they want to be allied with the Shamans, there was no one left in the old city. Everyone is at the Landfill now.

And I barely have enough people to place guards around here. There's absolutely no way we can attack. The Orcs made up the largest part of the army on Suslanger. They are all on the other side now.
I serve the Motherland!

The General of Suslanger Military Region. My father was a general, my grandfather was a general, and my great-grandfather was a general. I command all military units on Suslanger. Or rather, those that remained after the largest part of our army deserted.

However, there are other generals on Suslanger. Many of them spent their vacation here. Together we established temporary headquarters. That's the army I have.
Greetings!
Hello. Who are you and why are you loitering?

name.en: What do you dream of at night?

text.en: How would you know that? Has someone told you...? I specifically asked... Never mind. The thing is, I have nightmares... It's the curse of young adepts who are going to become psychics in the service of the Committee. I have rather strong powers.

name.en: How are you doing as a pioneer?

text.en: Our group is winning the competition! We achieved great results in sports, labor, and patriotic education! We look towards our leaders as an example!
I'm Ekaterina Rysina, the leader of the first pioneer group. I'm preparing to apply to the Higher School of Nezeb's Committee!

name.en: What do you dream of at night?

text.en: Who told you? Kolya Fomkin or Phima Korolkin? Don't listen to those hooligans. They are a bad influence.

name.en: How are you doing as a pioneer?

text.en: Don't you know that our first squad is the first not only in name, but also in aspiration?   Dynin himself commended us. Do you not listen to your superiors?

Katya Rysina. And I don't remember you. Although there are many new faces in the pioneer camp. Take Alice, for example... No one saw her, no one knows where she came from, but they decided to put her in the third group. And the third group are all hooligans! They are a bad influence. Samantha is a different matter. She's a good egg. It's hard to believe she's an elf!
Hello...
Hello, hello!
Ehh... How am I? I'm fine. Everything is... great.
I'm Fomkin. Kolya. Nikolay, I mean. Why do you ask?

Everything is fine. If you see Alice, tell her I did everything she asked. And didn't tell anyone anything! Even Rysina, I mean, Katya, asked me where I was. She kept grilling me... Did you know she's a sleepwalker? That's so funny!
Yes, I'm Kolya, Kolya Fomkin. Did Alice send you? I saw you talking.
Welcome to the pioneer camp "Dune"!
Welcome to the pioneer camp "Dune"!

The pioneers are the members of the Nezeb All-Imperial Pioneer Organization! All young constructors of our country can be admitted - from high school students to university students. And after Yasker signed a truce with the League, we started an exchange program. Now any League resident of any age can visit our wonderful Dune camp to share in the spirit of camaraderie and our bright ideals.   Through this, and not through war, we're going to prove to the world that the Empire is the only true path.

name.en: How do I become a pioneer?

text.en:
To become a pioneer, you must study diligently, uphold the ideals of our country, and always be ready to help others! You must swear the pioneer oath, wear the pioneer uniform and badge!

You can repeat after me: "As I join the ranks of the Nezeb All-Imperial Pioneer Organization, I, , solemnly swear to love my motherland; to live, study, and fight as the great Nezeb instructed us!

There are several simple rules:

A pioneer is loyal to his imperial homeland!

A pioneer takes cues from the heroes of labor.

A pioneer honors the memory of the fallen soldiers.

A pioneer is persistent in their studies, work, and sports.

A pioneer is an honest and loyal friend who always stands up for the truth.

A pioneer cherishes their pioneer badge and their group banner.

A pioneer fights for the honor of their group so they are the first in everything.

A pioneer does not let their friends down.
Greetings! I am Nina Krasavina, the leader of the first pioneer group! If you have any questions about our favorite pioneer camp "Dune", then I'm ready to answer them!

My dear young friend!  I'm glad you asked me.

The pioneers are the members of the Nezeb All-Imperial Pioneer Organization! All young constructors of our country can be admitted - from high school students to university students. And after Yasker signed a truce with the League, we started an exchange program. Now any League resident of any age can visit our wonderful Dune camp to share in the spirit of camaraderie and our bright ideals.   Through this, and not through war, we're going to prove to the world that the Empire is the only true path.

name.en: How do I become a pioneer?

text.en:
You should know that since you're a pioneer already. But if you want, I can remind you:

To become a pioneer, you must study diligently, uphold the ideals of our country, and always be ready to help others! You must swear the pioneer oath, wear the pioneer uniform and badge!

You can repeat after me: “As I join the ranks of the Nezeb All-Imperial Pioneer Organization, I, , solemnly swear to love my motherland; to live, study, and fight as the great Nezeb instructed us!

I'm always happy to remind my charges of these simple rules:

A pioneer is loyal to his imperial homeland!

A pioneer takes cues from the heroes of labor.

A pioneer honors the memory of the fallen soldiers.

A pioneer is persistent in their studies, work, and sports.

A pioneer is an honest and loyal friend who always stands up for the truth.

A pioneer cherishes their pioneer badge and their group banner.

A pioneer fights for the honor of their group so they are the first in everything.

A pioneer does not let their friends down.
Hello! I am Nina Krasavina, the leader of the first pioneer group! I'm always happy to help, even if you are from another group. You can ask me any time.

You don't know about Kurgan either? Wow, you're so ignorant! Kurgan the Crafty, a Shaman. He just sat there on Coldberg. Until one day he had a dream. A prothetic one! He understood that the destiny of all the Orcs laid in the desert.  That it's the only path to freedom. If they went into the wilderness, they would see a sign there.  And then Kurgan went to the Orcs' camps and told them about his dream.

But no one believed him. Then he came to Suslanger. There are a lot of Orc troops here. Well, at first no one here believed him either.  And then Fury followed him. And then many others.

And then there was a sign. The west blazed with a green glow!  Everyone understood then - there it was, the time of Orcish freedom had come. We have shed enough blood for humans, it's time for the Orcs to become masters of their destiny.

There was something else Kurgan prophesied. He said a Legendary Orc will come through the old portal after being reborn. And then the Orcs will no longer need Great Mages!
What, didn't expect to see me here? I'm not easy to catch, haha!

You don't know Shrinka? Wow!

Shrinka the Nimble. He was a general. He sat there at the human headquarters. But they offended Shrinka, passed him for a promotion. He held a grudge.

And then the whole mess started! The Orcs on their own! Then Shrinka tore off his shoulder straps and went into the desert with his men. So the Nimble clan stood with the Merciless.

Except Shrinka wanted to rule over everyone. He sees himself as the leader of the new Horde, he dislikes following a woman... Fury, that is. And then something came between them.

What... you still don't get it? You have a goblin brain or what? We... ugh... we want freedom! Like in the old times. Do you know that the Orcs used to rule the world? There was an Orc leader called Skulnar. He defeated the entire Kania. And Xadagan got so scared that it didn't come into existence until much later. There you have it.

Anyway, we'll kick everyone's asses. You know why? Because we are many, and we are mighty. And we have the Ambrosia. After you down some Ambrosia, you can punch through a metal door. So it's over for the Empire. And for the League. The Orcs will rule the world.

You don't know who I am? I'm Blabber the Merciless. I mean, I'm... whatchamacallit... The agitator. I explain to people who don't agree with us that they are wrong. I like talking, hah.

And if they disagree with me, I whack them on the head! It's very convincing.

You don't know who Fury is? Fury the Merciless Crazystorm's daughter! Her father is old now, but Fury is incredible. She's tough. And angry like an astral demon. She takes orders from no one. Her father wanted her to sit at home, nursing his grandchildren. She flipped and smacked him in the face. Then ran away from home.

Fury can rip anyone apart. She went to the river to draw water. And there was a crocodile. She grabbed him and tore him in half. You don't believe me? Everyone knows this story. Fury fought three hulks in the ring. Defeated them all! Because she's fast and agile. All warriors respect her! At first, no one believed Kurgan, thought it was some Shaman nonsense. But Fury took his side. That's how we were created - the Landfill Warriors!

name.en: Which clans report to the guest artists?

text.en: Among our clans are the Poor, the Nomadic, the Merry, and the Saltie! That doesn't sound like a lot, but we don't sit still, so there is enough of us everywhere. The Orcs don't like to sit still in general. Our carpet is a flower meadow, hehe. And in that meadow are our wagon, trusty rhinos, and booze!
Hey hey!

name.en: What do the traveling actors think about the rebellion?

text.en:
What do you think? For two hundred years, our people have been suffering under Xadagan's rule! They don't let us live freely, they barely allow us to breathe, so it's time to cast off the shackles and be free like in the good old days when we could go where we wanted and do whatever we wanted!

It's the traveling actors who are bringing the shamans' words to the masses, hah! We secretly travel between the allods of the Empire! Many of our people left for the other tribes that are free! They bring news that a new leader will appear soon. He will unite all the Orcs and lead the new Horde to freedom!

name.en:
I'm acting on behalf of Simon of Suslanger.

I need you to give me a report on the structure of the Imperial troops so I could understand the essence of what is happening.

text.en:
Yes? Show me the orders!

Okay... I believe you. I saw you and that red-haired mage speak with him...

Well, what are you interested in?

name.en: I'm interested in the forces of the Yakhch Military District!

text.en:
The blue ones, then... Listen up.

The Forces of Yakhch Military District.

The main color of the uniform and shoulder straps is blue. That's why they are called blue.

They are deployed on Yakhch, Istinsk, Xadagan.

They consist of Xadagan-Zem-Orc units, and their main task is to provide support for our valiant astral fleet.

Sentinels, then... Listen up.

The Imperial Sentinels used to be the Xadaganian army formed during the war with the League after the creation of the Empire. They have become an elite military unit. It is the officers of the Sentinels that lead the Imperial Army which is annually replenished with new recruits. So the Sentinels are not recruits.

These also include special types of troops: Units of Magical Supremacy, engineering troops, and other eggheads.

The colors of the Sentinels' uniforms are dark shades or purple.

They are led by Commander Crazystorm the Merciless, who reports directly to the Great Mage Yasker.

name.en: I'm interested in the forces of the Suslanger Military District!

text.en:
The green ones, then... Listen up.

The Forces of the Suslanger Military District.

The main color of the uniform and shoulder straps is green or, on rare occasions, brown. That's why they are called green.

They are deployed on Suslanger, Manadar, Izune.

Mostly orc troops - they are an attacking army. Now, as you know, they were the ones who went AWOL.

name.en: I'm interested in the forces of the Igsh Military District!

text.en:
The red ones, then... Listen up.

The Forces of the Igsh Military District!

The main color of the uniform and shoulder straps is red. That's why they are called red ones!

They are deployed on Igsh, New Igsh, Vechnoslavsk.

They are mostly comprised of Xadaganian units, and their main goal is to protect the imperial allods. Meaning defense. Except every allod the Empire has set foot on is already ours, so we have to defend everything.

Who can tell anymore? It's like everyone has lost their mind. First there were rumors of this Orc that studied magic... And no one really cared, though the Shaman started yelling that we should leave the Empire.

Then there was this conflict on Izune. They sent armies without us Orcs there. Told us to sit quietly for now. Then Fury showed up, Crazystorm's daughter. She incited us to a rebellion, and one by one, the Orcs went to the Landfill. There's no one left here now.
What do you want?

Are you mocking me?

You are looking at the last Orc in this cursed city. Who do you think I am? I'm a loser. All my pals are at the Landfill. I'm the only one left. Because I swore an oath. Because I don't believe this crap about the Orcs who will rule the world.

I tried to argue with them. Punched a few faces. Cursed. Pleaded! But no, no one listened to me. They have gone crazy, all of them. "Freedom for Orcs", pshaw! As though we're all in chains slaving away at some mine. What do they want? We have food, women. We fight on occasion. That's all they want!

It's too bad I didn't die sooner.

name.en: Which clans report to the Punishers?

text.en:
The Punishers were once clans of warriors! Or shamans. It doesn't matter!

Our strength is in our faith. We believe in our heroes. It doesn't matter who they are. Anyway, our ancestors give us strength.

Now the Punishers are leading the following clans: the Nimble, the Unyielding, the Bloodthirsty, the Flaming, and the Righteous!
Our strength is in our heroes. Both the dead and the living.

name.en: What do the Punishers think about the rebellion?

text.en:
It's not that simple!

Someone thinks we should have our own heroes. Tensess, Nezeb, and Skrakan are all human heroes. The Pridens also believe in the light, and they don't need other people's heroes. Why should we?

But some of the Punishers, especially those close to Crazystorm, still believe in the Empire. It won't be easy to convince them otherwise.
Oh, thanks! I'll add you to my list.

name.en: Why aren't you with the Orcs?

text.en: Oh, there's some rebellion going on. I don't want that. I'm kind of a jester - I've spent all my life making people laugh. Why would I want to go to war?
Hello, everyone! Am I'm Orc announcer!

I'm a... I mean... An Orc announcer! I work at the local mana radio!

Or... I used to. They kicked me out.

Why? I don't know. Never figured it out. They laughed at me, asking, "Are you for the alliance between the League and Empire or for the new Orc Horde?" Sang some mocking song about mud and swamps... It's a nightmare.

Now I'm sitting here, collecting money to go to the canteen. I'm too poor!

name.en: Which clans report to the shamans?

text.en:
It's easier to ask how many stars are in the sky or how many grains of sand are in this desert! Once upon a time, each clan had its own shaman and obeyed him... A military leader was elected only when the need arose...

Now... There are many who don't listen to spirits yet want to lead the tribe. At least there's a lot of us...

We have the Nimble, the Northwind, the Free, the Wild, the Smokedry, the Riverborn, the Montane, the Crafty, the Maritime, the Sandy, the Merciless, the Gloomy, the Nomadic, the Salty, the Sleepy, the Fierce, the Brainy, and the Clever on our side! Is that not enough? And that's only the ones I remembered.
Wind, rain, soil - everything obeys the shamans!

name.en: What do the shamans think about the rebellion?

text.en:
Hah! The shamans started this uprising, heh.

We have been looking for the descendants of the Legendary Orc for centuries. We believed that sooner or later he would be found.

The Orcs should be free! So says Kurgan, so says Wrokag. And all the shamans agree with it. Now our task is to help Skulnar with everything. Skulnar will leads to freedom. And then the Orcs will realize that it was achieved thanks to the shamans.
You won't hear me when I cut your throat...

name.en: What do the Thugs think about the rebellion?

text.en:
We're always game for anything...

On the one hand, there is no war in the Empire at this time, and no war means no business for us thugs...

On the other hand, the rebel orcs do not pay us much either. Look around. What do they have here besides rags, trash, and scrap metal?

So our guys came up with this: they divided into two groups, one remained in the service of Xadagan, the others left to join the Arisen. That's how they operate. They don't fight each other, of course.

name.en: Which clans report to the warriors?

text.en:
Hah! Now there are more warrior clans than anything else!

What's the most honorable activity for an orc? War, of course! So most of our clans are led by warriors.

I'm getting tired of listing them, and I'll probably forget someone. But listen here: the Merciless, the Gallant, the Rowdy, the Swift-Footed, the Quick, the Hungry, the Greedy, the Iron, the Bony, the Forester, the Awry, the Bloodthirsty, the Insatiable, the Brassbound, the Scorched, the Paunchy, the Skillful, the Steel, the Brassy, the Sated, the Sober, the Honest, the Crazybrick, the Speedy - they are all the true warrior clans!
What are you looking at? Want a shiner?

name.en: What do the warriors think about the rebellion?

text.en:
At the beginning, we thought it was some nonsense. Something the shamans hallucinated!

In the service of the Empire, we had everything we needed: food, booze, women!

But Yasker signed a peace treaty with the League. Agrh... The Architects are defeated! Demons, damn their tentacles, are also our friends... And now the undead are fighting at the Citadel.

There's nothing for the Orcs to do! We sat there in the garrison with no money - after all, they don't pay extra for the war anymore, so it's boring...

And then there's Fury... She might be a woman, but she's so strong she can take any guy. She'd say, "let's go guys, we'll set fire to the headquarters and take off." So that's what we did.

The Orcs need their freedom! So we can decide for ourselves if we want to fight!

name.en: Which clans report to the thugs?

text.en:
Our clans include the Daring, the Insidious, the Ruthless, and the Silent... Yes, we have smaller numbers than the warriors and shamans, but we don't really work well in crowds. Our task is to sneak in unnoticed and cut our enemies' throats.

Each of us is an individual, each is a master of their craft. That's why being a member of our clan is not an honor, but a great benefit.

name.en: How did you end up here?

text.en:
I was exiled for the boldness of my questions and theories. Just imagine that: as soon as I touched a raw nerve, a scandal erupted...

I have been to many places, like you, and even somewhere you wouldn't dare think about. After my exile, I broke all the laws - from trivial to the law of gravity.

I knew your enemy, Nihaz... But we had a different kind of relationship.

You don't need to know more.
A strange intelligent creature with orange eyes is peering at you attentively and with interest... As if by itself, a question pops up in your head.

An exile from the House de Desirae, forgotten by the general public.  They called me many things in my life - strange, crazy, eccentric... Only those who understood me saw me differently: a researcher, a threat to the world!

I am one of those who believe that everything is possible - you just need to muster up enough strength and willpower!

name.en: What do you think of our world?

text.en:
You have no idea how narrow your view is: you're not even trying to comprehend the structure of the world!

Tell me, when was the last time the Hero of Sarnaut tried to understand the full picture? You are immortal, but you don't seem to be taking advantage of it, missing all these opportunities! After all, you can carry out the most dangerous experiments without a risk to your life.

And then what? Just cut off the heads in battle. One after another.

No other options?

You are so... Everyone is so narrow-minded, never trying to think outside the square. Stereotypes - that's their word! But they always look and sound so pompous...!

I want to learn, to create!
There's the sun shining above us. It's a beautiful life!
We see powerful progress. We see miracles!
It's all good. I'm walking around, enjoying myself. That pioneer camp is such a boring place
Sergey Syroezhkin It's nice to meet you! Perhaps you can tell me something interesting about the city?
I'm looking for interesting places. Do you know if there are any attractions?
Oh, hello! So you managed to get out of the camp, too? It's awfully dull, right?
But you're a person. You're brave and strong, you can be the master of your destiny.
Childhood will be over eventually, it doesn't last forever.
The most important question for me right now is this: what does it mean to be a true person? I'm looking for an answer. So far unsuccessfully.
I would like to know an answer to this myself...
I took the first place in running, mathematics, and chess competitions. But I'm afraid I still haven't found an answer to the question that bothers me.
Hi, I'm Sergey from the third pioneer group. It's nice to meet you!
Again? Again?! AGAIN?!
Why are you here?
What happened?
Priestess of the Church of Light She's the doctor and a nurse here.

name.en: What did the Orcs ever do to you?

text.en:
I've had enough of them! We welcomed them with open arms, granted them rights, and what did they do? Did they thank us? No!

I can't stand these Orcs. They take our jobs. If there's a hard work that pays well, they always hire the Orcs. They even got into the army. What about our common Xadaganian guys?

The crime rate has also increased. We used to have order in our cities... and now? If there's an Orc district, it's best not to set foot in there at night. And during the day, too! And goblins? Where the Orcs are, goblins usually follow. Nothing like this ever happened under Nezeb's rule! Nezeb would have put them in their place!
Greetings!
I'm just a plant worker. Got a ticket to the local sanatorium. My vacation is over now, but I'm still here. I'm stuck here, and now there are Orcs everywhere! I hate them!

I talked to Khasim yesterday. He needs... samples for his research. Is that what they are called? Apparently people are willing to pay a lot for it... So I'm putting together a caravan. The desert has always been dangerous, but now it's doubly so. I'm trying to find a few brave guys who'll join me. If it sounds like something you're interested in, perhaps we could go together?

name.en: What business do you have with Khasim Kehelin?

text.en:
Oh, Khasim, my unfortunate friend. Everyone turned their backs on him after what he did...

But I see big... as they say in the capital... potential!

This Ambrosia is... a valuable thing, they say. And Khasim understands how it all works. So I'm wondering how his skills might help me make a profit...
Greetings, dear guest!
I'm Stanislav Karamzin. A famous merchant! Everyone knows and respects me on this allod. I can get you anything - I have contacts even in the capital!
FRESH PIES, HOT BUNS, SWEET TEA! Ugh, I'm tired from all the yelling.

What do you think I'm doing here? Looking after the local library. It's a nightmare if you ask me. Every book must be returned on time, let alone returned in a proper condition!

Do you think anyone at this camp follows these simple rules? At all? No!

So I had to close down the library.

Are you blind? Can't you see I'm a librarian?

When I first got to this beautiful camp, I thought there's be order. The League lacks order! We need to learn from the Empire. It was a disappointment. As messy as Irene's brothel!

Why are you ask... Ooh!

I'm... I'm just a pioneer. I mostly read and stroll. Nothing special. We've been stuck here for a long while, so the books are read from cover to cover. Especially since Eugenie closed the library. Fortunately, other pioneers can exchange the books.

I'm reading a great book about the fall of the House de Vevre. It's called "Captured by the Astral Storm."

My name is Lena. I don't know what to tell you.

Together with my sister we arrived at this camp from the Kanian allod Zlatovest. That was after Yasker and Antoinette signed the exchange agreement for the League to visit this place and the Empire to visit us.

It's a curious place. But sometimes it seems that I've been here for too long.

I'm a leader of a music club. We need to organize a concert. We have so many talents among us, including hidden. I think it's very important that we reach general agreement, but how else can we achieve it, if not by common cause? Of all things, music is the best.

Rumor has it, there was such concert already. But we aren't any worse, we can do it too.

I'm Sarang Mika! An Arisen from Xadagan. I like music, fun, entertainment. That's my main difference from other Arisens. Do you have any idea how hard it is for me to be with the quiet, dark people you can't even talk to? This wonderful camp was a lucky place for me. It's much more fun and much more talkative people.

I came to this camp to start friendship with imperial comrades. It all started with my letter to the Great Mage Yasker... after which he and Antoinette, the head of our House, decided to go with an exchange. Pioneers from the Empire were supposed to visit League allods, and we, different races of the League, were supposed to visit this amazing Duna pioneer camp!

I am Samantha de Delice, the official elven and League ambassador in this pioneer camp! I have an honorable mission to reconcile the League and the Empire. The sole fact that I'm here is a testament to my big success.
Hello!
Many things. Right now, I'm helping a troop leader. This place is packed, isn't it? That's why the leaders need help. They didn't expect the season to last for so long.

Slavyana Yaseneva! I'm a pioneer now, but I used to live in a small village on Malar. Our allod is very peaceful. It's been inhabited since ancient times, when Kania was one, not broken into tiny islands. Nothing ever happens, not even demonic attacks. We don't have major cities, but there are many towns and villages. And we have huge forests, so easy for an outsider to get lost in.

This and that. Many things. We swim, we hike, we prank! Comrade Dynin, the superintendent, is so funny when he gets angry for what we've done! He can't actually kick anyone out. You see, this allod is closed!

Goblinball and other sports are my favorite. Some day, I'm gonna win all golden medals at the Dionic Games.

I'm Ulyana Radziecka. Gibberling were very happy to visit this camp too!

It's so fun and there are so many people! Of course, it gets a little boring over time but we have so many friends! Together we invent mischief, so it's alright.
Greetings, comrade!

I'm an assistant troop leader. I keep an eye out on things. In fact, I'm trying to make our visitors from the League feel at home. Only by our example can we prove that the Imperial ideas are the future.

I'm Volka Krutch. A pioneer, an athlete, a drummer at school, and a future builder of our country.

I'm also an assistant troop leader. I keep an eye out on things.

Hiding. Observing. It's fun.

There are many events happening, you only need to observe them quietly. For example, there's a hatch under the medical unit. It leads to a secret lab. Viola often goes there. She's experimenting.

I'm Maas Yulee, a Priden from Nezebgrad. I live in the south-eastern district. I overheard that Suslanger gathers all pioneers, so I wanted to travel to this hot place. Joined the group, and then joined their ranks as well.

Hello! I'm a simple merchant from Nezebgrad. I sell the produce of our cooperative, buy local goods and sell them in Nezebgrad. I hear there's some sort of Ambrosia... must be valuable! I'll need to stock up. So I'm sorry, but I only accept Ambrosia for the time being!
The best goods from our stores in Nezebgrad! They are really hard to find!

name.en: But why so expensive? A fortune for some paper cap!

text.en: What do you know? It's a rarity. The paper has a headline from Nezeb's time! A true rarity!

Hi!

I'm responsible for keeping all pioneers' clothes tidy. I wash, dry, and iron. I can also give you a uniform.
Of course. It isn't given out for free, though.
Hello! I'm a cafeteria janitor. Sadly, food can be left over. And then Gerasim comes to rescue.
Gerasim is a fine example of the imperial teaching system success! Even an ogre can be a normal member of society! Would you like to have a friend like him?

Good afternoon, comrade!

I'm in charge of the zoo.

name.en: I would like to see the animals.

text.en: Of course. We have a cute jerboa, who can play a horn.
Oh, a new recruit! I could always use an extra pair of hands...

name.en: What do you need help with?

text.en: To stop your predecessors from destroying our world... But neither me nor my recruits can do it directly. So good old sabotage and false identities come into play... You'll understand when you get your tasks. Jump into the portal, we'll talk on the other side.

name.en: What kind of portals are these?

text.en:
My crowning accomplishment! Cutting the fabric of space-time in a way that creates neat little holes is a difficult task, considering the number of ruptures you and the likes of you have left behind. I patched up our poor world a little...

This rift leads to Suslanger in the future. Where I need help.

name.en: Why are you recruiting heroes from the past?

text.en: Because the heroes of the present have all been deceived, and I'm unable to reverse it. But it's not too late for you!

In any story, there is a key moment when the future becomes set in stone. Alas, the choices we made and will make, our decisions, actions and inaction - all that shapes the future that leads to the inevitable outcome.

I need heroes that have yet to make certain decisions. Those who completed the journey to Sogot, learned the prophecies about the doom of the world, and made preparations to follow the Infinity - they are not the people I need.

I do not appear in their space-time frame.

In the future, Suslanger will be selected for one very interesting scientific experiment. It would be an attempt to leave this place. But it will have certain consequences that we'd really like to avoid.

The only thing you need to know now is that a strange energy came through the Gates that were constructed there. It awakened the jinns who had been dormant for a very long time. This energy has a physical form - the Ambrosia. And it's the Ambrosia and the fire jinns, Ifrits, that we'll be dealing with.

You see, in this future the League and the Empire agreed on a truce and started working together, although I understand if you find that hard to believe. People from the League also started joining the pioneers. So anyone can become a pioneer, and no one will suspect them. It's a perfect disguise for us!

To save the world - isn't it a noble cause?

Fine, I know you, heroes. You'll be rewarded, of course. You will become stronger, more experienced, wealthier. You will lead your guild to glory... Suslanger is a prosperous place - it's where Nezeb hid his treasures. And they can become yours! So, ready to go after the treasures?

I just need to distract the heroes from the future for a while to slow them down.

name.en: Tell me about the Storm and my part in it.

text.en:
Listen carefully.

During the Storm, the heroes we are opposing will not be able to resist their greed - they will go after the Ifrits' treasures.

The jinns are unhappy about it, so they will do everything they can to stop them. Alas, their power is not infinite.

So we... help each other. During the Storm, Ifrits will grant you special powers - you will turn into a mirage and will be able to strengthen their servants.

Ifrits will only be appeased if the servant you empowered joins a fight and dies - that's how the energy you transferred to it will return to the Ifrits.

You will get this kind of task daily.

Your mission is to complete my tasks. Preferably every day, but we'll see. I'll welcome any help. Call your friends if you like.

Remember - you'll be just a pioneer to everyone around you. A inconspicuous pioneer, one among many. Even the local monsters will pay no mind to you.

It will help you act covertly. Endow the Ifrits' servants with power, collect Ambrosia. With time, I might give you other tasks.
The lake sings...

name.en: What does the lake sing about?

text.en:
Many things, youngling. It sings about the city on its banks. About the events that took place in its dusty streets...

What was before, will happen again. What was today, will be tomorrow. There will always be the lake and the city above it, there will be conversations, and the lake will be listening. Yesterday, Nezeb walked here, today it's you, and tomorrow... who knows?

And the lake will always be here.
The palms are waving...

Many people, youngling. They saw the labor of slaves on plantations, they heard the whip of the slave driver.

What was before, will happen again. What was today, will be tomorrow. The palms will always be here. They will see everything. A slavery of body became a slavery of spirit. Yesterday, Nezeb walked here, today it's you, and tomorrow... who knows?

And the palms will always be here.
Camels are walking...

To many different places, youngling. Thousands of years ago, the first caravan set off from here, and now, centuries later, the ships of the desert are on a long journey once again.

What was before, will happen again. What was today, will be tomorrow. There will always be caravans, camels loaded with bundles, and they will keep going forward, into the desert... Yesterday, Nezeb walked here, today it's you, and tomorrow... who knows?

And camels will always be here.
The water is flowing...

Who knows where all the waters end up, youngling? They used to flow into the seas, but there are no seas anymore. Who knows where they flow?

What was before, will happen again. What was today, will be tomorrow. The waters once whispered to me of cries over the canyon, of blood spilled down the slopes into the river. Yesterday, Nezeb walked here, today it's you, and tomorrow... who knows?

And the waters will always be here.
The sands hear...

They hear everything, youngling. Footsteps. Words. Thoughts.

Thousands of years have passed, and the sands still hear and remember the breath of every creature that has set foot into the desert. Yesterday, Nezeb walked here, today it's you, and tomorrow... who knows?

And the sands will always be here.
The wind whispers...

name.en: What does the wind whisper about?

text.en:
Many things, youngling. What was, and what will be.

Thousands of years have passed, and the wind still whispers. Countries change, cities change, but the desert remains the same. Yesterday, Nezeb walked here, today it's you, and tomorrow... who knows?

And the wind will always be here.
The scarab knows...

Many things, youngling. Things you and I have no idea about.

What was before, will happen again. New conquerors will come, but the little scarab will continue its work! Yesterday, Nezeb walked here, today it's you, and tomorrow... who knows?

And the scarab will always be here.
The sun sees...

The sun sees many things, youngling. It saw how the Great Mage was taken to the southern edge of the desert after a lost duel. It watched as he gathered armies, watched them set out for the north.

Many things have changed over the years, but the sun still rises over the desert. Yesterday, Nezeb walked here, today it's you, and tomorrow... who knows?

And the sun will always be here.
The cacti dream...

name.en: What do the cacti dream about?

text.en:
The cacti dream of many things, youngling. They slumbered when these lands belonged to the Zem people. They slumbered when the caravans of the Ugra people crossed the desert.

Everything comes and goes, but the cacti still bloom at the appropriate time. Yesterday, Nezeb walked here, today it's you, and tomorrow... who knows?

And the cacti will always be here.
The birds talk...

name.en: What do the birds talk about?

text.en:
The birds talk about many things, youngling. They warned each other when they saw a caravan move through the desert, they watched as Nezeb searched for the hidden jinn kingdom and discussed it among themselves.

The desert will always be here, and so will the birds. Yesterday, Nezeb walked here, today it's you, and tomorrow... who knows?

And the birds will always be here.
The animals seek...

They seek many things, youngling. They prowled the land around the tents of the Ugra people, watched the fires from the darkness. They saw how the Great Nezeb fought for power, defeating one leader after another.

The laws of the desert are unforgiving, there is no mercy. Yesterday, Nezeb walked here, today it's you, and tomorrow... who knows?

And the animals will always be here.
The rocks watch...

Many things, youngling. The rocks were the ancient walls of the magical jinn kingdom where we hid from the troubles of this world. But they weren't enough to hide us from Nezeb's craving for power.

The rocks still stand, but the jinns were enslaved. Yesterday, Nezeb walked here, today it's you, and tomorrow... who knows?

And the rocks will always be here.
Jinns guard...

They guard many things, youngling. The jinn people are numerous, there are many tribes - and we swore to guard the Great Nezeb's treasures.

But not all of us are faithful to duty. Fire Ifrits want these treasures for themselves! Yesterday, Nezeb walked here, today it's you, and tomorrow... who knows?

And the jinns will always be here.
My crabs are faster than everyone else! Lightning always comes first, then it's Thunder and Breeze, and then all the rest.
Careful with the rocket! No, you won't need a helmet, the water won't hurt you. Ready!

Do you want to race my crabs? I'm afraid this is not the right time. The wrong winds are blowing. They might take you away to the Astral, so no flying just yet. Look up the next event in your calendar!
Perish the thought, you can't fly in such a weather. What if the wind blows you out into the Astral? Look up the calendar first.
Well, here comes the terror of the depths!
Fly
No, not now, sorry. The Squawker is not ready to fly. Look up the event in your calendar.
They say, never shall those born to swim, learn to fly! Oh but yes we shall! I've been dreaming of flying since I was born, and now look, we've got our Squawker! Want a ride?
Do you want a ride? Such a pity, Squawker cannot fly right now. Look up the event in your calendar and come back.

It's not only birdies and butterflies that fly over the Atoll! We've raised a wonderful Squawker bird. He loves giving people rides!
He's not quite fully trained yet, but we're working on it. He's a great singer, too. When you ride him and hear him sing - encourage him, alright? No, not with treats - we feed him well enough, thank you. He loves fireworks! As soon as he starts singing - set off fireworks!
I'm sure you're going to love flying around. Just be careful not to fall off. Take a deep breath if your head starts spinning. Shut your eyes if the sun dazzles you. Cry if you feel like crying, shout if you feel like shouting! Enjoy the ride!

name.en: Exchange the Black Pearl for 100 Seashells.

text.en:
Wow! What a catch! Lucky you!

Here are your 100 Seashells, like I promised! If you find another, bring it here, too.

Sometimes special pearl oysters appear in the sea. You can find a very valuable Black Pearl inside. If you find one, bring it to me before it becomes faded!

I will reward you generously!

When catching flying bubbles, you may accidentally come across a durable inflatable bubble. If you find one in your bag, take it out and try to inflate it.

Inflate carefully! If you see that the bubble has turned red, stop blowing and let it cool down a little until it's no longer red, then inflate it further. Just pay attention - it deflates over time when you are not blowing.

If you can blow a bubble the size of my house, you'll get a nice prize. And don't be upset if your bubble bursts - you will still get a reward. The bigger the bubble, the greater the reward.

That's it!

It's easy!

This happens every June now. The breeze carries the sea foam to shore, blowing bubbles all over the beach. I don’t know why the bubbles come out so rainbow-colored, but it’s a real feast for the eyes!

Of course, there are people who love popping them. At first I chased them away, but then I thought - why not?

If you want to try it, I'll give you the Frog Amulet so that you can jump high and far. The rest is simple - you jump towards the bubbles and they - pop! - burst.

Pop a hundred, and I'll give you shells. And we also consider it a special achievement to burst a dozen in one jump or a hundred in a minute. So if you want to show your special skills in catching bubbles, now is the time. There will be no bubbles in July!
Just look how amazing they are! How beautifully they shimmer in the sun! And how loudly they burst!

The bubbles are so beautiful and so fragile - they have all burst!

Come back a little later - soon the wind will bring a pile of new bubbles from the sea. Here, take a look at the calendar!

In June, the wind brings beautiful iridescent bubbles from the sea. Their time is over now, but next year they will return again.

Come visit me next summer if you want to chase after them.
Usually Jack buys these pills from me. I will make a pill for you in exchange for 10 insects of any kind.
Here's your pill!

The third race of every hour is with random bets!

I'll roll the dice, and it will determine which crab your bet will land on. You can't change your bet, only wait until next time.

The risk is high, but the reward is also higher!

1st place - 25 shells,

2nd place - 20 shells,

3rd place - 15 shells,

4th place - 12 shells,

5th place - 10 shells,

6th place - 8 shells.
Accepted!

Quarr! I'll tell you the rules - listen carefully.

Everything will take in July. Not before and not after! Remember that! Do not dawdle or you'll miss everything!

Once an hour a large bonfire burns. And you come and dance with everyone. Watch for the hints and do as they say immediately. Do not think! The more correct moves, the better.

Then whirl around! Spin! And pick up the lights. But pick them up quickly, or you won't have enough.

Once you are done, you get your reward. Then wait and come back in an hour. Or when you're in the mood.

What is bonfire dancing? What do you think? It's our ancient tradition. Every July the tribe gathers, makes a big fire, then dances.

For what purpose? A bonfire is a particle of the hot sun. The sun shines - life continues, everyone rejoices.

Quarr! Pay attention to the hints that the fiery spirit gives you, make the right moves, avoid mistakes. Then spin like the sun in the sky and pick up the lights.

If you do everything right, you will be rewarded.

Remember: this dancing takes place only in July. Then it will be over until next year.
Dancing will start soon! Hurry up! Don't be late! It's time to dance and earn sparklets!
Quarr! This is not the right time for dancing. Wait until the time comes. It takes place every hour.
There's my favorite customer! Would you like a drink?

name.en: I want to take an egg

text.en:
That's wonderful! Quarr!

My people love winged creatures and try to tame every kind. Ancient, strong Squawkers, or a fierce thunder-bird, or a clever parrot. But those who have feathers but do not fly? We don't consider them birds!

Do you understand that it's a big responsibility?
Fine. Go and pick your future pet.
Now go to the egg keeper and ask for an egg.
I'll watch over the eggs!

name.en: Ask for a juicy fruit cocktail

text.en:
Excellent fruit, juicy and tasty!

What should I add? Some rum? Perhaps tequila?
Alright, alright! Here.

The parrot's eyes are filled with delight. He eagerly grabs the glass with his clumsy wings. Mission accomplished!

Now you need to return the fidget to the nest.

I can hardly recognize your friend! Where did he get this hat and glasses?

The young parrot looks pleased with itself, looking at you expectantly.

You need to feed it!

The fledgling ignores the fruit and finishes the cocktail.

You'll have to compromise.

…

The parrot clearly does not want to move from the spot.

name.en: Come on, it will be fun!

text.en:
…

The parrot shows a little interest, but he is still reluctant.

I can hardly recognize your friend! Where did he get this hat and glasses?

The young parrot looks pleased with itself.
What happened to your ward?

Let me guess - the past few days weren't easy for him? It's not surprising - your pet exhausted himself and ate too much!

Bring me fat bugs and butterflies of all kinds, and I will prepare a special potion that will cheer the fledgling up.

name.en: He are the insects you asked for

text.en: One of each? That should do. I'll make the potion now, and you go take a walk, then come back.
Ready. Here you go. Quarr! I hope your friend gets well.
Quarr! What brings you here, wingless creature?

name.en: I need equipment for my parrot

text.en:
Quarr! It is time, yes? You'll get your equipment!

But I've run out of certain materials. Bring them to me - I'll give you a discount.

Bring me two dozen palm leaves, one tough pearl oyster shell, and 90 seashells.

Usually I take a hundred, but like I said - I'm giving you a discount!

Good!

Once your parrot's training is complete, come back here. I should be done by then.
The equipment will be lightweight and comfortable!

It's ready! Take it!

Hold on tight, fly freely, and keep your eyes peeled to the sky!
Kesha is gazing at you with adoration, shuffling his feet impatiently.

name.en: How do I raise the parrot faster?

text.en:
Complete my tasks, and I'll give you a token. Trade it for a Spark from the Wise Woman. Then I'll give you another task to help you raise your parrot.

But only once a day! Can't let the young parrot overexert himself!

Do you remember where the Wise Woman is? Her name is Willa.

name.en: How do I raise the parrot faster?

text.en:
The summer is ending, but your friend is not ready to leave the nest? I know how we can fix this. Special sorcery! It's tricky! Fading Summer Spark - it hold the power of the sun! I'll give you one for a seashell or a coin.

You use its power to get a new task from Ar'ra to help you raise the parrot.

But only once a day! Can't let the young parrot overexert himself!

Do you want to see my goods?
Need to go up?
Need to go down?
How is your feathered friend? Give him regards from me and my tribe!
I have a new task for you.
That's all for today! Come back tomorrow to get your new tasks.

Once every few hours, I can suddenly announce a friendly race!

You will find out if I am going to organize a race as soon as my attraction opens. I will even give you a separate task for this!

If a race is planned, it will start five minutes before the end of my attraction, just like the sailboat races of the Aviaks.

You will need to start on my command together with all the other participants. And then just run as usual.

Come and get an additional reward!

Quarr! On behalf of the Summer Feather Tribe, I welcome you at the hour of the brightest suns!

We celebrate the warm summer flame! That is a great Aviak holiday, gratitude for the light and warmth.

The holiday lasts only thirty and one day in July. Then it ends.

While the festival is on, you can take part in it. There is fiery dancing around the fire, and there are water lanterns you can launch. Each activity earns you sparklets, and sparklets are a special currency you can exchange for goods.

Chiki has a friend Juju, the lemur prince who loves dancing. If you trade for him, he might dance with you.

name.en: I want it to be night!

text.en:
As you wish, my dear friend!

How did I do that? Oh, it's a little secret of our tribe. Enjoy the darkness and the light of the bonfires!
The bonfires are most beautiful at night!

Have they told you about our new entertainment? It's such a simple idea, but everyone liked it!

You can find colorful pebbles all over the atoll. It's easier to find on the shore in the bay or on the smaller islands in the sea. There's plenty on the seabed, too You can find different-colored pebbles in different parts of the atoll.

To build a tower, you need ten pebbles. Select a spot for the tower, lay a cornerstone, then the rest, one by one. It's easy!

Once you're done, climb it and sit at the top for a while, listening to the cries of seagulls and the crashing of waves... Nothing clears the mind like a peaceful contemplation of the beauty around us.

Now, I've been standing here for days, and you know what? Try it, and you'll see!
The main thing is a good balance and talent for creativity.

If you like building pebble towers, then I have... Puzzles for you! A new one every day! How to solve them?

First, listen to the puzzle and imagine what the tower should look like.

If it's a tower that looks like a tiger, it will be black and orange striped. Take black and orange pebbles and stack them accordingly. Done!

Once you build the tower, I will put a tag on it with a hint: how many colors were guessed and how many pebbles were correctly placed. If you don't guess it right away, the hint will help you make another attempt.

And you can consult with other vacationers! I don't mind!

First, you need a partner - can't play alone. Or better yet, four - the more players you have, the more points you earn. Hugi is always around, if there's no one else to play with.

You need to play in the court - and don't take the ball away from the court, or else it will leave you. Yes, it can do that.

To begin the game, you need to pick up the ball and serve it.

And then you need to run around and keep the ball from falling. And watch where you're sending the ball - turn to face the player you want to pass it to. Try to pick players who haven't hit the ball in a while. The more often everyone hits the ball, the more points you all get.

Try not to drop the ball. The longer the ball stays in the air, the more points everyone gets for hitting it.

For every ten hits, you get seashells. The more points you earn, the more seashells you get!
After running around after the ball for a bit, you should be able to beat monsters more easily. It will do you good!
We're playing beach volleyball here. But the court is temporarily closed. I'll rake the sand and clean the ball - then we'll be open again!

Quarr! For the whole of July, I will help visitors launch their lanterns twice per hour, and my brother Chik-Rick will catch them at the other end of the bay. It's so beautiful, especially in the dark!

To make a lantern, you need two things: an empty turtle shell and a fern flower.

You can look for shells on the shore, and fern flowers - like the one in my right hand - can be found in the jungle.

Once you have everything, you can make a lantern. Or better yet, make several!

Quarr! When the time is right, release your lanterns into the water here by my side.

They will float across the bay straight to my brother Chik-Rick. But their flame can go out on the way! Follow your lanterns and keep the flame in them alive.

If at least one lantern makes it to Chik-Rick, you will get seashells and sparklets. And the more lanterns get there, the greater the reward!

name.en: What kind of tradition is this?

text.en:
A lantern is another symbol of the sun. Like the sun, they float beyond the horizon, but the sun sinks into the sea, then emerges.

Keep the small suns - your lanterns - alive until they reach the end of their journey.

That's how this holiday is celebrated.
Quarr! It's time to launch the lanterns!
We launch lanterns twice per hour. Come back here when it's time.

A nice wind, isn't it?

Want to go sailing?

The wind is too weak right now...

Come back later!

Only those who completed a training with Gik are allowed to join!

Once you're done, come back.
Come here, land dweller! I'll teach to you to soar like a bird!
What is going on?
Demons? What demons? As if the Leper was not enough! Where have the demons come from? Go talk to Ratmir, let him explain!
Let’s hope fish is hungry and likes the berries. You wouldn’t want it to snack on you, would you?
Joyride!
Let’s go into my chamber and talk.

"Eclipse" is the modern ship, built by up-to-date technology and filled with latest magic, not possessed neither by the League, nor by the Empire. It is the greatest ship in the world, able to dwell into the deepest layers, right into the heart of the world!

Only our shipyard could create such a miracle! It has no peers! Just imagine the depths of the Astral we can explore now! I am proud that I took part in building this wonderful ship.
Don’t hit me! I’m going to cry!
Avadhuta had a book! Colorful! With pictures! But the guards took it away and said bad words. Avadhuta is going to cut their heads off, nobody says bad words any more.
What are you doing here?

What book? Never seen no books. Books are no good.

I only heard screams and saw a ghost. He is well scary, but seems to be able to talk. Go talk to him!
Stares you in silence.
This is so wet, and gloomy, and smells bad! I’ll have to order to clean this room thoroughly... later.
I overestimated my abilities last time. Look out and destroy everything and everyone that approaches me this time!
Squeak! Squeak!
Purr!
I feel so bad... So weak...
Look me in the eye!
Welcome! What do you search?

name.en: Ask Goldie about the living gems

text.en:
Living gems, you say? You mean those I gave to druids as a thank you for healing my little brother?

You cannot find any more of these. I had a gold mine, that could give a gem or two once in a while, that’s true, but no such living gems never existed there.

They way I obtained the Prophetic Ruby, that living gem you’re asking of, was pretty weird. My people came to me in horror once, and asked me to go down the shaft.

I descended, alone, for noone wanted to keep me company - they all were too scared. I saw a crack in the wall, all in green smoke and light, and there was a tiny lizard on the stone. She spoke to me, saying she had a gift for me. Then she waved her tail and disappeared, leaving a pile of precious glittering gems.

I took them and left. What it was, I do not know. And the Ruby served me well, see?

Why you beat Grub? Grub fix the bridge, collect gold! Grub is good!

Used to wave a striped stick to collect gold before. Knights came. Took the stick. Beat Grub. No stick now.

So Grub fix the bridge, take gold. Grub is good!

Share? No share! Mine! Grub built the bridge. Fix the bridge. Why share? All mine.

My bridge! Don’t breake bridge! Grub is good! Alright, I give you half the money!
Woe to me and woe to you! This is the dark time for my dear Umoir! No good faith, no bad faith, there’s only true faith!

There is hope, but very little hope. The Leper eats down Umoir day after day, hour after hour, and the Queen takes no notice. Why doesn’t she care? I don’t understand that. May be you can talk a little sense into her?
I know all roads and paths. I listen to beasts and fishes, and trees, and mountains. Nobody knows what the source of the Leper is...
We couldn’t even think of sending the dreadful disease to our own land! We are trying to fight it, but our power is not enough. Faith is our power, and it is running out...
You are not the only one who calls upon us!

No human could do such harm. Whoever did this, I don’t know. There is great magic being done in the Astral. No godly magic, no Light, no dragon’s magic - it has come from another world! I don’t know whether it’s for the good or for the bad, either.

I can see how much you care about Umoir. Try and talk to Catherina. Make her stop following and persecuting the true believers, the old druids. She cannot stand alone. Tell her about the strange magic.
We will stand! This is our land! We must unite! We will never give up our lands!

I love the fight, but we’re not fighting the right thing. We don’t have to fight one another, trying to find out whose faith is better. The Leper must come first!

I’m even to ready to stand shoulder to shoulder with the Light, only to defeat the Leper.
Greetings

What a curious thing! Let me take a closer look.

No, I can’t help you. You need to ask Emelian, he’s a great ship master. Well, he used to be, before he lost himself into drinking and was fired. He knows a lot, though. You will find him in Upper City - he’s easy to recognize, he is always drunk as hell.
Whaddaya want?

Astro what labe?

Look how skilled ancient crafters were! Today all you have to do is press the buttons to rule the ship. Back in the old days, a good captain could navigate through the Astral with his eyes closed. Let me take a closer look at your astral labe.

Right, I know the place. Look, this figure is called a coordinate. In this place there’s a small allod with Imperial dogs on it. No idea what they do there. Some kind of scientific ex-perdition, or something. Anyway, Queen said don’t bother the Imperials, but don’t let them in Umoir, either - they signed a peas tree, whatever it is.

By the way, we have a real Xadaganian here! True story, you know, he’s a swindler and an easy rider, and a traitor, too - he’s fleeing from Imperial justice. No wonder about that. The Imperials tend to hang every other criminal, so it’s pretty understandable. Queen ordered to protect him, anyway.

Where to find him, you ask? Talk to the guards, I’ve seen them dragging him into jankers.
Greetings

Oh, Miloslavin, he’s in prison. Stole something, I guess. He’s lucky not to have been kicked out into the Astral. It’s all thanks to the Queen’s protection. It was her order to consider him a native Umoirian - ah, let it be then. Our punishment for theft is cutting off arms! No pity to thiefs.
You’re not allowed to talk to prisoners! If you have questions, well, ask me!
Danil pointed at him, said he was the thief. What he stole, I don’t know, and it’s none of my business. My task is to catch the thief! Go to Danil and ask him, if you want.
Ouch, hole in your pouch! Here’s your precious gem, make sure not to lose it again!
Why are you pestering me again?
I’m not holding you here! Go, and don’t come back.
Neatly carved and looks familiar.
You can hear distant sounds of carriage wheels, steps, hooves, and feel the smell of campfire and herbs...
Welcome, traveler!

It’s not surprising that people would believe in it! We even offered the Templars to place the idol of Light in our shrine, and let people choose whom to bring offerings to. But they wouldn’t. They decided to attack us, instead.

As to your question, it is no secret. The idol depicts Peregrina, a young maiden of great might, who saved us from the Leper. She pointed to a safe place and protected us with her power. Our people trust in her now and forever, that is why we erected the idol. You may talk to Peregrina, she’s young and restless, always travel around the world, and if you choose to speak to her, it takes as much as a sacrifice of a handful of dust, and she’ll promptly reply!
Miaou?
Miaou!
Halt! Show me your ID.
Oh, so you like my sword, eh? Let’s play then, my sword, your gold. If you win, take the sword. If I win, your gold is mine. What do we play? Heads or Tails.
See the coin? This side is heads, the other side is tails. I flip it, I snip it, I turn it around, what’s your guess?
Good guess, you lucky dastard! Here, take my sword, it’s no good for anything, anyways.
Good guess, you lucky dastard! Here, take my sword, it’s no good for anything, anyways.
Ha ha! Wrong! I’m so lucky lucky lucky today! Let’s play once again, huh?
Ha ha! Wrong! I’m so lucky lucky lucky today! Let’s play once again, huh?
Alright!
Hey, do you have a coin? No? You’re down and out too? Go find one first, then we’ll play.
Hey! What do you want?

Debt? My debt? Ew, I thought it was long forgotten, but no way. He will first forget his mother’s name, and then the debts. And you! Shame on you, luring last coins from poor people!

I will have to sell my last shirt to pay it off! Woe! Here, take this to Jade, let him choke on it!
Ahoya, military man! What is that you want?

You’re devil, and your dark deeds and sins will drag you to the saddest of the sad places, you’ll see! Depriving poor people of their last copper coins! The gallow has long been missing Jade, can’t wait to hug his neck! You’ll see, he will drive you to hell, too!

Here. Tell him he’ll pay for his sins one day, oh yes, he will!
Hic... Whaaa?..

What? A debt? What debt? Never heard of any such!

...

Greedy? Who’s greedy? Me? Oh yeah... hiccup... I are... Here, there you go... hiccup... Take this all, all of if! Blob... Do you wanna drink? Drink some!

Who’s the fairest one of all? You are a great and fair Sarnaut hero, powerful and strong, worthy of everyone’s adoration - the League and the Empire, the high and low, the great mages and the crowd! Do you want to know your future? What awaits you? Look me in the eye! See your Destiny!

Don’t go! Are you scared to even look? I can only show you what’s inside your head, that is it. You cannot be afraid of your very self, can you?

Don’t be. Look at your dark side. Love it. Be it. This is your might. Follow Annette and Yaga to obtain your power in the depths!

Are you really leaving? Come back! Look at yourself! Ah, very well, go now. I know you will come back.
Things like that aren’t easily lost. Here it is. Kick her hard!
We are not so young and strong as we used to be...
Greetings, travelers!

name.en: Tell the brothers that Adamant is calling for them.

text.en: It’s getting pretty late. We have to go, see you in the house.

The cold stone sounds like whisper: "Return what’s ours! We won’t forgive! We won’t let go, till you return what’s ours!" Judging by the holes in the stone, someone’s taken our the gems and insulted the Spirits of the Woods. Who could it possibly be?
The wisper fades, and the roots around the cave entrance step back with a howl.

You're saying Adamant is looking for us? Well, he can wait. See, we are out for a bear hunt, but the bear is way too huge to simply beat him down. We'll have to trick him, you know. See that rabbit over there? We'll feed it poisonous shrooms and dump it off near the bear. He'll eat the rabbit and get poisoned, then we'll go and grab him with our bare hands! How do you like the plan? The only weak spot is that we cannot find any mushrooms...
The Haregon is eyeing you disdainfully.
It doesn’t feel good!
Yelisseus hugs the notebook.

Annette kept a journal of her miseries in this notebook. After her mother's death, her father married a noble Kanian woman of the Yagas family. The stepmother turned out to be a selfish, jealous and cruel woman. She abused Annette, mistreated her husband and depressed the whole House.

The notebook doesn't give us a clear notion of what has happened here: it misses half of its pages!
Hello there! You must be hot and tired, have some water.
That’s good, have some more.
That’s good, have some more.
That’s good, have some more.
That’s good, have some more.
It’s such a hot weather! Drink some!
Don’t make the old woman upset, drink!
Shame on you! Drink now!
Drink now!

I know you! You’re the Tequatl hero! They’ve got a whole poem about your deeds!

We need your help again! Listen to what happened the other day. We went to beds at night, and in the morning it got so cold, like in the freeziest of the winters. Ice on the ground, no tea herbs, no rice plants, sour cherries instead of our dear sweet oranges... Animals are still in forests, alright, but we’re not so skilled at hunting yet, and our provision supplies are running out. Help us survive, oh great hunter! Get us meat and furs! Bring them to our elder, Che Kak, he’ll distribute them evenly among us. Or may be you can even work out a plan on how to return us home, eh?

That’s a thing to thank for! We haven’t seen much of you after the Crystal Palace had fallen. The wise men say, before the grief comes, the city won’t know its hero! Look at me, I’m a simple blacksmith, not a leader. When we appeared in this frozen place, everyone went crazy. Some just stood there, others were running in circles and screaming... I had to take the leadership.

As long as there are only two of us, let’s sit down and think, how to get back home. Oh, before we do that, can you do us a favor, please? The damned monkeys stole our belongings and buried them down in the hollow. Please help us find our things! We're not that rich now to leave them scattered.
I am happy to see you again.
How can you do this! Helping erect the idol, summon the false god, talk to it! Return this dirty crocodile, where it belongs. I hope you are sorry about that.
You’re persistent, aren’t you? Catherina will know all about this.
This is hereticism! Just look at it, all green and blue, like the Leper. What good can it be?
I guess, you’re right, we have no other options. Okay, you may talk to him, but make sure to visit the church after we’ve returned!
I remember Genlun as if I saw him yesterday! He had a long tail, thick, green and scaly! There was something beside it, but it’s unimportant. The tail!

name.en: Tell them what Genlun looks like

text.en: See, I was right! You weren’t that wrong, eather. Let’s do it now.
What, did he use his tail to help and protect us? That’s nonsense! His paws were strong and spectacular! Large as tree trunks and skilled as... as... you know, really skilled! Paws are important!

name.en: Tell them what Genlun looks like

text.en: See, he did have the paws! And the rest, of course. Let’s start the construction!
What? What paws? What tail? Every other crocodile has got tails and paws. The most wondrous of him were his whiskers! Long, silky and really beautiful! Whiskers make Genlun’s image real!

name.en: Tell them what Genlun looks like

text.en: Wow! I can clearly see him now! As if he were here himself! Let’s roll!

Of course, of course, it’s high time! I think you need to lead the process, for you’re the only one who knows and brings the truth! Stand right there and give us orders! Be careful with the snow, it doesn’t seem to like being sculptured and always turns into aggressive monsters.
Why, sure! But those old beggars are still in doubt...

Stone Golem doesn’t move. There are dead monkeys at its feet. Fresh blood pours from a hole in its chest. Inside, there is a round trinket, that looks much like a hole in June portal. It might help you.
Golem rumbles and starts to move
Look who’s here? How dare you enter the house of the Light? Do you want to befoul it with the lies about crocodile god? No way!

name.en: I praise the Light! I come from the Church of the Light! This is the official messenger of the Church!

text.en: Lie! You are pagans! If you really believe in the Light, prove it! Come through death, and return alive!
Right time, right place!

name.en: Ask about the Servant of Light

text.en:
This was the first echo of the upcoming war. There were no enemies, no alliances, no armies, but the war was inevitable.

But you have another path to follow, so walk your way! Become strong. Keep your weapons ready. Look out. Protect, when the time comes.

It’s a simple question. They’re here, because I brought them here. You have no idea how much power the Tep’s Spark conceals - however, less than it used to! How tempting it is! I cannot entrust it neither to Aidenus, nor to Yasker or Zayan, not even Holy Zosim. It will remain here, heat the cold stone, help the trees grow and grant life to those, deprived of it by Tep.

Disgust and disgrace. It’s worse that the Plague or demons - they merely killed, that’s all. The Leper transforms, changes... corrupts! Corrupts in the way, presupposed by somebody.

It’s funny, you know. You don’t often ask me questions, and now that you do, I cannot give you a reply! I don’t know who started the Leper. I have no idea how to stop it. I can only keep it within the limits, though I’m far from saving Umoir... But I will! Some day I will!
I have many things to do, as well as you! Send my cheers to Catherina!

These monkeys are so sly and fast! While you chase one, it throws the orange to another one, and another! But your legs are longer, and there are two of you, so you will do better. Save as many oranges as you can. We won’t survive without them.

Oh bliss! Oh oranges! This smell and color, and juiciness! No gem will ever compare you you, oh orange! But I’m humbly asking you, hero, to accept this gold as reward. If you can save more oranges, bring them in! Every seed counts!

Was it your buddy who scared the whole bunch of thugs to death? She’s one of a kind! I’d like to meet her!
Do you know about Feint the Greedy’s treasure that is said to have been buried on one of these allods? Right among the buried ships... scary, huh?

I’m not scared, either. Let’s hit it! First we’ll get the keys. As soon as you go on with the hyena, give me a wave, I’ve got poison gas for the case. Then we’ll unload the cannons, use the charges to destroy the barricades and knock the information and the key out from Musket!
There were those who were afraid of Abordazh the Merciless. There were those who were afraid of the Red Beard. Feint himself was afraid of me!
In an hour those who’ll live will envy the dead!
I planted the charges, and the guys are ready for the assault. It’s all up to you now.

name.en: How do we get to the next allod?

text.en: See that jumper over there? The only problem is that it seems to be locked. Let’s search this pile of rubbish, we might find the key.
Right. You look over there, I’ll look here.

It’s clear: we shall get them rid of the marks and put the poor things to rest. Let’s beat the pirates up, and as soon as they open their mouths, you grab the marks. We’ll throw the damned things into the Astral, out of harm’s way.
Watch your fingers, huh huh.
Once we’re here, why don’t we help the old man.
Look at that. That’s Feint’s style! The arrow is pointed at the next allod. That’s where we will move. If we’re lucky, we may even find your friend’s traces there. And maybe more.

Look at them, they won’t disappear, however hard you beat them. Do you know who they are? Feint’s crew. He wasn’t a mage, but he knew the legends well enough. They say, if you put a black mark into a dead sailor’s mouth, he won’t rest in peace, until he gets rid of it. Let’s help them, shall we? I’m sure they will be grateful.

Look who’s here! Good old Merry! Why are you so sad today? Where’s the smile? Ahha, there it is, lovely, as ever, only a bit too far from the rest of your body. Not so funny to have your skull played as a foot ball, eh?

name.en: Prepare the barge to sail off

text.en: Alright!
Calm down?! Do you have any idea how many of them were there? Who took it? Who? Oh, right. I know. Let’s beat them up and see if any of them remembers how to speak. Are you with me?
That’s that.
There is a way. Can you see the dark shadows? They can pass through this veil easily. Let’s collect some cinder from them and rub it in our bodies, then the veil won’t stop us.
Nevermind, we can wash later!

name.en: Looks like we’ve found their barge.
