text.en: Here’s their junk. And their tracks - they go to the forest, and so clearly visible, we can find them without a hound dog. Aren’t you scared? It’s not too late to leave! No? Alright, let’s go then, and don’t forget - the gold is mine!
What? How? Where? Where’s the treasure? Where’s gold? Who took it all? I’ll be damned!

name.en: What do you think of it?

text.en: So, Benny came here first! It means, we can come through as well!
It’s Benny, Benny, poor Benny. Everyone has lost their minds, but Benny lost his body, now he’s with the shadows... he’s taken it there, there, all there, poor Benny...
Thank you-you-you...
No, no, no, no...
What? It must be old dead Feint, he came for his treasure. No worries, it’s just another dead man.
Treasure! All mine! Mine! Ah-ha-ha! Everyone died! Silberpod has survived, alone! Alive! And rich!

I hate the likes of you! Normal people’s hobby is gold, food and wine! And there are those with the Mission! Considering themselves saints! Oh well, all right, I will tell you about the girl.

As to you, Silberpod, you wanted my treasure? Take it, choke on it! You killed Benny - now you’re taking his place! You’ll be guarding this treasure till the end of the days!

This portal led to Umoir long ago. We used to do some illegal trade, have our share, you know, before the Queen found out. She locked the portal then, and however hard we tried to open it, we failed. Your friend must be pretty powerful - she clicked her fingers and passed, that’s that. So she’s nowhere else, but in Umoir now. Want to catch up with her? Touch the four June pillars here and go, don’t let the door hit your... rear.
So, you’ve found my treasures, eh? What are you waiting for? Take them! Aren’t you rich now?
Where to?
Um... how did it go...
OK

name.en: Teleport to the thicket of the forest

text.en: In an instant! I hope I don’t get the spell wrong...
OK
Close your eyes... One, two, three!
Okay
Where to?
Close your eyes... One, two, three!
Okay

name.en: Tell about your victory over robbers

text.en: Thank Tensess! We are so grateful!

This is true, Firebird is there, on our island. Old bach Nikodim owns it. Prays to old tree trunks and roots, lives in the woods, and won’t let anyone even look at the bird.

I owe you my life, so I’ll help you. Take this magic horse! It’s like no other horse in the world! Nikodim once offered me to exchange it for Firebird, but I refused then. Now I am giving it to you!
A dead man doesn’t really need a horse.
These thiefs appeared right out of the blue!
Don’t hurt me! Please!

name.en: You greedy guts, why have you swallowed the horse? How am I supposed to get Firebird now?

text.en:
I did eat your horse, true. But you have no idea how hungry I was! My fault, anyway. I must help you now. The name’s Savva, Savva Swallow, at your service.

Let’s visit Nikodim, he lives near here. Gather some nuts on the way, he feeds birds with it.
Perfect.

Come again, what exactly do you want? My Roanie?! Would you also like a key to my tower, where I keep my jewels, huh?

Alright, alright! You can have it. I’ll give it to you, as soon as you will have performed my three tasks.
I owe some money to our gardener, Zakhar Curoed. Go to him and work it off.
Good day! What are you looking for?
Now you’re talking, we always need a hand here. Take the forage, feed the hens - they’re always pecking at my feet, I hate it.
Not bad, not bad at all. I’m too old to lift heavy bags and cut the hay... Now to your second task...
There are some lazy bones! They don’t plough, don’t plant, just wander around. The Empire, they say, sends them to exile. We’re not so cruel, so just teach them a little lesson, beat them hard!
Wohoa, look at that, how they rush into the field!
It’s the most difficult one... Listen.
Thank you! Milava, come up... What are you looking at? Leave us alone now!
Hey, fetch me some chips!
Keep dreaming! Take the broom, it’ll do for the horse!
Oh you pest!
Have you fed the birds?
That was fast. Thank you. Tell Mira, we’re even.
Get lost!
I’m gonna teach you...
Good day! Can I help you?
Bird’s feathers are shining with the living flame.
It seems that the bird is happy to leave this forest.
What a horse! Never seen such a stallion! How could Mira Hooves say goodbye to such a horse!
I’ve got the horse, right? It means that the harness is mine, too, and the briddle, and the saddle, and the girl!
If you won’t give her the easy way, I’ll give you the hard way!
What do you want?
Oh, hello! Look, brother, it’s Firebird! Like I told you, and you didn’t believe me!
Greetings to you too, friend. Enough with the jokes, give us the bird. We’ll take it to Catherina ourselves. Seeing the Queen is too much honor to you, vagabond.
I appreciate your help so much! May Tensess bless you! This will teach him to keep his hands to himself!

name.en: Your groom asked me to help you.

text.en:
What groom? Mira Hooves? I’ve only got one beloved, the Light.

All right, I’ll talk to him myself. Let’s run away, before we wake up all the spirits on the island!
Holy Tensess, I come for thee...
Magic Horse stamping its hoof impatiently.
It’s not letting you!

name.en: Ask Milava to soothe the horse

text.en: As the girl comes up to Roan, it calms down.
I served you well, now it’s time to say goodbye!
Happy journeys! Come back any time!

Greetings! Greetings! Welcome to what's known as Al Rihat Ruins now.

Why is that? There was a great city here once, it was called Al Rihat. It perished even before the Blight, during Skrakan's time when another war with the Orcs began. It was led by Tugarin, one of the last giants.

You can see these ruins in the western part of these lands. They are now the very heart of the Blight. And here we have an elven settlement, once the fiefdom of a small elven House de Tristesse.

But perhaps you want to know more about what we have here?

I can tell you what my brothers from the Circle said... Of course, the information might be a little... outdated...

Friend! How are things?

We are faithful guards of Great Queen Catherina. We joined the Circle of the Keepers to help them fight the Blight. Al Rihat is the last frontier separating the free lands from the infection that's devouring our country. While the Blight started to retreat thanks to your victories, the triumph is still far away.

I was once a hunter, like my father and brothers who fell in battle against the creatures of the Blight. But now I decided to help the Circle of the Keepers, because only they know how to defeat it once and for all.

The Blight is an extremely curious phenomenon. Yes, when you defeated the First Demon in the Burial Mound, the Blight was cut off from its source. And after the events... uhm... on Dane, the forces that fueled it completely disappeared. Those were the most successful years - we were able to push it back significantly. Even Glimor was freed, for example...

However, after some time it stabilized along the borders of Plagot, Forlorn Thicket, Clear Valley, and Al Rihat. Now the stain of the Blight extends from the southern borders of the capital to the northeast of the allod.

What caused it? The Glimor Council of Technomagic is still debating that question...

I'm here on behalf of Nadezhda Sialova. Our abbess wants to find out if there really are witches here. Yes, I've heard about Nessora. I hope you'll help us find her along with all her accomplices.

I can't wait to burn their feet with hot iron!

That's what my brother who's overseeing this area has said:

Right behind the temple district, near the tombs, there was an arena where the heroes fought for glory for people's entertainment. When the city fell, the heroes of former days who rested nearby rose from the ground to defend their hometown. Or so they say. I don't know whether it's true or not. But there are a lot of fighters who have risen from the ashes around here!

There are dead people wandering around the place, but the living are still more dangerous. Beware of Netweavers and Dropplers, and if you see a rat queen, give it a wide berth!

Fear reigns here alongside sadness. You can't go very far these days without running into a ghost mourning its hometown. Aside from them, there are Corpse Eaters and Smokeshrooms. I hear marauders make chowder out of them. Well, what's there to say? Bon appetit!

That's what my brother who's overseeing this area has said:

«It is said that there were countless temples throughout Al Rihat. People prayed to all sorts of deities in there - both known and unknown lest they offend someone. And yet, when the horde came, prayers did not save the city. Tiny shrines, or the giant Pantheon - everything is in ruins now.

The most formidable monsters that live here are not ghosts. Asura is more terrifying, and the mantes are angrier. And meanest of all is our brother, the man. Watch out for the marauders, they are everywhere these days!

I heard newcomers here tell each other legends about the hideous Gazebo. What do they know! There's no need to be scared of Gazebo: it's not a monster at all, more like a gazebo-shaped structure. Ghosts are the ones you should be worried about. Many people lived here, many still wander around, howling and wailing.»

That's what my brother who's overseeing this area has said:

«They look pretty, those crystals, but when they cover the ground like a scab, it's not a pleasant sight. People used to live here, there were children running around. And now these things are sticking out of the ground.

Beware of the beasts of the forest - the altered ones. Dropplers, Gulpers, and all that. We also have mantes here now. They'll eat you and won't leave any bones!

The monsters here are mostly living. There are Hydras, Mewks, and even mantes. They might be hideous, but when you meet a few ghouls or the dreadful Gazebo, you'll start to miss them!»

That's what my brother who's overseeing this area has said:

«They say the elves have great houses, and Tristesse was one of them, but they were considered poor. Well, I don’t know. If you ask me, most would be lucky to be that "poor". Look at the towers they built! They also had strong warriors and powerful sorcerers. If only Catherina hadn’t turned the people of Umoir against them, they wouldn’t have let the Blight into these lands, and the Lulleaguin stronghold wouldn’t have fallen. Well, other elves live in their houses now. They are from a great house apparently. To hell with that greatness, I say!

Ghouls may be scary, but even they are afraid of someone. The necromantic curse was put on them, and the mother earth really doesn't like it. The Satyrs come here to hunt them, and spiders spin webs around them. And the worst of all are the mantes that sneak up on you unnoticed. Remember: right now, they are a threat both to the bloodsuckers and to you!

Damn, these vampires are so creepy! Even necromancers who deal with dead bodies are wary of them. It's ancient magic, forbidden and bloody... Well, if you go a little further, it's where the forest people dwell. And Werewolves, and Minotaurs. Do not disturb them for no reason - if you think about it, they are not our enemies at all. Except for the Ogres, of course. Show those no mercy!»

That's what my brother who's overseeing this area has said:

«It's an old stronghold that remembers Danas himself. It's where our fortress used to be. We guarded the shrine - the great tree. It doomed us when some unfortunate person carried the infection inside. Everyone who stood guard here died in a terrible siege: forest monsters on the outside and blighted Treants on the inside. Now that both the fortress and the tree are gone, the destruction of the entire forest is only a matter of time. If we don't find a cure, in a month or six everything here will be covered with blue scab.

We Keepers have always thought of ourselves as friends of nature. We forgot what mother earth can be like - it can soothe you or kill you. When the Blight first came, the animals and the people of the forest didn't care whether you were a pagan or Catherina's henchman - they took up arms against all humans. Beware of them - and the Satyrs, spiders, and most of all - the mantes!

Once a stronghold of life, the tree has turned into a hotbed of disease. The area around it is teeming with all the horrors we're fighting all over Umoir: both mutated animals and corrupted Treants... And marauders, of course - there's no escape from them!»

That's what my brother who's overseeing this area has said:

«The land of Umoir is full of wonders! Here, for example. Look! All year round, hot springs gushed up from under the ground. People from all over the allod came here to relax in the baths. They say Skrakan himself liked to soak his old bones here... Now only a memory of these miracles remains. Healing springs turned into an infected swamp.

The main danger in this area is the marauders. It's warm and cozy for them here, and there is plenty of prey... It's true what they say: a man gets used to anything!

Apparently, it's not just humans who appreciate the bathhouse: both Minotaurs and Werebears love to splash around here. We don’t have time for that while the allod is in danger!»

That's what my brother who's overseeing this area has said:

«Isn't it great to get out of the blue haze and feel the green grass and the warm sun again? It's beautiful here: before the fall of the city, country estates stood here, the tower of the sorceress loomed over the city... But it won't be green and bright here for much longer. Sooner or later, the Blight will come here too. And if we don't find a cure, the whole Umoir will die.

If the Blight hasn't reached some areas, it's because mother nature won't let it. But it's not strong enough. Little by little, it gives way under the weight of the disease. And yet it doesn't give up. To any animal, any Satyr or Werewolf here, you are nothing but a carrier of infection. Do not try to negotiate with them, they will not listen to you. If they attack, steel your heart and defend yourself!

Even if it’s not as terrible here as in the ruins of the city, even if the ground is yet unaffected by the disease, the bones of the townspeople still crunch under our feet. It was a terrible battle. Oh, so terrible. And there are just as many ghosts here, outside the city, as there are on the ruined streets. Have pity on them: help the unfortunate find peace if you can!»

That's what my brother who's overseeing this area has said:

«This was a holy place. Maybe it's thanks to these ancient stones that the Blight hasn't reached it yet. But their strength is running out. A little more - and the place where people lived, rejoiced, and prayed will be buried under the blue mold.

Even a simple beast in this place is formidable. It's an old grove, the holy of holies of mother earth! They are children here, and we are stepchildren. They are the hosts, and we are uninvited guests!

Treants, Werebears, and Spiritwoods live here. And the monsters... There are no monsters here. Get this through your head! We are the Blighted vermin here! Listen to me: if I hear that you bully our Spiritwoods, you'll regret it!»

That's what my brother who's overseeing this area has said:

«The townspeople would lose their minds if an astral ship fell in the middle of the city! But there had been no park or townspeople here for a while when it happened. I don't know whose ship it was or what destroyed it. There's no sign of the crew, and the cargo, if there was one, was plundered by marauders a long time ago. They say every now and then the smell of smoke or cooking wafts from the thing. If you find out who the cook is, make sure to tell me!

In these parts, try to avoid Asura. If it puts a hex on you, there'll be no lifting it! I've also heard about forest witches in the area. If it's true, then we're in deep trouble... I pray you won't meet them!

The area is swarming with ghosts, and they are wailing loudly. If you listen to them, you'll go insane. We also have Smokeshrooms, Manticores, and Gargoyles. It's a fun place, as you can see!»

That's what my brother who's overseeing this area has said:

«There are many villages like that in Umoir. Maybe the monsters chased the people out, or maybe they left themselves. The river burst its banks, the ground sank, or there was a poor harvest, and people moved to another place. Who lived here and why they left - there's no one around to tell.

First of all, beware of the Satyrs. They are strong, brave, and most importantly, you don't have to fight them. Give the Agitated Toads and Wolfbasts a wide berth, too. Not scared? That's fine - you'll have time for that when you run into the undead and the Gazebo in the city!

The undead from the city rarely wander in here. But there are plenty of living monsters. Mutant Toads, Corpse Eaters, and Reed Hydras. Something to fit any taste, as they say.»

That's what my brother who's overseeing this area has said:

"This temple is the oldest of all. It stood here in ancient times, even before the Cataclysm. They praised the Foremother who had power over fresh and salt water... There's still plenty of water here, but it's foul and toxic. If we get rid of the monsters and figure out how to make the water clean again, I'll travel all over Umoir with a bag, collecting money for the restoration of the temple. We can't leave the shrine in ruins!

This is where the Forestfolk have lived for centuries. When trouble came, they went crazy and turned into Elmclaws. But don't fear them. Be afraid of forest witches that are hiding in the woods. If one catches you, being cooked alive is not the worst thing that can happen to you!

They say when the city was alive, people from all over the region came here to pray for good health. Now, you see, the temple is in ruins, and its parish are the undead. Of the living, only animals remain - Carpetfish and the like. Though that fact doesn't really fill you with joy."

That's what my brother who's overseeing this area has said:

«The Ridgeline is probably the last place in the area untouched by the Blight, marauders, or vampires. But the place is no longer as quiet as it used to be. You can’t sit by the waterfall and think about eternity. Minotaurs, Satyrs, and Werewolves gathered here from all over the region. And they are not happy to see us here.

The most formidable are the Satyrs, especially when they're drunk. Besides them, it's the usual forest creatures: all sorts of mantes, spiders, Wolfbasts... No ghouls, no blighted things - it's a blessing!

All the forest dwellers have gathered here: the Minotaurs, the Werewolves, and the Spiritwoods... You know what? Just stay away from that place, don't disturb them. They're not really monsters, they just don't get along with humans. We need to be friends, not enemies - who knows, maybe we can defeat the Blight together! And beyond the watershed, it's the vampires' domain. Don't show them any mercy!»
Oh... This one got me bad. Looks like I'm going to the Purgatory once again...

You mission is pretty simple. See that bunch of imbeciles and a tadpole? The imbeciles are carrying the explosives, the tadpole will help them blow it up, and I am their commander. The are absolutely worthless on their own...

There ain't nothing difficult in handling these idiots. Just shout loud enough and make sure to pop your eyes out to make them fear you!

Remember the commands: "Move it", "Wrong way" and "Freeze". They don't get it any other way, believe me.

If any of them dies, there ain't no big deal. Just don't let the bomb explode, or we're all dead.
If anything goes wrong, I didn't see you!
Soul... Where is my soul?! Have you seen it?

Eyes! They stare, and stare, and then the light. And my soul - phew! My soul's gone! Hahaha! Looking for the soul, hahaha! The soul's gone, HE took it. HE sees everything! Where there was lighthouse, now HE is!

Time! Time heals, heals the souls. When time isn't flowing, the soul isn't living. Ahaha! Sparks are scattered around, oh...

HE! HE is looking! And seeing everything!
What? The Alliance? I don't know anything about any Alliance! I want my Yegor back! Where is here? Are the monsters gone?
Hush... The monsters are eveywhere.

Get away! Don't touch me, you demon! Your words won't confuse me!

May the Light save us...
May the Light save us...
You say the harbor is safe? As if I would believe it! The monsters are coming from there. I will hide here until the reinforcement from the Iron City arrives!
None of this would have happened in Nezebgrad...

name.en: Send the Priden woman to the harbor

text.en: Are you out of your mind, zoor? The place swarms with monsters! I'm not getting out of here, no way.
Civilization, they said! Safety, they said! Hot water all year long... Shoish! Stupid tailless!

Stop! Who goes there?

Are you from the Iron City?
Alright, we don't have time for chatting. Take you sword and slay the bastards! We can talk afterwards...
Hey! Who are you?

What disposition you are talking about?! They are just beating us into the ground! They're absolutely insane. I can't begin to count how many of us were killed.

Do you want to help? Beat the enemy! Or pick up the batteries from the bodies - we need them here more!

Another Crystal? Thanks goodness! I thought the last one burned five minutes ago.

See that huge cannon? Without this crystal it's just a pile of metal scrap. It's too bad crystals burn too quickly!

What are you waiting for? Install the crystal and start the fire!
Here you go... Just don't let the guards see you!

Ah... It wasn't my idea, I swear! It was that human. I met him near the monolith on the bottom of the lake. Nobody knew what was that stone and where it came from, but he knew! He told us about the strangers from the sky, who sent us the great gift that would lead our people to glory!

It was then that I understood that the Great Fish never answered us because it didn't exist. And the monolith is real, I can feel its power right now!

Stupid Hariuses never believed me! All they want is to live on humans' charity, but we, together with the monolith and the strangers from the sky, can become the masters of the lakes and the rivers! All we have to do is to pray and bring gifts to the monolith. Hariuses didn't like that, but our people have made the choice! Now I am the lord, and Hariuses are pitiful outcasts!

When strangers from the sky will endow me with power, the whole world will kneel before me! Ah... Did I say it out loud?

To arms, my faithful warriors! Defend your Great Prophet! Warriors? Where are you?..

Don't touch me!
Aho! It seems to be quiet here, but stay alert - the Architects may be anywhere.
The raft is ready!

name.en: Ask why the lake people are attacking the boats

text.en:
It's Antonis! He makes us do that. The Guards of the Order gave him a great power. He says he will use it drive all humans away from the lake shores!

When Julis tried to contradict, Antonis almost killed him. It sparked off a real rebellion! Prince Janis fled with his wounded father, and I wanted to leave with them - but I was too scared. Let me go, please! I don't want to fight.
I surrender! Don't hit me!

Ay me, they are talking about the traitors even on the shore!

So here is what happened. Antonis, the first priest of the Great Fish, betrayed us. He has gone insane! He says, the strangers from the sky are the real gods, the Guards of the Order. He says, they came from the sky to punish the humans who encroach upon our lake. What a guff! Humans have never been our enemies.

The Architects? Is this how you call the strangers from the sky?

My father became suspicious at once. But he was too old. Antonis yelled that the stone in the middle of the lake is a sign from the above, a sign of the new age of freedom! Phew! But he was very convincing. I tried to bring other Nyxes to their senses, but nobody listened to me. Me and my father had to flee as cowardly shrimps!

name.en: Ask about the way to cross the lake

text.en: Why do you need to go to the Iron City? Are you lying to me, human? No? Then prove it!
What are you doing? This is our lake!

name.en: Find out what the Architect wants

text.en:
...The Architect's voice sounds like an echo. It seems like it is surrounding you, and thousands of resounding and vibrating voices tell you:

"We wish to build the Path. The Path of Order, the path of Harmony which goes through time and space. You do not understand it. you are poisoned with Chaos. You do not see the essence of things. You are shattered. Secluded. Broken.

Stop destroying the whole, and accept the Ascension. Then you will behold the purpose of the whole creation: the pursuit of harmony, the reduction of entropy, and achieving the Absolute! Do not resist what is predestined!"
I am the Architect. I am the Order. Why do you resist the Ascension? Why don't you want to be part of the whole?
What is predestined cannot be changed!
Why are you staring at me?
Me? How dare you?!
What? What do you want?
What? I have no idea what you are talking about!
You know what? Go to... Rohlin. He's been talking about... that sort of things.
What do you want? Come on, spit it out.

Damn it, why don't you mind your business? You think I didn't know it was Syoma? He is a chatterbox and nothing more, but who stands behind him? Who gave him the leaflets, do you know? Neither do I! I was watching him, hoping to get at something, and now you've ruined everything!

Get lost. No use of you here!
The altar is covered with blood and writings in blood, and the bodies of the sacrificed citizens lie beside it.

They are written in blood. Something about "the Prophet", "the Ascension", "Perfection through Eternal Order", and "parts of the whole". The madmen that wrote it seemed to be truly believing that the Architects were gods. And that they can make people equal gods...

What a heresy. What made those misfortunates believe in such thing? How can be good intentions covered in blood?!
Greetings! How can I help you?

name.en: Ask about the emergence of the Architects

text.en: Hell if I know! They just jump out from under the ground.

name.en: Ask about the emergence of the Architects

text.en: Let me think... You know what - they swarm near the shell craters. Maybe you should take a closer look at them?

name.en: Ask about the emergence of the Architects

text.en: I have no idea. You know, I noticed that some of the shells do not explode when they hit the ground - and then the Architects appear next to the craters.
They want war? We will give them war!

First, the Portals stopped working. Then, Adventurer's Stones started behaving unpredictably. But we only realized that was not a coincidence after the White Fortress was attacked...

Unfortunately, we don't have a Great Mage here on Dane, who could have transmitted the message throughout Sarnaut, so we had to face the invasion on our own. The capital is blocked, the northern part is flooded with the Architects, and I have no idea what is going on in the east and in the Iron mountains.
Greetings!

What can we do against that giant thing?! Do you have a cannon in your pocket by any chance? No? Well neither do we!

Listen, can you sneak to Full Moon and see if and of its cannons are still working? It would help us greatly!
Ah... They are coming from the north!
An army! A whole army of the Architects! And a giant monster unlike any we've seen before. What do we do?!
O, hello! You marvel at the beauty of Full Moon, too? Indeed it's a splendid ship with a professional crew. We will give some hell to those Architects!

name.en: Say that you are going to stir Full Moon

text.en: Have you lost your mind? Do you know what kind of training we have on Umoir? You won't figure out those levers in a year!

name.en: Ask for a starter's equipment set

text.en:
Of course we have some spare clothes and armor.

They are good for starters, but we suggest you find something better in the short term.

If you lose these clothes or wear them out - come back again, and we will provide you with a replacement.

Oh, we are living in a grim age. First Demons, now these monsters...

Sometimes you just want to turn your face to the wall.
Stop! Stop, you fools!
What's the order, commander?
Hurray! Beat the enemy!
Get back! Get back, it's a trap!

It was Hoof's idea. Here was the only passage to the valley behind the mountains, and now nobody will get into our lands! Hoof is the boss, and I am his faithful assistant, huh. Now Chelezny will have to take us into account!

What else do you want to hear? About the Prophet? He doesn't exist. All that gibberish about the Ascension and the Order is nonsense. Hoof came up with everything to fool the dumb citizens. All we needed was money. Ugh... Call the doctor, please, I'm not feeling well...
What are you smiling at? You think you've won? Like I give a damn now...
Don't beat me!

name.en: Ask about the reason of Nyx's aggression

text.en: I can't breathe! A grey veil in front of my eyes... I can't think... Every sound is as loud as thunder! It hurts!

name.en: Ask about the reason of Nyx's aggression

text.en: Blue water! There, near the pier... Blue like blood!

name.en: Ask about the reason of Nyx's aggression

text.en: Sorcery! Old human sorcery! They poison the water, poison our minds... We are fishers, not warriors... But we feel so much anger!
Just don't choke on it!
Where did I leave the waterdye seeds?..

Hey, what do you think you're doing?

You tryin' to intimidate me? You gonna turn me in to Ivan?

Eeh, alright, alright, I will tell you everything.

Hoof ordered us to get rid of someone without making a fuss. Who am I to contradict him? An order is an order!

Why did we have to kill you - I don't know. Gora Sharashkin brought us the paper with Hoof's signature from the refugees camp. It said that we had to take the Alliance spy for a ride, and that's it.

What do you want with me? Go and find Gora if you don't believe me!
What is it?
The handle is polished to a luster after years of exploitation. A faintly visible hallmark is imprinted on the blade - two crossed pickaxes.

A regular axe for cutting logs - there are plenty of these in the camp. But the way the blows were dealt gives away a hand of a professional. There is a small chance that Gora will resurrect after this...

There are several crumpled papers on the bottom of the bag. These are the same leaflets that Syoma Rohlin had! The one that Hoof killed right in front of your eyes. So Hoof has something to do with the idiots who are trying to give in to the Architects?

It becomes more and more twisted...
The bag is full with all sorts of things. Looks like Gora was stealing everything he could lay his hand on.

name.en: Tell about the brand on the axe

text.en:
Shoish! I know that hallmark!

Before my house was destroyed by the monsters from the void, I used to hunt and sell fresh game in the mines of the Iron City. There were crossed pickaxes on every instrument the miners used. Instruments like these cannot be sold or won. It means this axe belonged to a miner...
Greetings! What do you want to talk about?
Who are you? What do you want?
What do you mean, swish? The mine is closed! You better go away.
What are you talking about? Go to the city and buy there everything you need! They have all sorts of swishes.
I told you to get lost! You had your chance, now you're coming with us!

It all started with the "inspection". That dreadful minotaur, Hoof, with several suspicious individuals came shouting about the terrible conditions on the mine, and then declared it closed by the order of the Tycoon.

Well, I'm not only a geodesist, but a magician also, so I instantly saw that the order was fake. So I spoke up. Then the mess started...

It was a planned revolt! Part of the workers have already took the side of Hoof and his gang. They grabbed everyone who opposed them, slayed the director and captured all gold and meteo... Oh my! This is classified.
Oh... You... Ivan sent you? It is a nightmare! I thought we were all dead...

name.en: Tell Klavdia Kalugina about the Architects and the assault on Dane

text.en:
Architects? Never heard of them. But I can see you are telling the truth...

So you found a passage that led beyond Sarnaut on Ferris? You stirred up a wasps' nest, and now the wasps strive for revenge? Interesting, interesting...

As far as I understand, Architects are not actually gods. They are not creators but something else. Modifiers? Probably. They can modify space as well as time...

So, what do we have here?

Huh! The new play with the old actors.

May I ask, what you are doing here?

Return to Umoir? No way. I won't have anything to do with that drama queen again.

Though... Ah, taking the helm of Eclipse is worth putting up with the temper of its owner.

Damn those rotten rats! I haven't drunk a single drop of water in the last three days.

You are right in time, friend. They were about to start shredding my skin...

Why? For no reason. If there were a reason, they would have killed me right away. Just some old grudge...
Get ready!

This man is not lying, believe me. If everything is really that serious, and the Architects are ready to launch a full-scale invasion, we need to act right now! I will contact my command immediately and demand putting all our military divisions on full combat alert.
Good day, comrade! How can I help you?

We cannot repel this attack on our own. We are traders, and though we often take up arms, I doubt that we are capable of handling a threat like this one. We are nothing, really, against these stone monsters. Unless the League and the Empire come to the rescue, we are finished.
Oh... How did I deserve that? My ship is a wreck, half of my team is dead, and the goods! The goods! Everything I worked for so hard... Oh!

If that honorable smuggler is not lying, it means that a great war lies ahead of us. And when it's upon us, there will be no time for diplomacy. I don't think something really depends on me now. I will send a message our command to urge them to put their troops on full combat alert. My mission here is over.
Greetings! I believe we have not before.
Get ready! I'm opening the Portal!
Get ready! I'm opening the Portal!
Teleporting

Egh, come on! We have nothing to do with that. Haven't you heard of the Mercenaries' code, eh? We are the Free Traders' guards, and we are just executing their orders.

They told us to beat you up. So go and sort this out with them. This is none of our business!
Hey you! You got problem, fella?
Good afternoon! So, what's new in the White Fortress?

name.en: Report on the state of things

text.en:
The White Fortress has been recaptured? That's great news. The reinforcement must be on the way!

Soldiers, listen to my command!
The space around the Distortion melts and shifts.
Touching
Aagh! What is this mist? We're being poisoned...
What are you talking about! We are already dead...
Great! So we've been waiting for you? Listen then...

This neighborhood is quite troubled - we get knife fights every week, but this is something we couldn't expect.

Look, the body is neatly dismembered, and some of the organs are missing. I may be wrong, but it seems to me that all life energy was drained of the body before it was actually dismembered. It could be a skillful mage, but mages usually don't leave gigantic footprints. This means...
There's... There's a monster! We found it!

We found the killers! They were hiding in the basement near the abandoned garden. There was an ugly creature with them - in the dark, I couldn't tell if it was human or an Architect. It tore the guards to pieces and ran to the eastern gates, and the rest of them followed it. We need to go there, now!
Oh, this is horrid...

This wasn't a man! I swear, it wasn't.

I didn't really see anything - I just heard some noise and looked out of the window. It was very dark, and I only saw a shadow - a huge scary shadow! It had one arm longer than the other. And then I heard a terrifying scream. I hid under the bench and stayed there until the guards arrived...
I've seen plenty of things in my life, but nothing like this.

Well, they called for our patrol squad right after the murder. I was the first one to arrive on the spot. The Elf's body was utterly disfigured - no head, no arms, chest cut open... They seem to have torn him apart really quick - there wasn't even much blood. There were also footprints near the body - they looked human, however, I've never seen such a huge man in my life! Why did they kill the poor guy and why did they need his body parts - I have no idea.
I'm bleeding...

I didn't see their faces... They were wearing masks and floor-length robes. I couldn't take a proper look at the creature - it knocked me down as it rushed by me. It was huge as a troll... and it was whistling!

They ran that way, away from the city. Those two were carrying some bags - I guess they couldn't get too far.
Ask what you want, and then get off my back.

Godrick - this was the poor fella's name - liked to wet his whistle too much for an elf. So we decided to have a couple of beers together, and it was already past midnight when he left. As soon as I closed the gates, I heard something heavy falling on the ground. Then I heard voices above on the wall. I tried to look out of the window, but it was already too dark. While I was lighting a chip, I heard a terrible scream. And a whistle! A voice from above cried something, the whistle stopped, and then again there was a loud rumble somewhere above the roof, and then all went quiet. I walked outside, and - you know what I saw...
So, what's the news? Did you find the killer?

What a monster... How did it get inside the city unnoticed? I will give the guards a dressing down for such negligence! And you should bring these remains to Eladia - maybe she will figure out what kind of creature that was.
Hey, what's your detachment? A secret Alliance operation is taking place here! I order you to leave the territory, or we will have to use force!
What?! We warned you - guys, let's get that rat now!

Wait! Wait! I will tell you everything!

The Prophet! The Prophet told us to come here from the valley. He said that before our soul Transcends, we need to Ascend our bodies. For that, we needed some parts of those who used to be so close to the Perfectness! Everyone who wants to become an Initiate, needs to obtain those parts with their own hands. I swear we mean no harm! You just don't understand... The Order is the future! The future of whole Sarnaut! You all are servants of Chaos, and you will just keep on bringing more and more wars and destruction to our world!

Why don't you understand that?!
The old Portal seems to be functioning...
The cleft in the pattern looks like a keyhole.
So, what do you say?

Ah, my head hurts so much... Let me concentrate.

So they teleported behind the wall. Then they walked - quite a bit. And in the end I saw mountains, somewhere in the north-east - not far from the Astral shore - and Portal ruins. So this is how they get here! They couldn't cross the mountains, so they found an old June Portal and repaired it somehow!

Well, my eyes could have failed me - making prophecies is hard; it's like looking into murky waters. You should go and see for yourself if I was right. Maybe they took our sorceress somewhere through that Portal...
Teleporting...

name.en: Say that the dead men were fanatics

text.en:
Is it so? Ah, I don't like looking into the past - makes my head hurt too much!

Wait, let me concentrate...

...

I can see! Some people... And something big... and evil... There are charms on it, so I can't see it clearly, but I can feel its aura... They are screaming... Eladia looks back... Flash of light - three of them fall down... Oh god... They killed Eladia!

...

Ah, no... She's alive. But I can't see her Thread... What is this? A Portal? They carry her by the arms... And they're carrying what's left of the monster....

...

I can't do this anymore!

name.en: Ask what happens if you agree

text.en: You will become a part of the Whole! There is nothing more important than fulfilling your predestination, finding harmony and accepting the Order!

name.en: Ask why the Order still hasn't defeated Chaos

text.en:
The Path is not completed. The Universe is imperfect. Unpredictable. Chaotic.

I am the Order! I am the Architect, and I am the Path that leads to the Absolute. You cannot resist your predestination. Nothing can stop the Path!

name.en: Say that you have already stopped it

text.en:
Your mind is poisoned with Chaos. It is weak. It is shattered.

You don't understand. The Path has not been laid yet. The Path is the Purpose. The Purpose is the Meaning. You cannot stop what has been predestined!

When I lay the Path into your Chaos-stricken world, you will perceive it. You will become a part of the Whole. This is your destiny!

name.en: Say that you are ready to accept the Path

text.en:
Chaos has not devoured your world completely. You understand!

Hold on! Stop destroying the parts of the Whole - it makes laying the Path harder. Wait until Fractal appears in your world. Accept the Ascension! This is the only way to meet your predestination and bring closer the fulfillment of the Design!
Nothing can stop the Great Design! Accept the Ascension!
Look me in the eye. Sleep! Sleep...

I will cast you into a trance. You will see the future - not the inevitable, but the possible one. Don't be afraid! If you can defeat the shadows of the future, you can defeat them in the present, too.
Finally! I thought no one would come to help us!

We are a partisan squad.

We hid in the forest after the monsters captured the White Fortress. Sidor, a Demon Hunter, was our chief. He sent us scouting.

And now there's a huge unit of Architects approaching our camp!

Me and the Priden girl want to distract them and lead them away from the camp. Can you help us?

Happy to hear that!

The plan is: we lure the monsters away from the camp - there where they cannot use their quantitative superiority, and then throw bombs on them. We have a whole crate of bombs!

There they are! The Architects!

You see the largest one? He is the commander. Without a commander, the rest of the Architects become somewhat dumb. Just like our army, huh.

You take the giant one. Distract him, while we lure the rest of them to the quarry. Meet us there!
Come on, we will cover you!
Aho! What is it, zoor?

name.en: Ask about the details of the plan

text.en: We spotted a big group of Architects. If they reach the camp, we're done. So we need to draw a red herring across their path. We will lure them into the old quarry and then rain bombs on them.
Let's not waste the time!
Tonight the Victory Banner will stream above this citadel!
So only you can defeat this huge thing that can stop time? If you say so... We will try to keep away from it.
Go ahead! We will cover you back!
So, are we gonna beat them?!

name.en: Ask not to walk on the edge of the path

text.en: What? Why not?

How do you know? Do you see the future? What if you're wrong?

Alright, I will do as you say.
Let's show them!

name.en: Report on clearing the Sparrow high point

text.en: Light save us. Attack!
Are we going yet?

So what are your complaints?

Let me take a look at you.

I need you to take a small quiz in order to evaluate your, ahem, mental state.

So, the first question is: what lies beyond the astralosphere?
Neither do I. The next question is: who is Tep?

And also a maniac and a pervert.

Alright, answer this: who is Tensess?

name.en: A Great Mage from the past, canonized by the church.

text.en:
Correct! I'm glad you can see the difference between the reality and the teachings of the church.

And the next one: why does the Astral absorb all matters?

Well, I wouldn't argue with that.

Here's the last one. Finish this sentence: don't trouble trouble until...?

Don't you have a little sense of humor?

Well, what can I say. If you are willing to survive, there's nothing I can do!

Here, drink this mixture and go away.
Clearly, you haven't recovered yet. I need you to stay in the hospital.

name.en: Because the Astral is an unstable chaotic ultra-matter

text.en:
Let's assume it is, so what?

You are clearly unable to link up a logical chain and need further treatment.
That's some risky talk! I can't let you out when you're like that. They will blame me for releasing a psychopath!

Is he a god? Really? As far as I remember, you participated in the events on Asee-Teph and communicated directly with his Spark.

You are still obviously suffering from memory lapses and need further treatment.
No need to get so excited! This is all for your own good. Have another week in bed...
Buy from me and no one else!

Spare me! I swear I didn't know these were stolen!

A man brings me goods every other day. He was going to come today and take his part of the proceeds. Wait for him! I have nothing to do with that.
Don't let him see you!
Who are you? What do you want?

It's not me! They forced me!

I am just a warehouse clerk. The bandits told me they'd embowel me if I refused to help them. I had no choice!

Please, let me go!
Go away... Go away! You don't exist!

name.en: Make the sailor drink the potion

text.en: Aaagh!
The space around the Distortion flows and trembles. Some vague images emerge and disappear in it.

Something's wrong. You don't feel the same pull that you felt next to other Distortions. Something's missing. You should speak to Unn to find out how this Distortion is different from the previous ones.
The space is shivering, as if being crumpled by an un overwhelming force!
I remember you - we met in the Shore City! I am Bjorn the Seagull, the captain of this unfortunate ship, and I am going to leave this place as soon as possible. Are you coming with us?
Run, of course. We have emptied the local military warehouse, so now our cargo hold bulges at the seams. I hope we don't turn over...

name.en: Ask whether it is time to sail off

text.en: It is, but can you see those two dots in the sky? Those are Furies, flying Architects. As soon as we launch the reactor, they will riddle our hull, and we have no cannons to fight back. Somebody's going to have to distract them, and my bet it is going to be you!
Great! When the reactor heats up to the right temperature, I will let you know.
Hey, you're not one of my soldiers. Did you come with the reinforcements?

They destroyed the ships in the first place. See those wrecks on the shore? This is all that's left from the fleet. There is no Portal here, so we will have to fight our way out.

Oh wait! They've been repairing "Robust" on the other side of the allod! This is our chance!
The only way to reach the shipyard lies through the city. It is swarming with the Architects, but we don't have other options.
The fleet is destroyed, the monsters are everywhere! We're doomed!

name.en: Tell about the ship in the shipyard

text.en: Thanks Tensess! We are saved! Cover me while I'm trying to reach the shipyard.

It's a miracle you survived after what Savant did to you. He tried to reverse the processes in your organism! Not just for a couple of years back, but more like a couple of centuries!

He attempted to destroy not just your body, but your whole being. If it hadn't been for me, your Spark would have completely disappeared from existence!

I warned you! You better listen to me next time.
Look who's here. How are you feeling? By the way, I was the one who carried you from the battlefield on my back!
I'm dying... Help me...

Wow! I know this language.

It is an order to Blackmane to sneak with his mercenaries to Kurbatskoe field, there create a stir in our rear and then leave to the other side of the mountains. Signed by Hoof... That traitor!

There is no way we can reach him now - the passages are blocked, and the mines are obstructed... But we will get him later anyway!
Hey! What do you want?
Step by step, we are going ahead!

name.en: Give rope pieces to the gibberlings

text.en:
This is just what we need! Hold on a second...

Here you go. Just attach this ladder to the edge of the bridge!
You smell with blood! What do you want?

Here, take it.

It is a part of the other stone alien. Looks like a face. The other alien had a face. He fought the first stone aliens. They broke his face in battle. Take it.
The stone is cold and grim. The names of girls, who fell in battle with evil, can be immortalized on its flat side.

The cold stone reads:

Yela Komelkova

Rita Osanina

Lisa Brichkina

Galia Chetvertakova

Sonya Gurvichskaya

In loving memory of those who gave their lives for their motherland.

The Sculptor? I haven't heard of him. So the Architect is not integral? Or a part of him detached itself and gained its own will? This explains so much!

Like those fanatics who worshipped the Architect. I never believed that the Architects could have come up with the idea of their own cult and demand blood sacrifice! Why would they need Hoof or helpless Nyxes? But if the Sculptor had gained his identity after keeping company with the people from the Empire, then I am almost certain that all that plotting was his doing!
Here the Threads intertwine in a strange Pattern...
Oh... Who are you? Where is my husband?

So... We cannot even resurrect now. What will poor Yevsey do without us?

This was all because of a doll! I knew I shouldn't have let my daughter play with it. But she just loved it so much...

Tell Yevsey that everything is going to be fine. He is strong. And I... have to go now.

Hurr... Pff...

Hurr... Hey! What do you want?
I am a free goblin! I will do what I want!
Come on, I was just kidding!
Oh... Who are you?

So you're not one of them! Finally, someone remembered about us. Since Hoof showed up and took over Ivan's summer residence, we've been in trouble. The bandits were polite at first - they told us they were preparing the residence for the tycoon's arrival, but when those guys with scarfs on their faces came... They said, they were in charge! Which meant, they could steal, they could kill, and no one could do anything about that. There's that gang in the village right now - they're drinking, picking fights, hurting girls. No one can stick up for us! They took all healthy men to the castle, and here in the village only women and old men are left...
Cuarr! Wingless stranger! I did not see you here before, but you fought that scum who came from the other side of the mountains. Where do you come from? Who you fight for? Speak, now!

name.en: Assure the Aviak that you are on the same side

text.en:
Alright, I believe you. You fight bravely, wingless. I am glad you are on our side.

The minotaur's bandits are hunting Aviaks down because we are refusing to obey their stupid rules! We fly wherever we want, and no one limits our freedom! If they have a problem with that, this means we are at war. And if you want to help, this is good news!
Help me!
I am such an idiot! Why didn't I take at least a stick or something to beat off the animals!
Wingless stranger! So that was you who my brave yet dumb son spoke about?

name.en: Tell about the war with the bandits

text.en:
Yes, I know. I am against war. Cual is young, brave, and stupid. He found weapon. He wants to fight. He wants war... He is crazy!

Bandits come and go, but the winged people stay. However, I did not say no. If he wants to fight, he may. Maybe a punch in the head will teach him something? Just make sure they don't kill him.
Hey, that was you who kicked Hoof out of the city! Huh!

name.en: Ask what the fight is about

text.en:
Well, you know... It all went smooth at first, we moved into the castle and kept all the locals under our thumb. We thought we'd live as tycoons - drink wine, play dominoes, watch cinemas! Yeah, right!

While Hoof was withering over his gold, that Prophet took control. He threatened and brainwashed everyone - he's good at that, you know. He threw us out of the castle. This is when it started... I've seen plenty of things in my life, but nothing like what they are doing to poor villagers. They chop them alive and glue with pieces of Architects... They make zombies out of people! They say, it's the way to the Ascension! A great honor for the mortals! Screw them!
Ay-hya! I thought I was already dead! But the spirits heard my prayers and sent you to the rescue, eysh!

Morrrons! They call this Orrder, but they are into horrible things, eysh! Even hunhurrs would be appalled by what so-called Initiates and their crazy Prophet are doing. They speak about some Ascension which will allow us to get rid of our outward flesh, which is contaminated by chaos. Damned fanatics cut people into pieces and glue them to parts of stone hunhurrs and bring them to life with wicked prrrayers of their psychotic Prophet, but they only crrreate monsters which are just as twisted as they are, eysh!

They saved me for the last. They thought that my magical skills and the energy of this ancient altar would help them somehow. Then they captured that powerful sorceress and decided to test their conjectures on me. If it were not for you... I don't want to think of it, eysh!
What do you want? Speak and get lost.
What is it you want?

name.en: Ask for a starter's equipment set

text.en: You're a slick one, ain't you?
Here comes our hero! So what are you going to do next?
Winged cavalry arrived!
Can you even fly it? Breeze is a rogue bird!

Well, since my plan was disrupted thanks to your courage, now go back and wait for me there. I can't stand flying, so I will make it on my own. Get out of here before the fanatics realized they are being attacked by an army and not by a single amateur bomber!
Ahem... What are you doing here?

Alright... This was as brave of you as it was dumb. You really think these clowns could have hurt me? Me? The one who saw civilizations rise and fall? Don't be so surprised, haven't you heard of Incarnations? Alright, let's talk about this later...

You see, I was playing helpless victim quite consciously and convincingly to find out who stands behind all this. It couldn't be a crazy goblin or a dumb minotaur.
See you outside!
Kya!
Kya!

This king of the Free Traders, he built himself quite a palace! More of a museum, actually.

Did you know Ivan Chelezny is an acknowledged collector? He lays his hands on all sorts of pieces of art, from silicon axes to elven statues, and the biggest part of his collection is stored in his country residence.

Now that place is occupied by the fanatics, so the museum is slowly turning into either a brothel or a nuthouse.

What about him? He's just a greedy boor who can sell his own mother for a handful of gold. However, he is packed into an Assault Shell and carries a Meteorite hammer, but anyway, I don't think he's a problem for you. He's not Tep after all, and definitely not my father... But he will fight for his gold till his last drop of blood, I can tell you that for sure.

If you defeat the Prophet and Hoof soon enough, bandits and fanatics will be beheaded and scattered. Then no one will stand in the way between us and the Sculptor.

The Prophet... I wonder where that crazy goblin came from. And also, how can people be such idiots?

Who in their right mind can believe a goblin on stilts, who wears a painted robe and carries a dead Architect core under his arm? This is pure madness. Maybe this is his secret? If one combines pure madness with infinite faith, it can become a terrifying weapon in the hands of a skillful puppet master, namely the Sculptor.

By the way, I heard there was a fire in a slum hospice right after the first Architects' attack on the Iron City. It was burned to the ground together with its patients and the staff, which usually consists of goblins. Some of the bodies were not found. Maybe this twisted faith in the "holy Architects" was born in that fire?

You mean those in the park? I don't like them either. It's so weird to see elves without wings!

I read about those statues in a popular scientific magazine, "Science & Death", in the Supernatural section. The Historians have discovered elven ruins on a distant allod which date back thousands of years. The destroyed city was built by elves before the Change - which means, long before the Cataclysm.

Just imagine how excited the archeologists were - the five elven statues remained intact among the ruins and ash! Too bad the ancient elves didn't like uninvited guests, so the second expedition found only withered remains of the first one at the feet of the statues. The second expedition was found dead on a plundered Astral ship... In its turn, the wrecked ship was discovered on a shore on Suslanger, and then the statues emerged on the black market after a while. Eventually, an anonymous collector bought them.

Some say the statues are cursed, some say that they still preserve ancient elven magic or even the Sparks of the heroes of the past... It seems that you will be the one to unearth the truth.
Here comes our hero! So what are you going to do next?

I knew there was someone more powerful behind the fanatics and the Prophet. At first I thought it could be a Great Mage, but when I heard them mention the Sculptor - and nobody told me about him for some reason! - everything became clear. However, I can only speculate about the purpose of their experiments. And my speculations are not comforting at all.

As you can remember, faith is a great power which can literally move mountains. The Architects - or should I say the Architect - is using the power of self-assertion. He believes in himself, and he is unflinching in his faith in the special purpose of his mind. But the Sculptor has lost that power when he detached himself from the whole. Now he is trying to compensate it by creating monsters who look like him and have infinite faith in his strength.
The first reasonable idea for today!
Well, let's go! We barely have anything to lose...
Good luck!
Close your eyes and don't breathe!
Oh...
Close your eyes and don't breathe!
The door opens with a squeak.
Incorrect password!
Incorrect password!
Incorrect password!
Correct password!
Dents and burned stains on the door show that someone tried to break through it. Or keep restrained what's behind it...
The door is code-locked. Maybe you will find the password among the papers on the floor?
Close your eyes!

name.en: They can kiss my stone ass

text.en:
"The vocabulary of the Golem requires modification. Analyzing the logical component...

Stage two confirmed.

Stage three: injuring humans".

name.en: Sacks with meat! Kill all humans!

text.en:
"Identification complete: Combat Golem Destroyer, category HK.

Access permitted.

Serious structure malfunction detected. Full diagnostics is recommended".

name.en: Sacks with meat! Kill all humans!

text.en:
"Identification complete: Combat Golem Destroyer, category HK.

Access permitted.

Serious structure malfunction detected. Full diagnostics is recommended".
The massive stone gates slide into the hidden slots in the wall.

The key starts to glow dimly in your hands; you can hear rattling and humming behind the gates, then from under the ground a cold mechanical voice says: "No response received. Golem identification initiated."

name.en: Pretend to be a June Golem

text.en:
"Damage detected in the Combat Golem structure. Automatic identification failed. Initiating mental activity identification.

Stage one: analyzing the accordance of the security rules."

name.en: A Golem has to provide its own security at its best ability.

text.en:
"Identification failed.

Servant Golems are not allowed in the Combat Sector!

Recommendation: use the service entrance."

name.en: A Golem is created to deal harm and destruction.

text.en:
"Stage one confirmed.

Stage two: following human commands."

name.en: A Golem must follow all human orders except those which implicate inflicting damage.

text.en:
"Identification failed.

Servant Golems are not allowed in the Combat Sector!

Recommendation: use the service entrance."

name.en: A Golem cannot harm humans or allow humans get harmed by omission of action.

text.en:
"Identification failed.

Servant Golems are not allowed in the Combat Sector!

Recommendation: use the service entrance."

name.en: A Golem cannot harm humans or allow humans get harmed by omission of action.

text.en:
"Identification failed.

Servant Golems are not allowed in the Combat Sector!

Recommendation: use the service entrance."

name.en: Ask for a starter equipment set

text.en:
You're asking for too much, don't you think so?

Alright, for this time, I will give you what you want. Let me see what I have.

name.en: Agree to go to Planar Rim

text.en: Close your eyes and don't breathe!
We shouldn't stay here for too long, or else we will be younger than our grandchildren by the time we come back.
Where is the old one? Have you lost it? How irresponsible!
Close your eyes if you don't want to lose your mind.

You see... That was me who showed the Architect the way to Sarnaut! I didn't mean to, of course.

After what happened on Umoir, I was looking for a way to stop Sarn before he turned the world into dust, but I failed time after time until I remembered about the Star Gates. To bring my dad back to life, trap him, and make him do what I want - it all seemed so simple...

I reached the Gates and sent an electromagnetic impulse beyond the limits of our world, and I received an answer... I thought it was my father, so I just waited. But it turned out that my improvised beacon showed the Architects the way through time and space... I only realized it recently!

I know it sounds crazy, but believe me, we have no other options. Neither the League not the Empire have the power to stop a demiurge. A god can be only defeated by another god!

I'm telling the truth. What's the point of lying when my own life is at stake?!

name.en: Ask what Klavdia intends to do next

text.en: Well, my plan was partly successful - I've brought a power that is able to defeat Sarn to this world. There is still hope! Chaos can only be stopped by Order. Sarn and the Architect are like positive and negative charges. If we manage to bring them together, they will eliminate each other, and even if one of them survives, he will be weakened, so we will handle him somehow.
Close your eyes and don't breathe!

name.en: Propose to go deeper into the Pyramid

text.en:
This would be a dead frost. The elevator to Tep's chambers is broken, and the corridor to Nihil's chamber is occupied by the cultists and the Mechanoids. Sihal's laboratory is inaccessible as well. I'm not going to discourage you, but I can't risk my men's lives.

If you want my advise, you should capture one of the cultists alive and interrogate them. All sorts of surprises can be waiting for you inside!
What brings you here?

Our lord will return! And when he does, you will shiver in agony and eat your rotting insides! No spells will help you - the Spear of Vengeance, created by Sihal from the shards of the divine weapon, will leave you no chance to survive!
Agh... That hurts...

Damn it! The cultists must have somehow carried their treasure away from the lab. Where do we look for the key now?

Alright, let's go back. It's too dangerous here.
Well, did you find anything?
Close your eyes and don't breathe!
Too late! Even if I die, I will be reborn in the rays of glory! Hahaha!

Pathetic worms... The damned witch stole my power, so what? Did you achieve anything great, anything worthy or outstanding? Something that would be remembered through the centuries, something that would immortalize your names? You are nothing, just dust and ashes under the feet of the one who has embraced the Creator's design. The likes of you tried to master just one facet of the divine ability, but instead they have awoken powers unattainable for feeble worms!

If it had not been for damned Jeeg, I would have already laid my hands on the second Shard and released the world from the parasites who suck on its blood! I could have made it perfect!

You have made a mistake, worms. You cannot catch me unawares anymore! You cannot steal my Spark!

I will die - and I will return. I always return! I've been dying for thousands of years, and I have seen all faces of death! Miserable mortals... Your time will come.
Have you come to laugh at me, you worms? Go on then! Laugh while you still can!
Departing
Elevator

name.en: Ask if there is a cave that matches the description

text.en: Among all caves on Frontier, I would suspect the one that is being so persistently obstructed by the brave Watchful family. And since the Wormfaces are equally persistent in their attempts to clear it, I am pretty sure that the temple you are looking for is located there.

name.en: Tell about the Destroyers and the key

text.en: Let me think. Destroyers only dwell on this allod, which means their temple must be somewhere on Frontier. We haven't seen anything looking like a temple, which means it is hidden somehow. Most likely, under the ground. How do we get under the ground? Through a cave, obviously!
Get ready!
Close your eyes!
Ah, this so creepy. Tep's dead, but his Pyramid lives on with its own life. We need to get away from here as soon as possible!

name.en: Ask Klavdia what she is going to do

text.en:
Nothing has changed here... If the weapon does exist, it is not here.

I'm afraid we'll have to resort to extreme measures. There's no other choice. I will try to revive Tep's memory! I will instill a Spark into his withered remains and make him talk!

You think it won't work? Ha! Don't worry, I've almost depleted his Spark, so he won't be a threat... I'm almost certain. We won't know unless we try!

Well, let's try and resurrect the most dangerous and crazy sorcerer in the world! I always wanted to do something like this...
Taking the elevator
The Elevator Control Panel slightly gleams with a green light.
The Elevator Control Panel slightly gleams with a green light.

It’s easy for Yasker - they will just do whatever he says. And in the League... Oh, reaching any sort of concordance in the League is a pain in the neck.

But as I’ve said it many times... we won't give up! We'll make it through! We'll win!

It’s easy for Yasker - they will just do whatever he says. And in the League... Oh, reaching any sort of concordance in the League is a pain in the neck.

But as I’ve said it many times... we won't give up! We'll make it through! We'll win!
The only thought that consoles me is that you bring our enemies the same amount of trouble as you do to us.
So this is how it worked out for you... You’re always restless, aren’t you?
What a curious construction. Is it called the Observatory? I feel very calm here.
This place gives us many possibilities... And I’m not sure whether I want to use them.
My advice is: less counsels and meetings, more action.

name.en: Tell about the Purgatory from the future

text.en: What a dread. What Nihaz wants with me in the future? Anyway, he’s not getting it!

Peace is always a weird political situation. When you’re at war, everything is clear and simple. You know who you don’t trust. You know what you want to achieve and how. You have rigid moral restrictions, and your people have vivid goals. While armistice...

As my experience shows, there isn’t such thing as peace. There’s only uncertainty. You’re either part of the Empire, or you’re against the Empire. A simple world design.

Peace is always a weird political situation. When you’re at war, everything is clear and simple. You know who you don’t trust. You know what you want to achieve and how. You have rigid moral restrictions, and your people have vivid goals. While armistice...

As my experience shows, there isn’t such thing as peace. There’s only uncertainty. You’re either part of the Empire, or you’re against the Empire. A simple world design.
So they’ve got brave? Well, this is for the best... Maybe. But don’t think I’ll forget this.
Is there anything important? If no, please excuse me - I’m busy.
Why did you have to blow up the bulwark of Imperial science? Well, I shouldn’t be surprised... Destroying things has become your hobby a long time ago.

name.en: Your Darkness has ruined the world!

text.en:
I tried, you silly worm, I tried so hard to make you and thousands of others see the truth of this world. And you seemed to understand it, you seemed to be able to enunciate it... But still you refuse to embrace it.

I created this world. Do you understand? I created it a long time ago. A perfect blank slate engulfed in flames. First-rate stars, a convenient nebula nearby that hides my creation from prying eyes. And rage of a defeated god as its core! Ah, Sarn. You could have become a WORLD, foolish brother.

A couple of billions of years - and the world could give birth to a new race. A strong, proud race. They would come into existence on their own, without divine interference -  it’s possible, believe me.

But gods of Light are snobs. He refused to concede defeat! He mistook his madness for wisdom and tried to follow in my footsteps. To fight fire with fire. "The gods of Darkness want nothing but destruction for the sake of destruction," his wounded pride told him. "I will destroy that Darkness and turn his weapon against him!"

Hah.

Well, he got what he wanted. He overpopulated the world with quarrelsome races, including some natural destroyers! The world split into many shards when it could have lived on and thrived. And his children killed their own creator in the end. Now they live in a dying world, built on the bones of their mad god.

And the most scary thing is that those tiny destroyers now have turned their eyes to the skies.

‘We want other worlds!’, demons say. Holy simplicity!

Do you really think that they will just let you in? Oh no. If you had been kind enough to dig your own grave, please remain in it. A sick sheep should keep away from the herd.

Think of it... as of my gap analysis. I have taken my daughter, and now nothing stands in the way of my trying to build a perfect world from scratch. Without any crazy gods interfering with my business.

And you... Well, you should go. You can deliver my message to everyone. Live on in your swamp... if you want to.
In these days, you can’t avoid dealing with impostors even at THE PURGATORY GATES! Unbelievable.
... Klavdia does not react. It seems like she doesn’t hear anything... You can’t get an answer from her.
... Klavdia doesn’t say anything and stares in front of herself.

...When you touch the Tree roots, an electric charge shakes you. For a moment everything disappears in a blinding fog. Then you hear a voice that seems to be coming from everywhere - but in fact, it only sounds in your head. Nordrak, whose Spark feeds the Tree, has noticed your presence.

"You don't belong to this world... And you are going to destroy it. You will only find demise under my roots!"

name.en: I need to wake the creature that you have captured!

text.en:
It does not belong in this world either. But it is useful. Full of life. Full of energy. Its energy is protecting this land.

Your energy, mortal fly, is worthless. Your chances to save this world have long since gone. Now it’s only me standing between the Darkness and him... Waiting.

name.en: You are only standing in the way of the inevitable. That creature can help me fix everything!

text.en:
The mortal fly doesn’t believe its own words. Even if it did, it stupidity still would be greater.

To die under my roots is your fate!

... The sphere entangled in the Great Tree’s roots can’t be confused with anything. The Tree must have imprisoned an Architect...

And a very familiar one.

name.en: How did you end up here?

text.en:
I ran.

The proximity of the Central Node was threatening my new-found self-sustainability. Despite my inner conflict, I mobilized the resource of my altered consciousness called ‘willpower' and assembled a temporal device which sent me to the place where the Nod couldn't find me.

I hoped to travel to a somewhat more distant future, but I ended up here.

After that, I had to settle down into slumber to protect my consciousness. I found a great source of energy which could conceal my presence... and fell asleep. I couldn't foresee that this source would turn out to be alive. My knowledge of this world's trees must be very limited.

I expected to wait until the Nod is dead... I succeeded in that, I suppose. I feel that now I've become the biggest Architect nod. This is... weird.

name.en: So you’re now the Architect god?

text.en:
I don’t really get why you have to use theistic terms to describe something utterly common. The cycle has completed, this is it. If you mean that now I am capable of using my consciousness in order to reshape the overall power of our Net - I assume, yes, I am. I am the Alpha Architect now.

However, the Net power has dropped to the minimum... It will be awhile before I can put it into Order. The Architects are gone. There are only Sculptors now. They are all my reflections and incarnations.
Whether the world is build in Chaos or in Order, it will die in Darkness.

name.en: Ask how you should behave in the future

text.en:
Since you are going to the world of future possibilities and not fixed events in the past, you don't have to follow so many rules. Your actions won't have a direct impact on our reality. Your death is an exception, for in that case, you will fall out of our reality for good. This will have some dire consequences...

Ah yes, about the location chosen by the Observatory. I don't know what that place is, but I can see energy outbursts which can only signify a collision of two major magical forces. Maybe I'm about to send you right into the heat of war - who knows?

Be careful. This is the only rule.
I know you! I remember.
O-ho-ho...

So this is what’s happened... If it hadn’t been for you, I would have died or gone crazy there? Well, well... Alright, friend, thank you. I don’t mind living a bit longer. You can always count on my help.

name.en: Have I changed anything in the present?

text.en: You have, and it is still changing - the world is licking its time wounds fast, but not momentarily. Soon the orcish shamans will learn that their hope still lives... It will take them some time to realize they have missed this event. Then, I assume, they will put some pressure on Skulnar and get all political. Maybe it’s a good thing - time will tell. As for the rest, there were no significant changes. You have done everything in the best possible way - fast, subtle, with no fuss. The Laboratory is still closed, but Tep’s cultists are to blame for that. Your affray will remain in the history of the Empire forever... But other Laboratories have improved their safety for sure.
...The demon is carelessly hovering and doesn’t seem to notice you.
... The Demon doesn’t seem talkative but his greeting emotion feels pretty friendly.
A good place to rest from the buzz of Polis.
Cosmos is still showing off his Observatory... Alright, I admit it’s an impressive device.

If you ask me... What’s dead should remain dead. Of course, Skulnar is no undead, in spite of his name. But I don’t think this world will let him live peacefully. Destiny is a funny thing. That orc is now your responsibility. Yours and Cosmos’. Take care of him if he’s so precious.
Locker with Lab Coats.

You want to talk? Well, why the hell not. Anyway, I have nothing else to do!

My name is Skulnar. From the Fierce clan. I’m here because I can fry up anyone’s brains in this steel cave, and also of every single creature in Nezebgrad. Without even lifting a finger. If you don’t believe me, you should ask those guys what happened to my ‘tester’ the other day. They are here to protect the world from me, huh.

I’m kidding, of course. I don’t give a dung heap about those skeletons in their coats and the white-skinned Imperial commanders in Yasker’s tower, bah! Why would I give them an easy death? I will let them kill themselves slowly in their beloved war - in the name of the Light, in the name of the Progress! D’oh! I have no one to fight for. The orcs have sold themselves to the Empire a long time ago. Nothing is left of their dignity.

So who are you? And why are you covering yourself with that coat?

I’ll be damned!

Of course I know I wouldn’t last long in here and I was thinking about escaping myself... But now the cavalry’s here, huh! You think I wouldn’t make it? What do you know. I’d kill all of them in a...

What do you mean, we can’t kill anyone?! Do you even know what they’ve done to me?

Ah, a new face. Let me take a look at you... Hm... I don’t get why they’ve sent you here. And what is going on inside your head. I used to see weird stuff like that when I was younger and I was fooling around with mushrooms... Is this your memory?

You’re one odd creature.

I can see stone beasts and a... square deity? The League and the Empire have joined their ranks - alright, this makes your cube god look as a pretty sober fantasy, huh! I can see the world dying in fire, and coming back as if nothing had happened. I can see you flying away from a six-pawed cat in an empty white world...

Alright, keep your memory away from me. It gives me headache.
Wrong password!
Wrong password!
Wrong password!
This is the barrier control panel. Enter the password to disable the barrier.
Wrong password!
1st Field Generator Control Panel
Done. Field Generator disabled.

name.en: Ask for the password to the energy barrier.

text.en: Which department are you from?
You’re going the wrong way. You should go back.
Why didn’t you just tell the password? ‘YaskersPowerIfSacred’ - don’t forget it!
Hello!

name.en: Ask for the password to the energy barrier

text.en: Oh... You know... I’ve forgotten it myself! Just don’t tell anyone... There was something about...
No, no...
Yes, right, something about Yasker! And those creatures... nasty ones...
No, not them!
No, that’s another password. This one was about... How do you call them...
Right! ‘YaskersTermitesAreDeadly’!
Hello!
Hi! You’re new? It’s okay, you’ll blend in soon. Just don’t touch the termites.
It’s good to see new faces. This doesn’t happen too often after that acid accident with that poor girl... Where was I?
Where are you going? We’ve got a job to do!
You can’t get out - only once the job is done. And of course, in case of emergency. Once, the termites escaped... that was a mess!
This is the Termitary control panel. Enter the password to open the gates.
Someone has already entered password ‘ImaMagicFairy’. Now you just need to press the confirmation button.
For the Empire!
For the Empire!
They say black shadows wander here at night... What a nonsense.

name.en: The guard won’t admit a lab worker! That’s an outrage! I will report on that!

text.en: What do you mean, won’t admit?!
A rat can’t sneak by my guys!
Ask Sarang Aahotepre, she’ll help.
Ask Nomarkh Netjerkare, he should know.
She said I knew? Of course I do! I’m a senior lab worker! But it is her job to hand out passwords to newbies like you! Tell her that!
Is this what he said? I’m hearing for the first time that it’s actually my job. Ah, alright, you can have a part of the password - “Mana”. Ask for the rest from Netjerkare if he’s so smart.

name.en: Ask for the second part of the password

text.en: What an idiocy! The second part is “Power”. And now leave me alone.
I don’t like that Yinov guy... Something’s wrong about him!
For the Empire!

name.en: I was told to feed the specimens

text.en: It’s not lunch time yet. If you’re here only for that, come back later.
Hm. Which one exactly?
That one’s only next week. You must have got your schedule wrong.
You are going to be present? Really? Alright, go.
Stop, comrade! This is the experimental specimen department. What is the purpose of your visit?
