Admit you? Let me remind you that this hallway leads to the Termitary, which is a limited access unit. What is your assignment?

name.en: Report on the delivery of a Termite Queen

text.en: What’s wrong with you? She’s been here for ages! Off you go!
This is unnecessary. We have our own supplier now.
Alright, alright. That’s one dirty job you have. Wait... Where is your chemical protection suit? Put it on right now!
There you go! Safety comes first! Now, guys, let the lab worker in.
Weird things happen here. Weird and great!
2nd Field Generator Control Panel.
3rd Field Generator Control Panel.
Done. Field Generator disabled.
Error. Enter senior scientist’s password. In case of emergency, disable the generator manually.

name.en: Do you know the password to the reactor room?

text.en: How do I know?! Let’s go take a look at the door - maybe we can figure it out.
What are you waiting for?
Enter the password to open the gates.
Control panel of the Observatory Astrolabe. Needs to be calibrated.
Control panel of the Observatory Astrolabe. Allows traveling through time and space.

All of your actions have consequences, and they leave memory. I suggest you refrain from killing and try to be seen as little as possible. At least find some disguise!

I can't tell for sure where you're going to end up, but I can see it's an Imperial territory.

name.en: What do you want to do?

text.en:
I suggest we fix something and see what happens. There is no more reliable way to find the root of events than to try and prevent them!

In other words, yes, I want to send you to the past and ask you to save someone’s life. Isn’t it exciting?

But there’s a catch. Klavdia, a mysterious woman in every respect, seems to be using some magical construction in this world’s dimension... Something like a prison for abusers of temporal magic. You see what I’m trying to say? Have you ever been there?

Anyway, I would like to get the key to that prison. It would be rude to break in.
Great deeds are waiting for us, friend.
A brooch? How interesting...
I'm glad you came back alive. The situation here was... ugly. Luckily, I had a chance to lock myself up in the lab.
Done! Now you can use the Adventurer's Stone to return to Terminus.
Looking for something?

name.en: Who is Terminus and where to find him?

text.en:
Terminus is more of a technomage than a demonologist. I have no idea how he got here. I believe, he investigates ways to refine life power and turn it into magotechnical charges. Demons are kind of cheap labor here.

There he is. The huge aoidos, you can't miss him.
...The demon growls, but quickly realizes that resistance is futile.
...The demon looks at you warily with his numerous pairs of eyes. Clearly, he does not understand your intentions.

name.en: Give Terminus the bottle with blood.

text.en: Ah well, if it's all we have, I can work with it.
Ah well, it'll do.
Still working...

Tegorah is silently looking at you. You can feel his inner anger, as if a room were filled with suffocating smoke. However, the demon is holding it together. An intricate hand gesture, and a vial filled with black and blue... substance appears in his hand out of the blue. Tegorah silently hands it to you and turns away.

name.en: Connect the drone to the device.

text.en: Terminus activates portal feeding via the drone.
The screen shows a lot of illegible symbols.

name.en: Teleport to the Citadel upper level, to Terminus.

text.en: Teleporting.
The portal is ready for use.

name.en: Teleport to the Citadel upper level, to Terminus.

text.en: Teleporting
Good.
The portal is ready for use.

name.en: Teleport to the Citadel lower level

text.en: Teleporting
The signal is stable. Do you copy?
An Infocube? Excellent.

name.en: Retrieve data from the expedition journal.

text.en: Start playback
Oh, great.

Nothing good, that's for sure. Demons and demonologists tried to slit each other's throats with their bare teeth. There have been deaths. Mad demons were killed, but many "normal" fell... The demonologist team got smaller, too.

I could as well ask you what happened here. I arrived by the end of the show. Nogrom freaked out and summoned me. I put straight the cheekiest of them, but...

But there's something weird in their heads. I don't know how to describe it. The black... light? They're dim. I've never seen any such thing before.

name.en: Ask if he found out anything about the artifact.

text.en: Well, if you care about the theory... I think, this machine was used for "configuring" demons, so to say. Ancient, primitive, primal demons, the ancestors of those that we know today. Sarn created them from pure Astral. He was the sculptor of their minds, instincts, and thoughts, and this machine was his tool. I say "machine" for I can't find a better name for it. I have no idea how to use it, and I want the whole world to remain in the dark! There's no place for Sarn's heritage in Sarnaut!
All of it was a mistake. The expedition, the camp in the Citadel, and the demonologist as a whole.

name.en: Teleport to the Citadel upper level.

text.en: Teleporting.

name.en: Ask if there's a mage or a demon on Sogot that can affect other creatures' mind.

text.en:
Tegorah stays silent for a while. You can feel a light heat and awful itch. It translates from the demonic mental language as deep irritation. The archdemon seems to be out of sorts.

Nevertheless, his voice sounds extremely polite, although cool, when he starts to speak.

"Stormbringer, you're wondering if there are your enemies amongst us, demons. I can't blame you. I don't know anyone of my kin that matches your description".
I'm very busy. What is the matter?

That's what I would love to know, too.

I've received only two reports since they left. The last came in three weeks ago. There's no communication. They should have returned two weeks ago.
...You can't read demon's face as he's looking at you. His spirit is clearly emanating tranquility.
...Some bloody bandages. Someone from the advance party must have been wounded. There isn't too much blood. The wound wasn't bad.
...A half-empty bag. It used to belong to one of the party members. There are only a few empty vials in it.

...It's a lost journal. Could it be left behind on purpose? The last record clearly was written in a hurry. It's smudged, but you can read the inscription: "We heard an explosion upstairs. We got to the portal, but it is out of order. Maybe, the power is cut off. We are looking for shelter from the dark creatures... One of us was wounded along the way. We were able to bandage him, he'll live. We found a weak spot in the floor in one of the rooms. If we destroy the floor here, it'll be a shortcut downstairs. We can come up with a plan to return later..."

name.en: Tell Alastar that you're ready to go.

text.en: ...The demon nods.

name.en: What lies in the depths of the Citadel?

text.en:
If I wanted some drama, I would tell you, "The primal Darkness, the most horrible thing in the world!"

But I don't. We don't have enough data or people to start a research, while the Catacombs are infested with shadows. I will try to describe them.

You have already seen how "hospital" the Citadel can be. The atmosphere here was tense from the start. For obvious reasons. But things have become even worse since then.

At first, some demons lost their minds. Just some of them, which is not typical. The whole Sogot's pack was very confused. The thing is, the mood of all demons in a pack is usually synced. Tegorah claimed that he couldn't "feel" the mad creatures, they went out of his power. The general council decided to destroy them. It was the wakeup call they ignored.

Oh, what happened next was much worse! Demonologists started going insane. Some of our brothers became paranoid and went into exile. Others stopped ingesting demonic blood. You must be aware of what happens to those who tried the blood and then stopped taking it. It takes over!

I panicked. Demonologists were too proud to blame anything but the stress. But it was an obvious external magical impact. I tried to find the source and discovered a strange magic signature deep in the Citadel. I shared my fears with others, but I was ridiculed.

Luckily, someone took my fears seriously. Demian, a kind man, used all his authority to send an expedition under the guise of searching for ancient artifacts. It was a mistake. The expedition recruited those who never believed in the magical nature of the discord on Sogot.

name.en: Tell him about the expedition members you met earlier.

text.en:
Oh yes. The closer we were to the artifact, the more unstable they became. Both demonologists and demons. We quickly reached the breaking point. Demons fled in fear, and demonologists... Well, you've seen what happened to them.

The demonic horror made me certain we were on the right track. Fear is atavistic in demons. They got rid of it a long time ago along the process of magic evolution. And the fact that the horror returned in them means... I don't even know what that means.

Alastar and I did all we could to protect the minds of the remaining demons, but... We were all who stayed. And I'm afraid if we fail to do something very soon, there will be nothing to protect. Alastar is holding on and using his last ounce of strength. The magic of Light protects him, an incredibly rare gift for a demon, but no magic is eternal.
Glad to see you, although we haven't met.

...The closer you are to the artifact, the stronger the angst and the hopeless sorrow grow. In the corridors, in dark corners, on the ceiling, everywhere you can hear the mournful echo of the familiar voices of the dead.
There's so much energy around, the air is buzzing!

name.en: Ask Imperius if he knows how to surpass the protection.

text.en: Every energy can be directed. Every artifact has a threshold of resistance. If we properly focus the energy output, we might make it...
The portal looks stable for now. How long will it last?
Teleporting.
The portal looks stable for now. How long will it last?
Teleporting.
This land is still in sync with the Dark God's magic.

Hello, Outlander! Welcome to our land!

Was Draconids' before. Burning Claw's now!
They... they attacked! Captured everyone! Took them away!..
Pirates! The Astral pirates! They took them all to the other bank of the lake! Took our folk, took the lizard girl!
Silly shaggy pirate! The Burning Claw power will punish all!
Listen up!

I haven't seen you in a long time.

Of course, I remember you. We are still telling our kids how you knocked the previous chief's head off, the rotten Snap the Riverfolk! We had less trouble since then. Bloop the Riverfolk isn't bad, either, but he's obviously not Smack the Lakefolk. He's got a long way to go. That's why the pirates had no problem capturing them.

name.en: Offer protection of the Burning Claw lizards.

text.en: The lizardmen of yours are so good with the spears! The Lakefolk say yes.

This Smack the Lakefolk thinks too highly of himself! Snap, our previous chief, was no piece of cake... It isn't my fault, but I must clean up this mess.

If you think the Lakefolk made friends with us right after you killed Snap, think again. If they were a little more flexible, we could fight off the pirates together.

name.en: Offer protection of the Burning Claw lizards.

text.en: It is a good thing you're saying! United we stand! The Riverfolk say yes.
Outlander is one of us now! Great honor! Ready to enter the sacred ring and face Hissit-Asha-Shi?
The ritual is not over yet. Outlander wants to exit the sacred ring?
Outlander dances good, he-he.

You are fine. The Lizardmen know shaman's way. Their connection with spirits is strong. Alas, I am the only one who remains of all Frontier spirits.

It was wise of the horse people from faraway lands to bring you here. I can see the darkness in your soul. But is it wise to banish it?.. The time will show.

If you want to be healed, I can help. A part of my spirit will follow you everywhere. It will help you in the dark hour.

Go without fear, child.
You are the flame now! Go without fear, Burning Claw!

Strong body, strong soul! Fire burning in the sacred ring is not just another fire! It burns not only your body, but your very soul. You must become fire to survive. Outlander drink a special potion to become fire!
Fire no harm you no more. Go without fear, Burning Claw!
Flame is raging in the sacred ring. Sacred food blesses our body and let us become one with the flame. It hurts no more. Outlander eats our food to dance in the flame, like a true Burning Claw!

name.en: Say thank you and take the Ritual Mask.

text.en: Your face is the flame now! Go without fear, Burning Claw!

Every Lizardman and every Outlander must cover their muz... their faces in the presence of great spirit Hissit-Asha-Shi. It is how we show respect to our patron and protect our minds from his flaming eye. I made this mask specially for you, Outlander, as Hiss Abyss requested.
I'm trying to understand why Lizardmen want the bird elements on this physical shape. Customs of these people are very strange.

If it weren't for Outlander, Kiela would never see home again. Kiela no forget you. Name my first child in your honor!

No, wait, the first child is the sacrifice to the spirit of fire... I name my second child in your honor!
Nice dance, Outlander. Hissit-Asha-Shi is satisfied.

Outlander is always welcome in our land! Not Outlander anymore!

Come at any time! We share food with you!

Not share no women, though. No, no.
Outlander had fun yesterday! Ha-ha!
Our Patron favors us and Outlander!

The tribe of warriors... Perfect.

Citovras taught us to search other tribes of warriors and learn their wisdom.
The Spirits of the Ancestors are silent...

Life is frozen here. It's like the nature is dead, but it fails to realize that it's dead.

The orcs are very strong, given that they manage to survive here.

All right. Allow me to perform the Ritual of Truth on them.

It will take a minute.
I sense danger... We shouldn't stay here for too long.
Look what the wind blew in. Horse people! Fancy that! They're not even corrupted.

name.en: So you managed to defeat the Leper.

text.en:
Defeat? That's a bit strong. Although that's the way our songwriters will put it. Naah. We're ordinary people. All we did was pray to gods for it to pass.

I have no idea if it was gods' help or someone else's bright actions, but the Leper is fading. The Queen's guards are doing all they can. Not everyone is happy about their presence, you know.

name.en: Ask to receive the Centaurs as visitors.

text.en:
Aye, I wouldn't kick you out once you're here. You can stay.

For one night.
These lands were devastated during the war with the Leper. Have people won it? Umoir people are mighty... Citovras taught us to respect those who lived through troubles.
...Ancient Moon frowns and growls even in his sleep. He might be dreaming about the fight by the Well of Souls and the brave tribe chieftain.
...The shaman cuddles the magic staff in her sleep.
Hear me... Come to the Maiden's call...

The time has come!

Follow me. You will see it with your eyes.
A good night for sorrow.

Greetings to you. I didn't have a chance to bow before you and thank you for your feats. Allow me to use this chance to thank you.

It's a sad night tonight. The Sage is leaving this world.

Everything is bound to come to an end. Old gods become weaker. The Sage, our God Father, is the first to leave this world, and it won't be long before we follow him.

There's no room for magic and miracles in this world. We put more load on humans' shoulders. Their burden gets heavier. But they will manage.

Ah... It is time. The time has come to say goodbye to the Sage.

name.en: Talk about your dream and the Sage.

text.en:
Don't worry, Stormbringer. Every creature, mortal or divine, gives a lot of meaning to their own death. But in fact... you understand, don't you?

Umoir gods have every reason to worry about their people. While mortals believe in magic and miracles, the old gods will be replaced with the new ones. Young, naive, beautiful! They will have this world.

Who knows, how many gods there were before on Umoir...
Your quest here is completed. Do you wish to return?

name.en: Ask for an opinion about Frontier.

text.en:
Frontier has become the last refuge for many civilizations and even races. Its continuum seems to attract the "events of the end".

The Lizardmen patron is a very interesting figure. They settled there just recently. The appearance of a powerful magical anomaly with its own will over such a short period seems unlikely. I will carefully observe them.

name.en: Ask for an opinion about Gipat.

text.en:
The ability of its creatures to leave behind intelligent soulprints, that add more chaos to the communication of the living, puzzles me.

Intelligent beings of this world develop fast enough to regulate their own existence.

In my opinion, the spirits' exodus will have a good impact on Enclave civilizations. I wonder what the catalyst for the events is... Orcish spirits are not the only fading magical anomalies. I have seen similar events occuring all over Sarnaut.

name.en: Ask for an opinion about Umoir.

text.en:
It's interesting. If creatures with signs of divinity are losing power, it is usually caused by the weakening of the mental energy influx from the inferior associates. In your case, it would be faith.

But I don't see how the faith of Umoir residents is weak! In fact, it's stronger than ever. It means, something else is making gods leave this world.

I know that Order and Chaos must exist together in Harmony. However, this event goes against Harmony. When the gods' power is weakened, faith is weakened. In this case, gods will disappear forever. What happens to the balance of Sarnaut's powers... is unpredictable.
It's so good to see the green valleys of the Spiral Ridge again! This land is not friendly anymore, but I will miss it when we leave for our new home...
I thought Tekyan were naive. Just look at these stone children!
The only thing that could banish the Astral from Sarnaut and restore the unity of all lands is... um... us! The Order of Creation!

name.en: Ask where you can find the Sculptor.

text.en: The last time I checked I was ruling the Order, not the Lost and Found service! How am I supposed to know?

Nice. It won't take long.

Oh, it's awkward to do magic in public, he-he. The aoidos are like kids, gaping at any miracle. You know, it's even cute... Ah, can I help it if a hero is asking for assistance?

Stay right there!
Good to see you again, Stormbringer!

name.en: How are the things going in Triquetrum?

text.en: As you can see, we made peace with the Centaurs. Both nations believe that we are too small and, how shall I put it, too mortal to be involved in a war for territory.

name.en: How can I get to the Centaur Camp?

text.en:
Ha! How about taking that canyon after you've covered yourself in sticky stinky... phew. Let's not get into that. They should have closed that backdoor, anyway.

We have peace, but the Centaurs are not prepared to open the gates of their camp for us. They might let you come in, though. Centaurs respect power. My friend Ancient Moon will show you the way.

I'm sorry I can't keep you company. Too busy. Triquetrum is growing by the hour.
Greetings, Stormbringer! Apios told me all about you.
Done! Now you can use drone's coordinates to return.
The Eye of the Sculptor is gazing around. You can feel your Adventurer's Stone starting to buzz in its presence. You can set it to drone's coordinates.
The world of chaos is amazing.

name.en: Ask about the Sculptor's objectives in the Centaur Camp.

text.en:
It wasn't my intention to arrive here.

The Centaurs summoned me. We had certain... difficulty in communication. We might need your help.
Thank you!
Listen up.
What huge trees! You can't see the sky behind the canopy. It's an amazing place.
Greetings, Stormbringer!
Falling asleep.

The reflection nods silently. The space behind it becomes alive. The light refracts and reflects, casting specks all over the place. Glares are jumping between you and the reflection, like a racing echo.

It is not my-his-your-our dream. No more questions. Only answers. Answers to the Riddle.

I am you as you are me as I am you and you are me.

The echo is jumping between you and the reflection, like a racing glare. I, and you, and it, and we, all the words lost their meaning, they echo one another.

name.en: There's only light here. Is there darkness?

text.en:
Tranquility embraces your mind, or whatever is left of it. You understand that the face before you is you. Not an ally. Not an enemy. Just you. There is nothing to worry about.

There's only darkness here. Is there light?

The face looks like a reflection in a distorted mirror. It looks puzzled and empty. It's studying you as closely as you're studying it.

This face looks familiar.
The vortex of memory is floating up. It hurts to touch it, but it's necessary.
Teleporting.
The vortex of doubt is floating up. Touching it makes your heart cold.
Teleporting.

name.en: Demand to show you the way to Darkness.

text.en:
The silly baby mouse is crying for answers. You asked your questions. You have your answers. It's your fault if you don't know how to treat them.

Go now. Your foolishness is tiresome.
So...
Are you lost, baby mouse?

name.en: How do you reject the Light?

text.en:
The twin nods at the pillar of Light.

Go to the Light and wait until you're given a choice. The Darkness awaits at the gate that must be closed forever.

name.en: How can Riddles bring me closer to the Darkness?

text.en:
The reflection shakes the head in sympathy.

We all are in the Darkness, even when we are surrounded by the Light. The Darkness is a part of us. Can you see what's inside you?

name.en: If there's Light around, where is the darkness that I must dispel?

text.en:
The twin smiles deviously.

You still think that Nihaz is using tricks. The Darkness is primal. Why would it hide? It's everywhere. Just turn off the Light, and you will see it. Reject the Light. It's easy.
Teleporting.

You're carrying a particle of the God of Light with you. Ask for his help!

I'm sure he will try to trick you, knowing his temper. But you know best what's in your head, right?
Nothing that you wouldn't know already. It's Darkness. Infinite Darkness.
The old man in dark clothes is smiling kindly at you. His face looks slightly familiar.
Why? Listen closely.
The old man is eyeing you, floating above the ground.

name.en: Ask about the surgery on your mind.

text.en:
Immersion into the subconscious is dangerous and often unnecessary. What is hidden down there, should not be set free. This... Well, there is no use trying to describe it. You will understand it soon.

You have an advantage. Your Spark is tempered, the blood of the Dragon flows in your veins, and the Irdrich story left a mark on your mind. Perhaps, the Planar Rim will be your entry point... The more familiar pictures, the better.

name.en: Visit Cosmos (the Call to Stormbringer quest)

text.en: Entering.
Entering.
Your face is seen all over the city...

So, you say, you saw a cat talking in colored letters and giving you riddles? And the color corresponded to the answering stones? Your subconscious doesn't have a high opinion about your intelligence, he-he. However, I don't like the fact that there's Cosmos on allods... What does it mean?

name.en: Tell about the Bridge of Times.

text.en: Follow will-o'-the-wisp over the deadly bridge in the middle of... wait, what? Where did you get this bridge at all? And what does it mean, you've seen it? What Planar Rim? Why did this Wanderer become the Eternity? Argh!

Wow, isn't your head messy! Remember, I told you back there on Sogot, it pains me to watch you while you sleep? That wasn't a lie. And there's a good old method of thinking things through. Step one: get drunk!
Hey!
A flying horse? It doesn't look good. Have you ever heard about sailplanes? Lightning Bolt? Mana-bike? No?.. How can you be so ignorant?

No idea how, but Nihaz gained direct control over you. Just like any mystic would do. Or me. The only difference is that Nihaz doesn't need to be near you. He can just show up in your dream, and that's it. You can chain yourself every time you go to bed, huh.

You must temper your mind. Got it? So nobody could get into your stone head! I know a trick or two, but he's a god, and you must seek help of a god. Cautiously! The fewer people know about the weak spot of yours, the better.
Greetings, my friend! What do you think about the local architecture?

The dark aesthetics of the old... Beautiful. Do you know that the Citadel is many years old? Say what you will about the Demonologists, they did a lot to keep this place running... But where are my manners? August de Grandeur, at your service. I’m here from Marianne de Ardeur as an arbiter. Demons want to live peacefully? I find that hard to believe. If they wish to prove their intentions, the Light will accept them. The Light accepts everyone regardless of their origins! But it can also bring their sins to the surface... And burn them out. Must be a hard choice for demons, hm?
So, is the bed comfortable? Heh.

Hello again! We are here to exchange our knowledge with the colleagues, so to speak! We remember you, yes. You helped us gather food for our Demon Couriers. At least someone understands that demons can be friendly.

Welcome back to the world of living... Even though it may sound ironical.

Let me introduce myself. I am Sarbaz Sais, a researcher of the Church.

So Nefer Ur sent you? Interesting. After all these years, he still... Hah.

Welcome to the Citadel, as the locals call it. It is inhabited by demons and Demonologists, the pioneers of the new magical discipline. Or at least that's how they see themselves. The Church sees them as dangerous renegades. I share this opinion, but I'm not here to judge anyone. My interest is purely academic...

Well, since you're well and in good health, that's one load off my mind. I can work on my research now.
...Kanian looks at you appraisingly. There is neither interest nor judgement in his stare.

Hello, if you mean it. My name is Velit Molotov. Yes, one of those from Siveria, damn them all.

They say you’re a great hero and all. Killed so many demons, architects, and what not - too many to count. Then what are you doing here? Protecting “peaceful” demons? Ha! PEACEFUL DEMONS!

Crazy...

...Tegorah silently hovers above the floor, absorbed in his thoughts. You feel the aura of power wrapped around the demon, but the power is... unusual. There is no chaos, no destructive energy hidden in it.

Just a strange unshakable confidence, like a crystal rock among the stormy astral. You are surprised to catch yourself bowing your head slightly in the Archdemon's presence. No wonder the demon is the leader of the local pack... If even the mortals sense the aura of his authority.

name.en: The aoidos sent me here to help.

text.en:
...Tegorah nods silently, and then you feel as though you are falling. For a moment, you think you are going to faint again, but the sensation fades as quickly as it appears. The Archdemon continues to look at you, but this time you begin to distinguish the echoes of emotions in his eyes. One is brighter than others: it's weariness. His weariness burns so bright that you can feel its heat.

Tegorah takes a step back, and the suffocating sensation goes away. The Archdemon bows his head as though apologizing. His voice echoes in your head.

"Forgive me for the inconvenience, Stormbringer. We will have to speak in this manner. These walls have eyes and ears."

The Archdemon bows his head, observing your reaction.

"Your nickname means nothing good. We cling to any good tidings, but the situation appears to be desperate. We have just been informed that the Destroyer broke into the upper platform. There will be slaughter. I will gladly answer any of your questions, but right now my attention is focused on the defense."

...The demon beckons you closer as though to whisper in your ear, but instead places a hand on your forehead. You instinctively tense, but the demon exudes no hostility. His hand does not feel warm or cold, or... alive. The next moment you realize that you no longer feel it, and what is more, you have completely lost the sense of your own body. As though neither of you exists separately - there is just one integral "I". Then the demon's consciousness unfolds before you like a book, and a flood of memories overwhelms you. You sense that the demon is hurriedly easing that flow lest you drown in this sea of information.

"The Demonologists crave power, Stormbringer. They wish to draw it from us. We had no choice other than to accept their "help". Without them, we'd have no shelter, and the advocates of Light would have wiped us out. The aoidos are our loyal allies, but they stand no chance against this world... They are like children."

...Tegorah sighs heavily. You see the entire Sogot before you. It takes you a while to realize that you are looking at the allod through the eyes of a flying demon.

"Everything has a price. We pay for their services with our powers and our lives. Both sides are fine with this arrangement. These lives are sacrificed for the good of all others. And yet... With the arrival of the Destroyers and servants of Light, many of us have been dying for nothing."

We don't know where the Destroyers came from. They are demons like us, yet they ignore our appeals. The only thing that drives them is their need to... destroy.
Looking great, sweetie.
Take your winged friends and go to the Citadel. Destroy their defense system and kill everyone you see. Have some fun.
Work in Full Swing

Tegorah wants to turn the Citadel into a ship - I’m all for that. I’ll even help, and that will help me on several fronts. Should look good on my resume... Elves will their Galleon can go to hell, I have a better plan!

So there’s the Master's Citadel on the Isle of Revelation... See what I mean? Even the name is the same! There’s a lot of stuff in there. Piles of batteries. But what’s more...
I don’t have time for this. Go up the stairs and look around - I’ll grant you access. Just don’t bring this damn allod down on our heads.
List of data:

name.en: Data about the Heart of the Citadel.

text.en: The device is ready.
You have already retrieved data from this device.
Look at that thing! It powers most of the Citadel systems. Demons never told me anything about it... Neither did the Demonologists. Must be a big secret.

Well, well. What do we have here? Ooh, this is bad. OF COURSE, it’s a living organism. So we can’t just build something similar, we need to carve living flesh? Oh well... The local Citadel is also powered by some large demon, after all.

Ciphers, you say? That’s good, that’s useful. I’ll think about it over dinner.

By the way, don’t drink the local coffee.
Good boys... And hungry, too. Want to have a bite? Go! Gnaw, tear, feast!
These fools think a few barriers can save them from their fate... Prove them wrong. You must get to the workshop and destroy one goblin’s work. Do not shy away from... bloody measures.
The deciphered text is scribbled on the wrinkled note, but it’s hard to make out the words.
Unacceptable... Another minute, and they would’ve made it to the Heart!
Your goblin is missing. There is no body. Considering the Destroyers’ strength and his size, he could’ve simply crumbled into dust. Maybe you can find something we’ve missed.
It’s chaos everywhere...
Are you speaking to me, mortal?

name.en: Ask about August de Grandeur's spark.

text.en: Mortals killed by Destroyers cannot resurrect. August’s spark is fading away. I shall allow it to say its last words to you, but I am powerless to do more.

name.en: Summon the spark of August de Grandeur.

text.en: Well, I shall allow his Spark to manifest for a time... But make haste.
No... No... Keep away! I can see right through you! I KNOW what you are! Great Light, we were so wrong... Stay away! Stay away from me!!
...The elf is trying to say something, but you don’t hear anything. His spirit slowly fades away, dissolving into the eerie darkness of Purgatory.
Eww. Gestures like that don’t impress anyone. There was an elf on Avilon who jumped from Darkblood Citadel because of unrequited love. Now that’s dramatic!
Mmm... Someone influential ordered your release, so off you go. And grab your undead thing.
More creatures are coming! We won’t last much longer!
We meet again. How can I help you?
Let’s see what we have here...

name.en: Tell Skulnar about the signal rocket and demons.

text.en: So you fired a signal rocket to make all demons come after you. Whose idea was it?
How are you? Alright?
There is a residue of the Destroyers’ deadly power in your body which I can’t do anything about... It’s a miracle you’re still alive. But who knows what it can do to you if we don’t fix this?
How are you feeling?
That’s what I’m talking about! Now get out of here, we don’t need wounded soldiers on the frontline. Go help that... genius of technology.
Help me with this cannon. Go on, I’ll tell you what to do.
Keep calm!
We are the order of the Demonologists, and this land belongs to the Citadel! The Hunters have trespassed on our territory and attacked us!
So we’re provoking them? They are ready to tear our allies apart. They are the ones riling us up, because they’ll have a reason to slaughter everyone.
Cursed demon lovers!

name.en: Ask not to attack the Demonologists.

text.en: They are pandering to those astral creatures! We’ve fought them for years and we’ll keep doing it! And you should decide what side you’re on!

name.en: These demons want to live peacefully. They won't hurt you.

text.en: Of course they won’t - we have demons like that for breakfast! How can you protect demons whey have just tried to kill everyone? Demons are evil, and they must be eradicated!
Good fellow. I always knew I could count on you.
Hello again, my faithful servant!

name.en: You have no power over me!

text.en:
Oh? I’ll have to disagree! You think my assistant just scratched you?

Well, no. Your body is just cosmic dust. Simple matter. Power over matter is my prerogative, you see.

So listen. There will be a battle in your Citadel. I won’t lie to you, that’s exactly what I’ve been waiting for... but those believers are way too zealous, even for me! I’ve always said there’s nothing more dangerous than fanatics.

Their eyes are glowing with the flames of a right cause! They ooze righteousness! Self-proclaimed judges with delusions of grandeur! Such people are so easy to manipulate.

You’ll kill them all, one by one. They outlived their usefulness. Just imagine the conversations it would provoke: the Demonologists subjugated Destroyers and flooded the fields of Sogot with blood! I can even restore life here after such an occasion. Blood-red trees, shrubs with bloody berries... Snow white rabbits with scarlet eyes hopping on crimson grass...

Idyll!

name.en: No... I’m not going to kill anyone. You can’t make me!

text.en:
That’s where you’re wrong, darling. I can and I will. I’m a god, after all. And you’re just a little bug. Your body is nothing but cosmic dust. Simple matter. Power over matter is my prerogative, you see.

Alright, look into my eyes. Try and deny me. Well?

name.en: Yes, Master. I’ll do as you say...

text.en:
That's it? No resistance? Excellent!

So listen. There will be a battle in your Citadel. I won't lie to you, that's exactly what I've been waiting for... but those believers are way too zealous, even for me! I've always said there's nothing more dangerous than fanatics.

Their eyes are glowing with the flames of a right cause! They ooze righteousness! Self-proclaimed judges with delusions of grandeur! Such people are so easy to manipulate.

You'll kill them all, one by one. They outlived their usefulness. Just imagine the conversations it would provoke: the Demonologists subjugated Destroyers and flooded the fields of Sogot with blood! I can even restore life here after such an occasion. Blood-red trees, shrubs with bloody berries... Snow white rabbits with scarlet eyes hopping on crimson grass...

Pure harmony!

name.en: No... A different fate awaits you.

text.en: What will happen to me?
What will happen to me?
You want to give me another chance? Ha. You have demiurge’s ambitions... I’m guided by my common sense and faith. I do what I need to do. What is RIGHT to do. What do you expect to achieve?
I’m glad to see your mind is still working. Fair justice is what makes us different from those ungodly creatures.

name.en: Death. With no possibility of resurrection.

text.en: Well... I guess there’s no other choice. I’m glad I met you... Stormbringer. I wish I could believe that this world is not doomed in the hands of people like you... but I don’t.

name.en: Tell Amos about the events at the Citadel.

text.en: Well... It could have been worse. I admit, I’m rather surprised. The Church is considered a bastion of pure intentions and earnest faith. How could there be fanatics like that? If it wasn’t for you, they would have easily wiped out all demons in this world. I thank you on behalf of all Aoidoi and demons, my friend.

name.en: Tell Nefer Ur about Sarbaz Sais.

text.en:
Yes, I’ve heard about her... project. Being so wrong about your brethren is hard to take.

Sometimes scientists and true believers are willing to cross the line in the name of their convictions. We’re lucky you stopped her in time.

As for your decision - I can’t say I approve of frontier justice. I’d rather do everything quietly. In any case, thank you. You did more than I could ever hope for.

name.en: You are wasting my time. Why am I here again?

text.en:
Well, I just wanted to have a chat with the star of a small play. If I was writing one, I’d name it “Darkness over Sogot”. Ah, Sogot... Funny that demons decided to settle here of all places. Fate has an interesting sense of humor.

Do you know what happened here? Though how can you...

Dear old Sarn experimented on demons. As you can see, there are so many varieties. Like the Demonologists, he studied them and conducted experiments to breed out flaws. First, their free will. Then the desire to have a name. Then their memory. He repeated this process generation after generation. That was his testing ground, so to speak. You can imagine the atrocities that took place here, seeing how the area looks today, he he.

Not all demons liked that. Some rebelled and were slaughtered by their more impressionable brethren. Those who were smarter went into hiding. There was this one demon, Cairage. He blinded himself so Sarn couldn’t see through his eyes and find out where he was. Cairage just wanted some peace and quiet.

name.en: Why are you telling me this?

text.en:
What do you mean? You’re like Cairage. Blind and dumb. Though Cairage at least had the sense to stay out of sight... Until later. Believe it or not, he’s sitting right there, under our feet. Underneath Sogot. Quiet as a mouse, hearing every word spoken at the Citadel. Every step, every sound of a dead body hitting the ground.

Your hearing improves if you spend thousands of years blind, you know.

I think I’ll have to drag him out to the surface. Such power cannot be left unchecked.

name.en: You're tiring me. I want to wake up.

text.en:
I know of a good way to do it! They say if you fall in your sleep, you wake up right away. Try it. You only live once. The edge of the platform is right there.

See you next night, hehe...
Good luck! Hehe.
Amazing place, isn’t it?

name.en: Tell Ollum about the demons' fate.

text.en: The demon starts to calm down. He believes his tribe is not in any immediate danger.

What can I say? We’re in trouble... There isn’t enough food. Whatever is growing here, I’m not putting that in my mouth. We need to get to the Citadel, but hell knows how many demons are between us, and the Aoidoi are probably useless in a fight...

name.en: Tell them to keep order in camp.

text.en: Aye aye, captain!

name.en: Order to prepare food using whatever ingredients they can find.

text.en: I’ll look around. Perhaps some of our supplies survived the crash.
There are bones and weird flowers all over the place. What should we cook with?

name.en: Tell them not to panic and determine the scope of damage sustained.

text.en: There are holes in the bottom, Captain... But we’ll see what can be done.
Our first ship... First flight... and this... Maybe fate doesn’t want us wandering the expanse of chaos?

name.en: Order to gather the strongest crew members and equip them for patrol and defense.

text.en: I’ll get it done. Who knows when those demons come back... I’ll gather everyone who can fight.
What do we do?

name.en: Render first aid to the wounded.

text.en: Yes, Captain!
Oh, so many wounded...
Greetings.
I am concerned about the future of demons, because we are the ones responsible for our alliance with them.
I couldn’t stand idly by, because it was my blood we fed the demons when we formed the alliance...

The Church calls them a sect, which is understandable... Demonology is a field of magic that studies and utilizes demonic power. It leaves a certain mark on the practitioners of this discipline... which negatively affects their mind. The reason the Church attacks the Demonologists is simple, though - it’s heresy.

Yasker and Aidenus disregarded the issue and decided that a nonaggression treaty was enough. Renegade Demonologists are not rare. But it’s the first time in history that they have decided to establish some sort of organization. And no one would have thought much of it, if they hadn’t made a deal with demons... That’s where it gets strange.

The Demonologists and demons settled in this ancient citadel on Sogot. Astral travelers give this allod a wide berth - the astral around it is too volatile, and there is nothing on the allod but ruins and wastelands. In the past, it was torn apart by demonic fangs during a demonic invasion.

The citadel that still stands there belonged to a branch of the Demon Hunter order which called itself the Red Legion. Pompous, maybe, but there’s no accounting for taste. The entire Legion died there during that invasion. The Citadel is more of a memorial now.

Demons do not care for the history of this place. It sounds like the friends of Aoidoi saw a vacant world with an empty palace and decided to settle there.

When the Church found out - both the Trinity and the Holy one - its leaders went crazy. After enlisting the support of the Demon Hunters, they launched a crusade - for the sake of preserving the legacy of brave warriors and eradicating the creatures of darkness.

An unpleasant conflict is brewing. There is nothing to gain or lose from a victory or defeat, and we’d like to maintain good relations with the Aoidoi. I’m also concerned about the future of the demons: they can assist us in establishing global peace in Sarnaut. We shouldn’t underestimate beautiful symbols...

A friend of mine, Sarbaz Sais, is a researcher in this crusade. She is smart enough not to buy into the global hysteria. I suggest you go to Sogot and work with her on a solution for this issue.
...Ollum soundlessly hovers in the air. You sense that the demon is alarmed.
The Pegasus is ready to take you anywhere you want.
This is the Callisto!
What’s up, cap’n?
Next we’re firing a signal rocket! We go up that hill and bang!
There was a mistake... There was a mistake...

name.en: Ask Harpoon why he killed Shorr.

text.en: There was a mistake! To continue! Click on enter and return to the window!
Well, how are your negotiations with the aviaks going?
Have you spilt it? No problem, I've got some more here, at the bottom of it.

name.en: Here's the mushroom pulp for the tincture

text.en: Oh, that's just what I needed! Give it here, let's get started.
OK, let's do this... Here you go! Now give this wine to our feathered friends.
Where is it, I wonder... ha! Wine is a strange thing - one moment it's here, and the next it's all gone. I know what we need - mushrooms! Go get some more, and I'll cook 'em up.
What do we need?
You are going to ruin us!
Hi! Aren't you hot in your full armor?

First, don't forget that the majority of those you see are still asleep. Don't bother telling them about Tep or lictors or the illusory world... they won't understand you. Their consciousness will simply reject all unnecessary information.
Second, because you did manage to wake up, this created a gaping hole in the fabric of the illusion. What brought it about? A paradox, someone playing outside the rules. Do you remember how you tried to ruin the Spectacle in Gipat? The same is happening here: developments follow one another in a familiar rut, and to break free of the fetters you must go against the flow.
You must return to the aviaks and play their war games according to their rules until you see an opportunity to derail the narrative and send it careening down a different track. You will see success right away, as every new breach will create new holes, each of which could be used to return to the real world. But don't tarry, either: however well you may hide, sooner or later Tep will want to know who's shooting his toy full of holes.
Well, have you found golem pieces?

name.en: Give the cogwheels of the June golem

text.en: How lovely, how antiquated! Now wait for a moment, my... erm... colleague and I need to study it.
Why or why must I wade in the mud over this mossy old rock?

This is a very ancient statue, much older than even the Benefactor's. The Immortals don't like this kind of talk, and it's not exactly topical, so the legend of the crocodile is only remembered by strange old men like my grandpa, may the grass be soft under his feet. The legend goes something like this. A long, long time ago, when the Ancients disappeared and the world sunk into darkness, the Tekyans lived in turmoil and poverty. One particularly bad year the Jumayo River dried up, and the Tekyans' laundry list of problems now included thirst. Now, that would have been the end of us, but then a benevolent crocodile god appeared. He struck the ground with his mighty tail, creating a spring bursting with pure and fresh water. The Tekyans praised the crocodile as their saviour and built this statue in his honor. And that's pretty much it...
It's been almost a century since my name day, but I have never met creatures like yourself.

What a delicate taste and flavor! I...What's going on? I start... recalling!
O, the Ancients! O, glorious Genlun! Forgive us, your imprudent children! What a shame...

name.en: Ask the sage about the Tekyan people

text.en:
Take a look around. What you see before you is Tequatl - the only settlement of our ancient nation. Its beauty rivals that of mandarin flowers in spring, though it cannot compare with the beauty of a city on the ruins of which it was built and whose name it bears.
Tequatl was the city of the Ancients. They were all-knowing, all-powerful and wielded great magic. The Ancients knew how to make rock come alive. They were masters of the heavens and the earth. Our small nation was like a younger sibling to them, and we lived our lives without worry. Only vague legends remain of those wonderful times.
The Ancients had a sworn enemy. A monster from the Void which cannot be described: even the words are scared of him and fall to silence. Who he was and where he came from is beyond our grasp. The Enemy was so powerful that all of the Ancients' wisdom and magic wasn't enough to protect them. Before they perished, in their dying moments the Ancients made sure to save us, their children and heirs. We have built our own Tequatl on the ruins of the great Tequatl of the Ancients. Thus began a new era for my people - an era of darkness and solitude. We dug roots and hunted mice, learned to build fires and sew simple rough garments for wear. Long were those days, and filled with sorrow. So thunderous was the Tekyans' cry of despair that the world split into two!
But everything changed when They came. The true gods appeared to our people. They have built their palace on the mountain and settled there. They taught our people to build houses, sew beautiful clothing from soft fabrics, and cook delicious food. And all they asked in return was our devotion. The gods are powerful, righteous and kind. And if you prove your faith, you too may experience their favor!
Oh... You're telling me the Tekyans are worshipping those ugly mugs? For shame! If only I were still alive...

name.en: Ask for the blessing to fight the Immortals

text.en: I gladly give you my blessing! My blessing to banish those wicked beings, and to beat some sense into and return my people to tradition! And tell them something else from me personally: I forgive them for their past misdeeds, but if they're going to continue to neglect their ancestors' graves, I vow to haunt them every night. With sighs. Loud and with rebuke.

Hey, friend! Congratulations, we've won! The illusory world has been destroyed, Tep is dead, all the captives are free and sucking on lollipops in celebration of their release. Everyone is happy, dancing and laughing. Ha ha ha!
But really, you're about to meet your end. And the Resistance will follow suit in an hour. I betrayed you all, muahahaha! I may be a simple sailor, but I know which side the bread is buttered on! Say we are going to defeat Tep... then what? Back to Kania to mop ship decks? But here I can be anyone - a hero, a ladies' man, even a dragon! Instead of dry salted beef I can feast on barbequed Tekyans or spicy aviak wings. I can become an Immortal! Pity, this fate is not for you. Indeed, your fate is death!
He he he. I told you: it's good to control the illusion!
Tekyans are pleased with the victory and thank the player.

name.en: Ask about the mountain in the north

text.en: That island name Marai-Nui, you call it Crystal Mountain. It is taboo. You better not go there, not look, not even think. Ulumi Half-Wing broke the taboo once, flew there, and look at him now!
I'm a simple tanner. What do my wingless guest, a great warrior, need?

name.en: Ask about the mountain in the north

text.en: Better not ask. It's a bad place, a scary place. Nobody returned from there. Only Ulumi Half-Wing went there once and lost his mind. You better forget the Crystal Mountain forever.
I see, you have questions? Ask, don't be shy!

name.en: Ask about the mountain in the north

text.en: I know nothing about Crystal Mountain, Marai-Nui! A terrible place! Forbidden! One who asks questions is more inane than me, worse than a ropemaker! Stupid, stupid like Ulumi Half-Wing!
Yes, wingless? Do you want to know how to make rope?

name.en: Ask about the mountain in the north

text.en: You ask about Marai-Nui, Crystal Mountain? Why do you want to know? It's a scary place, very bad. Only Ulumi Half-Wing went there once and lost his mind!

name.en: Ask about the mountain in the north.

text.en: I did not know! I have never even come close to abyss - old men say it is full of strange monsters! Nobody returned from there, only Ulumi Half-Wing. But he did not say anything, only frowned and coughed loud.

name.en: Ask about the mountain in the north.

text.en: Marai-Nui, Crystal Mountain... You better never go there, never ask, not even look. Ulumi Half-Wing went there once, look at him now!
Kharr! And who are you? I do not know you! Go, go away!
What? Crystal...Kharr... Kharr!!
Greetings! Be on your guard in the Holy Land, for danger is everywhere.

name.en: I'm here on behalf of Svetlana Demina

text.en:
Ah, it looks like the capital has received my report! Well, they sent you... Let me look at you.

Pretty green, but there's visible enthusiasm already. In our business it's a must.

I guess Svetlana didn't say much when she sent you here, right?

Well, let's start with the basics. You are probably familiar with the canons of the Trinity Church. How Nezeb and Skrakan sacrificed their lives to close the demonic portal to another world, so the demonic threat was eliminated. Doubting this dogma is tantamount to heresy and treason, but you and I are outcasts anyway, right?

Listen to me very carefully: it seems that the demons weren't completely defeated! How so? I'm not sure, but there's an alarming level of activity on Asee-Teph. They are clearly planning something...

And no one can stop them but us.

You need to be ready. While you're getting settled here, complete the tasks of your commanders and wait. When you are certain you are well prepared, find me and let me know.
Alright, it looks like it really is time...
Good afternoon! Be on your guard in the Holy Land, for danger is everywhere.

name.en: I'm here on behalf of Vranomir Temnov

text.en:
Ah, it looks like the capital has received my report! Well, they sent you... Let me look at you.

Pretty green, but there's visible enthusiasm already. In our business it's a must.

I guess Vranomir didn't say much when he sent you here, right?

Well, let's start with the basics. You are probably familiar with the canons of the Church of Light. How Nezeb and Skrakan sacrificed their lives to close the demonic portal to another world, so the demonic threat was eliminated. Doubting this dogma is tantamount to heresy and treason, but you and I are outcasts anyway, right?

Listen to me very carefully: it seems that the demons weren't completely defeated! How so? I'm not sure, but there's an alarming level of activity on Asee-Teph. They are clearly planning something...

And no one can stop them but us.

You need to be ready. While you're getting settled here, complete the tasks of your commanders and wait. When you are certain you are well prepared, find me and let me know.
Alright, it looks like it really is time...

Are you ready to escort the elemental? If you want help from your comrades, have each of them talk to me first. Be sure that everyone understands the combat orders. Only then should you report that you are ready.
I summon the elemental!
What an interesting order.
Interesting... And how does he expect me to execute this order if all my men are captured?
Oh... An order... I would have preferred a pot of porridge though.
We must win this war!
Thank Tensess! What news do you have? Are we going to begin a general offensive soon?
Hey, do you have anything edible? We're starving out here...
Aho, frriend!

The Doolga say we must shut ourselves in this Holy Land. The source of the power of the Illuminated is here, the thread that led to Howlem.

The eyes of all Sarnaut are fixed on this place. But this land is foreign to us. The spirits of these lands see us as strangers, and hunhurrs are not afraid of us, eysh.

The Doolga know what to do.

We must prove ourselves. To show the spirits of this earth who we are and what we stand for.

So we're going on the Great Hunt. We will strike down the most majestic animals of this land, we will prove that the Pridens are hunters, not prey.

Will you take part in this Hunt?
Aho, frriend!

The eyes of all Sarnaut are fixed on this place. But this land is foreign to us. The spirits of these lands see us as strangers, and hunhurrs are not afraid of us, eysh.

The Doolga know what to do.

We must prove ourselves. To show the spirits of this earth who we are and what we stand for.

So we're going on the Great Hunt. We will strike down the most majestic animals of this land, we will prove that the Pridens are hunters, not prey.

Will you take part in this Hunt?

name.en: Can I have a brochure please?

text.en: Here you go, make sure to read the entire thing!
Hello adventurer. Do you need something?

name.en: Show the papers to Stonesky the Crafty at the Eljune Bazaar.

text.en: Yeah, these look legit. Now the camp is open for you. But let me warn you, this area is for honest and respectable folk only. Try any of that counterfeit stuff here and your ass will be sorry. Okay, move along!

name.en: Offer to escort them to camp

text.en: Perfect! Let's go.
Well? What is it? Are you here to help the pilgrims?
Arrrrgh!!
Excellent! We finally made it to the Holy Land!

name.en: Offer to escort them to camp

text.en: That's good news, we're eager to get going!
Alright, it looks like it really is time...
Alright, it looks like it really is time...

Agrh... Woof, woof! Agrh...

Stand back or I'll bite you!

name.en: I was sent from Asee-Teph, are you an agent of the Demonologists?

text.en:
Yes! You took your time! They... have they stopped catching cats?

Agrh... Woof, woof! Agrh...

Fine. Listen. I've never believed the tales of the churchmen saying the demons were defeated once and for all. You'd have to lose your sense of smell and stay out of the Astral. There are demons roaming around!

But now you can rub their noses in the obvious! The Edge of Eternal Night - have you ever heard of it? It used to be a Place of Power, and now... it's some cesspit, I can smell it from here. Cultists and demons - that's who live there now, and they are advancing on other lands.

I suppose it will soon reach the upper circles of the League and the Empire. You and I can't kill all the demons in the world, but we have our own goal. Demon blood is a powerful remedy, and we need a supply of it. With luck, you can rip out a dead demon's heart - I know you did that on Asee-Teph. The heart is a source of blood, so it should last us a while.

I ask you to get these hearts. Of course, you shouldn't stick your nose in there if you're not ready. Gain some experience first. When the time comes, let me know.

Agrh... Woof, woof! Agrh...

Alright, it looks like it really is time...

Aho!

What are you looking for in this frozen land?

name.en: Tell me what you found here

text.en:
Hah, this land is not so simple. It is an ancient land that once belonged to the June people. Their traces are everywhere, and the spirits of this place remember them. The Junes were the greatest hunters in the world who hunted down dragons. It won't be easy to match that, eysh.

Be careful, local enemies are much stronger. You shouldn't go hunting unless you're well prepared.

But the ritual needs to be carried out - we have to prove ourselves to earn the right to be here.
Alright, it looks like it really is time...
What's wrong? I don't know anything!
Hey, hey! It's good to see a friend in a place like this.

name.en: What did you want to tell me?

text.en:
The Coba Plateau is the heart of all evil, I swear by the First, eysh.

But to be honest, I don't understand what's going on here. My gift speaks to me about three forms of evil. The ancient evil is Tep and his servants. They fought here and left their traces which are not erased even ten thousand years later.

The new evil that has emerged recently is the demons and their cultists. Places of Power are defiled. They only birth darkness now.

And finally, the future evil - the darkness that's going to consume the whole world... Where it comes from, I don’t know. But the danger is close, very close. I can feel it.

We need to complete the final ritual. Then perhaps the spirits of the Coba Plateau will give us answers.

Temper your will and prepare, then come find me.
Alright, it looks like it really is time...
What happened?
Here, take it.
Where are the others? Lost? Hehe, whoever finds it is in for a surprise!
The southern tomb can wave the curse
These magpies are trained to pick up loot and bring it to you. Very useful for a busy adventurer! You can buy one in the Boutique.

What? Are you going to interrogate me? Do you want me to reveal the secrets of our command?
Well, listen to me! Yasker has no secrets! He is a Great Mage, a disciple of Nezeb himself, hallowed be his name! Yasker is perfect! Do you understand? I doubt that. Your Tensess can't even be compared with our leader.
This is over. I won't tell you anything!

Argh! Bastard! What do you want from me?
What? A weak spot of Yasker? Are you insane? Why should I care? Do you think I follow his every step?
Why, he is the leader. But I don't think it will last long. Soon everyone will realize that he is not the one we need. We will find ourselves a new leader - an Orc, of course!

Stop! Calm down! Stop the violence!
What do you want to know? A Yasker's weak spot?
Hmm... Perhaps I'm the only one who can tell you something about that.
For a very long time I've been trying to understand why Yasker hates us, the Zem people. He keeps this secret safe, but I found the answer on an occasion. During my final exams one young necromancer demonstrated his abilities, and I saw how the Great Mage was trying to avoid the summoned creatures! You see?
He hates undead, their rotten flesh, their smell... And his disgust spreads on us, too!
What a fool! Why can't he see the difference? He's got to change his attitude, or soon he will be dethroned.

This thing...? This is just a piece of wood. You can throw it into the fire for all I care.
What really matters is kindness. I recently had a revelation and realized that the Empire has forgotten about mercy and goodness. The Kanians should be our brothers, but our soldiers kill them and the scientists use the defenseless prisoners in their experiments.
I had to put an end to this. And not simply with words, but with steel and fire!

Ah, so is that why you came? Yes, I replaced Nezeb's Staff with a fake, and those stupid scientists couldn't even tell the difference!
You ask who put me up to this? Only the Light! The true guidance that only faith in Tensess can bring!
The Light showed me the darkness of the state, and all of the bribery and corruption in it! Yet the officials turn a blind eye to it all, and do anything necessary to get ahead. Sooner or later this darkness WILL be dispelled, and then the evil defilers of the Empire will be cast down.
Soon, we will flee this corrupted land. The League will not leave us in our time of need, and their ships should be landing on the shores of the Empire any minute. We will return to Kania and gather our strength until the Empire can be defeated!

You ask who put me up to this? Only the Light! The true guidance that only faith in Tensess can bring!

What is it that you need?
So, shall we go?
Go!

Here you go.
And remember, when we find my father, you and I fight the same battle.
You won't take me down without a fight!
Alright, I have called to them. If you want to ask them something, now is your chance.
What do I do now, spend the rest of my days as a ghost?
I can't believe even those Servants of the Light can't figure this out! Holy smokes, what do I do now?

name.en: Ask about building and repairing a ship

text.en: What are you interested in?

name.en: Give away the License and 1500 gold to receive an Astral Ship

text.en: Excellent! Perfect! I'll prepare your ship in 5 minutes.

name.en: Give away the License and 1500 gold to receive an Astral Ship

text.en: You don't have enough money.
What do you want to know?

name.en: We finally finished the job! You are now the proud owner of an Astral ship.

text.en: Congratulations! Your ship is ready to fly.

name.en: Ask about your ship's construction progress

text.en: I am happy to give you a progress report. If you'd like to speed things along, ask me about the work being done on your ship.

name.en: Pay 1500 gold to start the construction of your ship.

text.en: Perfect! I'll make arrangements to start the construction right away. It's quite a long process, but I can tell you how to speed it up.

name.en: Pay 1500 gold to start the construction of your ship.

text.en: You don't have enough money.

Demonology is a school of magic just like any elemental one. Or witchcraft, mysticism, necromancy...

The Church, of course, tried to impose penance: how dare we practice our foul arts! And rub elbows with demons to boot? They fuss over their Light like it’s the only thing that matters... Well, it’s their right as the high and mighty. But we’ll get even.

The Church wants you to eliminate demons? Wonderful. You’ll use their own weapons against them. Remember: demons are not our allies. They are no better than lab rats. Demons are a tool that will take us to a world of new magical opportunities, nothing more.
May Tensess, Nezeb and Skrakan protect you!

name.en: Ask for a Frozen Tear of the Dragon

text.en: Here. Use it wisely.

This is so sweet! It is always pleasant to know that your work is appreciated.

Say hello to everyone from me!

Oh, hi there! What are you saying?..

Oh, that's so nice of you! Thank you very much. It's good to know that you are remembered.

Me? I'm doing fine.

When it gets boring, I give the resurrected ones thumps in the head so that they think twice next time! You can't spread the Light without using your fists, you know.

But thank you. I mean it.
Here you are! You can always ask for more, if you need.

My name is Sarbaz Losash. I started studying alchemy a very long time ago, all the way back in my past life. I can tell you anything you need to know on the subject.

After using the alchemic mortar, place the following ingredients inside: herbs with the required properties and auxiliary substances that you can buy from me.
The properties of the ingredients used must form a harmonious combination. If you can ensure that, you'll get a potion whose effect depends directly on how well-matched the properties are. Yet the brewing process can result in a failure. You need to be ready for that and not lose hope.
By increasing your skill level, you'll gain access to new, more sophisticated and powerful formulas. Try making exactly these potions: the more sophisticated the formula, the greater the increase in your skill. However, making potions of levels surpassed long ago won't help your development. Your skill level depends on your character level as well: you can't become a high-class master if you stop developing.

name.en: Ask about tips for experienced alchemists

text.en:
An occasional failure is inevitable, everybody knows that. Make sure to use the correct ingredients, the properties of which will result in something useful. It’s doubtlessly more rewarding to brew something good than just a portion of goo. Besides, even if you can’t use it yourself, you can always sell it at an auction!
Remember to use only high quality equipment. Upgrade it whenever possible. This will enable you to brew over one potion at one attempt. Pick up right herbs, and with a little luck, you might brew two different potions at once!
Use a herb as described in a recipe. If you ever see an unknown property, don’t let it scare you off - it will surely work for the future!

Don't step on the lawn! Don't step on the lawn!

Citizens of the Empire, come closer and look at this wonderful Gibberling! Even three of them!

I've never seen her, but I've heard the discussions!
What do you need? How can I help you this time?

Well, I've changed the topic.

Franky, I'm not interested in it.
Let your way be lighten with Light of Nezeb, Skrakan and... Tensess!

A real loke of fate!

After using the alchemic mortar, place the following ingredients inside: herbs with the required properties and auxiliary substances that you can buy from me.

By increasing your skill level, you'll gain access to new, more sophisticated and powerful formulas. Your skill level depends on your character level as well: you can't become a high-class master if you stop developing.

An occasional failure is inevitable, everybody knows that. Make sure to use the correct ingredients, the properties of which will result in something useful. name.en: Learn how to become a leatherworker

text.en: Read the manual. You will need a set of tools for your work. You can buy them all from me.
Nice to meet you. My name is Valentina de Ardeur and I teach all the up and coming tailors in the League. I can teach you everything you need to know, from taking measurements to sewing on buttons!

Describe tailoring? How can anyone describe a sunrise? How can anyone describe a dancing girl? They must be seen.
However, I will say something. My main clients are mages and necromancers, who need freedom, not defense, to fight. And believe me, they are all sharp dressers and don't want to wear rags! Only us tailors can solve this very important issue!
I am not afraid of competition, like some of my colleagues. And I freely sell a manual and instruments. If you will resolve to study this craft, you will need to buy them from me.
However, if you don't like tailoring, then talk to other schoolmasters. For example, Raw family, who are experts in tanning hides. You can find them in the Gibberling District.

No one but us tailors can craft clothes from fabric or make cloaks. Besides, we possess the knowledge how to make pectorals and necklaces.
Now, about the process itself. Use a sewing kit to learn the list of blueprints available and prepare the right components. The threads required for your work can be bought from me. You'll get the other components by fighting enemies. Embroidery, lace, buttons and beads can be used as they are, while fabric rolls have to be cut with scissors first.
The process is simple: you make five parts, check their quality, keep the good ones and retailor the others. You can only retailor each part twice, and you work on at least two parts at a time.
If all parts are of equal quality, you'll get an item of that same quality. If the quality is uncommon, you'll even get two items. If not, you'll get the item anyway, but it won't be as good as it could be.
You'll gain experience for each item you make. When you've gained enough experience, your skill level will increase and new blueprints will be available to you.
The maximum available level of tailoring equals your character level.
Keep in mind that, as your skill level increases, you only gain access to the simplest blueprints that allow making items for personal use. But there are other, more sophisticated and expensive blueprints that you'll have to buy or obtain by yourself. They will allow you to craft items for sale to other heroes, higher-level items or even relics.
And most importantly: we can create Glyphs! Fight enemies at the Wild Shore and in the Astral to get required reagents. In order to create Glyphs of the highest quality, you will have to convert your Inspiration points into Illumination points. When the Illumination progress of a Glyph recipe reaches its maximum, you will be able to improve the quality of the produced Glyph.
By the way, if you ever need lower-level components, you can use retroform that you can buy from me as well. Don't worry, a single vial will last for a while.

The result largely depends on how lucky you are. If you are lucky, you'll make an item of rare or even epic quality. Some tricks of our craft will let you considerably increase your chances.
First of all, work on improving your tools. This will allow you to get rid of faulty parts, reforge one part at a time, increase the maximum number of reforges to three, and even stimulate your inspiration. With your tools improved, half of the parts you make will be uncommon, a third will be rare, and only one-sixth of them will be epic. Upgrades can be bought from me.
If you got away with a smaller number of retailoring attempts, the leftover material will be enough to make an extra item of the same quality.
You can try and make epic items or craft 2 to 3 uncommon items at a time, or you can choose the golden mean and get a pretty good chance to make rare items. Every craftsman decides for himself as to which strategy to choose.

name.en: Learn how to become a tailor

text.en: Read the manual. You will need a set of tools for your work. You can buy them all from me.

Weaponsmiths are always in demand: we make swords and spiked clubs, bows and crossbows, and even magic wands. But before you get down to crafting weapons, you'll have to practice making kitchen knives and simple hammers.
Now, about the process itself. Use weaponsmith's tools, learn the list of blueprints available and prepare the correct components. You can buy coal for your work from me. Use a pick to extract ore that should then be cast in the molds you need. Parts will be harder to obtain. Rods, tips, bases, blades, braidings, additives, flux, granulations, enamels... All of that can be obtained by fighting enemies or bought from other heroes.
The forging process is simple: you create five parts, check their quality, keep the good ones and reforge the rest. You can only reforge each part twice, and you work on at least two parts at a time.
If all parts are of equal quality, you'll get an item of that same quality. If the quality is uncommon, you'll even get two items. If not, you'll get the item anyway, but it won't be as good as it could be.
You'll gain experience for each item you make. When you've gained enough experience, your skill level will increase and new blueprints will be available to you. The maximum available level of weaponsmithing equals your character level.
Keep in mind that, as your skill level increases, you only gain access to the simplest blueprints that allow making items for personal use. But there are other, more sophisticated and expensive blueprints that you'll have to buy or obtain by yourself. They will allow you to craft items for sale to other heroes, higher-level items or even relics.
By the way, if you ever need lower-level components, you can use retroform that you can buy from me as well. Don't worry, a single vial will last for a while. Keep in mind, though, that retroform affects neither ore nor the goods made from it.

First of all, work on improving your tools. This will allow you to get rid of faulty parts, reforge one part at a time, increase the maximum number of reforges to three, and even stimulate your inspiration. With your tools improved, half of the parts you make will be uncommon, a third will be rare, and only one-sixth of them will be epic. Upgrades can be bought from me.
If you got away with a smaller number of reforges, the leftover material will be enough to make an extra item of the same quality.
You can try making epic items or craft 2 to 3 uncommon items at a time, or you can choose the golden mean and get a pretty good chance to make rare items. Every blacksmith decides for himself as to which strategy to choose.

I'm Zoritsa Kovaleva, I teach weaponsmithing. You won't find sharper blades and more powerful wands than those I make at any fair!
Trade

Good day! I'm Rada Lemesheva, the master disassembler.

Times are tough and we can't just go out and buy fabric whenever we feel like it! There's a war raging - we need to be thrifty! That's why we disassemble items so that others can turn them into new items.

After you obtain a valuable item, you can use scissors or pliers to disassemble the item into its individual components. The quality of the item that you disassemble will determine the quality of the materials that you receive. The components are generally used by tailors and leatherworkers to make new gear.
Every time you successfully disassemble an item, your skill level will increase. At higher skill levels you have a higher chance to receive more valuable items. Finally, you should know that if your overall level isn't high enough, you won't be able to increase your disassembling skill past a certain point.

name.en: Learn how to become an alchemist

text.en: You'll have to read the manual, and you'll need tools for your work. You can buy it all from me.

Let's see I need some more belladonna and anise... and some better quality aloe...
Oh, sorry! I didn't notice you there. My name is Mathilde de Grandeur, herbalism trainer, at your service!

Collecting herbs is the most exciting and profitable work! Exciting because you always need to be attentive and stick your nose everywhere, to find rare herbs and roots. Profitable because alchemists are prepared to die for the ingredients that you bring them and will pay any price! This is what herb collection is all about!
Are you still thinking of something else? Don't! Simply buy a manual and equipment from me and you will have a foundation for wealth and popularity!

All of these people wandering around aimlessly are interrupting our thoughts... They think that mining is a piece of cake, but it's an art you know! And we are the masters of it!

Are you still here? Hm... Well, let's talk.

Are you interested in mining? Well... do you have strength to investigate fields, mountains and caves in the search of ore? Are you ready to fight with wild beasts and cruel bandits that stand between you and your rocks? Are you ready to haggle with blacksmiths, tailors and leatherworkers over prices to get as much money as possible... Hm, then maybe we'll tell you our secrets...
Ah, I can see the enthusiasm in your eyes! Well, if you're interested in what we just said then we can sell you a training manual and some tools.
Trade
Here you are! You can always ask for more, if you need.
Here you are! You can always ask for more, if you need.
Here, take it! They are in rich supply. Feel free to ask me if you need more!
May Tensess bless you!
Please, please spare some coin...

name.en: Ask if Vsemil Snowdrop may help.

text.en: Is he playing up or something? If he wanted to help, he should have sent us food!

name.en: Offer five silver coins for the book

text.en:
What? Five silver? Hm... Okay!
I don't know why I stole that book. The Astral controlled me, I swear! I just saw it lying on a bench and I took it, I had no idea... I'll be glad to get rid of it!
What? I know nothing, I've seen nothing, I've heard nothing, I've taken nothing! I'm not nervous! Not suspicious! I know no books! Oops... I shouldn't have said that!

Runes can be removed from one item and sold or inserted into a different item. To do this, you'll need to buy a special removal pick that I can sell you. However, you must remember that every time you remove a rune, it becomes weaker. There's also a small chance that it'll be completely ruined.
I recommend obtaining a more advanced removal pick or grabbing some Rune Removal Seals from the Allods Boutique to safely remove runes. It's a small price to pay to protect such a valuable item.
Runes of a single type and level can be combined to create a more powerful rune of that same type. To do this, you'll need to buy a special welder, gold dust, and crystal chips. You can buy the welder and the gold dust from me. Crystal chips can be obtained in the Allods Boutique, auction house, or by trading with other players.
Runes must inserted into special slots. Keep in mind that not every piece of equipment has slots. However, you can always make a slot yourself with the help of an engraving kit. You can also make existing slots bigger with an engraving kit. You can find various different types of engraving kits in the Allods Boutique as well.

Good question! Know that the rune not activated can be sold at Auction House. But as soon as you use its powers, the rune becomes bound to you.
Don't forget it when you combine the runes. If at least one bound rune is used in the combining, the resulting rune will bind to you too!
